cause: A non-zero integer value is required when the following keyword attributes are specified: TIMEOUT, EXPIRE, DELAY, NEXT
solution: Correct the syntax and retry the command.

message: must use file-level media recovery on data file string
cause: The control file does not contain an entry for this file, so block media recovery cannot be done.
solution: Restore the data file and perform file-level media recovery.

message: illegal redo log block size string specified - exceeds limit of string
cause: The specified block size of the redo log is greater than the maximum block size for the operating system.
solution: Create the redo log on a device with a smaller block size

message: error in adding log file ' string ' - file cannot be created
cause: The creation of the redo log file failed
solution: Check: 1) there is enough storage space on the device 2) the name of the file is valid 3) the device is online 4) an IO error occurred Also, it is possible REUSE was specified on the command line and a file of the incorrect size exists. Either do not specify REUSE or use a file of the correct size.

message: limit of string logs exceeded
cause: The maximum number of redo log files has been exceeded.
solution: Use the CREATE CONTROLFILE command with a larger value for MAXLOGFILES if the compatibility is lower than 10.2.0. Otherwise, allocate more storage space for the control file.

message: cannot process Parallel Redo
cause: A redo log containing Parallel Redo has been detected. The current Oracle release cannot process this format of redo.
solution: Use a later release that supports Parallel Redo. to process this log.

message: requested INSTANCE_NUMBER is busy
cause: An instance tried to start by using a value of the initialization parameter INSTANCE_NUMBER that is already in use.
solution: Either a) specify another INSTANCE_NUMBER, b) shut down the running instance with this number c) wait for instance recovery to complete on the instance with this number.

message: log string of thread string inconsistent; belongs to another database
cause: The database ID in the redo log file does not match the database ID in the control file. This redo log file is not from the current database.
solution: Specify the correct redo log file, then retry the operation.

message: limit of string instances in this database
cause: Starting this instance would exceed the maximum number of instances allowed for this database. This message occurs only with STARTUP shared and multiple instances.
solution: You cannot start more than the lower of a) port-specific limit as to the number of instances b) the number of instances specified at create-database time

message: requested INSTANCE_NUMBER out of range, maximum is string
cause: The initialization parameter INSTANCE_NUMBER specified a number that was out of range.
solution: Change INSTANCE_NUMBER to a valid range and restart the instance. The minimum value is one and the maximum value is the lower of the operating system-specific maximum or the MAXINSTANCES option specified in the CREATE DATABASE statement. See also your operating system-specific Oracle documentation.

message: cannot open archived log ' string '
cause: The system cannot access a required archived redo log file.
solution: Check that the off line log exists, the storage device is online, and the archived file is in the correct location. Then attempt to continue recovery or restart the recovery session.

message: log belongs to wrong database
cause: The system cannot access the archived redo log because it belongs to another database.
solution: Specify the correct redo log file, then retry the operation.

message: archived log contains sequence string ; sequence string required
cause: The archived log is out of sequence, probably because it is corrupted or the wrong redo log filename was specified
solution: Specify the correct redo log file; then retry the operation.

message: cannot read header from archived log
cause: An I/O error occurred when attempting to read the log file header from the specified archived redo log file.
solution: Other messages will accompany this message. See the associated messages for the appropriate action to take.

message: online log string thread string : ' string '
cause: This message reports the filename for details of another message.
solution: Other messages will accompany this message. See the associated messages for the appropriate action to take.

message: open failed for members of log group string of thread string
cause: The online log cannot be opened. May not be able to find file.
solution: See accompanying errors and make log available.

message: log string of thread string , expected sequence# string doesn't match string
cause: The online log is corrupted or is an old version.
solution: Find and install correct version of log or reset logs.

message: log string of thread string , wrong thread # string in header
cause: The online log is corrupted or is an old version.
solution: Find and install correct version of log or reset logs.

message: log string of thread string , type string in header is not log file
cause: The online log is corrupted or is an old version.
solution: Find and install correct version of log or reset logs.

message: file type string in header is not log file
cause: This is not an archived log file.
solution: Find the correct file and try again.

message: log string of thread string , expected file size string doesn't match string
cause: On header read the file size indicated in the control file did not match the file size contained in the log file.
solution: Restore correct file or reset logs.

message: log string of thread string has incorrect log reset status
cause: Check of log file header at database open found that an online log has log reset data that is different from the control file. The log is probably an incorrectly restored backup.
solution: Restore correct file or reset logs.

message: cannot read file header from log string of thread string
cause: The file is not available.
solution: Restore the log file.

message: log string of thread string , cannot update log file header
cause: Cannot write to the log file.
solution: Restore the access to the file.

message: log string of thread string is not current copy
cause: Check of log file header at database open found that an online log appears to be an incorrectly restored backup.
solution: Restore correct file or reset logs.

message: Current log of thread string not useable and all others need archiving
cause: Attempt to open thread failed because it is necessary to switch redo generation to another online log, but all the other logs need to be archived before they can be used.
solution: Archive the logs for the thread then retry open.

message: log file ' string ' translated name ' string ' too long, string characters exceeds string limit
cause: the translated name for a log file is too long.
solution: Choose a untranslated name that yields a shorter translated name.

message: archived log for thread string , wrong thread # string in header
cause: The archived log is corrupted or for another thread. Can not use the log for applying redo.
solution: Find correct archived log.

message: log begins at change string , need earlier change string
cause: The archived log supplied for recovery was generated after the log that is needed. Can not yet use the log for applying redo.
solution: Find correct archived log.

message: log string of thread string , physical size string less than needed string
cause: A log file has shrunk in size. This is likely to have been caused by operator or operating system error.
solution: Restore the log file from backup. If backup is not available, drop this log and re-create. If the database was shut down cleanly, no further action should be required; otherwise incomplete recovery may be required.

message: archived log ends at change string , need later change string
cause: The archived log supplied for recovery was generated before the log that is needed. Can not use the log for applying redo.
solution: Find correct archived log.

message: archived log begins at change string , need change string
cause: The archived log is not the correct log. An earlier log is needed.
solution: Restore the correct log file.

message: archived log ends at change string , need change string
cause: The archived log is not the correct log. A later log is needed.
solution: Restore the correct log file.

message: log version string incompatible with ORACLE version string
cause: The log was written by incompatible version of Oracle.
solution: Recover the database with the compatible software, shut it down cleanly, then restart with current software.

message: archived log is too small - may be incompletely archived
cause: The log is smaller than the space allocated in it. May be the result of a shutdown abort while it was being written by the archiver.
solution: Get a complete version of this log and use it for recovery. There should either be an online version of it or a copy that was successfully archived.

message: redo log read error block string count string
cause: An IO error occurred while reading the log described in the accompanying error.
solution: Restore accessibility to file, or get another copy of the file.

message: archived log: ' string '
cause: Reporting filename for details of another error
solution: See associated error messages

message: online log string : No log with this number, log does not exist
cause: Reporting filename for details of another error
solution: See associated error messages

message: log file size string blocks is less than minimum string blocks
cause: The log file size as specified in create database is too small.
solution: Increase the log file size.

message: log file ' string ' does not exist and no size specified
cause: An attempt to add a log found neither an existing file nor a size for creating the file.
solution: Specify a size for the log file.

message: log string of thread string is more recent than control file
cause: The control file change sequence number in the log file is greater than the number in the control file. This implies that the wrong control file is being used. Note that repeatedly causing this error can make it stop happening without correcting the real problem. Every attempt to open the database will advance the control file change sequence number until it is great enough.
solution: Use the current control file or do backup control file recovery to make the control file current. Be sure to follow all restrictions on doing a backup control file recovery.

message: archived log does not contain any redo
cause: The archived log is not the correct log. It is a copy of a log file that has never been used for redo generation, or was an online log being prepared to be the current log.
solution: Restore the correct log file.

message: IO error processing online log string of thread string
cause: An IO error occurred on the named online log.
solution: Restore accessibility to file, or restore file from backup.

message: log string of thread string , wrong log # string in header
cause: The internal information in an online log file does not match the control file.
solution: Restore correct file or reset logs.

message: archived log does not have expected resetlogs SCN string
cause: Recovery was given a log that does not belong to current incarnation or one of the parent incarnation. There should be another log that contains the correct redo.
solution: Supply the correct log file.

message: unable to re-create online log ' string '
cause: An I/O failure occurred when attempting to re-create an online as part of either ALTER DATABASE OPEN RESETLOGS or ALTER DATABASE CLEAR LOGFILE command.
solution: Correct the file/device as indicated by accompanying errors.

message: redo log write error block string count string
cause: An IO error has occurred while writing the log
solution: Correct the cause of the error, and then restart the system. If the log is lost, apply media/incomplete recovery.

message: log member marked as STALE and closed
cause: A log file member was no longer complete.
solution: Correct the underlying problem by referring to the other error messages found with this one.

message: log string of thread string , expected block size string doesn't match string
cause: On header read the blocksize indicated in the control file did not match the blocksize contained in the log file.
solution: Restore correct file or reset logs.

message: single-process redo failure. Must abort instance
cause: A failure occurred during a critical portion of the log code during single process operation. This error does not occur during normal multi-process operation.
solution: Shutdown abort and warmstart the database.

message: failure obtaining block size for ' string '
cause: The operating system was unable to determine the blocksize for the given filename.
solution: Consult the accompanying error message, and correct the device or specify another filename.

message: log string of instance string (thread string ) needs to be archived
cause: The command cannot be done because the log has not been archived, and media recovery has been enabled.
solution: Archive the log or disable media recovery. If the command supports an UNARCHIVED option then it can be used. However this may result in making backups unuseable, and forcing the drop of some offline files.

message: recover-to time invalid
cause: The time specified in a recover-until statement must be after January 1st 1988.
solution: Specify a time after January 1st 1988.

message: all logs for thread string need to be archived - cannot enable
cause: Attempting to enable a thread with all logs needing to be archived, and media recovery has been enabled. There is no log that can be made the new current log for the thread.
solution: Archive a log for the thread or disable media recovery.

message: log corruption near block string change string time string
cause: Some type of redo log corruption has been discovered. This error describes the location of the corruption. Accompanying errors describe the type of corruption.
solution: Do recovery with a good version of the log or do incomplete recovery up to the indicated change or time.

message: corrupt redo log block header
cause: The block header on the redo block indicated by the accompanying error, is not reasonable.
solution: Do recovery with a good version of the log or do time based recovery up to the indicated time. If this happens when archiving, archiving of the problem log can be skipped by clearing the log with the UNARCHIVED option. This must be followed by a backup of every datafile to insure recoverability of the database.

message: change numbers out of order
cause: A change number found in the redo log is lower than a previously encountered change number. The log is corrupted in some way. The corruption may be at the earlier change or at this one.
solution: Do recovery with a good version of the log or do time based recovery up to the indicated time.

message: inconsistent lengths in change description
cause: A change record in the redo log contains lengths that do not add up to a consistent value. The log is corrupted in some way.
solution: Do recovery with a good version of the log or do time based recovery up to the indicated time.

message: too many members specified for log file, the maximum is string
cause: An add logfile or add logfile member command would result in a log with too many members. The number of members is set when the database is created.
solution: Use fewer log file members.

message: Too many file members specified, the maximum is string
cause: A create or alter statement specified too many members in a parenthesised file list.
solution: Specify a number of file members that is within the port-defined limit.

message: logfile group string does not exist
cause: An add logfile member or drop logfile request specified a logfile group number that does not exist.
solution: Check the configuration of the log files and reissue the command.

message: not a logfile member: string
cause: A filename was given to drop logfile member that is not a part of the database, or which is a data file.
solution: Supply a valid logfile member name.

message: cannot remove last log member string for group string
cause: An attempt has been made to remove the last member of a log file group.
solution: If desired, delete the entire log, by using DROP LOGFILE.

message: member is required to form a valid logfile in group string
cause: A request to drop a logfile member was denied because it would remove data required to form a complete logfile.
solution: If desired, delete the entire log (after archiving if required), by using DROP LOGFILE;

message: log is not the archived version
cause: d by failing to list the current log of an enabled thread in a CREATE CONTROLFILE command.
solution: Find the archived version of the log and supply its name. If this is media recovery immediately following a CREATE CONTROLFILE, be sure the current log for this thread was included.

message: cannot write header to new log member
cause: An i/o error occurred when attempting to write the header to a log member that is being added to an existing group.
solution: See accompanying errors. Fix problem or use another file.

message: the specified log is not the correct next log
cause: The specified log failed to pass checks to ensure it corresponds to the log that was just applied. This is probably the result of using a log that was generated against a cold backup image of the database.
solution: Find the log that was generated by this copy of the database and give that filename to recovery.

message: log string of thread string , checksum error in the file header
cause: The file header for the redo log contains a checksum that does not match the value calculated from the file header as read from disk. This means the file header is corrupted
solution: Find and install correct version of log or reset logs.

message: checksum error in log file header
cause: The file header for the redo log contains a checksum that does not match the value calculated from the file header as read from disk. This means the file header is corrupted
solution: Find the correct file and try again.

message: checksum error in redo log block
cause: The redo block indicated by the accompanying error, is not vaild. It has a checksum that does not match the block contents.
solution: Restore correct file or reset logs.

message: Current log of thread string not useable and other log being cleared
cause: Attempt to open thread failed because it is necessary to switch redo generation to another online log, but all the other logs are being cleared or need to be archived before they can be used.
solution: If the ALTER DATABASE CLEAR LOGFILE command is still active then wait for it to complete. Otherwise reissue the CLEAR command. If there are other online logs for the thread, that are not being cleared, then archive the logs.

message: potential deadlock during kcbchange operation
cause: Error code used internally by software. Should never be reported
solution: Treat as internal error. See error 600.

message: not enough shared pool memory, should be atleast string bytes
cause: Init.ora parameter shared_pool_size is too small
solution: Increase the parameter value

message: file string cannot be modified at this time
cause: attempting to modify the contents of a file that cannot be modified. The file is most likely part of a read only tablespace but may be in the process of going offline, or the database may be in the process of closing.
solution: check the status of the file and its tablespace

message: online log version string incompatible with ORACLE version string
cause: The online log was written by incompatible version of Oracle. Can occur when the log file was created by either a new or older version of Oracle.
solution: Recover the database with the compatible software, shut it down cleanly, then restart with current software.

message: parameter db_block_size = string invalid ; must be a multiple of string in the range [ string .. string ]
cause: invalid value for db_block_size parameter
solution: adjust parameter and restart

message: file string cannot be read at this time
cause: attempting to read from a file that is not readable. Most likely the file is offline.
solution: Check the state of the file. Bring it online

message: Frequent backups of file string causing write operation to stall
cause: Backups are occurring too frequently on this file. Each time a new backup is started for a file, any writes which have been previously issued (but not completed) have to be re-issued. If hot backups are started very, very frequently, it is possible that some writes will be re-issued repeatedly and never complete.
solution: Increase the interval between begin hot-backup commands for this file.

message: buffer pools cannot be created as specified
cause: Either the number of buffers or the number of lru latches is too small to satisfy the specified buffer pool configuration.
solution: Either increase the number of buffers and/or number of lru latches or configure smaller buffer pools.

message: no free buffers available in buffer pool string for block size string K
cause: All buffers in the specified buffer pool for the specified block size are in use and no free buffers are available.
solution: Increase the number of buffers in the specified pool for the specified block size

message: cannot specify db_ string k_cache_size since string K is the standard block size
cause: User specified the parameter db_nk_cache_size (where n is one of 2,4,8,16,32), while the standard block size for this database is equal to n Kbytes. This is illegal.
solution: Specify the standard block size cache using db_cache_size (DEFAULT pool) (and db_recycle_cache_size, db_keep_cache_size if additional buffer pools are required). Do NOT use the corresponding db_nk_cache_size parameter for the standard block size.

message: cannot use both new and old parameters for buffer cache size specification
cause: User specified one or more of { db_cache_size , db_recycle_cache_size, db_keep_cache_size, db_nk_cache_size (where n is one of 2,4,8,16,32), db_cache_advice } AND one or more of { db_block_buffers, buffer_pool_keep , buffer_pool_recycle }. This is illegal.
solution: Use EITHER the old (pre-Oracle_8.2) parameters OR the new ones. Don't specify both. If old size parameters are specified in the parameter file, you may want to replace them with new parameters since the new parameters can be modified dynamically and allow you to configure additional caches for additional block sizes. Cache advisory can only be enabled with the new cache parameters.

message: string not a valid block size, valid range [ string .. string ]
cause: User specified a value for db_nk_cache_size where n is one of {2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, but nk is not a valid block size for this platform.
solution: Remove corresponding parameter from the "init.ora" file and restart the instance.

message: DEFAULT cache for blocksize string cannot be reduced to zero
cause: User attempted to reduce db_cache_size to zero, or attempted to to reduce db_<n>K_cache_size to zero while there were still online tablespaces with blocksize <n>K. Note that since the SYSTEM tablespace cannot be taken offline, it is always illegal to set db_cache_size to zero.
solution: Offline any tablespaces with the corresponding blocksize and then perform the operation again.

message: Insufficient memory to grow cache
cause: The system could not allocate sufficient memory to grow the cache to the specified size.
solution: Attempt a smaller increase in the value of the parameter.

message: cannot enable Very Large Memory with new buffer cache parameters
cause: User specified one or more of { db_cache_size , db_recycle_cache_size, db_keep_cache_size, db_nk_cache_size (where n is one of 2,4,8,16,32) } AND use_indirect_data_buffers is set to TRUE. This is illegal.
solution: Very Large Memory can only be enabled with the old (pre-Oracle_8.2) parameters.

message: use_indirect_data_buffers not supported
cause: The system could not allocate sufficient memory to grow the cache to the specified size.
solution: Attempt a smaller increase in the value of the parameter.

message: log string of thread string is being cleared, cannot become current log
cause: An attempt to switch to a new online log for the redo thread failed because no reusable log could be found. This log is being cleared and will be useable when the clearing completes. The command that began the clearing may have terminated without completing the clearing.
solution: If the clear command is still executing then wait for its completion. If it terminated then reissue the clear command, or drop the log.

message: All threads must switch to new log format at the same time
cause: An attempt to switch the current log of a single thread is not allowed because the compatiblity requirements force a new log format version number. When changing log formats, all threads must switch to the new format at the same time.
solution: Open the database to cause the coordinated log switch. If that is not possible then return to the same software version and compatibility setting last used to open the database.

message: log string of thread string is being cleared, operation not allowed
cause: An operation encountered this online log in the middle of being cleared. The command that began the clearing may have terminated without completing the clearing.
solution: If the clear command is still executing then wait for its completion. If it terminated then reissue the clear command, or drop the log.

message: log string of thread string is needed for recovery of offline datafiles
cause: Log cannot be cleared because the redo in it is needed to recover offline datafiles. It has not been archived so there is no other copy available. If the log is cleared the tablespaces containing the files will have to be dropped.
solution: Archive the log then repeat the clear command. If archiving is not possible, and dropping the tablespaces is acceptible, then add the clause UNRECOVERABLE DATAFILE at the end of the clear command.

message: online log reused while attempting to archive it
cause: It has been detected that an online log that is being archived has been reused
solution: Cannot archive the logfile anymore since it has been overwritten

message: online logs for the clone database must be renamed
cause: A clone database open forces logfile renaming to avoid overwriting the primary logfiles
solution: Rename the logfiles manually or using the log_file_name_convert initialization parameter

message: error string required fallback to single-pass recovery
cause: The indicated error caused two-pass instance or crash recovery to fail. Recovery was retried with an alternate (slower) method to avoid the error.
solution: Correct the cause of the indicated error (also recorded) so that future instance or crash recovery can succeed with the two-pass algorithm. This usually requires making more main memory available to the recovery process.

message: instance recovery process terminated with error
cause: The foreground process doing instance recovery died.
solution: Check the foreground trace file for the cause of recovery failure.

message: abort thread recovery due to reconfiguration
cause: Global enqueue service reconfiguration occurred during instance/crash recovery.
solution: This is used internally, no action is required.

message: corrupt change description in redo log
cause: A change vector in the redo log failed validation checks.
solution: Do recovery with a good version of the log or do time based recovery up to the indicated time.

message: invalid release value string for parameter string
cause: The release level given for the specified init parameter is invalid.
solution: Correct the parameter value in the parameter file and retry.

message: the value for parameter string is not supported by this release
cause: The value specified cannot be supported by this release of the software.
solution: Choose an appropriate value, or remove the parameter value to use the default value.

message: database changes by release string cannot be used by release string
cause: Changes have been made to the database that require a newer software release or that violate the compatibility parameters.
solution: Use a version of the software that can understand the changes or relax the compatibility requirements in the init file.

message: string ( string ) is not the same as other instances ( string )
cause: Another instance has set the compatible or compatible no recovery parameters differently than this instance.
solution: Change the parameters of the current instance to match other instances already running.

message: Convert file not found: ' string '
cause: The file used for converting the database from V7 to V8 could not be found.
solution: Verify that the migration process has been started on this database and that the convert filename is accessable.

message: compatibility type " string "
cause: Reporting a type associated with another error.
solution: See accompanying error

message: COMPATIBLE parameter needs to be string or greater
cause: The COMPATIBLE initialization parameter is not high enough to allow the operation. Allowing the command would make the database incompatible with the release specified by the current COMPATIBLE parameter.
solution: Shutdown and startup with a higher compatibility setting.

message: rolling upgrade from release string . string to string . string is not allowed
cause: Another instance executing software at a different point release already has the database mounted.
solution: Shutdown all instances then startup with the new software.

message: parameter string is set to TRUE
cause: Reporting the parameter that resulted in the compatibility error.
solution: Shutdown and startup with a higher compatibility setting.

message: COMPATIBLE needs to be string or higher to use AUTO SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT
cause: This is due to migrating from an older release of Oracle with tablespaces created using AUTO SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT. To open the database, the COMPATIBLE parameter needs to be set to the specified value.
solution: Shutdown and startup with the specified compatibility setting.

message: ORACLE feature is not licensed. Contact Oracle Corp. for assistance
cause: ORACLE feature is not licensed.
solution: Contact ORACLE for assistance.

message: string Option not installed
cause: The specified option is not installed.
solution: Purchase and install the option.

message: feature not enabled: string
cause: The specified feature is not enabled.
solution: Do not attempt to use this feature.

message: background process " string " did not start
cause: The specified process did not start.
solution: Ensure that the executable image is in the correct place with the correct protections, and that there is enough memory.

message: background process " string " failed while starting
cause: Usually due to a bad (or non-existent) background process image.
solution: Get a good background process image.

message: background process " string " did not start after string seconds
cause: The specified process did not start after the specified time.
solution: Ensure that the background did not die and leave a trace file.

message: background process started when not expected
cause: The background process specified started up AFTER the RDBMS was already running.
solution: If nobody at your site started the process, then this is an internal error.

message: fatal error in background process
cause: One of the background processes died unexpectedly.
solution: Warm start the system.

message: normal completion of background process
cause: One of the background processes completed normally (i.e. exited). The background process thinks that somebody asked it to exit.
solution: Warm start the system.

message: background process ' string ' unexpectedly terminated with error string
cause: A foreground process needing service from a background process has discovered the process died.
solution: Consult the error code, and the trace file for the process.

message: background process ' string ' did not start
cause: The specified process did not start.
solution: Consult the error code, and the trace file for the process.

message: foreground process died unexpectedly
cause: The foreground process for the new connection did not start.
solution: Reconnect to Oracle.

message: foreground process unexpectedly terminated with error string
cause: The foreground process for the new connection did not start.
solution: Reconnect to Oracle.

message: backgroud process ' string ' is dead
cause: The background process that was being messaged was dead or its incarnation was invalid.
solution: Restart the background process.

message: CKPT process terminated with error
cause: The checkpoint process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: LGWR process terminated with error
cause: The log writer process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: DBWR process terminated with error
cause: The database writer process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: PMON process terminated with error
cause: The process cleanup process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: ARCH process terminated with error
cause: The archive process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: SMON process terminated with error
cause: The system cleanup process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: TRWR process terminated with error
cause: The system tracing process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: RECO process terminated with error
cause: The distributed transaction (two-phase commit) recovery process died.
solution: Warm start instance

message: SNP* process terminated with error
cause: A materialized view refresh process died
solution: PMON will restart SNP process shortly. If SNP process does not get started, contact Oracle support.

message: SMON process terminated due to error string
cause: SMON was unable to service the requests due to error in cleanup of resources
solution: Warm start instance

message: RVWR process terminated with error string
cause: The RVWR process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: LCK* process terminated with error
cause: A system lock process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: LMON process terminated with error
cause: The global enqueue service monitor process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: LMD* process terminated with error
cause: A global enqueue service daemon process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: During shutdown a process abnormally terminated
cause: One of the background processes did not exit normally at or near the time of shutdown.
solution: Use shutdown abort.

message: LMS* process terminated with error
cause: A global cache service process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: DIAG process terminated with error string
cause: A global diagnostic process died
solution: Wait for process to restart

message: ASMB process terminated with error
cause: An ASM background process died.
solution: Warm start instance. Also check that ASM Instance is running.

message: CTWR process terminated with error
cause: The change tracking process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: RBAL process terminated with error
cause: The ASM rebalance coordinator process died.
solution: Warm start instance.

message: ARB* process terminated with error
cause: An ASM rebalance worker process died.
solution: Wait for process to restart.

message: PSP process terminated with error
cause: The process spawner died
solution: Warm start instance

message: RMS0 process terminated with error
cause: The RAC Management Process died
solution: None

message: GTX* process terminated with error
cause: A global transaction background process died.
solution: Warm start instance

message: GMON process terminated with error
cause: The ASM disk group monitor process died
solution: Warm start instance

message: enqueue string held for too long (more than string seconds) by 'inst string , osid string '
cause: The specified process did not release the enqueue within the maximum allowed time.
solution: Reissue any commands that failed and contact Oracle Support Services with the incident information.

message: GEN0 process terminated with error
cause: The generic background processing process died.
solution: Warm start the instance.

message: LMHB process terminated with error
cause: The LM heartbeat monitor process died.
solution: Warm start the instance.

message: XDMG process terminated with error
cause: The Cell automation manager process terminated with error.
solution: PMON will restart XDMG process shortly. If XDMG process does not restart, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: XDWK process terminated with error
cause: The Cell automation worker actions process terminated with error.
solution: PMON will restart XDWK process shortly. If XDWK process does not restart, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: XDMG repeatedly failed to initialize terminating the instance.
cause: The Cell automation manager process repeatedly failed to initialize.
solution: Examine the alert log for the reason prior attempts to start XDMG failed. If it is due to user error or bad configuration, fix it and restart the instance. Otherwise, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: cannot request processor group - NUMA not enabled
cause: Cannot start process in a requested processor group when the NUMA feature is disabled.
solution: Start the process without requesting a NUMA processor group.

message: Requested processor group string is too large (maximum string )
cause: The process could not be started in the requested processor group.
solution: Start the process in another processor group.

message: Maximum number of interrupt handlers exceeded
cause: User specified too many ^c handlers
solution: Remove some old handlers.

message: Failed to acquire global enqueue.
cause: A prior error occurred on one of the instances in the cluster. Typically errors are caused by shared pool resource contention.
solution: Check for and resolve prior errors on all instances in the cluster. If there is shared pool resource contention, increase the SHARED_POOL_SIZE, DML_LOCKS, PROCESSES, TRANSACTIONS, CLUSTER_DATABASE_INSTANCES and PARALLEL_MAX_SERVERS initialization parameters.

message: cleanup lock conflict
cause: PMON process runs into lock conflict trying to recovery processes
solution: This is trapped internally, no action necessary

message: internal programming exception
cause: Internal programming exception
solution: Report as bug

message: ORACLE server session terminated by fatal error
cause: An ORACLE server session was in an unrecoverable state.
solution: Login to ORACLE again so a new server session will be created

message: error occurred at recursive SQL level string
cause: An error occurred while processing a recursive SQL statement (a statement applying to internal dictionary tables).
solution: If the situation described in the next error on the stack can be corrected, do so; otherwise contact Oracle Support.

message: Internal error code
cause: A call to deferred upi functions was made in non deferred mode
solution: Report as a bug.

message: Internal error occurred while making a change to a data block
cause: An internal error or memory exception occurred while Oracle was applying redo to a data block.
solution: call Oracle Support

message: testing error [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: Internal error reserved for testing.
solution: call Oracle Support

message: could not attach to incoming connection
cause: Oracle process could not answer incoming connection
solution: If the situation described in the next error on the stack can be corrected, do so; otherwise contact Oracle Support.

message: Internal error code
cause: Oracle process started too late
solution: This error should never be seen by the customer. Contact Oraclce Support

message: soft internal error, arguments: [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ]
cause: Internal inconsistency that will not crash a process
solution: Report as a bug - the first argument is the internal error.

message: object necessary for warmstarting database cannot be altered
cause: Attempt to alter or drop a database object (table, cluster, or index) which are needed for warmstarting the database.
solution: None

message: bootstrap verison ' string ' inconsistent with version ' string '
cause: The reading version of the boostrap is incompatible with the current bootstrap version.
solution: Restore a version of the software that is compatible with this bootstrap version.

message: maximum number of row cache instance locks exceeded
cause: There are not enough row cache enqueues.
solution: Increase the row cache enqueue parameter and warm start the system.

message: bootstrap process failure
cause: Failure in processing bootstrap data - see accompanying error.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: inconsistent state during start up; shut down the instance, then restart it
cause: A previous attempt to start an instance was terminated.
solution: Shut down the instance completely, then restart it.

message: error changing format of file ' string '
cause: An attempt to change the block0 format of the specified file failed because the file is read-only or offline.
solution: Make the file read-write or bring the file online and set the BLK0_FMTCHG event.

message: new tablespace name is the same as the old tablespace name
cause: An attempt to rename a tablespace failed because the new name is the same as the old name.
solution: No action required.

message: new tablespace name is invalid
cause: An attempt to rename a tablespace failed because the new name is invalid.
solution: Choose a valid new name and retry the command.

message: cannot rename system tablespace
cause: An attempt to rename the system tablespace failed.
solution: No action required.

message: ALTER DATABASE RESET COMPATIBILITY command has been de-supported
cause: ALTER DATABASE RESET COMPATIBILITY command has been de-supported since Oracle 10i.
solution: No action required.

message: changes by release string cannot be used by release string
cause: An attempt to import a tablespace failed because the tablespace contains changes that require a newer software release or that violate the compatibility parameters.
solution: Use a version of the software that can understand the changes or relax the compatibility requirements in the initialization parameter file.

message: Feature " string "
cause: Reporting name of the feature for details of another error.
solution: See associated error message.

message: Initialization parameter COMPATIBLE must be explicitly set
cause: Oracle detected that the initialization parameter COMPATIBLE was not explicitly specified, and the compatibility of the database is lower than the default value of the COMPATIBLE parameter. In order to use the new compatible setting, the intialization parameter must be explicitly set by the user.
solution: Explicitly set the value of COMPATIBLE parameter either in PFILE or SPFILE, whichever is used.

message: ALTER DATABASE CONVERT command has been de-supported
cause: ALTER DATABASE CONVERT command has been de-supported since Oracle 10i.
solution: No action required.

message: Desupported ALTER DATABASE SET STANDBY clause specified: string
cause: A deprecated ALTER DATABASE SET STANDBY was specified.
solution: No action required.

message: datafile size of ( string ) blocks exceeds maximum file size
cause: The user specified datafile size exceeded maximum file size.
solution: Please check REFERENCE for maximum size. Reduce the size and retry.

message: logfile size of ( string ) blocks exceeds maximum logfile size
cause: The user specified logfile size exceeded maximum logfile size.
solution: Please check REFERENCE for maximum size. Reduce the size and retry.

message: Log read detects lost write in thread number sequence number block number
cause: Either a write issued by Oracle was lost by the underlying operating system or storage system or an Oracle internal error occurred.
solution: The trace file shows the lost write location. Dump the problematic log file to see whether it is a real lost write. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: database has been previously mounted and dismounted
cause: The instance has already mounted and dismounted the database, which is only allowed once in its lifetime.
solution: Shut down the database.

message: could not obtain resilvering status for file
cause: An error occurred while obtaining the mirror resilvering status of a file.
solution: Refer to other error messages shown for additional details of the problem.

message: recovery detected a lost write of a data block
cause: A write of a data block to storage was lost during normal database operation on the primary database.
solution: Shutdown the primary database and activate the physical standby database to failover. See the Data Guard Concepts and Administration guide for details.

message: Specified value of sga_max_size is too small, needs to be at least string M
cause: The specified value of sga_max_size is too small for the SGA to accommodate all of the necessary SGA components such as the log buffer, buffer pools, shared pool, etc.
solution: Set sga_max_size to the recommended value or reduce the values of any SGA component size parameters you have specified.

message: Specified value of sga_target string M is too small, needs to be at least string M
cause: The specified value of sga_target is too small for the SGA to accommodate all of the necessary SGA components such as the log buffer, buffer pools, shared pool, etc.
solution: Set sga_target to the recommended value or reduce the values of any SGA component size parameters you have specified.

message: MMAN process terminated with error
cause: The Memory Management process died.
solution: Warm start instance

message: Specified value of sga_target greater than sga_max_size
cause: The specified value of sga_target is greater than sga_max_size.
solution: Increase sga_max_size to match up with sga_target or decrease sga_target to match up with sga_maxsize.

message: cannot set SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET due to existing internal settings
cause: Could not set SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET due to current parameter settings.
solution: Check the other error messages for additional information.

message: cannot set DB_BLOCK_BUFFERS if SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET is set
cause: SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET set with DB_BLOCK_BUFFERS set.
solution: Do not set SGA_TARGET, MEMORY_TARGET or use new cache parameters, and do not use DB_BLOCK_BUFFERS which is an old cache parameter.

message: cannot set SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET for an ASM instance
cause: SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET set for an ASM instance.
solution: Do not set SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET.

message: could not shrink sga_target to specified value
cause: Attempted to shrink the SGA to the specified value but did not succeed because the SGA components could not be shrunk as they were already at their minimum sizes.
solution: Do not set sga_target to a value below the current value without first shrinking the individual SGA components.

message: specified value of shared_pool_reserved_size inconsistent with internal settings
cause: Unable to set shared_pool_reserved_size to specified value if SGA_TARGET set, either because the specified value is too small, or because it is too large for the current internal size of shared pool. More details can be found in the alert log.
solution: If possible, do not set shared_pool_reserved_size without setting shared_pool_size if SGA_TARGET set. Examine the alert log for information about current internal size of shared pool, and valid range of values for shared_pool_reserved_size.

message: cannot set statistics_level to BASIC with auto-tune SGA enabled
cause: The user attempted to set statistics_level to BASIC with auto-tune SGA enabled which cannot be done because auto-tune SGA cannot work with statistics_level set to BASIC.
solution: Disable auto-tune SGA and try setting the statistics_level to BASIC again.

message: no streams pool created and cannot automatically create one
cause: A database feature which needs STREAMS SGA was being used, however, the streams_pool_size parameter was not defined and the value of db_cache_size was too small to permit an automatic transfer of SGA to the streams pool from the buffer cache.
solution: Please set the parameter streams_pool_size or set SGA_TARGET.

message: Specified value of MEMORY_TARGET greater than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET
cause: The specified value of MEMORY_TARGET was greater than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.
solution: Set MEMORY_TARGET less than or equal to MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.

message: Specified value of MEMORY_TARGET is too small, needs to be at least string M
cause: The specified value of MEMORY_TARGET was less than the sum of the specified values for SGA_TARGET and PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET.
solution: Set MEMORY_TARGET to at least the recommended value.

message: SGA_TARGET cannot be modified to the specified value
cause: The specified value of SGA_TARGET was not compatible with current settings of PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET and MEMORY_TARGET/MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.
solution: Set SGA_TARGET to be no more than the difference of MEMORY_TARGET/MEMORY_MAX_TARGET and PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET. Also ensure that the current PGA memory used for non-auto workareas is low.

message: PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET cannot be modified to the specified value
cause: The specified value of PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET was not compatible with current settings of SGA_TARGET and MEMORY_TARGET/MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.
solution: Set PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET to be no more than the difference of MEMORY_TARGET/MEMORY_MAX_TARGET and SGA_TARGET.

message: MEMORY_TARGET not supported on this system
cause: MEMORY_TARGET parameter was not supported on this system as shmfs was disabled.
solution: Refer to documentation for a list of supported systems.

message: DB_BLOCK_BUFFERS cannot be set with SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET
cause: DB_BLOCK_BUFFERS was incompatible with SGA_TARGET and MEMORY_TARGET.
solution: Remove the incompatible parameter setting.

message: Parameter not taking MEMORY_MAX_TARGET into account
cause: The parameter was larger than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.
solution: Check the other error messages for additional information about the parameter. Set the parameter to a lower value than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.

message: Parameter not taking MEMORY_TARGET into account
cause: The parameter was larger than MEMORY_TARGET.
solution: Check the other error messages for additional information about the parameter. Set the parameter to a lower value than MEMORY_TARGET.

message: MEMORY_TARGET not supported on this system
cause: The MEMORY_TARGET parameter was not supported on this operating system or /dev/shm was not sized correctly on Linux.
solution: Refer to documentation for a list of supported operating systems. Or, size /dev/shm to be at least the SGA_MAX_SIZE on each Oracle instance running on the system.

message: could not shrink MEMORY_TARGET to specified value
cause: Attempted to shrink MEMORY_TARGET to the specified value but did not succeed because the PGA and SGA components could not be shrunk.
solution: Do not set MEMORY_TARGET to a value below the current value without first shrinking the individual memory components.

message: MEMORY_TARGET/MEMORY_MAX_TARGET and LOCK_SGA cannot be set together
cause: MEMORY_TARGET/MEMORY_MAX_TARGET was set to a non-zero value and LOCK_SGA was also set
solution: Do not set MEMORY_TARGET or MEMORY_MAX_TARGET if LOCK_SGA is set to TRUE.

message: STATISTICS_LEVEL cannot be set to BASIC with SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET
cause: STATISTICS_LEVEL of BASIC was incompatible with SGA_TARGET and MEMORY_TARGET.
solution: Fix the incompatible parameter setting. Set STATISTICS_LEVEL to TYPICAL or ALL to use SGA_TARGET or MEMORY_TARGET.

message: SGA_TARGET string cannot be set to more than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET string .
cause: SGA_TARGET value was more than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET value.
solution: Set SGA_TARGET to be less than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.

message: PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET string cannot be set to more than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET string .
cause: PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET value was more than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET value.
solution: Set PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET to be less than MEMORY_MAX_TARGET.

message: SGA_MAX_SIZE string cannot be set to more than MEMORY_TARGET string .
cause: SGA_MAX_SIZE value was more than MEMORY_TARGET value.
solution: Set SGA_MAX_SIZE to be less than MEMORY_TARGET.

message: Rolling migration monitor process terminated.
cause: The ASM rolling migration monitor process died.
solution: Warm start the instance.

message: specified length too long for its datatype
cause: for datatypes CHAR and RAW, the length specified was > 2000; otherwise, the length specified was > 4000.
solution: use a shorter length or switch to a datatype permitting a longer length such as a VARCHAR2, LONG CHAR, or LONG RAW

message: invalid character
cause: identifiers may not start with any ASCII character other than letters and numbers. $#_ are also allowed after the first character. Identifiers enclosed by doublequotes may contain any character other than a doublequote. Alternative quotes (q'#...#') cannot use spaces, tabs, or carriage returns as delimiters. For all other contexts, consult the SQL Language Reference Manual.
solution: None

message: input parameter too long
cause: one of your input strings was too long
solution: shorten the input parameter length

message: missing or invalid index name
cause: An index name of the form [ <identifier> . ] <identifier> is expected but not present. If OIDINDEX clause, index name must be <identifier>
solution: Enter an appropriate index name.

message: missing or invalid auditing option
cause: AUDIT or NOAUDIT statement contains an invalid auditing option.
solution: Use a valid option.

message: ambiguous column naming in select list
cause: A column name in the order-by list matches more than one select list columns.
solution: Remove duplicate column naming in select list.

message: too many group-by / order-by expressions
cause: The group-by or order-by column list contain more than 1000 expressions.
solution: Use 1000 or less expressions in the group-by or order-by list.

message: table name not in FROM list
cause: The table name referred in the select list is not specified in the from list.
solution: Make sure the name is correctly specified and matches one of the names in the from list.

message: column aliases not allowed for '*'
cause: The statement is trying to alias the * expression in the select list which is not legal.
solution: Remove the alias.

message: identifier is too long
cause: An identifier with more than 30 characters was specified.
solution: Specify at most 30 characters.

message: Specified pseudocolumn or operator not allowed here.
cause: LEVEL, PRIOR, ROWNUM, CONNECT_BY_ROOT, CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF or CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE was specified at an illegal location.
solution: Remove LEVEL, PRIOR, ROWNUM, CONNECT_BY_ROOT, CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF or CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE.

message: duplicate auditing option
cause: AUDIT or NOAUDIT statement specifies an option more than once
solution: Either use ALL with no other auditing options or make sure no option is listed more than once.

message: synonym translation is no longer valid
cause: A synonym did not translate to a legal target object. This could happen for one of the following reasons: 1. The target schema does not exist. 2. The target object does not exist. 3. The synonym specifies an incorrect database link. 4. The synonym is not versioned but specifies a versioned target object.
solution: Change the synonym definition so that the synonym points at a legal target object.

message: cannot mix table and system auditing options
cause: Table and system-wide auditing options were specified in the same AUDIT or NOAUDIT statement.
solution: You must issue table and system options in separate statements.

message: cannot audit or noaudit SYS user actions
cause: An attempt was made to AUDIT or NOAUDIT SYS user actions.
solution: Execute the statement again with a valid user.

message: only MAC privileges may be granted to procedures
cause: Object privileges or non-MAC system privileges were granted to the procedure.
solution: Only grant MAC privileges using the PROCEDURE clause.

message: fetch out of sequence
cause: This error means that a fetch has been attempted from a cursor which is no longer valid. Note that a PL/SQL cursor loop implicitly does fetches, and thus may also cause this error. There are a number of possible causes for this error, including: 1) Fetching from a cursor after the last row has been retrieved and the ORA-1403 error returned. 2) If the cursor has been opened with the FOR UPDATE clause, fetching after a COMMIT has been issued will return the error. 3) Rebinding any placeholders in the SQL statement, then issuing a fetch before reexecuting the statement.
solution: 1) Do not issue a fetch statement after the last row has been retrieved - there are no more rows to fetch. 2) Do not issue a COMMIT inside a fetch loop for a cursor that has been opened FOR UPDATE. 3) Reexecute the statement after rebinding, then attempt to fetch again.

message: invalid OCI operation
cause: One of the following: 1) You attempted an invalid OCI operation. 2) You are using an Oracle client application linked with version 7.1 (or higher) libraries, the environment variable ORA_ENCRYPT_LOGIN is set to TRUE, and you attempted to connect to a version 7.0 (or lower) Oracle Server. 3) You are connected to a version 7.1 (or higher) Oracle Server, the initialization parameter DBLINK_ENCRYPT_LOGIN is set to TRUE, and you attempted to use a database link pointing to a version 7.0 (or lower) Oracle Server. 4) You are connected to a version 9.0.2(or higher) Oracle Server and you attempted to use a database link pointing to a version 9.0.1(or lower) Oracle Server for distributed autonomous transaction.
solution: For the above causes: 1) Do not use the invalid OCI operation. 2) If you do not wish to use encrypted connect passwords in your distributed database, set ORA_ENCRYPT_LOGIN to FALSE. If you wish to use encrypted connect passwords, you must upgrade all Oracle Servers to version 7.1 (or higher). 3) If you do not wish to use encrypted database links in your distributed database, set DBLINK_ENCRYPT_LOGIN to FALSE. If you wish to use encrypted database links, you must upgrade all Oracle Servers to version 7.1 (or higher). 4) Do not attempt distributed autonomous transaction on version 9.0.1(or lower) Oracle Server.

message: This function can be called only after a fetch
cause: Cursor in an invalid state.
solution: Make sure that the oci/upi function is called after fetch.

message: unable to allocate memory in the user side
cause: The user side memory allocator returned error.
solution: Increase the processes heap size or switch to the old set of calls.

message: database operation not supported in this configuration
cause: The attempted database operation does not conform to the user programming interface (UPI) for the two communicating ORACLE servers.
solution: You may need to upgrade one or more of your ORACLE servers or re-link your user side application with new libraries. Report the problem to Worldwide Customer Support.

message: Cursor context not found (Invalid cursor number)
cause: The cursor number is not a valid open cursor.
solution: Make sure that the cursor is open.

message: UPI parameter out of range
cause: An integer parameter to a upi function is out of range.
solution: This usually indicates an error in a tool built on top of the oracle dbms. Report the error to your customer support representative.

message: multiple buffers of size > 4000 in the bind list
cause: More than one long buffer in the bind list.
solution: Change the buffer size to be less than 4000 for the bind variable bound to a normal column.

message: bind variables not allowed for data definition operations
cause: An attempt was made to use a bind variable in a SQL data definition operation.
solution: Such bind variables are not allowed.

message: internal two task error
cause: Received send long message but don't have the cursor context.
solution: Report as a bug.

message: internal two task error
cause: Received a request to send the long again when there is no long
solution: Report as a bug

message: SELECT ... INTO variable does not exist
cause: The SELECT... INTO specified in the bind call does not correspond to a variable in the SQL statement.
solution: If it is not possible to correct the statement, call customer support.

message: no such userid
cause: This is an internal error message related to Export/Import.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: ORACLE initialization or shutdown in progress
cause: An attempt was made to log on while Oracle is being started up or shutdown.
solution: Wait a few minutes. Then retry the operation.

message: ORACLE not available
cause: Oracle was not started up. Possible causes include the following: - The SGA requires more space than was allocated for it. - The operating-system variable pointing to the instance is improperly defined.
solution: Refer to accompanying messages for possible causes and correct the problem mentioned in the other messages. If Oracle has been initialized, then on some operating systems, verify that Oracle was linked correctly. See the platform specific Oracle documentation.

message: ORACLE only available to users with RESTRICTED SESSION privilege
cause: Logins are disallowed because an instance started in restricted mode. Only users with RESTRICTED SESSION system privilege can log on.
solution: Request that Oracle be restarted without the restricted option or obtain the RESTRICTED SESSION system privilege.

message: illegal variable name/number
cause: Unable to find bind context on user side
solution: Make sure that the variable being bound is in the sql statement.

message: maximum cursor memory exceeded
cause: Attempting to process a complex sql statement which consumed all available memory of the cursor.
solution: Simplify the complex sql statement.

message: cannot write database file version string with ORACLE version string
cause: Attempting to write datafile headers in an old format. The new format can not be used until after the database has been verified as being compatible with this software version.
solution: Open the database to advance to the new file formats, then repeat the operation. If the operation is required before the database can be opened, then use the previous software release to do the operation.

message: insufficient privileges on underlying objects of the view
cause: Attempting to explain plan on other people's view without the necessary privileges on the underlying objects of the view.
solution: Get necessary privileges or do not perform the offending operation.

message: invalid character in password; logon denied
cause: There are multibyte characters in the password or some characters in the password are not in US7ASCII range.
solution: Resubmit password with valid characters.

message: internal error. hostdef extension doesn't exist
cause: Pointer to hstdef extension in hstdef is null.
solution: Report as a bug

message: detaching a session with open cursors not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to detach a seesio n which had open cursors.
solution: Close all the cursors before detaching the session.

message: user side memory corruption [ string ], [ string ], [ string ], [ string ]
cause: The application code corrupted some of the usr memory used by oracle
solution: Make sure that the application code is not overwriting memory.

message: size string of buffer bound to variable exceeds maximum string
cause: An attempt was made to bind a buffer whose total size would exceed the maximum size allowed. Total array size for arrays is calculated as: (element_size)*(number of elements)
solution: Reduce buffer size.

message: Couldn't find the specified procedure in the given context
cause: The procedure user specified in deferred RPC doesn't exist.
solution: Check to make sure that the procedure exists and is visible to the replication process.

message: Bind by name is not spupportted in streamed RPC
cause: A newer version of server is talking with this version requesting an operation not supported in this version.
solution: None

message: deferred rpc buffer format invalid
cause: The deferred rpc data in sys.def$_call is corrupted.
solution: Contact your customer support representive.

message: required destination LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST is not specified
cause: A valid destination for parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST was not specified when parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST was set to two.
solution: Either specify a value for parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST, or reduce the value for parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST to one.

message: Object datatypes not supported for bind or define in this mode
cause: Bind or Define used for objects with an invalid mode
solution: Change the mode.

message: internal New Upi interface error
cause: Attempt to delete non existant hstdef extension.
solution: Report as a bug.

message: parse expected before a bind or execute
cause: The client application attempted to bind a variable or execute a cursor opened in a PL/SQL block before the statement was parsed.
solution: Ensure the statement is parsed before a bind or execute.

message: array binds or executes not allowed
cause: The client application attempted to bind an array of cursors or attempted to repeatedly execute against a PL/SQL block with a bind variable of type cursor.
solution: Bind a single cursor or execute the PL/SQL block once.

message: cannot start up a V8 server using a V7 client application
cause: You are using an Oracle client application linked with version 7 (or lower) libraries and you attempted to start up a V8 (or higher) server.
solution: Use a client application linked with V8 (or higher) libraries.60

message: unable to allocate memory for define buffer
cause: Exceeded the maximum buffer size for current plaform
solution: Use piecewise fetch with a smaller buffer size

message: Using an old version of Oracle for the server
cause: Using pre 7.0.10.1 version of oracle for server
solution: Upgrade server to post 7.0.10.1 version

message: cannot perform operation without starting up ORACLE
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: cannot stop ORACLE; ORACLE not running
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: fatal connection error: unrecognized call type
cause: An illegal internal operation was attempted.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: cannot shut down ORACLE; inside a login session - log off first
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: you are currently logged on
cause: Attempt to login while logged in.
solution: None

message: multiple logons per process not yet supported
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: background process initialization failure
cause: Failure during initialization of ORACLE background processes.
solution: Further diagnostic information should be in the error stack or in the trace file.

message: failure in processing system parameters
cause: Failure during processing of INIT.ORA parameters during system startup.
solution: Further diagnostic information should be in the error stack.

message: ORACLE database was not properly created, operation aborted
cause: There was an error when the database or control file was created.
solution: s to recreate the database or a new control file.

message: error in shutting down ORACLE
cause: Failure during system shutdown.
solution: Further diagnostic information should be in the error stack.

message: cannot start already-running ORACLE - shut it down first
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: 'row_locking = always' requires the transaction processing option
cause: "row_locking = always" is specified in INIT.ORA file. This feature is not supported by ORACLE without the transaction processing option.
solution: Remove it from INIT.ORA file or set it to "default" or "intent".

message: value of parameter " string " is inconsistent with that of other instances
cause: The value of the given parameter is required to be the same for all instances in the cluster database configuration. ROW_LOCKING and SERIALIZABLE are 2 examples.
solution: Change the value of the parameter in INIT.ORA file to match that of other cluster database instances.

message: invalid argument in OCI call
cause: The failing OCI call contains an argument with an invalid value.
solution: Use valid argument values. For more information, see the Programmer's Guide to the Oracle Call Interfaces and the appropriate programming language supplement.

message: preceding errors in deferred rpc to " string . string . string "
cause: Errors were encountered when the named procedure was executed as a deferred remoted procedure call.
solution: Correct the cause of the preceding errors.

message: savepoint ' string ' never established in this session or is invalid
cause: An attempt was made to roll back to a savepoint that was never established in this session, or was invalid.
solution: Try rolling back to the savepoint from the session where it is established.

message: shutdown in progress - operation not permitted until restart
cause: The SHUTDOWN command was used to shut down a running Oracle instance but the shutdown operation was not complete.
solution: Wait for the instance to be restarted or contact your database administrator.

message: immediate shutdown in progress - no operations are permitted
cause: The SHUTDOWN IMMEDIATE command was used to shut down a running ORACLE instance, so your operations have been terminated.
solution: Wait for the instance to be restarted, or contact your DBA.

message: shutdown in progress - connection is not permitted
cause: The SHUTDOWN command was used to shut down a running ORACLE instance, so you cannot connect to ORACLE.
solution: Wait for the instance to be restarted, or contact your DBA.

message: failure during startup force
cause: Unable to destroy the old SGA.
solution: Manually remove the old SGA and reissue the STARTUP command

message: ORACLE instance terminated. Disconnection forced
cause: The instance this process was connected to was terminated abnormally, probably via a shutdown abort. This process was forced to disconnect from the instance.
solution: Examine the alert log for more details. When the instance has been restarted, retry action.

message: ALTER DATABASE CLOSE only permitted with no sessions connected
cause: There is at least one more session other than the current one logged into the instance. ALTER DATABASE CLOSE is not permitted.
solution: Find the other sessions and log them out and resubmit the command

message: DML statement processed zero rows
cause: During a call to OTEX, an update, delete, or insert statement being executed processed zero rows. The execution of statements by OTEX was halted at this point.
solution: None

message: program version ( string ) incompatible with instance ( string )
cause: A program is trying to connect to an instance using a different version of code than the database was started with. This is not allowed.
solution: Either relink the program with the same version as the database or restart the database using the old version of code.

message: cannot shutdown while in a transaction - commit or rollback first
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: cannot mount database in SHARED mode if started in single process mode
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: database already mounted
cause: A database is already mounted in this instance.
solution: None

message: database being created currently mounted by some other instance
cause: Some other instance has the database of same name currently mounted and you are trying to create it.
solution: Either change the database name or shutdown the other instance.

message: cannot mount database in EXCLUSIVE mode
cause: Some other instance has the database mounted exclusive or shared.
solution: Shutdown other instance or mount in a compatible mode.

message: database name ' string ' in control file is not ' string '
cause: The database name in the control file does not match your database name.
solution: Either find the correct control file or change your database name.

message: number of control files ( string ) does not equal string
cause: The number of control files used by this instance disagrees with the number of control files in an existing instance.
solution: Check to make sure that all control files are listed.

message: mount is incompatible with mounts by other instances
cause: An attempt to mount the database discovered that another instance mounted a database by the same name, but the mount is not compatible. Additional errors are reported explaining why.
solution: See accompanying errors.

message: database must be closed before dismounting
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: database must be mounted for media recovery
cause: An attempt to perform media recovery was made but the database is not mounted.
solution: Mount the database.

message: file string is in backup or media recovery
cause: Either media recovery is actively being applied to the file, or it is being backed up while the database is in NOARCHIVELOG mode. It cannot be used for normal database access or crash recovery.
solution: Complete or cancel the media recovery session or backup.

message: database not open
cause: A command was attempted that requires the database to be open.
solution: Open the database and try the command again

message: data file string : ' string '
cause: Reporting file name for details of another error. The reported name can be of the old file if a data file move operation is in progress.
solution: See associated error message.

message: name for data file string is unknown - rename to correct file
cause: The data file was missing from a CREATE CONTROLFILE command or backup control file recovery was done with a control file that was saved before the file was created.
solution: Rename the MISSING file to the name of the real file.

message: media recovery not started
cause: An attempt to continue media recovery is being made but media recovery was not started.
solution: None

message: file string needs media recovery
cause: An attempt was made to online or open a database with a file that is in need of media recovery.
solution: First apply media recovery to the file.

message: IO error writing block to file string (block # string )
cause: The device on which the file resides is probably offline. If the file is a temporary file, then it is also possible that the device has run out of space. This could happen because disk space of temporary files is not necessarily allocated at file creation time.
solution: Restore access to the device or remove unnecessary files to free up space.

message: IO error reading block from file string (block # string )
cause: Device on which the file resides is probably offline
solution: Restore access to the device

message: error in opening database file string
cause: Usually the file is not accessible.
solution: Restore the database file.

message: adding file ' string ' with illegal block size: string ; limit is string
cause: An attempt was made to add a database file with a block size that is greater than the maximum block size allowed.
solution: Retry the DDL command with a smaller block size.

message: cannot add any more database files: limit of string exceeded
cause: There is no more room in the control file for adding database files.
solution: Resize the control file or drop other tablespaces.

message: error in creating database file ' string '
cause: Usually due to not having enough space on the device.
solution: None

message: cannot remove online database file string
cause: Attempting to drop a datafile when it is online
solution: Take file offline before dropping.

message: cannot rename database file string - file is in use or recovery
cause: Attempted to use ALTER DATABASE RENAME to rename a datafile that is online in an open instance or is being recovered.
solution: Close database in all instances and end all recovery sessions.

message: database file string failed verification check
cause: The information in this file is inconsistent with information from the control file. See accompanying message for reason.
solution: Make certain that the db files and control files are the correct files for this database.

message: cannot start online backup; media recovery not enabled
cause: An attempt to start backup of an on-line tablespace failed because media recovery is not enabled.
solution: Enable media recovery and retry this operation.

message: cannot recover data file string - file is in use or recovery
cause: An attempt to do media recovery found that the file was not available for recovery. Either it is online and the database is open in some instance, or another process is curently doing media recovery on the file.
solution: Do not do media recovery.

message: cannot disable media recovery - file string has online backup set
cause: An attempt to disable media recovery found that an online backup is still in progress.
solution: End the backup of the offending tablespace and retry this command.

message: database must be mounted in this instance and not open in any instance
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: database name ' string ' exceeds size limit of string characters
cause: Obvious
solution: None

message: cannot start online backup - file string is offline
cause: An attempt to start an online backup found that one of the files is offline.
solution: Bring the offending files online and retry this command or do a cold backup.

message: user's default or temporary tablespace does not exist
cause: The user's default or temporary tablespace was dropped.
solution: Reassign the default or temporary tablespace.

message: file string accessed for DML/query is offline
cause: Attempted to access a data file that is offline
solution: Bring the data file back online

message: specified size of file string ( string blocks) is less than original size of string blocks
cause: A file size was specified in the AS clause of ALTER DATABASE CREATE DATAFILE, and the size was smaller the the size needed
solution: Create the file with a larger size.

message: data file string is still in the middle of going offline
cause: It was not possible to get the lock for a file that is offline when attempting to bring it online. The most likely cause is that the lock is still held by the instance that is took it offline.
solution: Wait a bit and try to online the file again.

message: database must either be open in this instance or not at all
cause: The requested operation can not be done when the database is mounted but not open in this instance, and another instance has the database open.
solution: Execute the operation in an open instance, open the datbase in this instance, or close the database in the other instances.

message: RESETLOGS option only valid after an incomplete database recovery
cause: The RESETLOGS option was given in ALTER DATABASE OPEN, but there has been no incomplete recovery session.
