cause: The os role does not exist, is not granted to you, or you did not provide the correct password.
solution: Re-attempt the SET ROLE with a valid os role and password, if necessary.

message: GRANT failed: password file missing or disabled
cause: The operation failed either because the INIT.ORA parameter REMOTE_LOGIN_PASSWORDFILE was set to NONE or else because the password file was missing.
solution: Create the password file using the orapwd tool and set the INIT.ORA parameter REMOTE_LOGIN_PASSWORDFILE to EXCLUSIVE.

message: password file cannot be updated in SHARED mode
cause: The operation failed because the INIT.ORA parameter REMOTE_LOGIN_PASSWORDFILE was set to SHARED.
solution: Set the INIT.ORA parameter to EXCLUSIVE.

message: user SYS is not permitted to create indexes with freelist groups
cause: user tried to create an index while running with sys authorization.
solution: None

message: security violation
cause: This error code is never returned to a user. It is used as a value for column, audit_trail.returncode, to signal that a security violation occurred.
solution: None

message: can't use ALLOCATE or DEALLOCATE options with REBUILD
cause: Allocate or deallocate storage and rebuild index are not compatible.
solution: Choose one or the other.

message: the size specified for a file must not be zero
cause: A value of zero was specified in a SIZE or RESIZE clause of a file specification.
solution: Use correct syntax, or, if allowed, omit the SIZE or RESIZE clause.

message: cannot select FOR UPDATE from view with DISTINCT, GROUP BY, etc.
cause: An attempt was made to select FOR UPDATE from a view which had not been merged because the view used syntax (for example, DISTINCT or GROUP BY) preventing the merge, or because of initialization file parameter settings.
solution: Determine the reason the view will not merge and, if possible, make changes so that it can.

message: cannot select FOR UPDATE from remote table
cause: An attempt was made to select FOR UPDATE on a remote table (directly, or via a view) that had abstract data type columns, and the view or select list contained abstract data type columns or non-column items.
solution: To attempt a select FOR UPDATE, use a view or select list that consists only of base columns from the remote table, none of which may be abstract data type columns.

message: too many database links in use
cause: The current session has exceeded the INIT.ORA open_links maximum.
solution: Increase the open_links limit, or free up some open links by committing or rolling back the transaction and canceling open cursors that reference remote databases.

message: DDL operations are not allowed on a remote database
cause: An attempt was made to use a DDL operation on a remote database. For example, "CREATE TABLE tablename@remotedbname ...".
solution: To alter the remote database structure, you must connect to the remote database with the appropriate privileges.

message: remote statement has unoptimized view with remote object
cause: The local view is unoptimized and contains references to objects at the remote database and the statement must be executed at the remote database.
solution: Create a similar view on the remote database and modify the violating view in the SQL statement with the new view@remote.

message: database link not found
cause: Database link to be dropped is not found in dictionary
solution: Correct the database link name

message: all tables in the SQL statement must be at the remote database
cause: The user's SQL statement references tables from multiple databases. The remote database is not Oracle V7 or above, and can perform updates only if it can reference all tables in the SQL statement.
solution: None

message: missing LINK keyword
cause: keyword missing
solution: supply missing keyword

message: multi-row UPDATE of LONG column is not supported
cause: A bind variable with length greater than 4000 bytes is being used to update a column, and the update statement updates more than one row.
solution: You may only update a single row with such a bind variable.

message: fetching an exact number of rows is not supported by the server
cause: The server does not support UPIALL, so the fetch of an exact number of rows cannot be emulated on the user side.
solution: Connect to a valid server or do not use an exact fetch.

message: missing FILE keyword
cause: keyword missing
solution: supply missing keyword

message: can only select from fixed tables/views
cause: An attempt is being made to perform an operation other than a retrieval from a fixed table/view.
solution: You may only select rows from fixed tables/views.

message: no ROWID for fixed tables or for external-organized tables
cause: An attempt is being made to access rowid from a fixed table or from a external-organized table.
solution: Do not access ROWID from a fixed table or from a external-organized table.

message: clustered tables cannot be used before the cluster index is built
cause: User attempted to perform a DML statement on a clustered table for which no cluster index has yet been created.
solution: Create the cluster index.

message: a cluster index for this cluster already exists
cause: A cluster index already exists for the cluster.
solution: None

message: speed bind not permitted
cause: Speed bind not allowed with supplied bind variables. Trapped internally by the system.
solution: None

message: illegal bundled operation combination
cause: User requested that the UPI bundled execution call perform an an illegal combination of operations.
solution: See documentation for legal operation combinations.

message: too many variables to describe with automatic cursor open
cause: User requested that the UPI bundled execution call perform automatic cursor open and close on a describe operation. There were too many select-list items or bind variables to do this.
solution: open and close cursor explicitly

message: uninitialized speed bind storage
cause: User attempted a UPI bundled execution call containing a standalone execute operation without first performing a UPI bundled execution call containing a bind operation.
solution: perform a UPI bundled execution call with bind before performing a bundled execution call with execute

message: define is not allowed for array type
cause: User attempted to define a select list variable of type "array". Arrays may only serve as host bind variables.
solution: None

message: bind by value is not allowed for array type
cause: User attempted to bind an array host variable by value. Arrays may only be bound by reference.
solution: None

message: remote database string does not support two-phase commit
cause: the database was potentially updated but does not support prepare to commit (as determined by its logon transaction traits). The transaction was rolled back.
solution: Do not attempt to update the remote database unless it is the only database updated in one transaction.

message: client database did not begin a transaction
cause: internal error
solution: contact support

message: too many distributed transactions
cause: the distributed transaction table was full because too many distributed transactions were active.
solution: Run fewer transactions. If you are sure you don't have too many concurrent distributed transactions, this indicates an internal error and support should be notified. Instance shutdown/restart would be a work-around.

message: must end current transaction before executing string
cause: a transaction is in progress and one of the following commands commands is issued: COMMIT FORCE, ROLLBACK FORCE, or ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE DISTRIBUTED RECOVERY in single process mode.
solution: COMMIT or ROLLBACK the current transaction and resubmit command.

message: transaction manager login denied: transaction in progress
cause: a remote transaction manager tried to log in while a distributed transaction is in progress.
solution: end the current transaction (this is a protocol error from a remote transaction manager)

message: too many local sessions participating in global transaction
cause: too many sessions at this site for this transaction.
solution: use an existing link so another session need not be created.

message: distributed transaction already begun
cause: internal error or error in external transaction manager. A server session received a begin_tran RPC before finishing with a previous distributed tran.
solution: None

message: cannot join the distributed transaction in progress
cause: Either a transaction is in progress against a remote database that does not fully support two phase commit, and an update is attempted on another database, or updates are pending and and an attempt is made to update a different database that does not fully support two phase commit.
solution: complete the current transaction and then resubmit the update request.

message: attempt to begin distributed transaction without logging on
cause: client program must issue a distributed transaction login.
solution: contact support.

message: transaction string rolled back, some remote DBs may be in-doubt
cause: network or remote failure in 2PC.
solution: Notify operations; remote DBs will automatically re-sync when the failure is repaired.

message: another session or branch in same transaction failed or finalized
cause: A session at the same site with the same global transaction ID failed. The failure could also be caused by an application error if an attempt was made to update the database while another tightly coupled transaction branch with the same global transaction ID was finalized or aborted.
solution: No action necessary as the transaction will be automatically recovered. In the case of an application error, make sure there are no more updates to the database once the transaction manager has started two-phase commit for tightly coupled distributed transaction.

message: remote transaction failure at string
cause: error in remote transaction at given DBLINK
solution: retry

message: transaction string committed, some remote DBs may be in-doubt
cause: network or remote failure in 2PC.
solution: Notify operations; remote DBs will automatically re-sync when the failure is repaired.

message: transaction string in-doubt
cause: network or remote failure in 2PC.
solution: Notify operations; DBs will automatically re-sync when the failure is repaired. Monitor pending_trans$ for final outcome.

message: distributed update operation failed; rollback required
cause: a failure during distributed update operation may not have rolled back all effects of the operation. Since some sites may be inconsistent, the transaction must roll back to a savepoint or entirely
solution: rollback to a savepoint or rollback transaction and resubmit

message: 2PC: string : bad two-phase command number string from string
cause: two-phase commit protocol error.
solution: recovery of transaction attempted. Monitor pending_trans$ table to ensure correct resolution. Contact support.

message: 2PC: string : bad two-phase recovery state number string from string
cause: internal error in two-phase recovery protocol
solution: contact support

message: no prepared transaction found with ID string
cause: no transaction with local_tran_id or global_tran_id found in the pending_trans$ table in prepared state.
solution: check the pending_trans$ table.

message: ORA-2PC-CRASH-TEST- string in commit comment
cause: This is a special comment used to test the two phase commit.
solution: Don't use this special comment (%s a number 1-10)

message: select for update specified a join of distributed tables
cause: tables in a join with the for update clause must reside at the same DB.
solution: None

message: lock table specified list of distributed tables
cause: tables in a lock table statement must reside at the same DB.
solution: issue multiple lock table commands.

message: distributed recovery received DBID string , expected string
cause: a database link at a coordinator no longer points to the expected database. Link may have been redefined, or a different DB mounted.
solution: restore link definition or remote database.

message: preceding string string from string string
cause: an Oracle error was received from a remote database link.
solution: refer to the preceding error message(s)

message: distributed operation not supported
cause: One of the following unsupported operations was attempted: 1. array execute of a remote update with a subquery that references a dblink, or 2. an update of a long column with bind variable and an update of a second column with a subquery that both references a dblink and a bind variable, or 3. a commit is issued in a coordinated session from an RPC procedure call with OUT parameters or function call.
solution: simplify remote update statement

message: illegal option for ALTER SYSTEM
cause: The option specified for ALTER SYSTEM is not supported
solution: refer to the user manual for option supported

message: missing or invalid DISPATCHERS text
cause: A character string literal was expected, but not found, following ALTER SYSTEM SET DISPATCHERS
solution: place the string literal containing the dispatcher's specification after ALTER SYSTEM SET DISPATCHERS

message: transaction or savepoint rollback required
cause: A failure (typically a trigger or stored procedure with multiple remote updates) occurred such that the all-or-nothing execution of a previous Oracle call cannot be guaranteed.
solution: rollback to a previous savepoint or rollback the transaction and resubmit.

message: following severe error from string string
cause: A severe error (disconnect, fatal Oracle error) received from the indicated database link. See following error text.
solution: Contact the remote system administrator.

message: global_names parameter must be set to TRUE for this operation
cause: A remote mapping of the statement is required but cannot be achieved because global_names should be set to TRUE for it to be achieved
solution: Issue alter session set global_names = true if possible

message: database string string does not support string in this context
cause: The remote database does not support the named capability in the context in which it is used.
solution: Simplify the SQL statement.

message: error initializing capabilities for remote database string
cause: Could not load a remote-specified capability table.
solution: Contact support for the remote SQL*Connect product.

message: distributed database network protocol mismatch
cause: This should never happen between different PRODUCTION releases of ORACLE, but may happen between alpha and beta releases, for example.
solution: Upgrade the older release.

message: sequence numbers not supported in remote updates
cause: Sequence numbers may not be used in INSERTS, UPDATES, or DELETES on remote tables.
solution: None

message: cannot string in a distributed transaction
cause: A commit or rollback was attempted from session other than the parent of a distributed transaction.
solution: Only commit or rollback from the parent session.

message: another instance changed state of transaction string
cause: A commit force or rollback force was issued from a session in another instance.
solution: Check if another Oracle instance is performing recovery of pending transactions. Query DBA_2PC_PENDING to determine the new state of the transaction.

message: sequence not co-located with updated table or long column
cause: all referenced sequences must be co-located with the table with the long column.
solution: None

message: selects of long columns must be from co-located tables
cause: if a select returns long columns from multiple tables, all the tables must be co-located
solution: None

message: cannot join a committing distributed transaction
cause: Once a transaction branch is prepared, no more new transaction branches are allowed to start, nor is the prepared transaction branch allowed to be joined.
solution: Check the application code as this is an XA protocol violation.

message: database link is in use
cause: a transaction is active or a cursor is open on the database link given in the alter session close database link <link> command.
solution: commit or rollback, and close all cursors

message: database link is not open
cause: dblink given is not currently open.
solution: None

message: a loopback database link must have a connection qualifier
cause: An attempt was made to create a database link with the same name as the current database.
solution: a loopback database link needs a trailing qualifier, for example MYDB.EXAMPLE.COM@INST1 - the '@INST1' is the qualifier

message: database name has illegal character ' string '
cause: supplied database name can contain only A-Z, 0-9, '_', '#', '$' '.' and '@' characters.
solution: None

message: database name is missing a component
cause: supplied database name cannot contain a leading '.', trailing '.' or '@', or two '.' or '@' in a row.
solution: None

message: database link string connects to string
cause: a database link connected to a database with a different name. The connection is rejected.
solution: create a database link with the same name as the database it connects to, or set global_names=false.

message: database (link) name is too long
cause: database/database link name can have at most 128 characters.
solution: None

message: object locked by another process in same transaction
cause: A database link is being used in the cluster database environment that loops back to the same instance. One session is trying to convert a lock that was obtained by the other session.
solution: Get the more restrictive lock first. For example, if session 1 gets a share lock and session 2 gets an exclusive lock on the same object, get the exclusive lock first. Or, simply use the same session to access the object.

message: distributed database option not installed
cause: Remote and distributed updates and transactions are a separately priced option in ORACLE V7.
solution: None

message: COMMIT is not allowed in a subordinate session
cause: COMMIT was issued in a session that is not the two-phase commit global coordinator.
solution: Issue commit at the global coordinator only.

message: network error: attempted callback+passthru
cause: internal error.
solution: None

message: transaction rolled back
cause: Also see error 2092. If the transaction is aborted at a remote site then you will only see 2091; if aborted at host then you will see 2092 and 2091.
solution: Add rollback segment and retry the transaction.

message: out of transaction table slots for distributed transaction
cause: The transaction is assigned to the system rollback segment and is trying to get into the PREPARED state, but the required number of non-PREPARED slots are not available, hence the transaction is rolled back.
solution: Add a rollback segment and retry the transaction.

message: TRANSACTIONS_PER_ROLLBACK_SEGMENT( string ) more than maximum possible( string )
cause: Value of parameter specified is greater than allowed on this port.
solution: Use default or reduce it to less than max.

message: replication option not installed
cause: The replication option was not installed at this site. Updatable materialized views, deferred RPCs, and other replication features were, therefore, unavailable.
solution: Install the replication option. The replication option is not part of the Oracle Server product and must be purchased separately. Contact an Oracle Sales representative if the replication option needs to be purchased.

message: specified initialization parameter cannot be modified
cause: The specified initialization parameter is not modifiable
solution: None

message: specified initialization parameter is not modifiable with this option
cause: Though the initialization parameter is modifiable, it cannot be modified using the specified command.
solution: Check the DBA guide for information about under what scope the parameter may be modified

message: parameter cannot be modified because specified value is invalid
cause: Though the initialization parameter is modifiable, the modified value is not acceptable to the parameter.
solution: Check the DBA guide for range of acceptable values for this parameter.

message: error parsing index-table reference (:I)
cause: An incorrect index-table (:I) syntax was encountered.
solution: This syntax is for oracle internal use only.

message: invalid tablespace name
cause: An identifier does not follow ALTER TABLESPACE.
solution: Specify a tablespace name following ALTER TABLESPACE.

message: invalid OFFLINE option
cause: An option other than NORMAL or IMMEDIATE follows OFFLINE.
solution: The user must either specify no option following OFFLINE or one of the options NORMAL or IMMEDIATE.

message: missing or invalid ALTER TABLESPACE option
cause: A valid option was not present.
solution: Use one of the valid options: add, rename, default, online, offline, read only, read write, begin, end, no, force, retention guarantee and retention noguarantee.

message: invalid STORAGE option
cause: An option other than INITIAL, NEXT, MINEXTENTS, MAXEXTENTS, or PCTINCREASE was specified in the STORAGE clause.
solution: Specify only valid options.

message: no option specified for ALTER CLUSTER
cause: No ALTER CLUSTER options are specified.
solution: Specify one or more of the following options: pctfree, pctused, size, storage.

message: missing STORAGE option
cause: No STORAGE options were specified following STORAGE (
solution: Specify one or more STORAGE option between the parentheses.

message: SHARED specified multiple times
cause: The SHARED option was specified in a CREATE DATABASE statement multiple times.
solution: Only specify the SHARED option once.

message: conflicting SHARED/EXCLUSIVE options
cause: Both the SHARED and EXCLUSIVE options were specified in a CREATE DATABASE statement.
solution: Specify SHARED or EXCLUSIVE, but not both.

message: EXCLUSIVE specified multiple times
cause: The EXCLUSIVE option was specified in a CREATE DATABASE statement multiple times.
solution: Only specify the EXCLUSIVE option once.

message: Specified partition does not exist
cause: Partition not found for the object.
solution: Retry with correct partition name.

message: invalid new tablespace name
cause: The new tablespace name specified in ALTER TABLESPACE RENAME TO statement was invalid.
solution: Retry with a valid new tablespace name.

message: invalid tablespace name: string
cause: Oracle cannot create a tablespace whose name starts with '_$deleted$'.
solution: Try a different tablespace name.

message: Invalid ALTER TABLESPACE ... RENAME option
cause: An option other than DATAFILE or TO follows by ALTER TABLESPACE ... RENAME.
solution: The user must specify either DATAFILE or TO following ALTER TABLESPACE ... RENAME.

message: invalid VALUES password string
cause: An encoded password string does not follow the VALUES clause.
solution: Place a proper encoded password string after the VALUES clause.

message: a tablespace with the name ' string ' is found
cause: An attempt to rename a tablespace to a new name failed because the new name is already used by some other tablespace.
solution: Retry with a different new name.

message: invalid DEFAULT tablespace identifier
cause: An identifier does not follow DEFAULT TABLESPACE.
solution: Place a tablespace name after DEFAULT TABLESPACE.

message: invalid TEMPORARY tablespace identifier
cause: An identifier does not follow TEMPORARY TABLESPACE.
solution: Place a tablespace name after TEMPORARY TABLESPACE.

message: no options specified for ALTER USER
cause: No options were specified.
solution: Specify at least one ALTER USER option.

message: invalid CREATE INDEX option
cause: An option other than COMPRESS, NOCOMPRESS, PCTFREE, INITRANS, MAXTRANS, STORAGE, TABLESPACE, PARALLEL, NOPARALLEL, RECOVERABLE, UNRECOVERABLE, LOGGING, NOLOGGING, LOCAL, or GLOBAL was specified.
solution: Choose one of the valid CREATE INDEX options.

message: installed DLM does not support releasable locking mode
cause: The parameter file specified gc_* parameters that allow locks to be release by the LCK process when not in use. This mode requires additional support from the DLM that is not available.
solution: Specify configuration parameters that do not require the additional function.

message: index-organized table can not contain columns of type LONG
cause: A column of type LONG defined for index-organized table.
solution: Do not use columns of type LONG in index-organized tables.

message: invalid value for MAXLOGFILES
cause: A number does not follow MAXLOGFILES.
solution: Specify a number after MAXLOGFILES.

message: invalid value for MAXDATAFILES
cause: A number does not follow MAXDATAFILES.
solution: Specify a number after MAXDATAFILES.

message: invalid value for FREELIST GROUPS
cause: A number does not follow FREELIST GROUPS.
solution: Specify a number after FREELIST GROUPS.

message: DATAFILE clause specified more than once
cause: The CREATE DATABASE command contains more than one DATAFILE clause.
solution: Specify at most one DATAFILE clause.

message: invalid option for CREATE DATABASE
cause: An invalid CREATE DATABASE option is present.
solution: Specify only valid CREATE DATABASE options.

message: ARCHIVELOG and NOARCHIVELOG specified
cause: Both ARCHIVELOG and NOARCHIVELOG are specified in a CREATE DATABASE statement.
solution: Specify at most one of these two options.

message: LOGFILE clause specified more than once
cause: The CREATE DATABASE command contains more than one LOGFILE clause.
solution: Specify at most one LOGFILE clause.

message: invalid value for FREELISTS
cause: A number does not follow FREELISTS
solution: Specify a number after FREELISTS

message: FREELISTS storage option not allowed
cause: The user attempted to specify the FREELISTS storage option. This option may only be specified during create table or create index.
solution: Remove these options and retry the statement.

message: FREELIST GROUPS storage option not allowed
cause: The user attempted to specify the FREELIST GROUPS storage option. This option may only be specified during create table and when allow_freelist_groups INIT.ORA is specified.
solution: Remove this option and retry the statement or set the allow_freelist_groups INIT.ORA parameter.

message: invalid value for MAXLOGHISTORY
cause: A number does not follow MAXLOGHISTORY
solution: Specify a number after MAXLOGHISTORY

message: The PUBLIC keyword is not appropriate for a disable thread
cause: The PUBLIC keyword was specified for a disable.
solution: Remove the keyword and resubmit.

message: invalid option for DROP TABLESPACE
cause: Either a token other than INCLUDING was found following the tablespace name or some text was found following INCLUDING CONTENTS.
solution: Place nothing or only INCLUDING CONTENTS after the tablespace name.

message: Missing required thread number
cause: Must specify thread number after THREAD keyword
solution: None

message: invalid rollback segment name
cause: In the CREATE or DROP ROLLBACK SEGMENT statements, an identifier was not found following ROLLBACK SEGMENT.
solution: Place the segment name following ROLLBACK SEGMENT.

message: invalid option for CREATE ROLLBACK SEGMENT
cause: An invalid option was specified in a CREATE ROLLBACK SEGMENT statement.
solution: Specify one of the valid options: TABLESPACE and STORAGE.

message: Missing required group number
cause: Must specify group number after GROUP keyword
solution: None

message: correct syntax is: SET TRANSACTION READ { ONLY | WRITE }
cause: There is a syntax error in the user's statement.
solution: Correct the syntax as indicated.

message: valid options: ISOLATION LEVEL { SERIALIZABLE | READ COMMITTED }
cause: There is a syntax error in the user's statement.
solution: Correct the syntax as indicated.

message: invalid option for CREATE TABLESPACE
cause: An invalid option appeared.
solution: Specify one of the valid options: DATAFILE, DEFAULT STORAGE, ONLINE, OFFLINE, FORCE, RETENTION.

message: invalid option to ROLLBACK WORK
cause: A token other than TO follows ROLLBACK [WORK].
solution: Place nothing or TO SAVEPOINT <name> after ROLLBACK [WORK].

message: savepoint name expected
cause: An identifier does not follow ROLLBACK [WORK] TO [SAVEPOINT].
solution: Place a savepoint name following TO [SAVEPOINT].

message: valid options: ISOLATION_LEVEL { SERIALIZABLE | READ COMMITTED }
cause: There is a syntax error in the user's statement.
solution: Correct the syntax as indicated.

message: resource quotas are not allowed in REVOKE
cause: In a revoke statement, a resource quota was specified.
solution: Specify resource privilege without the quota.

message: a token other than WORK follows COMMIT
cause: A token other than WORK follows COMMIT.
solution: Place either nothing or WORK after COMMIT.

message: tablespace resource privilege may not appear with other privileges
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke a resource quota in the same statement in which other privileges are granted or revoked.
solution: Use a separate grant or revoke statement for the resource quota privilege.

message: invalid quota specification
cause: In a grant or revoke statement, the user attempted to grant a tablespace quota above the upper limit.
solution: Grant a smaller tablespace quota.

message: Cannot enable instance publicly
cause: An attempt was made to publicly enable a thread associated with an instance.
solution: Leave out the PUBLIC keyword.

message: ON <tablespace> required
cause: In a grant or revoke statement, the user specified a tablespace quota but did not follow it with the ON <tablespace> clause.
solution: Specify the tablespace on which the quota is to be applied with the ON <tablespace> clause.

message: keyword TABLES expected
cause: The keyword TABLES is expected following DROP CLUSTER <name> INCLUDING.
solution: Place TABLES after INCLUDING.

message: correct syntax is: SET TRANSACTION USE ROLLBACK SEGMENT <rbs>
cause: There is a syntax error in the user's statement.
solution: Correct the syntax as indicated.

message: PCTINCREASE not allowed for rollback segment storage clauses
cause: pctincrease was specified in a create or alter rollback segment
solution: reissue statement without the pctincrease clause

message: event specification syntax error string (minor error string ) near ' string '
cause: There is a syntax error in an event specification.
solution: Fix the error.

message: Attempt to create string object in a string tablespace
cause: The object type is inconsistent with a tablespace contents.
solution: Create an object in a different tablespace, or change the user defaults.

message: PERMANENT/TEMPORARY option already specified
cause: In CREATE TABLESPACE, the PERMANENT and/or TEMPORARY options were specified more than once.
solution: None

message: file list already specified
cause: In CREATE TABLESPACE, more than one DATAFILE/TEMPFILE clause was specified.
solution: Merge the DATAFILE/TEMPFILE clauses into a single clause.

message: ONLINE/OFFLINE option already specified
cause: In CREATE TABLESPACE, the ONLINE and/or OFFLINE options were specified more than once.
solution: Specify at most one of ONLINE or OFFLINE.

message: missing DATAFILE/TEMPFILE clause
cause: A CREATE TABLESPACE statement has no DATAFILE/TEMPFILE clause.
solution: Specify a DATAFILE/TEMPFILE clause.

message: WITH GRANT OPTION not allowed for PUBLIC
cause: An attempt was made to GRANT to PUBLIC WITH GRANT OPTION.
solution: Remove the WITH GRANT OPTION clause.

message: sequence not allowed here
cause: An attempt was made to reference a sequence in a from-list.
solution: A sequence can only be referenced in a select-list.

message: no more tables permitted in this cluster
cause: An attempt was made to create a table in a cluster which already contains 32 tables.
solution: Up to 32 tables may be stored per cluster.

message: INITIAL storage options not allowed
cause: The user attempted to alter the INITIAL storage option of a table, cluster, index, or rollback segment. These options may only be specified when the object is created.
solution: Remove these options and retry the statement.

message: ALTER, INDEX and EXECUTE not allowed for views
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke an invalid privilege on a view.
solution: Do not attempt to grant or revoke any of ALTER, INDEX, or EXECUTE privileges on views.

message: only SELECT and ALTER privileges are valid for sequences
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke an invalid privilege on a sequence.
solution: Do not attempt to grant or revoke DELETE, INDEX, INSERT, UPDATE, REFERENCES or EXECUTE privilege on sequences.

message: duplicate INITRANS option specification
cause: INITRANS is specified more than once.
solution: Specify INITRANS at most once.

message: invalid INITRANS option value
cause: The INITRANS value is not an integer between 1 and 255 and less than or equal to the MAXTRANS value.
solution: Choose a valid INITRANS value.

message: duplicate MAXTRANS option specification
cause: MAXTRANS is specified more than once.
solution: Specify MAXTRANS at most once.

message: invalid MAXTRANS option value
cause: The MAXTRANS value is not an integer between 1 and 255 and greater than or equal to the INITRANS value.
solution: Choose a valid MAXTRANS value.

message: no options specified for ALTER TABLE
cause: No ALTER TABLE option was specified.
solution: Specify at least one alter table option.

message: invalid value for PCTFREE or PCTUSED
cause: The specified value for PCTFREE or PCTUSED is not an integer between 0 and 100.
solution: Choose an appropriate value for the option.

message: duplicate PCTFREE option specification
cause: PCTFREE option specified more than once.
solution: Specify PCTFREE at most once.

message: duplicate PCTUSED option specification
cause: PCTUSED option specified more than once.
solution: Specify PCTUSED at most once.

message: duplicate BACKUP option specification
cause: The BACKUP option to ALTER TABLE is specified more than once.
solution: Specify the option at most once.

message: duplicate tablespace name clause
cause: There is more than one TABLESPACE clause in the CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, or CREATE ROLLBACK SEGMENT statement.
solution: Specify at most one TABLESPACE clause.

message: tablespace name expected
cause: A tablespace name is not present where required by the syntax for one of the following statements: CREATE/DROP TABLESPACE, CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, or CREATE ROLLBACK SEGMENT.
solution: Specify a tablespace name where required by the syntax.

message: duplicate storage option specification
cause: A storage option (INIITAL, NEXT, MINEXTENTS, MAXEXTENTS, PCTINCREASE) is specified more than once.
solution: Specify all storage options at most once.

message: invalid INITIAL storage option value
cause: The specified value must be an integer.
solution: Choose an appropriate integer value.

message: invalid NEXT storage option value
cause: The specified value must be an integer.
solution: Choose an appropriate integer value.

message: invalid MINEXTENTS storage option value
cause: The specified value must be a positive integer less than or equal to MAXEXTENTS.
solution: Specify an appropriate value.

message: invalid MAXEXTENTS storage option value
cause: The specified value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to MINEXTENTS.
solution: Specify an appropriate value.

message: invalid PCTINCREASE storage option value
cause: The specified value must be a positive integer.
solution: Specify an appropriate value.

message: invalid OPTIMAL storage option value
cause: The specified value must be an integer.
solution: Choose an appropriate integer value.

message: EXECUTE privilege not allowed for tables
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke an invalid privilege on a table.
solution: Do not attempt to grant or revoke EXECUTE privilege on tables.

message: only EXECUTE and DEBUG privileges are valid for procedures
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke an invalid privilege on a procedure, function or package.
solution: Do not attempt to grant or revoke any privilege besides EXECUTE or DEBUG on procedures, functions or packages.

message: invalid MAXEXTENTS value (max allowed: string )
cause: The MAXEXTENTS specified is too large for the database block size. This applies only to SYSTEM rollback segment.
solution: Specify a smaller value.

message: invalid cluster name
cause: A cluster name of the form [ <identifier> . ] <identifier> is expected but not present.
solution: Enter an appropriate cluster name.

message: duplicate SIZE specification
cause: The SIZE option is specified more than once.
solution: Specify the SIZE option at most once.

message: invalid SIZE option value
cause: The specified value must be an integer number of bytes.
solution: Specify an appropriate value.

message: invalid ALTER CLUSTER option
cause: An option other than PCTFREE, PCTUSED, INITRANS, MAXTRANS, STORAGE, or SIZE is specified in an ALTER CLUSTER statement.
solution: Specify only legal options.

message: missing or invalid option to ALTER DATABASE
cause: An option other than ADD, DROP, RENAME, ARCHIVELOG, NOARCHIVELOG, MOUNT, DISMOUNT, OPEN, or CLOSE is specified in the statement.
solution: Specify only legal options.

message: invalid MOUNT mode
cause: A mode other than SHARED or EXCLUSIVE follows the MOUNT keyword in an ALTER DATABASE statement.
solution: Specify either SHARED, EXCLUSIVE, or nothing following MOUNT.

message: invalid CLOSE mode
cause: A mode other than NORMAL or IMMEDIATE follows the CLOSE keyword in an ALTER DATABASE statement.
solution: Specify either NORMAL, IMMEDIATE, or nothing following CLOSE.

message: changes to this table are already logged
cause: the log table to be added is a duplicate of another
solution: Don't add this change log to the system; check that the replication product's system tables are consistent

message: this table logs changes to another table already
cause: the table to be altered is already a change log for another table
solution: Don't log changes to the specified base table to this table; check that the replication product's system tables are consistent

message: invalid file name
cause: A character string literal was not used in the filename list of a LOGFILE, DATAFILE, or RENAME clause.
solution: Use correct syntax.

message: invalid file size
cause: A non-integer value was specified in the SIZE or RESIZE clause.
solution: Use correct syntax.

message: filename lists have different numbers of files
cause: In a RENAME clause in ALTER DATABASE or TABLESPACE, the the number of existing filenames does not equal the number of new filenames.
solution: Make sure there is a new filename to correspond to each existing filename.

message: there are objects which reference this sequence
cause: the sequence to be dropped is still referenced
solution: Make sure the sequence name is correct, or drop the referencing constraint/object

message: invalid value for OBJNO or TABNO
cause: A number does not follow either OBJNO or TABNO.
solution: Specify a number after OBJNO or TABNO.

message: must of form EXTENTS (FILE <n> BLOCK <n> SIZE <n>, ...)
cause: bad extent storage clause
solution: respecify

message: no options specified for ALTER INDEX
cause: No options specified.
solution: Specify at least one of REBUILD, INITRANS, MAXTRANS, or STORAGE.

message: invalid ALTER INDEX or ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW option
cause: An option other than INITRANS, MAXTRANS,or STORAGE is specified in an ALTER INDEX statement or in the USING INDEX clause of an ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW statement.
solution: Specify only legal options.

message: invalid ALTER ROLLBACK SEGMENT option
cause: The STORAGE option is expected but not found.
solution: Specify the STORAGE option.

message: invalid ROLLBACK SEGMENT name
cause: An identifier was expected, but not found, following ALTER [PUBLIC] ROLLBACK SEGMENT.
solution: Place a rollback segment name following SEGMENT.

message: missing EVENTS text
cause: A character string literal was expected, but not found, following ALTER SESSION SET EVENTS.
solution: Place the string literal containing the events text after EVENTS.

message: no option specified for ALTER SESSION
cause: The option SET EVENTS was expected, but not found, following ALTER SESSION.
solution: Place the SET EVENTS option after ALTER SESSION.

message: invalid option for ALTER SESSION
cause: Obvious.
solution: see SQL Language Manual for legal options.

message: missing or invalid value for MAXLOGMEMBERS
cause: A valid number does not follow MAXLOGMEMBERS. The value specified must be between 1 and the port-specific maximum number of log file members.
solution: Specify a valid number after MAXLOGMEMBERS.

message: missing or invalid constraint name
cause: The constraint name is missing or invalid.
solution: Specify a valid identifier name for the constraint name.

message: subquery not allowed here
cause: Subquery is not allowed here in the statement.
solution: Remove the subquery from the statement.

message: check constraint condition not properly ended
cause: The specified search condition for the check constraint is not properly ended.
solution: End the condition properly.

message: constraint specification not allowed here
cause: Constraint specification is not allowed here in the statement.
solution: Remove the constraint specification from the statement.

message: DEFAULT <expression> not allowed here
cause: Default value expression is not allowed for the column here in the statement.
solution: Remove the default value expression from the statement.

message: obsolete 7.1.5
cause: Was that defaults must not conflict with not null constraints
solution: None

message: number of referencing columns must match referenced columns
cause: The number of columns in the foreign-key referencing list is not equal to the number of columns in the referenced list.
solution: Make sure that the referencing columns match the referenced columns.

message: maximum number of columns exceeded
cause: The number of columns in the key list exceeds the maximum number.
solution: Reduce the number columns in the list.

message: duplicate or conflicting NULL and/or NOT NULL specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate or conflicting specification.

message: duplicate UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate specification.

message: table can have only one primary key
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the extra primary key.

message: such unique or primary key already exists in the table
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the extra key.

message: ORA- string occurs while type-checking column default value expression
cause: New column datatype causes type-checking error for existing column default value expression.
solution: Remove the default value expression or don't alter the column datatype.

message: need to specify the datatype for this column
cause: The required datatype for the column is missing.
solution: Specify the required datatype.

message: name already used by an existing constraint
cause: The specified constraint name has to be unique.
solution: Specify a unique constraint name for the constraint.

message: cannot derive the datatype of the referencing column
cause: The datatype of the referenced column is not defined as yet.
solution: Make sure that the datatype of the referenced column is defined before referencing it.

message: unique/primary keys in table referenced by enabled foreign keys
cause: An attempt was made to truncate a table with unique or primary keys referenced by foreign keys enabled in another table. Other operations not allowed are dropping/truncating a partition of a partitioned table or an ALTER TABLE EXCHANGE PARTITION.
solution: Before performing the above operations the table, disable the foreign key constraints in other tables. You can see what constraints are referencing a table by issuing the following command: SELECT * FROM USER_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = "tabnam";

message: column type incompatible with referenced column type
cause: The datatype of the referencing column is incompatible with the
solution: Select a compatible datatype for the referencing column.

message: referenced table does not have a primary key
cause: The referenced table does not have a primary key.
solution: Specify explicitly the referenced table unique key.

message: key column cannot be of LONG datatype
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Change the datatype of the column, or remove the column from the key.

message: no matching unique or primary key for this column-list
cause: A REFERENCES clause in a CREATE/ALTER TABLE statement gives a column-list for which there is no matching unique or primary key constraint in the referenced table.
solution: Find the correct column names using the ALL_CONS_COLUMNS catalog view

message: table does not have such constraint
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Make sure the specified constraint name is correct.

message: constrained column cannot be of LONG datatype
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Change the datatype of the column, or remove the constraint on the column.

message: this unique/primary key is referenced by some foreign keys
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove all references to the key before the key is to be dropped.

message: duplicate referential constraint specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate specification.

message: such a referential constraint already exists in the table
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the extra constraint.

message: default value type incompatible with column type
cause: The type of the evaluated default expression is incompatible with the datatype of the column.
solution: Change the type of the column, or modify the default expression.

message: invalid sequence name
cause: The specified sequence name is not a valid identifier name.
solution: Specify a valid identifier name for the sequence name.

message: duplicate or conflicting MAXVALUE/NOMAXVALUE specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate or conflicting specification.

message: duplicate or conflicting MINVALUE/NOMINVALUE specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate or conflicting specification.

message: duplicate or conflicting CYCLE/NOCYCLE specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate or conflicting specification.

message: duplicate or conflicting CACHE/NOCACHE specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate or conflicting specification.

message: duplicate or conflicting ORDER/NOORDER specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate or conflicting specification.

message: cannot alter starting sequence number
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Don't alter it.

message: duplicate INCREMENT BY specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate specification.

message: duplicate START WITH specifications
cause: Self-evident.
solution: Remove the duplicate specification.

message: no options specified for ALTER SEQUENCE
cause: Self-evident.
solution: The statement is meaningless without any options.

message: sequence number not allowed here
cause: The specified sequence number (CURRVAL or NEXTVAL) is inappropriate here in the statement.
solution: Remove the sequence number.

message: invalid OPEN mode
cause: A token other than RESETLOGS appears following ALTER DATABASE <name> OPEN.
solution: Either nothing or RESETLOGS should be placed following OPEN.

message: sequence does not exist
cause: The specified sequence does not exist, or the user does not have the required privilege to perform this operation.
solution: Make sure the sequence name is correct, and that you have the right to perform the desired operation on this sequence.

message: cannot validate ( string . string ) - check constraint violated
cause: an alter table operation tried to validate a check constraint to a populated table that had nocomplying values.
solution: Obvious

message: cannot enable ( string . string ) - constraint changed during validation
cause: While one DDL statement was attempting to enable this constraint, another DDL changed this same constraint.
solution: Try again, with only one DDL changing the constraint this time.

message: found more than one enable/disable clause for constraint
cause: a create or alter table specified more than one enable and/or disable clause for a given constraint.
solution: only one enable or disable may be specified for a given constraint.

message: cannot enable ( string . string ) - null values found
cause: an alter table enable constraint failed because the table contains values that do not satisfy the constraint.
solution: Obvious

message: cannot disable constraint ( string . string ) - dependencies exist
cause: an alter table disable constraint failed becuase the table has foriegn keys that are dpendent on this constraint.
solution: Either disable the foreign key constraints or use disable cascade

message: cannot validate ( string . string ) - parent keys not found
cause: an alter table validating constraint failed because the table has orphaned child records.
solution: Obvious

message: cannot validate ( string . string ) - duplicate keys found
cause: an alter table validating constraint failed because the table has duplicate key values.
solution: Obvious

message: invalid value for OIDGENERATORS
cause: A number was not specified for the value of OIDGENERATORS.
solution: Specify a number for OIDGENERATORS.

message: maximum number of OIDGENERATORS is 255
cause: A number greater than 255 was specified for the value of OIDGENERATORS.
solution: Make sure the number specified for OIDGENERATORS does not exceed 255.

message: invalid or missing type name
cause: An invalid or missing type name was entered in a statement.
solution: Enter a valid type name in the statement and retry the operation.

message: cannot drop or replace a type with type or table dependents
cause: An attempt was made to drop or replace a type that has type or table dependents.
solution: For DROP TYPE, drop all type(s) and table(s) depending on the type and then retry the operation, or use the FORCE option. For CREATE TYPE, drop all type(s) and table(s) depending on the type and then retry the operation, or drop all table(s) depending on the type and retry with the FORCE option.

message: invalid object identifier literal
cause: An attempt was made to enter an object identifier literal for CREATE TYPE that is either: - not a string of 32 hexadecimal characters - an object identifier that already identifies an existing object - an object identifier different from the original object identifier already assigned to the type
solution: Do not specify the object identifier clause or specify a 32 hexadecimal-character object identifier literal that is unique or identical to the originally assigned object identifier. Then retry the operation.

message: only EXECUTE, DEBUG, and UNDER privileges are valid for types
cause: An attempt was made to GRANT or REVOKE an invalid privilege (not EXECUTE, DEBUG, or UNDER) on a type.
solution: GRANT or REVOKE only the EXECUTE, DEBUG, or UNDER privilege on types.

message: cannot create a type that already has valid dependent(s)
cause: An attempt was made to create a type that already has some valid dependent(s) (these dependents depend on the fact that the type does not exist).
solution: Drop the dependents first before creating the type, or do not create the type.

message: cannot alter with REPLACE option a type that is not valid
cause: An attempt was made to ALTER with REPLACE option a type that is not valid.
solution: Use the CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE command to modify the type.

message: invalid option string for object type column
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid option, such as PACKED or UNPACKED, for the object type column.
solution: Remove the invalid option from column specification and retry the operation.

message: atomic NULL violation
cause: An attempt was made to acess the attributes of a NULL object instance.
solution: Ensure that the object instance is non-NULL before accessing.

message: exceeded maximum number of allowable columns in table
cause: The attributes in the object type column exceeded the maximum number of columns allowed in a table.
solution: Specify fewer attributes for the object type and retry the operation.

message: cannot alter with COMPILE option a valid type with type or table dependents
cause: An attempt was made to ALTER with COMPILE option a type that is valid and has type or table dependents.
solution: No need to perform this operation.

message: object type contains non-queryable type string attribute
cause: The specified object type contains a nested attribute whose type is non-queryable.
solution: Use an object type with queryable attribute types.

message: illegal use of type constructor
cause: The statement contains an illegal use of a type constructor.
solution: Refer to the SQL Reference manual for the correct statement syntax.

message: incorrect number of arguments for default constructor
cause: The number of arguments specified for the default constructor doesn't match the number of attributes of the object type.
solution: Specify the correct number of arguments for the default constructor and retry the operation.

message: failure in creating storage table for nested table column string
cause: An error occurred while creating the storage table for the specified nested table column.
solution: See the messages that follow for more details. If the situation they describe can be corrected, do so; otherwise contact Oracle Support.

message: failure in accessing storage table of the nested table column
cause: An error occured while performing DML on the storage table of the nested table column.
solution: If the situation described in the following messages can be corrected, do so; otherwise contact Oracle Support.

message: more than one column in the SELECT list of THE subquery
cause: More than one column was selected in the THE subquery.
solution: Specify only one column in the SELECT list of the THE subquery and retry the operation.

message: cannot create index on expression with datatype string
cause: An attempt was made to create an index on a non-indexable expression.
solution: Change the column datatype or do not create the index on an expression whose datatype is one of VARRAY, nested table, object, LOB, or REF.

message: column of datatype string cannot be unique or a primary key
cause: An attempt was made to place a UNIQUE or a PRIMARY KEY constraint on a column of datatype VARRAY, nested table, object, LOB, FILE or REF.
solution: Change the column datatype or remove the constraint. Then retry the operation.

message: datatype specification not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to specify the data type in the column constraint specification of an object table.
solution: Remove data type specification and retry the operation.

message: cannot create constraint on column of datatype string
cause: An attempt was made to create a constraint on a column posessing a non-constrainable datatype -- VARRAY, nested table, object, LOB, FILE, or REF.
solution: Change the column datatype, or remove the constraint.

message: cannot create index on attributes of this column
cause: An attempt was made to create an index on an attributes of an object type column.
solution: Do not specify the index on the attribute.

message: cannot create constraints on attributes of this column
cause: An attempt was made to create a constraint on an attribute of an object type column.
solution: Remove the constraint or change the object type.

message: cannot infer type for column
cause: A datatype was not declared for this column (in the CREATE TABLE) and an attempt was made to create a constraint on an attribute of this column.
solution: Declare a datatype for the column.

message: invalid datatype for cluster column
cause: An attempt was made to declare a CLUSTER column of datatype object, REF, nested table, VARRAY, LOB, or FILE.
solution: Remove the CLUSTER column or change the datatype of the column.

message: column attribute cannot be accessed
cause: An attempt was made to extract an attribute of an object type column.
solution: Change the object type for the column and retry the operation.

message: not an object type column
cause: An attempt was made to use dotted notation on a non-ADT column; that is, "a.b.c" where "a" is not an object type.
solution: Either change the column type to an object type or do not perform this operation.

message: missing or invalid column constraint specification
cause: A column constraint was not specified.
solution: Remove the column specification or specify a column constraint. Then retry the operation.

message: invalid column specification
cause: An attempt was made to specify the PACKED or UNPACKED keyword for a non-object type column.
solution: Remove the PACKED or UNPACKED keyword in the column specification and retry the operation.

message: invalid column specification
cause: An attempt was made to specify an UNPACKED column within a packed table.
solution: Remove the UNPACKED keyword in the column specification.

message: replacement type has compilation errors
cause: The use of the ALTER...REPLACE statement on a valid type caused a compilation error.
solution: Use the ALTER...REPLACE statement to replace the type with a valid type which does not cause compilation errors.

message: cannot revoke execute on a type with table dependents
cause: An attempt was made to revoke execute on a type that has dependents.
solution: Drop all table(s) depending on the type, then retry the operation, or use the FORCE option.

message: cannot create a view with column based on CURSOR operator
cause: A CURSOR operator was used as one of the SELECT elements in the subquery of a CREATE VIEW or CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT statement.
solution: Remove the CURSOR operator and replace it with the CAST operator.

message: cannot grant privileges on columns of an object table
cause: An attempt was made to grant privileges on the columns of an object table.
solution: None

message: cannot create VARRAY column with embedded LOB
cause: An attempt was made to create a column of a VARRAY type which has an embedded LOB attribute. The LOB could be an attribute of a subtype of the declared type of VARRAY's element.
solution: Remove offending attribute from type. If it is a subtype attribute then declare the VARRAY column NOT SUBSTITUTABLE.

message: invalid user-defined type - type is incomplete
cause: An attempt was made to use an incomplete type definition as a column or table datatype.
solution: Complete the type definition and retry the operation.

message: internal error: string
cause: An unexpected error condition was detected.
solution: Make a note of the error number and message and contact Oracle Support Services.

message: error setting an OCI attribute: string
cause: An OCI error has occurred.
solution: The table or column referenced may not be accessible. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be resolved.

message: error fetching an OCI attribute: string
cause: An OCI error has occurred.
solution: The table or column referenced may not be accessible. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be resolved.

message: error in exporting/importing data string
cause: An error has occurred in a stream export or import operation. This message will be followed by another message giving more details about this error.
solution: See export/import documentation for an explanation of the second error message.

message: error opening file: string
cause: An attempt to open the specified file for data export/import failed.
solution: Review the error message. Resolve the problem and retry the the operation. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be resolved.

message: The database is out of space. The load cannot continue

message: header in file string may not contain correct information
cause: The header may be corrupted.

message: error in exporting or importing data
cause: An error has occurred in a stream export or import operation.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: database version in file string is not valid
cause: The specified file could not be used for this load because its database version was not compatible with the database version in the other files in the DUMPFILE clause.

message: fatal error during data export/import initialization
cause: An unexpected error occurred during initialization for data export/import.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: error while attempting to allocate number bytes of memory
cause: d by insufficient memory.
solution: Reconnect to the instance and retry the operation.

message: error closing file: string
cause: An attempt to close the specified file for data export/import failed.
solution: Review the error message. Resolve the problem and retry the the operation. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be resolved.

message: error reading from file: string
cause: An attempt to read from the specified file for data export/import failed.
solution: Review the error message. Resolve the problem and retry the the operation. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be resolved.

message: error writing to file: string
cause: An attempt to write to the specified file for data export/import failed.
solution: Review the error message. Resolve the problem and retry the the operation. Contact Oracle Support Services if

solution: Review the error message. Resolve the problem and retry the the operation. Contact Oracle Support Services if

cause: The table had some indexes which were loaded if there were no errors.
solution: None

message: read ended but had expected more data from file string

solution: Verify unload operation completed successfully and that the files had not been accidentally truncated.

message: the following file is not valid for this load operation
cause: A file could not be used for this load. See the following message for more information.
solution: Verify all the files in the DUMPFILE clause are from the same unload operation and that the unload was successful.

message: internal number in header in file string is not valid
cause: The specified file could not be used for this load because the internal number in the header was not valid.
solution: If the dump files were transferred over, verify the transfer operation was done correctly.

message: internal metadata in file string is not valid
cause: The specified file could not be used for this load because the internal metadata stored in this file does not match the metadata stored in the first file piece set.
solution: Verify all the files in the DUMPFILE clause are from the same unload operation.

message: Loader must be at least version string . string . string . string . string for direct path
cause: The loader being used is incompatible with this version of the kernel.
solution: Upgrade your loader to at least the specified version or use the conventional path.

message: data for row: string
cause: A conversion error occurred while loading data into a table. The message shows values for the field in the row that had the conversion error.
solution: None. This is only an informational message.

message: Error parsing insert statement for table string .
cause: self-evident.
solution: Check the error given below this one.

message: conversion error loading table string . string
cause: A row could not be loaded into the table because there was a conversion error for one or more columns in a row.

message: conversion error loading table string . string partition string
cause: A row could not be loaded into the table because there was a conversion error for one or more columns in a row.
solution: See the message that follows for more information about the row that could not be loaded. To avoid this error, make sure the definition of the table being imported matches the definition of the table being exported.

message: invalid or redundant resource
cause: a create, or alter profile command which names a resource not yet defined, or try to specify same resource twice.
solution: define resource first

message: invalid resource limit
cause: specifying limit of 0
solution: specify limit > 0

message: profile string already exists
cause: Try to create a profile which already exist
solution: None

message: profile string does not exist
cause: Try to assign a user to a non-existant profile
solution: None

message: cannot drop PUBLIC_DEFAULT profile
cause: Try to drop PUBLIC_DEFAULT profile
solution: None

message: illegal cost factor
cause: Negative or UNLIMITED cost for this resourc
solution: None

message: exceeded maximum idle time, please connect again
cause: as stated
solution: None

message: exceeded PRIVATE_SGA limit, you are being logged off
cause: Only when using TP monitor
solution: expand limit

message: exceeded procedure space usage
cause: Stored procedured used up too much space in SYSTEM Tablespace
solution: Use less stored procedure

message: exceeded maximum connect time, you are being logged off
cause: As stated
solution: None

message: explain plan output buffer size limit exceeded
cause: Internally this error is raised and caught to handle cases where the plan output exceeds te buffer size. The output is truncated in cases.
solution: This error should never be seen externally.

message: cannot EXPLAIN view owned by another user
cause: The view specified in the SQL statement belongs to another user and cannot be explained.
solution: Create a view with the same definition that belongs to current user.

message: PLAN_TABLE not found
cause: The table used by EXPLAIN to store row source information does not exist in the current schema.
solution: Create a plan table in the current schema or use the INTO clause of the statement to put the results of the explain command in an existing plan table.

message: plan table does not have correct format
cause: The explicit plan table does not have the appropriate field definitions.
solution: Redefine the plan table to have the appropriate field definitions.

message: specified plan table not found
cause: The specified plan table does cannot be found.
solution: Create the specified plan table or use an existing plan table.

message: invalid sql plan object provided
cause: The user provided a NULL, empty, or malformed object of type SQL_PLAN_TABLE_TYPE
solution: Provide a new, properly formed object to the function

message: missing schema authorization clause
cause: the AUTHORIZATION clause is missing from a create schema statement.
solution: Preceed the schema authorization identifier with the AUTHORIZATION keyword.

message: missing or invalid schema authorization identifier
cause: the schema name is missing or is incorrect in an authorization clause of a create schema statement.
solution: If the name is present, it must be the same as the current schema.

message: missing or invalid schema element
cause: A statement other than a create table, create view, or grant privilege appears in a create schema statement.
solution: Self-evident.

message: schema name does not match schema authorization identifier
cause: a table definition with a schema name prepended to the table name does not match the schema name provided in the authorization clause of a create schema statement.
solution: make sure the schema names match.

message: potential circular view references or unknown referenced tables
cause: the create schema statement contains views that depend on other views in the containing create schema statement or they contain references to unknown tables.
solution: create the dependent views in a separate create schema statement and make sure all referenced tables are either defined in the create schema statement or exist outside the statement.

message: create table failed
cause: a create table statement failed in the create schema statement.
solution: the cause for failure will be presented below this error message. Follow appropriate action(s) as suggested by the subsequent error message.

message: privilege grant failed
cause: a grant privilege statement failed inthe create schema statement.
solution: the cause for failure will be presented below this error message. Follow appropriate action(s) as suggested by the subsequent error message.

message: create view failed
cause: a create view statement failed in the create schema statement.
solution: the cause for failure will be presented below this error message. Follow appropriate action(s) as suggested by the subsequent error message.

message: could not add foreign key reference
cause: could not add a foreign key reference because of error in declaration. Either referenced table does not exist or table does not have an unique key.
solution: make sure referenced table exists and/or has unique key

message: cannot drop index used for enforcement of unique/primary key
cause: user attempted to drop an index that is being used as the enforcement mechanism for unique or primary key.
solution: drop the constraint instead of the index.

message: cannot enable constraint ( string ) - no such constraint
cause: the named constraint does not exist for this table.
solution: Obvious

message: cannot disable constraint ( string ) - no such constraint
cause: the named constraint does not exist for this table.
solution: Obvious

message: cannot enable primary key - primary key not defined for table
cause: Attempted to enable a primary key that is not defined for the table.
solution: Need to add a primary key definition for the table.

message: cannot disable primary key - primary key not defined for table
cause: Attempted to disable a primary key tht is not defined for the table.
solution: None

message: cannot enable unique( string ) - unique key not defined for table
cause: attempted to enable a unique key that is not defined for the table.
solution: None

message: cannot disable unique( string ) - unique key not defined for table
cause: attempted to disable a unique key that is not deined for the table.
solution: None

message: date or system variable wrongly specified in CHECK constraint
cause: An attempt was made to use a date constant or system variable, such as USER, in a check constraint that was not completely specified in a CREATE TABLE or ALTER TABLE statement. For example, a date was specified without the century.
solution: Completely specify the date constant or system variable. Setting the event 10149 allows constraints like "a1 > '10-MAY-96'", which a bug permitted to be created before version 8.

message: cannot validate ( string . string ) - primary key violated
cause: attempted to validate a primary key with duplicate values or null values.
solution: remove the duplicates and null values before enabling a primary key.

message: Column check constraint cannot reference other columns
cause: attempted to define a column check constraint that references another column.
solution: define it as a table check constriant.

message: Unique index on a deferrable constraint is not allowed
cause: attempted to enable a deferrable primary key/unique constraint that has an existing unique index on the constraint columns.
solution: Drop the index on the constraint columns or make the constraint not deferrable.

message: Create as select with referential constraints not allowed
cause: create table foo (... ref. con. ...) as select ...;
solution: Create the table as select, then alter the table to add the constraints afterwards.

message: Cannot drop nonexistent primary key
cause: alter table drop primary key - primary key does not exist.
solution: None

message: Cannot drop nonexistent unique key
cause: alter table drop unique (<col list>) - unique specification does not exist.
solution: make sure column list for unique constraint is correct.

message: Cannot drop constraint - nonexistent constraint
cause: alter table drop constraint <constraint_name>
solution: make sure you supply correct constraint name.

message: Cannot resolve referenced object in referential constraints
cause: attempted to define foreign key referencing an object which cannot be resolved to a base table reference
solution: referential constraints can only be defined on objects which can be resolve to base table reference

message: Exceptions table not found
cause: the explicity or implicity declared exceptions table does not exist.
solution: Create the table then issue the enable command again.

message: CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT failed - check constraint violated
cause: An attempt was made to use a CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT statement when some rows violated one or more CHECK constraints.
solution: Do not select rows that violate constraints.

message: cannot defer a constraint that is not deferrable
cause: An attempt was made to defer a nondeferrable constraint
solution: Drop the constraint and create a new one that is deferrable

message: constraint does not exist
cause: The named constraint does not exist
solution: Stop trying to do something with a nonexistant constraint

message: unique/primary keys in table referenced by foreign keys
cause: An attempt was made to drop a table with unique or primary keys referenced by foreign keys in another table.
solution: Before performing the above operations the table, drop the foreign key constraints in other tables. You can see what constraints are referencing a table by issuing the following command: SELECT * FROM USER_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = "tabnam";

message: Invalid hash option - missing keyword IS
cause: Missing IS keyword.
solution: Specify HASH IS option.

message: duplicate HASHKEYS specification
cause: The HASHKEYS option is specified more than once.
solution: Only specify the HASHKEYS option once.

message: invalid HASHKEYS option value
cause: The specified HASHKEYS option must be an integer value.
solution: Specify an appropriate value.

message: duplicate HASH IS specification
cause: The HASH IS option is specified more than once.
solution: only specify the HASH IS option once.

message: Number of hash keys per block ( string ) exceeds maximum of string
cause: The SIZE argument is too small.
solution: Increase the SIZE argument.

message: The number of cluster key column must be 1
cause: When specifing the HASH IS option, the number of key columns must be 1.
solution: Either do not specify the HASH IS option or reduce the number of key columns.

message: The HASH IS column specification must be NUMBER(*,0)
cause: The column specification must specify an integer.
solution: Specify the column definition as type NUMBER(precision, 0).

message: The HASH IS option must specify a valid column
cause: The HASH IS column name is not specified in the cluster definition.
solution: Specify a valid column name.

message: HASHKEYS must be specified for a HASH CLUSTER
cause: The HASHKEYS option must be specified when creating a HASH CLUSTER.
solution: Specify the HASHKEYS option.

message: Hashkey value must be a positive integer
cause: The value of the hash key was not a positive number.
solution: Specify a positive integer.

message: Inappropriate index operation on a hash cluster
cause: An attempt to create a cluster index was issued on a hash cluster.
solution: Do not attempt to create such an index.

message: Inappropriate use of the INDEX option
cause: This option is only valid for non hash clusters.
solution: Do not specify this option.

message: Duplicate INDEX option specified
cause: The INDEX option is specified more than once.
solution: Only specify the INDEX option once.

message: Duplicate HASH IS option specified
cause: The HASH IS option is specified more than once.
solution: Only specify the HASH IS option once.

message: Cluster definition can not be both HASH and INDEX
cause: The cluster can either be a hash or indexed cluster - not both.
solution: Remove either the HASH IS or INDEX options.

message: Inappropriate use of the HASH IS option
cause: This option is only valid for clusters
solution: Do not specify this option

message: The SIZE and INITRANS options cannot be altered for HASH CLUSTERS.
cause: An attempt was made to change the SIZE and INITRANS options after the hash cluster was created.
solution: Do not specify this option.

message: Column referenced in expression not found in cluster definition
cause: A column in the hash is expression was not present in cluster definition.
solution: Recreate the cluster and correct the error in hash expression.

message: Constant or system variable wrongly specified in expression
cause: A constant or system variable was specified in the hash expression.
solution: Recreate the cluster and correct the error in hash expression.

message: Hash expression does not return an Oracle Number.
cause: Result of evaluating hash expression is not an Oracle Number.
solution: Recreate the cluster and correct the error in hash expression.

message: TO_DATE, USERENV, or SYSDATE incorrectly used in hash expression.
cause: TO_DATE, USERENV and SYSDATE are not allowed in hash expressions.
solution: Recreate the cluster and correct the error in hash expression.

message: SYSDATE, UID, USER, ROWNUM, or LEVEL incorrectly used in hash expre\ssion.
cause: SYSDATE, UID, USER, ROWNUM, or LEVEL are not allowed in hash expression\s.
solution: Recreate the cluster and remove the offending keywords.

message: PL/SQL functions not allowed in hash expressions
cause: A PL/SQL function was used in the hash expression.
solution: Recreate the cluster and remove the PL/SQL function.

message: Error while evaluating the cluster's hash expression.
cause: An error occurred while evaluating the clusters hash expression.
solution: Correct the query and retry.

message: Fixed hash area extents used ( string ) exceeds maximum allowed ( string )
cause: The number of extents required for creating the fixed hash area exceeds the maximum number allowed.
solution: Reduce the number of extents required by increasing the extent allocation sizes within the STORAGE clause.

message: maximum cluster chain block count of string has been exceeded
cause: The number of blocks in a cluster chain exceeds the maximum number allowed.
solution: Increase SIZE parameter in CREATE CLUSTER statement or reconsider suitability of cluster key.

message: can not create index due to parallel direct load on table
cause: A parallel direct load is occurring to the specified table.
solution: Retry statement after load is complete.

message: can not perform parallel direct load on object string
cause: A parallel direct load is not possible because an index is is being created on the table.
solution: Retry load after index creation is complete.

message: merge into base segment would overflow MAXEXTENTS limit
cause: Merge of temporary segment into base segment failed because MAXEXTENTS was larger than the total in the temp and base segments
solution: Use a larger value for MAXEXTENTS on the base segment or make the extents in the temporary segments larger

message: error while translating file name for parallel load
cause: An invalid file name was specified to load data into.
solution: Specify a valid database file.

message: Too many processes specified for events (max string )
cause: Too many processes specified than allowed per event.
solution: Enter fewer processes by using ranges or wildcards if possible.

message: Syntax error in event specification ( string )
cause: Illegal event string
solution: Enter a legal event string

message: Syntax error in process specification ( string )
cause: Illegal process string
solution: Enter a legal process string
