message: Invalid _trace_buffers parameter specification ( string )
cause: Bad process or size in _trace_buffers INIT.ORA parameter.
solution: None

message: Invalid _trace_options parameter specification ( string )
cause: Bad syntax for _trace_options INIT.ORA parameter.
solution: None

message: Error in writing trace file string
cause: Error occurred in creating/writing the file.
solution: Check file name and make sure it is constructed properly. Also, check permissions for directories.

message: Error in converting trace data
cause: Incompatible binary trace data was specified.
solution: Check the format of the input data.

message: Error encountered when accessing file [ string ] for trace conversion
cause: An attempt was made to open or access the trace file during a trace conversion.
solution: Check the permissions for both input and output files. Also, check the file compatibility for the trace conversion.

message: missing required file size in RESIZE clause
cause: No value was specified for the RESIZE clause.
solution: Use correct syntax.

message: missing required keyword ON or OFF in AUTOEXTEND clause
cause: The keyword ON or OFF was not specified for the AUTOEXTEND clause.
solution: Use correct syntax.

message: missing required file block increment size in NEXT clause
cause: No value was specified for the NEXT clause.
solution: Use correct syntax.

message: invalid file increment size in NEXT clause
cause: A non-integer value was used for the NEXT clause of the DATAFILE list.
solution: Use correct syntax.

message: invalid or missing maximum file size in MAXSIZE clause
cause: UNLIMITED was not specified, or an invalid integer value was specified, for the MAXSIZE clause in the DATAFILE file list. The MAXSIZE value cannot be smaller than the SIZE value.
solution: Use correct syntax.

message: cannot resize file string , tablespace string is read only
cause: An attempt was made to resize a data file in a tablespace that is read only.
solution: Change the tablespace to read/write and retry the resize operation.

message: osnoraenv: error translating ORACLE_SID
cause: Two-task driver could not find the value of ORACLE_SID in the environment.
solution: Make sure that the ORACLE_SID environment variable has been properly set and exported.

message: osnoraenv: error translating oracle image name
cause: ORACLE_HOME environment variable not set.
solution: Make sure that the ORACLE_HOME environment variable has been properly set and exported.

message: osnoraenv: error translating orapop image name
cause: ORACLE_HOME environment variable not set.
solution: Make sure that the ORACLE_HOME environment variable has been properly set and exported.

message: osnpopipe: pipe creation failed
cause: The pipe driver failed to create pipes for communications with the orapop process.
solution: You have probably exceeded the maximum number of open file descriptors per user or the system file table is full. Note the operating system error code and contact your system administrator.

message: osndopop: fork failed
cause: The two-task driver could not fork orapop.
solution: Verify that there are enough system resources to support another process. The user or system process limit may have been exceeded, or the amount of free memory or swap space may be temporarily insufficient.

message: osnpol: polling of communication channel failed
cause: The pipe driver failed while polling the communications channel.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnshs: host name too long
cause: The length of your host-string specified by the TWO_TASK environment variable exceeds the ORACLE system-imposed limit.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnacx: cannot allocate context area
cause: The invoked Unix two-task driver could not allocate heap space for the context area.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnrntab: connect to host failed, unknown ORACLE_SID
cause: The invoked Unix two-task driver failed to find an entry in oratab for the sid you supplied.
solution: First, check whether you have read access to oratab, and see if the desired sid is there. Add an entry to oratab for the desired sid, if necessary.

message: osnpop: pipe creation failed
cause: The pipe driver failed to create pipes for two-task communications with the oracle shadow process.
solution: You have probably exceeded the maximum number of open file descriptors per user or the system file table is full. Note the operating system error code and contact your system administrator.

message: osnpop: fork failed
cause: The pipe driver could not fork the oracle shadow process.
solution: Verify that there are enough system resources to support another process. The user or system process limit may have been exceeded, or the amount of free memory or swap space may be temporarily insufficient.

message: osnpvalid: write to validation channel failed
cause: The pipe driver failed to write to the orapop process.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpop: malloc failed
cause: The pipe driver failed to allocate enough heap space for its context area buffers.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnprd: message receive failure
cause: The pipe driver failed to read a message from the communications channel.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpwr: message send failure
cause: The pipe driver failed to write a message to the communications channel.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpgetbrkmsg: message from host had incorrect message type
cause: The pipe driver received a message having an unrecognizable message type.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpgetdatmsg: message from host had incorrect message type
cause: The Pipe driver received a message having an unrecognizable message type.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpfs: incorrect number of bytes written
cause: The Pipe driver sent a message that was apparently successful, but the number of bytes transmitted did not match the number of bytes furnished to the driver.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnprs: reset protocol error
cause: The two-task driver could not reset the connection.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnfop: fork failed
cause: The fast driver could not fork the oracle shadow process.
solution: Verify that there are enough system resources to support another process. The user or system process limit may have been exceeded, or the amount of free memory or swap space may be temporarily insufficient.

message: osnfop: shmat failed
cause: When the fast driver was invoked, processes failed to attach to the shared memory buffer. You probably supplied an illegal shared memory attach address, or the system ran out of data space to accomodate the buffer.
solution: Try invoking the Fast driver later, or use the default attach address.

message: osnseminit: cannot create semaphore set
cause: The Fast driver failed to get a semaphore set.
solution: The system-imposed limit on semaphores or semaphore identifiers may have been exceeded. Read the returned operating system error code and check with your system administrator.

message: osnpui: cannot send break message to orapop
cause: The Pipe driver could not send a break message to orapop.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpui: cannot send break signal
cause: The Pipe driver could not send a break message to the ORACLE shadow process.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpbr: cannot send break message to orapop
cause: The Pipe driver could not send a break message to orapop.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpbr: cannot send break signal
cause: The Pipe driver could not send a break message to the ORACLE shadow process.
solution: Kill system call failed. Check errno and contact customer support.

message: osnpop: access error on oracle executable
cause: The Pipe driver could not access the oracle executable.
solution: Check the permissions on the ORACLE executable and each component of the ORACLE_HOME/bin path.

message: osnpop: access error on orapop executable
cause: The Pipe driver could not access the orapop executable.
solution: Check the permissions on the orapop executable and each component of the ORACLE_HOME/bin path.

message: osnfop: access error on oracle executable
cause: The Fast driver could not access the oracle executable.
solution: Check the permissions on the ORACLE executable and each component of the ORACLE_HOME/bin path.

message: osncon: driver not in osntab
cause: The driver you have specified is not supported.
solution: Check with your database administrator which drivers are supported.

message: osnrnf: cannot find user logon directory
cause: The driver you have specified could not find your logon directory while searching for your local .sqlnet file.
solution: Set and export the HOME environment variable to identify your home directory. Check with your system administrator to make sure that your uid and home directory are correct in the /etc/passwd file.

message: osnrnf: malloc of buffer failed
cause: The specified driver could not find enough heap space to malloc a buffer.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnrnf: cannot find a matching database alias
cause: Database alias specified was not identified in either $HOME/.sqlnet or /etc/sqlnet.
solution: Create the alias in a file called .sqlnet in your home directory for personal use or ask your system administrator to create the alias in /etc/sqlnet for system-wide use.

message: osnsnf: database string too long
cause: While converting a database alias to a database ID, the resulting database ID string exceeded the ORACLE system-imposed limit.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnftt: cannot reset shared memory permission
cause: The Fast driver was unable to reset shared memory permissions.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnfpm: cannot create shared memory segment
cause: The Fast driver failed to create a shared memory segment for two-task communication.
solution: Check whether the system-imposed limit on shared memory identifiers has already been reached for your system.

message: osnfpm: illegal default shared memory address
cause: The Fast driver failed to establish a default shared memory address.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpcl: cannot tell orapop to exit
cause: The Pipe driver failed to send orapop the command to exit.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnpwrtbrkmsg: incorrect number of bytes written
cause: The pipe driver apparently sent an imcomplete break message.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osncon: host alias is too long
cause: The alias used for a sqlnet host is longer than 161 characters.
solution: Use a shorter alias.

message: osnfsmmap: cannot open shared memory file ?/dbs/ftt_<pid>.dbf
cause: The Fast driver failed to create a shared memory file for two-task communication.
solution: Check the permissions on the directory ?/dbs

message: osnfsmmap: cannot map shared memory file
cause: The Fast driver failed to map a shared memory file for two-task communication.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnfsmmap: illegal shared memory address
cause: The Fast driver failed to attach shared memory at the expected location.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnfsmmap: cannot close shared memory file
cause: The Fast driver cannot close the shared memory file.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnfsmmap: cannot change shared memory inheritence
cause: The Fast driver could not alter the inheritence attributes of the shared memory.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnfsmcre: cannot create chared memory file ?/dbs/ftt_<pid>.dbf
cause: The Fast driver failed to create a file for shared memory.
solution: Check the permissions on the directory ?/dbs

message: osnfsmnam: name translation failure
cause: The Fast driver encountered an error translating the shared memory filename ?/dbs/ftt_<pid>.dbf.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: osnfop: fork_and_bind failed
cause: The Fast driver failed to fork a process onto the desired cluster and node number.
solution: Check the desired node number in sercose[0] and cluster ID in sercose[1]. If these seem valid, contact customer support.

message: Allocation of internal array failed
cause: The package was unable to allocate memory for an array because the system ran out of memory.
solution: Either reclaim memory by killing other processes or reboot the machine with more memory.

message: Not enough request descriptors available
cause: All of the package's request descriptors are in use performing other requests.
solution: Either wait until enough requests are done, or shut the package down and re-initialize it with more request descriptors.

message: Client close of file failed.
cause: The client was unable to close a file after forking the servers.
solution: This is a system problem - contact your System Administrator.

message: File number to be canceled is negative.
cause: The file number contained with the sfiov structure is less than zero.
solution: This may be a programming error. If it is not, contact ORACLE support.

message: file number to be cancelled is greater than the maximum.
cause: The file number contained with the sfiov structure is greater than the maximum.
solution: This may be a programming error. If it is not, contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to cancel at least one request
cause: No requests were found that could be cancelled.
solution: This error can occur if all the requests dealing with that file number have already been filled.

message: Invalid package mode
cause: The mode of the package can only be parallel or duplex.
solution: See sfa.h for the correct values.

message: Invalid maximum number of servers
cause: The number of servers given was less than or equal to zero.
solution: Use a number greater than zero.

message: Invalid maximum of request descriptors
cause: The number of request descriptors was less than or equal to zero.
solution: Use a number greater than zero.

message: Less than one request descriptor was allocated per server
cause: The package requires that the number of request descriptors be greater than or equal to the number of servers used.
solution: Use a higher number

message: Maximum number of files is invalid
cause: The maximum number of files to be used by the package was less than or equal to zero.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Setting of handler for SIGTERM failed
cause: The package was unable to set up handling by the server for the termination signal. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Total number of blocks is invalid
cause: The total number of blocks to be allocated for use by the package was not greater than zero.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Illegal request time out value
cause: The number was not a positive number.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Invalid maximum server idle time
cause: The time given was not a positive number.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Invalid maximum client wait time
cause: The time given was not a positive number.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Invalid request list latch time out value
cause: The time given was not a positive number.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Invalid request done signal
cause: The signal number was not a positive number.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Value for request done signal exceeds maximum
cause: The value sent to the package for use as the "request done" signal exceeds the maximum allowed by the operating system.
solution: None

message: Stat failed on log directory
cause: The package was unable to get information about the directory in which the log files are to reside.
solution: Check the permissions on the directory or use a different directory name.

message: Name given for the log directory is invalid
cause: The name given for the directory in which the logs are to be kept does not correspond to a directory.
solution: Use a different name.

message: Stat failed on core dump directory
cause: The package was unable to get information about the directory into which the servers are to dump core in the event of an exception.
solution: Check the permissions on the directory or use a different directory name.

message: Name given for the core dump directory is invalid
cause: The name given for the directory in which the server processes are to dump core in the event of an exception does not correspond to a directory.
solution: Use a different name.

message: Invalid value given for the timing wanted flag
cause: The value given was not TRUE or FALSE.
solution: None

message: Both read and write functions were not specified
cause: To ensure that the functions act symmetrically, pointers to both the read and write functions must be given.
solution: Either specify both functions or specify neither. The package will supply its own functions.

message: Both post and wait functions were not specified
cause: To ensure that the functions act symmetrically, pointers to both the posting and waiting functions must be given.
solution: Either specify both functions or specify neither. The package will supply its own functions.

message: Invalid shared memory ID specified
cause: The ID of the segment specified for use as the shared buffer region was invalid.
solution: Use a different ID, or let the package specify its own.

message: Invalid shared memory buffer size
cause: The size given for the shared memory segment to be used as the shared buffer region was less than or equal to zero.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Size needed for shared region is greater than segment size
cause: The size of the shared segment that was specified for the shared buffer region is less than the number of bytes required. The first field of the "additional information" field is the size needed. The second is the size of the segment.
solution: Use a larger size segment or let the package allocate its own.

message: Unable to allocate memory for segment list
cause: The package cannot allocate memory for an internal segment list because the system has run out of memory. The "additional information" field is the amount of memory that the package attempted to allocate.
solution: None

message: Unable to find kernel process pointer in async process array
cause: Internal error - Contact ORACLE support.
solution: None

message: Maximum number of files reached
cause: The maximum number of files that can be used for asynchronous I/O has been reached.
solution: Shut down the servers and re-initialize the package with a higher number.

message: File name is too long
cause: The length of the name of a file that is being opened for asynchronous I/O is longer than the maximum. The "additional information" field is the maximum length.
solution: Use a shorter name.

message: Unable to open file for use with asynchronous I/O
cause: The package could not open file for some reason.
solution: Check the file name.

message: Unable to fstat() a file being used for asynchronous I/O.
cause: The fstat(2) call on a file being used for asynchronous I/O failed.
solution: Check the file name.

message: Close of asynchronous I/O failed.
cause: The client was unable to close a file being used for asynchronous I/O.
solution: Contact ORACLE support - this should not happen.

message: Client unable to get key for shared memory
cause: The client was unable to get a key so that it obtain shared memory for use with shared memory.
solution: Contact ORACLE support - this is an internal error.

message: Request list is empty
cause: The client was signalled by a server that it was done with a request but the "done" list was empty.
solution: Internal error - contact ORACLE support.

message: Done request is not in correct state
cause: A request is not in the right state.
solution: Internal error - contact ORACLE support.

message: No requests available
cause: No free request descriptors are available.
solution: Wait until some requests are filled and then retry the request, or shutdown the servers and initialize the package with a higher number of requests.

message: Invalid number of requests
cause: The number of operations sent to either sfard() or sfawrite() is less than zero.
solution: This is a user programming error.

message: Unable to arm signal handler
cause: The arming of a signal handler for the "done" signal failed.
solution: Internal error - contact ORACLE support.

message: Requests timed out
cause: Some of the requests for asynchronous input or output were not serviced in the required amount of time.
solution: If the load on the system is high, it is possible that the timeout limit is too low. Reset it with sfainit(). If the server processes are dying due to unexpected signals, this is an internal error, and ORACLE support should be contacted.

message: Operations timed out
cause: Some asynchronous operations timed out in kernel mode.
solution: Internal error - contact ORACLE support.

message: No idle servers available in parallel mode
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Retrieval of current time failed
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Allocation of memory failed for log file name
cause: The client was unable to allocated a buffer for the name of the log file.
solution: Contact your System Administrator.

message: Unable to set handler for SIGTPA
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to set handler for SIGALRM
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Allocation of memory for I/O vectors failed.
cause: The client was unable to allocate memory for the array of I/O vectors that the servers are to use.
solution: Contact your System Administrator.

message: Allocation of memory of open files array failed.
cause: The client was unable to allocate memory for an array of flags that the servers are to use.
solution: Contact your System Administrator.

message: Jump buffer not valid
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to make temporary file name in order to get key
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to get shared memory
cause: Shmget(2) failed.
solution: Check the UNIX number. If you are unsure about what it means, contact ORACLE customer support.

message: Unable to attach shared memory
cause: Shmat(2) failed.
solution: Check the UNIX number. If you are unsure about what it means, contact ORACLE customer support.

message: Unable to kill a process
cause: A server did not die after being sent a kill signal.
solution: The process may be a runaway - contact ORACLE customer support.

message: Read failed
cause: A server could not read a requested amount of data.
solution: Check the call to sfard(). An incorrect file descriptor may have been sent to sfard(). The number in the "additional information" field is the starting block number of the data segment being read in.

message: Less than the number of blocks requested was read in
cause: A server could not read in the request amount of data. The first number in the "additional information" field is the block number being read in. The second is the actual number of bytes that was read in.
solution: This is a programming error.

message: Write failed
cause: A server was unable to perform a write. The number in the "additional information" field is the starting block number of the data segment being written out. The first number in the "additional information" field is the block number being written out. The second is the actual number of bytes that was written out. The disk may have filled up.
solution: Check the UNIX error number.

message: Unable to write the requested number of blocks
cause: A server could not write the requested amount of data out to disk. The disk may have run out of space.
solution: Check the UNIX error number.

message: Unable to read the requested number of blocks.
cause: A server could not read the number of blocks that was requested. The end of the file may have been read.
solution: Check the file on disk.

message: Invalid block offset
cause: A server was unable to seek to the designated block.
solution: Check the UNIX error number.

message: Buffer is not aligned.
cause: The buffer on which an I/O is being done is not on the correct boundary.
solution: Check the calling program.

message: Request free list is empty
cause: The list from which the package allocates request descriptors is empty because all of the descriptors is in use.
solution: Wait until some become free, or initialize the package with a higher number of request descriptors.

message: Request on free list was not free
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Illegal block size
cause: A negative number was given for the I/O block size to be used by the asynchronous I/O package.
solution: This is a programming error - use either a positive number or zero to get the default value.

message: Invalid file number
cause: The file number upon which an operation is to done is either less than zero or greater than the maximum number of files than can be open.
solution: This is a programming error. Since the calling program should not touch this number, this is a programming error.

message: Segment free list is empty
cause: No segments are available to allocated.
solution: Free some segments or shut down the package and re-initialize it with a higher number of segments.

message: No segment of the proper size is available
cause: No segment of the proper size is ready for use by the caller.
solution: Free some segments and try again.

message: Segment could not be split - no free segments available
cause: A segment that is larger than that desired could not be split because no free segment was available.
solution: Free some segments and try again.

message: Segment deallocation failed - empty segment list
cause: The caller attempted to deallocate a segment but the "in use" list was empty. This is a programming error.
solution: Check the calling program.

message: Segment deallocation failed - segment not on list
cause: The caller attempted to deallocate a segment that was not on the "in use" list. This is a programming error.
solution: Check the calling program.

message: Server was unable to close file
cause: A server was unable to close a file being used for asynchronous I/O.
solution: See the UNIX error number for more information.

message: Server unable to open file
cause: The server was unable to open a file for use with asynchronous I/O.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for more information.

message: Server unable to send signal to client
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to create temporary key file
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to unlink temporary file
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to arm signal handler for the alarm signal
cause: The arming of a signal handler for the alarmsignal failed.
solution: Internal error - contact ORACLE support.

message: Sync of blocks to disk failed.
cause: The server was unable to flush its writes out to disk.
solution: Check the UNIX error number.

message: Open of log file by client failed
cause: The client process was unable to open its log file.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for more information.

message: Server died on start up
cause: A server exited during its initialization process.
solution: Check the servers' logs for more information.

message: Client unable to fork a server
cause: The client could not spawn a server. A possible reason is that the operating system has reached its limit on the number of processes that it can spawn.
solution: Either reduce the number of servers that are to be used, or reconfigure the operating system so that it can handle more processes.

message: Invalid value for kernel flag
cause: An illegal value was given for the kernel flag in the information structure. Only TRUE and FALSE are permitted.
solution: This is a programming error - check the calling routine.

message: Invalid value for the leave open flag
cause: A value was given for the flag that determines whether a file is to be left open after the client checks it to see if the servers can use it. Only TRUE and FALSE are supported.
solution: This is a programming error - check the calling routine.

message: Invalid value for the timing wanted flag
cause: A value was given for the flag that indicates that operations are to be timed out. Only TRUE and FALSE are supported.
solution: This is a programming error - check the calling routine.

message: Unkillable server
cause: A server would not respond to the termination signal. The first number is the number of the server. The second is its UNIX process number. This is an internal problem.
solution: This is an operating system problem.

message: Server did not terminate when posted
cause: A server did not respond to a posted request to shutdown. The first number is the number of the server. The second is its UNIX process number. This is an internal problem.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Asynchronous I/O package is not running
cause: An operation using the asynchronous I/O package was attempted without first initializing the package using sfainit().
solution: Call sfainit() before using the package.

message: Read failed because of an error
cause: A server could not read the requested amount of data from disk.
solution: Check the UNIX error number.

message: File is closed
cause: A file upon which an asynchronous I/O operation is to be performed has already been closed by the package.
solution: This is a programming error.

message: Request list is empty when it should not be
cause: This is an internal problem.
solution: Contact ORACLE support.

message: Invalid critical-section time out value
cause: The time given was not a positive number.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Invalid server list latch time out value
cause: The time given was not a positive number.
solution: Use a positive number.

message: Invalid number of request buffers
cause: The value given for "db_slave_buffers" in your INIT.ORA file is less than 0.
solution: Use a number that is greater than or equal to 0.

message: Number of requests is less than the number of slaves
cause: The value given for "db_slave_buffers" in your INIT.ORA file is less than the number specified for the number of slaves, "db_slaves."
solution: Specify a number that is greater than that given for "db_slaves" Alternatively, specify 0. The kernel will supply the appropriate number.

message: smpini: Unable to get shared memory for PGA
cause: Stated in errno.
solution: Resolve the problem.

message: smpini: Unable to attach to shared memory for PGA
cause: Stated in errno.
solution: Resolve the problem.

message: smpini: Unable to initialize memory protection
cause: The adspcinit program has not been executed.
solution: Execute the adscpinit program as shown in your Installation and Users' Guide. If the problem persists, try rebooting your computer.

message: sou2o: Variable smpdidini overwritten
cause: The variable smpdidini was overwritten, probably by client code.
solution: Verify client code, e.g. Pro*C, for illegal memory access. If the problem occurs outside Single Task operation, contact your customer support representative.

message: sou2o: Could not gain access to protected memory
cause: This is an internal error, note error code in errno.
solution: Report to your customer support representative. Restarting your application or your computer may cure the problem.

message: smpini: Could not register PGA for protection
cause: This is an internal error, note error code in errno.
solution: Report to your customer support representative. Restarting your application or your computer may cure the problem.

message: sou2o: Could not revoke access to protected memory
cause: This is an internal error, note error code in errno.
solution: Report to your customer support representative. Restarting your application or your computer may cure the problem.

message: sou2o: Could not register SGA for protection
cause: This is an internal error, note error code in errno.
solution: Report to your customer support representative. Restarting your application or your computer may cure the problem.

message: smscre: Cannot create SGA with Extended Shared Memory feature
cause: The environment variable EXTSHM was set before starting oracle.
solution: Unset the environment variable EXTSHM and startup oracle.

message: unimplemented feature
cause: This feature is not implemented.
solution: None

message: operator not implemented
cause: This is an internal error.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: obsolete feature
cause: User attempted to use a feature which is no longer supported.
solution: None

message: Incompatible OCI function call
cause: An incompatible OCI function call was issued for new functionality.
solution: Do not use V7 OCI calls for this functionality.

message: a server linked as single-task cannot use SQL*Net
cause: A statement containing a SQL*Net connect string was issued to the single-task server. For example, a database link was used in a SQL statement.
solution: Do not use SQL*Net connect strings in a single-task environment.

message: two-task detected inconsistent datatype specification
cause: There was both a datatype, and an anonymous datatype declaration found.
solution: Correct the specification.

message: attempt to close ORACLE-side window on user side
cause: This is an internal error.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: operation would block
cause: This is a status code that indicates that the operation cannot complete now.
solution: None; this is not an error. The operation should be retried again for completion.

message: two-task internal error
cause: Internal error.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: client-server protocol violation
cause: The application received a bad escape sequence from the server and may indicate a problem with the client application user code.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: network driver does not support non-blocking operations
cause: A non-blocking operation was attempted and the network driver does not support non-blocking operations.
solution: Use default blocking operations or use a driver supporting non-blocking operations.

message: no new operations allowed until the active operation ends
cause: An attempt was made to execute a new operation before the active non-blocking operation completed or a new operation was attempted before all the pieces of a column were inserted or fetched.
solution: Execute the new operation after the non-blocking operation completes. If piecewise binds/defines were done, execute the new operation after all the pieces have been inserted or fetched.

message: connection is in blocking mode
cause: The OCI test for non-blocking mode on a connection indicates that the connection is in blocking mode.
solution: If non-blocking mode is required use appropriate OCI calls to change the mode.

message: the next piece to be inserted is required
cause: The application performed a piecewise bind on a column.
solution: Provide the next piece of this bind variable.

message: the buffer for the next piece to be fetched is required
cause: The application performed a piecewise define on the column.
solution: Provide the next buffer for the next piece to be retrieved.

message: an invalid buffer was provided for the next piece
cause: The application either provided the length of the buffer for the next piece to be zero or provided a null pointer.
solution: Verify if the buffer pointer for the next piece is null or if the length is zero.

message: two-task default value overflow
cause: The default value specified for a record field was too large.
solution: Change the default value to fit the field size.

message: Connections to this server version are no longer supported.
cause: An attempt was made to connect to an Oracle server of older version.
solution: Please refer to documentation for more details.

message: connection lost contact
cause: 1) Server unexpectedly terminated or was forced to terminate. 2) Server timed out the connection.
solution: 1) Check if the server session was terminated. 2) Check if the timeout parameters are set properly in sqlnet.ora.

message: inbound connection timed out
cause: Inbound connection was timed out by the server because user authentication was not completed within the given time specified by SQLNET.INBOUND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT or its default value
solution: 1) Check SQL*NET and RDBMS log for trace of suspicious connections. 2) Configure SQL*NET with a proper inbound connect timeout value if necessary.

message: TTC protocol internal error : [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: TTC protocol internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Connection terminated due to security policy violation
cause: Connection was terminated due to a security policy violation.
solution: Contact the Database Administrator

message: This OCI call has been disabled by the DBA
cause: The SEC_DISABLE_OLDER_ORACLE_RPCS initialization parameter was enabled.
solution: Contact the Database Administrator

message: I/O operation in progress
cause: The current I/O operation was not complete. The error is typically returned from vectored and/or asynchronous I/O calls.
solution: Perform the necessary operation to complete or abort the current I/O.

message: I/O request queue full
cause: The I/O request queue was full and no more requests could be queued.
solution: Perform the proper operations to complete part or all of the current in-progress I/O requests.

message: Session ID: number Serial number: number
cause: Connection was lost for the specified session and serial number. This is either due to session being killed or network problems.
solution: Reconnect and if error persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Process ID: string Thread ID: string
cause: Connection was lost for the specified process ID and thread ID. This is either due to session being killed or network problems.
solution: Reconnect and if error persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Process ID: string
cause: Connection was lost for the specified process ID. This is either due to session being killed or network problems.
solution: Reconnect and if error persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: I/O streaming direction error
cause: Attempted to PUT data when GET streaming was in progress or attempted to GET data when PUT streaming was in progress.
solution: Complete current stream read or write I/O before attempting I/O in reverse direction.

message: Invalid buffer length for TTC field
cause: A corrupt Two-Task Common (TTC) packet was received.
solution: This is a internal protocol error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Missing mandatory TTC field
cause: A corrupt Two-Task Common (TTC) packet was received.
solution: This is an internal protocol error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Invalid Oracle error code
cause: An invalid Oracle error code was received by the server.
solution: This is an internal protocol error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: end-of-file on communication channel for database link
cause: The connection between the client and the remote server process was broken.
solution: Look in the alert.log file of the remote server for any errors. Also, check to see whether the remote server process is dead and whether a trace file was generated at failure time.

message: An invalid client operation was requested by the server
cause: You are using an Oracle client application linked with libraries with lower version than the current server version.
solution: Upgrade client libraries to be same as or higher than the server version.

message: deadlocked on readable physical standby (undo segment string )
cause: A new undo segment was added. A query can occasionally deadlock when issued around the time an undo segment is added and used immediately on the primary.
solution: Retry the query. Avoid creating new undo segments when using standby as a regular part of operation.

message: Recovery was terminated during query execution
cause: Recovery was terminated. A query can ocassionally deadlock when recovery is terminated because it needs a block with changes that are made after the point at which recovery was terminated.
solution: Retry the query. Avoid cancelling recovery on standby.

message: STANDBY_MAX_DATA_DELAY of string seconds exceeded
cause: Standby recovery fell behind the STANDBY_MAX_DATA_DELAY requirement.
solution: Tune recovery and retry the query later, or switch to another standby database within the data delay requirement.

message: Standby may not be synced with primary
cause: ALTER SESSION SYNC WITH PRIMARY did not work because either the standby was not synchronous or in a data-loss mode with regard to the primary, or the standby recovery was terminated.
solution: Make the standby synchronous and no-data-loss with regard to the primary. Make the standby recovery active.

message: STANDBY_MAX_DATA_DELAY does not apply to SYS users
cause: ALTER SESSION SET STANDBY_MAX_DATA_DELAY did not work for SYS users.
solution: Issue ALTER SESSION SET STANDBY_MAX_DATA_DELAY for non-SYS users.

message: parameter string mismatch
cause: The value of the %s parameter was not the same in all instances.
solution: Check %s in all instances.

message: string only works on an open physical standby database
cause: The database was not an open physical standby database.
solution: Issue the command on an open physical standby database.

message: the segment type specification is invalid
cause: segment type is not TABLE, INDEX, or CLUSTER
solution: use a correct segment type

message: the group number specification is invalid
cause: the freelist group number was either negative or larger than the the number of freelist groups in the segment
solution: use a correct group number

message: the scan limit specification is invalid
cause: the scan limit did not have a positive integer value the number of freelist groups in the segment
solution: use a correct scan limit

message: concurrent update activity makes space analysis impossible
cause: high volume of user updates interfere with the space analysis
solution: retry the command or lock the underlying objects

message: the segment type specification should indicate partitioning
cause: partition name is specified for the space analysis, but the object type does not indicate parttitioning
solution: specify PARTITION in the segment type, if the object is partitioned, otherwise, omit the partition name

message: partition name is required when partitioned type is specified
cause: partition name is not specified for the space analysis, but the object type indicates parttitioning
solution: specify partition name, if the object is partitioned, otherwise, specify a non-partitioned type

message: maximum file size of ( string ) blocks in AUTOEXTEND clause is out of range
cause: The maximum file size for an autoextendable file has exceeded the maximum number of blocks allowed.
solution: Reduce the size and retry.

message: subpartitioned type must be specified for composite object
cause: partition type is specified for the space analysis, but the object type indicates composite partitioning
solution: specify subpartition name and subpartition type

message: partitioned type must be specified for a non-composite object
cause: subpartition type is specified for the space analysis, but the object type indicates non-composite partitioning
solution: specify partition name and partition type

message: DBMS_ADMIN_PACKAGE invalid file/block specification
cause: The value of file number or block number is outside of limits or inconsistent
solution: Fix the file number/block number value

message: DBMS_ADMIN_PACKAGE invalid option specification
cause: The value of one of the option parameters is incorrect
solution: Fix the option value

message: The segment does not exist or is not in a valid state
cause: The segment specified in the DBMS_SPACE_ADMIN or DBMS_SPACE operation does not exist or is not in a state appropriate for this operation
solution: Fix the segment specification, or put the segment in the appropriate state.

message: Temporary Segment cannot be created in locally-managed tablespace
cause: Attempt to create a temporary segment for sort/hash/lobs in in permanent tablespace of kind locally-managed
solution: Alter temporary tablespace of user to a temporary tablespace or a dictionary-managed permanent tablespace

message: Invalid Lob Segment Name for DBMS_SPACE package
cause: The Lob Segment specified in the DBMS_SPACE operation does not exist.
solution: Fix the Segment Specification

message: File Size specified is smaller than minimum required
cause: File Size specified for add/resize datafile/tempfile does not allow for the minimum required of one allocation unit.
solution: Increase the specification for file size

message: File Size specified for resize is too small
cause: File Size specified for resize datafile/tempfile causes bitmap control structures to overlap
solution: Increase the specification for file size

message: Tablespace/Segment Verification cannot proceed
cause: Corruptions detected during verification whch cannot be dealt with
solution: Do manual verification

message: invalid option for alter of TEMPORARY TABLESPACE
cause: invalid option for alter of temporary tablespace was specified
solution: Specify one of the valid options: ADD TEMPFILE, TEMPFILE ONLINE, TEMPFILE OFFLINE

message: invalid option for CREATE/ALTER TABLESPACE
cause: invalid option for create/alter tablespace of type locally-managed
solution: Specify one of the valid options.

message: Tablespace ' string ' is dictionary-managed, offline or temporary
cause: Operation which is only applicable to permanent, online, locally-managed tablespaces is specified for a tablespace which is either dictionary-managed, offline or temporary
solution: Reissue operation for a different tablespace, mount the tablespace or do not issue it at all, since it does not apply for the given tablespace

message: DBMS_ADMIN_PACKAGE required parameter is NULL or missing
cause: Some of the procedures was called with missing or NULL parameters
solution: Specify the missing parameter

message: Temporary tablespaces and temporary segments must have standard block size
cause: An attempt was made to do one of the following : (1) create a temporary tablespace with a non-standard block size or, (2) alter an existing permanent tablespace of non-standard block size to a temporary tablespace or, (3) issue a DDL statement that would result in the creation of a temporary segment in a tablespace of non-standard block size.
solution: (1) If creating a temporary tablespace, do not specify a block size different from the standard block size. (2) If altering an existing permanent tablespace to a temporary tablespace, ensure that it is of standard block size. (3) Ensure that the user's temporary tablespace is a tablespace having the standard block size.

message: average row size and row count must be greater than zero
cause: Either a bad value passed to dbms_space.create_table_cost() or explain plan did not pass through size information.
solution: Check the row size parameter in dbms_space.create_table_cost(). For explain plan, make sure statistics have been computed for all source tables in the CREATE TABLE AS SELECT statement.

message: Bitmap index block addressable limitation reached
cause: The limitation of addressability of BMIB (Bitmap Index Block) was reached for the current blocksize.
solution: If the segment size has grown greater than addressability of BMIB (Bitmap Index Block), do the following: (1) Partition the table. (2) Move the segment to a tablespace having bigger blocksize.

message: segment only contains string blocks of unused space above high water mark
cause: Attempt to preserve too many blocks.
solution: reduce the KEEP amount.

message: the INITIAL extent may not be deallocated
cause: Attempt to deallocate space from the segment which was truncated prior to the 7.3 release.
solution: increase the KEEP amount, or truncate the segment, and reissue the command.

message: unable to extend table string . string subpartition string by string in tablespace string
cause: Failed to allocate an extent for table subpartition segment in tablespace.
solution: Use ALTER TABLESPACE ADD DATAFILE statement to add one or more files to the tablespace indicated.

message: unable to extend index string . string subpartition string by string in tablespace string
cause: Failed to allocate an extent for index subpartition segment in tablespace.
solution: Use ALTER TABLESPACE ADD DATAFILE statement to add one or more files to the tablespace indicated.

message: max # extents ( string ) reached in table string . string subpartition string
cause: A table subpartition tried to extend past maxextents
solution: If maxextents is less than the system maximum, raise it. Otherwise, you must recreate with larger initial, next or pctincrease params

message: max # extents ( string ) reached in index string . string subpartition string
cause: An index subpartition tried to extend past maxextents
solution: If maxextents is less than the system max, raise it. Otherwise, you must recreate with larger initial, next or pctincrease params.

message: Initial Extent of specified size cannot be allocated in tablespace ( string )
cause: Too large a size for an initial extent due to freelist group specification
solution: Reduce number of freelist groups specified for segment

message: unable to extend LOB segment string . string subpartition string by string in tablespace string
cause: An attempt was made to allocate an extent for LOB subpartition segment in tablespace, but the extent could not be allocated because there is not enough space in the tablespace indicated.
solution: Use the ALTER TABLESPACE ADD DATAFILE statement to add one or more files to the tablespace indicated.

message: maxextents ( string ) reached in LOB segment string . string subpartition string
cause: A LOB subpartition segment tried to extend past maxextents.
solution: If maxextents is less than the system maximum, raise it. Otherwise, recreate the subpartition with larger INITIAL, NEXT, or PCTINCREASE parameters.

message: User's temporary tablespace same as tablespace being migrated
cause: Users default temporary tablespace must be different from the tablespace being migrated.
solution: alter users default temporary tablespace to be different.

message: Invalid unit size
cause: User specified an invalid unit size for the tablespace
solution: Specify the correct unit size. To estimate unit size please refer to Oracle Server Administrator's Guide.

message: Tablespace migration retried 500 times
cause: For migration to complete, temporary segments should not be present in the tablespace at the time of migration.
solution: Avoid migrating the tablespace when there is heavy temporary segment creation going on as with object drops.

message: destination dba overlaps with existing control information
cause: Cannot overlap control information during relocation
solution: Please chose another destination address

message: No free space found to place the control information
cause: During migration of tablespace found no place to put the control information. If during bitmaps relocation, found no space at the specified destination.
solution: If during migration, add more space to the tablespace and retry migration. If during bitmaps relocation, specify a destination address where there is enough free space.

message: Tablespace has to be dictionary managed, online and permanent to be able to migrate
cause: Tablespace was not dictionary managed or online or permanent.
solution: Make sure the tablespace is online, permanent and dictionary managed

message: Invalid block number specified
cause: Control information cannot be placed at the specified dba either because the block number specified is beyond the file end or the file is not large enough to accomodate the control information at that location
solution: specify a correct block number

message: Invalid block number specified
cause: Relocation of bitmaps to the said destination will make the tablespace self descriptive
solution: Choose another destination dba.

message: Too much of segment creation activity during migration
cause: Temporary segments were attempted to be created during migration
solution: The error is signalled after retrying migration for 500 times. Run migration when there is less of segment creation activity is going on.

message: Uniform size for auto segment space managed tablespace should have atleast string blocks
cause: For the given blocksize, uniform size specified is insufficient
solution: Specify larger extent size and retry

message: Cannot mark this segment corrupt
cause: This segment cannot be marked corrupt because it contains data dictionary objects
solution: Check the segment information and reissue the command.

message: Cannot issue this command on SYSTEM tablespace
cause: It is not permitted to migrate SYSTEM tablespace from locally managed format to dictionary managed format or relocate bitmaps.
solution: Check the tablespace name and procedure name

message: initial extent size not enough for LOB segment
cause: Fatblock size of LOB segment is too big to fit into the initial extent.
solution: Specify a smaller fatblock size or create the LOB segment in other tablespaces with bigger initial extent size.

message: unable to execute the sql in read only database
cause: Unable to create a consistent snapshot of the object in a read only database. Transaction recovery must be performed before opening the database read only.
solution: Open the database read write, allow dead transaction recovery to complete and then open the database read only.

message: the tablespace string has only one file
cause: Dropping file from ts which has a single file extent.
solution: Cannot make a tablespace fileless

message: the file is non-empty
cause: Trying to drop a non-empty datafile
solution: Cannot drop a non empty datafile

message: cannot drop the first file of tablespace string
cause: Trying to drop the first datafile with which ts is created
solution: Cannot drop the first datafile with which ts is created

message: cannot drop offline datafile of locally managed tablespace
cause: Trying to drop offline datafile in lmts
solution: Try to drop file afetr making it online

message: both ALLOCATE EXTENT and DEALLOCATE UNUSED options are specified
cause: The DEALLOCATE option and the ALLOCATE option are specified in the same command.
solution: Choose one of the options or issue two separate commands.

message: duplicate DEALLOCATE option specification
cause: The DEALLOCATE UNUSED option to ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX is specified more than once.
solution: Specify the option at most once.

message: duplicate ALLOCATE EXTENT option specification
cause: The ALLOCATE EXTENT option to ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX is specified more than once.
solution: Specify the option at most once.

message: invalid SIZE specified
cause: The specified value must be an integer.
solution: Choose an appropriate integer value.

message: duplicate ALLOCATE EXTENT option specification
cause: An option (DATAFILE, SIZE or INSTANCE) was specified more than once.
solution: Specify each option at most once.

message: invalid INSTANCE specified
cause: The specified value is not recognized as a valid instance name.
solution: Use a valid name.

message: invalid DATAFILE filename specified
cause: A character string literal is expected, but not found.
solution: Specify filenames using character string literals.

message: invalid ALLOCATE EXTENT option
cause: An option other than DATAFILE, SIZE or INSTANCE was specified.
solution: Remove invalid option and retry the command.

message: missing ALLOCATE EXTENT option
cause: No ALLOCATE EXTENT options were specified.
solution: Specified one or more of the following options: DATAFILE, SIZE or INSTANCE.

message: specified datafile string does not exist
cause: The datafile does not exist
solution: Retry the option with the correct datafile

message: datafile or tempfile string is not a member of tablespace string
cause: The specified datafile or tempfile did not belong to the tablespace that the object resides in.
solution: Retry the option with the correct datafile or tempfile.

message: ALLOCATE EXTENT not valid for HASH CLUSTERS
cause: The cluster is a hash cluster, and can not use the allcoate extent option.
solution: None

message: invalid FREELIST GROUP specified
cause: The specified FREELIST GROUP number is invalid
solution: Choose a number between 1 and # freelist groups for this object

message: both FREELIST GROUP and INSTANCE parameters may not be specified
cause: Both FREELIST GROUP and INSTANCE were specified in clause
solution: Remove one of the two parameters

message: partition name and segment type do not match
cause: Partition name and segment type specified for space analysis do not match
solution: Specify type PARTITION if the object is partitioned, specify SUBPARTITION if the object is composite

message: Invalid truncate command - missing CLUSTER or TABLE keyword
cause: Invalid object specification given.
solution: Either specify TRUNCATE CLUSTER or TRUNCATE TABLE

message: Invalid truncate option - missing STORAGE keyword
cause: Expected STORAGE keyword
solution: Either specify DROP STORAGE or REUSE STORAGE

message: Table to be truncated is part of a cluster
cause: The table being truncated is a member of a cluster.
solution: Either use TRUNCATE CLUSTER or DROP TABLE

message: Cluster to be truncated is a HASH CLUSTER
cause: Only INDEX CLUSTERS can be truncated.
solution: Drop and recreate the HASH CLUSTER instead of using truncate.

message: cannot resize datafile - file string not found
cause: The specified datafile is not available for resizing.
solution: Ensure that the datafile name is valid, and if so, ensure the file is accessible.

message: file contains used data beyond requested RESIZE value
cause: Some portion of the file in the region to be trimmed is currently in use by a database object
solution: Drop or move segments containing extents in this region prior to resizing the file, or choose a resize value such that only free space is in the trimmed.

message: cannot shrink datafile - file string is under hot backup
cause: Attempt to shrink a datafile while it is under hot backup. This is not allowed.
solution: Retry shrinking the file after the hot backup completes.

message: cannot create dictionary table string
cause: A dictionary table is created upon the first execution of the command 'alter database datafile autoextend on' for a database. This operation did not succeed. The most probable cause for this is insufficient space in the system tablespace.
solution: See action for next error message in error stack.

message: the sum of PCTUSED and PCTFREE cannot exceed 100
cause: the sum of PCTUSED and PCTFREE for a cluster or table exceeds 100
solution: create the table/cluster specifying values whose sum is <= 100

message: sequence parameter string must be an integer
cause: %s (a sequence parameter) specified was not an integer
solution: create the sequence, giving the specified parameter an integer value

message: INCREMENT must be a non-zero integer
cause: a sequence increment was specified to be zero
solution: specify the increment to be a non-zero value

message: sequence parameter string exceeds maximum size allowed ( string digits)
cause: %s (a sequencer parameter) had too many digits
solution: specify the parameter with the allowed number of digits

message: MINVALUE must be less than MAXVALUE
cause: MINVALUE was specified to be greater than or equal to MAXVALUE
solution: specify a MINVALUE that is less than MAXVALUE

message: INCREMENT must be less than MAXVALUE minus MINVALUE
cause: the INCREMENT specified is >= MAXVALUE-MINVALUE
solution: specify an INCREMENT that is < MAXVALUE-MINVALUE

message: START WITH cannot be less than MINVALUE
cause: the given starting value is less than MINVALUE
solution: make sure that the starting value is >= MINVALUE

message: MINVALUE cannot be made to exceed the current value
cause: the given MINVALUE would be greater than the current value
solution: always make sure that MINVALUE is <= the current value

message: START WITH cannot be more than MAXVALUE
cause: the starting value would be larger than MAXVALUE
solution: make sure that the starting value is less than MAXVALUE

message: MAXVALUE cannot be made to be less than the current value
cause: the current value exceeds the given MAXVALUE
solution: make sure that the new MAXVALUE is larger than the current value

message: the number of values to CACHE must be greater than 1
cause: the value in the CACHE clause was one
solution: specify NOCACHE, or a value larger than one

message: sequence string must range between string and string
cause: the value specified for one of the sequence parameters exceeds limits
solution: specify parameter within these limits

message: object is not a sequence
cause: the object specified cannot have sequence ddl's performed on it
solution: re-enter the statement being careful with the spelling of the name

message: number to CACHE must be less than one cycle
cause: number to CACHE given is larger than values in a cycle
solution: enlarge the cycle, or cache fewer values

message: descending sequences that CYCLE must specify MINVALUE
cause: sequences that cycle must have their wrap-wrap specified
solution: re-create the sequence, specifying its wrap-value

message: ascending sequences that CYCLE must specify MAXVALUE
cause: sequences that cycle must have their wrap-wrap specified
solution: re-create the sequence, specifying its wrap-value

message: sequence string no longer exists
cause: sequence was dropped while processing its next value.
solution: re-create the sequence

message: invalid value string (length = string ) for parameter max_dump_file_size
cause: neither did the string supplied for max_dump_file_size parameter match the "UNLIMITED" string value nor did it represent a base 10 integer.
solution: reassign a proper value to this parameter.

message: deadlock detected while trying to lock object string string string string string
cause: While trying to lock a library object, a deadlock is detected.
solution: Retry the operation later.

message: timeout occurred while waiting to lock object string string string string string
cause: While waiting to lock a library object, a timeout occurred.
solution: Retry the operation later.

message: nowait requested, but had to wait to lock dictionary object
cause: Had to wait to lock a library object during a nowait request.
solution: Retry the operation later.

message: Object string string string string string could not be validated or authorized
cause: A number of attempts were made to validate or authorize an object but failed.
solution: Please report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: self-deadlock detected while trying to mutex pin cursor string
cause: While trying to mutex pin a cursor, a self-deadlock is detected.
solution: Retry the operation later.

message: maximum allowed library object lock allocated for string string string string string
cause: Too many active locks for the object has been allocated. This error can be a result of too many cursors kept open per session.
solution: Close cursors, reduce session_cached_cursors value.

message: self-deadlock during automatic validation for object string . string
cause: An attempt was made to validate an invalidated object but it failed because of a self-deadlock.
solution: , e.g. compile the invalidated object separately.

message: cannot generate diana for object string string string string string
cause: Cannot generate diana for an object because of lock conflict.
solution: Please report this error to your support representative.

message: error ORA- string occurred when querying string string string
cause: The table or view being queried might be missing. The error number indicates the error.
solution: Fix the error.

message: out of process memory when trying to allocate string bytes ( string , string )
cause: Operating system process private memory was exhausted.
solution: None

message: pga_aggregate_target must be set before switching to auto mode
cause: attempt to set workarea_size_policy to AUTO while pga_aggregate_target is not specified
solution: before setting workarea_size_policy, set pga_aggregate_target to a value representing the total private memory available to the instance. This total is generally the total physical memory available in the system minus what is needed for the SGA minus what is needed for the operating system (e.g. 500MB)

message: Insufficient memory to grow pool
cause: The system had insufficient memory to grow the pool to the specified size.
solution: Specify a smaller value to grow the pool.

message: unable to shrink pool to specified size
cause: The pool could not shrink to the specified size as it could not free memory.
solution: Specify a larger value to which to shrink the pool to.

message: unable to allocate string bytes of shared memory in shared object cache " string " of size " string "
cause: More shared memory is needed than was allocated in the shared object cache.
solution: None

message: package specification must be created first before creating package body
cause: Attempt to create a package body before creating its package specification.
solution: Create the package specification first before creating the package body.

message: procedure, function, package, or package body does not exist
cause: Attempt to access a procedure, function, package, or package body that does not exist.
solution: Make sure the name is correct.

message: object string does not exist
cause: An object name was specified that was not recognized by the system. There are several possible causes: - An invalid name for a table, view, sequence, procedure, function, package, or package body was entered. Since the system could not recognize the invalid name, it responded with the message that the named object does not exist. - An attempt was made to rename an index or a cluster, or some other object that cannot be renamed.
solution: Check the spelling of the named object and rerun the code. (Valid names of tables, views, functions, etc. can be listed by querying the data dictionary.)

message: procedure, function, package, or type is not allowed here
cause: A procedure, function, or package was specified in an inappropriate place in a statement.
solution: Make sure the name is correct or remove it.

message: errors during recompilation/revalidation of string . string
cause: This message indicates the object to which the following errors apply. The errors occurred during implicit recompilation/revalidation of the object.
solution: Check the following errors for more information, and make the necessary corrections to the object.

message: results of compilation are too large to support
cause: Attempt to compile and store a large stored procedure that results in compilation data that is too large for the system to support or store.
solution: Reduce the size of the store procedure by splitting it into smaller stored procedures.

message: object specified is incompatible with the flag specified
cause: The object type implied by the flag does not match the type of object specified.
solution: Specify the correct object, or use the appropriate flag

message: invalid or missing procedure, function, or package name
cause: The required procedure, function, or package name is invalid or missing.
solution: Specify a valid name.

message: user string cannot use database link string . string
cause: During forwarding of a remote object access, an attempt was made to use a non-existent database link or one owned by a user other than the logon user or PUBLIC.
solution: Change your database link structure so that all indirect remote accesses are done from the same userid that originates the request.

message: error occurred when looking up remote object string string string string string
cause: An error occurred when trying to look up a remote object.
solution: Fix the error. Make sure the remote database system has run CATRPC.SQL to create necessary views used for querying or looking up objects stored in the database.

message: error occurred when validating remote object string string string string string
cause: An error occurred when trying to validate a remote object.
solution: Fix the error. Make sure the remote database system has run CATRPC.SQL to create necessary views used for querying or looking up objects stored in the database.

message: database link string does not exist
cause: During compilation of a PL/SQL block, an attempt was made to use a non-existent database link.
solution: Either use a different database link or create the database link.

message: Aborted: " string " formed a non-REF mutually-dependent cycle with " string ".
cause: This compilation was aborted because the library unit that was compiled would have formed a non-REF mutually-dependent cycle with some other library units. This happens when an attempt is made to compile types that have attributes of other types that may participate in a cycle with this type. Example: create type t1; create type t2 (a t1); create type t1 (a t2);
solution: Break the cycle (possibly by adding a REF or by using another type).

message: insufficient privileges to execute string
cause: Attempt to execute a stored procedure without sufficient privileges.
solution: Get necessary privileges.

message: existing state of string has been invalidated
cause: Attempt to resume the execution of a stored procedure using the existing state which has become invalid or inconsistent with the stored procedure because the procedure has been altered or dropped.
solution: Try again; this error should have caused the existing state of all packages to be re-initialized.

message: string of string has been changed
cause: Attempt to execute a stored procedure to serve an RPC stub which specifies a timestamp or signature that is different from the current timestamp/signature of the procedure.
solution: Recompile the caller in order to pick up the new timestamp.

message: string has errors
cause: Attempt to execute a stored procedure or use a view that has errors. For stored procedures, the problem could be syntax errors or references to other, non-existent procedures. For views, the problem could be a reference in the view's defining query to a non-existent table. Can also be a table which has references to non-existent or inaccessible types.
solution: Fix the errors and/or create referenced objects as necessary.

message: not executed, invalidated string
cause: Attempt to execute a stored procedure that has been invalidated.
solution: Recompile it.

message: not executed, altered or dropped string
cause: Attempt to execute a stored procedure that has been altered or dropped thus making it not callable from the calling procedure.
solution: Recompile its dependents.

message: non-executable object, string
cause: Attempt to execute a non-procedure.
solution: Make sure that a correct name is given.

message: not executed, string does not exist
cause: Attempt to execute a non-existent stored procedure.
solution: Make sure that a correct name is given.

message: existing state of packages string string string has been discarded
cause: One of errors 4060 - 4067 when attempt to execute a stored procedure.
solution: Try again after proper re-initialization of any application's state.

message: cannot drop or replace a library with table dependents
cause: An attempt was made to drop or replace a library that has dependents. There could be a table which depends on type which depends on the library being dropped.
solution: Drop all table(s) depending on the type, then retry.

message: invalid trigger name
cause: An invalid trigger name was specified.
solution: Verify that trigger name is not a reserved keyword.

message: missing BEFORE, AFTER or INSTEAD OF keyword
cause: The trigger statement is missing the BEFORE/AFTER/INSTEAD OF clause.
solution: Specify either BEFORE, AFTER or INSTEAD OF.

message: invalid trigger type
cause: An invalid trigger type was given.
solution: Specify either INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE.

message: column list not valid for this trigger type
cause: A column list was specified for a non-update trigger type.
solution: Remove the column list.

message: invalid REFERENCING name
cause: An invalid name was given in the referencing clause.
solution: Verify the referencing name is not a reserved word.

message: invalid trigger action
cause: An statement was given for the trigger action.
solution: Re-specify the trigger action.

message: invalid NEW or OLD specification
cause: An invalid NEW or OLD specification was given for a column.
solution: Re-specify the column using the correct NEW or OLD specification.

message: WHEN clause cannot be used with table level triggers
cause: The when clause can only be specified for row level triggers.
solution: Remove the when clause or specify for each row.

message: OLD and NEW values cannot be identical
cause: The referencing clause specifies identical values for NEW and OLD.
solution: Re-specify either the OLD or NEW referencing value.

message: invalid trigger specification
cause: The create TRIGGER statement is invalid.
solution: Check the statement for correct syntax.

message: trigger ' string ' does not exist
cause: The TRIGGER name is invalid.
solution: Check the trigger name.

message: trigger ' string ' already exists
cause: The TRIGGER name or type already exists.
solution: Use a different trigger name or drop the trigger which is of the same name.

message: NEW or OLD references not allowed in table level triggers
cause: The trigger is accessing "new" or "old" values in a table trigger.
solution: Remove any new or old references.

message: invalid trigger variable ' string '
cause: The variable referenced in the trigger body is invalid.
solution: See the manual for valid trigger variable types.

message: cannot change NEW values for this trigger type
cause: New trigger variables can only be changed in before row insert or update triggers.
solution: Change the trigger type or remove the variable reference.

message: cannot change the value of an OLD reference variable
cause: Old values can only be read and not changed.
solution: Do not attempt to change an old variable.

message: trigger description too long, move comments into triggering code
cause: The trigger description is limited to 2000 characters (for dictionary storage reasons). The description does not include the text of the "when" clause or the text of the pl/sql code executed for the trigger.
solution: If the trigger description contains a large comment, move that

message: cannot change the value of ROWID reference variable
cause: Rowid's can only be read and not changed.
solution: Do not attempt to change an rowid value.

message: error during execution of trigger ' string . string '
cause: A runtime error occurred during execution of a trigger.
solution: Check the triggers which were involved in the operation.

message: cannot create triggers on objects owned by SYS
cause: An attempt was made to create a trigger on an object owned by SYS.
solution: Do not create triggers on objects owned by SYS.

message: ' string ' specifies same table, event and trigger time as ' string '
cause: Trigger is of duplicate event and trigger time.
solution: Combine the triggering information into one trigger which is fired at the given time.

message: table string . string is mutating, trigger/function may not see it
cause: A trigger (or a user defined plsql function that is referenced in this statement) attempted to look at (or modify) a table that was in the middle of being modified by the statement which fired it.
solution: Rewrite the trigger (or function) so it does not read that table.

message: cannot string in a trigger
cause: A trigger attempted to commit or rollback.
solution: Rewrite the trigger so it does not commit or rollback.

message: references to columns of type LONG are not allowed in triggers
cause: A trigger attempted to reference a long column in the triggering table.
solution: Do not reference the long column.

message: table string . string is constraining, trigger may not modify it
cause: A trigger attempted to modify a table that was constraining for some referential constraint of a parent SQL statement.
solution: None

message: trigger ' string ' already exists on another table, cannot replace it
cause: Cannot replace a trigger which already exists on a different table than the one being replaced.
solution: Drop the trigger with the same name and re-create it.

message: trigger ' string ' has a WHEN clause which is too large, limit 2K
cause: A trigger's 'when' clause is limited to 2K for dictionary storage reasons. The trigger being created exceeded that size.
solution: Use a smaller 'when' clause. Note, the trigger body could be used to perform the same limiting action as the 'when' clause.

message: DDL conflict while trying to drop or alter a trigger
cause: An attempt was made to concurrently perform two DDL operations on a trigger or trigger table.
solution: Investigate the new state of the trigger and retry the DDL operation, if still appropriate.

message: trigger ' string ' is valid but not stored in compiled form
cause: A trigger was attempted to be retrieved for execution and was found to be valid, but not stored. This may mean the an upgrade was done improperly from a non-stored trigger release.
solution: Alter compile the trigger to create the trigger in stored form. Also, you may want to review that a proper upgrade was done.

message: open sequence number failed or initial state is valid
cause: Either Shared Sequence Number OS component was not installed properly, or an MC hardware failure may have occurred or a previous instance was not shut down properly.
solution: Verify that there are no background or foreground Oracle processes from a previous instance on this node using the OS command ps -ef|grep <instance_name>. Verify that there are no shared memory segments belonging to the user which owns the Oracle installation by isuing the ipcs -b OS command. If there are shared memory segments or processes still on the system, use svrmgrl to shutdown the instance with the abort option. If the instance is not up, verify that the cluster software and/or the hardware is installed and working. Log in as superuser and issue the cnxshow command.
