solution: Insure that the ethernet driver has been installed by completing the TCP/IP installation on your system, and testing a connection. If problem continues, contact your customer support representative for a list of supported ethernet drivers.

message: TLI Driver: could not clear the IPX ethernet SAP at init
cause: The IPX driver has not been correctly installed.
solution: Reinvoke the Oracle root installation. If problem continues, contact your customer support representative.

message: TLI Driver: could not set the IPX ethernet SAP at init
cause: The IPX driver has not been correctly installed.
solution: Reinvoke the Oracle root installation. If problem continues, contact your customer support representative.

message: TLI Driver: could not set the IPX network number at init
cause: The IPX driver has not been correctly installed, or the network number encoded in the /etc/netware/yellowpages file is invalid.
solution: The network number in the yellowpages file should match the four-byte network number of your Novell file server. If this is configured correctly, reinvoke the Oracle root installation. If problem continues, contact your customer support representative.

message: TLI Driver: could not read the ethernet driver's node address
cause: The ethernet driver is not installed correctly, or does not support this operation.
solution: Contact your customer support representative for a list of supported ethernet drivers.

message: TLI Driver: the configured ethernet address is incorrect
cause: The node address read from the ethernet driver does not match the value encoded in the /etc/netware/yellowpages file for this server.
solution: Confirm the correct ethernet node address for your LAN card, and enter this value in the yellowpages file.

message: TLI Driver: the SPX device file could not be opened
cause: The /dev/nspxd file does not exist, or the driver has not been installed in the kernel correctly.
solution: Reinvoke the Oracle root installation. If problem continues, contact your customer support representative.

message: TLI Driver: could not link SPX and IPX streams
cause: The SPX driver has not been correctly installed.
solution: Reinvoke the Oracle root installation. If problem continues, contact your customer support representative.

message: TLI Driver: could not set the SPX SAP address
cause: The SPX driver has not been correctly installed.
solution: Reinvoke the Oracle root installation. If problem continues, contact your customer support representative.

message: TLI Driver: could not read the Novell network address
cause: The file $ORACLE_HOME/spx/address could not be opened for reading and writing.
solution: Make sure ORACLE_HOME is set, and the permissions on the ORACLE_HOME are read, write. If this file has been unintentially deleted, run spxctl (net option) to reset the configured Novell network number for SQL*Net SPX.

message: CMX: cannot read tns directory
cause: CMX is not started on your system.
solution: Install and/or start CMX on your system.

message: CMX: no local name assigned to local application
cause: Local application oracmx has no local name assigned
solution: Enter unique local name for oracmx in the tns directory

message: CMX: cannot attach to cmx subsystem
cause: ccp-xxxx is not started
solution: start your ccp software on the communication controller

message: CMX: cannot read transport address of remote application
cause: remote application not entered in tns directory
solution: enter remote application in tns directory

message: CMX: no transport address available for remote application
cause: no local name assigned to remote application
solution: assign local name to remote application

message: CMX: connect error
cause: remote partner not listening
solution: make sure remote node has CMX installed and running make sure oracmx is running on remote host

message: CMX: cannot get maximum packet size from CMX
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error during connect confirmation
cause: remote partner aborted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error during transfer of ORACLE_SID
cause: remote partner aborted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error during acknowledge of ORACLE_SID
cause: remote partner aborted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: Cannot start oracle process on remote machine
cause: oracle process not found or wrong mode (should be 4751)
solution: change /etc/oratab or set mode to 4751

message: CMX: t_event returns ERROR
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: write error in datarq
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error during redirection of connection
cause: oracmx has been stopped, or user process has been aborted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: unexepected event during start of oracle
cause: connect sequence out of sync
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: unknown t_event in datarq
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error in data read (t_datain)
cause: remote partner aborted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error in data read (too many bytes read)
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: T_NOEVENT during wait for read event
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error during write request (unknown event)
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: getbrkmsg illegal datatype
cause: received packets are corrupted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: getdatmsg illegal datatype
cause: received packets are corrupted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: bad write length
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: illegal break condition
cause: break handling out of sync
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: wrong break message length
cause: received packets are corrupted
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: disconnect during connect request
cause: partner is not responding
solution: make sure partner is up and running and reachable

message: CMX: T_ERROR during read data
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: T_DATAIN received before all data written
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: wrong ORACLE_SID
cause: ORACLE_SID is not entered in remote oratab
solution: add ORACLE_SID to remote oratab

message: CMX: error when sending ORACLE_SID
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error when checking ORACLE_SID
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error during read_properties for server
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error in local name
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: CMX: error during attach
cause: internal error in CMX
solution: contact your customer support representative

message: No error
cause: SQL*Net AppleTalk error codes base. This is not an error.
solution: None

message: Operating system call error
cause: AppleTalk API received error in VMS system service.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support representative.

message: Remote end of the communication issued a forward-reset packet.
cause: Peer program may have aborted
solution: Investigate network problems and try again.

message: Not enough virtual memory
cause: Not enough memory available.
solution: Check VMS process quotas and/or sysgen parameters

message: Illegal file name
cause: Erroneous file name
solution: Check path name for server output file, or SQL*Net Appletalk Logical names and symbols.

message: Number of database servers exceed limit
cause: Too many database connections.
solution: Check ATKSRV_MAXCONparameter in configuration file.

message: Failed to get local host name
cause: Unable to get Appletalk host name.
solution: Check Appletalk configuration.

message: No SID is currently available
cause: Incoming SQL*Net connection specified invalid SID name.
solution: Specify correct SID in connect string and retry.

message: Failed to access configuration file
cause: Unable to access CONFIG.ATK
solution: Check file protections.

message: Buffer I/O quota is too small
cause: Buffered I/O quota exceeded.
solution: Increase BIOlm using AUTHORIZE utility and retry.

message: Failed to access log file
cause: SQL*Net Appletalk listener could not create log file.
solution: Check directory path and protections.

message: X.25 Driver: remote host is unknown
cause: Host name specified in the login (connect string) is unknown.
solution: Check spelling; make sure name is in the X.25 HOST file.

message: X.25 Driver: invalid buffer size
cause: The buffer size specified in the login string must be between 5 and 4096.
solution: Re-submit with valid buffer size.

message: X.25 Driver: SID lookup failure
cause: From the remote host's SQL*Net X.25 server: the database SID, specified in the login (connect) string, was not recognized.
solution: Add the appropriate SID entry to the CONFIG.ORA file on the remote host (and restart the SQL*Net X.25 server).

message: X.25 Driver: connect to host failed
cause: Connection attempt to remote host has failed. Probably means that the SQL*Net X.25 server on the remote host is not up, or the host itself is not up.
solution: Start the SQL*Net X.25 server process on the remote host.

message: X.25 Driver: endpoint creation failure
cause: Process open file quota probably exceeded.
solution: Contact your customer support representative.

message: X.25 Driver: X.25 Level 2 failure
cause: X.25 level 2 is down. X.25 link is not working.
solution: Run system checks to verify functioning of X.25 software. Contact your hardware vendor.

message: X.25 Driver: Too many callback tries
cause: Call back address probably same as called address.
solution: Verify that callback address and called address are different.

message: X.25 Driver: server cannot start oracle
cause: The remote X.25 server was unable to start an ORACLE process on behalf of the client.
solution: Make sure permissions on the remote ORACLE program are correctly set. Contact your system administrator.

message: slsid: oracle_sid not set.
cause: The environment variable $(ORACLE_SID) is not set.
solution: Set ORACLE_SID environment variable.

message: slhom: oracle_home variable not set in environment.
cause: $(ORACLE_HOME) environment variable not set.
solution: Set ORACLE_HOME.

message: sltln: invalid parameter to sltln.
cause: The sltln name translation routine was called with invalid arguments. The input, or output stings were either NULL or 0 length.
solution: Probable internal oracle error. Contact customer support.

message: sltln: attempt to translate a long environment variable.
cause: A string was passed to sltln containing a long environment variable. sltln accepts environment names of 30 or less characters.
solution: Shorten environment variable name to less than 30 characters.

message: sltln: name translation failed due to lack of output buffer space.
cause: The sltln routine is given a maximum length buffer to expand the name into. An overflow of this buffer occurred.
solution: Possible internal error. Check output buffer length stored in sercose[0]. Pathnames are limited to 255 characters.

message: slgtd: time error, unable to obtain time.
cause: Time() system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Contact customer support.

message: slgtd: gettimeofday error, unable to obtain time.
cause: Gettimeofday() system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Contact customer support.

message: sigpidu: process ID string overflows internal buffer.
cause: The sigpidu routine is given a maximum length buffer to hold process ID string. An overflow of this buffer occurred.
solution: Internal error. Contact customer support.

message: sfwfb: failed to flush dirty buffers to disk.
cause: The fsync system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Contact customer support.

message: sfofi: file size limit was exceeded.
cause: The size of the file to be opened exceeded the OS limit imposed on this process.
solution: Run osh to increase the file size limit.

message: slcpu: getrusage error, unable to get cpu time.
cause: Getrusage system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Contact customer support.

message: slgcs: gettimeofday error, unable to get wall clock.
cause: Gettimeofday system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned in OS reference manual. Contact customer support.

message: slcpu: times error, unable to get cpu time.
cause: times system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Contact customer support.

message: slgcs: times error, unable to get wall clock.
cause: times system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned in OS reference manual. Contact customer support.

message: slgunm: uname error, unable to get system information.
cause: uname system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned in OS reference manual. Contact customer support.

message: slsget: getrusage error.
cause: Getrusage system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Look for information in OS reference. Contact customer support.

message: slghst: gethostname error, unable to get name of current host.
cause: gethostname system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned in OS reference manual. Contact customer support.

message: sltln: environment variable cannot be evaluated.
cause: getenv call returned a null pointer.
solution: Set the environment variable and try again.

message: slkhst: could not perform host operation
cause: Unix system() call failed
solution: Examine system error message

message: slspool: unable to allocate spooler argument buffer.
cause: Malloc failed to allocate space to hold spooler arguments.
solution: Check additional information returned in OS reference manual. The process may have run out of heap space. Contact customer support.

message: slspool: wait error.
cause: Wait returned an error, when waiting for spool job to complete. Possible spooler program error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Refer to OS reference manual. Contact customer support.

message: slspool: exec error, unable to start spooler program.
cause: Exec failed when starting line printer spooler command. Likely that either the default line printer command, or ORACLE_LPPROG, is incorrectly set.
solution: Verify default line printer command and ORACLE_LPPROG are set correctly. Set ORACLE_LPPROG to working line printer spooler.

message: slspool: line printer spooler command exited with an error.
cause: The line printer spooler exited with a non-zero return value. This probably indicates an error in spooling file.
solution: Verify that line printer spooler is up. Verify that ORACLE_LPPROG, and ORACLE_LPARG are set properly. Check exit value returned as additional informatin.

message: slspool: fork error, unable to spawn spool process.
cause: Fork system call failed to create additional process. Probable resource limit reached.
solution: Check additional information returned. Retry operation. Contact system administrator.

message: sfnfy: failed to obtain file size limit; errno = string .
cause: The ulimit system call returned an error.
solution: Check errno and contact customer support.

message: sldext: translation error, unable to expand file name.
cause: Additional information returned is error returned from sltln.
solution: Check additional information.

message: rtneco: unable to get terminal mode.
cause: The ioctl call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information for errno. Contact customer support.

message: rtneco: unable to set noecho mode.
cause: The ioctl call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information for errno. Contact customer support.

message: rtecho: unable to restore terminal to echo mode.
cause: The ioctl call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information for errno. Contact customer support.

message: slcpuc: error in getting number of CPUs.
cause: error in mpcntl system call
solution: check errno and contact system administrator

message: slemcr: fopen error, unable to open error file.
cause: Fopen failed to open file.
solution: Try to determine which file was not opened. Check that file exists and is accessible.

message: slemcc: invalid file handle, seals do not match.
cause: Function was called with an invalid argument. The file handle used was not obtained be slemcr.
solution: Internal error. Contact customer support.

message: slemcc: fclose error.
cause: An error was encountered when closing the file. Possible OS error.
solution: Contact system administator.

message: slemcw: invalid file handle, seals do not match.
cause: Function was called with an invalid file handle. File handle was not obtained by slemcr.
solution: Internal error. Contact customer support.

message: slemcw: fseek error.
cause: Unable to seek to desired position in file. Possible OS error. Possible internal error.
solution: Verify that error message file is intact. Try to regenerate error message file. Contact customer support.

message: slemcw: fwrite error.
cause: Unable to write item to file. Possible OS error. Possible permissions problem.
solution: Retry operation.

message: slemop: open error.
cause: Unable to open error file. Possible permissions problem.
solution: Verify permission on error message file. Check additional information for errno.

message: slemcl: invalid file handle, seals do not match.
cause: Function was called with an invalid file handle. Handle was not obtained by previous call to slemop.
solution: Internal error.

message: slemcl: close error.
cause: Unable to close file. Possible OS error.
solution: Contact system administator. Check additional information for errno.

message: slemrd: invalid file handle, seals do not match.
cause: Function was called with invalid file handle. Handle was not obtained by call to slemop.
solution: Internal error. Contact customer support.

message: slemrd: seek error.
cause: Unable to seek to desired position in file. Possible OS error.
solution: Check that error file is still intact. Verify space on device. Contact system administrator. Check additional information for errno.

message: slemrd: read error.
cause: Unable to read file. Possible OS error.
solution: Verify that error file is intact. Regenerate error message file. Contact customer support. Check additional information for errno.

message: slembfn: translation error, unable to translate error file name.
cause: Additional information indicates error returned from sltln.
solution: Check additional information.

message: supplied buffer not big enough to hold entire line
cause: supplied buffer was not big enough
solution: Internal error. Contact customer support. Additional information indicates how big the supplied buffer was.

message: ssfccf: create file failed, file size limit reached.
cause: An attempt was made to create a file that exceeds the process's file size limit.
solution: Run osh to raise the file size limit.

message: sfccf: unable to lseek and write the last block.
cause: An attempt was made to move and write to a bad device address.
solution: Check errno. Possible lack of space on device.

message: sfofi: open error, unable to open database file.
cause: sfofi returns an error.
solution: This is an oracle internal error.

message: skgfrfms, skgfrnms: read error, unable to read block from database file
cause: The ioctl() system call returned an error doing VOL_READ_MIRRORS.
solution: Check errno.

message: sfwfb: write error, unable to write database block.
cause: sfwfb returns an error.
solution: This is an oracle internal error.

message: slsget: open error, unable to open /proc/pid.
cause: The open() system call returned an error.
solution: Check that /proc has the right permissions.

message: spcre: semget error, unable to get first semaphore set.
cause: An error occurred when trying to get first semaphore set.
solution: Check errno. Verify that system is configured to have semaphores. Verify that enough semaphores are available. Additional information indicates how many semaphores were requested.

message: spcre: semget error, could not allocate any semaphores.
cause: Semget failed to even allocate a single semaphore. Either they are all in use or the system is not configured to have any semaphores.
solution: Check to see if all semaphores are in use. Check to see if system is configured to have semaphores. Check errno.

message: spcre: semget error, could not allocate semaphores.
cause: Semget system call returned an error. Possible resource limit problem.
solution: Check errno. Verify that enough semaphores are available in system. If additional errors occur in destroying the semaphore sets then sercose[0] will be non-zero. If this occurs, remove the semaphore sets using ipcrm.

message: spdes: semctl error, unable to destroy semaphore set.
cause: Semctl system call returned an error.
solution: Check semaphore sets. May require manual cleanup. Check additional information returned. Consult OS reference manual.

message: spdcr: translation error while expanding ?/bin/oracle.
cause: An error occurred while translating the name of the oracle executable.
solution: Check sercose[0] for error returned from sltln. Perhaps $(ORACLE_HOME) is not set correctly.

message: spini: cannot set up signal handler.
cause: System failed to set up signal handler.
solution: Check errno and sercose[0] for the signal number that failed.

message: sptrap: cannot set up signal handler to catch exceptions.
cause: System failed to set up signal handler to catch exceptions.
solution: Check errno and sercose[0] for the signal number that failed.

message: spdcr: translation error expanding program name.
cause: Error ocurred when expanding program name ora_PNAME_@. The result of this translation is put in argv[0] of oracle process.
solution: Check error returned by sltln returned in sercose[0].

message: spdcr: fork error, unable to create process.
cause: An error occurred when creating a new process.
solution: Check errno. Perhaps a system limit on the number of processes has been exceeded.

message: spdcr: exec error, detached process failed in startup.
cause: An oracle detached process died shortly after startup. Wait() indicated that a child process terminated.
solution: Check ?/dbs directory for trace or core files. Check errno.

message: spdcr: wait error.
cause: Wait system call returned an error.
solution: Check errno.

message: spdde: kill error, unable to send signal to process.
cause: Kill system call returned an error. Possibly an attempt to destroy an already gone process.
solution: Check errno.

message: sptpa: sptpa called with invalid process id.
cause: This is an internal error.
solution: This is an oracle internal error.

message: sptpa: kill error.
cause: Kill system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check errno. Additional information indicates the process ID tested.

message: spwat: semop error, unable to decrement semaphore.
cause: Semop system call returned an error. Semaphore set may not exist.
solution: Check errno. Semaphore ID is returned in sercose[0]. Verify semaphore set exists. A possible cause for this error is that a "shutdown abort" was done while this process was running.

message: sppst: semop error, unable to increment semaphore.
cause: Semop system call returned an error. Semaphore set may not exist.
solution: Check errno. Semaphore ID is returned in sercose[0]. Check semaphore set existence. A possible cause for this error is that a "shutdown abort" was done while this process was running.

message: sppst: invalid process number passed to sppst.
cause: Function was passed an invalid oracle process id.
solution: Internal error.

message: spwat: invalid process number.
cause: Function was passed an invalid oracle process id.
solution: Internal error. Additional information indicates the invalid process id.

message: szguns: getpwuid error.
cause: Getpwuid() could not find an entry in the passwd file for a user.
solution: Add an entry for the user in the passwd file.

message: spdcr: detached process died after exec.
cause: Detached process succesfully execed, but died shortly thereafter. Additional information indicates exit code, and termination status.
solution: Check termination code for information as to why process exited. Check for core dump or trace file.

message: spalck: setitimer error, unable to set interval timer.
cause: An error occurred while trying to set an interval timer. Probable porting problem.
solution: Check errno.

message: spwat: invalid oracle process number.
cause: Function was called with an invalid oracle process number (0).
solution: Internal oracle error.

message: spwat: invalid semaphore set id.
cause: Semaphore ID fetched from SGA was not initialized to valid value. Additional information returned is semaphore set index, and oracle process number.
solution: Oracle internal error. Check semaphore set index. Check oracle process number.

message: sppst: invalid semaphore id.
cause: Semaphore ID fetched from SGA contained an invalid value. Additional information returned is semaphore set index, and oracle process number.
solution: Oracle internal error. Check semaphore set index. Check oracle process number.

message: spdcr: access error, access to oracle denied.
cause: Unable to access "oracle" program. Verify ?/bin/oracle or $ORABCKPRG exist, and are executable.
solution: Check errno returned.

message: unable to send signal to process
cause: The kill system call returned an error. Possibly an attempt to signal a process which does not exist.
solution: Check errno.

message: no dba group in /etc/group.
cause: A group has not been set up for dba users.
solution: Contact system administrator. Set up dba group in /etc/group.

message: spdde: illegal pid passed as argument.
cause: A 0 pid was passed to spdde.
solution: Internal error. .

message: splon: ops$username exceeds buffer length.
cause: Splon constructed an ops$username logon which exceeded the alloted buffer space.
solution: Use a shorter Unix username, or use an oracle username. Contact customer support.

message: spcre: semget error, unable to get first semaphore set.
cause: An error occurred when trying to get first semaphore set.
solution: Check errno. Verify that system is configured to have semaphores. Verify that enough semaphores are available. Additional information indicates how many semaphores were requested.

message: slsget: unable to get process information.
cause: The ioctl call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information for errno. Contact customer support.

message: slsget: times error, unable to get cpu time.
cause: times system call returned an error. Possible OS error.
solution: Check additional information returned. Contact customer support.

message: sksaprd: string overflow.
cause: The internal buffer is not big enough to hold the archive control string.
solution: Internal restriction. Try a shorter archive control string.

message: sksaprd: invalid volume size for archive destination.
cause: An invalid volume size was specified.
solution: Specify a valid volume size in archive control string.

message: sksaprd: volume size specification not terminated properly.
cause: Some non-numeric text follows the volume size specification.
solution: Enter a correct archive control string.

message: sksaprd: volume size should not be specified for a disk file.
cause: Volume size was specified for a disk file.
solution: If you are archiving to a disk file, do not specify its volume size.

message: sksagdi: cannot obtain device information.
cause: Stat on the log archiving device failed.
solution: Check the returned OSD error for the reason of failure.

message: sksagdi: unsupported device for log archiving.
cause: Log archiving to this device is unsupported.
solution: Try log archiving to a supported device.

message: sksagdi: specified directory for archiving does not exist.
cause: The specified pathname is not a directory.
solution: Verify that the archive destination directory exists.

message: ksmcsg: illegal database buffer size.
cause: The database buffer size must be a multiple of the database block size, and less than the maximum block size.
solution: Verify that the db_block_size parameter is correct in INIT.ORA.

message: ksmcsg: illegal redo buffer size.
cause: The redo buffer size must be a multiple of machine block size.
solution: Verify that the log_buffer INIT.ORA parameter is correctly set.

message: ksmcsg: illegal database buffer size.
cause: The database buffer size must be a multiple of the extended cache mapping size for indirect data buffers to be used.
solution: Verify that the db_block_size parameter is correct in INIT.ORA, or disable the use_indirect_data_buffers parameter.

message: smpall: malloc error while allocating pga.
cause: Malloc library routine returned an error.
solution: Check errno. Possibly out of swap space.

message: smpdal: attempt to destroy pga when it was not mapped.
cause: Smpdal was called when the PGA had not been previously created.
solution: Internal error.

message: spcre: maximum number of semaphore sets exceeded.
cause: The internal buffer is not big enough to hold the number of semaphore set identifiers requested.
solution: Reconfigure OS to have more semaphores per set.

message: The datafile name must not contain the string '..'.
cause: The specified datafile name contains '..'.
solution: Correct the datafile name and retry the operation.

message: slnrm: normalized file name is too long
cause: After normalizing the specified file name, the resulting file name was too long.
solution: Specify the shorter file name and retry the operation.

message: sftopn: translate error, unable to translate file name.
cause: An error occurred while expanding the file name to open. Additional information returns error generated in translation routine.
solution: Lookup additional error code for further information.

message: sftopn: fopen error, unable to open text file.
cause: Fopen library routine returned an error.
solution: Verify existence and permissions.

message: sftcls: fclose error, unable to close text file.
cause: Fclose library routine returned an error.
solution: Possible internal oracle error.

message: unable to delete text file
cause: An error occurred while deleting a text file.
solution: Verify that the file exists and check additional errors.

message: unable to append string to text file
cause: An error occurred while performing a string put operation.
solution: This is an internal error. Check additional information.

message: slemtr: translated name for the message file is too long.
cause: The name for the message file overflows internal buffer.
solution: Try making the complete path-name of the message file shorter by reorganizing the directory hierarchy.

message: sptrap: cannot restore user exception handlers.
cause: The system failed to restore user exception handlers.
solution: Check errno and sercose[0] for the signal number that failed.

message: sprst: cannot restore user signal handler.
cause: The system failed to restore user signal handlers.
solution: Check errno and sercose[0] for the signal number that failed.

message: sfanfy: db_writers parameter not valid.
cause: The db_writers parameter in INIT.ORA exceeds the system-dependent maximum or is less than 0.
solution: Change the db_writers parameter in INIT.ORA.

message: sfareq: Timeout occurred waiting for request to complete.
cause: The master database writer timed out waiting for a write or close to complete. One of the database writers may have stopped running.
solution: Check all database writer trace files. Shut down the database and try to warm start.

message: sptrap: cannot setup alternate signal stack.
cause: The system failed to setup an alternate signal stack.

solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system error. Also check the "additional information" field for the SQL*Net error. If there is no error, contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to get information label from connection
cause: ORACLE was unable to retrieve the user's information label from the SQL*Net connection.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system error. Also check the "additional information" field for the SQL*Net error. If there is no error, contact ORACLE support.

message: Can't spawn process - background log directory not created properly
cause: ORACLE was unable to spawn a background process because the directory that will hold trace files of the background processes was not created properly.
solution: Examine the directory pointed to by the initialization parameter "background_dump_dest". Make sure that all of the following is true: 1. The directory exists. 2. The name indeed points to a directory, and is not a file. 3. The directory is accessible and writable to the ORACLE user.

message: Can't spawn process - user log directory not created properly
cause: ORACLE was unable to spawn a background process because the directory that holds the trace files of the dedicated server processes was not created properly.
solution: Examine the directory pointed to by the initialization parameter "user_dump_dest". Make sure that all of the following is true: 1. The directory exists. 2. The name indeed points to a directory, and is not a file. 3. The directory is accessible and writable to the ORACLE user.

message: Can't spawn process - core dump directory not created properly
cause: ORACLE was unable to spawn a background process because the directory that holds the core dumps produced by ORACLE processes in the event of exceptions was not created properly.
solution: Examine the directory pointed to by the initialization parameter "core_dump_dest". Make sure that all of the following is true: 1. The directory exists. 2. The name indeed points to a directory, and is not a file. 3. The directory is accessible and writable to the ORACLE user.

message: Unable to create audit trail file
cause: ORACLE was not able to create the file being used to hold audit trail records.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system error. If there is no error, contact ORACLE customer support.

message: Unable to set effective privilege set of the server
cause: A dedicated server was unable to set it's own privilege set.
solution: Check the privileges granted to the ORACLE executable. It must have at least "allowmacacess" privilege.

message: Unable to set label of server
cause: ORACLE was not able to set the label of a server to a new value.
solution: Check the privileges on $ORACLE_HOME/bin/oracle. Make sure that it has "allowmacaccess" privilege.

message: Unable to restore the label of server
cause: ORACLE was unable to restore the label of the server to the value that it had before raising it to database high.
solution: This is an internal error - contact ORACLE support.

message: GLB of two labels is invalid
cause: The result of a greatest lower bound operation on two labels was not valid.
solution: Repeat the operation with two different labels. Consult the system encoding file for the values of valid labels.

message: LUB of two labels is invalid
cause: The result of a least upper bound operation on two labels was not valid.
solution: Repeat the operation with two different labels. Consult the system encoding file for the values of valid labels.

message: Unable to open ORACLE password file for reading
cause: An attempt to open a password file for reading failed.
solution: Make sure that the permissions on the file have not been changed so that the ORACLE user cannot open it.

message: Close of ORACLE password file failed.
cause: An attempt to close a password file failed.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for the specific reason.

message: Deletion of old password file failed.
cause: The removal of the old password file failed.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for the specific reason.

message: Link of current password file to old failed.
cause: ORACLE was unable to create a link so that the old password file could be saved.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for the specific reason.

message: Unlink of current password file failed.
cause: ORACLE was unable to complete the saving of the current password file.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for the specific reason.

message: Open of ORACLE password file for write failed.
cause: ORACLE was unable to create a password file.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for the specific reason.

message: Chmod of ORACLE password file failed.
cause: ORACLE was unable to change a password file to be readonly.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for the specific reason.

message: Save of signal handlers failed.
cause: ORACLE was unable to save the previous values of selected signal handlers.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact ORACLE support.

message: Restoration of signal handlers failed.
cause: ORACLE was unable to restore the previous values of selected signal handlers.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact ORACLE support.

message: ORACLE password file header is corrupt
cause: The header of one of the password files was not in the format that ORACLE expected.
solution: Check the headers of both files. The header should be in the format "FILE VERSION: N.N.N.N.N EXECUTABLE VERSION: N.N.N.N.N" where N is a number. Remove the corrupt file(s) and re-run "orapasswd".

message: Version of orapasswd or installer is older than file.
cause: The version of orapasswd or installer that is being run is older than that of the ORACLE password file. Since the file version is only changed when the format is changed, this error means that the executable is using a different format than that with which the file was created.
solution: Run a version of the installer or orapasswd whose version is the same or later than that of the file.

message: Write of ORACLE password file header failed.
cause: The attempt to write out the header of the ORACLE password file failed.
solution: Check the operating system error number. It is possible that the file system became full.

message: Allocation of memory for password list component failed.
cause: When it is building a list of password file entries, ORACLE allocates memory for various components. One of the allocations failed.
solution: Check the operating system error number. The system has probably run out of memory.

message: Password entry is corrupt.
cause: An entry in an ORACLE password file was not in the format that ORACLE expected.
solution: Removed the corrupt file(s) and re-run "orapasswd."

message: Unable to initialize the audit trail file
cause: ORACLE unable to write header information to the file being used as the audit trail.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system error. If there is no error, contact ORACLE customer support.

message: File name too long for buffer
cause: The buffer that was to be used to hold a file name was determined to be too short for the generated name. This will happen if the translated name for either a trace file or an audit file is longer than the maximum allowed, which on many ports is 256 characters.
solution: Use a shorter file name.

message: Unable to allocate connection attributes structure
cause: ORACLE was not able to allocate the memory needed to hold the attributes of the SQL*Net connection. The "Additional Information" field holds the number of bytes that ORACLE attempted to allocate.
solution: Check the UNIX error number. It is probable that the system has run out of memory. If there is no error, contact ORACLE customer support.

message: Process information label retrieval failed.
cause: ORACLE was unable to get the information label for a process.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system failure. If there is no error, contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to get client operating system privileges
cause: ORACLE was unable to get the operating system privileges for the client process.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system failure. If there is no error, contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to get server operating system privileges
cause: ORACLE was unable to get its privileges from the operating system.
solution: This is an error that should never happen. Contact ORACLE customer support.

message: Unable to create file
cause: ORACLE was unable to create a file.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system failure. If there is no error, contact ORACLE support.

message: scgcmn: lk_open_convert unexpected return: open failed
cause: The distributed lock manager returned an unexpected value
solution: Check for system error message and refer to the distributed lock manager documentation or contact your customer support representative.

message: scggc: unexpected return of a lock convert
cause: The distributed lock manager returned an unexpected value
solution: Check for lock manager error message and refer to DLM documentation refer to the distributed lock manager documentation or contact your customer support representative.

message: scgcc: unexpected return status to callback of lock close
cause: The distributed lock manager returned an unexpected value
solution: Check for lock manager error message and refer to DLM documentation refer to the distributed lock manager documentation or contact your customer support representative.

message: scgcan: unexpected return status when canceling a lock
cause: DLM system service x returned an unexpected value
solution: Check for system error message and refer to DLM documentation refer to the distributed lock manager documentation or contact your customer support representative.

message: scgcm: unexpected lock status condition
cause: A global locking system service returned an unexpected value.
solution: Check for system error message (if any) and refer to refer to the distributed lock manager documentation or contact your customer support representative.

message: Unable to send termination request to IMON
cause: The attempt to send a termination signal to IMON failed.
solution: This is an internal error, contact ORACLE support.

message: IMON: two processes with the same ORACLE pid are active
cause: The IMON process was unable to add an entry for a server process because another active process occupies the slot.
solution: This is an internal error, contact ORACLE support.

message: IMON: deletion of a process failed.
cause: The IMON process was unable to delete a server process from its process ID array because no entry for the process could be found.
solution: This is an internal error, contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to establish signal handler for termination signal
cause: ORACLE was unable to set up a handler for the signal used to notify it that the instance was shutting down.
solution: This is an internal error, contact ORACLE support.

message: Unable to restore termination signal handler
cause: ORACLE failed to set the handler for the termination signal to its previous value.
solution: This is an internal error, contact ORACLE support.

message: falure in translation while expanding ?/dbs/lk for lock file
cause: Oracle failed to translate ?/dbs/lk, when creating a file name for the database mount lock or the instance startup/shutdown lock.
solution: Check additional return errors for more information.

message: unable to create or open lock file
cause: Oracle failed, when making an open system call, inorder to acquire a file lock used by the database mount lock or the instance startup/shutdown lock.
solution: Check errno for more information.

message: unable to lock file
cause: The system call for locking a file returned an error when trying to acquire a database mount lock or the instance startup/shutdown lock.
solution: Check errno for more information.

message: unable to close or remove lock file
cause: The close system call or unlink system call returned an error.
solution: Check errno for more information.

message: skxfidini: Error Initializing SDI Channel
cause: The process was unable to initialize the SDI channel properly.
solution: Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: kxfspini: Error Initializing SDI Process
cause: The process was unable to attach to the SDI channel.
solution: Verify that the SDI process specific limits correctly configured. Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfqdini: Error Creating Port
cause: The process was unable to create a communications endpoint.
solution: Verify that the SDI port specific limits correctly configured. Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfqhini: Error Connecting
cause: The process was unable to connect to another endpoint.
solution: Verify that the SDI port specific limits correctly configured. Check that the other node(s) is part of the cluster and operating properly. Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfqhdel: Error Disconnecting from another endpoint.
cause: The process was unable to disconnect cleanly from another endpoint.
solution: Check that the other node(s) are part of the cluster and operating properly. Check the instance and processes on the other node(s). Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfqhsnd: Error Sending a message to another endpoint
cause: The process was unable to send a message to an existing endpoint.
solution: Check that the other node(s) are part of the cluster and operating properly. Check the instance and processes on the other node(s). Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfqdrcv: Error Receiving a message from another endpoint
cause: The process encountered an error while trying to receive a message.
solution: Check that the other node(s) are part of the cluster and operating properly. Check the instance and processes on the other node(s). Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfqdreg: Error Adding a page to the SDI buffer pool
cause: The process was unable to add a page to the SDI buffer pool.
solution: Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfqddrg: Error Removing a page from the SDI buffer pool
cause: The process was unable to remove a page to the SDI buffer pool.
solution: Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: skxfidsht: Error shutting down SDI channel
cause: The process was unable shut down the SDI channel
solution: Check the SDI persistent resources using SDI tools. Verify that all processes exited cleanly and the instance is safely shut down. Delete any remaining SDI channel IDs associated with the current instance.

message: SGA file $ORACLE_HOME/dbs/sgadef$ORACLE_SID.dbf does not exist
cause: file does not exist or is not accessible
solution: Restart the instance to create the SGA definition file.

message: SGA definition file could not be read
cause: UNIX read() operation failed
solution: check errno and take appropriate action.

message: wrong number of bytes read from SGA definition file
cause: Struct skgmsdef size differs from no. of bytes read from SGA file
solution: Compare the two struct definitions and ensure that they are identical in size and structure.

message: unable to attach to SGA in READ-ONLY mode
cause: The instance is not up, or SGA segments are not read-accessible
solution: Verify that the instance is up and read permissions for the SGA segments are set.

message: error while detaching SGA
cause: skgmsdef struct is corrupted and/or segment addresses are modified
solution: Safely shut down instance and mount SGA segments again.

message: attempt to use invalid skgmsdef struct pointer
cause: Pointer to skgmsdef struct used without validating it
solution: Assign a valid address to the skgmsdef struct pointer before using it.

message: simulated error for test string of K2GTAB latch cleanup
cause: levels 1..6 for insert, 7..11 for delete
solution: None

message: make tranids in error msgs print as 0.0.0 (for testing)
cause: also makes "alter system enable distributed recovery" synchronous
solution: None

message: get error message text from remote using explicit call
cause: for npigem coverage testing (normally called only for V5 remote)
solution: None

message: limit size ( string ) of the PGA heap set by event 10261 exceeded
cause: The PGA memory use exceeded the limit set by the event 10261.
solution: Check event 10261 settings.

message: Limit the size of the PGA heap
cause: the limit is one kilobyte times the level of the event. If the pga grows bigger than this signal an internal error.
solution: None

message: Don't check for memory leaks
cause: Setting this event to level one causes memory leak checking to be disabled. Setting this event to any other non-zero number allows that number to be used as a threshold value when checking for memory leaks in the PGA, SGA, and UGA heaps.
solution: None

message: Don't free empty PGA heap extents
cause: This is useful for debugging since watchpoints are lost on free
solution: None

message: Keep random system generated output out of error messages
cause: so test system files don't diff
solution: None

message: Trace OSD stack usage
cause: Porters should implement this to help them debug their stack implementations. It should be used in at least smcstk().
solution: None

message: Inhibit KSEDMP for testing
cause: Some tests may generate internal or fatal errors on purpose.
solution: LEVEL used by KSEDMP is one less than level of this event.

message: Don't do forward coalesce when deleting extents
cause: setting this event keeps kts from coalescing forward at each extent when dropping a temp segment.
solution: None

message: Don't do coalesces of free space in SMON
cause: setting this event prevents SMON from doing free space coalesces
solution: None

message: Debug shared cursors
cause: Enables debugging code in shared cursor management modules
solution: None

message: maximum time to wait for process creation
cause: used to override the default SPMXWAIT, level = timeout in sec.
solution: None

message: Inhibit signalling of other backgrounds when one dies
cause: Used in KSB
solution: None

message: simulate zero/infinite asynch I/O buffering
cause: Used in KCF, level=1 out of space (red), level=2 infinite (green)
solution: None

message: Cannot do block media recovery; media recovery session may be in progress
cause: A media recovery, RMAN, or flashback database session may have been in progress when an attempt was made to perform block media recovery on the standby database.
solution: Check for and cancel any conflicting recovery session and perform block media recovery on the standby database.

message: cannot open standby database; media recovery session may be in progress
cause: A media recovery, RMAN, or flashback database session may have been in progress on a mounted instance of a standby database when an attempt was made to open the standby database.
solution: Check for and cancel any conflicting recovery session and open the standby database.

message: cannot close standby database due to active media recovery
cause: A media recovery session was in progress on a standby database when an attempt was made to close the standby database.
solution: Cancel the media recovery session and close the standby database.

message: standby database requires recovery
cause: A standby database was in a state requiring media recovery when an attempt was made to open the standby database.
solution: Perform the necessary recovery and open the standby database.

message: cannot start media recovery on standby database; conflicting state detected
cause: An attempt was made to perform media recovery on a standby database while another instance was performing recovery on the standby database, had the standby database open, or a data file move operation was in progress.
solution: Close the standby on all other instances, cancel any conflicting recovery session or data file move operation, and perform manual recovery.

message: error creating control file backup, no checkpoint
cause: The control file being backed up did not contain a valid control file checkpoint. Therefore the control file could not be backed up, as such a backup would not be usable later for recovery. A common cause for this situation is that you executed CREATE CONTROLFILE, which mounts the database, but not ALTER DATABASE OPEN, to open the database. The latter operation generates a valid control file checkpoint.
solution: Open the database with ALTER DATABASE OPEN ..., which results in a valid control file checkpoint. Run the backup operation again.

message: Backup data block for data file has an unlogged change
cause: Flashback was enabled for the data file when the backup data block used for block media recovery had an unlogged change.
solution: Remove the data file from the flashback set or use a backup block that does not contain an unlogged change to perform block media recovery.

message: Automatic block repair cannot repair an offline or read-only data file
cause: Automatic block repair failed when trying to repair an offline or read-only data file.
solution: Bring the data file online in read/write mode.

message: Real-Time Query cannot be enabled while applying migration redo.
cause: The Real-Time Query feature was enabled when an attempt was made to recover through migration redo generated during primary upgrades or downgrades.
solution: Close the standby database in order to recover through migration redo. Reenable the Real-Time Query feature afterwards.

message: Cannot perform block media recovery; standby database does not have requisite redo.
cause: An attempt was made to perform block media recovery on the standby database when the necessary redo was not available.
solution: Wait until the necessary redo is available and reattempt block media recovery.

message: Cannot perform block media recovery; standby database is not caught up with primary.
cause: An attempt was made to perform block media recovery on the standby database up to scn %s, which is greater than the highest scn of %s yet applied at the standby.
solution: Recover the standby up to scn %s and reattempt block media recovery.

message: Cannot perform block media recovery on a read-only plugged-in datafile.
cause: An attempt was made to perform block media recovery on a read-only plugged-in datafile.
solution: Convert the plugged-in datafile to read/write and reattempt block media recovery.

message: Cannot perform block media recovery using a read-only plugged-in backup datafile.
cause: An attempt was made to perform block media recovery using a backup of a read-only plugged-in datafile.
solution: Reattempt block media recovery using a backup taken after the plugged-in datafile has been converted to read/write.

message: Incompatible UNTIL CONSISTENT clause
cause: RECOVER UNTIL CONSISTENT required database-level recovery with a backup control file.
solution: Omit the UNTIL CONSISTENT clause and retry recovery.

message: Media recovery failed to bring datafile string to a consistent point
cause: Media recovery couldn't recover database to a consistent point due to the specified datafile.
solution: Restore a backup of the datafile.

message: block type ' string '
cause: Report block type for details of another error.
solution: See associated error message.

message: block type ' string ', data object# string
cause: Report block type and data object number for details of another error.
solution: See associated error message.

message: Error occurred while applying redo to data block (file# string , block# string )
cause: See other errors on error stack.
solution: Investigate why the error occurred and how important is the data block. Media and standby database recovery usually can continue if user allows recovery to corrupt this data block.

message: Test recovery had to corrupt data block (file# string , block# string ) in order to proceed
cause: Test recovery completed.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has ended successfully. See other messages on error stack for a summary of the result of the test recovery.

message: tablespace string
cause: Report tablespace name for details of another error.
solution: See associated error message.

message: Another test recovery session is active
cause: There can only be one test recovery session at any time. Another test recovery session is active.
solution: Wait till the other test recovery session completes.

message: Test recovery has used all the memory it can use
cause: Test recovery tests redo in memory. It can no longer proceed because it has consumed all the memory it can use.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has ended successfully. See other messages on error stack for a summary result of the test recovery.

message: Redo is inconsistent with data block (file# string , block# string , file offset is string bytes)
cause: There are two possible causes of this error: (1) A write issued by Oracle was lost by the underlying OS or storage system. (2) an Oracle internal error.
solution: Investigate why the error occurred and how important is the data block. Media and standby database recovery usually can continue if user allows recovery to corrupt this data block.

message: Failed to allocate recovery state object: out of SGA memory
cause: out of SGA memory
solution: Restart the instance. If problem persists, call Oracle support.

message: Test recovery complete
cause: Test recovery completed.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has ended successfully. See other messages on error stack for a summary result of the test recovery.

message: Test recovery canceled
cause: User canceled test recovery.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has ended successfully. See other messages on error stack for a summary of the result of the test recovery.

message: Test recovery canceled due to errors
cause: See other errors on the error stack.
solution: is needed. See other messages on error stack for a summary of the result of the test recovery so far.

message: Test recovery tested redo from change string to string
cause: This message show the range of test recovery have tested.
solution: No action is needed. See other messages on error stack.

message: Test recovery did not corrupt any data block
cause: This message summarizes test recovery result.
solution: No action is needed. See other messages on error stack.

message: Give up restoring recovered datafiles to consistent state: out of memory
cause: There were not enough memory to restore recovered datafiles to consistent state
solution: This error is just a warning: You may not be able to open the database with resetlogs immediately after this error. However, you may continue media/standby recovery, and that may make the datafiles recovered consistent again.

message: Give up restoring recovered datafiles to consistent state: some error occurred
cause: See alert file or other errors on the stack for a cause of the problem.
solution: This error is just a warning: You may not be able to open the database with resetlogs immediately after this error. However, you may continue media/standby recovery, and that may make the datafiles recovered consistent again.

message: Can not invoke test recovery for managed standby database recovery
cause: Test recovery option is used for managed standby database recovery.
solution: Either remove the test recovery option or invoke manual test standby database recovery.

message: Can not allow corruption for managed standby database recovery
cause: You used the allow corruption option for managed standby database recovery.
solution: Either remove the allow corruption option or invoke manual standby database recovery.

message: Can not modify control file during test recovery
cause: To proceed with recovery, test recovery needs to modify the control file. But test recovery is not allowed to modify control file.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has ended successfully. It can only go so far in the redo stream.

message: Can not modify datafile header during test recovery
cause: To proceed with recovery, test recovery needs to modify a datafile header. But test recovery is not allowed to modify datafile headers.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has ended successfully. It can only go so far in the redo stream.

message: Can not modify redo log header during test recovery
cause: To proceed with recovery, test recovery needs to modify a redo log header. But test recovery is not allowed to modify redo log headers.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has ended successfully. It can only go so far in the redo stream.

message: The control file is not a backup control file
cause: User requested backup control file test recovery, but the control file is not a backup control file.
solution: Use a backup control file, or do not use USING BACKUP CONTROLFILE option.

message: Can not recovery file string renamed as missing during test recovery
cause: One of the files to be recovered is renamed as missing.
solution: Rename the file to the correct file or offline it.

message: Can not invoke parallel recovery for test recovery
cause: Both test recovery and parallel recovery are requested.
solution: Drop either one of the two recovery options.

message: Test recovery can not apply redo that may modify control file
cause: Test recovery has encountered a special redo that may modify control file.
solution: No action is needed. Test recovery has proceeded successfully as far as it could from its starting point.

message: Test recovery had to corrupt 1 data block in order to proceed
cause: This message summarizes test recovery result: Oracle may have to corrupt one block in order to apply the range of redo tested.
solution: See alert log for details of the problem.

message: Invalid count for ALLOW n CORRUPTION option
cause: The number specified in the ALLOW n CORRUPTION option is too big.
solution: Use a smaller number.

message: Test recovery had to corrupt string data blocks in order to proceed
cause: This message summarizes test recovery result: Oracle may have to corrupt a number of data blocks as specified in the message in order to apply the range of redo tested.
solution: See alert log for details of the problems.

message: Operation not allowed on this segment
cause: This procedure can be used only on segments in tablespaces with AUTO SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT
solution: Recheck the segment name and type and re-issue the statement

message: Invalid tablespace type for temporary tablespace
cause: Tablespace with AUTO SEGMENT SPACE MANAGENEMT specified cannot be used as a temporary tablespace
solution: Recheck the tablespace name and re-issue the statement

message: Operation not allowed on this tablespace
cause: Cannot perform the operation on tablespace with AUTO SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT
solution: Recheck the tablespace name and re-issue the statement

message: Cannot create rollback segment in dictionary managed tablespace
cause: Rollback segments cannot be created in dictionary managed tablespaces when SYSTEM tablespace is locally managed
solution: Recheck the tablespace name and re-issue the statement

message: Operation not allowed on this segment
cause: This DBMS_SPACE operation is not permitted on segments in tablespaces with AUTO SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT
solution: Recheck the segment name and type and re-issue the statement

message: Avoid assertions when possible
cause: A bug (or upgrade) hits unicode assertions (csid, csform, bfc)
solution: Event makes RDBMS skip assertions and patch up datastructures

message: Operation not allowed on this segment
cause: Cannot alter freelist storage parameter for segments in tablespaces with AUTO SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT
solution: Recheck the segment name and re-issue the statement

message: Dump the content of the index leaf block
cause: Generate a complete index tree dump, not just an overview during alter session set events immediate trace name treedump
solution: This event is recommended only for small table/index since it

message: Turn on sanity check for kdiss index skip scan state
cause: Will do sanity checking on the kdiss state.
solution: set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development

message: Illegal syntax specified with SHRINK clause
cause: An illegal option was specified with the SHRINK clause
solution: Verify the SQL Reference Manual and reissue the command

message: SHRINK clause should not be specified for this object
cause: It is incorrect to issue shrink on the object
solution: Verify the object name and type and reissue the command

message: Invalid rowid
cause: Segment Highwatermark was overwritten due to shrink and space reused
solution: Reissue this command.

message: No space found in the segment
cause: Raised while trying to find space during segment shrink
solution: This error should be trapped internally and treated. The user should not be able to see the error.

message: Segment is already being shrunk
cause: Only one invocation of shrink can be in progress on a segment at any time
solution: Reissue the command after the first shrink is over

message: Invalid segment or tablespace type
cause: Cannot shrink the segment because it is not in auto segment space managed tablespace or it is not a data, index or lob segment.
solution: Check the tablespace and segment type and reissue the statement

message: ROW MOVEMENT is not enabled
cause: To shrink a data segment, row movement must be enabled.
solution: Enable row movement and reissue this command.

message: The segment does not exist
cause: Segment to be shrunk has been dropped
solution: None

message: Index status is invalid
cause: Cannot shrink an index which is being rebuilt or disabled is an unusable state.
solution: None

message: Dump library cache during reparse loops
cause: During this error a library cache dump is necessary , so enable librarycache dump if event is set.
solution: Dump a library cache if this event is set when reparse error.

message: Operation not permitted during SYSTEM tablespace migration
cause: SYSTEM tablespace is being migrated to locally managed format.
solution: Reissue this command once SYSTEM tablespace migration is over.

message: Cannot find a rollback segment to bind to
cause: SYSTEM tablespace migration requires rollback segment in locally managed tablespace.
solution: Drop rollback segments in dictionary managed tablespaces other than SYSTEM and create rollback segments in locally managed tablespace and retry migration.

message: Found rollback segments in dictionary managed tablespaces
cause: When SYSTEM tablespace is migrated found rollback segments in dictionary managed tablespaces.
solution: Drop the rollback segments in dictionary managed tablespaces and reissue the command

message: Database should be mounted in restricted mode and Exclusive mode
cause: When SYSTEM tablespace is being migrated database should be mounted in Exclusive mode and in Restricted mode.
solution: Reissue this command after mounting the database in right mode.

message: SYSTEM tablespace cannot be default temporary tablespace
cause: When SYSTEM tablespace is being migrated no user should have SYSTEM as the default temporary tablespace.
solution: Reissue this command after altering the default temporary tablespace setting for all users.

message: Recursive Extension in SYSTEM tablespace during migration
cause: When SYSTEM tablespace is being migrated, dictionary tables tried to extend recursively. Must be caught and processed internally. Should not be thrown to the user.
solution: Report the error as a bug.

message: Too many recursive extensions during SYSTEM tablespace migration
cause: When SYSTEM tablespace is being migrated, dictionary tables tried to extend recursively more than 1000 times.
solution: If SYSTEM tablespace is very large, then simply reissue the tablespace migration command.

message: Tablespace other than SYSTEM, string , string not found in read only mode
cause: When SYSTEM tablespace is being migrated, tablespaces other than the three should be ALTERed to read only.
solution: Alter the tablespace status to read only and retry migration.

message: Tablespace SYSAUX is not offline
cause: The SYSAUX tablespace was online while SYSTEM tablespace was being migrated.
solution: Alter the SYSAUX tablespace status to offline and retry migration.

message: Turn off/trace lob index freelist coalesce

solution: None

message: Inject Evil Literals

It is common for an identifier to be parsed once with a max of 30 bytes, then reparsed later with a max of 4000, so it may not be possible to inject such an identifier without the aid of this event. cause: An attempt was made to open a database after an instance failure or SHUTDOWN ABORT interrupted an online backup.

solution: Check the following error message for the cause, and consult your error manual for the appropriate action.

solution: this should only be enabled for internal testing

message: invalid TABLESPACE GROUP clause
cause: An invalid option appears for TABLESPACE GROUP clause.
solution: Specify a valid tablespace group name.

message: TABLESPACE GROUP cannot be specified for this type of tablespace
cause: In CREATE/ALTER TABLESPACE, the TABLESPACE GROUP clause was used while creating/altering a tablespace that is not TEMPORARY.

message: TABLESPACE GROUP already specified

message: TABLESPACE GROUP cannot be specified

message: TABLESPACE GROUP name cannot be the same as tablespace name

solution: Please specify an appropriate tablespace group name.

message: Default temporary tablespace group must have at least one tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to move the only tablespace in the default database temporary tablespace group to another tablespace group.
solution: Either change the database default temporary tablespace or add another tablespace to the group that this tablespace belongs to.

message: Cannot offline tablespace belonging to default temporary tablespace group
cause: An attempt was made to offline a tablespace in the default database temporary tablespace group.
solution: Either change the database default temporary tablespace or change the tablespace group of this tablespace.

message: Cannot drop tablespace belonging to default temporary tablespace group
cause: An attempt was made to drop a tablespace in the default database temporary tablespace group.
solution: Either change the database default temporary tablespace or change the tablespace group of this tablespace.

message: Temporary tablespace group is empty
cause: An attempt was made to allocate a temporary segment in a group, which now no longer has any members.
solution: Either add some temporary tablespaces or change the temporary tablespace for this user.

message: backout event for bug 2133357
cause: 2133357 dynamically sets the varying width flag and character width. Lob data which is not migrated during migration from single byte to multibyte charater set will be displayed as special characters.
solution: To help migrate lob data which was not migrated during migration by backing out 2133357, so lob data can be selected and moved to multibyte character set.

message: backout evet for 2619509
cause: 2619509 catches offsets when not reading/writing on full character boundary. To facilitate backward compatiblity event is being introduced.
solution: To help upgrade/migrate issues which already have corrupt data

message: trace flags for join index implementation
cause: This is an informational message.
solution: Values are as follows: LEVEL ACTION --------------------------------------------------------------------------- > 1 Dump refresh expressions (SQL) to trace file. > 999 If a complete refresh is invoked, it will not be performed but the system will assume that a complete refresh was done, causing the view to be VALID and updating timestamps. This should be used only under Oracle Support supervision.

message: another startup/shutdown operation of this instance inprogress
cause: An Oracle Instance startup or shutdown operation failed to procure the serialization primitive. Another foreground process may have attempted startup or shutdown operation in parallel.
solution: Check additional error messages in the alert log and the process trace file.

message: cannot create log: table ' string ' already has a trigger
cause: Materialized view logs are filled by a trigger on the master table. That trigger cannot be created.
solution: To create a materialized view log, drop the current trigger on the master.

message: there is no materialized view log on table " string "." string "
cause: There was no materialized view log on the master table.
solution: Create a materialized view log on the master table.

message: materialized view " string "." string " does not exist
cause: The materialized view with the given owner and name does not exist.
solution: Verify inputs and create a materialized view.

message: REFRESH FAST cannot be used for materialized view " string "." string "
cause: The materialized view log does not exist or cannot be used. PCT refresh is also not enabled on the materialized view
solution: Use just REFRESH, which will reinstantiate the entire table. If a materialized view log exists and the form of the materialized view allows the use of a materialized view log or PCT refresh is possible after a given set of changes, REFRESH FAST will be available starting the next time the materialized view is refreshed.

message: may not schedule automatic refresh for times in the past
cause: An attempt was made to schedule an automated materialized view refresh for a time in the past.
solution: Choose a time in the future instead.

message: materialized view reuse parameters are inconsistent
cause: The CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW .. or CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG .. REUSE command was given inconsistent parameters immediately after the REUSE.
solution: Examine the other messages on the stack to find the problem.

message: error in materialized view refresh path
cause: Table SNAP$_<mview_name> reads rows from the view MVIEW$_<mview_name>, which is a view on the master table (the master may be at a remote site). Any error in this path will cause this error at refresh time. For fast refreshes, the table <master_owner>.MLOG$_<master> is also referenced.
solution: Examine the other messages on the stack to find the problem. See if the objects SNAP$_<mview_name>, MVIEW$_<mview_name>, <mowner>.<master>@<dblink>, <mowner>.MLOG$_<master>@<dblink> still exist.

message: cannot create materialized view log on table owned by SYS
cause: An attempt was made to create a materialized view log on the table owned by SYS. CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG attempts to create a trigger on the table, but triggers can not be created on SYS tables.
solution: Do not create a materialized view log on SYS tables.

message: execution of string jobs failed
cause: An error was caught in dbms_ijob.run from one or more jobs which were due to be run.
solution: Look at the alert log for details on which jobs failed and why.

message: error on auto execute of job string
cause: An error was caught while doing an automatic execution of a job.
solution: Look at the accompanying errors for details on why the execute failed.

message: updatable materialized views must be simple enough to do fast refresh
cause: The updatable materialized view query contained a join, subquery, union, connect by, order by, or group by caluse.
solution: Make the materialized view simpler. If a join is really needed, make multiple simple materialized views then put a view on top of them.

message: table ' string ' does not contain a primary key constraint
cause: The CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG command was issued with the WITH PRIMARY KEY option and the master table did not contain a primary key constraint or the constraint was disabled.
solution: Reissue the command using only the WITH ROWID option, create a primary key constraint on the master table, or enable an existing primary key constraint.

message: cannot create a fast refresh materialized view from a complex query
cause: Neither ROWIDs and nor primary key constraints are supported for complex queries.
solution: Reissue the command with the REFRESH FORCE or REFRESH COMPLETE option or create a simple materialized view.

message: materialized view does not include all primary key columns
cause: The query that instantiates the materialized view did not include all of the columns in the master's primary key constraint.
solution: Include all of the master's primary key columns in the materialized view query or create a ROWID materialized view.

message: cannot alter primary key mview ' string ' to a rowid mview
cause: An attempt was made to convert the primary key of a materialized view to a ROWID materialized view.
solution: Conversion of a primary key materialized view to a ROWID materialized view is not supported. Create a new materialized view with ROWIDs or drop and recreate the materialized view with ROWIDs.

message: following error encountered during code generation for " string "." string "
cause: The refresh operations for the indicated materialized view could not be regenerated due to errors.
solution: Correct the problem indicated in the following error messages and repeat the operation.

message: master table is a synonym to a remote object
cause: An attempt was made to create a materialized view or a materialized view log on a remote synonym which is unsupported.
solution: Do not create a materialized view or materialized view log on a remote synonym.

message: materialized view string is not registered
cause: An attempt was made to unregister a materialized view that is not registered.
solution: No action required.

message: materialized view " string "." string " is corrupt
cause: The materialized view indicated is no longer valid.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: materialized view log on " string "." string " already has rowid
cause: Materialized view log on the indicated table already has ROWID information.
solution: No action required.

message: missing index on materialized view " string "." string "
cause: The specified ROWID materialized view did not have the required index on the ROWID column of its underlying table.
solution: Drop and recreate the materialized view.
