message: cannot reproject
cause: Reprojection from source to destination projection produced a large distortion.
solution: Check the destination projection and make sure it is suitable for the area covered by the source GeoRaster object. Check the GeoRaster documentation for more information about reprojection.

message: the Source Type is not supported
cause: The specified source type was not supported.
solution: Check the documentation for the source types (such as FILE and HTTP) supported by GeoRaster.

message: the destination type is not supported
cause: The specified destination type was not supported.
solution: Check the documentation for the destination types (such as FILE) supported by GeoRaster.

message: GeoRaster object is not initialized for the image
cause: No GeoRaster object has been initialized for the specified image.
solution: Initialize a GeoRaster object to hold this image before loading it into the database. Check the documentation for details.

message: insufficient memory for the specified GeoRaster data
cause: There was insufficient memory to hold the specified GeoRaster data for this operation.
solution: Use SDO_GEOR.subset to isolate a subset of the GeoRaster data, or reblock the GeoRaster data into smaller sized blocks. Check the documentation for details.

message: the file format or compression type is not supported: string
cause: The file format or compression type was not supported.
solution: Check the documentation for formats that are currently supported by GeoRaster.

message: error occurred during compression or decompression: string
cause: The operation could not be completed because an error occurred during compression or decompression. Check the error message for details.
solution: Check that the GeoRaster object is valid, that its metadata is valid for the specified compression format, and that valid parameters are passed into the compression or decompression operation.

message: invalid or insufficient GeoTIFF metadata to georeference the GeoRaster object: string
cause: The GeoTIFF metadata of the specified input image contained invalid or insufficient information to georeference the GeoRaster object.
solution: Check the error message for details.

message: SRID not found for source coordinate system metadata
cause: No SRID was found in the Oracle Spatial CS_SRS table to match the source coordinate system metadata.
solution: Add a user-defined coordinate reference system for this coordinate system, as explained in the Oracle Spatial documentation.

message: string
cause: This is an internal GeoRaster error.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services. You may want to make sure the GeoRaster object is valid before you do so.

message: string
cause: An error related to an external plugin was encountered in the GeoRaster component.
solution: Check the documentation for the external plugin, or contact the plugin provider and supply the exact error text.

message: string
cause: This is an internal Spatial error.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: SYSAUX DATAFILE clause specified more than once
cause: The CREATE DATABASE command contains more than one SYSAUX DATAFILE clause.
solution: Specify at most one SYSAUX DATAFILE clause.

message: Cannot drop SYSAUX tablespace
cause: Tried to drop SYSAUX tablespace
solution: None

message: Cannot rename SYSAUX tablespace
cause: An attempt to rename the SYSAUX tablespace failed.
solution: No action required.

message: Creating SYSAUX tablespace with invalid attributes
cause: An attempt to create the SYSAUX tablespace with invalid attributes.
solution: Create SYSAUX tablespace with ONLINE, PERMANENT, EXTENT MANAGEMENT LOCAL, SEGMENT SPACE MANAGEMENT AUTO attributes.

message: No SYSAUX datafile clause specified
cause: If Create Database has the datafile clause, then SYSAUX datafile clause has to be specified, unless using OMF.
solution: Specify the SYSAUX datafile clause.

message: SYSAUX tablespace can not be made read only
cause: Attempting to set the SYSAUX tablespace to read only. The SYSAUX tablespace must remain read write for database operation.
solution: Leave SYSAUX tablespace read write.

message: operation failed due to invalid snapshot range ( string , string )
cause: An attempt was made to perform operation with an invalid Start/End Snapshot Pair.
solution: Choose a valid Start/End Snapshot Pair.

message: error encountered during updates to a AWR table
cause: An update error occurred during OCI operation due to an underlying error.
solution: Check associated OCI error. Correct problem and retry the operation.

message: invalid RETENTION string , must be in the range ( string , string )
cause: The user has specified a RETENTION setting that is not in the supported range of (MIN, MAX).
solution: Choose a valid RETENTION setting and retry the operation.

message: invalid INTERVAL string , must be in the range ( string , string )
cause: The user has specified a INTERVAL setting that is not in the supported range of (MIN, MAX).
solution: Choose a valid INTERVAL setting and retry the operation.

message: Metric Capture too close to last capture, group string
cause: The metric capture cannot be executed because it is too close to the last capture (within 1 centi-second).
solution: add some delay and reissue command to retry.

message: Error encountered during Database Usage Statistics capture
cause: Error occurred during OCI operation due to underlying error.
solution: Check associated OCI error. Correct problem and retry the operation.

message: AWR Operation failed: string
cause: The operation failed because AWR is not available. The possible causes are: AWR schema not yet created; AWR not enabled; AWR schema not initialized; or database not open or is running in READONLY or STANDBY mode.
solution: check the above conditions and retry the operation.

message: Baseline (id = string ) does not exist
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline ID does not exist in the Workload Repository.
solution: check the baseline id and retry the operation.

message: Invalid database id ( string )
cause: The operation failed because the specified database ID does not exist in the Workload Repository.
solution: check the database id and retry the operation.

message: Database id ( string ) exists in the workload repository
cause: The operation failed because the specified database ID already exists in the Workload Repository.
solution: check the database id and retry the operation.

message: Database id ( string ) not registered, Status = string
cause: The operation failed because the specified database ID was not registered in the Workload Repository properly.
solution: check the status of database id and retry the operation.

message: Unregister operation on local Database id ( string ) not allowed
cause: The operation failed because the local database ID cannot be unregistered from the Workload Repository.
solution: check the database id and retry the operation.

message: unable to allocate required space for return type
cause: Out of memory to allocate the space for the return variable for an external procedure.
solution: Try operation again.

message: error encountered while retrieving baseline information
cause: A read error occurred during the OCI operation to retrieve the baseline information
solution: Check associated error. Correct problem and retry the operation.

message: error with computing space usage for sysaux occupant
cause: Error occurred during OCI operation due to underlying error.
solution: Check associated OCI error. Correct problem and retry the operation.

message: baseline ( string ) does not exist
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline name does not exist in the Workload Repository.
solution: check the baseline name and retry the operation.

message: invalid baseline name
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline name is invalid.
solution: check the baseline name and retry the operation.

message: name ( string ) is already used by an existing baseline
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline name already exists in the Workload Repository.
solution: check the baseline name and retry the operation.

message: Error occurred when flushing AWR table group
cause: An error occurred during the flushing of a table group. Because of the error in the group, we are unable to flush this table.
solution: Check the error associated with the table group.

message: invalid TOPNSQL string , must be in the range ( string , string )
cause: The user has specified a TOPNSQL setting that is not in the supported range of (MIN, MAX).
solution: Choose a valid TOPNSQL setting and retry the operation.

message: SQL Text was purged from AWR before the operation completed
cause: A SQL was purged from AWR before the operation completed.
solution: Retry the operation.

message: SQL ID [ string ] already exists
cause: The operation failed because the specified SQL ID already existed in the repository.
solution: Check the SQL ID and retry the operation.

message: invalid SQL ID
cause: The operation failed because the specified SQL ID was invalid.
solution: Check the SQL ID and retry the operation.

message: Current SQL count( string ) reached maximum allowed ( string )
cause: The operation failed because the maximum allowed colored SQL was exceeded.
solution: Check the count for colored SQL.

message: name ( string ) is already used by an existing baseline template
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline template name already existed in the Workload Repository.
solution: Check the baseline template name and retry the operation.

message: baseline template ( string ) does not exist
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline template name did not exist in the Workload Repository.
solution: Check the baseline template name and retry the operation.

message: invalid input for create baseline template ( string , string )
cause: Invalid input was specified for the create baseline template routine.
solution: Check the argument displayed in the error message text.

message: invalid value for baseline expiration ( string )
cause: An invalid value was specified for the expiration of a baseline. The expiration is specified in number of days, and the expiration must be at least one day.
solution: Check the value for expiration.

message: invalid input for modify baseline window size ( string , string )
cause: Invalid input was specified for the modify baseline window size routine.
solution: Check the argument displayed in the error message text.

message: operation not allowed on system moving window baseline ( string )
cause: The requested operation was not allowed on the system moving window baseline.
solution: Retry the operation with another baseline name.

message: system moving window baseline size ( string ) greater than retention ( string )
cause: The system moving window baseline size must be less than the retention setting. The specified window size or retention violate this.
solution: Check the moving window baseline size or retention.

message: baseline ID ( string ) does not exist
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline ID did not exist in the Workload Repository.
solution: Check the baseline ID and retry the operation.

message: error encountered while retrieving baseline template information
cause: A read error occurred during the OCI operation to retrieve the baseline template information.
solution: Check associated error. Correct problem and retry the operation.

message: error encountered while automatically generating a baseline
cause: An error occurred while automatically generating a baseline based on the template information.
solution: Look in the trace file for more error information.

message: invalid baseline template name
cause: The operation failed because the specified baseline template name was an invalid identifier.
solution: Check the baseline template name and retry the operation.

message: Error encountered during maintenance of Adaptive Thresholds
cause: Error occurred during OCI operation due to underlying error.
solution: Check associated OCI error. Correct problem and retry the operation.

message: Unable to drop baseline since it is in use by string
cause: The system is not able to drop the baseline since the baseline is in use by a functionality that depends on its existence.
solution: Note the name of the functionality using the baseline, and check if the functionality still needs the baseline.

message: Unable to find valid snapshot IDs for the inputted baseline time range
cause: The system is not able to find valid snapshot IDs for the inputted time range while attempting to create a baseline.
solution: Check that the inputted time range has at least two valid snapshots. The dba_hist_snapshot displays the snapshot id and time information.

message: invalid input for create baseline with time range ( string )
cause: Invalid time input was specified for the create baseline routine.
solution: Check the argument displayed in the error message text.

message: error encountered in Advisor string
cause: An error occurred in the Advisor. This message will be followed by a second message giving more details about the nature of the error.
solution: See the Advisor documentation for an explanation of the second error message.

message: The specified Advisor string does not exist.
cause: The user specified an advisor name that has not be defined in the advisor repository.
solution: Correct the advisor name and retry the operation.

message: The specified parameter string is not valid for task or object string .
cause: The user attempted to access a task parameter that does not exist for the specified advisor object. The parameter may be misspelled or the user has selected a parameter that is not supported by the particular advisor.
solution: Validate the parameter name and retry the operation.

message: The specified parameter string cannot be fetched as a numeric value for task or object string .
cause: The user attempted to retrieve a string parameter as a numeric value.
solution: Check the datatype for the task parameter and retry the operation.

message: The specified parameter string cannot be fetched as a SQL table.
cause: The user attempted to retrieve a non-table parameter as a table name.
solution: Check the datatype for the task parameter and retry the operation.

message: The specified task or object string does not exist for the current user.
cause: The user attempted to reference an advisor task or object using a name that does not exist in the Advisor repository.
solution: Adjust the name and retry the operation.

message: the specified task parameter element string is out of range for parameter string .
cause: The user attempted to reference an invalid parameter element.
solution: Adjust the element offset and retry the operation.

message: The specified task or object string already exists
cause: The user attempted to create the specified task or object using a name that already exists in the Advisor repository. Task names must be unique to the database user.
solution: Adjust the name and retry the operation.

message: The specified name string is invalid.
cause: An attempt was made to specify a name for a task, object, execution or directive instance, which contained invalid characters or an invalid wildcard specifier.
solution: Adjust the name and retry the operation.

message: The specified task string must be executing to be cancelled or interrupted.
cause: The user attempted to cancel or interrupt a task that is not currently executing.
solution: Check the status of the task and retry the operation.

message: The directive string does not exist for task string .
cause: The user attempted to access a task directive that does not exist.
solution: Validate the directive and retry the operation.

message: The command string is not a valid advisor command.
cause: The user attempted to specify a command that does not exist.
solution: Validate the command and retry the operation.

message: The recommendation action string , string is not valid for task string .
cause: The user attempted to access a recommendation action that does not exist in the task.
solution: Validate the recommendation-action and retry the operation.

message: The requested operation is not supported for this advisor object.
cause: The user attempted to perform an operation that is not supported for the particular advisor or task type.
solution: Validate the task or object and retry the operation.

message: The template string is not compatible with the current advisor.
cause: The user attempted to create a new task or object using an existing task or object that was not created by the same advisor.
solution: Validate the template and retry the operation.

message: The task or object string is greater than the maximum allowable length of 30 characters.
cause: The user attempted to create a new task or object using a name that is too long.
solution: Shorten the name and retry the operation.

message: The current user string has not been granted the ADVISOR privilege.
cause: The user attempted an advisor operation that requires privilege.
solution: Adjust the user's privileges and retry the operation.

message: The specified task string already executing
cause: The user attempted to execute a task that is currently executing.
solution: Wait for the task to finish before attempting any further task activities.

message: The specified value is not a valid value for procedure argument string .
cause: The user executed a procedure but failed to provide correct values for the argument.
solution: Correct the procedure arguments and retry the operation.

message: The procedure argument string is greater than the maximum allowable length of string characters.
cause: The user attempted to pass a character argument that is too long.
solution: Shorten the specified character argument and retry the operation.

message: The task or object string is read-only and cannot be deleted or modified.
cause: The user attempted to perform an operation that will update or delete a read-only task or object.
solution: Adjust the READ_ONLY property for the object and retry the operation.

message: The task_or object string is marked as a template and cannot perform the requested operation.
cause: The user attempted perform an unsupported operation on a task or object that is identified as a template.
solution: Choose a different object and retry the operation.

message: invalid recommendation annotation
cause: The user attempted to mark a recommendation using an invalid annotation. Valid annotation actions are ACCEPT, REJECT and IGNORE.
solution: Correct the action and retry the operation.

message: The recommendation string is not valid for task string .
cause: The user attempted to access a recommendation that does not exist in the task.
solution: Validate the recommendation and retry the operation.

message: The task string is executing and cannot be deleted or modified.
cause: The user attempted to access a task that currently executing.
solution: Wait for the task to complete and retry the operation.

message: string is an invalid advisor object type.
cause: The user has specified an invlaid object type.
solution: Refre to dba_advisor_object_types for all valid object types

message: The specified object string is not valid for task string .
cause: The user specified an non-existent object for the task
solution: Choose a different object and retry the operation.

message: Setting of parameter string is disallowed until the task is reset.
cause: The user attempted to set the value of a parameter before the task was reset. This parameter cannot be changed until the task is reset.
solution: Reset the task and retry the operation.

message: Insufficient privileges to access the task belonging to the specified user
cause: The user could not access dba_* views.
solution: Retry operation as owner of the task or after granting new privileges.

message: The task or object string is being used by another operation.
cause: The user attempted to access a task or object that is locked by another session.
solution: Wait for the task or object activity to complete and retry the operation.

message: The task string contains execution results and cannot be executed.
cause: The user attempted to execute a task that already contains execution results.
solution: Reset the task to its initial state and retry the operation.

message: The most recent execution of task string contains no results.
cause: The user attempted to create a report or script from a task that has not successfully completed an execution.
solution: Execute the task and then retry the operation

message: The user cancelled the current operation.
cause: The user signaled a cancel during a task or object operation.
solution: None

message: The task string was interrupted and needs to be resumed.
cause: The user attempted to execute a task that was interrupted.
solution: Resume the execution of the task via the RESUME_TASK API.

message: The task string needs to be reset before being re-executed.
cause: The task must be in an inital state to be executed.
solution: Reset the task to its initial state and retry the operation.

message: The value provided for parameter string cannot be converted to a number.
cause: A numeric parameter was incorrectly supplied in string form.
solution: Retry by supplying valid numeric value.

message: The specified value provided for parameter string is not valid for this advisor.
cause: The user supplied an invalid parameter value.
solution: Retry by supplying valid value.

message: Executing or modifying task string is disallowed until the task is reset to its initial state.
cause: The user attempted to execute or modify the task that is in not in its INITIAL state.
solution: Reset the task and retry the operation.

message: The user interrupted the current operation.
cause: The user signaled an interrupt during a task or object operation.
solution: None

message: The current operation was interrupted because it timed out.
cause: The task or object operation timed out.
solution: None

message: The current operation was cancelled because it timed out, and was not in interruptible mode.
cause: The task or object operation timed out.
solution: None

message: Task cannot be interrupted yet. You may cancel it instead.
cause: The user attempted to interrupt a task that has not reached interruptible mode.
solution: Wait until the task reaches interruptible mode, or cancel the task execution.

message: The specified string string provided for string cannot be converted to a date. The acceptable date format is string .
cause: The user supplied a date value in an incorrect format.
solution: Retry by supplying valid value.

message: The task can not be interrupted or cancelled.
cause: Request to interrupt or cancel task execution can not be granted because the task has not reached the appropriate mode.
solution: User should wait for a few seconds and try again.

message: The user " string " is invalid.
cause: Invalid user name specified to advisor framework
solution: User should specify a correct, case-sensitive, name

message: The specified execution string does not exist for this task.
cause: You attempted to reference an advisor task execution using a name that did not exist.
solution: Adjust the name and retry the operation.

message: The specified execution string already exists
cause: You attempted to perform a new execution using a name that already exists for the specified task. Execution names must be unique within the same task.
solution: Adjust the name and retry the operation.

message: Setting of parameter string is disallowed during task execution.
cause: You attempted to set the value of a parameter while the task was being executed. This parameter cannot be changed until the task finishes its execution.
solution: Verify the status of the task and retry the operation.

message: The specified execution type does not exist for this advisor.
cause: You attempted to use an advisor task execution type using a name that did not exist.
solution: Adjust the name and retry the operation.

message: The type of execution is not specified for this advisor or task.
cause: You attempted to execute a task for a multi-execution task advisor without specifying the type of execution to perform.
solution: Set the execution type and retry the operation.

message: The specified object does not exist for this execution.
cause: You attempted to associate an object to a task execution that id not contain the object.
solution: Adjust the execution name and object ID, and then retry the operation.

message: The specified list of execution parameters is invalid.
cause: The list did not include pairs of (parameter_name, parameter_value) where every parameter is a valide task parameter. Duplicates are not allowed.
solution: Adjust the content of the list, and then retry the operation.

message: Cannot set execution parameters for this advisor
cause: You attempted to set execution parameters for an advisor that did not support multiple executions of its tasks.
solution: Adjust the property of the advisor, and then retry the operation.

message: The directive with definition id string was not found.
cause: An invalid directive identifier was specified to advisor framework.
solution: User should specify a correct identifier number and retry the operation.

message: The directive with instance id of string was not found.
cause: An invalid instance identifier was specified to advisor framework.
solution: User should specify a correct instance identifier number and retry the operation.

message: The directive document contains a syntax error and cannot be loaded.
cause: An attempt was made to load an XML-based directive that does not conform to the documented DTD.
solution: Reformat the directive according the documented DTD.

message: The parameter was not found in directive string .
cause: The specified parameter name could not be located within the directive XML document.
solution: Verify the existence of the parameter in the specified directive.

message: The filter Xpath specification has invalid syntax.
cause: The specified filter could not be compiled within the directive XML document.
solution: Verify the syntax of the filter and retry the operation.

message: The specified directive already has an instance
cause: An attempt was made to create multiple instances of a directive when not permitted
solution: Verify the parent directive identifier and the instance name.

message: A directive with domain " string " and name " string " already exists for advisor string .
cause: The specified directive is not unique among the directives.
solution: Choose a directive name and domain that is distinct for the associated advisor.

message: A directive instance with the name " string " already exists.
cause: The specified directive instance is not unique among instances for this directive.
solution: Choose an instance name that is distinct for the associated directive.

message: A directive instance with the name " string " was not found.
cause: An attempt was made to update or delete a non-existent directive instance.
solution: Verify the parent directive identifier and the instance name.

message: The specified value provided for parameter string is not valid for this task.
cause: The supplied parameter value was not valid for the current task configuration.
solution: Retry by supplying valid value. Check the current task configuration.

message: The task string contains no results for execution string .
cause: An attempt was made to create a report or script from an execution that had not been successfully completed.
solution: Run a new execution and then retry the operation.

message: A task-managed "SQL Tuning Set" already exists for task " string ".
cause: An attempt was made to create a task-managed SQL Tuning Set for a task that already had one.
solution: Create a new task to use a different SQL Tuning Set.

message: Execution names are not correctly ordered.
cause: The supplied execution names were not properly ordered by execution start date.
solution: Retry by supplying a valid order.

message: Task ID string does not exist.
cause: The supplied task ID was invalid.
solution: Check the task ID and try again.

message: Execution ID string does not exist.
cause: The supplied execution ID was invalid.
solution: Check the execution ID and try again.

message: The current operation was aborted because it was blocking another session.
cause: The task or object operation interrupted itself when it detected that it was blocking some other session.
solution: Retry the operation when the conflicting operations are not running.

message: Execution provided has type " string ", expected " string ".
cause: An execution was provided whose type did not match the one expected by the API.
solution: Check the execution name, and try again.

message: No execution of type string exists for task provided.
cause: No execution of the required type existed for the given advisor task.
solution: Check the task, and try again.

message: Advisor feature is not currently implemented.
cause: An attempt was made to execute an unsupported advisor operation.
solution: Verify the availability of the operation.

message: Snapshot pair [ string , string ] seems to be specified in reverse order.
cause: The start snapshot id was greater than the end snapshot id.
solution: Swap the start and end snapshot ids.

message: Snapshot IDs specified by the range [ string , string ] are equal.
cause: The start snapshot id and end snapshot id were identical.
solution: Provide different start and end snapshot ids.

message: The snapshot pair [ string , string ] for database_id string and instance_id string are not found in the current repository.
cause: The snapshot ids or the database id or the instance id was invalid or the specified snapshots have already been purged.
solution: Set valid snapshot ids and retry.

message: Invalid value " string " specified for parameter " string ".
cause: The parameter was not set before executing the ADDM.
solution: Set the parameter to a valid value and retry.

message: There was a instance shutdown/startup between the snapshots in the range [ string , string ].
cause: Instance was shut down and restarted between the two specified snapshots.
solution: Specify start and end snapshot ids that does not have a shutdown/startup in between them.

message: Invalid value " string " specified for parameter " string " in " string " analysis mode.
cause: The parameter was not set to an acceptable value for this particular mode of analysis.
solution: Set the parameter to a valid value and retry.

message: Either the start snapshot string or the end snapshot string is incomplete or missing key statistics.
cause: Either the start or the end snaphots was missing or purged or had encountered errors while creating them.
solution: Verify that AWR is done taking these two snapshots, or Look in DBA_HIST_SNAP_ERROR to find what tables are missing in the start/end snapshots. Use the ERROR_NUMBER column in that view together with the alert log to identify the reason for failure and take necessary action to prevent such failures in the future. Try running ADDM on a different snapshot range that has valid start and end snapshots.

message: Some snapshots in the range [ string , string ] were purged before the analysis was complete.
cause: One or both of the snapshots have been purged from AWR.
solution: Verify that the AWR auto purging is not trying to purge these snapshots and re-run ADDM.

message: Required parameter " string " must be set before execution.
cause: The parameter needs to be set before running the ADDM
solution: Set the parameter to a valid value and retry.

message: Parameter " string " must have a higher value than parameter " string ". The values supplied were " string " and " string " respectively.
cause: Invalid interaction between two parameter values.
solution: Set at least one of the values so the value of the first parameter is higher than the value of the second parameter.

message: Some snapshots in the range [ string , string ] are missing key statistics.
cause: Some AWR tables encountered errors while creating one or more snapshots in the given range. The data present in one or more of these missing tables is necessary to perform an ADDM analysis.
solution: Look in DBA_HIST_SNAP_ERROR to find what tables are missing in the given snapshot range. Use the ERROR_NUMBER column in that view together with the alert log to identify the reason for failure and take necessary action to prevent such failures in the future. Try running ADDM on a different snapshot range that does not include any incomplete snapshots.

message: Cannot perform ADDM analysis on AWR snapshots from previous releases. Snapshot version " string " do not match the database version " string ".
cause: ADDM analysis can only be performed on AWR snapshots taken in the current release.
solution: One can still generate AWR and ASH reports using ?/rdbms/admin/awrrpt and ?/rdbms/admin/ashrpt on these snapshots to analyze the data in them.

message: Finding name " string " does not exist. Look in DBA_ADVISOR_FINDING_NAMES for all valid values
cause: Attempt to refer to an advisor's finding name that does not exist.
solution: Specify a valid value. The list of all valid values is in DBA_ADVISOR_FINDING_NAMES

message: " string " is not a valid SQL_ID value
cause: The specified value of SQL_ID was not properly formatted.
solution: Specify a valid value consisting of a 13 character string with characters from '0' to '9' and from 'a' to 'z'.

message: " string " is not recognized by ADDM as a parameter name
cause: The specified value for a system parameter was not recognized by ADDM.
solution: Specify a value that appears in the NAME column of V$PARAMETER.

message: Diagnostic Package License is needed for using this feature.
cause: The specified value for system parameter CONTROL_MANAGEMENT_PACK_ACCESS indicated that the Diagnostic Package was disabled.
solution: Modify the parameter value if the Diagnostic Package License was purchased.

message: Tuning Package License is needed for using this feature.
cause: The specified value for system parameter CONTROL_MANAGEMENT_PACK_ACCESS indicated that the Tuning Package was disabled.
solution: Modify the parameter value if the Tuning Package License was purchased.

message: Tuning Package License or Real Application Testing Option is needed for using this feature.
cause: The specified package license and option were not installed.
solution: Consider purchasing and installing either the missing package licence or option. If the tuning package license was purchased, then check the value of system parameter CONTROL_MANAGEMENT_PACK_ACCESS.

message: Imported AWR snapshots are from a database with an incompatible character set.
cause: ADDM analysis was attempted on imported Automatic Workload Repository (AWR) snapshots with incompatible character set.
solution: Perform ADDM analysis using a database with the same version and character set as the original database.

message: dimension name provided is too long
cause: Active Session History (ASH) dimension name provided was longer than the limit of 30 characters.
solution: Correct the dimension name and retry the operation.

message: dimension name provided is invalid
cause: Active Session History (ASH) dimension name provided was invalid.
solution: Correct the dimension name and retry the operation.

message: User " string " has not been granted the "ADMINISTER SQL TUNING SET" privilege.
cause: The user attempted an SQL Tuning Set operation that requires a specific privilege.
solution: Adjust the user's privileges and retry the operation.

message: "SQL Tuning Set" " string " does not exist for owner " string " or user " string " does not have permission to access the "SQL Tuning Set".
cause: The user attempted to access a SQL Tuning Set that does not exist or the user does have permission to access the SQL Tuning Set
solution: Check the existence of the "SQL Tuning Set" or adjust the user's privileges and retry the operation.

message: User " string " must be SYS or must have the "ADMINISTER ANY SQL TUNING SET" privilege.
cause: The attempted to create a SQL Tuning Set in another schema without having the right privilege.
solution: Connect as SYS or adjust the user's privilege and retry the operation.

message: "SQL Tuning Set" " string " already exists for user " string ".
cause: The user attempted to create a "\SQL Tuning"\ Set using a name that already exists for that owner.
solution: Change the name of the SQL Tuning Set and retry the operation.

message: "SQL Tuning Set" " string " does not exist for user " string ".
cause: The user attempted to access a SQL Tuning Set that does not exist.
solution: Check the speelling of the SQL Tuning Set name and retry the operation.

message: invalid "SQL Tuning Set" name
cause: The user attempted to specify a SQL Tuning Set name that is invalid. A name must not contain wildcards and its length must be less than 30 characters.
solution: Adjust the name and retry the operation.

message: Cannot update attribute " string ".
cause: The user attempted to update an attribute element that cannot be modified. The only string attributes that can be updated are MODULE, ACTION, PARSING_SCHEMA_NAME, PRIORITY, and OTHER.
solution: Adjust the attribute name and retry the operation.

message: "SQL Tuning Set" " string " owned by user " string " is active.
cause: The user attempted to update an active SQL Tuning Set.
solution: Remove all reference to the SQL Tuning Set and retry the operation.

message: "SQL Tuning Set" " string " owned by user " string " is in use.
cause: The user attempted to modify a SQL Tuning Set or to add a reference to a SQL Tuning Set which is in use.
solution: Wait until the end of the previous operation and retry.

message: User " string " cannot remove reference " string ".
cause: The user attempted to remove a SQL Tuning Set reference that does not exist. The user might not own the reference.
solution: Check the reference ID and the reference owner and retry the operation.

message: invalid filter
cause: The user attempted to select data from a data source using an invalid filter. A filter is a WHERE clause on data source content.
solution: Correct the filter and retry the operation.

message: The string ranking measure is invalid.
cause: The user attempted to select data from a data source using an invlaid ranking measure. A ranking measure must represent a valid numerical expression.
solution: Correct the ranking measure and retry the operation.

message: illegal ranking attribute " string "
cause: The user attempted to use an attribute element that is not allowed in a ranking meseare.
solution: Check the attribute in the ranking meseare and retry the operation.

message: Value " string " is illegal as a result percentage.
cause: The user attempted to select data from a SQL Tuning Set using an invalid result percentage. The result percentage must be between 0 and 1.
solution: Correct the result percentage value and retry the operation.

message: Value " string " is illegal for a result limit.
cause: The user attempted to select data from a SQL Tuning Set using an invalid result limit. A result limit must be a positive interger.
solution: Correct the result limit value and retry the operation.

message: A ranking measure is required.
cause: The user attempted to select data from a SQL Tuning Set using a percentage argument without specifying a ranking measure.
solution: Add a ranking measure or remove the percentage argument and retry the operation.

message: End snapshot ID must be greater than begin snapshot ID.
cause: The user attempted to select data from the workload repository using an invalid snaphot ID range.
solution: Adjust the snapshot ID range and retry the operation.

message: Snapshot ID must be between string and string .
cause: The user attempted to select data from the workload repository using a snaphot ID which does not exist.
solution: Adjust the snapshot ID and retry the operation.

message: Snapshots string and string do not exist.
cause: The user attempted to select data from the workload repository using snapshots that do not exist.
solution: Check the snapshot identifiers and retry the operation.

message: Baseline " string " does not exist.
cause: The user attempted to access a baseline that does not exsit.
solution: Check the speelling of the baseline name and retry the operation.

message: cannot obtain exclusive lock string on "SQL Tuning Set" " string " owned by user " string "
cause: Unexpected error from DBMS_LOCK.REQUEST.
solution: This error should not normally occur. Check your system for anomalies and retry the operation. If this error persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: unexpected deadlock on "SQL Tuning Set" " string " owned by user " string "
cause: Unexpected error from DBMS_LOCK.REQUEST
solution: This error should not normally occur. Check your system for anomalies and retry the operation. If this error persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: insufficient privileges to select data from the cursor cache
cause: The user attempted to perform an operation without having the appropriate privileges on V$SQL and V$SQL_BIND_CAPTURE.
solution: Adjust the user's privileges and retry the operation.

message: insufficient privileges to select data from the workload repository
cause: The user attempted to perform an operation without having the appropriate privileges on views DBA_HIST_BASELINE, DBA_HIST_SQLTEXT, DBA_HIST_SQLSTAT, DBA_HIST_SQLBIND, DBA_HIST_OPTIMIZER_ENV, and DBA_HIST_SNAPSHOT.
solution: Adjust the user's privileges and retry the operation.

message: inconsistent datatype in input cursor
cause: The user attempted to load a SQL Tuning Set using an invalid input cursor. All rows in the cursor must match type SQLSET_ROW.
solution: Check the rows type in the cursor and retry the operation.

message: User " string " has not been granted the "SELECT" privilege on the "SQL tuning set" DBA views.
cause: The user attempted to read a SQL tuning set belonging to someone else without having SELECT privilege on the DBA views
solution: User should be granted the privilege or only access his own STS

message: invalid list of attribute names
cause: The user specified an attribute element that is not valid. The only attributes that can be selected are NULL, BASIC, TYPICAL, ALL or a comma separated list of the names including EXECUTION_STATISTICS, OBJECT_LIST, BIND_LIST and SQL_PLAN.
solution: Adjust the attribute list and retry the operation.

message: no new name or owner specified for "SQL Tuning Set"
cause: The user attempted to call remap_stgtab_sqlset without specifying either a new SQL tuning set name or a new SQL tuning set owner
solution: Specify at least one or the other argument as non-NULL

message: invalid load option
cause: The user attempted to call load_sqlset with a load option that is different than INSERT, UPDATE and MERGE.
solution: Adjust the load option and retry the operation.

message: SQL statement does not exist.
cause: The user attempted to tune a SQL statement that does not exist.
solution: Verify the sql_id and the plan hash value of the statement and retry the operation.

message: cannot perform test-execute and explain plan operations on the automatic SQL tuning task
cause: The user attempted to test-execute or generate explain plans for a SQL workload using the automatic SQL tuning task.
solution: Verify the name of the tuning task and retry the operation.

message: invalid tuning scope
cause: The user attempted to specify a tuning task scope that is invalid. The possible values are LIMITED or COMPREHENSIVE.
solution: Check the scope value and retry the operation.

message: cannot accept SQL profiles for all statements in the " string "
cause: An attempt was made to accept SQL profiles for all statements in the input workload.
solution: Provide the object identifier corresponding to a statement in the workload and retry the operation.

message: missing target object for tuning task " string "
cause: The user attempted to perform an operation on a task without specifying a target object or by using an invalid object identifier.
solution: Check the identifier of the object and retry the operation.

message: missing SQL text of statement object " string " for tuning task " string "
cause: The user attempted to accept SQL profile for an object that has not a SQL text associated to it.
solution: Check the identifier of the object and retry the operation.

message: missing SQL profile for statement object " string " for tuning task " string "
cause: The user attempted to accept a SQL profile for an object that has not a SQL profile associated to it.
solution: Check the identifier of the object and retry the operation.

message: invalid recommendation type
cause: The user passed an invalid recommendation type in the rec_type argument to script_tuning_task. Possible values are ALL or any subset of a comma-separated list of PROFILES, STATISTICS and INDEXES.
solution: Check the rec_type arg and retry the operation.

message: invalid process action
cause: The user passed an invalid action to process a SQL statement. Possible value is any subset of a comma-seperated list of EXECUTE and EXPLAIN_PLAN.
solution: Check the action argument and retry the operation.

message: invalid value for time limit
cause: The user passed an invalid value for the time limit argument.
solution: Check the argument specified value and retry the operation.

message: cannot resume a task created to process a single statement
cause: An attempt was made to resume a task that was created for a single SQL statement. A task can be resumed only if it is used for a SQL Tuning Set.
solution: No action required.

message: invalid comparison metric
cause: An invalid metric to compare SQL performance was specified.
solution: s.

message: execution type mismatch
cause: An attempt was made to analyze the performance of a SQL workload using two executions that were generated using two different
solution: check the name and type of task executions to analyze and retry the operation.

message: missing task execution
cause: An insufficient number of valid task executions to analyze the performance of a SQL workload were specified.
solution: run the task to generate two executions of the same type and retry the operation.

message: invalid value string specified for problem type
cause: An invalid problem type was specified to the SQL diagnosis advisor. Problem type should be one of the PROBLEM_TYPE_* defined in 'admin/dbmsdiag.sql'.
solution: Specify valid problem type.

message: invalid SQL Id specified, string
cause: Invalid SQL Id specified for conversion.
solution: Specify valid SQL Id.

message: Parameter string cannot be NULL.
cause: A call to GET_THRESHOLD procedure was made without a required parameter.
solution: Specify a valid value for this parameter.

message: threshold not found
cause: No threshold was found with the specified threshold key.
solution: No action required.

message: concurrent DDL failure on SQL repository objects
cause: A SQL repository object was the target of two concurrent DDL operations.
solution: Check the current state of the object and retry the operation that failed.

message: invalid value for SQLTUNE_CATEGORY parameter
cause: An invalid Oracle identifier was used as the value of the parameter.
solution: Specify the parameter conforming to the rules for Oracle identifiers.

message: failed to purge SQL Tuning Base entry from sql$
cause: An error occured while try to delete a SQL Tuning Base object.
solution: Look at the underlying error(s) on the error stack.

message: missing SQL statement text for create SQL profile
cause: No SQL text was provided to the create SQL profile operation.
solution: Retry with properly specified SQL text.

message: empty SQL profile not allowed for create or update SQL profile
cause: No attributes were specified to the create SQL profile operation.
solution: Retry with at least one hint specified.

message: null or zero length attribute specified in SQL profile collection
cause: One of the attributes within the SQL profile was not properly specified.
solution: Retry with a fully specified SQL profile.

message: generated SQL profile name string already exists
cause: A SQL profile already exists with the name generated by the system.
solution: Retry the operation as the generated name is time sensitive.

message: SQL profile named string already exists
cause: A SQL profile already exists with the name specified.
solution: Specify a different name or drop the existing SQL profile.

message: SQL profile with category string already exists for this SQL statement
cause: A SQL profile already exists for the given SQL statement and category.
solution: Drop or update the existing SQL profile.

message: SQL profile name specified is invalid
cause: An invalid SQL profile name was specified.
solution: Look for the underlying error on the error message stack.

message: category name specified is invalid
cause: An invalid category name swas pecified.
solution: Look for the underlying error on the error message stack.

message: SQL profile named string doesn't exist
cause: A SQL profile name was specified that doesn't exist.
solution: Verify the name of the SQL profile.

message: name of SQL profile to be cloned must be provided
cause: A SQL profile name was not provided as the from target of a clone SQL profile operation.
solution: Provide the name of the SQL profile being cloned.

message: invalid attribute name specified
cause: An invalid attribute name was specified for an alter SQL profile operation.
solution: Verify the name of the attribute.

message: invalid attribute value specified
cause: An invalid attribute value was specified for an alter SQL profile operation.
solution: Verify the attribute value.

message: invalid HASH_VALUE
cause: An invalid HASH_VALUE was passed to a create SQL profile operation
solution: Verify the HASH_VALUE.

message: invalid ADDRESS value
cause: An invalid ADDRESS value was passed to a create SQL profile operation.
solution: Verify the ADDRESS value.

message: V$SQL row doesn't exist with given HASH_VALUE and ADDRESS.
cause: A HASH_VALUE and ADDRESS combination passed to the create SQL profile operation doesn't coorespond to an existing V$SQL entry.
solution: Verify the HASH_VALUE and ADDRESS in V$SQL.

message: Concurrent DDL Error in create SQL profile operation.
cause: A concurrent DDL operation was performed during a create or replace sql profile operation.
solution: Try operation again

message: SQL profile named string already exists for a different signature/category pair
cause: A SQL profile already exists with the name specified under a different signature/category pair so it cannot be replaced, even with FORCE specified.
solution: Specify a different name or drop the existing SQL profile.

message: no SELECT privilege on DBA_SQL_PROFILES
cause: A user has tried to perform an operation that requires SELECT privileges on the DBA_SQL_PROFILES view.
solution: Either perform the operation as another user or get the privilege

message: no SQL profile with name like " string " exists for category like " string "
cause: A user tried to perform an operation by specifying a profile name/ category filter that did not target any profiles
solution: Try a different filter after checking the profile name/category

message: no new SQL profile name or category specified.
cause: A user called remap_stgtab_sqlprof without specifying new values for the sql profile name or category. At least one is required.
solution: Specify either a new profile name, or a new category, or both

message: invalid SQL profile XML specification provided
cause: The supplied XML specification for the SQL profile did not adhere to the proper schema.
solution: Check the syntax and try again.

message: Cannot create SQL plan baseline on the given plan
cause: There are either multiple plans exist for the given value or the plan is not reproducible.
solution: Call Oracle Support.

message: The plan with plan hash value string does not exist
cause: The give plan does not exist.
solution: Check the available plans.

message: Tracing for client identifier string is not enabled
cause: Attempt to disable a client identifier tracing which was never enabled
solution: Supply correct client identifier

message: Tracing for client identifier string is already enabled
cause: Attempt to enable a client identifier tracing which has been already enabled
solution: Supply correct client identifier, or disable and re-enable tracing with different bind/wait options

message: Tracing for service(module/action) string is not enabled
cause: Attempt to disable a service-level tracing which was never enabled
solution: Supply correct service(module/action) name

message: Tracing for service (module/action) string is already enabled
cause: Attempt to enable a service-level tracing which has been already enabled
solution: Supply correct service(module/action), or disable and re-enable tracing with different bind/wait options

message: Tracing for service(module/action) string on instance string is not enabled
cause: Attempt to disable a service-level tracing which was never explicitly enabled on a specific instance
solution: Supply correct service(module/action) name

message: Tracing for service (module/action) string on instance string is already enabled

solution: Supply correct service(module/action), or disable and re-enable tracing with different bind/wait options

message: Service name must be specified

solution: Supply the service name

message: Invalid module name

solution: Supply correct name

message: Invalid action name

solution: Supply correct name

message: Action cannot be specified without the module specification
cause: Action name is specified, but the module name is not
solution: Supply the module name

message: Invalid service name
cause: Service name is too long (exceeding 64 characters)
solution: Supply correct name

message: Statistics aggregation for client identifier string is already enabled
cause: Attempt to enable a client identifier aggregation which has been already enabled
solution: Supply correct client identifier

message: Statistics aggregation for client identifier string is not enabled
cause: Attempt to disable a client identifier statistics aggregation which was never enabled
solution: Supply correct client identifier

message: Statistics aggregation for service(module/action) string is not enabled
cause: Attempt to disable a service-level statistics aggregation which was never enabled
solution: Supply correct service(module/action) name

message: Statistics aggregation for service (module/action) string is already enabled
cause: Attempt to enable a service-level statistics aggregation which has been already enabled
solution: Supply correct service(module/action)

message: Module name must be specified
cause: Attempt to enable/disable a service-level statistics aggregation without a module specification
solution: Supply module name

message: Client identifier must be specified
cause: Omitting client identifier while enabling/disabling tracing or aggregation
solution: Supply the client identifier

message: Database-wide SQL tracing is already enabled
cause: Attempt to enable a database-level tracing which has been already enabled
solution: Disable and re-enable tracing with different bind/wait options

message: Instance-wide SQL tracing on instance string is not enabled
cause: Attempt to disable a service-level tracing which was never explicitly enabled on a specific instance
solution: No action required

message: Instance-wide SQL tracing on instance string is already enabled
cause: Attempt to enable an instance-level tracing which has been already enabled on a specific instance
solution: Disable and re-enable tracing with different bind/wait options

message: Database-wide SQL tracing is not enabled
cause: Attempt to disable a database-level tracing which was never enabled
solution: No action required

message: Invalid instance name
cause: Instance name is too long (exceeding 16 characters)
solution: Supply correct name

message: missing or invalid parameter string
cause: A call to SET_THRESHOLD procedure was either missing a parameter, or the parameter was invalid.
solution: Specify a valid value for this parameter.

message: Object string was not found.
cause: An object name was passed to SET_THRESHOLD procedure that did not map to a valid object.
solution: Specify a valid object name.

message: The specified file string is not a data file.
cause: The object name was passed to a SET_THRESHOLD procedure that did not map to a valid data file.
solution: Specify a valid data file name.

message: Invalid combination of string threshold value and operator.
cause: A non-positive number was used for "Blocked User Session Count" metrics while operator contains equal.
solution: Use a positive number for the threshold value or use "greater than" operator.

message: The file has been dropped and recreated during the procedure call.
cause: The file on which threshold is specified was dropped and recreated during the procedure call.
solution: Retry this operation.

message: Critical or warning threshold have incorrect values
cause: The tablespace threshold values can be in the range 0 to 100 only.
solution: Check the threshold values

message: The tablespace is not of the right type.
cause: An attempt was made to set a threshold on dictionary-managed tablespaces.
solution: Check the tablespace type and reissue the command.

message: Threshold value is invalid.
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid value for critical or warning thresholds.
solution: Use non-negative integers only for threshold values.

message: Invalid combination of metrics id and object type parameters.
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid combination of metrics id // and object type parameters.
solution: Specify a valid combination of metrics id and object type parameters.

message: Invalid combination of threshold value and operator.
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid combination of threshold value and operator.
solution: Check the operator and threshold values and reissue statement.

message: Parameter string cannot be NULL.
cause: An attempt was made to call GET_THRESHOLD procedure without a required parameter.
solution: Specify a valid value for this parameter.

message: Threshold not found
cause: The threshold did not exist with the specified threshold key.
solution: No action required.

message: Critical threshold value is less than warning threshold value.
cause: An attempt was made to call SET_THRESHOLD procedure with the critical threshold value less than the warning threshold value.
solution: Check the threshold values and reissue the statement.

message: The threshold cannot be set when SYSAUX is offline.
cause: SET_THRESHOLD procedure was called when SYSAUX tablespace was offline.
solution: Call SET_THRESHOLD procedure when SYSAUX is online.

message: Threshold notification failed.
cause: An error occurred when sending notification for this threshold.
solution: Make sure you have enough space on SYSAUX tablespace and retry this operation.

message: Critical byte based free space threshold value is greater than warning threshold value.
cause: An attempt was made to call SET_THRESHOLD procedure with the bytes based critical threshold value greater than the warning threshold value.
solution: Check the threshold values and reissue the statement.

message: Invalid value " string " specified for parameter " string "
cause: An invalid value was specified for the the given parameter.
solution: Correct the value being specified for the parameter.

message: Posting system alert with reason_id string failed with code [ string ] [ string ]
cause: Connection to the database is dead, or invalid parameter to alert routine.
solution: If this condition repeats, please contact Oracle Support.

message: Updating system alert with reason_id string failed; previous alert not found
cause: System Error: An attempt to update a system alert failed. The alert was improperly cleared from WRI$_ALERT_OUTSTANDING.
solution: Do not delete from WRI$_ALERT_OUTSTANDING. If this condition repeats, please contact Oracle Support.

message: Cannot specify values for parameter " string " and for parameter " string "
cause: Can only specify a value for one or the other.
solution: Pass just one of the parameters.

message: Threshold cannot be set when database is in read-only mode.
cause: SET_THRESHOLD procedure was called when database was open in read-only mode.
solution: Call SET_THRESHOLD procedure when database is open in read/write mode.

message: MMON sub-action time limit exceeded
cause: MMON sub-action did not complete within the system specified time frame.
solution: None

message: Invalid name of " string " given
cause: Passed an invalid component, report, or transformation name to the framework. Names must be alphanumeric and can contain the underscore (_) character.
solution: Try again with a valid name

message: string " string " unknown
cause: Passed an unknown component, report, or transformation to the framework.
solution: Give a different name

message: string " string " unknown for string " string "
cause: An object with the first name is unknown within the naming scope of the second name
solution: Change the parameters passed in or register the proper object

message: string unknown for string " string "
cause: An object is unknown within the given naming scope
solution: Change the parameters passed in or register the proper object

message: string with name " string " already exists
cause: An object with the given name already exists
solution: Give a different name

message: string with name " string " already exists for string " string "
cause: An object with the first name already exists within the naming scope of the second name
solution: Give a different name

message: Improperly-formed report tag
cause: The top-level report tag was not built properly
solution: Make sure that the report tag is built using the common tag library function

message: Invalid content type
cause: An invalid content type was passed to the register format API
solution: Correct your code to use the values in dbmsrep.sql

message: Invalid reference string parameter or value
cause: An invalid parameter/value was passed to a dbms_report API
solution: Ensure that the parameter names and values are alphanumeric.

message: Filename too long
cause: An invalid file name was passed to STORE_FILE
solution: Ensure that the filename is less than 500 bytes

message: Invalid file URL
cause: A URL with invalid syntax was provided, either directly to the function or via an XML IMPORT or INCLUDE.
solution: Check the URL.

message: Invalid file URL or path prefix
cause: Either a URL or path prefix with invalid syntax was provided.
solution: Check the URL

message: Could not find file at URL provided
cause: The file requested could not be found in the given location.
solution: Check the URL provided.

message: Missing <body> tag from HTML
cause: An HTML document was passed to the function missing its <body> tag.
solution: Check the HTML source.

message: Invalid reference string
cause: The given reference string could not be parsed.
solution: Check the reference string syntax.

message: Invalid URL provided to servlet
cause: An invalid URL was provided to the servlet.
solution: Check the URL.

message: Error \ string received from XPath engine
cause: An error was received from the xpath library during an xpath operation.
solution: Check xmlerr.h to understand the cause of the error.

message: Invalid input to build common < string > tag
cause: Invalid input was given when attempting to build a common tag.
solution: Check the function input to make sure all necessary information is given.

message: Invalid input given to variable argument list report function.
cause: An invalid parameter was provided to one of the report framework variable argument list functions.
solution: Check the function input and try again.

message: Invalid input given to structured argument list report function.
cause: An invalid parameter was provided to one of the report framework structured argument list functions.
solution: Check the function input and try again.

message: Invalid tag name given to common tag callout function.
cause: This is an internal Server Manageability Error
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services

message: only one LOCAL clause may be specified
cause: CREATE INDEX statement contained more than one LOCAL clause
solution: Specify LOCAL option at most once

message: LOCAL clause contradicts previosly specified GLOBAL clause
cause: CREATE INDEX statement contained a GLOBAL clause and a LOCAL clause
solution: Specify LOCAL or GLOBAL clause, but not both

message: only one GLOBAL clause may be specified
cause: CREATE INDEX statement contained more than one GLOBAL clause
solution: Specify GLOBAL option at most once

message: GLOBAL clause contradicts previosly specified LOCAL clause
cause: CREATE INDEX statement contained a LOCAL clause and a GLOBAL clause
solution: Specify GLOBAL or LOCAL clause, but not both

message: missing PARTITION keyword
cause: keyword PARTITION missing
solution: supply missing keyword

message: missing RANGE keyword
cause: keyword RANGE missing
solution: supply missing keyword

message: invalid partition name
cause: a partition name of the form <identifier> is expected but not present.
solution: enter an appropriate partition name.

message: missing LESS keyword
cause: keyword LESS missing
solution: supply missing keyword

message: missing THAN keyword
cause: keyword THAN missing
solution: supply missing keyword

message: partition bound may not be specified for a LOCAL index partition
cause: while parsing a CREATE INDEX statement to create a LOCAL partitioned index, <partition-description> of one of partitions was found to contain VALUES LESS THAN clause which is illegal since a LOCAL index inherits partition bounds from its base table
solution: remove all VALUES LESS THAN clauses from descriptions of LOCAL index partitions

message: this physical attribute may not be specified for an index partition
cause: unexpected option was encountered while parsing physical attributes of an index partition; valid options for Range or Composite Range partitions are INITRANS, MAXTRANS, TABLESPACE, STORAGE, PCTFREE; only TABLESPACE may be specified for Hash partitions
solution: remove invalid option(s) from the list of physical attributes of an index partition

message: names assigned to resulting partitions must be distinct
cause: Names of partitions resulting from splitting of an existing table or index partition are not distinct
solution: rename resulting partition(s) to ensure that their names are distinct and different from those of any other partition of the table or index

message: resulting partition name conflicts with that of an existing partition
cause: Name of a partition resulting from splitting of an existing table or index partition is identical to that of some other existing partition of that table or index
solution: rename resulting partition(s) to ensure that their names are distinct and different from those of any other partition of the table or index

message: duplicate partition name
cause: Name of a partition of a table or index being created is not unique
solution: rename partition(s) to ensure that their names are unique among partitions of the table or index being created

message: maximum number of partitioning columns is 16
cause: number of columns in a partitioning column list exceeded the legal limit of 16
solution: modify partitioning column list so that it consists of at most 16 columns

message: too many partition descriptions
cause: CREATE TABLE or CREATE INDEX contained too many partition descriptions; maximum number of partitions is 1048575 (1024K-1).
solution: Reduce number of partitions to not exceed 1048575 (1024K -1).

message: underlying table of a LOCAL partitioned index must be partitioned
cause: User attempted to create a LOCAL partitioned index on a non-partitioned table which is illegal. Only GLOBAL indices (partitioned or otherwise) may be created on a non-partitioned table.
solution: Correct the statement and reenter

message: partition bound list contains too many elements
cause: Partition bound list contained more elements than there are partitioning columns
solution: Ensure that the number of elements in partition bound list is equal to the number of partitioning columns of the table or index

message: partition bound list contains too few elements
cause: Partition bound list contained fewer elements than there are partitioning columns
solution: Ensure that the number of elements in partition bound list is equal to the number of partitioning columns of the table or index

message: partition bound element must be one of: string, datetime or interval literal, number, or MAXVALUE
cause: Partition bound list contained an element of invalid type (i.e. not a number, non-empty string, datetime or interval literal, or MAXVALUE)
solution: Ensure that all elements of partition bound list are of valid type

message: this physical attribute may not be specified for a table partition
cause: unexpected option was encountered while parsing physical attributes of a table partition; valid options for Range or Composite Range partitions are INITRANS, MAXTRANS, TABLESPACE, STORAGE, PCTFREE, and PCTUSED; only TABLESPACE may be specified for Hash partitions
solution: remove invalid option(s) from the list of physical attributes of a table partition

message: MAXVALUE must be specified for all columns
cause: In the VALUES LESS THAN clause for the highest (last) partition of a GLOBAL index, MAXVALUE must be specified for all columns
solution: Ensure that VALUES LESS THAN clause for the last partition of a GLOBAL index has MAXVALUE specified for all columns

message: creation of LOCAL partitioned cluster indices is not supported
cause: An attempt was made to create a LOCAL partitioned cluster index, which is currently illegal
solution: Remove LOCAL along with <partition description>s, if any, from the CREATE INDEX statement.

message: creation of GLOBAL partitioned cluster indices is not supported
cause: An attempt was made to create a GLOBAL partitioned cluster index, which is currently illegal
solution: Remove PARTITION BY RANGE clause along with <partition description>s from the CREATE INDEX statement.

message: number of partitions of LOCAL index must equal that of the underlying table
cause: User attempted to create a LOCAL partitioned index with a number of partitions which is different from that of the underlying table.
solution: Correct the CREATE INDEX statement to specify a correct number of partitions

message: PARTITION may not be specified for a materialized view or a materialized view log
cause: PARTITION option was encountered while parsing a definition of a materialized view or a materialized view log
solution: Ensure that a definition of a MATERIALIZED VIEW does not include invalid options

message: PARTITION and CLUSTER clauses are mutually exclusive
cause: definition of a table contained both PARTITION and CLUSTER clauses which is illegal
solution: Remove one of the conflicting clauses

message: only one PARTITION clause may be specified
cause: CREATE TABLE statement contained more than one PARTITION clause
solution: Specify PARTITION option at most once

message: missing AT or VALUES keyword
cause: keyword AT or VALUES missing
solution: supply missing keyword

message: GLOBAL partitioned index must be prefixed
cause: partitioning columns of a global partitioned index must form a prefix of the index' key columns
solution: Ensure that the GLOBAL partitioned index being created is prefixed

message: non-existent partitioning column in CREATE TABLE statement
cause: Partitioning column specified in CREATE TABLE statement is not one of columns of the table being created.
solution: Ensure that all columns in the partitioning column list are columns of the table being created.

message: partitioning column may not be of type LONG or LONG RAW
cause: Partitioning column specified by the user was of type LONG or LONG RAW, which is illegal.
solution: Ensure that no partitioning column is of type LONG or LONG RAW.

message: partition bound of partition number string is too high
cause: High bound of the partition whose number (partitions are numbered starting with 1) is displayed in this message did not collate lower than that of the following partition, which is illegal.
solution: Ensure that high bound of every partition (except for the last one) collates lower than that of a following partition.

message: partition bound value too large for column
cause: Length of partition bound value is longer than that of the corresponding partitioning column.
solution: Ensure that lengths of high bound values do not exceed those of corresponding partitioning columns

message: partition bound of partition " string " is too high
cause: High bound of the partition whose name (explicitly specified by the user) is displayed in this message did not collate lower than that of the following partition, which is illegal.
solution: Ensure that high bound of every partition (except for the last one) collates lower than that of a following partition.

message: GLOBAL partitioned index must be prefixed
cause: User attempted to create a GLOBAL non-prefixed partitioned index which is illegal
solution: If the user, indeed, desired to create a non-prefixed index, it must be created as LOCAL; otherwise, correct the list of key and/or partitioning columns to ensure that the index is prefixed

message: partitioning columns must form a subset of key columns of a UNIQUE index
cause: User attempted to create a UNIQUE partitioned index whose partitioning columns do not form a subset of its key columns which is illegal
solution: If the user, indeed, desired to create an index whose partitioning columns do not form a subset of its key columns, it must be created as non-UNIQUE; otherwise, correct the list of key and/or partitioning columns to ensure that the index' partitioning columns form a subset of its key columns

message: partition bound may not be specified for resulting partitions
cause: while parsing an ALTER {TABLE|INDEX} SPLIT PARTITION statement, <partition-description> of a resulting partition was found to contain VALUES LESS THAN clause which is illegal
solution: remove VALUES LESS THAN clause from the description(s) of partitions resulting from splitting an existing table or index partition

message: partition bound may not be specified for a partition being moved, modified or rebuilt
cause: while parsing an ALTER {TABLE|INDEX} MODIFY PARTITION, ALTER TABLE MOVE PARTITION, or ALTER INDEX REBUILD PARTITION statement, description of new physical attributes of the partition being moved, modified, or rebuilt was found to contain VALUES LESS THAN clause which is illegal
solution: remove VALUES LESS THAN clause from the description of new attributes of the partition being moved, modified, or rebuilt

message: only one partition may be added
cause: ALTER TABLE ADD PARTITION contained descriptions of more than one partition to be added
solution: Ensure that the statement contains exactly one partition definition and that it does not contain any commas

message: only one partition may be moved
cause: ALTER TABLE MOVE PARTITION contained descriptions of more than one partition to be moved
solution: Ensure that the statement describes exactly one partition to be moved and that it does not contain any commas

message: only one partition may be modified
cause: ALTER TABLE|INDEX MODIFY PARTITION contained descriptions of more than one partition to be modified
solution: Ensure that the statement describes exactly one partition to be modified and that it does not contain any commas

message: a partition may be split into exactly two new partitions
cause: ALTER TABLE|INDEX SPLIT PARTITION did not contain descriptions of exactly two new partitions into which an existing table or index partition was to be split
solution: Ensure that the statement describes exactly two partition into which an existing partition is to be split

message: ALTER TABLE|INDEX RENAME may not be combined with other operations
cause: ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX statement attempted to combine a RENAME operation with some other operation which is illegal
solution: Ensure that RENAME operation is the sole operation specified in ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX statement;

message: a partition maintenance operation may not be combined with other operations
cause: ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX statement attempted to combine a partition maintenance operation (e.g. MOVE PARTITION) with some other operation (e.g. ADD PARTITION or PCTFREE which is illegal
solution: Ensure that a partition maintenance operation is the sole operation specified in ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX statement; operations other than those dealing with partitions, default attributes of partitioned tables/indices or specifying that a table be renamed (ALTER TABLE RENAME) may be combined at will

message: invalid ALTER TABLE MODIFY PARTITION option
cause: An option other than PCTFREE, PCTUSED, INITRANS, MAXTRANS, STORAGE, BACKUP, ALLOCATE EXTENT, or DEALLOCATE UNUSED was specified in an ALTER TABLE MODIFY PARTITION statement for a Range or Composite Range partition.
solution: Specify only legal options.

message: invalid ALTER INDEX MODIFY PARTITION option
cause: An option other than INITRANS, MAXTRANS, STORAGE, or DEALLOCATE UNUSED was specified in an ALTER INDEX MODIFY PARTITION statement.
solution: Specify only legal options.

message: invalid ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW option
cause: An option other than PCTFREE, PCTUSED, INITRANS, MAXTRANS, STORAGE, or BACKUP was specified in an ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW statement.
solution: Specify only legal options.

message: partition-extended table name syntax is disallowed in this context
cause: User attempted to use partition-extended table name syntax in illegal context (i.e. not in FROM-clause or INSERT, DELETE, or UPDATE statement)
solution: Avoid use of partition-extended table name in contexts other those mentioned above.

message: illegal attempt to modify string in string statement
cause: Certain attributes of objects (e.g. tables) may be specified at creation time, but may not be modified using ALTER statement. Unfortunately, user specified one of such attributes.
solution: Ensure that ALTER statement specifies new values only for attributes which may be changed once an object has been created

message: invalid ALTER TABLE TRUNCATE PARTITION option
cause: Name of the partition to be truncated may be followed by DROP STORAGE or REUSE STORAGE
solution: Ensure that no options besides DROP STORAGE or REUSE STORAGE are specified with ALTER TABLE TRUNCATE PARTITION

message: keyword REBUILD in ALTER INDEX REBUILD must immediately follow <index name>
cause: ALTER INDEX statement contained REBUILD keyword following some index attributes (e.g. INITRANS.)
solution: Ensure that keyword REBUILD immediately follows the name of the index being altered

message: partition number string : sum of PCTUSED and PCTFREE may not exceed 100
