message: invalid syntax in the alias path after ' string '
cause: An invalid alias/directory name syntax was specified.
solution: Correct the alias path and try again.

message: entry ' string ' does not exist in directory ' string '
cause: The specified alias did not exist in the given directory.
solution: Correct the alias path and try again.

message: cannot create alias for diskgroup metadata file ' string '
cause: An attempt was made to create an alias for a diskgroup metadata file.
solution: Correct the alias path and try again.

message: file ' string ' already has an alias associated with it
cause: An attempt was made to create an alias for a file that already had an existing alias.
solution: Correct the file name and try again or drop existing alias.

message: cannot operate on system aliases
cause: An attempt was made to modify a system alias.
solution: Correct the alias name and try again.

message: directory ' string ' is not empty; cannot drop this directory
cause: An attempt was made to drop a directory that contained valid entries.
solution: Correct the directory path or specify the FORCE option to drop a directory that is not empty.

message: missing or invalid alias name
cause: The command did not specify a valid alias identifier.
solution: Specify a valid alias identifier.

message: could not open dynamic library string , error [ string ]
cause: The library was not accessible
solution: Correct the permissions of the library and try again.

message: symbol [ string ] not found in library string , error [ string ]
cause: An error was encountered while loading the specified ASMLIB symbol.
solution: Correct the error reported and try again.

message: ASMLIB [ string ] version mismatch, ORACLE version [ string ]
cause: The ASMLIB version reported is not supported by the ORACLE binary.
solution: Install the correct library and try again.

message: ASMLIB initialization error [ string ]
cause: Unable to initialize the ASMLIB in ORACLE.
solution: Contact ASMLIB library vendor support with the error details.

message: ASMLIB error could not be determined [ string ] [ string ]
cause: An error was encountered which cannot be diagnosed further.
solution: Contact ASMLIB libary vendor for support.

message: could not close dynamic library string , error [ string ]
cause: Could not close the dynamic library.
solution: Contact ASMLIB libary vendor for support.

message: ASMLIB error function = [ string ], error = [ string ], mesg = [ string ]
cause: An error occured during a call to function listed in the error.
solution: The detailed message associated with the error is listed along with the error. Correct the error and try again or contact ASMLIB library vendor for support.

message: Incompatible RDBMS operation [ string ] pushed to storage
cause: RDBMS to storage version mismatched with incompatibility operation.
solution: Upgrade RDBMS to match storage version.

message: process terminated due to an ASMLIB error
cause: A process was terminated as a result of an ASMLIB error.
solution: See the alert log for more information. Reconnect to the database or the ASM instance. If the process termination resulted in instance termination, restart the instance.

message: invalid ASM disk header [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: ASM encountered an invalid disk header.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid ASM block header [ string : string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string != string ]
cause: ASM encountered an invalid metadata block.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: suppressing string additional ASM messages
cause: The ASM command generated so many erorrs that this summary message was reported in place of many individual messages.
solution: If the command contained multiple actions, try separating each action into its own command and executing each command by itself. Otherwise, try not to generate so many errors.

message: operation string is not yet available
cause: An unimplemented operation was attempted.
solution: Consider upgrading to later releases as they become available.

message: initialization parameter string ( string ) is not a power of two
cause: The value specified for this initialization parameter was not a power of two.
solution: Correct the initialization parameter value and restart the instance.

message: disk string contains a valid RDBMS file
cause: A disk specified in a CREATE DISKGROUP or ALTER DISKGROUP ... ADD DISK command appeared to contain a file from an existing database. By default, ASM will not allow a diskgroup to be created using this disk, as a safeguard against damaging an existing database.
solution: Check that the ASM disk specification is correct. Otherwise, when storage from a defunct database is reused as part of an ASM diskgroup, specify the FORCE option to the ASM SQL command.

message: cannot create additional ASM internal change segment
cause: The mount of a diskgroup by an additional instance in a RAC cluster required more space for internal use by ASM than was available in the diskgroup.
solution: Delete unused files from the diskgroup or add additional disks to the diskgroup and retry the operation.

message: diskgroup string contains disks from an incompatible version of ASM
cause: Diskgroup was created by an ASM instance with a higher compatibility setting.
solution: Use an ASM instance with the appropriate software version to mount the diskgroup.

message: database version string is incompatible with diskgroup string
cause: The database compatibility of the diskgroup was advanced to a later version.
solution: Upgrade the database instance to appropriate version of ORACLE.

message: requested mirror side unavailable
cause: The requested mirror side of a block is either unallocated or allocated on a disk that has been dropped from the diskgroup.
solution: Resubmit the request or try another mirror side.

message: duplicate diskgroup string specified
cause: A command specified the same diskgroup twice.
solution: Specify each diskgroup only once.

message: conflicting or duplicate PERMISSION options
cause: The PERMISSION clause contained the USER, GROUP, or OTHER keyword more than once.
solution: Specify each keyword, at most, once.

message: conflicting or duplicate OWNERSHIP options
cause: The OWNERSHIP clause contained either the OWNER or the GROUP keyword more than once.
solution: Specify each keyword, at most, once.

message: missing or invalid OWNER or GROUP name
cause: The command did not specify a valid name for either the OWNER or the GROUP keyword.
solution: Specify a valid name for either the OWNER or the GROUP keyword.

message: command operates on only one attribute
cause: More than one disk group attribute was specified in the ALTER DISKGROUP statement.
solution: Specify only one disk group attribute per ALTER DISKGROUP statement.

message: missing or invalid attribute specification
cause: The command did not specify a valid attribute name or a valid attribute value.
solution: Specify a valid attribute name and value pair.

message: missing or invalid user name
cause: The command did not specify a valid user name.
solution: Specify a valid user name.

message: missing or invalid user group name
cause: The command did not specify a valid user group name.
solution: Specify a valid user group name.

message: missing or invalid timeout value after DROP AFTER
cause: The command did not specify a valid timeout value after the DROP AFTER clause.
solution: Specify a valid timeout value after the DROP AFTER clause.

message: timeout value exceeded range
cause: The OFFLINE timeout value exceeded the range of 0-136 years, inclusive. 136 years are 49674 days, 1192176 hours, and 71530560 minutes.
solution: Specify a timeout value within the range of 0-136 years, inclusive.

message: conflicting or duplicate disk region options
cause: The command contained one or more of the following: - both the HOT and the COLD keywords - both the MIRRORHOT and the MIRRORCOLD keywords - the HOT keyword more than once - the COLD keyword more than once - the MIRRORHOT keyword more than once - the MIRRORCOLD keyword more than once
solution: Specify either the HOT or the COLD keyword and either the MIRRORHOT or the MIRRORCOLD keyword, at most, once.

message: invalid file attribute specification
cause: The keyword UNPROTECTED, MIRROR, HIGH, FINE, or COARSE was specified in a MODIFY FILE clause. These file attributes are immutable once a file is created.
solution: Specify a disk region keyword; for example, HOT, COLD, MIRRORHOT, or MIRRORCOLD.

message: ASM operation requires compatible.asm of string or higher
cause: The ASM operation specified requires a higher disk group attribute value for compatible.asm.
solution: Set the disk group attribute compatible.asm to or above the requested version.

message: diskgroup ' string ' does not require the FORCE option
cause: An attempt was made to MOUNT or DROP a disk group with the FORCE option.
solution: MOUNT and DROP diskgroup with the FORCE option are only permitted if the diskgroup cannot be mounted normally.

message: advancing diskgroup compatibility would exclude connected clients
cause: Disk group compatibility could not be advanced because connected clients were at a lower compatibility than the target value.
solution: Make sure all connected clients are at target compatibility level or higher.

message: cannot advance diskgroup compatibility due to offline disks
cause: Disk group compatibilty could not be advanced because some disks are offline.
solution: Retry the command after offline disks are dropped.

message: cannot advance diskgroup compatibility due to [ string ]
cause: Disk group compatibilty could not be advanced because of errors.
solution: Check the alert log for more information on the reason for the failure.

message: target RDBMS compatibility ( string ) exceeds ASM compatibility ( string )
cause: An attempt was made to advance RDBMS compatibility beyond the disk group's ASM compatibility.
solution: Advance ASM compatibility before advancing RDBMS compatibility.

message: diskgroup string mount mode conflicts with existing mount
cause: The mode specified in the diskgroup mount command conflicted with the mode in which it was mounted on some other instance.
solution: Specify a compatible mode in the diskgroup mount command.

message: diskgroup string mounted in restricted mode
cause: The specified diskgroup was mounted in restricted mode prohibiting client access.
solution: Dismount the diskgroup and remount it in appropriate mode.

message: attribute string cannot be set in CREATE DISKGROUP
cause: The specified attribute may not be set with the CREATE DISKGROUP command.
solution: Check the attribute name or use ALTER DISKGROUP SET ATTRIBUTE.

message: string is not a valid value for attribute string
cause: The specified value was not valid for the attribute.
solution: Check the attribute name and value.

message: allocation unit size higher than string requires RDBMS compatibility string
cause: The allocation unit size requested exceeded the limit imposed by the RDBMS compatibility setting.
solution: Use a smaller allocation unit size or specify a higher RDBMS compatibility setting.

message: attribute name string is invalid
cause: The attribute name was not valid or was not recognized.
solution: Check the attribute name.

message: attribute string is read only
cause: The attribute value is read-only and cannot be changed.
solution: None. The attribute value cannot be changed.

message: could not set attribute string
cause: An error occurred while setting the attribute.
solution: Look at the underlying error(s) on the error stack.

message: string is not a valid version number
cause: The given version number was invalid, or not valid in this context.
solution: Verify that the version number is valid and is appropriate for this command. Check for additional errors reported.

message: new compatibility setting less than current [ string ]
cause: The compatibility setting was invalid. The compatibility setting can only be advanced.
solution: Check the version number.

message: ASM disk string is already being brought online
cause: An attempt was made to bring online a disk that is already being brought online.
solution: Change the ONLINE statement to exclude the disk.

message: cannot bring ASM disk string both online and then offline in the same statement
cause: An attempt was made to bring the specified disk both online and offline in the same statement.
solution: Revise the statement to either bring the disk online or take the disk offline.

message: cannot specify both WAIT and NOWAIT options in the same statement
cause: An attempt was made to specify both WAIT and NOWAIT options in the same statement.
solution: Revise the statement and include at most one option.

message: ASM attributes feature not enabled
cause: The ASM attributes feature was not enabled.
solution: Advance disk group ASM compatibility to version 11.1.0 or newer.

message: could not locate ASM attribute string
cause: The specified attribute could not be accessed.
solution: Check the attribute name and examine underlying error(s) on the error stack.

message: insufficient diskgroup space for rebalance completion
cause: The command attempted to reduce the available diskgroup space below the current space used.
solution: Consult V$ASM_DISK to determine the space requirements for the diskgroup contents, and repeat the command after making the required storage available.

message: only restricted mount is allowed in the ASM instance
cause: The ASM instance was started in restricted mode, and an attempt was made to mount a diskgroup in non-restricted mode.
solution: Start the ASM instance in non-restricted mode and mount the diskgroup again, or mount the diskgroup in restricted mode.

message: user name ' string ' does not exist in OS user dictionary
cause: The specified user name was not a valid operating system user.
solution: Specify a valid operating system user.

message: user group name ' string ' exceeds limit of string characters
cause: The length of the specified user group name exceeded the maximum limit.
solution: Reduce the length of the user group name to a value within the limit.

message: user group ' string ' already exists in disk group
cause: The specified user group name already existed in the disk group.
solution: Specify a different user group name.

message: user group ' string ' does not exist in disk group ' string '
cause: The specified user group name did not exist in the disk group.
solution: Specify a valid user group name.

message: user ' string ' is already a member of user group ' string '
cause: The specified user was already a member of the specified user group.
solution: Specify either an alternate user or an alternate user group.

message: exceeded string number of members per user group
cause: The maximum number of members per user group was exceeded.
solution: Delete existing members of the user group to create space.

message: user group entry number must be between string and string , inclusive
cause: The specified user group entry number was beyond the acceptable range.
solution: Specify a valid value for the user group entry number.

message: user ' string ' is not a member of user group ' string '
cause: The specified user was not a member of the specified user group.
solution: Specify either an alternate user or an alternate user group.

message: permission denied on ASM disk group
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation on an ASM disk group without the appropriate privileges.
solution: Ask the ASM administrator to perform the operation or grant the required privileges.

message: user ' string ' already exists in disk group ' string '
cause: The specified UID already existed in the disk group.
solution: Specify a different UID.

message: user ' string ' does not exist in disk group ' string '
cause: The specified UID did not exist in the disk group.
solution: Specify a user with a valid UID.

message: user name ' string ' exceeds limit of string characters
cause: The length of the specified user name exceeded the maximum limit.
solution: Reduce the length of the user name to a value within the limit.

message: Operating system function returned error string
cause: An operating system error occurred.
solution: Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

message: user identification number not in range of [ string , string ]
cause: The operating system user identification number exceeded the maximum value.
solution: Change the user identification number to a value within the accepted range.

message: user identification number ' string ' is not allowed
cause: This user identification number is used internally by ASM.
solution: Please choose a different user identification number.

message: internal Oracle file string already exists.
cause: File was already in existence.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: group identification number not in range of [ string , string ]
cause: The operating system group identification number exceeded the maximum value.
solution: Change the group identification number to a value within the accepted range.

message: disk string is not a quorum disk
cause: The specified disk was not a quorum disk.
solution: Retry the operation without the quorum attribute for the disk.

message: failgroup string is a quorum failgroup
cause: The specified failgroup was a quorum failgroup.
solution: Retry the operation with the quorum attribute for the failgroup.

message: failgroup string is not a quorum failgroup
cause: The specified failgroup was not a quorum failgroup.
solution: Retry the operation without the quorum attribute for the failgroup.

message: Could not create the required number of voting files.
cause: The required number of voting files could not be created. See accompanying messages for possible causes.
solution: See accompanying messages for possible actions.

message: Not enough failgroups ( string ) to create voting files
cause: The number of failgroups required for this redundancy were not present in the diskgroup to create voting files.
solution: Retry the operation after creating new failgroup(s).

message: Not enough contiguous space ( string AUs) in disk string to allocate a voting file
cause: The specified disk did not have enough space to allocate a voting file on it.
solution: Ensure that there is at least 1 disk with the required space in atleast the required number of failgroups for the diskgroup.

message: ASM diskgroup string has cluster voting files
cause: An attempt was made to drop a diskgroup that contained cluster voting files.
solution: Move the cluster voting files out of the diskgroup and retry the operation.

message: disk string is a quorum disk
cause: The specified disk was a quorum disk.
solution: Retry the operation with the quorum attribute for the disk.

message: external redundancy diskgroup requires at least one regular disk
cause: An attempt was made to create an external redundancy diskgroup with only quorum disks.
solution: Specify atleast one regular disk to create an external redundancy diskgroup.

message: user ' string ' is currently being deleted
cause: The specified user was in the process of being deleted and could not be used.
solution: Either abandon this operation or specify a different user.

message: user ' string ' owns existing files
cause: An attempt was made to drop a user that still owns existing files.
solution: Specify the INCLUDING CONTENTS option to drop the user and all of the owned files.

message: not all specified disks were brought ONLINE
cause: Some of the disks specified either experienced I/O errors while being brought ONLINE, or were simultaneously brought OFFLINE or dropped in another session, or were full.
solution: Query V$ASM_DISK or use ASMCMD LSDSK to determine which disks were not brought ONLINE. Inspect any additional error messages and the alert log to determine the exact cause. If some of the disks failed, either fix the cause of the failures or drop the disks. If some of the disks are full, either free space in the disk group or add new disks to the diskgroup.

message: ASM disk " string " is not visible cluster-wide
cause: An ALTER DISKGROUP ONLINE command specified a disk that could not be discovered by one or more nodes in a RAC cluster configuration.
solution: Check operating system permissions for the device and the storage sub-system configuration on each node in the RAC cluster that cannot identify the disk.

message: ASM operation requires compatible.rdbms of string or higher
cause: The ASM operation specified requires a higher disk group attribute value for compatible.rdbms.
solution: Set the disk group attribute compatible.rdbms to or above the requested version.

message: ASM terminated ALTER DISKGROUP ONLINE
cause: None of the disks specified by ALTER DISKGROUP ONLINE could be brought ONLINE.
solution: Inspect additional error messages and the alert log to determine why the specified disks cannot be brought ONLINE.

message: disk ' string ' violates disk group attribute string
cause: Including the specifed disk would violate a restriction imposed by the specified disk group attribute.
solution: Retry the operation while omitting the offending disk or change the attribute.

message: could not set disk group attribute string due to offline disks
cause: The specified disk group attribute could not be set because the disk group includes offline disks.
solution: Retry the operation after the offline disks in this disk group are dropped or brought online.

message: could not set disk group attribute string due to incompatible disks
cause: The specified disk group attribute could not be set because the disk group includes disks that conflict with the new value.
solution: Retry the operation after dropping the conflicting disks in this disk group.

message: disk(s) require disk group attribute string clause
cause: Some of the disks specified by the command also require the specified disk group attribute to be stated.
solution: Retry the command including an ATTRIBUTE clause for the required disk group attribute. Alternatively, omit the disks that require setting the disk group attribue. See the alert log for additional information on the disks that require setting the disk group attribute.

message: ASM disk string cannot be resized beyond string M
cause: A resize disk command specified a size beyond the maximum allowed for this disk.
solution: Check alert logs from all ASM instances to identify the reason for the size limitation. If there are any 10g database instances using this disk group, shut down those instances and retry the resize operation.

message: operation not permitted on offline disk string
cause: An attempt was made to specify an operation that is only permitted on disks that are online. The specified disk was not online.
solution: Online the disk or wait for online to complete before retrying the operation.

message: ASM could not add disk " string " to disk group " string "
cause: An attempt was made to add a disk to a disk group while the distribution of disks in failure groups was too uneven.
solution: Add or drop disks to or from failure groups to balance their distribution in all failure groups and retry the operation.

message: Disk name string is being used by another disk
cause: The specified disk name could not be reused because an 11.1.0.6.0 or earlier database instance had it cached in memory.
solution: Do one of the following - Specify a different name for the disk. - Wait for the rebalance to complete successfully. - Identify the database instance with the problem and shut it down before retrying the command.

message: operation disallowed by ASM_POWER_LIMIT
cause: This operation required data movement in order to complete successfully. However, ASM_POWER_LIMIT was set to zero, thereby preventing this operation.
solution: Repeat the operation after setting ASM_POWER_LIMIT to a non-zero value.

message: SYSASM privilege not allowed on database instance
cause: The SYSASM privilege was not allowed on this database instance; it is allowed only on an ASM instance.
solution: Use either the SYSDBA or the SYSOPER privilege.

message: ASM instance software version string less than client version string
cause: The ASM instance software version was less than the client version.
solution: Upgrade the ASM instance software. Check the alert log for more information on the reason for the failure.

message: possible lost disk write detected during crash recovery
cause: ASM crash recovery read a block who's version was older than expected.
solution: None. End users will not see this error. ASM automatically traps this error and attempts a fallback recovery.

message: FINE striping not allowed for the Staleness Registry
cause: An SQL command attempted to set the striping attribute of the ASM_STALE template to FINE striping.
solution: Do not modify the striping attribute of the ASM_STALE template.

message: File string is incompatible with this operation
cause: The file type was incompatible with the operation.
solution: Use another file of the correct type.

message: cannot change string of the open file ' string '
cause: A SET OWNERSHIP or SET PERMISSION command was attempted on an open file.
solution: Close the file and retry the SQL command.

message: active use of files owned by user ' string ' precludes its drop
cause: A DROP USER command specified a user owning files that were in use.
solution: Close all files owned by this user.

message: Voting files could not be created in diskgroup string due to small Allocation Unit size
cause: An attempt was made to create voting files in a diskgroup with a small Allocation Unit size.
solution: Create voting files in a different diskgroup whose Allocation Unit size is at least 1 mega byte.

message: operation requires ACCESS_CONTROL.ENABLED attribute to be TRUE
cause: An attempt was made to run an operation that required the ACCESS_CONTROL.ENABLED attribute to be set to TRUE, but its existing state was FALSE.
solution: Set the ACCESS_CONTROL.ENABLED attribute to TRUE and retry the operation.

message: cannot operate on ASM internal files
cause: An attempt was made to operate on Automatic Storage Management (ASM) metadata used to manage the diskgroup.
solution: Check the specified ASM file name.

message: ASM password file update failed on at least one node
cause: A CREATE USER, ALTER USER, DROP USER, GRANT, or REVOKE command failed on at least one node of the Automatic Storage Management (ASM) cluster.
solution: Check the ASM alert logs for more information.

message: disk string not discoverable by CSS; diskgroup string has CSS voting files
cause: An attempt was made to add a disk which cannot be discovered by Cluster Synchronization Services (CSS). CSS has voting files in the disk group and will not be able to use the new disk if CSS cannot discover the disks.
solution: Update the Automatic Storage Management (ASM) disk string in the Grid Plug and Play (GPnP) profile to include the specified disk and retry the operation. Alternatively, migrate the CSS voting files out of the diskgroup and retry the operation

message: could not access ASM SPFILE in RDBMS instance
cause: A relational database management system (RDBMS) instance attempted to access an Automatic Storage Management (ASM) SPFILE.
solution: Connect to an ASM instance and reissue the command. Alternatively, specify an RDBMS SPFILE.

message: could not access database SPFILE in ASM instance
cause: An Automatic Storage Management (ASM) instance attempted to access a relational database management system (RDBMS) SPFILE.
solution: Connect to an RDBMS instance and reissue the command. Alternatively, specify an ASM SPFILE.

message: process terminated due to signal
cause: A process was terminated as a result of a signal in the I/O path.
solution: Reconnect to the database or the ASM instance. If the process termination resulted in instance termination, restart the instance.

message: process terminated due to fenced I/O
cause: A process was terminated because it was fenced from doing any more I/Os.
solution: Reconnect to the database or the ASM instance. If the process termination resulted in instance termination, restart the instance.

message: invalid file type
cause: Automatic Storage Management (ASM) could not determine the type of file.
solution: The file specified is not supported with Automatic Storage Management (ASM). Specify a supported file type for the operation.

message: Write errors in disk group string could lead to inconsistent ASM metadata.
cause: One or more failures occurred while writing ASM metadata to disk.
solution: Repair the hardware problem and remount the disk group. Check the accompanying errors and alert log for the disks which reported the error.

message: Previous client instance string has not fully exited.
cause: One or more processes from a prior instantiation of this client were not fenced.
solution: Make sure all processes belonging to the client instance exited. Check the client alert log and the trace file of the process that terminated the instance.

message: disks in disk group string cannot be resized
cause: Execution of ASM Storage Reclamation Utility script was incomplete on the specified disk group.
solution: Execute ASM Storage Reclamation utility on the disk group to complete the operation.

message: cannot set attribute with connected clients
cause: The disk group attribute could not be set because there were connected clients.
solution: Shut down connected clients and retry the command. Query the V$ASM_CLIENT fixed view in an ASM instance or use ASMCMD LSCT to list active clients.

message: ASM password update has failed on local node
cause: A CREATE USER, ALTER USER, DROP USER, GRANT, or REVOKE command failed on the local node of the Automatic Storage Management (ASM) cluster.
solution: Check the ASM alert logs for more information.

message: requested operation is not allowed on the password file string
cause: An attempt was made to run an operation that is not supported on password files.
solution: Specify a new file name or a file with the correct file type and retry the operation.

message: file string is not a valid password file
cause: An attempt was made to open a file that had a type different from the password file.
solution: Specify correct password file name and retry the operation.

message: specified input string is a not an ASM file
cause: The attributes could not be obtained as the specified input is either a disk group or a directory.
solution: Specify a valid Automatic Storage Management (ASM) file name.

message: remote ASM is not enabled
cause: An operation was requested that requires remote ASM to be enabled.
solution: Enable remote ASM.

message: user identification string ' string ' exceeds limit of string characters
cause: The user identification string provided for this operation exceeded the maximum number of characters allowed.
solution: Provide a user identification string of shorter length.

message: cluster identification string ' string ' exceeds limit of string characters
cause: The cluster identification string provided for this operation exceeded the maximum number of characters allowed.
solution: Provide a cluster identification string of shorter length.

message: ASM user name format requires COMPATIBLE.ASM of string or higher
cause: The ASM user name format specified requires a higher disk group attribute value for COMPATIBLE.ASM.
solution: Set the disk group attribute COMPATIBLE.ASM to or above the requested version.

message: ASM proxy instance ORACLE_SID string does not start with string
cause: The ASM proxy instance was started with an invalid ORACLE_SID prefix.
solution: Start the ASM proxy instance with an ORACLE_SID that begins with the correct prefix.

message: ASM proxy instance cannot connect to an ASM server
cause: The ASM proxy instance could not find an ASM server to connect to during startup.
solution: Verify that an ASM server instance is running and accessible in the cluster and restart the proxy instance.

message: disk is not visible on client instance
cause: An ALTER DISKGROUP ADD DISK statement specified a disk that could not be discovered by all ASM client instances.
solution: Check the ASM alert logs for more information. Check operating system permissions for the device and the storage subsystem configuration.

message: VUBG process terminated with error
cause: The volume background process terminated with error.
solution: Warm start instance.

message: ASM metadata corruption detected in disk group ' string '
cause: A corruption was detected reading a block. It may be recoverable.
solution: The corruption could be the result of a storage problem, a configuration issue, or a software bug. Check the alert log for the result of the recovery attempt. If unsuccessful, contact Oracle Support Services with the incident information.

message: not running on supported ASM appliance
cause: An attempt was made to initialize the server code as an appliance when it was not running a supported appliance configuration.
solution: Check the appliance configuration and retry the operation.

message: command not supported on ASM appliance ' string '
cause: An attempt was made to run an operation that is not supported by the specified appliance.
solution: Check the documentation to see which operations are allowed or disallowed for the specified appliance.

message: insufficient number of disks to support ASM appliance ' string '
cause: An attempt was made to do an operation that resulted in insufficient number of disks required for the specified appliance.
solution: Check the appliance configuration and retry the operation after inserting disks in the appropriate slots.

message: unable to read an ASM appliance configuration file
cause: Oracle ASM was unable to read an appliance configuration file.
solution: Check the operating system error messages to determine the identity of the configuration file. Then, fix the configuration file.

message: Oracle ASM could not add disk " string " to disk group " string " on appliance string
cause: There were too many dropping or offline disks in the specified disk group.
solution: Wait for the drop and rebalance operations to complete, or online the offline disks and wait for the online to complete. Then, retry the operation.

message: Slot string in Oracle ASM appliance ' string ' contains more than one disk
cause: An attempt was made to add a disk to a slot in the ASM appliance that already had a disk (possibly OFFLINE) associated with it.
solution: Use FORCE to drop the disk that exists in the specified slot. Then, retry the operation.

message: All disks in disk group string are not of the same type.
cause: An attempt was made to add disks of a different type to the disk group under appliance mode.
solution: Check if all the disks in the disk group are of the same type. Do not add flash and hard disks to the same disk group.

message: Disks in disk group string do not have equal size.
cause: The disks in the disk group were not of equal size.
solution: Ensure that all disks in the disk group are of equal size. If adding new disks to the disk group, their size must be equal to the size of the existing disks in the disk group. If resizing, all disks in the disk group must be resized to the same size.

message: Failure groups in disk group string have different number of disks.
cause: An attempt was made to enable appliance mode with a different number of disks in each failure group.
solution: Check if all failure groups have an equal number of disks and try again.

message: Operation on disk group string is incompatible under appliance mode.
cause: An attempt was made to do an operation that resulted in dropping all disks in a failure group or creating a new failure group.
solution: Disable appliance mode, perform the operation and reenable appliance mode. WARNING: To reenable appliance mode, ensure the following constraints are met: * There are a sufficient number of disks in each failure group. * All failure groups have an equal number of disks. * There are no offline disks in the disk group. * Every disk in the disk group is of the same type (flash or hard disk). * All disks in the disk group have an equal size.

message: Appliance mode is disabled.
cause: Appliance mode could not be set because it was explicitly disabled.
solution: Enable appliance mode and appliance partnering parameters.

message: Appliance mode requires at least string failure groups and either string or string disks in all failure groups.
cause: Appliance mode could not be enabled because it did not meet the minimum requirements.
solution: Check if there are sufficient failure groups and a sufficient number of disks in each failure group.

message: could not retrieve appliance properties for disk group string
cause: Some of the appliance properties were invalid. This could be due to a cell software downgrade after setting the 'appliance.mode' attribute.
solution: Check the cell software on all of the cells or disable appliance mode.

message: ASM disk string in disk group string is offline.
cause: An offline disk prevented the current ADD or DROP operation.
solution: Drop the offline disk or online the offline disk or disable appliance mode.

message: invalid volume name specifier
cause: The volume name specified was invalid
solution: Specify a valid volume name.

message: missing or invalid volume size specifier
cause: The volume size specified was invalid.
solution: Specify a valid volume size.

message: missing or invalid stripe width specifier
cause: The volume stripe width specified was invalid.
solution: Specify a valid volume stripe width.

message: invalid STRIPE_COLUMNS specifier
cause: An ADD VOLUME command did not specify a valid number of stripe columns.
solution: Specify a valid number of stripe columns.

message: ALTER DISKGROUP ALL cannot use single volume names
cause: An ALTER DISKGROUP ALL command specified a single volume or a list of volumes
solution: Use the ALL keyword when specifying volumes on multiple diskgroups.

message: FORCE option cannot be used when specifying ALL volumes
cause: The FORCE option was used to disable ALL volumes.
solution: Use FORCE option to disable one volume at a time.

message: missing or invalid volume usage specifier
cause: The command did not specify a valid volume usage string.
solution: Specify a valid volume usage string with alphanumeric characters.

message: first letter of the volume name is not alphabetic
cause: A volume name was specified with a nonalphabetic first character.
solution: Set the first character of the volume name to be alphabetic.

message: invalid character in volume name
cause: A volume name was specified with an invalid character.
solution: Use a volume name with only alphanumeric characters.

message: STRIPE_WIDTH of string is not a power of two
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_WIDTH that was not a power of two.
solution: Select a STRIPE_WIDTH that is a power of two; for example, 4K, 8K, etc.

message: volume name ' string ' is already in use
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a volume name that was already used by another volume.
solution: Select a different name for the volume.

message: STRIPE_WIDTH of string bytes is less than the minimum of string bytes
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_WIDTH that was too small.
solution: Select a larger STRIPE_WIDTH.

message: STRIPE_WIDTH of string bytes is greater than the maximum of string bytes
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_WIDTH that was too large.
solution: Select a smaller STRIPE_WIDTH.

message: volume size of string K is less than the minimum of string M
cause: The volume size specified was too small.
solution: Select a larger volume size.

message: STRIPE_COLUMNS of string is greater than the maximum of string
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_COLUMNS that was that was too large.
solution: Select a smaller STRIPE_COLUMNS value.

message: STRIPE_COLUMNS of string is less than the minimum of string
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_COLUMNS that was too small.
solution: Select a larger STRIPE_COLUMNS value.

message: volume name ' string ' does not exist
cause: The command specified a volume name that does not exist.
solution: Ensure a valid volume name is used.

message: volume operation is already in progress
cause: Another command was currently operating on a volume.
solution: Wait a short time before retrying the command.

message: volume ' string ' in diskgroup ' string ' is currently being accessed
cause: An attempt was made to communicate with the volume driver. The volume was being accessed by another application and, therefore, could not be changed.
solution: Shut down all applications that might be accessing this volume and then retry the command.

message: VBG process terminated with error
cause: A volume background process terminated with error.
solution: Wait for process to restart.

message: VDBG process terminated with error
cause: The volume driver background process terminated with error.
solution: Warm start instance.

message: volume redundancy incompatible with diskgroup redundancy
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a volume redundancy that was incompatible with the diskgroups redundancy.
solution: Specify a valid volume redundancy. A volume cannot have external redundancy with a high redundancy diskgroup. Also, a volume cannot have high redundancy with an external redundancy diskgroup.

message: volume library cannot be loaded. Platform may not support volume creation.
cause: The volume library could not be loaded. Either the platform does not support volume operations, or there is a problem with the library.
solution: Ensure that the platform supports volumes. If the platform does support volumes, check the alert log for library loading failure information.

message: access to a volume's storage through an unsupported interface
cause: An attempt was made to access or modify a volume's storage through an unsupported interface.
solution: Use supported interfaces for access to volume devices.

message: volume name is greater than string characters
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a volume name that was too long.
solution: Select a smaller volume name.

message: usage string is greater than string characters
cause: The usage string specified was too long.
solution: Select a smaller usage string.

message: ACFS volumes must be resized with the 'acfsutil size' operating system command.
cause: An attempt was made using SQL to resize an ADVM volume that contains an ACFS file system.
solution: Use the 'acfsutil size' operating system command to resize the volume.

message: cannot communicate with the volume driver
cause: An attempt was made to communicate with the volume driver.
solution: Check that the ASM volume driver is loaded. If so, check the alert log to identify the reason for failure and take necessary action to prevent such failures in the future.

message: ACFS process terminated with error
cause: The ACFS background process terminated with error
solution: Wait for process restart

message: ASM diskgroup does not support volumes
cause: Volumes were not supported. A common example is having disks, such as NFS, in the diskgroup that are not supported by volumes.
solution: Remove unsupported disks in the diskgroup.

message: error reported in the ASM volume driver
cause: An error was reported in the ASM volume driver.
solution: Check the operating system log files to identify the reason for the failure and take necessary action to prevent such failures in the future.

message: missing or invalid volume mountpath specifier
cause: A invalid volume mountpath string was specified.
solution: Specify a valid volume mountpath string with alphanumeric characters.

message: failed to create/remove device file for volume string on diskgroup string
cause: Improper driver installation.
solution: Check the alert log for device file creation failure information. Reload the driver using the supported installation method.

message: volume driver version is not compatible with the ASM instance
cause: The version of the ASM volume driver was not supported by ASM.
solution: Update the volume driver or the ASM instance.

message: volume ' string ' contains string error(s)
cause: Errors were returned by the ALTER DISKGROUP CHECK VOLUME command.
solution: See the alert log for details of the errors.

message: number of volumes in diskgroup exceeds the maximum of string
cause: A volume was added on a diskgroup that already contained the maximum number allowed.
solution: Remove volumes on the diskgroup.

message: internal error while altering volume
cause: An internal ASM error occurred while altering a volume.
solution: See the alert log for details of the error.

message: cannot shutdown the ASM instance with an open ASM volume
cause: One or more ASM volumes were found to be open during shutdown.
solution: Close the ASM volume and retry the shutdown.

message: volume string is open on instance string
cause: ASM volume was not closed prior to instance termination on node specified.
solution: Close the ASM volume either via unmount or node restart and retry the operation

message: conflicting volume already open on this node
cause: An ASM volume was not closed prior to instance shutdown on node specified. It is conflicting with the volume that is to be enabled.
solution: Close the ASM volume either via unmount or node restart and retry the operation.

message: not all instances could add/drop the volume
cause: The ASM volume cannot be added/dropped on all instances.
solution: See the alert log for the reason the volume could not be added/droped.

message: volume redundancy conflicts with disk region options
cause: Non-mirrored volumes erroneously contained the MIRRORHOT or MIRRORCOLD keyword.
solution: Remove the MIRRORHOT or MIRRORCOLD keywords from non-mirrored volumes.

message: command or option incompatible with ASM volumes
cause: An attempt was made to use a feature which is not compatible with existing ASM volumes. A common example is adding a disk to the diskgroup that is unsupported by ASM volumes.
solution: Omit the option from the command.

message: target ADVM compatibility ( string ) exceeds ASM compatibility ( string )
cause: An attempt was made to advance ADVM compatibility beyond the disk group's ASM compatibility.
solution: Advance ASM compatibility before advancing ADVM compatibility.

message: compatible.advm must be string or higher
cause: An attempt was made to set the ADVM compatibility to a version that was lower than the minimum supported.
solution: Set ADVM compatibility to at least the minimum supported version.

message: ASM operation requires compatible.advm of string or higher
cause: The ASM operation specified required a higher disk group attribute value for compatible.advm.
solution: Set the disk group attribute compatible.advm to or above the requested version.

message: volume size is greater than the maximum of string T
cause: The volume size specified was too large.
solution: Select a smaller volume size.

message: diskgroup uses a sector size that is incompatible with volumes
cause: The diskgroup used a sector size that was not 512 bytes.
solution: Create the volume in a diskgroup with a sector size of 512 bytes.

message: Volume name ' string ' would collide with existing volume(s) ' string string '.
cause: A volume name was specified that would conflict with existing volume device(s). A volume '<vol_name>-<dg_num>' is the name of the block device. Additionally, a raw device named 'r<vol_name>-<dg_num>' is also created. Since that name already existed, a name collision occurred.
solution: Choose another name for the volume (no leading 'r' is recommended).

message: cannot start workload capture on instance string
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to start the workload capture.
solution: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

message: cannot stop workload capture on instance string
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to stop the workload capture.
solution: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

message: cannot startup instance when procedures in "DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE" or "DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY" are in the middle of their execution
cause: The new instance could not be started because the database was executing a procedure in either the DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE or DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY package.
solution: Start the new instance after such procedures in the given packages have finished execution.

message: cannot start workload capture because instance string not present in RESTRICTED SESSION mode
cause: The NO_RESTART_MODE option in DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE.START_CAPTURE was FALSE, therefore all the active instances were expected to be in the RESTRICTED SESSION mode.
solution: Start all instances using STARTUP RESTRICT or execute ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RESTRICTED SESSION on all active instances before issuing DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE.START_CAPTURE.

message: cannot start workload capture because instance string encountered errors while accessing directory " string "
cause: Given instance could not access the specified CAPTURE directory or the specified CAPTURE directory already had a workload capture in it.
solution: Provide a directory object that is valid, empty and accessible from all the instances in the database cluster.

message: cannot prepare instance string for replay
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to prepare for a workload replay.
solution: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

message: cannot start workload replay on instance string
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to start a workload replay.
solution: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

message: cannot cancel workload replay on instance string
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to cancel a workload replay.
solution: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

message: workload replay has been cancelled
cause: Workload replay was cancelled.
solution: Restart the workload replay.

message: cannot perform operation when "STATISTICS_LEVEL" is "BASIC"
cause: The STATISTICS_LEVEL initialization parameter was set to BASIC.
solution: Change the STATISTICS_LEVEL initialization parameter setting to either TYPICAL or ALL.

message: cannot process workload capture because no user sessions were recorded
cause: No user sessions were recorded in the given workload capture. Processing this capture failed because no user workload was captured.
solution: Capture a workload in which at least one user session connects and performs some operations.

message: directory " string " does not contain a valid processed workload capture
cause: One or more files created by DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PROCESS_CAPTURE were missing.
solution: Process the workload capture using DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PROCESS_CAPTURE and then retry the command.

message: cannot access the input directory
cause: Given input directory is either invalid or inaccessible.
solution: Verify that the input directory is valid and accessible and then retry the command.

message: cannot find a match for the remote procedure call during replay
cause: The corresponding PL/SQL program was either dropped or modified.
solution: Verify that the corresponding PL/SQL program is defined the same way during replay as it was defined during workload capture.

message: error while replaying remote procedure call: " string . string . string "
cause: Error encountered during the replay of a remote procedure call.
solution: Correct the cause of the preceding error and restart workload replay.

message: parallel preprocessing worker hit error ORA- string
cause: One of the parallel preprocessing workers died unexpectedly while processing the workload.
solution: Find the root cause or simply preprocess the workload using only one process.

message: cannot start parallel preprocessing worker
cause: One of the parallel preprocessing workers could not be started.
solution: Find the root cause or simply preprocess the workload using only one process.

message: parallel preprocessing encountered an unexpected error
cause: An unexpected error occured during parallel preprocessing.
solution: Find the root cause or simply preprocess the workload using only one process.

message: cannot access database link " string " because it is disabled
cause: For security considerations, access to external databases via database links were disabled during workload replay.
solution: Use advanced parameter for Database Replay to enable database links during workload replay.

message: Directory is corrupted. Two WMD files are found at " string " and " string "
cause: Two WMD files were found in the directory.
solution: Check that the WMD files in capture directory were not modified, moved, duplicated or deleted.

message: failed to create file " string " during workload processing
cause: An attempt was made to create a file during workload processing without the proper file permissions.
solution: Correct the file permissions and try again.

message: failed to generate a workload capture subset: " string "
cause: An attempt to generate a workload capture subset failed. Possible reasons are included in the error message.
solution: Correct the issue and try again.

message: workload replay client cannot connect to database server
cause: The server connection identifier was invalid.
solution: Restart the client with correct server connection identifier.

message: workload replay client cannot login to database server
cause: 1) the replay client used an invalid username or password; 2) the replay user does not have the privilege to switch user; 3) the recorded username does not exist in the replay database.
solution: 1) restart replay client with correct username and password 2) grant user switching prvilege to the replay user 3) verify whether the replay database was restored properly

message: workload replay client cannot execute the DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY package
cause: Workload Replay Client's replay user did not have EXECUTE permission on the DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY package.
solution: Grant execute permission on the DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY package to replay user and restart the Workload Replay Client.

message: cannot start workload replay client because the database server is not in PREPARE mode
cause: The Workload Replay Client could not connect to the database server because the database server was not in the PREPARE mode.
solution: Put the database in PREPARE mode by using DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PREPARE_REPLAY, and restart the Workload Replay Client.

message: workload replay client encountered unexpected error: " string "
cause: Workload Replay Client encountered an unexpected error.
solution: Check the Workload Replay Client's log files and the database server alert log to diagnose the problem.

message: invalid input specified to the workload replay client
cause: Invalid input was specified.
solution: Use the Workload Replay Client's HELP=Y option to know more about valid input options.

message: workload replay client cannot access the replay directory or the database version do not match the preprocessing one
cause: The Workload Replay Client could not access the directory that contained the workload to be replayed, or the workload was preprocessed by a different version of the database.
solution: Restart the workload replay after specifying the correct replay directory, or preprocess it with the correct database.

message: replay thread encountered unexpected error
cause: A single replay thread got disconnected from the server due to an unexpected error.
solution: Check the Workload Replay Client's log files and the database server alert log to diagnose the problem.

message: workload replay client cannot open workload capture file
cause: The Workload Replay Client could not access one or more workload capture files from the replay directory.
solution: Restart the workload replay after copying all the workload capture files to the replay directory.

message: workload replay client cannot access the work directory
cause: The Workload Replay Client could not access the work directory to write log files for debug information.
solution: Restart the Workload Replay Client after specifying the correct work directory.

message: workload replay client cannot connect to the remapped connection with conn_id : string
cause: The specified connection is invalid or the specified host is inaccessible.
solution: Test the specified connection using other methods and redefine the connection remapping, if necessary. Consult the view DBA_WORKLOAD_CONNECTION_MAP to inspect connection remappings.

message: workload replay client cannot read the DBA_WORKLOAD_CONNECTION_MAP view
cause: The DBA_WORKLOAD_CONNECTION_MAP view did not exist or was not accessible.
solution: Re-create the workload capture and replay views. For additional information, see the documentation.

message: workload replay client cannot spawn new threads
cause: The Workload Replay Client does not have enough resource (CPU or memory) to spawn new threads.
solution: Restart the workload replay after allocating more resource (CPU and memory) to the Workload Replay Client or use more hosts as replay clients to drive the workload.

message: contents of the replay directory provided to the workload replay client do not match with the replay directory provided to the database server
cause: The processed workload capture files given to the workload replay client directory did not match the contents of the replay directory given as input to DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.INITIALIZE_REPLAY.
solution: Provide the same processed workload capture files to both the database server and all the workload replay clients and restart the replay. If the same workload capture files were processed more than once, provide a copy of the latest processed workload capture files to all the workload replay clients and the database server.

message: workload replay client cannot replay user call in the current version
cause: The workload replay client encountered a user call in the captured workload that was not supported for replay in the current version.
solution: Look in the DBA_WORKLOAD_REPLAY_DIVERGENCE view for details about the call that encountered this error. Refer to the documentation for more details on the types of workload that are not supported in the current version.

message: replay user string encountered an error during a sanity check
cause: The replay user encountered an error when accessing internal objects for Database Replay or switching user.
solution: Set up the replay user appropriately at the replay database. Make sure the replay user can access SYS-owned objects and has BECOME USER privilege.

message: login of user string during workload replay failed with ORA- string
cause: The recorded user did not exist in the replay database or encountered other problems during log in.
solution: Check the returned error number and set up the recorded user appropriately at the replay database.

message: timeout encountered during the replay of a recorded user call
cause: The replay of a recorded user call was terminated since it was significantly slower than the workload capture.
solution: Find the root cause for the performance issue. Or, use DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY API to disable the timeout check if the replay is expected to be slower.

message: encountered incomplete workload capture files
cause: The captured workload contained one or more incomplete recording files. This can happen when the original workload capture's FINISH_CAPTURE command timed out while waiting for all the active sessions to close their workload capture files.
solution: Incomplete capture files will not interfere with the processing and replaying of the captured workload. This is simply a warning message to point out that some database calls might not have been recorded due to FINISH_CAPTURE command timing out. For a list of the incomplete files, check the alert log for lines containing DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PROCESS_CAPTURE after capture processing.

message: encountered corrupt workload capture files
cause: The captured workload contained one or more corrupt recording files.
solution: For a list of the incomplete files, check the alert log for lines containing DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PROCESS_CAPTURE after capture processing. The corrupt files will be replayed up to the point of the corruption. Alternatively, it is possible to remove the corrupt files and run DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PROCESS_CAPTURE again. In this case, no workload from the corrupt files will be replayed.

message: Invalid value specified for parameter " string "
cause: An invalid value was specified for the given parameter.
solution: Correct the value being specified for the parameter.

message: Parameter " string " cannot be NULL.
cause: An attempt was made to call a procedure without a required parameter.
solution: Specify a valid value for this parameter.

message: Action cannot be performed when database is in read-only mode.
cause: A procedure in DBMS_AUTO_TASK_ADMIN package was invoked when database was open in read-only mode.
solution: Retry when database is open in read/write mode.

message: Initialization parameters prevent client from being enabled.
cause: An attempt was made to enable a client that was disabled for automatic execution by an initialization parameter.
solution: Check the related client parameters and try again.

message: " string " is not a Maintenance Window
cause: Window name passed to DBMS_AUTO_TASK_ADMIN.ENABLE procedure must be a member of the MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_GROUP.
solution: Make the window a member of the MAINTENANCE_WINDOW_GROUP and retry the call.

message: SQL limit already reached by prior task execution
cause: An attempt was made to resume the execution of a task when the prior execution already reached the SQL limit.
solution: Task execution is complete. Examine the report to review Advisor's recommendations.

message: All "SQL Tuning Set(s)" with name like " string " and owner like " string " are empty
cause: An attempt was made to pack one or more SQL Tuning Sets, none * of which contained any statements.
solution: Check the input and try again.

message: duplicate values for plan line ID in input collection
cause: An invalid input was provided containing duplicate values for plan line IDs causing the load of the statement to fail.
solution: Check the input and try again.

message: invalid version number " number " for SQL tuning set staging table
cause: An invalid version number was provided for a staging table used to pack a SQL tuning set.
solution: Check the input and try again.

message: invalid name " string " for SQL Performance Analyzer task
cause: An invalid SQL Performance Analyzer task name was used.
solution: Check the name of the SQL Performance Analyzer task to ensure that it is correct.

message: parameter " string " not set for SQL Performance Analyzer task " string "
cause: Could not find the specified parameter name for the SQL Performance Analyzer task.
solution: Check that the specified parameter exists for the SQL Performance Analyzer task so that the parameter is set.

message: no COMPARE_PERFORMANCE execution exists for SQL Performance Analyzer task " string "
cause: Could not find an execution of type COMPARE_PERFORMANCE for specified SQL Performance Analyzer task.
solution: Ensure that the given SQL Performance Analyzer task has at least one execution of type COMPARE_PERFORMANCE.

message: specified execution name " string " is not a valid COMPARE_PERFORMANCE execution for SQL Performance Analyzer task " string ".
cause: The specified execution name was not a valid execution of type COMPARE_PERFORMANCE for the SQL Performance Analyzer task.
solution: Ensure that a valid COMPARE_PERFORMANCE execution name is used for the SQL Performance Analyzer task.

message: need to specify the object ID if the tuning task is on a SQL set.
cause: There could be multiple objects in the SQL tuning task. Specify which one.
solution: Add object ID to the interface.

message: The directory name is null.
cause: The directory name for finding the SQL traces was null.
solution: Create the directory.

message: The plan type is not valid.
cause: The specified plan type was not valid
solution: Check the existing plan types and specify the right one.

message: Missing EXECUTE privilege on DBMS_AUTO_SQLTUNE.
cause: The current user was missing the necessary privileges to execute the API.
solution: Grant the privilege and try again.

message: The previous Oracle Data Masking job is unfinished. " string " table is not empty.
cause: The previously executed Oracle Data masking job was not successfully completed.
solution: Execute Oracle Data masking cleanup.

message: database open for read-only access
cause: The database was opened for read-only access. Attempts to modify the database using DML or DDL statements generate this error.
solution: In order to modify the database, it must first be shut down and reopened for read/write access.

message: database already open for read-only access by another instance
cause: The database has been opened for read-only access by another instance, and cannot be opened for read/write access by this instance.
solution: This instance must be opened for read/write access, or all other instances must first be shut down and reopened for read-only access.

message: database already open for read/write access by another instance
cause: The database has been opened for read/write access by another instance, and cannot be opened for read-only access by this instance.
solution: This instance must be opened for read-only access, or all other instances must first be shut down and reopened for read/write access.

message: standby database is restricted to read-only access
cause: An attempt was made to open a physical standby database in read/write mode.
solution: Reissue the ALTER DATABASE OPEN specifying READ ONLY.

message: backup database required recovery
cause: The database could not be opened for read-only access by this instance because it requires recovery.
solution: Perform the necessary recovery and reopen for read-only access.

message: database requires recovery
cause: The database requires recovery, and therefore cannot be opened for read-only access by this instance.
solution: Perform the necessary recovery and reopen for read-only access.

message: invalid backup control file checkpoint
cause: The database could not be opened for read-only access because its control file did not contain a valid control file checkpoint.
solution: Open the database for read/write access to create a valid control file checkpoint. The database can then be opened for read-only access.

message: indeterminate control file checkpoint
cause: The control file for the database being opened for read-only access was created using the CREATE CONTROLFILE statement. Therefore, a control file checkpoint could not be calculated and the database could not be opened for read-only access.
solution: First, open the database for read/write access. This creates a valid control file checkpoint. Then, reopen the database for read-only access.

message: invalid redo transport destination
cause: The redo transport destination could not accept redo data because it was not a valid redo transport destination type.
solution: Verify that all redo transport destinations are either standby databases or downstream capture databases.

message: Remote File Server process is in Error state.
cause: The Remote File Server (RFS) process at the specified redo transport destination experienced an unrecoverable error and was unable to receive further redo data.
solution: Correct the problem at the redo transport destination.

message: database identifier mismatch
cause: The database identifier of a physical standby database did not match that of the primary database.
solution: Ensure that the database identifier of each physical standby database matches that of the primary database.

message: log string sequence# string does not need archiving
cause: An attempt was made to archive the named file manually, but the file did not require archiving. The file had previously been successfully archived.
solution: No action is required.

message: log string sequence# string not archived, no available destinations
cause: An attempt was made to archive the named log, but the archive was unsuccessful. The archival failed because there were no archive log destinations specified, or all destinations are in an error state.
solution: Verify that archive log destinations are specified or take the necessary step to correct any errors that may have occurred.

message: Log string sequence# string was not archived.
cause: An attempt was made to archive the named log to a destination, but the operation did not succeed because the destination was not in ARCHIVELOG mode.
solution: Enable ARCHIVELOG mode at all destinations and retry.

message: archived log for thread string sequence# string unavailable
cause: Redo apply timed out waiting for the requested archived log file.
solution: Verify that the primary database is still archiving redo data to the standby database and reissue the RECOVER STANDBY DATABASE command.

message: cannot use LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST without a primary archive destination
cause: The parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST was set to a non-NULL value when the primary archive destination was set to NULL explicitly.
solution: Set the primary archive destination to a valid non-NULL value.

message: cannot use string with LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n or DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST
cause: One of the following events caused an incompatibility: 1) Parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST was in use when a LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) parameter was encountered while fetching initialization parameters. 2) An ALTER SYSTEM ARCHIVE LOG START TO command was in effect when a LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter was encountered while fetching initialization parameters. 3) A LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter was in use when an ALTER SYSTEM command was used to define a value for either the LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST parameter. 4) Parameter DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST was in use when an attempt was made to use an ALTER SYSTEM or ALTER SESSION command to define a value for LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST.
solution: Eliminate any incompatible parameter definitions.

message: cannot use string with LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST
cause: One of the following events caused an incompatibility: 1) Parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST was in use when the specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) or DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST parameter was encountered while fetching initialization parameters. 2) Parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST was in use when an attempt was made to use an ALTER SYSTEM or ALTER SESSION command to define a value for the specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n or DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST parameter. 3) An ALTER SYSTEM ARCHIVE LOG START TO command was in effect when the specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter was encountered while fetching initialization parameters. 4) An ALTER SYSTEM ARCHIVE LOG START TO command was in effect when an attempt was made to use an ALTER SYSTEM or ALTER SESSION command to define a value for the specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter.
solution: Eliminate any incompatible parameter definitions.

message: fewer destinations available than specified by LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST
cause: The number of archive log destinations that could be used was less than the LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST parameter value.
solution: Either adjust the log archive destination parameters, or lower the value of LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST.

message: session string destination cannot be the same as session string destination
cause: An attempt was made to change the first specified archive log parameter using ALTER SESSION to have a destination value that duplicates the session-level destination value of the second specified archive log parameter.
solution: Specify a different session destination value for one of the LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameters.

message: LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST cannot be NULL because LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST is non-NULL
cause: An attempt was made to change parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST to NULL when parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST is non-NULL.
solution: Either set parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST to a non-NULL value, or set parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST to a NULL value.

message: system string destination cannot be the same as session string destination
cause: An attempt to change the first specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) parameter produced a destination that duplicates the session destination value of the second specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter. This error can occur when setting a non-NULL value with the ALTER SYSTEM command. Or, this error can occur when setting a NULL value with ALTER SESSION command, because then the associated system destination value may appear as a duplicate.
solution: Specify a different destination value for the first specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter.

message: parameter string cannot be parsed
cause: The value for the indicated LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) parameter could not be parsed. Common causes for this error are a misplaced equal sign, an unrecognized attribute, or an attribute that is missing a required value.
solution: Correct the value for the indicated LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter.

message: parameter string contains repeated or conflicting attributes
cause: The value for the specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) parameter contained either repeated attributes or attributes that conflicted with each other.
solution: Correct the value for the indicated LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter.

message: parameter string contains an invalid attribute value
cause: The value for the specified LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) parameter contained an attribute with an invalid value.
solution: Correct the value for the indicated LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter.

message: parameter string is missing a destination option
cause: The value for the indicated LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) parameter failed to include a destination option. A destination option is specified using either the LOCATION or SERVICE attrbute.
solution: Correct the value for the indicated LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter.

message: new string causes less destinations than LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST requires
cause: An attempt was made to change the indicated LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n or LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_STATE_n parameter (n = 1...31) to a value that reduces the number of archive log destinations to less than the specified LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST value.
solution: Either select different options for the LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n or LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_STATE_n parameters, or reduce the value for parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST.

message: cannot change LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST, no archive log destinations
cause: An attempt was made to change the LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST parameter when there are no archive log destinations.
solution: Define one or more log archive destinations using parameters LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST, LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST, or LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31). Then, change the value of parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST.

message: session specific change to the LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST parameter requires a LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n destination
cause: The following event caused an incompatibility: Parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST was in use when an attempt was made to change the LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST parameter with an ALTER SESSION command.
solution: Replace any LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST and LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST parameters with LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n (n = 1...31) parameters.

message: parameter string destination string exceeds string character limit
cause: The value for the specified parameter contained a destination string that is too long.
solution: Replace the destination value for the specified parameter with a character string that has a length below the limit specified in the error message.

message: parameter string destination string cannot be translated
cause: The value for the specified parameter contained a destination string that could not be translated.
solution: Use a valid destination string in the specified parameter.

message: parameter string destination cannot be the same as parameter string destination
cause: An attempt was made to change the first specified archive log parameter to have a destination value that duplicates the system-level destination value of the second specified archive log parameter.
solution: Specify a different value for one of the archive log parameters.

message: Recovery could not be started.
cause: Database recovery could not be started because the FROM and MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE clauses were both specifed when attempting to start recovery.
solution: Retry the command with either the FROM or MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE clause, but not both.

message: missing required keyword string
cause: The indicated keyword is required but was not specified.
solution: Correct the syntax and retry the command.

message: invalid CANCEL option
cause: A mode other than IMMEDIATE followed the CANCEL keyword in RECOVER MANAGED STANDBY DATABASE statement.
solution: Specify either nothing or IMMEDIATE following CANCEL.

message: user requested cancel of managed recovery operation
cause: The managed standby database recovery operation has been canceled per user request.
solution: No action is required.

message: RFS request version mismatch
cause: A request to archive a redo log to a redo transport destination failed because of an Oracle software version mismatch at the destination.
solution: Verify that a compatible version of Oracle software is running at the redo transport destination.

message: Destination archive log file is locked.
cause: The target archive log file was locked. This indicates that the file is being archived to another Remote File Server (RFS) process.
solution: Ensure that each remote redo transport destination uses a unique network service name.

message: Remote File Server fatal error
cause: The Remote File Server (RFS) process at a redo transport destination encountered a fatal error and was no longer available. Further redo transmission to this destination may not be possible.
solution: Refer to the appropriate RFS trace file located at the redo transport destination for details regarding the error encountered and take corrective action.

message: user requested cancel immediate of redo apply
cause: Redo apply was canceled immediately per user request. Processing of the current archive log file has been interrupted and, therefore, the database is in an inconsistent state.
solution: No action is required.

message: Redo apply has been canceled.
cause: Redo apply was canceled per user request or operation timeout.
solution: More specific messages will accompany this message.

message: Destination string attribute cannot be specified at session level.
cause: An attempt was made to modify a redo transport destination attribute using the ALTER SESSION command.
