message: replication parallel push watermark error
cause: An error occurred during parallel push while trying to update the high-water-mark information in system.def$_destination.
solution: None

message: obsolete procedure; drop objects and recreate using new master
cause: dbms_repcat.switch_mview_master is no longer supported.
solution: Drop the objects in the object group and recreate them using the new master.

message: could not find materialized view to be associated with " string "." string "
cause: Could not find materialized view associated with a trigger or index that is being pulled from the master site.
solution: Ensure that materialized view, master, and master index or trigger is registered as replicated objects.

message: the user is already the propagator
cause: The given user is already the current propagator.
solution: None

message: duplicate propagator
cause: More than one valid propagator exist.
solution: Unregister any duplicate propagator.

message: object " string "." string " of type " string " does not exist or is invalid
cause: The given name was null or misspelled, the given type was wrong, the object does not exist as a valid database object, or the object does not exist as a replicated object with the appropriate status.
solution: Ensure the object is valid in the database, is visible to the user, and, if appropriate, is a valid object in all_repobject.

message: database link " string " does not exist or has not been scheduled
cause: the database link does not exist in the schema of the replication propagator or has not been scheduled.
solution: Ensure that the database link exists in the database, is accessible and is scheduled for execution.

message: global name " string " does not match database link name " string "
cause: the database link name at the local node does not match the global name of the database that the link accesses.
solution: Ensure that global names is set to true and the link name matches the global name.

message: user name " string " at database link " string " does not match local user name " string "
cause: the user name of the replication administration user at the local node and the user name at the node corresponding to the database link are not the same. Symmetric replication expects the two users to be the same.
solution: Ensure that the user ID of the replication administration user at the local node and the user ID at the node corresponding to the database link are the same.

message: generation of replication support for " string "." string " is not complete
cause: Replication support for the specified object has not been generated or the generation process is not yet complete.
solution: Ensure that replication support has been generated for the object. Use DBMS_REPCAT.GENERATE_REPLICATION_SUPPORT() to generate replication support for the object.

message: invalid materialized view name " string "
cause: A null, misspelled, or badly formed materialized view name was given to dbms_mview.refresh.
solution: Provide a valid materialized view name to dbms_mview.refresh.

message: materialized view " string "." string " does not exist
cause: A materialized view name was given to dbms_mview.refresh that is not in sys.snap$ or its associated views.
solution: Provide a materialized view name that is in sys.snap$, all_mviews or user_mviews.

message: refresh was aborted because of conflicts caused by deferred txns
cause: There are outstanding conflicts logged in the DefError table at the materialized view's master.
solution: Resolve the conflicts in the master DefError table and refresh again after the table is empty. Alternatively, refresh with refresh_after_errors set to TRUE, which will proceed with the refresh even if there are conflicts in the master's DefError table. Proceeding despite conflicts can result with an updatable materialized view's changes appearing to be temporarily lost (until a refresh succeeds after the conflicts are resolved).

message: refresh group " string "." string " already exists
cause: Making a new refresh group when there is already a group of the same name in sys.rgroup$.
solution: Choose a diifferent refresh group name.

message: refresh group " string "." string " does not exist
cause: A refresh group name was given that is not in sys.rgroup$.
solution: Provide a refresh group name that is in sys.rgroup$ or dbs_rgroup.

message: refresh group number string does not exist
cause: A refresh group number was given that is not in sys.rgroup$.
solution: Provide a refresh group number that is in sys.rgroup$ or dbs_rgroup.

message: insufficient privileges on user " string "
cause: The caller is not the owner of the materialized view and does not have ALTER ANY MATERIALIZED VIEW privileges.
solution: Perform the operation as the owner of the materialized view or as a user with ALTER ANY MATERIALIZED VIEW privileges.

message: object name string must be shaped like "schema"."object" or "object"
cause: The object name (e.g., the rollback segment, the materialized view name, the refresh group) was incorrectly specified.
solution: Retry the operation with the object name properly specified (like "schema"."object" or "object")

message: this replication operation is not supported in a mixed configuration
cause: operation is not supported if the object group is replicated at a pre-V8 node.
solution: Ensure that all nodes of the replicated object group are V8.

message: could not find an unused refresh group number
cause: 1000 consecutive refresh group numbers, as defined by the rgroupseq number, were already used by rows in sys.rgroup$.
solution: Alter the sequence number to be within a legal unused range and destroy unneeded refresh groups.

message: materialized view " string "." string " is already in a refresh group
cause: A materialized view of the same name is already in a refresh group.
solution: Subtract the materialized view from the current refresh group and add it to its new refresh group, or combine the two refresh groups into a single refresh group.

message: materialized view " string "." string " is not in refresh group " string "." string "
cause: The specified materialized view is not in the specified refresh group.
solution: Try again with the proper materialized view and refresh group names.

message: master table's primary key columns have changed
cause: The master table's primary key constraint was modified after the primary key materialized view was created.
solution: Drop and recreate the primary key materialized view

message: table " string "." string " does not have a materialized view log
cause: The fast refresh can not be performed because the master table does not contain a materialized view log.
solution: Use the CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG command to create a materialized view log on the master table.

message: materialized view log for " string "." string " does not record rowid values
cause: A rowid materialized view is being fast refreshed, but the materialized view log does not record rowid information.
solution: Use the CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG...ADD ROWID command to begin recording rowid information in the materialized view log.

message: materialized view log for " string "." string " does not record the primary key
cause: A primary key materialized view is being fast refreshed, but the materialized view log does not record primary key information.
solution: Use the CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG...ADD PRIMARY KEY command to begin recording primary key information in the materialized view log.

message: table " string "." string " does not contain a primary key constraint
cause: The master table does not constaint a primary key constraint or the primary key constraint has been disabled.
solution: Create a primary key constraint on the master table or enable the existing constraint.

message: unknown materialized view type: string
cause: A fast refresh is being performed on a materialized view of an unknown or unsupported type.
solution: Check all_mviews and ensure that the materialized view being refreshed a valid materialized view.

message: cannot unregister the propagator who is currently in use
cause: The propagator is currently used in propagating replication RPCs.
solution: Try again later when there is no transaction active in propagating replication RPCs.

message: regenerate replication support before resuming master activity
cause: There are tables in the object group that require regeneration of replication support.
solution: Check the generation_status column in the all_repobjects view. Regenerate replication support for any table in the object group with a 'NEEDSGEN' status. Resume master activity.

message: interval must evaluate to a time in the future
cause: The parameter "interval" evaluates to a time earlier than SYSDATE.
solution: Choose an expression that evaluates to a time later than SYSDATE.

message: job number string is not a job in the job queue
cause: There is no job visible to the caller with the given job number.
solution: Choose the number of a job visible to the caller.

message: Oracle Server could not generate an unused job number
cause: Oracle Server could not generate a job number that was not used to identify another job.
solution: Retry the operation.

message: job number string is not positive
cause: The given job number is less than 1.
solution: Choose a positive integer.

message: materialized view " string "." string " at string not registered
cause: The specified materialized view has not be successfully registered at this site.
solution: Register the materialized view manually at either the master site or the materialized view site.

message: invalid materialized view identifier string
cause: The argument provided to dbms_mview.purge_mview_from_log is an invalid materialized view identifer or it does not identify an Oracle 8 fast refreshable materialized view or the materialized view has been already purged.
solution: If the materialized view is an Oracle 8 fast refreshable materialized view then provide purge_mview_from_log with its valid materialized view identifier.

message: deferred RPC queue has entries for string
cause: The requested action cannot be performed until the queue is empty for the given site/dblink
solution: Use dbms_defer_sys.push, dbms_defer_sys.purge_queue or dbms_defer_sys.delete_tran to empty the queue.

message: deferred purge queue argument string out of range
cause: Specified numeric argument to dbms_defer_sys.purge_queue is invalid.
solution: Fix the argument value and try again.

message: job associated instance number string is not valid
cause: A job is associated with an instance that is not running.
solution: Choose a running instance for job affinity, or set force parameter to TRUE.

message: argument " string " cannot be NULL or empty string
cause: The caller has provided an argument whose value cannot be NULL or the empty string.
solution: Check that the varchar2 value provided is not NULL or the empty string, and retry the call.

message: wrong state: string
cause: The routine was executed against a replicated object group that was in the wrong state.
solution: Make sure that the replicated object group is in the state given in the error message.

message: master site string already exists
cause: An attempt was made to instantiate a replicated object group at a master site that was already a part of the object group.
solution: If you were trying to add this site, do nothing because it already exists; otherwise, pick the name of another site, and re-run the routine.

message: executing against wrong master site string
cause: An attempt was made to execute the routine at a site that is different from the site specified in the argument of the routine.
solution: Provide an argument to the routine that correctly indicates the site against which the routine should be executing.

message: master site string not known for object group
cause: The site name given as an argument to a routine was not already known to the replicated object group.
solution: Execute the dbms_offline_og.begin_instantiation() routine to add a new site to the replicated object group.

message: cannot create an updatable ROWID materialized view with LOB columns
cause: The propagation of LOB data from materialized view sites to the master site requires a primary key on the replicated table. Thus updatable ROWID materialized views that contain LOB columns are not supported.
solution: Create a primary key materialized view instead of a ROWID materialized view. If the materialized view already exists, it can be converted to a primary key materialized view using the ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW DDL command.

message: missing template authorization for user
cause: The specified template authorization does not exist.
solution: Check the values for user name and refresh template name to ensure a valid row exists in the DBA_REPCAT_USER_AUTHORIZATIONS view.

message: template authorization already exists for user
cause: The specified user already has been authorized to use the specified refresh group template.
solution: Check the values for user name and refresh template name or query the DBA_REPCAT_USER_AUTHORIZATIONS view to ensure that the correct values were passed as parameters.

message: missing refresh group template
cause: The specified refresh group template does not exist.
solution: Verify that the refresh group template does not exist by querying the DBA_REPCAT_REFRESH_TEMPLATES view.

message: refresh group template already exists
cause: The specified refresh group template already exists.
solution: Verify that the refresh group template exists by querying the DBA_REPCAT_REFRESH_TEMPLATES view.

message: incorrect public template value
cause: The public template parameter is not 'Y', 'N' or NULL.
solution: Correct the value of the public template parameter. It must be 'Y','N' or NULL.

message: object does not exist for refresh group template
cause: The specified object does not exist in the refresh group template.
solution: Correct the object name and object type parameters. Check the DBA_REPCAT_TEMPLATE_OBJECTS view to verify the correct name and type of the object.

message: object already exists for the refresh group template
cause: The specified object already exists in the refresh group template.
solution: Change the object name and object type parameters. Query the DBA_REPCAT_REMPLATE_OBJECTS view to verify the correct name and type of the object.

message: missing template parameter
cause: The specified template parameter does not exist.
solution: Correct the template parameter value and execute the procedure again. Use the DBA_REPCAT_TEMPLATE_PARMS view to verify the name of the refresh group template and parameter name.

message: duplicate template parameter
cause: The template parameter already exists for the specified refresh group template.
solution: Correct the template parameter value and execute the procedure again. Use the DBA_REPCAT_TEMPLATE_PARMS view to verify the name of the refresh group template and parameter name.

message: missing template site
cause: The template site specified by the site name, user name and refresh group template name does not exist.
solution: Correct the invalid parameter and execute the procedure again. Use the DBA_REPCAT_TEMPLATE_SITES view to query the existing template sites.

message: duplicate template site
cause: The template site specified by the site name, user name and refresh group template name already exists.
solution: Correct the invalid parameter and execute the procedure again. Use the DBA_REPCAT_TEMPLATE_SITES view to query the existing template sites.

message: missing user parameter value
cause: The user parameter value specified by the user name, parameter name and refresh group template name does not exist.
solution: Correct the invalid parameter and execute the procedure again. Use the DBA_REPCAT_USER_PARMS view to query the existing user parameters.

message: duplicate user parameter value
cause: The user parameter value specified by the user name, parameter name and refresh group template name already exists.
solution: Correct the invalid parameter and execute the procedure again. Use the DBA_REPCAT_USER_PARMS view to query the existing user parameters.

message: missing user name
cause: The user specified by the user name parameter does not exist in the database.
solution: Correct an invalid user name or create the user in the master database. Use the DBA_USERS view to select the valid database users.

message: flavor already contains object " string "." string "
cause: The flavor already contains the specified object.
solution: Check that the specified object is correct. To add all columns of a table object, delete the object from the flavor and then add it again.

message: flavor string already defined for object group " string "." string "
cause: The given object group already contains a (possibly unpublished) definition of the specified flavor.
solution: Check the spelling of the flavor name. Check for an unpublished flavor of the desired name.

message: flavor string of object group " string "." string " is already published
cause: The given object group already contains a (published) definition of the specified flavor.
solution: Check the spelling of the flavor name.

message: requested operation is not supported on top flavor
cause: The TOP flavor has a NULL name and may not be directly defined or deleted.
solution: Supply the name of a flavor other than the TOP flavor or use dbms_repcat routines to implicitly change the TOP flavor.

message: flavor string not defined for object group " string "." string "
cause: The given object group does not contain a (published) definition of the specified flavor.
solution: Check the spelling of the flavor name. Ensure the flavor has been defined (and published) for the object group.

message: flavor string contains object " string "
cause: The given flavor contains the object to be dropped.
solution: Purge the flavor or choose another object to drop.

message: flavor string does not contain " string "
cause: The flavor does not contain the given object, column, or attribute.
solution: Either drop the flavor or choose a different object, column, or attribute.

message: invalid flavor ID string
cause: The given flavor ID is invalid.
solution: Make sure this flavor has been instantiated. If the flavor ID is outside the range (-2147483647, 2147483647), contact customer support.

message: inappropriate flavor string at string
cause: The given flavor at the given database prevents the operation from succeeding.
solution: Either change the database flavor or choose a different operation.

message: flavor string must contain " string "
cause: The flavor must contain the given object, column, or attribute.
solution: Either choose a different database flavor or ensure the object, column, or attribute is available.

message: missing value for column string in resolution method " string " for " string "." string "." string "
cause: before resolving conflicts, some values necessary resolving conflicts are not available, or after resolving conflicts, some values necessary for re-trying of the SQL are not available
solution: define appropriate flavors, provide necessary values through availability vector in USER FLAVOR FUNCTION for conflict resolution

message: flavor string in use at site string
cause: The given flavor cannot be deleted because it is being used at the given site.
solution: Change the flavor of the site, or unregister it if it is a materialized view site.

message: flavor incompatible with object " string "." string "
cause: An existing flavor includes the specified object with an incompatible type.
solution: Change the type of the object, or delete the flavor if it is not in use.

message: flavor lacks column string of " string "." string "
cause: The flavor includes some columns of an object group but not all the required columns.
solution: Change the flavor definition to include all required columns.

message: flavor already includes column string of " string "." string "
cause: The flavor includes the specified column which is being added.
solution: Check that the specified column is correct.

message: flavor requires missing object " string "." string "
cause: The flavor includes the specified object which does not exist
solution: Check that the specified object name is correct, and create the object if appropriate.

message: flavor lacks object " string "." string "
cause: The flavor does not include the specified object which is being dropped.
solution: Check that the specified object is correct.

message: missing string string
cause: The template is missing the object with the specified key.
solution: Add the object to the template.

message: string is different between templates
cause: The values for the specified columns are different in each template for the same key values.
solution: Correct the column values to make the templates the same.

message: invalid status
cause: The status should be DELETED, INSTALLING or INSTALLED. Any other status is invalid.
solution: Check that the specified status value is correct.

message: template not authorized for user
cause: The refresh template is private and the user has not been authorized to instantiate the template.
solution: Authorize the user to use the template.

message: materialized view " string "." string " must be atomically refreshed
cause: Non-atomic refresh is not supported for the specified materialized view.
solution: Set the value of the ATOMIC parameter to FALSE in the refresh procedure being used or remove the specified materialized view from the set of materialized views being refreshed.

message: replication RPC processing for " string "." string " is disabled
cause: The processing of replication RPCs for the object group that contains this object is disabled. This includes RPCs in the error queue.
solution: Processing of replication RPCs is disabled when the object group is being offline instantiated. Wait until offline instantiation is finished.

message: definition of " string "." string " has changed since generation of replication support
cause: The current columns in the specified table and their column types do not match the columns and column types when replication support was last generated.
solution: Regenerate replication support for the affected table. All flavors that include the specified table should be checked for validity. Types for any UDT columns should also be checked for validity.

message: key column string must be sent and compared
cause: The specified column is a key column and must be sent and compared during replication propagation.
solution: Make sure every key column is sent and compared.

message: cannot import from string to string
cause: This object was imported from a database with a different global name than the importing database.
solution: Only import this object into a database with the same global name.

message: unable to alter propagation mode for object group " string "." string "
cause: The propagation method of a materialized view object group can only be altered when no other object groups with the same master object group are sharing the materialized view site.
solution: Ensure that there are no other materialized view object groups at the local site with the same master object group.

message: object group " string " is already mastered at string
cause: There is at least one other materialized view repgroup at the local site with the same group name but a different master site.
solution: Ensure that all materialized view repgroups at the local site with the same group name have the same master.

message: Column string is not a top-level column of " string "." string ".
cause: The column is either not a top-level column or is not present in the table or materialized view.
solution: Ensure only valid top-level columns are used.

message: column string of " string "." string ": object types not allowed.
cause: The column is of Object Type.
solution: Ensure that all the columns are not of Object Type.

message: object " string "." string " not allowed in this operation.
cause: The specified operation does not support the given object.
solution: Do not invoke the operation for this object.

message: internal internet Application Server error: string
cause: An internal error occurred in internet Application Server.
solution: Report the error and other information to support.

message: Column group " string " must consist of a single numeric column only
cause: The column group doesn't contain only one numeric column.
solution: Use a column group containing a single numeric column.

message: object groups " string "." string " and " string "." string " do not have the same connection qualifier
cause: The specified two object groups do not have the same connection qualifier.
solution: Do not invoke the operation on the above object groups, or ensure they have the same connection qualifier.

message: propagation mode " string " for " string " is not allowed for this operation
cause: This operation does not support the specified dblink in the above propagation mode.
solution: Do not invoke the operation for this dblink, or change the propagation mode for this dblink.

message: duplicate entry " string "
cause: The specified value is duplicated in the parameter list.
solution: Remove duplicated entries in the parameter list.

message: extension request " string " with status " string " not allowed in this operation
cause: The specified operation is not allowed for the extension request with the specified status.
solution: Ensure the extension request has the appropriate status before retrying this operation.

message: no valid extension request at " string "
cause: The specified database does not have a valid extension request.
solution: Ensure there is a valid extension request in DBA_REPEXTENSIONS view before retrying this operation.

message: no new sites for extension request " string "
cause: There is no new site with the specified extension request.
solution: Ensure there is at least one new site in DBA_REPSITES_NEW view for this request before retrying this operation.

message: " string " is not a new site for extension request " string "
cause: The specified extension request does not include the specified site as a new site.
solution: Ensure the specified site is a new site for this extension request before retrying this operation.

message: too many rows for destination " string "
cause: The specified destination has too many rows in system.def$_destination table.
solution: Ensure the specified destination has at most two valid rows before retrying this operation.

message: serial propagation can not be used for " string "
cause: The sites involved may be in the process of adding a new site without quiescing.
solution: Check the def$_destination table for this destination and try parallel propagation.

message: can not change disabled status for " string " and " string "
cause: The disabled status for this site is set internally for synchronization during adding a new master without quiescing.
solution: Ensure adding a new master without quiescing finished before invoking this procedure.

message: repgroup name cannot be null
cause: The array of Repgroup names contains a null value.
solution: Ensure that the array of Repgroup names is dense and is not null terminated.

message: repgroups specified must have the same masters
cause: The Repgroup names specified do not have the same masters.
solution: Ensure that the Repgroup names specified have the same masters.

message: cannot switch master for a multi-tier materialized view repgroup " string "." string "
cause: An attempt was made to switch master for a materialized view repgroup when its parent repgroup is also a materialized view repgroup. This is not allowed.
solution: Drop and recreate the materialized view repgroup based on a proper parent repgroup.

message: refresh template cannot be instantiated for database with compatibilty equal to or less than 8.0
cause: Instantiation of a refresh template is not supported for database compatibility 8.0 or less.
solution: Be sure the database compatibility is 8.1 or above.

message: valid directory for offline instatiation is not specified
cause: An attempt was made to offline instantiate to a directory which is not specified or null.
solution: There are two ways to specify the directory: o As a parm offline_dirpath to the API o As an init.ora parm named utl_file_dir Make sure you have specified an appropriate directory in which the offline file can be created.

message: error occurred during IAS instantiation
cause: An attempt was made to instantiate a IAS site. Error occurred during IAS instantiation.
solution: See other errors on the error stack to look for the source of the problem. If the error still persists, contact Oracle Support.

message: columns added to table do not match list of columns to be added
cause: The list of columns passed as a parameter does not match the columns to be added to the table.
solution: Correct the DDL string or list of columns and rexecute.

message: Object " string "." string " is missing.
cause: The specified object does not exist.
solution: Check that the specified object is correct.

message: invalid or incorrect number of arguments
cause: The arguments passed to the online redefinition API were invalid or missing.
solution: Call the online redefinition API with the right number of valid arguments.

message: materialized views and/or their indices exist in the tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to drop a tablespace which contains materialized views and/or their indices.
solution: Drop the materialized views in this tablespace. Also, find indices belonging to materialized views in this tablespace and drop then. Then try dropping the tablespace.

message: site owner already exists in the template.
cause: Site owner for the template already exists.
solution: Do not create multiple siteowners for this template.

message: tables with different synchronization mechanisms are in the same group
cause: Tables belonging to the same replication group were specified to be cached with different synchronization mechanisms.
solution: Do not specify different synchronization mechanisms while caching tables belonging to the same replication group.

message: object " string "." string " can not be cached
cause: An attempt was made to cache an object which is not supported.
solution: Do not cache an object which is not supported.

message: missing column in materialized view container table " string "." string "
cause: After import, the materialized view container table has missing columns.
solution: Check if materialized view container table was imported correctly.

message: instantiating templates from multiple back ends is not allowed.
cause: An attempt was made to set a new non-null back end database for an iAS site.
solution: Call dbms_ias_configure.set_back_end_db procedure with null dblink. Then, call the same procedure with the new non-null dblink.

message: the object " string "." string " is not cached at the middle tier as expected.
cause: The object may have been dropped or renamed at the back end after dbms_ias_inst.start_ias_inst was executed.
solution: Check the validity of the object at the back end and retry the instantiation.

message: function or procedure string is not allowed to be invoked from this site.
cause: This function or procedure is restricted to the backend or middle tier site
solution: Connect to the proper site before calling this function or procedure.

message: cannot explicitly refresh a NEVER REFRESH materialized view (" string ")
cause: An attempt was made to explicitly refresh a NEVER REFRESH MV.
solution: Do not perform this refresh operation or remove the MV(s) from the list.

message: table " string "." string " currently being redefined
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table which is currently involved in an ongoing redefinition.
solution: Do not perform this redefinition operation on this table or wait till the ongoing redefinition of the table is completed.

message: Redefinition not defined or initiated
cause: An attempt was made to continue or complete a redefinition which was not defined or initiated.
solution: Define or initiate the redefinition before performing this operation.

message: tables do not match tables used while defining the redefinition
cause: An attempt was made to continue or complete a redefinition by providing different tables than those used while defining or initiating the redefinition.
solution: Repeat this operation and specify the same tables as those that were specified while defining or initiating the redefinition.

message: dependent object " string "." string " already registered
cause: An attempt was made to register an already registered dependent object to an ongoing redefinition.
solution: Do not attempt to register an already registered dependent object to an ongoing redefinition.

message: materialized view log on " string "." string " is in an inconsistent state
cause: There was an error while creating the materialized view log and the log is currently in an inconsistent state. A possible cause could be that schema redefinition has occurred on the master table while the log was being created. Another possible cause could be that there were DMLs being applied on the master table concurrently in another session at the time the materialized view log creation started and those DML transactions haven't committed even after a very long period of time.
solution: Drop the materialized view log and recreate it.

message: cannot create PROPAGATION, string already exists
cause: The propagate_name already exists.
solution: Drop the propagate_name usign DROP_PROPAGATEcommand or specify propagate_name.

message: PROPAGATION_NAME string does not exist
cause: Propagation does not exist.
solution: Query DBA_PROPAGATION view to find existing propagation_name

message: Invalid string process type string
cause: Specified GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process type is not valid.
solution: Specify either capture or apply.

message: string enqueue aborted due to low SGA
cause: An attempt to enqueue a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams message was aborted because ORACLE is running low on memory allotted.
solution: Either start consuming messages by enabling any GoldenGate, XStream or Streams propagation or apply which might be disabled. An alternative is to allot more memory to STREAMS, which can be done by increasing the streams_pool_size initialization parameter if one was defined or by increasing the shared_pool_size.

message: invalid value " string " for string parameter string
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid parameter value.
solution: Specify a valid value for the parameter. Check the documentation for valid parameter values.

message: invalid object string
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid object.
solution: Specify a valid object.

message: invalid column " string "
cause: An invalid column was specified in the column list.
solution: Check the columns in the object and specify the right column name.

message: invalid resolution column " string "
cause: An invalid column was specified as the resolution column. The resolution column must belong to the list of columns specified in the 'column_list' parameter.
solution: Check the columns in the column_list and specify the right resolution column name.

message: unable to find directory object for directory string
cause: There was no entry in ALL_DIRECTORIES corresponding to the specified directory.
solution: Grant to the current user appropriate privileges on either a new directory object or an existing directory object.

message: internal dbms_streams_tablespaces error: [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: Streams detected an erroneous result.
solution: Look for information in the session trace file and contact customer support.

message: tablespace " string " has more than one data file
cause: The specified tablespace had more than one data file and hence did not qualify as a simple tablespace.
solution: Choose a self-contained tablespace with a single data file, or use a procedure that supports any tablespace.

message: unable to find tablespace " string "
cause: Either the tablespace did not exist, or the current user did not have sufficient privileges on the tablespace.
solution: Grant appropriate privileges on the tablespace to the current user or choose a different tablespace.

message: Script string already exists
cause: A script for the specified invoking package already existed.
solution: Complete the previous invocation or drop the previous invocation before proceeding with the current invocation.

message: Script string does not exist
cause: The named script did not exist.
solution: Create the script.

message: Block number string does not exist for script string
cause: The specified block number did not exist for the script.
solution: Add the block or check the block number and reexecute.

message: Failure in executing block string for script string with string
cause: The execution of specified block failed.
solution: Check the error. Query DBA_RECOVERABLE_SCRIPT_BLOCKS to view the failed block. Rectify and rerun the block or script.

message: Block string for script string has already been executed
cause: The specified block was already executed.
solution: Check the block number and reissue the command.

message: Generation of script string is not complete.
cause: Script generation for the specified script was not completed in a prior invocation.
solution: Purge the specified script by calling the RECOVER_OPERATION API in the package DBMS_STREAMS_ADM and reattempt the entire operation.

message: non-Oracle system error: string
cause: A non-Oracle database has returned an error message to STREAMS when attempting to apply a DML statement. The non-Oracle system error message is a parameter to this Oracle error.
solution: Corrective action may or may not be possible (depending on the non-Oracle system error). If corrective action is possible, correct the problem and try applying the transaction again.

message: bind value size too large for PL/SQL CALL operation
cause: In a PL/SQL CALL to a stored procedure, the bind string size exceeded 4K.
solution: Either make the bind string size shorter (less than 4K) or use BEGIN-END to call the procedure instead of CALL.

message: Operation corresponding to script string is in progress.
cause: The script was already being run in a different session or was terminated before status for the script was updated to ERROR or EXECUTED.
solution: Make sure the script is not being run in a parallel session. Then call the RECOVER_OPERATION API in the DBMS_STREAMS_ADM package with the appropriate OPERATION_MODE argument.

message: Operation string . string . string is in progress.
cause: An attempt was made to execute a procedure which was being executed in a parallel session or failed execution.
solution: Query the DBA_RECOVERABLE_SCRIPT view to identify the operation that is currently in progress for the specified invoking procedure. Complete the operation before proceeding.

message: internal DBMS_COMPARISON error: [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: DBMS_COMPARISON detected an erroneous result.
solution: Look for information in the session trace file and contact Oracle Support Services.

message: A comparison operation is currently in progress for string .
cause: Another session was already performing an operation on this object.
solution: Retry the operation once other sessions are done with the specific comparison object.

message: Table shapes of string . string and string . string @ string did not match.
cause: Table shapes of local and remote tables to compare did not match.
solution: Retry by explicitly specifying columns that match in column_list or create views on the tables as appropriate.

message: No eligible index on table string . string
cause: Table did not have an eligible index to use for comparison.
solution: For a table to be compared using DBMS_COMPARISON, the table must have an appropriate index on a column of certain data types. Check the documentation for supported data types.

message: Comparison object string already existed.
cause: A comparison object by the specified name already exists.
solution: Retry with a different name.

message: Comparison query too long (actual string , allowed string ).
cause: A generated query for comparison was too long.
solution: Comparison is unsupported for very large tables with long column names. Retry with a subset of columns or with shorter column names.

message: string . string is not an eligible index on table string . string for comparison
cause: The specified index was not an eligible index to use for comparison.
solution: For a table to be compared using DBMS_COMPARISON, the table must have an appropriate index. Please specify an eligible index for the table to be compared.

message: Cannot switch to apply-state checkpoint mode (value " string ", string parameter string ), due to the following reason:
cause: Could not switch to apply-state checkpoint mode, or already in apply-state checkpoint mode.
solution: Can switch to apply-state checkpoint mode only if the capture is new (it never ran), the capture wasn't cloned from a capture with checkpoints, the capture doesn't include any extra attributes, and combined capture and apply is enabled.

message: apply-state checkpoint mode cannot change (value " string ", string parameter string )
cause: Could not switch to checkpoints because apply-state checkpoint mode was set.
solution: Drop the apply-state checkpoint capture and create a new one that will / take checkpoints.

message: Cannot force checkpoints in apply-state checkpoint mode (value " string ", string parameter string )
cause: The capture process was in apply-state checkpoint mode.
solution: Cannot take checkpoints in apply-state checkpoint mode.

message: Cannot turn off combined capture and apply mode in apply-state checkpoint mode (value " string ", string parameter string )
cause: The capture was running in apply-state checkpoint mode and had to run in combined capture and apply mode also.
solution: Ensure that this capture runs in combined capture and apply by dropping additional propagation or apply processes for the same queue.

message: Cannot include extra attributes in apply-state checkpoint mode
cause: The capture process was in apply-state checkpoint mode.
solution: Extra attributes are not supported in apply-state checkpoint mode.

message: MAINTAIN_TTS: tablespace(s) already exist(s) in target database.
cause: The tablespaces were already in existence in the target database when the streams MAINTAIN_TTS APIs were called."
solution: Check whether you can drop the tablespaces to be maintained in the target database. If not, don't use streams MAINTAIN_TTS APIs to setup streams. Check the Oracle documentation on how to setup streams.

message: MAINTAIN_TTS: Invalid tablespace name, reason: string .
cause: The tablespace name was either NULL or too long when the streams MAINTAIN_TTS APIs were called.
solution: Check that the specified tablespace names are not NULL and are spelled correctly. If there are too many tablespaces, group them together and call the streams MAINTAIN_TTS APIs for the group.

message: Cannot switch to checkpoint mode (value " string ", string parameter string )
cause: Capture was cloned from a capture in apply-state checkpoint mode.
solution: Clone from a capture with checkpoints.

message: Cannot switch to apply-state checkpoint mode (Capture string )
cause: Switch to apply-state checkpoint mode was prevented by a previous error.
solution: See the previous error for the appropriate action.

message: Cannot switch to checkpoints (Capture string )
cause: Switch to checkpoints was prevented by a previous error.
solution: See the previous error for the appropriate action.

message: string string process string does not exist
cause: Capture or Apply did not exist.
solution: Create a Capture or Apply process, then try again.

message: string string process string is not running
cause: Capture or Apply were not running.
solution: Start Capture or Apply process, then try again

message: Capture string is for Change Data Capture
cause: Capture was for Change Data Capture, and checkpoints were required.
solution: None

message: Capture string is for Audit Vault
cause: Capture was for Audit Vault, and checkpoints were required.
solution: None

message: No progress Capture string
cause: Capture was not capturing changes.
solution: Make sure Capture is running and capturing changes.

message: Capture string is already in string mode
cause: Capture was already in the desired mode.
solution: None

message: The oldest SCN could not be updated at Apply string
cause: The oldest SCN was not updated before the switch was performed.
solution: Make sure Apply is running and the switch package version is the same at both databases.

message: LogMiner session does not exist
cause: LogMiner session did not exist.
solution: Make sure the Capture process exists.

message: Attempting to set the oldest SCN to a greater value ( string ) than the current one ( string ) at Apply string
cause: The new value for the oldest SCN was not computed correctly.
solution: Make sure Capture and Apply are running, and Capture is making progress.

message: The SCN range cannot be smaller than 0, (SCN range = string )
cause: The function was invoked with a negative SCN range.
solution: Use a positive SCN range.

message: Timeout occurred while string string process string
cause: The GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process could not be stopped or started.
solution: Call the switch procedure again.

message: the converted file string already exists
cause: The converted file was already in existence. CONVERT FILE call does not overwrite the existing file.
solution: Check whether the existing file can be deleted. If the existing file can be deleted, delete it. Otherwise, specify a different directory or file extension.

message: Invalid character set specified when converting column ' string ' in ' string . string '
cause: The conversion between two character sets for the column in the given table is not supported.
solution: Check if the implicit conversion between source and destination column is supported.

message: Destination buffer is not large enough when converting column ' string ' in ' string . string ' (actual length: string ; maximum length: string )
cause: The conversion between two character sets failed because a source column value is too large for the destination column.
solution: Check if size of the source and destination column matches.

message: Unable to load NLS data object when converting column ' string ' in ' string . string '
cause: It may be caused by invalid NLS environment setting.
solution: Check your NLS environment setting.

message: Canon capture name " string " not found
cause: There's no such capture process
solution: Pass the right parameter to the function

message: subset rule length exceeds maximum allowed value
cause: The length of an insert, update, or delete subset rule computed from the DML condition input exceeded the maximum allowed length.
solution: Make the DML condition shorter.

message: local object string . string is not a single table view
cause: The view was based either on another view or multiple tables or views.
solution: For comparison, specify a view based on a single table.

message: remote object string . string is not a single table view
cause: The view was based either on another view or multiple tables or views.
solution: For comparison, specify a view based on a single table.

message: DML conflict handler " string " not found
cause: The DML conflict handler was not found for modification or removal.
solution: Make sure the name of the conflict handler is correct and that it exists.

message: Default column group in use by DML conflict handler " string "
cause: A default column group was found for the specified Apply name, operation name, and conflict type.
solution: Remove the existing default column group and retry.

message: Column " string " already used by conflict handler " string "
cause: The column was already in the column group of another conflict handler for the specified Apply name, operation name, and conflict type.
solution: Remove the column from the other conflict handler or specify a different column.

message: Column " string " does not have a numeric data type.
cause: The specified column did not have a numeric data type. Delta conflict resolution requires numeric columns.
solution: Check the data type of the column and specify only numeric columns.

message: Duplicate conflict handler name
cause: A DML conflict handler with the specified name was found.
solution: Remove the current DML conflict handler or specify a different name.

message: Duplicate column name " string "
cause: The specified value was duplicated in the column group list.
solution: Remove duplicated entries from the column group list.

message: Default column group required
cause: A default column group was not specified. The specified Apply name, operation name, and conflict type is only supported on default column groups.
solution: Specify a default column group.

message: Column not specified in column group for DML conflict handling for table " string "." string "
cause: The specified table contained a column that was not specified as part of a column group.
solution: Add the column to a column group.

message: Invalid resolution column " string " for table " string "." string "
cause: The specified resolution column was not valid.
solution: Set the resolution column to a valid column.

message: Unable to handle delta conflict resolution for table " string "." string "
cause: The specified table or the LCR contained a null value in one of the columns belonging to a delta conflict group.
solution: Correct each delta column in the table or the error LCR if it currently has a null value.

message: Unsupported OPERATION_NAME, CONFLICT_TYPE, and METHOD_NAME
cause: The specified OPERATION_NAME, CONFLICT_TYPE, and METHOD_NAME was not a valid set of parameters.
solution: Retry with a valid set of parameters.

message: invalid value string , string should be of the form [SCHEMA.]NAME
cause: An invalid value was specified for the paramerter.
solution: Specify a string of the form [SCHEMA.]NAME .

message: cannot create QUEUE_TABLE, string already exists
cause: The queue table already exists in the queueing system.
solution: Drop the table first using the DROP_QUEUE_TABLE() command or specify another table.

message: QUEUE_TABLE string does not exist
cause: Queue_table not exist.
solution: Query on the user view USER_QUEUE_TABLES to find out existing queue tables.

message: Queue table index string inconsistent with queue table string
cause: The queue table index has not yet been successfully imported.
solution: Import the queue table index before attempting to use the queue table. If the import failed, correct the problem and try to import the queue table index again.

message: invalid column name string in SORT_LIST, should be ENQ_TIME or PRIORITY
cause: Invalid column name was specified in the SORT_LIST.
solution: The valid column names are ENQ_TIME and PRIORITY.

message: Inappropriate utilities used to perform DDL on AQ table string . string
cause: An attempt was made to use the SQL command DROP TABLE or TRUNCATE TABLE or ALTER TABLE on queue metadata or tables.
solution: Use the DBMS_AQADM.DROP_QUEUE_TABLE to DROP TABLE, DBMS_AQADM.PURGE_QUEUE_TABLE to TRUNCATE TABLE. ALTER TABLE redefinition based on only ALTER_TABLE_PROPERTIES and ALTER_TABLE_PARTITIONING clauses are allowed.

message: cannot create QUEUE, string already exists
cause: The queue requested to be created already exists.
solution: Specify another queue name. Query USER_QUEUES for all the exisiting queues in the users's schema.

message: invalid value string , MAX_RETRIES should be non-negative integer
cause: An invalid value was specified for MAX_RETRIES.
solution: Specify a non-negative integer.

message: queue table string . string must be dropped first
cause: An error was detected when dropping a queue table in a cluster, tablespace, or schema.
solution: Use the DBMS_AQADM.DROP_QUEUE_TABLE procedure to drop the specified queue table first; then, retry the operation.

message: invalid value string , QUEUE_TYPE should be NORMAL_QUEUE or EXCEPTION_QUEUE
cause: Invalid queue type parameter
solution: Valid values are NORMAL_QUEUE for normal queue and EXCEPTION_QUEUE for exception queue.

message: QUEUE string does not exist
cause: The specified queue does not exist.
solution: Specify a valid queue. Query USER_QUEUES for all the valid queues.

message: cannot drop QUEUE, string should be stopped first
cause: The queue has not been stopped i.e. either enqueue or dequeue is still enabled.
solution: Stop the queue first using the STOP_QUEUE command and disable it from both enqueueing and dequeueing.

message: cannot drop QUEUE_TABLE, some queues in string have not been dropped
cause: A queue exists in the queue table which has not been dropped. All queues need to be dropped first.
solution: Drop all queues belonging to this queue table using the drop_queue() command. Be sure to stop the queues appropriately before dropping them. Alternately, use the force option in drop_queuetable.

message: invalid value string , RETRY_DELAY should be non-negative
cause: A negative value was specified for RETRY_DELAY.
solution: Specify a non-negative value for RETRY_DELAY.

message: invalid value string , RETENTION_TIME should be FOREVER or non-negative
cause: Queue retention was specified, but the retention time was specified to be less than zero.
solution: Specify the retention time to be non-negative or FOREVER. Alternately don't specify retention.

message: cannot create QUEUE_TABLE, QUEUE_PAYLOAD_TYPE string . string does not exist
cause: An invalid QUEUE_PAYLOAD_TYPE specified during create_queue_table.
solution: The QUEUE_PAYLOAD_TYPE should be RAW or an object type that already exists in the database.

message: cannot create QUEUE_TABLE, user string does not have execute privileges on QUEUE_PAYLOAD_TYPE string . string
cause: An invalid object type specified for QUEUE_PAYLOAD_TYPE during create_queue_table.
solution: The user should have execute priviliges on the object type specified for the queue.

message: cannot enable enqueue on QUEUE, string is an exception queue
cause: User tried to enable enqueueing to an exception queue.
solution: None

message: STOP_QUEUE on string failed, outstanding transactions found
cause: There were outstanding transactions on the queue, and WAIT was set to false, so STOP_QUEUE was unsucessful in stopping the queue.
solution: Set WAIT to TRUE and try STOP_QUEUE again. It will hang till all outstanding transactions are completed.

message: identifier for string too long, should not be greater than string characters
cause: The identifier specified is too long.
solution: Try again with a shorter identifier.

message: Internal error in DBMS_AQ_IMPORT_INTERNAL, string
cause: Internal Error occured in the package DBMS_AQ_IMPORT_INTERNAL.
solution: Internal error, call Oracle Support.

message: queue table definition not imported for string . string
cause: The queue definition is not updated because the queue table was not imported properly
solution: Import the queue table again.

message: the specified parameters has no effect on the queue
cause: The parameter combination will not cause the queue to be started or stoped.
solution: None. This is just a warning.

message: Internal error in DBMS_AQ_EXP_INTERNAL. string [ string ] [ string ]
cause: Internal Error occured in the package DBMS_AQ_EXP_INTERNAL.
solution: Internal error, call Oracle Support.

message: Internal error in DBMS_AQ_IMP_INTERNAL. string [ string ] [ string ]
cause: Internal Error occured in the package DBMS_AQ_IMP_INTERNAL.
solution: Internal error, call Oracle Support.

message: invalid value string , QUEUE_PAYLOAD_TYPE should be RAW or an object type
cause: Parameter queue_payload_type has invalid value.
solution: Specify a valid object type or RAW.

message: operation failed, queue string . string has errors
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue, dequeue or administer a queue which has errors.
solution: Drop the queue table setting the force option to true.

message: AQ HTTP propagation encountered error, status-code string , string
cause: AQ propagation's HTTP request to the propagation servlet at the specified address encountered an error
solution: Specify a valid address in the connect string of the propagation destination dblink, the dblink user has the correct permissions, check if the AQ propagation servlet was properly installed.

message: cannot create a reciever non-repudiable single consumer queue
cause: Tried to create a reciever non-repudiable single consumer queue
solution: This feature is not supported

message: operation not allowed on a single-consumer queue
cause: Tried an operation not allowed on a single-consumer queue.
solution: Specify the operation on a multi-consumer queue.

message: Only one of rule or rule-set must be specified
cause: Specified both a rule and rule-set for the operation.
solution: Specify only one of rule or rule-set.

message: invalid value, string should be non-NULL
cause: Parameter is NULL.
solution: Specify a non NULL value for the parameter.

message: object string exists, index could not be created for queue table string
cause: Oracle AQ tried to create an index with the name specified in the error message. The index could not be created for the specified queue table because a object exists with the same name.
solution: Drop the object specified in the error message and retry the command. You can also choose a different name for the queue table.

message: no recipients for message
cause: An enqueue was performed on a queue that has been set up for multiple dequeuers but there were neither explicit recipients specified in the call nor were any queue subscribers determined to be recipients for this message.
solution: Either pass a list of recipients in the enqueue call or add subscribers to the queue for receiving this message.

message: application string is already a subscriber for queue string
cause: An application name that was already a subscriber for the queue was specified in the dbms_aq.subscribe call.
solution: None

message: AQ agent string is not a subscriber for queue string
cause: An AQ agent that was not a subscriber for the queue was specified.
solution: Check the name and/or address of the agent and retry the call.

message: invalid SORT_ORDER column string specified for queue table
cause: The create queue table command was issued with message_grouping set to TRANSACTIONAL and a sort order column other than priority. Only the priority column can be specified in the sort order for queue tables with transactional grouping.
solution: Change the sort order list in the create queue table command and retry the call.

message: schema string in QUEUE_NAME is not same as schema string in QUEUE_TABLE
cause: The schema specified in the QUEUE_NAME parameter of CREATE_QUEUE is not the same as the schema specified in the QUEUE_TABLE parameter.
solution: Use the same schema name for both the QUEUE_NAME and QUEUE_TABLE parameters and retry the command.

message: RETRY_DELAY and MAX_RETRIES cannot be used for a 8.0 compatible multiple consumer queue
cause: The CREATE_QUEUE or ALTER_QUEUE command was issued with a non-zero RETRY_DELAY and a QUEUE_TABLE that was created for multiple consumers and with COMPATIBLE parameter set to '8.0'.
solution: Either set the RETRY_DELAY to zero or upgrade the queue table to 8.1 compatible using the DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE procedure.

message: Queue string not created in queue table for multiple consumers
cause: Either an ADD_SUBSCRIBER, ALTER_SUBSCRIBER, or REMOVE_SUBSCRIBER procedure, or an ENQUEUE with a non-empty recipient list, was issued on a queue that was not created for multiple consumers.
solution: Create the queue in a queue table that was created for multiple consumers and retry the call.

message: propagation schedule exists for QUEUE string and DESTINATION string
cause: A SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION was issued for a queue and destination pair which has an existing propagation schedule.
solution: Issue UNSCHEDULE_PROPAGATION to remove the existing schedule and then reissue the SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION call.

message: no propagation schedule exists for QUEUE string and DESTINATION string
cause: AN UNSCHEDULE_PROPAGATION was issued for a queue and destination pair which has no existing propagation schedule.
solution: Verify the spelling of the specified QUEUE and DESTINATION and then reissue the call with the correct spelling.

message: destination string uses a reserved name, names with AQ$_ prefix are not valid
cause: An attempt was made to specify a reserved name for a destination.
solution: Enter a different value or NULL for the local destination. Then retry the operation.

message: source string and destination string object types do not match
cause: A message recipient's queue has a different object structure than the sender's queue. The message cannot be propagated.
solution: Either remove the recipient from the subscriber's list for the sender's queue or create the destination queue with an object type that matches the source queue's object type.

message: invalid agent address string , agent address should be of the form [SCHEMA.]NAME[@DATABASE LINK]
cause: An invalid value was specified for the agent address parameter.
solution: Specify a string of the form [SCHEMA.]NAME[@DATABASE LINK].

message: protocol attribute reserved for future use
cause: The protocol attribute of the AQ agent object type is reserved for future use.
solution: Do not specify the protocol attribute in the agent object type.

message: invalid agent name string , agent name should be of the form NAME
cause: An invalid value was specified for the agent name parameter.
solution: Specify a string of the form NAME. Then retry the operation.

message: cannot create QUEUE_TABLE, user does not have access to AQ object types
cause: An attempt was made to issue the CREATE_QUEUE_TABLE command, but the user who issued the command does not have access to internal AQ object types.
solution: Use the DBMS_AQADM.GRANT_TYPE_ACCESS procedure to grant the user access to the AQ object types.

message: invalid agent name string , names with AQ$_ prefix are not valid
cause: An attempt was made to use a reserved prefix in the agent name.
solution: Enter a different value for the agent name. Then, retry the operation.

message: subscribers are not supported for exception queue string
cause: An ADD_SUBSCRIBER, ALTER_SUBSCRIBER, or REMOVE_SUBSCRIBER procedure was issued on a queue that was created as an EXCEPTION_QUEUE.
solution: Specify a NORMAL_QUEUE in the procedure.

message: cannot propagate object type payloads that have a REF attribute
cause: An ADD_SUBSCRIBER or ENQUEUE procedure with a non-NULL address field in the agent type was issued on a queue whose payload has a REF attribute. Propagation of object type payloads that have a REF attribute currently is not supported.
solution: Specify an agent with a NULL address field so that the agent can dequeue from the same queue. Or, change the object type definition to one that does not use REF attributes.

message: cannot propagate object type payloads with LOB attributes to an 8.0 release
cause: The recipient of a message with LOB attributes was using an Oracle 8.0 release. Propagation of LOB attributes is supported only in Oracle 8.1 and higher releases.
solution: Upgrade the target release to Oracle 8.1 and retry. Or, change the object type definition to one that does not use LOBs.

message: PRIMARY_INSTANCE and SECONDARY_INSTANCE must be non-negative
cause: One of PRIMARY_INSTANCE or SECONDARY_INSTANCE was negative.
solution: Specify non-negative integers for PRIMARY_INSTANCE and SECONDARY_INSTANCE.

message: cannot propagate to an Oracle 8.0.3 release or lower release
cause: The recipient of a message was using an Oracle 8.0.3 release or lower release. Propagation is supported only in Oracle 8.0.4 and higher releases.
solution: Upgrade the target release to Oracle 8.0.4 or higher and retry.

message: cannot delete propagation status rows that are in prepared state
cause: An attempt was made to use the internal administration procedure to delete status rows from the SYS.AQ$_PROPAGATION_STATUS table that were in the prepared state.
solution: Wait for the propagation to complete successfully before retrying the operation.

message: internal inconsistency for QUEUE string and destination string
cause: The sequence numbers used in the SYS.AQ$_PROPAGATION_STATUS table were inconsistent for the given queue and destination.
solution: Contact Oracle Worldwide Support.

message: cannot define subscriber with rule for queue string
cause: An ADD_SUBSCRIBER or ALTER_SUBSCRIBER procedure with a rule was issued on a queue for which rule based subscribers are not supported. Rule based subscribers currently are supported only for NORMAL (persistent) multi-consumer queues created using an Oracle release 8.1.0 or higher compatible queue table.
solution: Create a NORMAL multi-consumer queue in an Oracle release 8.1.0 or higher compatible queue table, and retry the call. Or, if the queue is a normal (persistent) multi-consumer queue, convert the queue table to Oracle 8.1.0 or higher compatibility and retry.

message: cannot downgrade QUEUE_TABLE that has propagation in a prepared state
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade the queue table when there were messages being propagated that were in the prepared state.
solution: Wait for the propagation to complete before retrying the operation.

message: invalid COMPATIBLE parameter setting string specified in DBMS_AQADM. string
cause: An invalid compatible parameter was specified in the DBMS_AQADM procedure. The parameter setting must be of the form '8.x.y' where x is the release number and y is the update number.
solution: Specify a valid COMPATIBLE parameter setting, and retry the operation.

message: cannot convert QUEUE_TABLE, string already is compatible with release string
cause: The source queue table in the DBMS_AQADM procedure is compatible with the specified COMPATIBLE parameter setting.
solution: Choose a different COMPATIBLE parameter setting to convert the queue table to the desired compatibility.

message: cannot specify non-zero SECONDARY_INSTANCE if PRIMARY_INSTANCE was zero
cause: A non-zero value was specified for SECONDARY_INSTANCE when PRIMARY_INSTANCE was zero.
solution: Specify a non-zero primary instance before you specify a non-zero secondary instance.

message: Subscriber table string inconsistent with queue table string
cause: The subscriber table has not yet been successfully imported.
solution: Import the subscriber table before attempting to use the queue table. If the import failed, correct the problem and try to import the subscriber table again.

message: cannot downgrade QUEUE_TABLE that has queues with rule-based subscribers
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade the queue table when there were queues on which rule based subscribers are defined.
solution: Remove the rule based subscribers for all queues in this queue table and retry.

message: propagation for QUEUE string and DESTINATION string already enabled
cause: An ENABLE_SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION command was issued for a queue and destination pair whose propagation schedule already was enabled.
solution: Make sure the QUEUE and DESTINATION are correct when you issue the ENABLE_SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION command.

message: propagation for QUEUE string and DESTINATION string already disabled
cause: A DISABLE_SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION command was issued for a queue and destination pair whose propagation schedule already was disabled.
solution: Make sure the QUEUE and DESTINATION are correct when you issue the DISABLE_SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION command.

message: invalid privilege specified
cause: An invalid privilege is specified for granting or revoking privilege
solution: Specify a valid privilege.

message: exceeded maximum number of subscribers for queue string
cause: An attempt was made to add new subscribers to the specified, but the number of subscribers for this queue has exceeded the maximum number (1024) of subscribers allowed per queue.
solution: Remove existing subscribers before trying to add new subscribers.

message: cannot start queue string , queue table string is being migrated
cause: An attempt was made to start a queue in a queue table that is being migrated.
solution: Complete the queue table migration, and retry the operation.

message: cannot downgrade queue table string while it is being upgraded
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade a queue table, but a previous command to upgrade the queue table has not yet completed successfully.
solution: Complete the upragde of the queue table by re-executing the DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE procedure. Then, downgrade the queue table.

message: cannot upgrade queue table string while it is being downgraded
cause: An attempt was made to upgrade a queue table, but a previous command to downgrade the queue table has not yet completed succesfully.
solution: Complete the downgrade of the queue table by re-executing the DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE procedure. Then, upgrade the queue table.

message: cannot perform operation string , queue table string is being migrated
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation on a queue in a queue table that is being migrated.
solution: Complete the queue table migration, and retry the operation.

message: cannot execute MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE procedure; must own queue table
cause: An attempt was made to upgrade or downgrade a queue table using the DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE procedure, but the user who executed the procedure does not own the queue.
solution: Reconnect as the owner of the queue table, and then execute the DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE procedure.

message: cannot specify RETENTION_TIME on exception queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter an exception queue by specifying a non-zero RETENTION_TIME.
solution: Use the default RETENTION_TIME parameter value for exception queues.

message: RETRY_DELAY and MAX_RETRIES cannot be used for exception queue %. string
cause: The CREATE_QUEUE or ALTER_QUEUE command was issued with a non-zero RETRY_DELAY and an exception queue.
solution: Do not specify RETRY_DELAY or MAX_RETRIES for exception queues.

message: cannot specify agent with NULL address and non-NULL protocol
cause: An ADD_SUBSCRIBER or enqueue was attemoted with an agent that had a NULL address and a non-NULL protocol.
solution: Either specify a non-NULL address or set the protocol to NULL.

message: cannot perform operation string for NON_PERSISTENT queue string . string
cause: One of the operations, SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION, ALTER_QUEUE, LISTEN, DEQUEUE was issued for a NON_PERSISTENT queue.
solution: Do not specify a NON_PERSISTENT queue for these operations.

message: cannot create propagation schedule for EXCEPTION queue string . string
cause: A SCHEDULE_PROPAGATION was issued for an EXCEPTION queue. Propagation schedules can be created only for NORMAL queues.
solution: To propagate messages from a queue specify the queue type as NORMAL.

message: cannot specify a non-NULL SECONDARY_INSTANCE if PRIMARY_INSTANCE was NULL
cause: A non-NULL value was specified for SECONDARY_INSTANCE when PRIMARY_INSTANCE was NULL.
solution: Specify a non-NULL primary instance before you specify a non-NULL secondary instance.

message: invalid name string , names with AQ$_ prefix are not valid for string
cause: An attempt was made to use a reserved prefix for the object name.
solution: Enter a different name for this object. Then, retry the operation.

message: unschedule_propagation pending for QUEUE string and DESTINATION string
cause: A propagation administration command was issued for a queue and destination pair whose propagation is being unscheduled.
solution: Do not issue propagation administration commands for a propagation schedule on which there is a pending unschedule request.

message: compatible parameter needs to be string or greater
cause: The compatible parameter was not high enough to allow the operation.
solution: shutdown and startup with a higher compatibility setting.

message: propagation may still be happening for the schedule for QUEUE string and DESTINATION string
cause: The snapshot process executing the propagation schedule did not respond to the disable propagation command.
solution: Make sure that the job for the propagation schedule has been ended.

message: cannot specify remote subscribers for string QUEUE string
cause: An add_subscriber call with a non-null address field was issued on a queue which does not support remote subscribers. Remote subscribers are not supported for NON_PERSISTENT QUEUES.
solution: Specify a null address field and retry the call.

message: DBLINK name in address field of agent string is not unique within the first 24 bytes
cause: Advanced Queuing requires that the agent's dblink name should be unique within the first 24 bytes (for 8.0 compatible queuetables)
solution: Specify a dblink name that is unique within the first 24 bytes or migrate to 8.1 compatible queuetables where this restriction is not there.

message: operation failed, queue string is invalid
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue, dequeue or administer a queue which is invalid. This could have occured because the payload type of the queue's queue table was dropped or rules associated with queue subscribers got altered or dropped.
solution: Drop the queue table setting the force option to true.

message: cannot create a 8.0 compatible string queue
cause: An attempt was made to create a 8.0 compatible queue table and enable a feature that is supported only on 8.1 style queue tables
solution: This feature is not supported

message: Invalid database user string
cause: An invalid database username was specified
solution: Specify a valid database user

message: AQ Agent string does not exist
cause: This AQ Agent does not exist
solution: Specify a valid AQ agent. Check the DBA_AQ_AGENTS view for a list of valid aq agents

message: AQ Agent string already exists
cause: This AQ agent has already been created
solution: Specify another agent name or use the ALTER api to modify the agent information.

message: at least one protocol must be enabled
cause: No protocol was enabled for aq agent
solution: Enable one of the protocols by setting one of the enable parameters to true.

message: Destination queue string is the same as the source queue
cause: Propagation cannot be scheduled when the destination queue is the same as the source queue.
solution: Specify a different destination queue.

message: invalid value string specified
cause: A queue, queue table, rule, or ruleset name that requires double quotes was specifed when the database compatibility was less than 10.0.
solution: Specify a value that does not require double quotes and retry the operation.

message: AQ agent string not granted privileges of database user string
cause: The specified AQ agent does not have privileges of the specified database user
solution: Specify a valid combination of AQ agent and database user. Check the DBA_AQ_AGENT_PRIVS or USER_AQ_AGENT_PRIVS view for user/agent mappings

message: invalid transformation, target type does not match that of the queue
cause: The target type of the transformation specified was different from the type of the queue.
solution: Provide a valid transformation whose target type is the same as the queue type.

message: invalid transformation, source type does not match that of the queue
cause: The source type of the transformation specified was different from the type of the queue.
solution: Provide valid transformation whose source type is the same as the queue type.

message: invalid message state specified
cause: Invalid value is specified for message state
solution: Provide a valid message state as specified in the documentation

message: Invalid value string , string should be non-negative
cause: A negative value or NULL was specified for the parameter.
solution: Specify a non negative integer.

message: invalid value string for string
cause: An Invalid value or NULL was specified for the parameter.
solution: Check the documentation for valid values.

message: operation not allowed for 8.0 compatible queues
cause: The specified operation is only supported for queues with compatibility 8.1 or greater
solution: Upgrade the 8.0 compatible queue to release 8.1 using DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE or specify a queue with compatibility 8.1

message: error in ktz testing layer
cause: There is an error in the Transaction layer test ICDs
solution: None

message: stopped processing the argument list at: string
cause: One of the arguments of the requested operation contained a list of scheduler objects. While processing this list an error was encountered with the specified item.
solution: Resolve the error for this element of the list and then re-issue the command with the remainder of the argument list. See the rest of the error stack to find out what the exact error is.

message: invalid prefix for generate_job_name
cause: generate_job_name was called with a prefix longer than 18 characters or a prefix ending in a digit.
solution: Re-issue the command using a prefix no longer than 18 characters and not ending in a digit.

message: invalid string parameter passed to DBMS_REPAIR. string procedure
cause: An invalid parameter was passed to the specified DBMS_REPAIR procedure.
solution: Specify a valid parameter value or use the parameter's default.

message: both cascade and a block range passed to DBMS_REPAIR.CHECK_OBJECT procedure
cause: Both cascade and a block range were specified in a call to DBMS_REPAIR.CHECK_OBJECT.
solution: Use either cascade or a block range, or do not use either one.

message: invalid block range specification
cause: An incorrect block range was specified.
solution: Specify correct values for the BLOCK_START and BLOCK_END parameters.

message: feature string is not yet implemented
cause: An attempt was made to use the specified feature, but the feature is not yet implemented.
solution: Do not attempt to use the feature.

message: invalid ACTION parameter passed to DBMS_REPAIR. string procedure
cause: An invalid ACTION parameter was specified.
solution: Specify CREATE_ACTION, PURGE_ACTION or DROP_ACTION for the ACTION parameter.

message: Object string . string has changed
cause: An attempt was made to fix corrupt blocks on an object that has been dropped or truncated since DBMS_REPAIR.CHECK_OBJECT was run.
solution: Use DBMS_REPAIR.ADMIN_TABLES to purge the repair table and run DBMS_REPAIR.CHECK_OBJECT to determine whether there are any corrupt blocks to be fixed.

message: invalid CASCADE_FLAG passed to DBMS_REPAIR. string procedure
cause: CASCADE_FLAG was specified for an object that is not a table.
solution: Use CASCADE_FLAG only for tables.

message: TABLESPACE parameter specified with an ACTION other than CREATE_ACTION
cause: The TABLESPACE parameter can only be used with CREATE_ACTION.
solution: Do not specify TABLESPACE when performing actions other than CREATE_ACTION.

message: partition name specified for a non-partitioned object
