cause: A partition name was specified for an object that is not partitioned.
solution: Specify a partition name only if the object is partitioned.

message: table name string does not start with string prefix
cause: An attempt was made to pass a table name parameter without the specified prefix.
solution: Pass a valid table name parameter.

message: table string does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to specify a map, repair, or sync table that does not exist.
solution: Specify a valid table name parameter.

message: table string has incorrect columns
cause: An attempt was made to specify a map, repair, or sync table that does not have a correct definition.
solution: Specify a table name that refers to a properly created table.

message: table name string is too long
cause: An attempt was made to specify a table name is greater than 30 characters long"
solution: Specify a valid table name parameter.

message: rule set string . string does not exist
cause: An attempt to access or modify a ruleset was made, which failed because the ruleset does not exist.
solution: Only access or modify existing rulesets.

message: invalid ruleset name
cause: An attempt to create a ruleset with an invalid name was made. The ruleset name can not be NULL, and can not be more than 26 characters, unless a rules_table_name is also specified, in which case the ruleset name may be up to 30 characters.
solution: Retry the create with a valid ruleset name.

message: invalid evaluation context name
cause: An attempt to create a rule/ruleset on an invalid evaluation name was made. The evaluation_context can not be more than 30 characters. The evaluation context with the name specified must exist.
solution: Retry the create with a valid evaluation context name.

message: rules engine internal error, arguments: [ string ], [ string ]
cause: An internal error occurred in the rules engine. This indicates that the rules engine has encountered an exception condition.
solution: Please report this error as a bug. The first argument is the error and the second argument is the package.

message: evaluation context string . string already exists
cause: An evaluation context of the given name already exists
solution: Specify another name for the evaluation context being created

message: rule string . string already exists
cause: A rule of the given name already exists
solution: Specify another name for the rule being created.

message: rule string . string does not exist
cause: The rule of the given name does not exist
solution: create the rule or specify one that exists

message: cannot drop rule string . string with dependents
cause: The rule still belongs to some rulesets, cannot be dropped
solution: do not drop a rule that belongs to rulesets without force option

message: invalid rule name
cause: An attempt to create a rule with an invalid name was made. The rule name can not be NULL, and can not be more than 30 characters
solution: None

message: evaluation context string . string does not exist
cause: The evaluation context of the given name does not exist
solution: create the evaluation context or specify one that exists

message: no evaluation context is associated with rule string . string or rule set string . string
cause: Whening adding a rule to a rule set, either the rule or the rule set must have an evaluation context associated with it
solution: do not add a rule without an evaluation context to a ruleset that does not have a default evaluation context

message: cannot drop evaluation context string . string with dependents
cause: The evaluation context still belongs to some rules or rule sets, cannot be dropped
solution: do not drop an evaluation context with dependents without force option

message: rule set string . string already exists
cause: A rule set of the given name already exists
solution: Specify another name for the rule set being created.

message: rule string . string already in rule set string . string
cause: a rule can be added to a rule set only once
solution: do not add a rule to a rule set that already contains this rule

message: rule string . string not in rule set string . string
cause: the rule to be removed from the rule set is not in the rule set
solution: do not remove a rule from a rule set that does not contain the rule

message: duplicate table alias string
cause: there is a table alias of the same name in the evaluation context
solution: do not add two table aliases of the same name to an evaluation context

message: duplicate variable name string
cause: there is a variable of the same name in the evaluation context
solution: do not add two variables of the same name to an evaluation context

message: invalid table alias
cause: table alias name or base table name is not specified in the table alias definiton
solution: specify both alias name and alias base table in the table alias structure

message: invalid variable definiton
cause: variable name or variable type is not specified in the variable definiton
solution: specify both variable name and variable type in the variable definition structure

message: name string already exists in the name value pair list
cause: there is already a name-value pair with the same name in the NVlist
solution: try another name.

message: name string does not exist in the name value pair list
cause: there is not such a name-value pair in the NVlist
solution: check the name-value pair exists in the NVList.

message: name value pair list is full, cannot add another entry
cause: The NVList is full (1024 elements) and cannot hold more elements
solution: do not add elements to a full list.

message: dblink is not supported in rules engine DDLs
cause: the object name has a database link in it, which is not supported
solution: Do not specify remote objects in rules engine DDLs.

message: invalid rule engine system privilege: string
cause: no such system privilege number for rule engine objects
solution: check specfication of dbms_rule_adm for valid system privilege numbers

message: invalid rule engine object privilege: string
cause: no such object privilege number for rule engine objects
solution: check specfication of dbms_rule_adm for valid object privilege numbers

message: evaluation context string . string has errors
cause: cannot resolve the table aliases and the variable types specified in the evaluation context
solution: make sure all base tables exist and all variable types correct

message: incompatible rule engine objects, cannot downgrade
cause: there are rule engine objects in the database that cannot be downgraded.
solution: check utlincmp.sql and remove all incompatible rules engine objects before downgrade.

message: rule string . string cannot have default evaluation context
cause: If a rule is added to a rule set with more than one evaluation contexts, it must not have an evaluation context itself.
solution: Do not set the evaluation context of such rules to a not-null value

message: rule condition has unrecognized variables
cause: The rule references variables not in the evaluation context.
solution: Modify the rule condition to remove illegal reference.

message: string . string is created by AQ, cannot be dropped directly
cause: This object is created by AQ, thus cannot be dropped directly
solution: use dbms_aqadm.drop_subscriber to drop the object

message: creation properties are only for internal use
cause: user specified not null creation properties when creating rules engine objects, which are not for external use
solution: do not set creation properties when creating rules engine objects

message: rule set string . string has errors
cause: The rule references variables not in the evaluation context.
solution: Modify the rule condition to remove illegal reference.

message: nested query not supported for rule condition
cause: user specified nested query in rule condition.
solution: do not use nested query in rule condition.

message: The number of string per evaluation context is more than string
cause: Number of tables or variables were more than the defined upper limit.
solution: Reduce the number of tables or variables per evaluation context.

message: The number of string exceeds limit string as there exists at least one nonsimple rule condition
cause: Upper limit of tables or variable per evaluation context exceeded as there exists at least one nonsimple rule condition.
solution: Reduce the number of tables or variables per evaluation context.

message: invalid transformation expression, the transformation expression does not evaluate to the target type/attribute
cause: The transformation expression does not evaluate to the target type or the target type's specified attribute.
solution: Provide valid transformation expression which evaluates to the target type or the target type's specified attribute.

message: The type string does not exist
cause: The source or destination type for the transformation does not exist
solution: Create the type or specify one that exists

message: attribute number specified does not exist
cause: The target type of the transformation does not have the attribute number specified in the ADD_ATTRIBUTE_TRANSFORMATION command
solution: check the target type definition and specify a valid attribute number

message: invalid transformation
cause: The transformation specified is invalid because the source or the target type have been dropped/modified.
solution: Drop and recreate the transformation

message: transformation string . string already exists
cause: The named transformation already exists.
solution: Specify another name for the transformation being created.

message: transformation string . string does not exist
cause: The specified transformation does not exist.
solution: Create the transformation before using it or specify an existing transformation.

message: wrong object type, could not transform message
cause: The object type of the message to be transformed does not match the source type of the specified transfomation.
solution: Specify another transformation, or specify a message of the correct type.

message: length of payload exceeds string
cause: the length of payload being taken exceeds the limit of varchar2 or raw.
solution: use clob type or blob type to call get_text or get_bytes.

message: the property name string has existed
cause: the property name being set has existed.
solution: use another property name.

message: the property name cannot be null
cause: the property name cannot be null.
solution: make sure the property name not null.

message: the property value exceeds the valid range string
cause: the property valus being set exceeds the valid range.
solution: make sure the property value is within the valid range.

message: attempt to read data in a message as the wrong type
cause: According to JMS specification, some type conversions were not allowed.
solution: Make sure to use the correct READ function to retrieve message data.

message: attemp to retrieve the name list of a map message with size exceeding 1024
cause: The GET_NAMES function returns the names in a varray with a size limit of 1024.
solution: Retrieve in several smaller steps using the GET_NAMES function with OFFSET and LENGTH parameters.

message: access the message in a wrong access mode
cause: StreamMessage and BytesMessage could not be read when they were in write only mode and vice versa.
solution: Change the access mode using PREPARE, CLEAR_BODY and RESET procedures.

message: JAVA stored procedure throws JAVA exceptions
cause: The JAVA stored procedure threw some exceptions that could not be catergorized.
solution: Use GET_EXCEPTION procedure to see what the exception is about.

message: attempt to use an invalid operation ID
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid operation ID to access messages.
solution: Use the correct operation ID returned by PREPARE or CLEAR_BODY procedure.

message: message store is overflow
cause: An attemp was made to access too many messages at the same time.
solution: Use the CLEAN procedure to clean up some of the messages.

message: duplicate publisher, publisher already added to the queue
cause: Attempted to add a publisher to the queue again.
solution: Specify another publisher or user DBMS_AQADM.ALTER_PUBLISHER to alter the publisher's properties.

message: publisher does not exist for the queue
cause: Attempted to alter or drop a non existent publisher from a queue.
solution: Specify another publisher.

message: operation failed, queue table string . string has errors
cause: An operation attempt was made to a queue table which has errors.
solution: Drop the queue table setting the force option to true.

message: existing string propagation schedules
cause: A propagation administrative interface was called when the existing propagation schedules were running in different mode (10.2/11g).
solution: Set appropriate internal parameter and unschedule existing schedules if required.

message: input to DBMS_DDL.WRAP is not a legal PL/SQL unit
cause: The input supplied to DBMS_DDL.WRAP or DBMS_DDL.CREATE_WRAPPED did not specify a legal PL/SQL package specification, package body, type specification, type body, function or procedure. This error can occur if you used incorrect syntax in the CREATE OR REPLACE statement or specified a unit that cannot be wrapped (e.g., a trigger or anonymous block).
solution: Provide a legal PL/SQL unit as input.

message: database access descriptor (DAD) string not found
cause: The specified Database Access Descriptor (DAD) did not exist.
solution: Make sure the name of the Database Access Descriptor (DAD) is correct and the DAD exists.

message: unknown Embedded PL/SQL Gateway attribute string
cause: The specified Embedded PL/SQL Gateway attribute was not known.
solution: Make sure the name of the Embedded PL/SQL Gateway attribute is correct.

message: argument passed to DBMS_UTILITY.VALIDATE is not legal
cause: One or more input arguments to the DBMS_UTILITY.VALIDATE routine was not legal. This error occurred because the object name or owner or namespace arguments (if specified) were NULL or illegal.
solution: Identify and correct the illegal argument.

message: unable to get source of string " string "." string ", insufficient privileges or does not exist
cause: The specified PL/SQL object in a DBMS_PREPROCESSOR subprogram did not exist or you did not have the privileges necessary to view its source.
solution: Make sure the specified object exists and you have the privileges necessary to view its source.

message: bad value for object type: string
cause: The specified object type was not appropriate.
solution: Make sure the specified object type is one of the following: package, package body, procedure, function, trigger, type, and type body.

message: source text is empty
cause: The input source text supplied to a DBMS_PREPROCESSOR subprogram was empty.
solution: Pass a non-empty input source text as the input.

message: object id argument passed to DBMS_UTILITY.INVALIDATE is not legal
cause: This error occurred because the p_object_id argument passed to the DBMS_UTILITY.INVALIDATE routine was NULL, there was no object with the specified object id, or the user calling the routine did not have sufficient privileges to invalidate the object.
solution: Correct the illegal argument.

message: object settings argument passed to DBMS_UTILITY.INVALIDATE is not legal
cause: This error occurred because the p_plsql_object_settings argument passed to the DBMS_UTILITY.INVALIDATE routine was NULL or malformed.
solution: Correct the illegal argument.

message: object could not be invalidated
cause: A call to the DBMS_UTILITY.INVALIDATE routine failed. This error occurred because the object type of the object specified by the p_object_id argument is not one of the types that can be handled by this routine. Alternately, the object was an object type specification with table dependents, or the object was the specification of the STANDARD, DBMS_STANDARD, DBMS_UTILITY package, or the body of the DBMS_UTILITY package.
solution: Call DBMS_UTILITY.INVALIDATE only on supported object types.

message: invalid database access descriptor (DAD) name
cause: The specified Database Access Descriptor (DAD) name was invalid.
solution: Make sure the name of the Database Access Descriptor (DAD) is valid and its length does not exceed its limit.

message: source text is in wrapped format
cause: The input source text supplied to a DBMS_PREPROCESSOR subprogram was in wrapped format.
solution: Pass a nonwrapped source text as the input.

message: anonymous access through a dynamically authenticated Database Access Descriptor (DAD) prohibited
cause: An attempt to allow anonymous access through a dynamically authenticated Database Access Descriptor (DAD) was prohibited.
solution: Make sure the Database Access Descriptor (DAD) is not dynamically authenticated before allowing anonymous access through it.

message: access control entry (ACE) already exists
cause: An access control entry (ACE) for the principal with the same grant or deny attribute in the IS_GRANT argument already existed.
solution: Add the privilege to the existing access control entry (ACE) instead.

message: invalid host or port for access control list (ACL) assignment
cause: The host or port to which the access control list (ACL) was assigned was invalid.
solution: Ensure the host and port to which you are assigning the access control list (ACL) are valid.

message: invalid network privilege
cause: The network privilege being added to the access control list (ACL) was invalid.
solution: Ensure the network privilege that you are adding to the access control list (ACL) is valid.

message: empty access control list (ACL) not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to store an empty access control list (ACL).
solution: Ensure that the access control list (ACL) has at least one

message: network access denied by access control list (ACL)
cause: No access control list (ACL) has been assigned to the target host or the privilege necessary to access the target host has not been granted to the user in the access control list.
solution: Ensure that an access control list (ACL) has been assigned to the target host and the privilege necessary to access the target host has been granted to the user.

message: XML DB extensible security not installed
cause: XML DB extensible security necessary for this operation has not been installed.
solution: Ensure that XML DB has been installed.

message: Authentication scheme " string " not supported
cause: An unsupported authentication scheme was used.
solution: Retry with a supported authentication scheme.

message: No supported authentication scheme found
cause: A supported authentication scheme was not found.
solution: Retry with a supported authentication scheme.

message: This statement is not supported by EXPAND_SQL_TEXT.
cause: EXPAND_SQL_TEXT did not support the specified statement. EXPAND_SQL_TEXT supports only SELECT statements.
solution: Submit only a SELECT statement.

message: Insufficient privileges for SQL profile operation
cause: A DDL operation was attempted on a SQL profile by a session without the proper privileges.
solution: Grant the user the appropriate privilege.

message: a row already exists in the string table for these parameters
cause: A call was made to create a new row in the specified table. A row already exists in the table with the specified values.
solution: Delete the existing row using the appropriate API or check the parameters used to create the row.

message: translation type must be either T, S or M
cause: The translation type parameter is not a T, S or an M. A value other than T, S or M was specified.
solution: Correct the translation type and reexecute the API call.

message: initialization value must be either F or T
cause: The initialization value must be either F or T. A value other than F or T was specified.
solution: Correct the initialization value and reexecute the API call.

message: translation text is required if translation type is T or S
cause: If a translation type of T or S is specified, translation text must be supplied.
solution: Provide translation text and reexecute the API call.

message: no row exists in the string table for these parameters
cause: A call was made to update a row that does not exist or a foreign key value supplied to create a table does not exist.
solution: Create the row using the appropriate API or check the parameters used to create the new row to ensure that all specified values exist.

message: function ' string ' parameter ' string ' missing or invalid
cause: The function <pkgname.funcname> was called with a parameter <parmname> that was null, 0 length, or had an invalid value.
solution: Correct the parameter to supply values that comply with its datatype and limits as specified in the documentation.

message: function ' string ' output ' string ' maximum value exceeded
cause: The function <pkgname.funcname> computed a value for the output <parmname> that exceeded the maximum allowed. This can occur when multiple input parameters, each valid separately, combine to specify an invalid result. For example, when a length parameter multiplied by a copies parameter yields a total length exceeding the maximum for the output datatype.
solution: Correct the input values to produce a result that will comply with the limits as specified in the documentation.

message: invalid database link string
cause: The database link did not exist.
solution: Make sure the database link name is correct.

message: remote table string not found
cause: The table did not exist in the remote database.
solution: Make sure the remote table name is correct.

message: view string is not a parallel access view
cause: The view was not created by CREATE_OR_REPLACE_VIEW API.
solution: Provide the correct view name that was created by CREATE_OR_REPLACE_VIEW API.

message: invalid input value for parameter string
cause: The parameter has been provided a negative, out of range, or NULL input value.
solution: Correct the input value such that it is valid, and is within the range as specified in the documentation.

message: invalid access past the maximum size of LOB parameter string
cause: The value of positional or size parameters exceeds the maximum allowed LOB size of 4 Gigabytes.
solution: Correct the input values for amount and offset such that their sum is less than or equal to 4 Gigabytes. If error occurs in a read or write loop, check the looping conditions and/or offset increments.

message: no more tables permitted in this sorted hash cluster
cause: A sorted hash cluster only supports a maximum of 2 tables
solution: None

message: max key length ( string ) for sorted hash cluster exceeded
cause: Sorted hash clusters have a maximum key size
solution: None

message: bad value for mode
cause: An undefined mode value was specified.
solution: Check that the correct mode is selected and that an allowed value for that mode is specified.

message: null host specified in thread-safe logon
cause: An HDA was not specified in the logon call while running in a thread safe environment.
solution: Make sure that HDA is not NULL when calling the logon routine.

message: host connection in use by another thread
cause: An attempt was made to use the host connection while it was in use by another thread.
solution: Wait for another thread to finish before using this connection.

message: call not supported in non-deferred linkage
cause: One of the calls that is supported in deferred mode linkage exclusively was invoked when the client was linked non-deferred.
solution: Use this call in deferred mode of linkage.

message: datatype not allowed for this call
cause: Data of this datatype cannot be sent or fetched in pieces.
solution: Use other bind or define calls for this datatype.

message: bad bind or define context
cause: The call was executed on a cursor for which this is invalid.
solution: Verify that this call is valid for this cursor. For example, Get piece information and set piece information are valid on a cursor if appropriate binds and defines have been done on this cursor.

message: bad buffer for piece
cause: A zero length buffer or a null buffer pointer was provided.
solution: Verify that the buffer pointing to this piece or its length is non-zero. The buffer pointer for the next piece or its length can be zero if it is the last piece to be inserted and there are no more data for the column.

message: invalid length for piece
cause: The length of the piece exceeded the maximum possible size.
solution: Verify that the length of this piece and the cumulative length of all the previous pieces is not more than the desired value supplied by the application.

message: illegal define position
cause: Call to modify attributes was done for a non-existent position
solution: Verify that a define has been done for this position

message: already connected to a server
cause: This server handle is already attached to a server.
solution: Disconnect from the server and then retry the call to establish a connection.

message: length specified for null connect string
cause: The connect string is null, but a length was specified for it.
solution: Set length to zero if connect string is null.

message: memory initialization failed
cause: Cannot initialize user memory.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: illegal parameters specified for allocating user memory
cause: An illegal size or null pointer was specified for user memory.
solution: Specify a legal size and a valid pointer for user memory.

message: user already authenticated
cause: A user has already been authenticated on this service handle.
solution: Terminate the service context before using it for another user.

message: service handle not initialized
cause: The server context does not done exist.
solution: Establish the server context in the service context.

message: illegal attribute type
cause: An illegal attribute type was specified for the handle.
solution: Consult user manual to specify an attribute valid for this handle.

message: illegal handle type
cause: An illegal handle type was specified.
solution: Consult user manual to specify a valid handle type.

message: define handle used in a different position
cause: A define was done with an existing handle on a different position.
solution: Specify the same position as before on a re-define.

message: call not allowed for scalar data types
cause: This call is valid only for object types.
solution: Verify that the data-type for this variable is an object type

message: unable to allocate memory
cause: Process was unable to allocate memory to store diagnostics.
solution: Terminate other processes in order to reclaim needed memory.

message: unable to initialize a mutex
cause: An attempt to initialize a mutex failed.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: inconsistent parameters passed
cause: One of the three memory function pointers is null or non-null.
solution: Verify that either all the memory functions are null or non-null.

message: unable to delete an initialized mutex
cause: An attempt to delete an initialized mutex failed.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: value not allowed
cause: A null value or a bogus value was passed in for a mandatory parameter.
solution: Verify that all mandatory parameters are properly initialized.

message: service handle not initialized
cause: An attempt was made to use an improper service context handle.
solution: Verify that the service context handle has all the parameters initialized prior to this call.

message: this OCI operation is not currently allowed
cause: An attempt was made to use a context handle outside its scope.
solution: Verify that the context handle is set to a service context handle that has been converted to a logon data area for other OCI calls. The logon data area must be converted back to a service context before it can be used.

message: handle passed in is already initialized
cause: An attempt was made to pass an initialized handle.
solution: Verify that the parameter passed in to retrieve a handle does not already point to a handle.

message: need explicit attach before authenticating a user
cause: A server context must be initialized before creating a session.
solution: Create and initialize a server handle.

message: illegal attribute value
cause: The attribute value passed in is illegal.
solution: Consult the users manual and specify a legal attribute value for the handle.

message: invalid character set identifier
cause: The character set identifier specifed is invalid
solution: Specify a valid character set identifier in the OCI call.

message: internal OCI error
cause: An internal OCI error has occurred.
solution: Please contact Oracle customer support.

message: user buffer too small
cause: The user buffer to contain the output data is too small.
solution: Specify a bigger buffer.

message: invalid object type
cause: An invalid object type is requested for the describe call.
solution: Specify a valid object type to the describe call.

message: zero iteration count
cause: An iteration count of zero was specified for the statement
solution: Specify the number of times this statement must be executed

message: no descriptor for this position
cause: The application is trying to get a descriptor from a handle for an illegal position.
solution: Check the position number.

message: cannot support more than 1000 columns
cause: The number of columns exceeds the maximum number supported.
solution: None

message: invalid result set descriptor
cause: The result set descriptor should have valid data fetched into it before it can be converted to a statement handle
solution: Fetch valid data into the descriptor before attempting to convert it into a statement handle

message: statement handle not prepared
cause: A statement cannot be executed before making preparing a request.
solution: Prepare a statement before attempting to execute it.

message: statement handle not executed
cause: A fetch or describe was attempted before executing a statement handle.
solution: Execute a statement and then fetch or describe the data.

message: cannot set server group name after connecting to server
cause: An attempt was made to set the server group in a server handle after connecting to the server. However, once the connection is established to a server, the server group name cannot be set anymore.
solution: Attach to the server after setting the server group name in the server handle.

message: cannot support more than 255 columns
cause: The number of columns exceeds maximum supported by the server.
solution: Limit your operation to 255 columns.

message: bad mode specified
cause: OCI_ENV_NO_MUTEX mode was specified for a non-threaded client.
solution: OCI_ENV_NO_MUTEX may be specified when OCI_THREADED had been specified at process initialization.

message: unable to destroy a mutex
cause: An attempt to destroy a mutex failed.
solution: None

message: user defined callback error
cause: The only valid return value for a user defined callback function is OCI_CONTINUE or OCI_ROWCBK_DONE. Any other value will cause this error.
solution: Please insure that OCI_CONTINUE or OCI_ROWCBK_DONE is returned from the user defined callback function.

message: success with compilation error
cause: A sql/plsql compilation error occurred.
solution: Return OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO along with the error code

message: A Truncation or null fetch error occurred
cause: A truncation or a null fetch error"
solution: Please ensure that the buffer size is long enough to store the returned data.

message: cannot execute without binding variables
cause: None of the bind variables in the SQL statement are bound.
solution: Please bind all the variables before the execute is done.

message: Warning of a NULL column in an aggregate function
cause: A null column was processed by an aggregate function
solution: An OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO is returned.

message: Update or Delete without Where
cause: An update or delete was executed without where clause
solution: An OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO is returned.

message: OCI call not allowed
cause: OCI used is not permitted from external procedures.
solution: Refer to user manual for usage restrictions.

message: invalid date passed into OCI call
cause: A bad date was passed into one of the OCI calls.
solution: Check your date bind values and correct them.

message: invalid COBOL display type passed into OCI call
cause: A bad COBOL display type was passed into one of the OCI calls.
solution: Check your COBOL display type bind values and correct them.

message: user buffer too small to accommodate COBOL display type
cause: User supplied buffer for a COBOL display type was too small to accommodate fetched number.
solution: Increase the allocation for COBOL display type buffer.

message: number fetched too large to fit in COBOL display type buffer.
cause: The number fetched was beyond the range that can be displayed.
solution: Please check the number in the database.

message: attempt to store a negative number in an Unsigned Display type.
cause: An attempt was made to convert a negative number into an unsigned display type.
solution: Please check the number in the database or change the defined datatype.

message: internal error while converting from to COBOL display type.
cause: An internal error was encountered during conversion to COBOL display type.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: internal error while converting from to OCIDate.
cause: An internal error was encountered during conversion to OCIDate type.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: OCIBindObject not invoked for a Object type or Reference
cause: OCIBindObject was not invoked resulting in an incomplete bind specification for a Object Type or Reference.
solution: Please invoke the OCIBindObject call for all Object Types and References.

message: OCIDefineObject not invoked for a Object type or Reference
cause: OCIDefineObject was not invoked resulting in an incomplete bind specification for a Object Type or Reference.
solution: Please invoke the OCIDefineObject call for all Object Types and References.

message: Type Descriptor Object not specified for Object Bind/Define
cause: Type Descriptor Object is a mandatory parameter for Object Types Binds and Defines.
solution: Please invoke the OCIBindObject() or OCIDefineObject() call with a valid Type Descriptor Object.

message: basic bind call not invoked before invoking advanced bind call
cause: One of the basic bind calls was not invoked on this bind handle before performing an advanced bind call.
solution: Please invoke the advanced bind call on this bind handle only after performing a basic bind call.

message: improper use of the character count flag
cause: When the character count flag is set, then the maximum size of the buffer in the server should be specified as a non-zero value.
solution: Please use a non-zero value for the mamimum size of the buffer in the server.

message: measurements in characters illegal here
cause: Measurements in characters instead of bytes are illegal if either the server's or client's character set is varying width.
solution: If either the client's or server's character set is varying width then do not use the OCI_ATTR_CHAR_COUNT attribute for the bind handle. Use OCI_ATTR_MAXDATA_SIZE instead.

message: internal error while padding blanks
cause: An internal error has occurred while attempting to blank pad string data. This error should not occur normally.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: error in character conversion
cause: This usually occurs during conversion of a multibyte character data when the source data is abnormally terminated in the middle of a multibyte character.
solution: Make sure that all multibyte character data is properly terminated.

message: migratable user handle is set in service handle
cause: This occurs during user authentication, a migratable user handle has been set in the service handle.
solution: Service handle must not be set with migratable user handle when it is used to authenticate another user.

message: user handle has not been set in service handle
cause: This occurs during authentication of a migratable user. the service handle has not been set with non-migratable user handle.
solution: Service handle must be set with non-migratable user handle when it is used to authenticate a migratable user.

message: OCI mutex counter non-zero when freeing a handle
cause: This is an internal OCI error.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: required callbacks not registered for one or more bind handles
cause: No callbacks have been registered for one or more of the bind handles which are part of the RETURNING clause.
solution: The bind handles which are to receive data in a DML statememt with a RETURNING clause must have their mode set as DATA_AT_EXEC and callback functions must be registered for these bind handles using OCIBindDynamic.

message: illegal piecewise operation attempted
cause: Data of a certain datatype that does not support piecewise operation is being sent or fetched in pieces.
solution: Always set the piece value to OCI_ONE_PIECE for datatypes that does not support piecewise operation.

message: data would not fit in current prefetch buffer
cause: An internal OCI error has occurred.
solution: Please contact Oracle customer support.

message: invalid object for describe
cause: The object to be described is not valid. It either has compilation or authorization errors.
solution: The object to be described must be valid.

message: invalid length specified for statement
cause: The length specified for the statement is either 0 or too large.
solution: Specify a valid length for the statement.

message: define not done before fetch or execute and fetch
cause: The application did not define output variables for data being fetched before issuing a fetch call or invoking a fetch by specifying a non-zero row count in an execute call.
solution: Issue OCI define calls for the columns to be fetched.

message: Cannot use V6 syntax when talking to a V8 server
cause: V6 syntax is no longer supported in V8 server.
solution: Change syntax to V7 syntax or higher.

message: cannot register/get user callback for non-environment handle
cause: A user callback registration or get was attempted on a handle which is not an environment handle.
solution: Pass the environment handle to register/get user callback.

message: invalid OCI function code
cause: An invalid function code was used to register or get user callback"
solution: Use a valid OCI function code.

message: user callbacks not allowed for this call
cause: An attempt was made to register a user callback for an OCI call for which it not allowed to register user callbacks.
solution: Do not register user callback for this OCI call.

message: invalid user callback type
cause: An invalid type of user callback was specified.
solution: Specify a valid user callback type.

message: invalid mode specification
cause: The mode parameter in an OCI call is invalid
solution: Use only valid mode parameter

message: error(s) in array DML
cause: One or more rows failed in the DML.
solution: Refer to the error stack in the error handle.

message: statement handled already executed or described
cause: The Statement handle was executed or described successfuly before.
solution: Perform a OCIStmtPrepare again before OCI_PARSE_ONLY.

message: Overflow segment of an IOT cannot be described
cause: The name specified in the OCIDescribeAny call referred to an IOT overflow segment.
solution: Use OCIDescribeAny to describe only documented objects.

message: Application context size is not initialized
cause: The size of the application context must be initialized before populating each context element.
solution: Issue OCIAttrSet with OCI_ATTR_CTX_SIZE to initialize context size

message: Application context size or index is not valid
cause: The size or index of the application context must be non-zero and non-negative.
solution: Use an appropriate value for the size.

message: statement/server handle is in use when being freed
cause: This is an internal OCI error.
solution: The user should reset in-use flag in statement handle before freeing the handle.

message: Invalid attach driver
cause: Trying to attach using the wrong driver
solution: Relink the application in the right mode

message: Unsupported functionality in fast path mode
cause: Feature not supported in fast path mode
solution: Avoid using the functionality in this mode

message: Invalid scrollable fetch parameters
cause: All the requested rows in this fetch could not be received.
solution: Check the fetch orientation, scroll offset, OCI_ATTR_CURRENT_POSITION and number of rows in OCIStmtFetch2 call. If required, change some of above parameters and fetch again.

message: Unsupported scrollable cursor operation
cause: The scrollable cursor execute or fetch has failed.
solution: Check the documentation for supported types, and other restrictions while using scrollable cursors.

message: invalid fetch operation
cause: Scrollable cursor operation requested with non-scrollable cursor.
solution: Check if the statement was executed in the scrollable mode. Else the only acceptable orientation is OCI_FETCH_NEXT that ignores the scroll offset parameter.

message: no connection pool to associate server handle
cause: OCIServerAttach called in OCI_POOL mode but no connection pool found to associate the server handle.
solution: 1) Verify that OCIConnectionPoolCreate is called before calling OCIServerAttach. 2) Verify that the database link specified in OCIServerAttach matches with that of the connection pool database link.

message: invalid mode for creating connection pool
cause: Mode specified in OCIConnectionPoolCreate is invalid.
solution: Use a valid mode.

message: invalid mode for destroying connection pool
cause: Mode specified in OCIConnectionPoolDestroy is invalid.
solution: Use a valid mode.

message: cannot reinitialize non-existent pool
cause: OCIConnectionPoolCreate was not called in OCI_DEFAULT mode for this pool handle.
solution: Create a connection pool prior to reinitializing it.

message: invalid attribute set in server handle
cause: Attribute OCI_ATTR_NONBLOCKING_MODE has been set on the server handle and attached in OCI_POOL mode. Connection pooling does not support non blocking mode.
solution: Do not set the OCI_ATTR_NONBLOCKING_MODE attribute on the server handle while attaching in OCI_POOL mode.

message: error occured while trying to free connections
cause: An internal error occured while trying to free connections.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: connection pool already exists
cause: A connection pool has already been created for the specified pool handle.
solution: 1) Specify a different pool handle to create a new connection pool. 2) If you wish to modify the pool parameters, call OCIConnectionPoolCreate in OCI_CPOOL_REINITIALIZE mode.

message: invalid number of connections specified
cause: An invalid combination of minimum, maximum and increment number of connections was specified in the OCIConnectionPoolCreate call.
solution: Specify a valid combination of parameters.

message: error occured while creating connections in the pool
cause: The database link specified in OCIConnectionPoolCreate might be an invalid one.
solution: Specify a valid database link.

message: cannot open further connections
cause: Sufficient number of connections are not present in the pool to execute the call. No new connections can be opened as the connMax parameter supplied in OCIConnectionPoolCreate has been reached.
solution: Call OCIConnectionPoolCreate in OCI_CPOOL_REINITIALIZE mode and increase the value of the connMax parameter.

message: error occured while creating connections in the pool
cause: The username and password specified in OCIConnectionPoolCreate might be invalid.
solution: Specify a valid username and password.

message: error occured while trying to destroy the connection pool
cause: Some connections in the pool were busy when an attempt to destroy the connection pool was made.
solution: Ensure no connections from the pool are being used.

message: connection pool does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to use the connection pool before creating it.
solution: Create the connection pool.

message: error occured while trying to create connections in the pool
cause: An internal error occured while creating connections in the pool.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: API mode switch is disallowed when a call is in progress.
cause: A mode switch from OCI8 to OCI7 was attempted in a callback.
solution: The user should perform the API mode switch either prior to initiating the top call or after the main call is done.

message: connection pool already exists
cause: A connection pool has already been created for the specified pool name.
solution: Specify a different pool name to create a new connection pool.

message: could not generate unique server group name
cause: An internal error occured while generating unique server group name.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: client cannot understand the object
cause: The client cannot process all the new features in the object.
solution: Upgrade the client so that features like inheritance and SQLJ objects can be used.

message: scrollable cursor max size exceeded
cause: Result set size exceeded the max limits.
solution: Check the documentation for allowable maximum result set size for scrollable cursors. Re-execute with a smaller expected result set size or make the cursor non-scrollable.

message: Session pool already exists.
cause: A session pool has already been created for the specified pool handle.
solution: 1) Specify a different pool handle to create a new session pool. 2) If you wish to modify the pool parameters, call OCISessionPoolCreate in OCI_SPOOL_REINITIALIZE mode.

message: Cannot reinitialize non-existent pool
cause: OCISessionPoolCreate was not called in OCI_DEFAULT mode for this pool handle.
solution: Create a session pool prior to reinitializing it.

message: Invalid number of sessions specified
cause: An invalid combination of minimum, maximum and increment number of sessions was specified in the OCISessionPoolCreate call.
solution: Specify a valid combination of parameters.

message: Only number sessions could be started.
cause: The number of sessions specified by the minSess parameter of OCISessionPoolCreate could not be started, possibly because the value supplied was larger than that supported by the server."
solution: This is a warning. Check the maximum number of sessions allowed on the server.

message: Missing or null username.
cause: Username and password must be specified when pool is created in this mode.
solution: Specify a valid username and password.

message: Invalid session Poolname was specified.
cause: An attempt was made to use a Session Pool that does not exist.
solution: Create a Session Pool before using it.

message: Session pool size has exceeded the maximum limit
cause: The number of sessions has exceeded the maximum size of the Session Pool.
solution: This is a warning. You can tune the session pool with appropriate minimum and maximum parameters.

message: Cannot open further sessions.
cause: Sufficient number of sessions are not present in the pool to execute the call. No new sessions can be opened as the sessMax parameter supplied in OCISessionPoolCreate has been reached.
solution: Call OCISessionPoolCreate in OCI_SPOOL_REINITIALIZE mode and increase the value of the sessMax parameter.

message: Proxy sessions are not supported in this mode.
cause: A proxy session was requested for from a Session Pool which does not support proxy sessions.
solution: Do not specify mode OCI_CRED_PROXY.

message: OCISessionRelease must be used to release this session.
cause: The session was retrieved using OCISessionGet, and an attempt has been made to release it using a call other than OCISessionRelease.
solution: Call OCISessionRelease.

message: OCISessionRelease cannot be used to release this session.
cause: The session was not retrieved using OCISessionGet, and an attempt has been made to release it using OCISessionRelease.
solution: Release the session using an appropriate call.

message: error occurred while trying to destroy the Session Pool
cause: An attempt was made to destroy the session pool while some sessions in the pool were busy.
solution: Ensure that no sessions from the pool are being used OR call OCISessionPoolDestroy with mode set to OCI_SPD_FORCE.

message: Cannot set the ROWID attribute - OCI_ATTR_FETCH_ROWID
cause: An attempt was made to set the implicit ROWID attribute.
solution: Use a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE statement that has not previously been described or executed before setting this ROWID attribute.

message: Invalid attempt to define at position 0
cause: An invalid attempt was made to call OCIDefineByPos for position 0.
solution: Ensure that the implicit ROWID attribute, OCI_ATTR_FETCH_ROWID, is set on the statement handle before doing the execute.

message: Invalid mode passed when defining at position 0
cause: An invalid mode was passed to OCIDefineByPos.
solution: Ensure a valid mode is passed to OCIDefineByPos when defining at position 0.

message: Invalid attributes on user handle
cause: Some of the attributes set on the user handle were not allowed in pooled mode.
solution: Unset the attributes on the user handle and call OCISessionGet or use sessions that are not pooled.

message: Sessions with SYSDBA privileges are not supported in this mode.
cause: A session with SYSDBA privileges was requested from a Session Pool which does not support sessions with SYSDBA privileges.
solution: Do not specify mode OCI_SESSGET_SYSDBA.

message: External authentication is not supported in this mode.
cause: An externally authenticated session was requested from a Session Pool which does not support external authentication.
solution: Do not specify mode OCI_SESSGET_CREDEXT.

message: Null values for sqltext and key were specified.
cause: An attempt was made to call OCIStmtPrepare2 and neither sqltext nor key were specified.
solution: Specify valid values for sqltext or key or both.

message: Statement does not exist in the cache
cause: The statement that was requested for does not exist in the statement cache.
solution: Please request for a valid statement.

message: The statement that was returned is not tagged.
cause: A tagged statement was requested for, but an untagged statement has been returned.
solution: This is a warning. Please modify and tag the statement as desired.

message: This statement has already been prepared using OCIStmtPrepare2.
cause: A statement that was earlier prepared using OCIStmtPrepare2 is now being reprepared using OCIStmtPrepare."
solution: Please use a different statement handle.

message: OCIStmtRelease called before OCIStmtPrepare2.
cause: An attempt was made to release a statement without first preparing it using OCIStmtPrepare2.
solution: Call OCIStmtPrepare2 before OCIStmtRelease.

message: Invalid Service Context specified.
cause: The statement was prepared using a service context that is different from the one specified in OCIStmtExecute.
solution: Please specify the same service context that the statement was prepared with.

message: Invalid statement Handle.
cause: OCIHandleFree called on a statement that was prepared using OCIstmtPrepare2.
solution: Release the statement using OCIStmtRelease.

message: OCIStmtExecute called before OCIStmtPrepare2.
cause: An attempt was made to execute a statement without first preparing it using OCIStmtPrepare2.
solution: Call OCIStmtPrepare2 before OCIStmtExecute.

message: Invalid Authentication Handle specified.
cause: The statement was prepared using an authentication handle that is different from the one specified in OCIStmtExecute.
solution: None

message: success with PLSQL compilation warning
cause: A plsql compilation warning occurred.
solution: Return OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO along with the error code.

message: OCI Easy Install mode cannot be initialized
cause: An internal OCI error has occurred.
solution: Please contact Oracle customer support.

message: Invalid cookie, resend sql text
cause: An internal OCI error has occurred.
solution: Please contact Oracle customer support.

message: Cannot pre-process OCI statement
cause: An error occured during statement pre-processing. E.g., SQL statement has invalid usage of N' or Q' literals.
solution: Correct the SQL statement.

message: string , Maximum call depth exceeded
cause: Your program has too many levels of recursion.
solution: Restructure your program to eliminate some levels of recursion.

message: Native Net Internal Error
cause: Internal error .
solution: This error should not normally occur. If it persists, please contact your customer service representative.

message: invalid OCI mode
cause: An attempt was made to invoke OCI API with an invalid mode.
solution: Provide the OCI API with legitimate mode.

message: Failed to initialize multithreaded environment
cause: Operating system did not support multithreaded mode.
solution: Use single thread mode instead.

message: Pool size was less than 1 in shared mode
cause: Pool size must be positive in shared mode.
solution: Set a positive pool size.

message: Invalid parameters were passed into environment creation call
cause: Invalid parameters were passed into the environment creation call. Check the passed in parameters for the following conditions: -envp should not be NULL -xtramem_sz should not be negative -Either both xtramem_sz and usrmempp have to be provided. Or, neither should be provided.
solution: Pass in legitimate parameters.

message: Setting authentication handle not allowed after pool create
cause: An attempt was made to set the authentication handle on session pool handle after OCISessionPoolCreate.
solution: Set the authentication handle on session pool handle before calling OCISessionPoolCreate.

message: Invalid attributes in session pool authentication handle
cause: Some of the attributes set on the authentication handle being set on the session pool handle are invalid.
solution: Unset the illegal attributes on the authentication handle being set on session pool handle and then call OCIAttrSet. Refer to OCI documentation for details.

message: Conflicting attributes in session pool authentication handle
cause: Some attributes could not be set both on the authentication handle passed to OCISessionGet and the authentication handle set on session pool handle.
solution: Unset the conflicting attributes on the authentication handle and call OCISessionGet.

message: invalid UTF16 mode
cause: UTF16 mode is allowed only at environment handle creation time.
solution: Remove UTF16 mode for functions other than OCIEnvCreate()

message: invalid UTF16 string passed in
cause: Non-UTF16 string is passed in while UTF16 string is expected
solution: Check the parameter which is actually a string

message: codepoint length overflows
cause: Returned buffer has more codepoints than allowed
solution: Set OCI_MAXCHAR_SIZE large enough to accommodate

message: codepoint length overflows for piecewise operation
cause: Accumulated codepoint length exceeds allowed codepoint length
solution: Set OCI_MAXCHAR_SIZE large enough to accommodate

message: data length larger than expected
cause: Incoming data larger than receiving buffer
solution: Set OCI_MAXDATA/MAXCHAR_SIZE appropriately or remove the setting

message: cannot change character set id on the handle
cause: Attempts to change character set id on non-environment handles
solution: Only try to change character set id on environment handles

message: invalid attempt to change character set id on env handle
cause: Attempts to change character set id after other handles have been allocated from the env handle
solution: Change character set id after creating environment handle but before allocating any handles from it.

message: invalid combination of character set ids
cause: Attempts to set one character set id as zero
solution: Set both charset and ncharset as zero or non-zero in OCIEnvNlsCreate()

message: Buffer is not aligned correctly.
cause: Alignment error ocurred in buffer when converting between character sets.
solution: Align buffer appropriately. For UTF16 buffer, pass a ub2 pointer.

message: OCI function currently not supported in UTF16 mode.
cause: Attempt to call an OCI function that was not supported in OCI_UTF16ID mode.
solution: Remove the offending function or do not create an OCI environment with OCI_UTF16ID mode or OCI_UTF16ID character set ID.

message: User not authorized to access column value.
cause: Column security is enabled and column value is not authorized.
solution: The program needs to handle this error and take appropriate action.

message: Column value authorization is unknown.
cause: Column security is unknown for the column.
solution: Verify the fetched data. It may or may not contain a meaningful value because it is probably the result of an expression that operated on unauthorized values.

message: Warning - column authorization unknown.
cause: Column security is unknown for one or more columns.
solution: Verify the fetched data. It may or may not contain a meaningful value because it is probably the result of an expression that operated on unauthorized values.

message: unhandled signal # number received. string
cause: Serious error: signal received
solution: Refer to the platform-specific signal code, and see if the application code caused the error. Otherwise, record all error state and notify Oracle Support Services.

message: error string encountered while handling error string ; exiting server process
cause: A second-level error occurred in an Oracle server process that required that process to exit.
solution: None. If an excessive number of incidents are dumped, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: incorrect size of attribute
cause: Transaction ID attribute size is incorrect.
solution: Verify that the size parameter is correct.

message: OCI_TRANS_NEW flag must be specified for local transactions
cause: Application attempted to start a local transaction without using OCI_TRANS_NEW.
solution: Use OCI_TRANS_NEW when starting local transactions.

message: local transactions cannot be detached
cause: An attempt to detach a local transaction was made.
solution: Local transactions may only be committed or rolled back.

message: cannot start new transaction with an active transaction
cause: An attempt to start a new transaction was made when there was an active transaction.
solution: Commit, rollback or detach the existing transaction before starting a new transaction.

message: OCI_TRANS_NOMIGRATE, OCI_TRANS_JOIN options are not supported
cause: These flags are currently not supported.
solution: None

message: transaction does not exist
cause: An invalid transaction identifier or context was used or the transaction has completed.
solution: Supply a valid identifier if the transaction has not completed and retry the call.

message: duplicate transaction identifier
cause: An attempt was made to start a new transaction with an identifier already in use by an existing transaction.
solution: Verify that the identifier is not in use.

message: not attached to the requested transaction
cause: An attempt was made to detach or complete a transaction that is not the current transaction.
solution: Verify that the transaction context refers to the current transaction.

message: invalid transaction start flags
cause: An invalid transaction start flag was passed.
solution: Verify that only one of the following values is specified: OCI_TRANS_NEW, OCI_TRANS_JOIN, OCI_TRANS_RESUME, or OCI_TRANS_PROMOTE.

message: invalid isolation level flags
cause: An invalid isolation level flag was passed.
solution: Verify that only one of following values - OCI_TRANS_READONLY, OCI_TRANS_READWRITE, OCI_TRANS_SERIALIZABLE is used.

message: server failed due to unspecified error
cause: An internal error has occured in the server commit protocol.
solution: Contact customer support.

message: transaction operation cannot be completed now
cause: The commit or rollback cannot be performed now because the session cannot switch to the specified transaction.
solution: Retry the operation later.

message: transaction branch prepare returns read-only
cause: The transaction is read-only, or this is the outcome of an optimization for two-phase commit protocol.
solution: None. Informational only.

message: cannot forget an active transaction
cause: Transaction identifier refers to an active transaction.
solution: Verify that the identifier of an active transaction was not passed as an argument.

message: cannot forget a prepared transaction
cause: Transaction identifier refers to a prepared transaction.
solution: Verify that the identifier of a prepared transaction was not passed as an argument.

message: cannot detach, prepare or forget a local transaction
cause: Service handle contains a local transaction context.
solution: Verify that the transaction context does not refer to a local transaction.

message: Cannot mix tightly-coupled and loosely-coupled branches
cause: Application attempted to start a transaction with a global transaction identifier and a wrong option.
solution: Verify that all branches of a global transaction are started with either OCI_TRANS_TIGHT or OCI_TRANS_LOOSE option. If the application is correct and uses distributed updates, contact customer support.

message: invalid transaction type flags
cause: OCI_TRANS_TIGHT or OCI_TRANS_LOOSE mode was not specified.
solution: Verify that the right parameters are being used.

message: cannot switch to specified transaction
cause: The transaction specified in the call refers to a transaction created by a different user.
solution: Create transactions with the same authentication so that they can be switched.

message: cannot prepare or commit transaction with non-zero lock value
cause: An attempt was made to detach the transaction with a non-zero lock value.
solution: Detach the transaction with lock value set to zero and then try to prepare or commit the transaction.

message: cannot start a new transaction
cause: An attempt was made to start a new transaction when session was already attached to an existing transaction.
solution: End the current transaction before creating a new transaction.

message: use of non-migratable database link not allowed
cause: The transaction, which needs to be migratable between sessions, tried to access a remote database from a non-multi threaded server process.
solution: Perform the work in the local database or open a connection to the remote database from the client. If multi threaded server option is installed, connect to the Oracle instance through the dispatcher.

message: cannot open connections
cause: The migratable transaction tried to access a remote database when the session itself had opened connections to remote database(s).
solution: Close the connection(s) in the session and then try to access the remote database from the migratable transaction. If the error still occurs, contact Oracle customer support.

message: detach not allowed with open remote cursor
cause: The migratable transaction tried to detach from the current session while having an open remote cursor.
solution: Close any open remote cursor prior to detach.

message: cannot recover a transaction while in an existing transaction
cause: An attempt was made to commit or roll back a transaction while in a different transaction, and the transaction for which the action is requested is in a recovery state (this happens if it is idle too long).
solution: Detach from the current transaction and retry the operation.

message: branches don't belong to the same global transaction
cause: The list of xids passed into kpotxmp() don't have the same gtrid
solution: None

message: Cannot detach from a non-migratable transaction
cause: An attempt was made to detach from a non-migrateable transaction.
solution: Either commit or rollback the transaction.

message: Cannot switch non-migratable transactions
cause: An attempt was made to prepare/commit a txn different from current.
solution: None

message: Transaction exists
cause: An attempt was made to start a transaction, while attached to a non-migrateable transaction
solution: None

message: Cannot resume a non-migratable transaction
cause: An attempt was made to resume a non-migrateable transaction.
solution: None

message: separated transaction has been completed
cause: The current transaction has been completed by another process.
solution: Start a new transaction

message: remote cursors must be closed before a call completes
cause: The previous operation did not close all the remote cursors it opened. Since separated transactions are enabled, this is not allowed.
solution: Close all remote cursors in each call, or start a regular (non-separated) transaction.

message: cannot switch to specified transaction (server type)
cause: The transaction specified was created by a shared server and the requestor is a dedicated server, or the transaction was created by a dedicated server and the requestor is a shared server.
solution: All parts of this application should connect as dedicated or as shared.

message: start not allowed in recursive call
cause: Oracle RM will not start/resume a branch in a recursive call
solution: Reconsider your application stack design

message: cannot mix OCI_TRANS_RESUME and transaction isolation flags
cause: An attempt was made to change the isolation level of an existing transaction.
solution: No action required

message: invalid transaction start flags
cause: An invalid transaction start flag was passed.
solution: Verify that OCI_TRANS_LOOSE was not passed along with OCI_TRANS_JOIN, OCI_TRANS_RESUME. Also, verify that other flags (such as OCI_TRANS_SEPARABLE) passed by the client are supported by the version of the Oracle server.

message: cannot mix services in a single global transaction
cause: Oracle RM will not serve global (distributed) transaction requests if branches are created using different services
solution: Configure clients such that those participating in the same distributed transaction use the same service name.

message: no active DTP service found
cause: Oracle RM will not serve global (distributed) transaction requests until DTP services are configured in RAC. It is possible that a service was stopped while transactions were in-flight.
solution: Provision/Start DTP services first.

message: Illegal string attempt made
cause: An illegal attempt was made to commit/rollback current transaction
solution: Use appropriate commit/rollback mechanism

message: operation completed; resume of original transaction rolled back
cause: The commit, rollback, or prepare completed successfully, but the current transaction for this thread was rolled back.
solution: If desired, retry the current transaction. If the operation was prepare, then end transaction appropriately with a commit or rollback operation.

message: cannot promote the current transaction to a distributed transaction
cause: An illegal attempt was made to promote the current transaction.
solution: Verify that OCI_ATTR_XID, OCI_ATTR_INTERNAL_NAME, and OCI_ATTR_EXTERNAL_NAME attributes have been set properly, and verify that the current transaction has neither performed IDL or PDML operations, nor already been a distributed transaction. Also, verify that the local transaction is in the same isolation level if the isolation flag value is set.

message: cannot resume the distributed transaction branch on another instance
cause: An attempt was made to resume a distributed transaction branch that is physically located on another RAC instance.
solution: Get a connection to the instance where the transaction branch is located.

message: illegal parameter value in OCI lob function
cause: One of the parameter values in the OCI lob function is illegal.
solution: Check every parameter in the OCI Lob function call to make sure they are correct. Offsets should be greater than or equal to one.

message: user defined lob read callback error
cause: The only valid return value for a user defined lob read callback function is OCI_CONTINUE. Any other value will cause this error.
solution: Verify that OCI_CONTINUE is returned from the user defined lob read callback function.

message: illegal parameter value in lob read function
cause: Internal error .
solution: This error should not normally occur. If it persists, please contact your customer service representative.

message: Lob read/write functions called while another OCI LOB read/write streaming is in progress
cause: Internal error.
solution: Wait for the ongoing LOB streaming call to finish before issuing the next server call, or use OCIBreak() abort the current LOB streaming call.

message: LOB type mismatch
cause: When copying or appending LOB locators, both source and desctination LOB locators should be of the same type.
solution: Pass the same type of LOB locators for copying or appending.

message: LOB form mismatch
cause: When reading from or writing into LOBs, the character set form of the user buffer should be same as that of the LOB.
solution: Make sure that the buffer you are using to read or write has the same form as that of the LOB.

message: LOB form mismatch
cause: When copying or appending LOBs, both source and desctination LOB locators should have the same character set form.
solution: Pass locators of the same character set form for copying or appending LOBs.

message: streaming of lob data is not allowed when using lob buffering
cause: Attempted to stream lob data via the polling mode or a callback when lob buffering was enabled for the input lob locator.
solution: Lob buffering is useful when reading/writing small amounts of lob data so streaming should not be necessary. Rewrite the OCILobRead/OCILobWrite call so that it does not use streaming. If streaming of data is required, lob buffering should not be used. In this case, flush buffers associated with the input lob locator as necessary, disable buffering on the input lob locator and reissue the OCILobRead/OCILobWrite call.

message: amount specified will not fit in the lob buffers
cause: LOB buffering is enabled for the input lob locator so buffering will be used. However, the amount of lob data to read or write is larger than what the lob buffers can hold.
solution: Either disable buffering on the input lob locator and reissue the command or pass a smaller amount.

message: attempting to write more data than indicated
cause: While writing into a LOB, more data was supplied than indicated.
solution: If data is written in pieces, then make sure that you do not provide more data in the pieces (cumulatively), than you indicated.

message: less data provided for writing than indicated
cause: While writing into a LOB, less data was provided than indicated.
solution: If writing data in single pieces, then make sure that the buffer length specified is big enough to accommodate tha data being provided. If data is written in pieces, then make sure that all the data has been provided before specifying OCI_LAST_PIECE.

message: character set conversion to or from UCS2 failed
cause: If the database character set is varying-width, the CLOB/NCLOB value is implicitly converted to or from UCS2. This implicit conversion failed.
solution: Contact Oracle Worldwide Support.

message: cannot send or receive an unsupported LOB
cause: An attempt was made to send a LOB across the network, but either the server does not support the LOB sent by the client, or the client does not support the LOB sent by the server. This error usually occurs when the client and server are running different versions of Oracle.
solution: Use a version of the Oracle that supports the LOB on both the client and the server.

message: operation not allowed for temporary LOBs
cause: Temporary LOB locators are not allowed in the operation. For example: OCILobAssign only takes persistent LOB locators as parameters, not temporary LOBs.
solution: Use OCILobLocatorAssign for temporary LOBs instead. Note that OCILobLocatorAssign can also be used for persistent LOBs, in which case it will behave the same as OCILobAssign.

message: Invalid character set form
cause: An invalid character set form was passed into an OCI LOB function. For example, the only valid cs form for OCILobCreateTemporary() is OCI_DEFAULT(0), SQLCS_IMPLICIT(1) or SQLCS_NCHAR(2).
solution: Specify a valid character set form.

message: Expanded non LONG bind data supplied after actual LONG or LOB column
cause: A Bind value of length potentially > 4000 bytes follows binding for LOB or LONG.
solution: Re-order the binds so that the LONG bind or LOB binds are all at the end of the bind list.

message: Unable to allocate the given chunk for current lob operation
cause: The given size is increased to accomodate the number of bytes from server due to varying width db char/nchar set.
solution: Use smaller chunk sizes when you have character set conversion between client/server or perform piece-wise read or write.

message: Operation not permitted on Abstract LOBs
cause: Abstract LOB locators were not allowed in the operation. For example, OCILobAssign only takes persistent LOB locators as parameters, not Abstract (i.e., client-side created) LOBs.
solution: Avoid the operation on Abstract LOBs.

message: Illegal reference count encountered for a temporary LOB
cause: Internal error.
solution: This error should not normally occur. If it persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Differnt LOB function called while another OCI LOB call is in progress
cause: An attempt was made to execute a new OCI LOB call while another OCI LOB call was in progress.
solution: Wait for the ongoing LOB streaming call to finish before issuing the next server call, or use OCIBreak() to abort the current LOB streaming call.

message: failed to startup shared subsystem
cause: While attempting to initialize OCI in shared mode, a problem was encountered in starting up the shared subsystem.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer support.

message: failed to connect to shared subsystem
cause: While attempting to initialize OCI in shared mode, a problem was encountered in connecting the process to the shared subsystem.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: protocol error during statement execution
cause: An internal protocol error occurred while receiving describe data from the server during execution of a statement.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: failed to connect thread to shared subsystem
cause: While attempting to initialize OCI in shared mode, a problem was encountered in connecting the thread to the shared subsystem.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: invalid pieceinfo provided
cause: While making the first call to write LOB data, an invalid pieceinfo value provided.
solution: Correct the call to use OCI_ONE_PIECE or OCI_FIRST_PIECE. If using OCCI, make sure to call writeBuffer before calling writeLastBuffer.

message: invalid or unsupported mode parameter passed in call
cause: The mode parameter passed into the OCI Client Notification call is incorrect.
solution: Please correct the mode parameter passed into OCI.

message: handles belonging to different environments passed into an OCI call
cause: All handles passed into an OCI call should belong to the same environment. In the call that returned this error, handles belonging to different environments were passed in.
solution: Please ensure that the handle parameters in the call to come from the same OCI Environment.

message: invalid subscription name or name-length in subscription handle
cause: The subscription handle passed into the OCI call does not have a proper name or name-length attribute.
solution: Please set the name and name-length attributes using the OCIAttrSet() call.

message: invalid namespace attribute passed into OCI call
cause: The subscription handle passed into the OCI call does not have a proper namespace attribute.
solution: Please set the namespace attribute using the OCIAttrSet() call.

message: invalid callback attribute passed into OCI call
cause: The subscription handle passed into the OCI call does not have a proper callback attribute.
solution: Please set the callback attribute using the OCIAttrSet() call.

message: invalid recipient protocol attribute passed into OCI call
cause: The subscription handle passed into the OCI call did not have a proper recipient protocol attribute.
solution: Please set the recipient protocol attribute using the OCIAttrSet() call.

message: invalid recipient attribute passed into OCI call
cause: The subscription handle passed into the OCI call did not have a proper recipient attribute.
solution: Please set the recipient attribute using the OCIAttrSet() call.

message: invalid pair of callback and recipient protocol attributes
cause: The subscription handle passed into the OCI call can't have both the callback defined and a recipient protocol other than OCI_SUBSCR_PROTO_OCI at the same time.
solution: Please set the appropriate callback and recipient protocol attributes using the OCIAttrSet() call.

message: invalid recipient presentation attribute
cause: The subscription handle passed into the OCI call does not have a valid recipient presentation attribute.
solution: Set the recipient presentation attribute using the OCIAttrSet() call

message: call in progress. Current operation cancelled
cause: The OCI call was invoked when another call on the connection was in progress.
solution: Check if the OCI call is supported when the call is in progress under special conditions; for example, if it is being used by a signal handler.

message: Cannot start listener thread at specified port
cause: Thread already running at a different port.
solution: Set the correct port in the environment handle or let the system choose the port.

message: Listener thread failed. string
cause: Thread listening for event notification exited because of an error. The error encountered is appended to the error message.
solution: The client needs to be restarted.

message: Cannot start Listener at specified IP address
cause: Thread was already listening at a different IP address.
solution: Set the correct IP address in the environment handle or let the system choose the correct IP address.

message: cannot use IP address attribute before release 11.2 compatible notifications
cause: An attempt was made to use OCI_ATTR_SUBSCR_IPADDR attribute before release 11.2 compatible notifications.
solution: Change the compatibility to 11.2.

message: invalid combination of string namespace, string presentation and string receive protocol
cause: An invalid combination of namespace, presentation and receive protocol was specified during notification registration. Currently, only AQ namespace is supported with XML presentation. Non-AQ namespace is not supported for e-mail and HTTP receive protocols.
solution: Please change the register call appropriately.

message: invalid combination of notification grouping attributes
cause: An invalid combination of notification grouping attributes was specified. Currently, only TIME notification grouping class is supported. If notification grouping class is zero, all other notification grouping attributes must be zero.
solution: Refer to documentation and change the attributes appropriately.

message: cannot use ntfn grouping attributes on before release 11.0 compatible ntfns
cause: An attempt was made to use notification grouping on before release 11.0 compatible notifications.
solution: Change the compatibility to 11.0.
