message: cannot use ntfn grouping with this receive protocol, presentation and/or QoS
cause: An attempt was made to use notification grouping with e-mail or HTTP receive protocol or XML presentation or payload delivery or reliable QoS. Currently, only OCI and PLSQL receive protocols and default presentation are supported with notification grouping.
solution: Refer to documentation and change the call appropriately.

message: cannot use timeout or grouping with ANONYMOUS namespace
cause: An attempt was made to use timeout or grouping with ANONYMOUS namespace. Currently, timeout and grouping are supported only with AQ and DBCHANGE namespaces.
solution: Refer to documentation and change the call appropriately.

message: cannot use context, QOS and timeout attributes of notification on lower than 10.2 compatible notifications
cause: An attempt was made to use context, QOS and timeout attributes of notification on lower than 10.2 compatible notifications.
solution: Change the database compatibility to 10.2.

message: invalid registration callback
cause: An attempt was made to use a reserved callback for notification registration.
solution: Choose a different name for the notification callback and change the register call appropriately.

message: Invalid namespace attribute specified for the subscription string
cause: An attempt was made to register with invalid namespace attribute.
solution: Refer to documentation and change the namespace appropriately.

message: unregister failed, registration not found
cause: The registration that was asked to be unregistered could not be found.
solution: Please check the callback function name and the subscription name in the unregister call.

message: register, unregister or post has incorrect collection count
cause: The register, unregister or post function was invoked with a collection that was smaller than the size specified by the parameter to the function.
solution: Please check the function's use and ensure that the size parameter is correct.

message: the attribute string is greater than the maximum allowable length of number
cause: The user attempted to pass an attribute that is too long
solution: Shorten the specified attribute and retry the operation.

message: invalid use of bind variable in trigger WHEN clause
cause: A bind variable was used in the when clause of a trigger.
solution: Remove the bind variable. To access the table columns use (new/old).column_name.

message: cannot create this trigger type on this type of view
cause: INSTEAD OF triggers can be created on any view which is not an Editioning View, while BEFORE and AFTER triggers may only be created on Editioning Views.
solution: Change the trigger type to INSTEAD OF or change the view on which you are attempting to create a DML trigger.

message: cannot create INSTEAD OF triggers on tables
cause: Only BEFORE or AFTER triggers can be created on a table.
solution: Change the trigger type to BEFORE or AFTER.

message: cannot change NEW values for this column type in trigger
cause: Attempt to change NEW trigger variables of datatype object, REF, nested table, VARRAY or LOB datatype which is not supported.
solution: Do not change the NEW trigger variables in the trigger body.

message: WHEN clause is not allowed in INSTEAD OF triggers
cause: WHEN clause is specified in an INSTEAD OF trigger.
solution: Remove the WHEN clause when creating an INSTEAD OF trigger.

message: cannot CREATE INSTEAD OF trigger on a read-only view
cause: attempt to create an INSTEAD OF trigger on a view created with read-only option. The view cannot be updated using INSTEAD OF triggers.
solution: Do not create the trigger.

message: cannot specify this column in UPDATE OF clause
cause: Attempt to create a trigger on update of a column whose datatype is disallowed in the clause, such as LOB and nested table.
solution: Remove the UPDATE OF clause.

message: functions or methods not allowed in WHEN clause
cause: PLSQL function call or method invocation is not allowed in the WHEN clause when creating a trigger.
solution: Remove the function call or method invocation from the WHEN clause.

message: no implicit conversion to LOB datatype in instead-of trigger
cause: When inserting or updating a view using instead-of trigger, the new value for a LOB view column is of a different datatype.
solution: Specified a LOB value as the new value for the LOB view column.

message: Nested table clause allowed only for INSTEAD OF triggers
cause: Triggers on nested tables can only be created on view columns using INSTEAD OF triggers.
solution: Use view nested table columns for defining nested table triggers.

message: Invalid nested table column name in nested table clause
cause: The column name specified in the nested table clause of an INSTEAD OF trigger does not correspond to a nested table column.
solution: Specify a nested table column on which the trigger is to be defined.

message: cannot create trigger on internal AQ table
cause: An attempt was made to try to create a trigger on a table that is used internally to support the Advanced Queueing (AQ) feature.
solution: Do not create the trigger.

message: PARENT and NEW values cannot be identical
cause: The referencing clause specifies identical values for PARENT and OLD.
solution: Re-specify either the PARENT or NEW referencing value.

message: OLD and PARENT values cannot be identical
cause: The referencing clause specifies identical values for OLD and PARENT.
solution: Re-specify either the OLD or PARENT referencing value.

message: cannot change the value of a PARENT reference variable
cause: Parent values can only be read and not changed.
solution: Do not attempt to change a Parent variable.

message: cannot perform DML on this nested table view column
cause: DML cannot be performed on a nested table view column except through an INSTEAD OF trigger
solution: Create an INSTEAD OF trigger over the nested table view column and then perform the DML.

message: cannot specify column list for insert into nested table view column
cause: A column list cannot be specified for inserts into the nested table view column.
solution: Specify all the columns for insert into the nested table.

message: cannot reference NEW ROWID for movable rows in before triggers
cause: NEW ROWID was referenced in a before row trigger which is defined on an index-organized table, or a partitioned table with enabled movement of rows. The ROWID cannot be computed in a before row update trigger because it depends on the actual values of the row
solution: Remove references to NEW ROWID from the trigger definition.

message: conflicting trigger string already exists
cause: Conflicting instead of DDL trigger on schema/database already exists.
solution: Remove the old trigger

message: too much concurreny
cause: cannot pin the database/schema because of too much concurrency
solution: try the operation later

message: renaming system triggers is not allowed
cause: renaming system triggers is not allowed
solution: Drop the trigger, and create a new one for the same

message: cannot reference a trigger defined on another table
cause: Referenced trigger in the FOLLOWS clause was defined on another table.
solution: Create the referenced trigger on the same table

message: cannot reference a trigger of a different type
cause: Referenced trigger in the FOLLOWS or PRECEDES clause was either a different type or not a compound trigger.
solution: Create the referenced trigger as the same type or a compound trigger.

message: Cyclic trigger dependency is not allowed
cause: A cycle of trigger dependency can be formed.
solution: Do not create a trigger that can formed a cyclic dependency.

message: cannot specify FOLLOWS for a REVERSE CROSSEDITION trigger
cause: The FOLLOWS clause was specified when creating the REVERSE CROSSEDITION trigger.
solution: Do not create a REVERSE CROSSEDITION trigger with a FOLLOWS clause.

message: cannot specify PRECEDES clause
cause: The PRECEDES clause was specified when creating a FORWARD CROSSEDITION trigger or a regular trigger.
solution: Do not create a FORWARD CROSSEDITION or a regular trigger with a PRECEDES clause.

message: FOR EACH ROW was specified with compound triggers
cause: FOR EACH ROW is not allowed with compound triggers.
solution: Remove the FOR EACH ROW clause.

message: compound triggers cannot be used as system triggers
cause: Compound trigger was defined as system trigger.
solution: Do not use compound trigger as system trigger.

message: regular trigger body can not start with keyword COMPOUND
cause: Regular triggers body should start with BEGIN/DECLARE etc .
solution: Fix the syntax and recompile.

message: compound triggers should always start with keyword COMPOUND
cause: Compound trigger body was started with incorrect keyword.
solution: Fix the syntax and recreate.

message: crossedition trigger cannot be owned by a non-editioned user
cause: An attempt was made to create crossedition trigger in a non-editioned schema.
solution: Enable editions for the user and then create the crossedition trigger.

message: only a crossedition trigger may be specified
cause: The trigger specified was not a crossedition trigger.
solution: Specify a crossedition trigger.

message: crossedition trigger cannot be created in ORA$BASE
cause: An attempt was made to create crossedition trigger in the ORA$BASE edition.
solution: Do not create a crossedition trigger in the ORA$BASE edition.

message: triggers cannot be executed at this time
cause: An attempt was made to execute a trigger when the session was almost finished.
solution: Do not attempt to DML with triggers that are expected to execute when session has almost ended.

message: cannot bypass trigger owned by another user
cause: An attempt was made to do DML from a crossedition trigger on an object that has a non-crossedition trigger owned by another user. DML from a crossedition trigger bypasses the running of non-crossedition triggers; this cannot be allowed for triggers owned by other users.
solution: Permit the non-crossedition trigger to be bypassed by attaching it to the editioning view rather than the table, moving one of the triggers to be in the same schema as the other, or explicitly disabling the non-crossedition trigger.

message: cannot perform DML on remote object from a crossedition trigger
cause: An attempt was made to do DML from a crossedition trigger that would modify data in a remote database. DML from a crossedition trigger has special rules applied regarding what triggers will fire as part of that DML; these special rules cannot be applied across database links and therefore the DML cannot be allowed.
solution: Perform the DML in a helper function separate from the crossedition trigger itself; the special rules are not applied when the DML is not issued from within the crossedition trigger itself.

message: TABLESPACE option can only be used with ALTER INDEX REBUILD
cause: The TABLESPACE option to ALTER INDEX was used without the REBUILD option.
solution: Use ALTER INDEX REBUILD TABLESPACE tablespace name.

message: duplicate REBUILD option specification
cause: The REBUILD option to ALTER INDEX is specified more than once.
solution: Specify the option at most once.

message: PARALLEL option can only be used with ALTER INDEX REBUILD
cause: The PARALLEL option to ALTER INDEX was used without the REBUILD option.
solution: Use ALTER INDEX REBUILD.

message: NOPARALLEL option can only be used with ALTER INDEX REBUILD
cause: The NOPARALLEL option to ALTER INDEX was used without the REBUILD option.
solution: Use ALTER INDEX REBUILD.

message: UNRECOVERABLE option can only be used with ALTER INDEX REBUILD
cause: The UNRECOVERABLE option to ALTER INDEX was used without the REBUILD option.
solution: Use ALTER INDEX REBUILD.

message: RECOVERABLE option can only be used with ALTER INDEX REBUILD
cause: The RECOVERABLE option to ALTER INDEX was used without the REBUILD option.
solution: Use ALTER INDEX REBUILD.

message: only one of PARALLEL or NOPARALLEL clause may be specified
cause: PARALLEL was specified more than once, NOPARALLEL was specified more than once, or both PARALLEL and NOPARALLEL were specified in an ALTER INDEX REBUILD statement.
solution: Remove all but one of the PARALLEL or NOPARALLEL clauses.

message: duplicate TABLESPACE option specification
cause: the TABLESPACE was specified more than once in an ALTER INDEX REBUILD statement.
solution: Remove all but one of the TABLESPACE clauses.

message: standby lock name space exceeds size limit of string characters
cause: The lock name space for the standby database exceeded the maximum string length.
solution: Change initialization parameter _STANDBY_LOCK_NAME_SPACE to a character string of less than the specified characters.

message: standby lock name space has illegal character ' string '
cause: An invalid lock name space was specified for the standby database. The lock name space for the standby database can only contain A-Z, 0-9, '_', '#', '$', '.' and '@' characters.
solution: Change initialization parameter _STANDBY_LOCK_NAME_SPACE to a valid character string.

message: NOSORT may not be used with a bitmap index
cause: An attempt was made to create a bitmap index using the NOSORT option.
solution: Remove NOSORT from the CREATE BITMAP INDEX statement.

message: creation of BITMAP cluster indices is not supported
cause: An attempt was made to create a cluster index with the BITMAP attribute.
solution: Remove BITMAP from the CREATE INDEX statement.

message: maximum number of BITMAP index columns is 30
cause: Too many columns were specified for the index.
solution: Create an index on fewer columns.

message: GLOBAL may not be used with a bitmap index
cause: An attempt was made to create a bitmap index using the GLOBAL option.
solution: Remove GLOBAL from the CREATE BITMAP INDEX statement, and/or add a LOCAL partition descriptor if the table is partitioned.

message: invalid file number specified in the DUMP DATAFILE/TEMPFILE command
cause: An invalid file number was used in dumping a datafile or tempfile.
solution: Specify a valid file number.

message: duplicate BLOCK option specification
cause: BLOCK (MIN/MAX) was specified more than once in the DUMP DATAFILE/TEMPFILE command.
solution: Specify only one BLOCK option.

message: invalid block number specified in the DUMP DATAFILE/TEMPFILE command
cause: An invalid block number was used in dumping a datafile or tempfile.
solution: Specify a valid block number.

message: MIN/MAX/Block Number expected
cause: A value other than MIN/MAX, or a block number was entered in the DUMP DATAFILE/TEMPFILE command.
solution: Correct the syntax.

message: invalid DUMP DATAFILE/TEMPFILE option
cause: An invalid option was specified for the DUMP DATAFILE/TEMPFILE command.
solution: Correct the syntax.

message: LOGGING/NOLOGGING option already specified
cause: In CREATE TABLESPACE, the LOGGING and/or NOLOGGING options were specified more than once.
solution: Remove all but one of the logging specifications.

message: MINIMUM EXTENT option already specified
cause: In CREATE TABLESPACE, the MINIMUM EXTENT option was specified more than once.
solution: Remove all but one of the MINIMUM EXTENT specifications.

message: MINIMUM EXTENT value greater than maximum extent size
cause: In CREATE/ALTER TABLESPACE, the value specified for the MINIMUM EXTENT option was greater than the maximum extent size.
solution: Choose a lower value for the MINIMUM EXTENT option.

message: Only LOCAL bitmap indexes are permitted on partitioned tables
cause: An attempt was made to create a global bitmap index on a partioned table.
solution: create a local bitmap index instead.

message: Too many components specified in the name.
cause: Specifying more components to a name than allowed.
solution: Check the name specified for the operation.

message: Database link name not allowed.
cause: Specifying a database link name when it is not permitted.
solution: Check the name specified for the operation.

message: BUFFER_POOL/FLASH_CACHE/CELL_FLASH_CACHE storage option not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to specify the BUFFER_POOL, FLASH_CACHE, or CELL_FLASH_CACHE storage option. This option may only be specified during - CREATE or ALTER TABLE - CREATE or ALTER CLUSTER - CREATE or ALTER INDEX
solution: Remove this option and retry the statement.

message: Invalid name specified for BUFFER_POOL/FLASH_CACHE/CELL_FLASH_CACHE
cause: The name of the cache hints specified by was invalid. The only valid names for BUFFER_POOL are KEEP, RECYCLE and DEFAULT. The only valid names for FLASH_CACHE and CELL_FLASH_CACHE are KEEP, NONE and DEFAULT.
solution: Use a valid name or remove the BUFFER_POOL, FLASH_CACHE, or CELL_FLASH_CACHE clause.

message: RELY not allowed in NOT NULL constraint
cause: An attempt to set RELY on for NOT NULL constraint.
solution: only NORELY may be specified for a NOT NULL constraint.

message: No insert/update/delete on table with constraint ( string . string ) disabled and validated
cause: Try to insert/update/delete on table with DISABLE VALIDATE constraint.
solution: Change the constraint's states.

message: cannot modify constraint ( string ) - no such constraint
cause: the named constraint does not exist for this table.
solution: Obvious

message: cannot modify primary key - primary key not defined for table
cause: Attempted to modify a primary key that is not defined for the table.
solution: None

message: cannot modify unique( string ) - unique key not defined for table
cause: attempted to modify a unique key that is not deined for the table.
solution: None

message: UNIQUE constraint ( string . string ) disabled and validated in ALTER TABLE EXCHANGE PARTITION
cause: cannot ALTER TABLE EXCHANGE PARTITION when the partition and the table have a disabled and validated unique constraints AND the unique keys in the partion is not mutually exclusive from the rest of the table.
solution: Change the constraint's status.

message: duplicate SINGLE TABLE option specified
cause: The SINGLE TABLE option was specified more than once.
solution: Specify the SINGLE TABLE option only once.

message: keyword TABLE expected
cause: The keyword TABLE is missing from the SINGLE TABLE option.
solution: Place the keyword TABLE after the keyword SINGLE in the command.

message: cannot use the SINGLE TABLE option
cause: The SINGLE TABLE option is only valid for hash clusters.
solution: Do not specify the SINGLE TABLE option.

message: this cluster can contain only one table
cause: An attempt was made to store more than one table in a cluster that was created with the SINGLE TABLE option.
solution: Do not attempt to store more than one table in the cluster.

message: Data value out of range
cause: Value from cast operand is larger than cast target size.
solution: Increase size of cast target.

message: string initialization parameter has been made obsolete
cause: An obsolete initialization parameter has been specified
solution: The system will come up, but parameters must be examined

message: invalid option for CREATE TEMPORARY TABLESPACE
cause: An invalid option appears.
solution: Specify one of the valid options: TEMPFILE, EXTENT MANAGEMENT LOCAL, UNIFORM

message: string space policy cannot be specified for the string extent management
cause: An invalid option appears.
solution: Make sure that for LOCAL extent management UNIFORM or AUTOALLOCATE is specified, and for DICTIONARY extent management UNIFORM or AUTOALLOCATE are not specified

message: invalid EXTENT MANAGEMENT clause
cause: An invalid option appears for EXTENT MANAGEMENT clause
solution: Specify one of the valid options: UNIFORM SIZE, AUTOALLOCATE

message: default storage clause specified twice
cause: default storage clause was specified twice for create tablespace
solution: Specify it once.

message: default storage clause is not compatible with allocation policy
cause: default storage clause was specified for a tablespace with AUTOALLOCATE or UNIFORM policy
solution: Omit the storage clause

message: invalid option for CREATE TABLESPACE with TEMPORARY contents
cause: An invalid option appears.
solution: Specify one of the valid options: EXTENT MANAGEMENT DICTIONARY, USER

message: allocation policy already specified
cause: In CREATE TABLESPACE, the allocation policy was specified more than once, for example, AUTOALLOCATE and UNIFORM.
solution: Remove all but one of the allocation policy specifications.

message: EXTENT MANAGEMENT option already specified
cause: In CREATE TABLESPACE, the EXTENT MANAGEMENT option was specified more than once.
solution: Remove all but one of the EXTENT MANAGEMENT specifications.

message: UNIFORM SIZE value greater than maximum extent size
cause: In CREATE/ALTER TABLESPACE, the value specified for the UNIFORM SIZE option was greater than the maximum extent size.
solution: Choose a lower value for the UNIFORM SIZE option.

message: ONLINE option not permitted
cause: An attempt was made to specify ONLINE for ALTER TABLE MOVE on a table that is not index-organized. The ONLINE option is currently supported only for index-organized tables.
solution: Remove the ONLINE option from the command.

message: Columns of UROWID type may not be indexed
cause: An attempt was made to create an index on a column of UROWID type
solution: Remove the column from the list of indexed columns

message: ALTERING of extent parameters not permitted
cause: An attempt was made to alter the extent parameters for a segment in a tablespace with autoallocate or uniform extent allocation policy.
solution: Remove the appropriate extent parameters from the command.

message: Rollback Segment cannot be created in this tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to create a rollback segment in a tablespace with autoallocate extent allocation policy.
solution: Specify a different tablespace for the rollback segment

message: TEMPFILE cannot be dropped at this time
cause: An attempt was made to drop a TEMPFILE being used by online users
solution: The TEMPFILE has been taken offline. Try again, later.

message: Temporary Tablespace is Empty
cause: An attempt was made to use space in a temporary tablespace with no files.
solution: Add files to the tablespace using ADD TEMPFILE command.

message: column part of USING clause cannot have qualifier
cause: Columns that are used for a named-join (either a NATURAL join or a join with a USING clause) cannot have an explicit qualifier.
solution: Remove the qualifier.

message: column used in NATURAL join cannot have qualifier
cause: Columns that are used for a named-join (either a NATURAL join or a join with a USING clause) cannot have an explicit qualifier.
solution: Remove the qualifier.

message: old style outer join (+) cannot be used with ANSI joins
cause: When a query block uses ANSI style joins, the old notation for specifying outer joins (+) cannot be used.
solution: Use ANSI style for specifying outer joins also.

message: Specified block size string is not valid
cause: An attempt was made to create a tablespace with a block size which is not supported.
solution: Specify one of the valid blocksizes i.e the standard blocksize or one of (2k, 4k, 8k, 16k, 32k) subject to the maximum and minimum blocksizes supported by the platform.

message: Cannot specify RELY for foreign key if the associated primary key is NORELY
cause: RELY is specified for the foreign key contraint, when the associated primary key constraint is NORELY.
solution: Change the option of the primary key also to RELY.

message: Must specify a valid tablespace number
cause: A valid tablespace number was missing.
solution: Specify a valid tablespace number.

message: Must specify a valid relative data block address
cause: A valid relative data block address was missing.
solution: Specify a valid relative data block address.

message: Cannot have both DBA and RDBA options
cause: Both the DBA and RDBA options were passed to ALTER SYSTEM DUMP REDO.
solution: Use either the DBA option or the RDBA option but not both.

message: Must specify both RDBA MIN and RDBA MAX options
cause: Only one RDBA option was passed to ALTER SYSTEM DUMP REDO.
solution: Specify both RDBA MIN and RDBA MAX.

message: Invalid tablespace number or relative data block address
cause: The relative data block adress is invalid for the given tablespace number or the table space number is invalid.
solution: Specify a valid tablespace number or relative data block address.

message: The tag expression is too complex.
cause: The statement tag value was not specified using a simple expression.
solution: Reduce the complexity of the statement tag expression. For example, assign the tag expression to a variable and reference the variable in the error logging clause.

message: no PRIMARY KEY constraint found
cause: A PRIMARY KEY constraint must be defined for a table with this organization
solution: Define a PRIMARY KEY

message: storage specification not permitted for primary key
cause: Storage parameters cannot be defined for a PRIMARY KEY constraint for a table with this organization
solution: Remove storage specification for primary key

message: UNRECOVERABLE option not permitted
cause: The UNRECOVERABLE option may not be specified for a primary key for a table with this organization
solution: Remove UNRECOVERABLE option for primary key

message: duplicate PCTTHRESHOLD storage option specification
cause: The storage option PCTTHRESHOLD is specified more than once.
solution: Specify storage options at most once.

message: invalid PCTTHRESHOLD storage option value
cause: The specified value must be a positive integer.
solution: Specify an appropriate value.

message: PCTTHRESHOLD only valid for certain table organizations
cause: PCTTHRESHOLD can only be specified for tables with certain organizations.
solution: Remove the PCTTHRESHOLD option.

message: missing ON keyword for NESTED INDEX
cause: ON keyword required to specify nested index column nest
solution: Add ON keyword

message: feature not currently available for index-organized tables
cause: An attempt was made to use one or more of the following feature(s) not currently supported for index-organized tables: CREATE TABLE with LOB/BFILE/VARRAY columns, partitioning/PARALLEL/CREATE TABLE AS SELECT options, ALTER TABLE with ADD/MODIFY column options, CREATE INDEX
solution: Do not use the disallowed feature(s) in this release.

message: index-organized table top index segment is in a different tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to drop a tablespace which contains an index only table's overflow segment but not the top index segment"
solution: find index-organized tables which span the tablespace being dropped and some other tablespace(s). Drop these tables.

message: column name expected
cause: A column name is not present where required by the CREATE TABLE for specifying last column to be included in the index segment of the index-organized table
solution: Specify a column name where required by the syntax.

message: index column other than last can not be specified for INCLUDE clause
cause: An index column name other than the last is specified as including column
solution: Specify either a column name which is not part of index-organized table primary key index , or the last key column of the primary key for the INCLUDING clause.

message: INCLUDING clause specified for index-organized table without OVERFLOW
cause: INCLUDING clause of a CREATE TABLE is an valid option only for index-organized tables with OVERFLOW clause (at creation time) or if an OVERFLOW segment already exists (at ALTER time).
solution: Specify OVERFLOW clause for the index-organized table : For ALTER, perform ADD OVERFLOW first.

message: specified exceptions table form incorrect
cause: The specified table does not have the proper field definitions.
solution: Specify the correct table to use.

message: illegal ALTER TABLE option for an index-organized table
cause: During ALTER of a index-organized table, the user attempted to enter one or more of the following options: TABLESPACE, ALLOCATE/DEALLOCATE EXTENT, PCTFREE/PCTUSED for IOT top index segment
solution: Remove the illegal option(s).

message: an index-organized table maintenance operation may not be combined with other operations
cause: ALTER TABLE statement attempted to combine an index-organized table maintenance operation (e.g. changing physical attributes) with some other operation (e.g. ADD constraint) which is illegal
solution: Ensure that a index-organized table maintenance operation is the sole operation specified in ALTER TABLE statement;

message: cannot reference overflow table of an index-organized table
cause: An attempt to directly access the overflow table of an index-organized table
solution: Issue the statement against the parent index-organized table containing the specified overflow table.

message: invalid option for an index-organized table
cause: An attempt to specify one or more of the following options for an index-organized table: [NO]CACHE, NO LOGGING, CLUSTER
solution: Remove the illegal option(s)

message: cannot use COMPRESS option for a single column key
cause: An attempt to use COMPRESS option on single column key
solution: Remove the COMPRESS option.

message: invalid COMPRESS prefix length value
cause: The specified value must be a positive integer less than the number of key columns
solution: Specify an appropriate value.

message: invalid option for index on an index-organized table
cause: An attempt to specify one or more of the following options for index on an IOT: BITMAP, REVERSE, PCTUSED
solution: None

message: keyword MOVE in ALTER TABLE MOVE must immediately follow <table name>
cause: MOVE specified after one/more other ALTER options
solution: Remove the illegal option(s)

message: an overflow segment already exists for the indexed-organized table
cause: An attempt was made to ADD OVERFLOW segment on an index-organized table that already has an overflow segment
solution: None

message: only range, list, and hash partitioning are supported for index-organized table
cause: System, or Composite partitioning schemes are not supported yet
solution: Select a different partitioning scheme

message: partitioning key of a index-organized table must be a subset of the primary key
cause: An attempt to specify a partitioning key which is not a prefix of the primary key of the index-organized table
solution: Select a different partitioning key

message: invalid value string , QUEUE_NAME should be [SCHEMA.]NAME
cause: A NULL parameter was specified for QUEUE_NAME.
solution: Specify a non-NULL queue name.

message: invalid value, VISIBILITY should be ON_COMMIT or IMMEDIATE
cause: An invalid value specified for parameter VISIBILITY.
solution: Specify either ON_COMMIT or IMMEDIATE.

message: invalid value NULL, string should be non-NULL
cause: A NULL value was specified for the parameter.
solution: Specify a non-NULL value.

message: invalid value string , DELAY should be non-negative
cause: A negative value or NULL was specified for DELAY.
solution: Specify a non negative integer for DELAY.

message: invalid value, SEQUENCE_DEVIATION should be BEFORE or TOP
cause: An invalid SEQUENCE_DEVIATION was specified.
solution: Specify either the option 'BEFORE' or 'TOP'.

message: the QUEUE string . string does not exist
cause: The specified queue does not exist.
solution: Create the queue first before specifying it for enqueue or dequeue.

message: enqueue failed, enqueue to exception queue string . string not permitted
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to an exception queue.
solution: Try enqueueing to another queue.

message: enqueue failed, queue string . string is disabled from enqueueing
cause: The queue has been stopped to prevent any further enqueueing.
solution: Enable the queue first by using an administrative operation.

message: RELATIVE_MSGID must be specified if SEQUENCE_DEVIATION is BEFORE
cause: A relative message identifier should be specified if sequence deviation is specified as BEFORE.
solution: Either specify an existing relative message identifier or don't specify sequence deviation as BEFORE.

message: invalid value string , EXPIRATION should be non-negative or NEVER
cause: The expiration is less than zero or NULL.
solution: Specify a valid value for expire_after which should be greater than or equal to zero or NEVER.

message: invalid value for RELATIVE_MSGID, no message in queue with that msgid
cause: No message inm the queue with the msgid equal to the specified RELATIVE_MSGID.
solution: Try again with a valid RELATIVE_MSGID.

message: invalid DELAY specified when using sequence deviation
cause: The DELAY specified in the enqueue is greater than the delay of the message with the given relative message id.
solution: Set the DELAY to be less than or equal to the delay of the message with the given relative message id. If the TOP option is used the delay must be less than or equal to the delay of all the messages in the queue.

message: invalid PRIORITY specified when using sequence deviation
cause: The PRIORITY specified in the enqueue is less than the priority of the message with the given relative message id.
solution: Set the PRIORITY to be less than the delay of the message with the given relative message id. If the TOP option is used the prioirty must be greater than or equal to the priority of all the messages in the queue.

message: message with specified RELATIVE_MSGID has been dequeued
cause: The message specified by the RELATIVE_MSGID field in the sequence deviation BEFORE option has been dequeued.
solution: None

message: cannot specify delay or expiration for enqueue to exception queue
cause: A message was enqueued to the exception queue with either delay or expiration specified.
solution: Enqueue a message without delay or expiration.

message: user_data type and queue type do not match
cause: A user tries to enqueue an object to a queue that was created for objects of different type.
solution: Try enqueue again with an object of the right type.

message: invalid recipient, either NAME or ADDRESS must be specified
cause: Both attributes, NAME and ADDRESS, were specified null for one of the recipients in the recipient list.
solution: Specify a non-null NAME or ADDRESS for the recipient.

message: enqueue failed, visibility must be IMMEDIATE for queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to a non-persistent queue without setting visibility to IMMEDIATE.
solution: Set visibility to IMMEDIATE.

message: enqueue failed, delay must be zero for queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to a non-persistent queue with delay greater than zero seconds.
solution: Set delay to zero.

message: enqueue failed, sequence deviation not allowed for queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to a non-persistent queue with sequence deviation specified.
solution: Do not specify sequence deviation.

message: enqueue failed, signature not specified for a non-repudiable queue
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to a non-repudiable queue without specifying the signature
solution: Give the signature

message: enqueue failed, signature specified queue not supporting non-repudiation
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to a queue specifying the signature for a queue not supporting non-repudiation
solution: Remove the signature

message: enqueue failed, complete sender info. not provided for a queue supporting non-repudiation
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to a queue without giving the complete sender information (name) for a queue supporting non-repudiation
solution: Provide the sender information

message: user_data type used is not supported
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue data into a non persistent queue that is of a type other than the supported raw or object type.
solution: Enqueue the message again with data of raw or object type.

message: sender name must be specified for enqueue into secure queues
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue into a secure queue without specifying a sender name.
solution: Enqueue the message with sender name specified.

message: invalid value string , DEQUEUE_MODE should be REMOVE or BROWSE or LOCKED
cause: An invalid parameter has been specified for DEQUEUE_MODE.
solution: Specify either REMOVE, BROWSE or LOCKED.

message: dequeue failed, queue string . string is not enabled for dequeue
cause: The queue has not been enabled for dequeue.
solution: Enable the queue using START_QUEUE.

message: Propagation job string doesn't exist
cause: The job doesn't exist in AQ$_SCHEDULES or cache.
solution: None

message: timeout or end-of-fetch during message dequeue from string . string
cause: User-specified dequeue wait time has passed or the end of the queue has been reached but no message has been retrieved.
solution: Try dequeue again with the appropriate WAIT_TIME or the FIRST_MESSAGE option.

message: error on transformation of message string string
cause: There was an error when transforming a message at enqueue, dequeue or propagation time.
solution: Correct the transformation function.

message: invalid value string , WAIT should be non-negative
cause: A negative value has been specified for WAIT.
solution: specify a non negative value or FOREVER.

message: cannot dequeue because CONSUMER_NAME not specified
cause: A user tried to dequeue from a queue that has been created for multiple consumers but a CONSUMER_NAME was not been specified in the dequeue options.
solution: Specify the CONSUMER_NAME in the dequeue options.

message: duplicate recipients specified for message
cause: An enqueue was performed with duplicate queue agents in the recipients parameter.
solution: Remove the duplicate queue agent and retry the call.

message: invalid parameter specified for NAVIGATION
cause: An invalid parameter has been specified for NAVIGATION.
solution: Choose one of FIRST_MESSAGE, NEXT_MESSAGE or NEXT_TRANSACTION. Use FIRST_MESSAGE for dequeuing the first message that satisifies the criterion, NEXT_MESSAGE for dequeuing the next message that satisifies the criterion and NEXT_TRANSACTION for moving to a set of messages enqueued by another transaction.

message: NEXT_TRANSACTION navigation option invalid for queue table string . string
cause: The NEXT_TRANSACTION navigation option was used in a dequeue from a queue in a queue table that was not created for transactional grouping.
solution: Specify either FIRST_MESSAGE or NEXT_MESSAGE as the navigation option. If you want to dequeue messages using transactional grouping create the queue in a queue table that has transactional grouping enabled.

message: fetched all messages in current transaction from string . string
cause: The NEXT_TRANSACTION navigation option was used in a dequeue when there were no more messages that belong to the same transaction.
solution: Use the NEXT_TRANSACTION navigation option to move to the next also use the FIRST_MESSAGE option to start from the head of the queue again.

message: buffer too small for user data
cause: The variable or buffer used for the out parameter payload is too small for the user data dequeued.
solution: Increase the size of the buffer or the size of the variable. Maximum size allowed is 32K.

message: navigation option used out of sequence
cause: The NEXT_MESSAGE or NEXT_TRANSACTION option was specified after dequeuing all the messages.
solution: Reset the dequeuing position using the FIRST_MESSAGE naviagtion option and then specify the NEXT_MESSAGE or NEXT_TRANSACTION option.

message: too many recipients specified for message destination string
cause: An ENQUEUE was performed with more than 32 recipients for the given destination (address).
solution: Reduce the number of recipients to 32 or less, and retry the call.

message: message ID not supplied when dequeuing from exception queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to dequeue from a release 8.0-compatible exception queue without including a message ID in the dequeue options.
solution: Check the application to ensure that the queue name has been specified correctly. If the queue name is correct supply a message ID when dequeuing from a release 8.0-compatible exception queue. Otherwise, upgrade the queue_table containing the queue to release 8.1-compatible using the DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE procedure.

message: message ID and dequeue condition/correlation ID specified in dequeue options
cause: An attempt was made to dequeue by including both a message ID and a dequeue condition/correlation ID in the dequeue options. In the dequeue options, you are permitted to specify either message ID or dequeue condition/correlation ID, or neither.
solution: To dequeue a message, specify a message ID or a dequeue condition/correlation ID in the dequeue options, but do not specify both. If you want to dequeue in the queue's sort order, then do not specify either the message ID or dequeue condition/correlation ID in the dequeue options.

message: cannot change correlation ID from string to string without FIRST_MESSAGE option
cause: An attempt was made to change the correlation ID while using the NEXT_MESSAGE or NEXT_TRANSACTION option for dequeuing.
solution: To use a correlation ID that is different from the previous dequeue call, reset the dequeuing position by using the FIRST_MESSAGE navigation option.

message: cannot change subscriber name from string to string without FIRST_MESSAGE option
cause: An attempt was made to change the subscriber name while using the NEXT_MESSAGE or NEXT_TRANSACTION option for dequeuing.
solution: To use a subscriber name that is different from the previous dequeue call, reset the dequeuing position by using the FIRST_MESSAGE navigation option.

message: CONSUMER_NAME cannot be specified when dequeuing from exception queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to dequeue from an exception queue by specifying the CONSUMER_NAME in the dequeue options. CONSUMER_NAME can only be specified when dequeuing from a normal queue created for multiple consumers.
solution: Specify only the message id in the dequeue options to dequeue a message from an exception queue.

message: dequeue index key not found, QUEUE string , rowid string
cause: An internal error was encountered. There may be an inconsistency in the queue table index.
solution: Contact your Oracle customer support representative. You may need to provide the trace file and information about reproducing the error.

message: agent name cannot be specified if address is a single-consumer queue or an exception queue
cause: The agent name for the agent in the LISTEN call was specified when the agent address was a single-consumer queue or an exception queue.
solution: Do not specify the agent name.

message: listen failed, the address string is an 8.0 style exception queue
cause: An 8.0 style exception queue was specified in the agent-list for the LISTEN call.
solution: Specify a normal 8.0 style queue or an 8.1 style queue in the agent-list.

message: string is not a recipient of specified message
cause: The consumer name specified in the dequeue options is not a recipient of the message specified by the message id.
solution: Ensure that the agent specified by the consumer name is a recipient of the message specified by the message id.

message: duplicate agent specified in the agent list
cause: An agent was specified more than once in the agent list of the LISTEN call.
solution: Remove the duplicate agent specification(s), and retry the call.

message: dequeue failed, dequeue not allowed for queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to dequeue from a non-persistent queue.
solution: Dequeue from a different queue.

message: Cannot specify a remote recipient for the message
cause: A recipient for the message enqueued to a non-persistent queue had a non-local address.
solution: Do not specify the address field or specify the queue which is the target of the enqueue

message: exceeded maximum number of recipients for message
cause: An attempt was made to issue an ENQUEUE call that exceeded the the maximum number (1024) of recipients per message.
solution: Reduce the number of recipients to 1024 or less, and retry the call.

message: listen failed, the address string is a non-persistent queue
cause: A non-persistent queue was specified as an address for an agent in the LISTEN call.
solution: Specify a normal queue as address for the agent, and retry the the LISTEN call.

message: listen failed, queue string . string is not enabled for dequeue
cause: An attempt was made to specify a queue that is not enabled for dequeue in a LISTEN call.
solution: Enable the queue for dequeue using START_QUEUE, and retry the LISTEN call.

message: time-out in LISTEN while waiting for a message
cause: The specified wait time has elapsed and there were no messages for any of the agents in the agent-list.
solution: Try the LISTEN call with an appropriate time-out.

message: incorrect subscription string string
cause: An incorrect subscription string was specified with OCIRegister.
solution: Specify a subscription string using the [CONSUMER:]SCHEMA.QUEUE form.

message: consumer cannot be specified with a single-consumer queue or an exception queue
cause: An attempt was made to specify a consumer in the subscription string when registering for notification on a single-consumer queue or an exception queue.
solution: Do not specify the consumer in the subscription string.

message: consumer must be specified with a multi-consumer queue
cause: An attempt was made to register on a multi-consumer queue without specifying a consumer in the subscription string.
solution: Specify a consumer in the subscription string.

message: cannot register for notifications on an 8.0 style exception queue
cause: An attempt was made to specify an 8.0 style exception queue in the subscription string of OCIRegister.
solution: Specify a normal queue or a non-persistent queue.

message: cannot specify protocol for agent
cause: The user specified the protocol attribute for an agent in the agent list.
solution: Do not specify the protocol attribute of the agent object type.

message: JOB_QUEUE_PROCESSES must be at least 2 for AQ propagation
cause: AQ Propagator encountered a setting for JOB_QUEUE_PROCESSES that is insufficient for AQ propagation.
solution: Set the number of JOB_QUEUE_PROCESSES to at least 2 for AQ propagation.

message: agent name cannot be NULL if address is a multi-consumer queue
cause: The name for the agent in the LISTEN call was not specified when the agent address was a multi-consumer queue.
solution: Specify a non-NULL name for the agent.

message: no message in queue string . string with message ID string
cause: An attempt was made to dequeue a message with a specific message ID, but no such message exists in the queue.
solution: Try dequeue again with a valid message ID.

message: cant get signature for this queue
cause: An attempt was made to dequeue the signature from this queue, which is not reciever non-repidiable.
solution: Try dequeue again without the get signature option

message: specified signature for a queue which does not support reciever non-repudiation
cause: An attempt was made to dequeue the message from a queue which does not support reciever non-repudiation, but the signature was specified for verification
solution: Try dequeue again without the signature

message: didnt try to dequeue by message id. with the signature
cause: The signature was specified for a queue, but the dequeue was not done by message id.
solution: Try dequeue again by message id.

message: didnt specify the signature for a reciever non-repudiable queue
cause: The signature was not specified for a reciever non-repudiable queue
solution: Try dequeue again along with the signature

message: didnt dequeue in browse mode with get signature option
cause: The dequeue was not performed in browse mode with get signature option
solution: Try dequeue again in browse mode

message: cant specify sognature with get signature option
cause: The signature is not required for the dequeue with get signature option
solution: Try dequeue again without the signature in dequeue options

message: sender info does not match with the actual sender of the message
cause: The sender info. and the message id. do not match
solution: Try dequeue again without the signature in dequeue options

message: queue table not found for the given queue
cause: The queue table does not exist for the given queue
solution: Provide the right queue name

message: Signature does not exist for the given reciever and message id.
cause: Signature does not exist for the given reciever and message id.
solution: Check the message id. and the reciever's information

message: table specified is not a queue table
cause: An invalid queue table name is specified.
solution: Check the dictionary views to see if the table is a queue table.

message: cannot grant or revoke object privilege on release 8.0 compatible queues
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke object privilege on release 8.0 style queues.
solution: Convert the release 8.0 compatible queue table to release 8.1 compatible using DBMS_AQADM.MIGRATE_QUEUE_TABLE before granting or revoking object privilege.

message: grantee name cannot be NULL
cause: An attempt was made to specify NULL for the grantee parameter.
solution: Specify a valid grantee parameter.

message: dequeue as select not supported before 8.2
cause: Dequeue as select not supported before 8.2.
solution: Dont use select condition while dequeuing

message: complete sender information not provided to non-repudiate sender
cause: complete sender information not provided to non-repudiate sender
solution: Provide the complete sender information

message: complete reciever information not provided to non-repudiate reciever
cause: complete reciever information not provided to non-repudiate reciever
solution: Provide the complete reciever information

message: message id. not provided for non-repudiation
cause: message id. was not provided
solution: Provide the message id.

message: either agent's name or address needed for non-repudiation
cause: neither agent's name nor address provided for non-repudiation"
solution: Provide the agent info.

message: Invalid value string for string
cause: An Invalid value or NULL was specified for the parameter.
solution: Check the documentation for valid values.

message: Invalid value string for array_mode
cause: An Invalid value or NULL was specified for the array_mode.
solution: Check the documentation for valid values.

message: Invalid number of elements in the message properties array
cause: Number of elements in the message properties array do not match the number of elements in the payload array.
solution: Create a message property array with one element (that applies for all the elements in the payload array) or create a message property array with the same number of elements as there are in the payload array.

message: Invalid value string , string should be non-negative
cause: An Invalid value or NULL was specified for the parameter.
solution: Specify a non negative integer.

message: AQ HTTP propagation encountered error, status-code number , string
cause: AQ propagation's HTTP request to the propagation servlet at the specified address encountered an error
solution: Specify a valid address in the connect string of the propagation destination dblink, the dblink user has the correct permissions, check if the AQ propagation servlet was properly installed.

message: Buffer Already Exists
cause: Buffer already exists for the specified queue.
solution: None

message: Cannot complete operation on queue string with existing messages
cause: Queue already has messages. Cannot complete operation
solution: Truncate the queue before adding/dropping a buffer

message: Buffer does not exist for the specified queue
cause: Buffer does not exist for the specified queue
solution: Operation on the buffer cannot be performed. create the buffer

message: Buffer operations are not supported on the queue
cause: Buffer operations are not supported on the specified queue type
solution: Buffered operations are only supported on to 8.1 style queues, which do not have transaction grouping.

message: Lob attributes must be null for buffered operations
cause: Enqueue of a buffered message with a non-null lob attribute was attempted
solution: Set the lob attributes to null before enqueuing the buffered message

message: Cannot propagate user buffered messages to a database with version lower than 10.2
cause: Propagation of user buffered messages was attempted to a database with version lower than 10.2.
solution: Do not propagate buffered messages to the database.

message: Subscriber is not allowed to dequeue buffered messages
cause: Subscriber is only allowed to dequeue persistent messages
solution: Drop the subscriber and re-create it, or dequeue only persistent messages for the subscriber

message: Queue Table string has a buffered queue string
cause: Buffered message was enqueued by specifying delay or sequence deviation.
solution: Do not specify delay of sequence deviation when enqueuing buffered messages.

message: Only immediate visibility mode supported for buffered message enqueue or dequeue
cause: A visibility of dbms_aq.ON_COMMIT was supplied with the buffered message enqueue or dequeue
solution: Supply a visibility of dbms_aq.IMMEDIATE

message: Invalid message delivery_mode
cause: Invalid value was specified for delivery mode
solution: Specify dbms_aq.BUFFERED or dbms_aq.PERSISTENT during Enqueue or dbms_aq.BUFFERED, dbms_aq.PERSISTENT or dbms_aq.PERSISTENT_OR_BUFFERED during Dequeue and Listen.

message: Cannot drop buffer for queue with buffered subscribers
cause: Cannot drop buffer for queue with buffered subscribers
solution: Either drop buffered subscribers or forcibly drop the buffer

message: Cannot enqueue or dequeue user buffered messages to a database with version lower than 10.2
cause: Enqueue or dequeue of user buffered messages was attempted to queues in a database with version lower than 10.2.
solution: Do not attempt to enqueue or dequeue user buffered messages.

message: Operation not possible for non-buffered queue string
cause: Last enqd/ackd message is only supported for buffered queues
solution: The operation is not supported.

message: Buffered operation allowed only on the owner instance
cause: Operation was not performed on the owner instance.
solution: Perform operation on the owner instance.

message: Cannot use priority order queues for capture LCRs
cause: Capture LCRs can only use commit time or enqueue time ordered queues.
solution: Use the appropriate type of queue for captured LCRs.

message: enqueue failed, expiration must be zero for queue string . string
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue to a buffered queue with expiration greater than zero seconds.
solution: Set expiration to zero.

message: Cannot connect to buffered queue's owner instance
cause: cannot connect to the owner instance of the buffered queue
solution: set listener information in REMOTE_LISTENERS or LOCAL_LISTENERS initialization parameter.

message: Enqueue rate too high, flow control enabled
cause: Subscribers could not keep pace with the enqueue rate.
solution: Try enqueue after waiting for some time.

message: Subscriber is Notification only; dequeue not supported
cause: Notification only subscribers are not allowed to dequeue.
solution: Recreate subscriber if necessary.

message: string not supported for non-persistent queue
cause: Specified QOS is not supported for non-persistent queues.
solution: Specify the right QOS.

message: Cannot specify nonzero sender protocol
cause: Sender protocol was specified during an enqueue operation.
solution: Specify the enqueue sender protocol as null or zero.

message: a queue may not subscribe to itself for propagation
cause: The specified subscriber had a NULL name and an address equal to the queue name.
solution: Provide a valid subscriber and retry the operation.

message: a commit-time queue table cannot be migrated to 8.0
cause: An attempt was made to migrate a commit-time queue table to an unsupported compatibility level.
solution: Provide an appropriate compatibility level, and retry the operation.

message: unsupported configuration for propagation of buffered messages
cause: An attempt was made to propagate buffered messages with the database link pointing to an instance in the destination database which is not the owner instance of the destination queue.
solution: Use queue to queue propagation for buffered messages.

message: Late in the current transaction to begin an Enqueue/Dequeue operation
cause: Check if the Enqueue/Dequeue operation is performed via triggers on Materialized Views which isn't supported.
solution: Triggers on materialized views aren't supported. Workarounds are on-demand materialized views or execution of trigger code within an autonomous txn.

message: Propagation stopped because of instance shutdown
cause: A propagation job has stopped because the instance is shutting down.
solution: No user action is required.

message: Propagation stopped because of instance affinity change
cause: A propagation job has stopped because its instance affinity has changed.
solution: No user action is required. The job will restart on the appropriate instance.

message: Queue table repartitioning aborted
cause: During instance restart in an Oracle RAC environment, queue table repartitioning aborted due to errors.
solution: Look at the incident generated for this error and report the problem to Oracle Support Services.

message: Failed to create, alter, or remove Subscriber
cause: There is a pending enqueue or dequeue operation on this queue from the same session.
solution: Either COMMIT or ROLLBACK pending enqueue or dequeue operation before attempting to create, alter, or remove the subscriber.

message: enqueue failed, user property specified but queue string . string is not an 8.1 style queue
cause: user properties can only be specified when enqueueing into 8.1 style queues.
solution: Specify an 8.1 style queue or pass user property as NULL.

message: Array string operation failed for message at index string
cause: Array operation fails for the message at specified index. Look at the remainder of the error stack to see what the problem was.
solution: Fix cause of error and retry array operation.

message: Array size is invalid
cause: Array size must be a positive, non-zero integer.
solution: Use corrected array size and retry array operation.

message: string argument size string is smaller than array size
cause: The size of the argument is smaller than the given array size.
solution: Lower array size or use a larger sized input argument.

message: AQ array operations not allowed on 8.0 queues
cause: An array enqueue/dequeue was attempted on an 8.0 queue.
solution: Use single enqueue/dequeue with this queue.

message: PL/SQL associative arrays may not be used with AQ array operations
cause: A PL/SQL associative array was provided for the payload parameter in an enqueue/dequeue array operation.
solution: Use VARRAY or NESTED TABLE types with AQ array operations.

message: cannot downgrade because there are commit-time queue tables
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade a database that has commit-time queue tables.
solution: Drop all commit-time queue tables before attempting the downgrade.

message: Invalid release value string for queue table compatible parameter
cause: The release level given for the queue table compatible parameter is invalid
solution: Specify a valid release value for the queue table compatible parameter

message: Buffered Queue to Queue propagation did not connect to the correct instance
cause: Queue to Queue propagation for buffered messages didn't connect to the correct instance, most likely because service was not started for the destination queue.
solution: No user action is required. Propagation will start the service for the destination queue and retry.

message: Buffered propagation must restart as the destination queue was recreated/moved
cause: Buffered propagation destination queue was recreated or its ownership was moved to another instance during propagation.
solution: No user action is required. Propagation will reinitialize its metadata and retry.

message: AQ array operations not allowed for buffered messages
cause: An array enqueue/dequeue was attempted for buffered messages
solution: Use single enqueue/dequeue for buffered messages or an array size of one.

message: Cannot contact instance string during Streams AQ operation
cause: The specified instance was not responding to AQ requests.
solution: Set parameter aq_tm_processes to a non-zero value. If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Cannot propagate in queue-to-queue mode to a database with version lower than 10.2
cause: Remote subscriber with queue_to_queue mode set to TRUE was added. The remote subscriber is on a database version lower than 10.2. Propagation was scheduled to a destination database with version lower than 10.2.
solution: Remove the remote subscriber with queue_to_queue mode and add the subscriber back with queue_to_queue set to FALSE. Unschedule the queue-to-queue propagation and schedule propagation in queue-to-dblink mode.

message: operation ' string ' is not allowed for sync_capture ' string '
cause: An attempt was made to execute the specified operation for a sync_capture process.
solution: Remove the offending call.

message: STREAMS ' string ' must be sync_capture
cause: The specified capture STREAMS did not exist or was not a sync_capture process.
solution: Remove the offending call.

message: must use commit-time queue for sync_capture
cause: An attempt was made to create a sync_capture without using a commit-time queue.
solution: Rerun statement with a commit-time queue.

message: sync_capture does not support " string "." string " because of the following reason:
cause: sync_capture encountered a table with an unsupported property. The most common reason is an unsupported column data type.
solution: Revise the Capture rules to skip over the table in question. One option is to remove the rule that captures changes from the unsupported table. Check DBA_STREAMS_TABLE_RULES to determine the rule on the table specified in the error. Also query the DBA_STREAMS_UNSUPPORTED view to determine which tables are not supported by STREAMS and for what reason. For potential workarounds to certain unsupported properties, see Metalink.

message: cannot downgrade because there are apply processes for user buffered messages
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade a database that has apply process for user-buffered messages.
solution: Drop all the apply processes for user-buffered messages before attempting the downgrade.

message: Streams error queue cannot be exported
cause: An attempt was made to export a database that has apply errors.
solution: Delete or reexecute errors before attempting the export.

message: statement has bind variables
cause: Current API could not handle a statement with bind variables.
solution: Use alternative API which handles bind variables.

message: maximum number of concurrent transaction branches exceeded
cause: the limit on the number of concurrent transaction branches has been reached
solution: Increase the INIT.ORA parameter 'transactions' and restart the system.

message: transaction is currently in use
cause: The transaction is currently used by a different session.
solution: Do not switch to a transaction attached to some other session.

message: no current transaction
cause: The user session is not attached to any transaction.
solution: Do not attempt to detach when there is no current transaction.

message: branch marked for deletion
cause: The branch specified cannot be killed immediately because another session is using the branch, but it has been marked for kill. This means it will be deleted as soon as possible after the current uninterruptable operation is completed.
solution: No action is required for the branch to be deleted.

message: must replay fetch
cause: A failure occured since the last fetch on this statement. Failover was able to bring the statement to its original state to allow continued fetches.
solution: This is an internally used error message and should not be seen by the user.

message: can not continue fetches
cause: A failure occured since the last fetch on this statement. Failover was unable to bring the statement to its original state to allow continued fetches.
solution: Reexecute the statement and start fetching from the beginning

message: transaction must roll back
cause: A failure occured while a transaction was active on this connection.
solution: The client must roll back.

message: could not reconnect
cause: The connection to the database has been lost, and attempts to reconnect have failed.
solution: Manually reconnect.

message: lost instance
cause: The primary instance has died.
solution: This is an internally used error message and should not be seen by the user.

message: transaction status unknown
cause: A failure occured while a transaction was attempting to commit. Failover could not automatically determine instance status.
solution: The user must determine the transaction's status manually.

message: could not generate a connect address
cause: Failover was unable to generate an address for a backup instance.
solution: Contact Oracle customer support.

message: connection terminated
cause: The connection was lost while doing a fetch.
solution: This is an internally used error message and should not be seen by the user.

message: can not safely replay call
cause: The connection was lost while doing this call. It may not be safe to replay it after failover.
solution: Check to see if the results of the call have taken place, and then replay it if desired.

message: failover happened during the network operation,cannot continue
cause: The connection was lost when fetching a LOB column.
solution: Failover happened when fetching LOB data directly or indirectly. Please replay the top level statement.

message: connection lost during rollback
cause: The connection was lost while issuing a rollback and the application failed over.
solution: The connection was lost and failover happened during rollback. If the transaction is not externally coordinated, then Oracle implicitly rolled back, so no action is required. Otherwise examine pending_trans$ to determine if "rollback force" is required.

message: remote instance does not support shared dblinks
cause: A shared dblink is being used to connect to a remote instance that does not support this feature because it is an older version.
solution: Use a normal dblink if you need to connect to this instance.

message: cannot downgrade database links after database link data dictionary has been upgraded
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade after the upgrade of the database link data dictionary.
solution: Drop the database links before attempting the downgrade.

message: Break request cannot be propagated over shared database link.
cause: No call in progress over shared database link.
solution: No action required. This is an informational message only.

solution: Check the column values specified, and try again with only one column value for each table alias, and column name.

cause: An attempt to evaluate was made, which failed during the evaluation of the specified rule.

message: rule string . string has errors

message: invalid variable name: string
cause: An attempt to evaluate was made, which failed because one of the attribute values specified had an invalid variable name.
solution: Check the valid variable names in the evaluation context, and try again with a valid name.

message: error string during evaluation of rule set string . string

message: too many attribute values for variable: string

message: duplicate attribute value for variable: string , attribute: string

message: error during evaluation of rule set: string . string for iterator: string

message: evaluation error for rule set: string . string , evaluation context: string . string
cause: An attempt to evaluate the specified rule set using the evaluation context specified failed due to some errors.

message: column name not specified for alias: string
cause: An attempt to evaluate was made, which failed because one of the column values for the specified alias name had a NULL column name.
solution: Check the list of column values, and try again with a valid column name.

message: data not specified for alias: string column name: string
cause: An attempt to evaluate was made, which failed because the column value for the specified alias and column name had NULL data.
solution: Check the list of column values, and try again with valid data.

message: duplicate attribute value for variable: string
cause: An attempt to evaluate was made, which failed because one of the attribute values supplied a value for a variable, which already had a variable value supplied.
solution: Check the variable and attribute values specified, and try again with either a variable value or attribute values for each variable.

message: attribute name not specified for variable: string
cause: An attempt to evaluate was made, which failed because one of the attribute values for the specified variable had a NULL attribute name.
solution: Check the list of attribute values, and try again with a valid attribute name.

message: maximum open iterators exceeded
cause: The open rule hit iterators in the session exceeded 2 * OPEN_CURSORS.
solution: Close some rule hit iterators.
