cause: The user attempted to put unsupported data types, such as LOBs and evolved ADTs, into the rule action context.
solution: Use only supported data types in rule action context.

message: database is not open
cause: Database must be open to perform ALTER SYSTEM QUIESCE RESTRICTED command.
solution: Open the database and retry this command.

message: ALTER SYSTEM QUIESCE RESTRICTED command failed
cause: Database resource manager failed to change plan.
solution: Look at the alert logs to see detailed description of the error.

message: concurrent ALTER SYSTEM QUIESCE/UNQUIESCE command is running
cause: There is a concurrent ALTER SYSTEM QUIESCE RESTRICTED or ALTER SYSTEM UNQUIESCE command running in the system.
solution: Contact the database administrator who is responsible for the concurrent command.

message: cannot open database because the database is being quiesced
cause: Database cannot be opened because the system is being or has been quiesced.
solution: Open the database after the system has been quiesced.

message: the system is already in quiesced state
cause: Cannot quiesce the system because the system is already quiesced.
solution: None

message: the system is not in quiesced state
cause: Cannot unquiesce the system because the system is not in quiesced state.
solution: None

message: resource manager has not been continuously on in some instances
cause: Cannot quiesce the system because resource manager has not been continuously on since startup in this or some other instances.
solution: None

message: resource manager has not been continuously on
cause: Cannot quiesce the system because resource manager has not been continuously on since startup.
solution: None

message: database is not mounted
cause: Database must be mounted to perform ALTER SYSTEM UNQUIESCE command.
solution: Mount the database and retry this command.

message: operation on " string "." string ". string not allowed
cause: A column has been added to a replicated table, but replication support processing has not completed.
solution: Wait until replication support processing has completed before updating the column

message: bad format of _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET: string
cause: One value in _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET is not a valid MTTR.
solution: Alter the value of _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET.

message: bad format of _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET
cause: One value in _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET is empty.
solution: Set the value of _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET properly.

message: too many candidate MTTRs are specified in _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET
cause: Too many candidate MTTRs are specified in _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET.
solution: Alter the value of _DB_MTTR_SIM_TARGET.

message: FAST_START_MTTR_TARGET is not specified
cause: An attempt to start MTTR advisory was made, which failed because FAST_START_MTTR_TARGET was not specified.
solution: Set FAST_START_MTTR_TARGET.

message: MTTR specified is too small: string
cause: The current FAST_START_MTTR_TARGET setting or a candidate MTTR setting is too small for MTTR advisory.
solution: Set a larger FAST_START_MTTR_TARGET or candidate MTTR.

message: MTTR specified is too large: string
cause: The current FAST_START_MTTR_TARGET setting or a candidate MTTR setting is too large for MTTR advisory.
solution: Set a smaller FAST_START_MTTR_TARGET or candidate MTTR.

message: FAST_START_IO_TARGET or LOG_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL is specified
cause: An attempt to start MTTR advisory was made, which failed because either FAST_START_IO_TARGET or LOG_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL was specified.
solution: Set FAST_START_IO_TARGET and LOG_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL to 0.

message: missing where clause in join index specification
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because no valid where clause was found.
solution: Ensure that a where clause with valid join conditions is specified in the create index statement.

message: join index where clause cannot contain OR condition
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because there was an OR branch in the where clause.
solution: Reformulate the where clause without using ORs.

message: join index must only contain inner equi-joins
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because it included a predicate which wasn't an equi-inner join.
solution: Remove the inappropriate predicate.

message: join index cannot be a functional index
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because a functional index was requested or necessary (such as is the case for indexing columns using timezone).
solution: Remove any functional indexing columns.

message: missing primary key or unique constraint on dimension
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because one or more dimensions did not have an appropriate constraint matching the join conditions.
solution: Ensure that the where clause is correct (contains all of the constraint columns) and that an enforced constraint is on each dimension table.

message: all tables must be joined in the where clause
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because one of the tables in the from clause did not appear in the where clause.
solution: Ensure that the where clause contains all from clause tables.

message: join index cannot be created on tables owned by SYS
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because one of the tables was owned by SYS.
solution: Ensure that no join index related table is owned by SYS.

message: join index where clause cannot contain cycles
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because the where clause contains a cycle.
solution: Ensure that the where clause is in the form of a star or snowflake schema.

message: join index where clause predicate may only contain column references
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because a predicate in the where clause contained something other than a simple column.
solution: Ensure that the where clause only contains columns.

message: join index must be of the bitmap type
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because no bitmap keyword was used.
solution: Make the index a bitmap index.

message: join index cannot be based on a temporary table
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because one of the tables was temporary.
solution: Ensure no underlying tables are temporary.

message: join index prevents dml cascade constraint operation
cause: An attempt to execute dml resulted in the need to perform dml on another table because of a cascade constraint. The join index only allows one of its underlying tables to me modified at a time.
solution: Drop the join index or remove the constraint.

message: join index prevents multitable insert or merge
cause: An attempt to execute an merge or multitable insert on a table that was used to create a bitmap join index was made. Merge and multitable inserts are not supported on tables that were used to create a bitmap join index.
solution: Drop the join index.

message: join index must be created on tables
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because the from clause contains non table object.
solution: Ensure that the from clause only contains tables.

message: column type incompatible with join column type
cause: The datatype of the join column is incompatible with the datatype of the joined column.
solution: Select a compatible datatype for the join column.

message: fact table must be included in the from clause
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because the from clause does not contain the fact table.
solution: Ensure that the from clause contains the fact table.

message: join index cannot be based on an index organized table
cause: An attempt to create a join index was made, which failed because one of the tables was an index organized table.
solution: Ensure no underlying tables are index organized.

message: partition load specified but table string is not partitioned
cause: The Loader control file contains a PARTITION clause but the table being loaded is not partitioned.
solution: Remove the partition specification from the SQL*Loader control file and retry the load.

message: Index string specified in SORTED INDEXES does not exist on table string
cause: A nonexistent index was specified in the SORTED INDEXES clause.
solution: Do not specify as a SORTED INDEX.

message: Table string has index defined upon it.
cause: Parallel load was specified into a table which has index defined upon it.
solution: Drop index(es) defined upon table, or don't use parallel load, or use SKIP_INDEX_MAINTENANCE option.

message: parallel load not supported for index-organized table string .
cause: Parallel load is not supported for index-organized tables.
solution: load the index-organized table without the PARALLEL option.

message: Tables loaded through the direct path may not be clustered
cause: User attempted to load a clustered table via the direct path.
solution: Use the conventional path.

message: Invalid handle for direct path load
cause: In direct path load, the handle passed in does not match the type listed.
solution: Verify the handle and type are correct.

message: Incorrect bind variable in column string 's sql expression - string
cause: In direct path load, the bind variables listed in the sql expression do not match the input argument column names.
solution: Verify all the input arguments are listed in the expression as bind variables, and all the bind variables are listed as input arguments to the expression. Or verify that there were no errors in executing the OCI statements when getting the bind variable list.

message: invalid value for SETID or OID column
cause: The value passed in a Direct Path API stream for a column containing a SETID or OID has an invalid value. SETIDs and Object IDs must be either 16 bytes of RAW data or 32 bytes of hexidecimal characters.
solution: Regenerate the Direct Path API stream with a valid value for the SETID column.

message: Invalid syntax or bind variable in SQL string for column string . string
cause: See following error message for more information. A SQL string cannot have quoted strings improperly terminated. A bind variable in a SQL string cannot have a length of 0, cannot exceed maximum length of 30 characters, and cannot be missing a double quote.
solution: Fix the SQL string. See following error for more information.

message: stream verification error: string

solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Column string in table string is NOT NULL and is not being loaded
cause: A column which is NOT NULL in the database is not being loaded and will cause every row to be rejected.

message: Cannot load type string into column string in table string
cause: A column can only store data of type declared for that column. And a substitutable column can only store data of valid subtypes of the supertype declared for that column.
solution: Check that the type or subtype specified is valid for that column.

message: header in file string has an incompatible version number
cause: A dump file was specified for a load operation whose version number is incompatible with the dump file version currently produced by the Oracle server on the system. Usually this message indicates that the dump file was produced by a newer version of the Oracle server.
solution: Load this dump file using the same version of the Oracle server that created the file.

message: List allocated may not be big enough
cause: There seems to be a discrepancy between the size for a list or buffer allocated by direct path api and the size needed.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: unexpected error on string string while retrieving string string
cause: The SQL error was returned from an OCIStmtExecute call.
solution: Correct the SQL error that was returned.

message: Array column string in table string is not supported by direct path
cause: User attempted to load an array column via the direct path.
solution: Use the conventional path.

message: Virtual column string in table string . string cannot be loaded by direct path
cause: You attempted to load an virtual column using the direct path.
solution: Virtual columns cannot be loaded using the direct path.

message: global indexes not allowed for direct path load of table partition string
cause: Global indexes are defined on a table when direct path loading a single partition of the table.
solution: None

message: Column string in table string does not exist
cause: Column specified in the loader control file does not exist.
solution: Make sure the column exists and that you have privileges on it. Correct the loader control file if it is wrong.

message: Column string in table string of type string not supported by direct path
cause: The Specified column of SQL column type %s is not supported by the direct path loader.
solution: If the column is NULLable, remove it from the control file description. Then it will be loaded as a NULL.

message: index string . string loaded successfully with string keys
cause: Non-partitioned index information put to loader log file.
solution: None. Informational only.

message: index string . string partition string loaded successfully with string keys
cause: Partitioned index information put to loader log file.
solution: None. Informational only.

message: index string . string was made unusable due to:
cause: A Non-partitioned index was made index unusable due to the error displayed below this error.
solution: Depending on the error, either rebuild the index, or drop and re-create it.

message: index string . string partition string was made unusable due to:
cause: A partition of a partitioned index was made index unusable due to error displayed below this error.
solution: Depending on the error, either rebuild the index partition, or drop and re-create the entire index.

message: SKIP_UNUSABLE_INDEXES requested and index segment was initially unusable
cause: User requested SKIP_UNUSABLE_INDEXES option, and the index segment * was in unusable state prior to the beginning of the load.

solution: The listed index was put into Index Unusable state due to the user requesting that index maintenance be skipped. Either rebuild the index or index partitions, or drop and re-create the index.

cause: A unique index is in IU state (a unique index cannot have * index maintenance skipped via SKIP_UNUSABLE_INDEXES).
solution: Either rebuild the index or index partition, or use * SKIP_INDEX_MAINTENANCE if the client is SQL*Loader.

message: unique index string . string partition string initially in unusable state
cause: A partition of a unique index is in IU state (a unique index * cannot have index maintenance skipped via SKIP_UNUSABLE_INDEXES).
solution: Either rebuild the index or index partition, or use * SKIP_INDEX_MAINTENANCE if the client is SQL*Loader.

message: index string . string initially in unusable state
cause: An index is in IU state prior to the beginning of a direct * path load, it cannot be maintained by the loader.
solution: Either rebuild the index, re-create the index, or use either * SKIP_UNUSABLE_INDEXES or SKIP_INDEX_MAINTENANCE (Sql*Loader only).

message: index string . string partition string initially in unusable state
cause: A partition of an index is in IU state prior to the beginning * of a direct path load, it cannot be maintained by the loader.
solution: Either rebuild index partition, re-create the index, or use either * SKIP_UNUSABLE_INDEXES or SKIP_INDEX_MAINTENANCE (Sql*Loader only).

message: index string . string had string partitions made unusable due to:
cause: A logical index error occurred on a partitioned index which * affected one or more index partitions, which are listed below * this message.

message: column string . string encryption properties differ for source or target table
cause: The source and destination columns did not have the same * encryption properties.

cause: The Loader control file contains a PARTITION clause but the table being loaded is not subpartitioned.
solution: Remove the subpartition specification from the SQL*Loader control file and retry the load.

cause: An attempt was made to load a system partitioned table with no partition name(s) specified.

cause: Trying to access data in block that was loaded without * redo generation using the NOLOGGING/UNRECOVERABLE option
solution: Drop the object containing the block.

message: DATETIME/INTERVAL datatype conversion error
cause: The column could not be converted from DATETIME * datatype to internal DATETIME/CHARACTER datatype.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: REF column string expects string arguments; found string .
cause: The number of arguments for the REF column is incorrect.
solution: Specify the correct number of input arguments for REFs. 1. Unscoped system-generated REFs can have exactly 1 or 2 input arguments. a) It has exactly 1 input argument (one for the OID value) if a fixed table name was specified through OCI_DIRPATH_EXPR_REF_TBLNAME. b) It has exactly 2 input arguments (one for the table name and one for the OID value) if a fixed table name was not specified through OCI_DIRPATH_EXPR_REF_TBLNAME. 2. Scoped system-generated REFs can have 1 or 2 input arguments. Because a table name argument is not needed for a scoped ref, only 1 argument (OID value) is expected. But if the table name argument is given, it's still accepted. 3. Scoped primary-key REFs with N columns in its primary-key OID can have N or N+1 input arguments. Because a table name argument is not needed for a scoped ref, only N arguments (making up the OID value) is expected. But if the table name argument is given, it's still accepted.

solution: Specify the correct table name for the scoped REF column.

message: Unscoped REF column has non-existent table name.

solution: Specify a valid table name for the unscoped REF column.

message: Direct path load of domain index is not supported for this column type.

message: internal error parsing packed decimal format string
cause: A packed decimal field with a non-zero scale factor is mapped to a character column. In order to perform the datatype conversion, a numeric format string must be created based on the input field's precision and scale specifications. Direct path loader encountered an error in creating this format string.
solution: Examine the packed decimal field's precision and scale specifications and make sure that they contain valid values.

message: Unsupported type number for SQL expression on column string .
cause: The direct path api does not support a SQL expression on a column of that type.
solution: Make sure the types are correct.

message: Row was not loaded due to conversion error.
cause: The current row was not loaded due to a conversion error.
solution: Continue with the load anyways. 260xx - 260xx Direct Path API

message: Direct Path Context prepared for a different mode than operation requested.
cause: The user prepared the direct path context for one operation (Load, Unload, Convert), but then tried to perform a different operation.
solution: Make sure the direct path context mode and operation matches.

message: Invalid buffer specified for direct path unload
cause: The user specified a zero length or null buffer to be used for the Direct Path Unload operation.
solution: Specify a valid buffer and length.

message: Requested direct path operation on a view is not supported.
cause: An attempt was made to load into a view using direct path that has user-defined types, XML data, object type table or SQL expressions.
solution: Do not attempt to use direct path when loading a view that has nonscalar columns or when using SQL expressions on input columns.

message: Conversion is not necessary for this direct path stream.
cause: User attempted to convert a direct path stream that does not require conversion.
solution: Load the stream without conversion it.

message: unexpected error fetching metadata for column string in table string
cause: The direct path API encountered an unexpected error while retrieving metadata for a column.
solution: Contact Oracle support.

message: Data is too large for column string
cause: The direct path API encountered a column that can not be loaded because the input data is too large for a column.
solution: Make the target column larger.

message: Can not convert type identifier for column string
cause: The direct path API encountered a type identifier for a column that can not be loaded because a mapping can not be found for the input value.
solution: Verify the input data.

message: Concurrent direct unloads is not allowed.
cause: User attempted a direct unload when another is still in progress.
solution: Complete the current direct unload before starting another.

message: Can not continue from previous errors.
cause: User attempted to continue a direct path load after receiving an error which indicates the load can not continue.
solution: Address the original error that was returned.

message: Can not flashback to specified SCN value - Wrap: string Base: string .
cause: User specified an SCN which occurs before the last time the table definition was modified.
solution: Specify a more recent SCN.

message: Invalid SCN specified - Wrap: string Base: string .
cause: User specified an invalid SCN.
solution: Specify a valid SCN.

message: check constraint cannot reference column, string , in direct path load
cause: An enabled check constraint was found on a column stored as a lob.
solution: Either disable the check constraint before loading the table data * using the direct path mode, or use the conventional path mode * instead.

message: cannot set or reset value after direct path structure is allocated
cause: Client attempted to set or reset the number of rows in a direct path * structure after it has already been allocated and initialized. * Attributes used is one of the following: * - OCI_ATTR_NUM_ROWS: to set # of rows in a direct path column array * - OCI_ATTR_DIRPATH_DCACHE_SIZE: to set size of a date cache * (default is 0) * - OCI_ATTR_DIRPATH_DCACHE_DISABLE: to set whether date cache will be * disabled on overflow (default is FALSE)
solution: Set the following attributes before: * - OCI_ATTR_NUM_ROWS: before calling OCIHandleAlloc for column array * - OCI_ATTR_DIRPATH_DCACHE_SIZE: before calling OCIDirPathPrepare * - OCI_ATTR_DIRPATH_DCACHE_DISABLE: before calling OCIDirPathPrepare

message: direct path column array is not initialized
cause: Client attempted to allocate a column array for a direct path * function context before allocating a column array for the * table-level direct path context.
solution: Allocate the table-level direct path context's column array * via OCIHandleAlloc before allocating column arrays for * direct path function contexts.

message: file " string " is not part of database being loaded
cause: A parallel load file was specified which is not part * of the database.
solution: Check filename and pathname for correctness.

message: file " string " is not part of table string . string
cause: A parallel load file was specified which is not in the * tablespace of the table being loaded.
solution: Check to make sure that the specified parallel load file * is in the tablespace of the table being loaded.

message: file " string " is not part of table string . string partition string
cause: A parallel load file was specified which is not in the * tablespace of the table (partition, subpartition) being loaded. * When a partitioned table is being loaded, the file must be * in the tablespace of every partition or subpartition * (i.e. each (sub)partition must be in the same tablespace).
solution: Specify a different parallel load file, or no file at all.

message: load of overlapping segments on table string . string is not allowed
cause: Client application is attempting to do multiple direct path load * operations on the same table, but the segments overlap.
solution: Check the partition names (subname attribute of the direct path * context) being loaded. Make sure you are not loading a table, * and a partition of the same table. Make sure you are not * loading a partition, and a sub-partition within the same * partition.

message: unsupported direct path stream version string
cause: The stream version requested is not supported by the server.
solution: Check to make sure that the VERSION attribute of the direct * stream is not being set to an invalid value.

message: direct path context already finished
cause: An OCIDirPathLoadStream operation was attempted after * OCIDirPathFinish was called. Once a direct path operaton * has been finished, no more data can be loaded.
solution: Check program logic to make sure OCIDirPathLoadStream is * not called after OCIDirPathFinish.

message: direct path operation must start its own transaction
cause: A direct path operation is being attempted within a transaction * that has already been started.
solution: Commit the transaction and Prepare the direct path operation again.

message: direct path does not support triggers
cause: A direct path operation is being attempted on a table which * has enabled triggers.
solution: Disable the triggers on the table and try again.

message: scalar column " string " must be specified prior to LOB columns
cause: All scalar columns (i.e. non-LOB and non-LONG columns) must be * specified by the client of the direct path API prior to * specifying any LOB columns.
solution: Specify all scalar columns prior to specifying any LOB columns.

message: LONG column " string " must be specified last
cause: A client of the direct path API specified a LONG column to be * loaded, but the LONG column was not the last column to be * specified.
solution: Specify the LONG column last.

message: row is in partial state
cause: A direct path operation is being finished or a data save request * has been made, but the table for which the request is being made * on has a row in partial state. The row must be completed before * the segment high water marks can be moved.
solution: Either complete the row, or abort the direct path operation.

message: requested direct path operation not supported
cause: A direct path operation was requested that is not supported
solution: Do not use that operation. Currently, UNLOAD is not supported.

message: only LONG or LOB types can be partial
cause: A column which is not a LONG or LOB had the * OCI_DIRPATH_COL_PARTIAL flag associated with it. * Only LONG or LOB type columns can be loaded in pieces.
solution: Do not use the OCI_DIRPATH_COL_PARTIAL flag for the column.

message: input data column size ( number ) exceeds the maximum input size ( number )
cause: The user attempted to specify a column size (%d) that exceeded * the maximum allowable input size (%d)."
solution: Make sure the input column metadata matches the column definition.

message: stream format error: input column overflow
cause: An input stream contained data for more input columns * than specified by the client of the direct path API.
solution: Make sure that the stream being loaded is for the * correct table. Check initialization sequence.

message: unprocessed stream data exists
cause: Either a OCIDirPathLoadStream call was made which provided * more stream data prior to the server being able to fully * process the stream data that it already has, or a * OCIDirPathFinish call was made when the server had * unprocessed stream data.
solution: Most likely an application mis-use of the direct path API. * Make sure that the stream is not being reset inadvertently * prior to any previous stream data being processed, or, that * OCIDirPathFinish is not being called prematurely (i.e. stream * pushed, error encountered and LoadStream not called to process * the remainder of the stream before Finish is called.)

message: transfer size too small for row data ( number bytes required)
cause: Either the transfer buffer size specified, or the default * transfer buffer size (if you did not specify a size), is * too small to contain a single row of the converted row data.
solution: Set the transfer buffer size attribute of the direct path * context to be larger.

message: unsupported conversion for column string (from type number to type number )
cause: The direct path api does not support the required conversion.
solution: Make sure the types are correct. *

message: direct path context is not prepared
cause: A direct path api function was called with a direct path * context which has not been prepared.
solution: Make sure all necessary attributes in the direct path * context have been set, and the context is prepared via * OCIDirPathPrepare.

message: direct path context is already prepared
cause: OCIDirPathPrepare was called with a context that has already * been prepared.
solution: Free the direct path context, set necessary attributes, and * call OCIDirPathPrepare.

message: tablespace # in file header is string rather than string for file string
cause: The tablespace number in the file header is inconsistent with that in the control file.
solution: Check if the control file has been migrated correctly. Retry with the correct control file and data file.

message: relative file # in file header is string rather than string for file string
cause: The relative file number in the file header is inconsistent with that in the control file.
solution: Check if the control file has been migrated correctly. Retry with the correct control file and data file.

message: V6 or V7 data file used to create control file
cause: The file header of the referenced file is in V6 or V7 format.
solution: Either remove the file from the create control file command, or somehow migrate the file header to V8 format.

message: error on caching " string "." string "
cause: Attempt to cache the replication information which is unavailable in the catalog for the object.
solution: Use dbms_reputil.sync_up_rep to validate the replication catalog, or use dbms_reputil.make_internal_pkg to validate internal package.

message: RepAPI operation failure
cause: An external RepAPI operation failed.
solution: consult detail error message.

message: error resignal
cause: An internal service failed and signalled an error"
solution: consult detail error message.

message: internal RepAPI operation failure on object string . string
cause: An unexpected internal RepAPI failure was detected
solution: Contact Oracle support.

message: operation not implemented
cause: The caller requested a RepAPI operation that was not implemented
solution: Do not issue this call.

message: unexpected internal null
cause: An internal buffer control structure was NULL
solution: Verify that sufficient memory resources are available to RepAPI.

message: null global context
cause: An internal buffer control structure was NULL
solution: Verify that sufficient memory resources are available to RepAPI.

message: null master connection
cause: The master connection handle was or became invalid.
solution: Verify that the master connection is valid.

message: null materialized view connection
cause: The client connection handle was or became invalid.
solution: Verify that the client connection is valid.

message: null materialized view control structure
cause: An internal materialized view control structure could not be obtained.
solution: Check that the owner and users provided are correct.

message: materialized view name: ' string ' is greater than max. allowed length of string bytes
cause: The specified materialized view name was too long.
solution: Shorten the materialized view name.

message: master table ' string . string ' not found
cause: A RepAPI operation was attempted against a non-existent or invalid master table
solution: Verify that the master table object exists.

message: error pushing transaction to def$error
cause: An unexpected error occurred while sending an def$error rpc to the master site
solution: Verify that the DBMS_DEFER package is valid and executable by the RepAPI client. Contact the local or master site administrator, if necessary.

message: push error: master proc. string $RP. string failed for trans: string seq: string
cause: A conflict/error occurred at the master site while executing a $RP.rep_insert(), rep_update(), or rep_delete() function which was not handled by conflict resolution logic at the master.
solution: Notify master site system adminstrator or DBA.

message: object ' string . string ' not found
cause: The specified object was expected but not found.
solution: Verify that the specified object exists and is valid.

message: no master log available for ' string . string '
cause: The specified master log was not found or available for the named table.
solution: Create the master log at the master site or correct any problems that may exist with the log.

message: no push transaction acknowledgement
cause: RepAPI was unable to confirm that the last pushed transaction was successfully commited by the master site.
solution: Verify that the communications link between the local site and the master site is still valid. If the transaction has not been committed at the master, repush the transaction.

message: materialized view control entry for ' string . string ' was not found
cause: The specified materialized view catalog control reocrd was not found.
solution: Verify that the local materialized view catalog is valid and that the local materialized view is properly defined.

message: push queue synchronization error detected
cause: Client tried to repush a transaction has already been committed at the master site. A common cause of this problem is an error at the local site in initializing or updating the local site transaction sequence mechanism.
solution: Verify that transaction data that RepAPI was attempting to repushed to the master site exists at the master table and is valid and consistent with the local site. If this error occurs, redundantly identified transactions are ignored and then purged from the local updatable materialized view logs. Check that the local site is correctly assigning new transactionIDs and is not accidently generating non-unique values.

message: no memory available to allocate
cause: There was no memory left for the RepAPI process. This error may occur when RepAPI is trying to allocate a new table buffer area.
solution: Shutdown one or more local applications to attempt to free heap memory and retry the RepAPI operation.

message: internal memory failure
cause: An internal memory error was detected.
solution: Check if other errors have occurred or determine if any local application may have corrupted the memory subsystem.

message: rpc initialization error
cause: An error occurred during the initialization of a PL/SQL rpc.
solution: Verify that the procudure to be invoked exists and is valid at the master site and is executable by the RepAPI user.

message: rpc execution error
cause: An error occurred during the execution of a PL/SQL rpc.
solution: Check the error messages from the remote procedure and fix any remote site problems that may be preventing the execution of the invoked rpc.

message: rpc termination error
cause: An error occurred during the termination of a PL/SQL rpc. This is usually caused by master site being unable to close an opened cursor or if RepAPI cannot deallocate internal memory.
solution: Fix any server side problems first, determine if the RepAPI memory subsystem has been corrupted.

message: nls subsystem initialization failure for product= string , facility= string
cause: The NLS product/facility error message file could not be located or properly initialized.
solution: Check that the error message directory and file(s) have been properly installed.

message: session connection attempt failed for string (@ string )
cause: A connection could not be established to the specified database using the provided connection string.
solution: Check that the user, password, connect string, names services, network, and any remote site listener process are properly installed and working.

message: materialized view sql ddl parse/expansion failed for string . string
cause: The client sql materialized view definition query could not be properly parsed by the master Oracle site.
solution: Check that materialized view ddl sql is compatible with the currently connected version of Oracle and does not violate any of the RepAPI sql limitations or restrictions.

message: local store callback init phase failed for ' string . string '
cause: The client callback failed during its INIT phase for the named object.
solution: Verify that the objects referenced by the client callback exist and are valid. Refer to the vendor-specific callback error code reference to diagnose the local problem. Record all error state and notify Oracle support.

message: local store callback proc phase failed for ' string . string '
cause: The client callback failed during its PROC phase for the named object.
solution: Refer to the vendor-specific callback error code reference to diagnose the local problem. Record all error state and notify Oracle support.

message: local store callback term phase failed for ' string . string '
cause: The client callback failed during its TERM phase for the named object.
solution: Refer to the vendor-specific callback error code reference to diagnose the local problem. Record all error state and notify Oracle support.

message: unable to build materialized view refresh control list
cause: The materialized view control list could not be constructed. This is generally the result of an error while accessing the local materialized view catalog.
solution: Verify that the named materialized view(s) are properly defined and valid.

message: replication parallel push simulated site failure
cause: A parallel push executed with event 26531 enabled raises this error to simulation failure of network or destination site.
solution: Do not enable the event for normal operation.

message: collision: tranID number ignored and purged
cause: A transaction that was pushed had a transaction ID that collided with a transaction that was previously pushed and committed at the master site.
solution: See the action section for E_QUEUESYNC (26518).

message: number byte row cache insufficient for table with rowsize= number
cause: A transaction that was pushed had a transaction ID that collided with a transaction that was previously pushed and committed at the master site.
solution: Increase the RepAPI row buffer size or reduce the width of the replicated tables.

message: refresh was aborted because of conflicts caused by deferred transactions
cause: There are outstanding conflicts logged in the DEFERROR table at the materialized view's master site.
solution: Resolve the conflicts in the master DEFERROR table and refresh again after the table is empty. Alternatively, refresh with REFRESH_AFTER_ERRORS, even if there are conflicts in the master's DEFERROR table. Proceeding despite conflicts can result in an updatable materialized view's changes appearing to be temporarily lost, until a refresh succeeds after the conflicts are resolved.

message: renaming this table is not allowed
cause: Attempt to rename a replicated table, an updatable materialized view table or the master table of a materialized view for which a materialized view log has beencreated.
solution: If desired, unregister the replicated table with dbms_repcat.drop_master_repobject, or use the recommended procedure to rename the master table of a materialized view.

message: string argument is not of specified type
cause: User passed type of the given argument number doesn't match with the type of the argument in the stored arguments.
solution: Invoke correct type procedure (i.e. get_XXX_arg)

message: Call to <type>_arg made before calling dbms_defer.call
cause: User invoked <type>_arg procedure before starting a deferred call
solution: Invoke various procedures in the correct order.

message: Couldn't open connect to string
cause: Failed to open connection using given dblink
solution: Make sure that the dblink is valid and remote m/c is up.

message: string . string . string : number of arguments ( string ) does not match replication catalog
cause: number of arguments does not match replication catalog
solution: examine total number of arguments for the rpc call

message: string . string . string : argument string does not match replication catalog
cause: the (rpc) call is corrupted
solution: examine total number of arguments and each argument for the rpc call

message: remote database does not support replication parallel propagation
cause: The remote database has a version lower than Oracle 8.0 and hence does not understand replication parallel propagation.
solution: Use serial propagation or upgrade the remote database to Oracle 8.0 or above.

message: cannot acquire SR enqueue
cause: An attempt to acquire the SR enqueue in exclusive mode failed.
solution: None

message: PRESERVE TABLE can not be used when dropping old style materialized view string . string
cause: The materialized view consists of a view and a container table.
solution: Drop the materialized view without PRESERVE TABLE option.

message: string string background process string might not be started successfully
cause: An error occurred during creation of a capture or apply background process.
solution: Review V$STREAMS_CAPTURE and V$STREAMS_APPLY_COORDINATOR views for the status of these processes. Also check the trace file for more information.

message: Unable to start or stop capture process string
cause: An attempt was made to start or stop a capture process while another capture process was concurrently starting or stopping.
solution: You cannot concurrently start or stop capture processes. Wait before attempting to start or stop additional capture processes.

message: Capture string did not start properly and is currently in state string
cause: An attempt to restart a capture process failed.
solution: Review V$STREAMS_CAPTURE view for the state of the capture process. Also check the trace files for more information.

message: Apply string did not start properly and is currently in state string
cause: An attempt to restart an apply process failed.
solution: Review V$STREAMS_APPLY% views for the state of the apply process. Also check the trace files for more information.

message: Capture string attempted to connect to apply string already configured for string
cause: An attempt was made by a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams Capture or XStream In to connect to an Apply that is already connected in the other mode.
solution: You cannot connect a capture to an apply already configured for another apply mode. Create or connect to another apply.

message: Invalid string specified for string procedure
cause: An attempt was made to execute the specified procedure with an invalid SCN value.
solution: Resubmit procedure with a valid SCN value.

message: Invalid action context value for string
cause: The value specified in the action context is invalid for use in GoldenGate, XStream or Streams.
solution: Check that the type and value are correct.

message: unable to process string Data Dictonary information for object
cause: The database is unable to process GoldenGate, XStream or Streams Data Dictionary for this object.
solution: Check that the compatibility for the database supports the object, and check the trace file for information about the object.

message: error queue for apply process string must be empty
cause: The error queue for this apply process contains error entries.
solution: Execute or delete errors in the error queue.

message: cannot create string process string
cause: An attempt was made to create a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process when another was being created concurrently.
solution: Wait for the creation of the other GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process to finish before attempting to create the process.

message: string process string already exists
cause: An attempt was made to create a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process that already exists.
solution: Either specify another process or remove the existing GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process.

message: cannot alter string process string
cause: An attempt was made to alter a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process that is currently running.
solution: Stop the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process with FORCE parameter set to TRUE and reissue the command.

message: invalid string parameter string
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid parameter.
solution: Check the documentation for valid parameters.

message: string process string exists
cause: An attempt to remove the component failed because it is associated with the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process.
solution: Either remove the process manually or specify the "cascade" option in dbms_streams_adm.remove_queue.

message: parameter string inconsistent with parameter string
cause: An attempt was made to specify a subprogram parameter value that is inconsistent with another parameter value.
solution: Check the documentation for valid parameter values.

message: No capture is found for queue ' string '
cause: An attempt was made to add an XStream outbound server to a queue using uncommitted data mode when no co-located Streams capture was configured for that queue.
solution: Change to committed data mode or configure a local Streams capture for the specified queue then retry the operation.

message: maximum number of string processes exceeded
cause: Cannot create additional GoldenGate, XStream or Streams processes since the maximum number of processes has been reached.
solution: Remove existing GoldenGate, XStream or Streams processes and retry the operation.

message: timeout occurred while stopping string process string
cause: Timeout occurred while waiting for a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process to shut down.
solution: Retry the operation. If the error persists, try stopping the process with the FORCE option, or contact Oracle Support Services.

message: duplicate column name string
cause: An attempt was made to specify a duplicate column name in an LCR.
solution: Remove the duplicate column and retry the operation.

message: Column mismatch in ' string . string ' (LCR: string type= string ; DB: string type= string )
cause: The columns in the LCR were not the same or not found in the database table.
solution: Alter the database table.

message: cannot create string capture process string
cause: GoldenGate, XStream or Streams capture process could not be created because one or more parameters contain invalid value.
solution: Refer to trace file for more details.

message: Table ' string . string ' has string columns in the LCR and string columns in the replicated site
cause: The number of columns in the LCR was not the same as the the replicated site.
solution: Alter the table structure

message: string downstream capture process string cannot proceed
cause: Database global name has been set to a value which is same as the source database name of the downstream capture process.
solution: Change database global name to a value other than the source database name for the downstream capture.

message: string downstream capture process for source database string must be created at database string first
cause: A GoldenGate, XStream or Streams downstream capture process was nonexistent when this operation was attempted.
solution: Create a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams downstream capture process, then retry the operation.

message: operation not allowed on LOB or LONG columns in LCR
cause: Certain operations on LOB/LONG columns of the LCR through rule-based transformations, DML handlers, or error handlers were not allowed.
solution: Do not perform restricted operations on LOB or LONG columns in LCRs. See the documentation for operations that are restricted on LOB/LONG columns in LCRs.

message: object type not supported
cause: The specified object type is not supported.
solution: Retry with a supported object type.

message: command type not supported
cause: The specified command type is not supported.
solution: Retry with a supported command type.

message: invalid value for publication_on
cause: The publication_on parameter should be either 'Y' or 'N'
solution: Retry with a proper value for publication_on.

message: invalid value for value_type
cause: The value_type parameter should be either 'OLD' or 'NEW'
solution: Retry with proper value_type.

message: invalid value for value_type
cause: The value_type parameter should be one of 'OLD', 'NEW' or '*'
solution: Retry with proper value_type.

message: cannot apply transactions from multiple sources
cause: Transactions from multiple sources were sent to the same apply process.
solution: Create multiple apply processes and create appropriate rules so that transactions from only one source reach an apply process.

message: cannot capture from specified SCN
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid SCN.
solution: Retry with a valid SCN.

message: no instantiation SCN provided for " string "." string " in source database " string "
cause: Object SCN was not set. If the object is a table, then both fields will be filled, for example "SCOTT"."EMP". If the object is a schema, only one field will be set, for example "SCOTT"."". And if the object is the entire database, no fields will be set, for example ""."".
solution: Set the SCN by calling DBMS_APPLY_ADM.SET_%_INSTANTIATION_SCN

message: missing key in LCR
cause: Metadata mismatch, or not enough information in the user generated LCR.
solution: Alter the database object, or provide all defined keys in the LCR.

message: column datatype mismatch in LCR
cause: The datatypes of columns in the LCR are not the same as the datatypes in the database object.
solution: Alter the database object.

message: datatype not supported at non-Oracle system
cause: One of the columns of the LCR being applied was of a datatype not supported by either the target non-Oracle system or by the Oracle transparent gateway through which the apply is being done.
solution: Do not apply data of this type. If possible, filter out columns containing such datatypes before applying.

message: operation not supported at non-Oracle system
cause: The apply process attempted an operation that is either not supported by the non-Oracle system or by the Oracle transparent gateway through which the apply is being done. Some kinds of DML (like procedure and function calls) and all DDL will cause this error to be raised.
solution: Do not attempt to apply such LCRs to non-Oracle systems. If possible, filter out such LCRs before applying.

message: invalid value string , string should be in string format
cause: The parameter specified was not in the correct format.
solution: Specify the parameter value in the correct format.

message: string string process dropped successfully, but error occurred while dropping rule set string
cause: An attempt to drop an unused rule set failed after dropping the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams proccess successfully.
solution: Check existence of rule set and manually drop if necessary.

message: error while enqueueing into queue string . string
cause: An error occurred while enqueueing a message.
solution: If the situation described in the next error on the stack can be corrected, do so.

message: error on call to string : return code string
cause: A locking related call failed.
solution: Try the call again after fixing the condition indicated by the return code.

message: no string data dictionary for object with number string and version number string from source database string
cause: An attempt to access the database object failed because the data dictionary for the object was either never populated or it was purged.
solution: Make sure the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams data dictionary is created by calling DBMS_CAPTURE_ADM.PREPARE_%_INSTANTIATION.

message: LCR contains extra column ' string '
cause: The LCR contained more columns than the replicated table.
solution: Alter the database object.

message: string did not have a string rule set
cause: The GoldenGate, XStream or Streams client does not have a rule set of the indicated type.
solution: Verify that the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams client has a rule set of the specified type, and retry the operation.

message: string message consumer string already exists
cause: An attempt was made to create a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams message consumer that already exists.
solution: Either specify another message consumer or remove the existing GoldenGate, XStream or Streams message consumer.

message: string process string does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to access a GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process which does not exist.
solution: Check with the relevant security views for the correct name of the object.

message: cannot downgrade capture process after Streams data dictionary has been upgraded
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade a capture process after it has upgraded the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams data dictionary.
solution: Drop the capture process before attempting the downgrade.

message: cannot downgrade capture process
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade a capture process that has a higher version than the downgrade release version.
solution: Drop the capture process after capture has finished consuming all the redo logs before attempting the downgrade.

message: remote DDL not supported by STREAMS : dblink string
cause: The apply process attempted to apply a DDL LCR via a dblink. This is not supported.
solution: Do not attempt to apply DDL LCRs via a dblink. If possible, filter out DDL LCRs before applying.

message: Streams RFS restart
cause: Remote file server (RFS) process was restarted to reflect a change in DOWNSTREAM_REAL_TIME_MINE option of the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams capture process.
solution: No action required. This is an informational message only.

message: incompatible version marker encountered during Capture
cause: Capture process cannot mine redo from a version higher than the current software release version.
solution: Drop and recreate the capture process.

message: remote table does not contain a primary key constraint
cause: The master table for remote apply does not constain a primary key constraint or the primary key constraint has been disabled.
solution: Create a primary key constraint on the master table or enable the existing constraint.

message: remote object is " string "." string "\@" string "
cause: See the preceding error message to identify the cause. This message names the remote object, usually a table or view, for which an error occurred when GoldenGate, XStream or Streams tried to access it for remote apply.
solution: See the preceding error message.

message: remote object does not exist or is inaccessible
cause: GoldenGate, XStream or Streams replication could not access the named table or view at a remote database to apply changes.
solution: Confirm that the given remote table or view exists and is accessible through the given database link. When using a Heterogeneous Services database link to access a non-Oracle system, it may be necessary to check administration details for network connections at the non-Oracle system.

message: User Error string encountered during apply process
cause: An error was encountered during an apply process.
solution: Query the DBA_APPLY_ERROR view to determine the error and take the appropriate action.

message: time limit reached
cause: The specified time limit was reached for the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process.
solution: Restart the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process, increasing the TIME_LIMIT parameter if necessary.

message: message limit reached
cause: The specified message limit was reached for the Capture process.
solution: Restart the Capture process, increasing the MESSAGE_LIMIT parameter if necessary.

message: SCN limit reached
cause: The specified SCN limit was reached for the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process.
solution: Change the MAXIMUM_SCN parameter, then restart the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams process.

message: transaction limit reached
cause: The specified transaction limit was reached for the Apply process.
solution: Restart the Apply process, increasing the TRANSACTION_LIMIT parameter if necessary.

message: enqueue of the LCR not allowed
cause: An apply process attempted to enqueue an LCR with a LONG column. This is not supported.
solution: Modify rules or unset the enqueue destination to prevent LCRs with LONG columns from being enqueued by the apply process.

message: user " string " requires the role " string "
cause: The caller did not have the specified role or called the procedure from a definer's rights package or procedure.
solution: Grant the specified role to the caller. If the procedure is called from a definer's rights package or procedure, change the definer's rights package or procedure to an invoker's rights package or procedure. Or grant all the privileges for the specified role explicitly.

message: only SYS is allowed to set the Capture or Apply user to SYS.
cause: The Capture or Apply user was specified as SYS by a user other than SYS.
solution: Set SYS as the Capture or Apply user while logged in as SYS.

message: cannot downgrade apply handlers
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade apply handlers that are not associated with a local database object, or the apply handlers are associated with a specific apply process.
solution: Drop the associated apply handlers before attempting the downgrade.

message: standby and DOWNSTREAM_REAL_TIME_MINE are incompatible
cause: An attempt was made to set the standby database and DOWNSTREAM_REAL_TIME_MINE option of the Oracle GoldenGate, XStream or Oracle Streams capture process on the same database.
solution: Do not attempt to set the DOWNSTREAM_REAL_TIME_MINE option for a Oracle GoldenGate, XStream or Oracle Streams capture process on a standby database. Do not attempt to change a database role to standby if there exists a capture process with the DOWNSTREAM_REAL_TIME_MINE parameter set to Y.

message: Cannot alter queue_to_queue property of existing propagation.
cause: The queue_to_queue property was specified for an existing propagation.
solution: Pass NULL for the queue_to_queue argument.

message: string ' string ' already exists
cause: An attempt to use FILE GROUP, FILE GROUP VERSION, or FILE GROUP FILE failed because the item in question already exists.
solution: Remove the object if appropriate and re-attempt the operation.

message: string ' string ' does not exist
cause: A FILE GROUP, FILE GROUP VERSION, or FILE GROUP FILE was specified that does not exist.
solution: Make sure the object exists and re-attempt the operation.

message: invalid file group string privilege
cause: The specified privilege number that was specified is invalid.
solution: Check specification of dbms_file_group for valid privileges.

message: timed-out waiting for file group lock
cause: The procedure waited too long while getting a lock to perform a file group repository operation.
solution: Retry the operation.

message: different datafiles_directory_object parameter must be specified
cause: The attempted operation involved datafiles platform conversion which required the datafiles_directory_object parameter to be specified for placing the converted data files.
solution: Retry the operation after specifying a valid datafiles_directory_object parameter. This directory must be different from the directory objects for any of the datafiles for the specified file group version.

message: operation not allowed on the specified file group version
cause: One or more datafiles or export dump file(s) were missing from the specified file group version.
solution: Retry the operation after adding all the data files and Data Pump dump file(s) to the specified version.

message: Data Pump error
cause: A Data Pump error occurred when the procedure performed a File Group Repository operation.
solution: Check the error stack and trace file for error details.

message: version string already has an export dump file
cause: A Data Pump dump file was added to a file group version that already has a dump file.
solution: Remove the existing dump file if appropriate, and retry the operation.

message: string ' string ' is not empty
cause: The FILE GROUP or FILE GROUP VERSION being dropped contained objects.
solution: Remove the child objects, then retry the operation.

message: cannot downgrade because there are file groups
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade a database that has file groups.
solution: Drop all file groups before attempting the downgrade.

message: cannot assemble lobs
cause: An attempt was made to assemble lobs, but the compatibility of the source database for the LOB information is lower than 10.2.0.
solution: Set ASSEMBLE_LOBS to FALSE in the DML or error handler while this handler is processing LOB information from a source database with a compatibility level lower than 10.2.0.

message: Maximum number of ignored transactions exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to add more than the allowed number of ignored transactions.
solution: Please clear the current list of ignored transactions.

message: string capture process " string " does not support " string "." string " because of the following reason: string
cause: GoldenGate, XStream or Streams capture encountered a table with an unsupported property. The most common reason is an unsupported column data type.
solution: Revise the Capture rules to skip over the table in question. One way might be to add a negative rule excluding changes from the unsupported table from being captured. Also query the DBA_STREAMS_UNSUPPORTED view to determine which tables are not supported by GoldenGate, XStream or Streams and for what reason. Consider adding negative rules for any tables that may be captured, but are present in this view. For potential workarounds to certain unsupported properties, see Metalink.

message: cursors ( string ) are not sufficient
cause: The maximum number of open cursors was too small for GoldenGate, XStream or Streams Apply.
solution: Increase the value of open_cursors.

message: DDL rule " string "." string " not allowed for this operation
cause: A DDL rule was specified for this operation.
solution: Specify a non-DDL rule for this operation.

message: The one-to-many transformation function string encountered the following error: string
cause: The specified transformation function encountered an error.
solution: Ensure that the function does not process or return DDL LCRs. Also ensure that the function does not return NULL.

message: The one-to-one transformation function string encountered the following error: string
cause: The specified transformation function encountered an error.
solution: Ensure that the function does not return an LCR that has a different type from the LCR which was passed to the function. Also ensure that the function does not return NULL. For DDL transformation functions, creating and returning a new DDL LCR is not allowed.

message: Unsupported LCR received for " string "." string "
cause: GoldenGate, XStream or Streams capture process received an LCR with unsupported operation from LogMiner.
solution: If this object is listed in DBA_STREAMS_UNSUPPORTED view, modify rules to prevent changes made to this object from getting captured.

message: Mismatched columns found in ' string . string '
cause: The columns in the LCR were not the same as the table in the database.
solution: Alter the database table.

message: cannot specify both one-to-one transformation function string and one-to-many transformation function string
cause: Both a one-to-one transformation function and a one-to-many transformation function were specified for a rule.
solution: Remove either the one-to-one transformation function, or the one-to-many transformation function.

message: Could not find message number string for transaction with id string
cause: Error
solution: Contact Oracle support"

message: Standby Redo Logs not available for real time mining
cause: Standby Redo Logs required for real time mining by downstream capture process were not available.
solution: Check the configuration of Standby Redo Logs and retry the operation at a later time. To start the capture process without real time mining property, reset DOWNSTREAM_REAL_TIME_MINE parameter of the capture process and retry the operation.

message: Cannot autogenerate name for parameter string because of the following reason: string
cause: An error was encountered while attempting to generate a name for a parameter which was passed a NULL value.
solution: If possible, fix the error, otherwise specify the parameter name explicitly.

message: invalid file type " string "
cause: An invalid file type was specified for the ASM file.
solution: Check documentation for valid ASM file types.

message: invalid parameter " string " for local capture " string "
cause: An invalid parameter was specified for the local capture process.
solution: Check documentation for valid parameters.

message: invalid parameter " string " for downstream capture " string "
cause: An invalid parameter was specified for the downstream capture process.
solution: Check documentation for valid parameters.

message: Unexpected redo pattern encountered by LogMiner
cause: d by tables with unsupported data types or newer table features.
solution: Remove the capture rule for the table and restart capture.

message: Not enough redo log information for LogMiner
cause: Direct-path SQL with NOLOGGING option or a SQL*Loader operation with UNRECOVERABLE clause was specified for the table.
solution: Remove the capture rule for the table and restart capture.

message: Maximum number of unsupported tables exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to add more than the allowed number of unsupported tables.
solution: Clear the current list of unsupported tables.

message: Object has a NULL value
cause: A method was invoked on a NULL object.
solution: Initialize the object with a non-NULL value.

message: A row with key string exists but has conflicting column(s) string in table string
cause: The row to update or delete exists in the table but had conflicting value for some columns.
solution: For Streams, please define a conflict resolution, or resolve the conflict and execute the error transaction using DBMS_APPLY_ADM.EXECUTE_ERROR. For logical standby, please verify the status of the database guard to ensure local modifications are not allowed, then re-instantiate the table and contact support if the problem persists.

message: The row with key string does not exist in table string
cause: The row to update or delete does not exist in the table.
solution: For Streams, please define a conflict resolution, or resolve the conflict and execute the error transaction using DBMS_APPLY_ADM.EXECUTE_ERROR. For logical standby, please verify the status of the database guard to ensure local modifications are not allowed, then re-instantiate the table and contact support if the problem persists.

message: The column string is not encrypted in the local database.
cause: The column in the destination database is NOT encrypted while it is encrypted in the source database.
solution: Set the corresponding column property in the destination database to 'encrypted' or change the apply parameter, PRESERVE_ENCRYPTED_COLS, to 'N' to supress the error.

message: Cannot split propagation string because only one propagation originates from its source queue " string "." string "
cause: Only one propagation originated from the propagation source queue.
solution: Please do not split this propagation.

message: Requesting a lock on string " string " timed out
cause: Could not get a lock on the object because another process was holding the lock.
solution: Please try later.

message: Cannot split or merge propagation " string "
cause: A process tried to split or merge this propagation, but failed and left STREAMS in an inconsistent state.
solution: Query DBA_RECOVERABLE_SCRIPT_BLOCKS view, and roll back the script which tried to split or merge this propagation.

message: Invalid source database name string
cause: The value for the source database global name was not valid.
solution: Specify a valid database global name. If the source database is not the local database, check the listener is up and running.

message: Number of capture processes that enqueued message to queue " string "." string " not equal to one
cause: Split-merge API requires only one capture process enqueued message to the queue where the propagation originated
solution: Please drop one capture, or split or merge another propagation.

message: Hierarchically enabled tables not supported
cause: Hierarchically enabled tables are not supported.
solution: Disable hierarchy for the table.

message: Cannot modify an LCR received from an XStream outbound server
cause: An attempt was made to modify an LCR generated by an XStream outbound server.
solution: Clone the LCR generated by the XStream outbound server by using the provided OCILCR* functions, such as OCILCRNew, OCILCRHeaderSet, and OCILCRRowColumnInfoSet. Then modify the cloned LCR.

message: XStream Out feature unsupported below compatible 10.2.0
cause: An attempt was made to create an XStream outbound server at compatibility below 10.2.0.
solution: Upgrade database compatibility to 10.2.0 or higher then retry.

message: LOB logical change record (LCR) missing LOB column in table " string "." string "
cause: The apply slave could not fill update LOB because of missing LOB column.
solution: Check that all LOB columns have been sent correctly.

message: Apply not the only subscriber for " string "." string ".
cause: The combined capture and apply optimization could not be used since Apply was not the lone subscriber to the queue.
solution: Apply has to be the only subscriber to the queue.

message: More than one subscriber for " string "." string ".
cause: Multiple subscribers were found when the combined capture and apply optimization was configured to only work for one subscriber.
solution: Configure a single subscriber, apply or propagation for the queue, or enable the optimization for multiple subscribers.

message: Queue " string "." string " has messages.
cause: The combined capture and apply optimization could not be used since the queue had messages.
solution: Make sure queue is empty before starting apply and capture.

message: Subscribers have changed for queue " string "." string ".
cause: The combined capture and apply optimization could not be used since the subscribers had changed.
solution: Optimization can be used only if the queue has a single subscriber.

message: Apply " string " is disabled.
cause: The apply process was disabled or aborted.
solution: Start the apply process.

message: Queue " string "." string " has rule based subscribers.
cause: The combined capture and apply optimization could not be used since the queue had rule based subscribers.
solution: Make sure queue has no rule based subscribers before starting apply and capture.

message: Remote database could not support combined capture and apply optimization.
cause: The remote database has a version lower than Oracle 11.0 and hence does not understand combined capture and apply optimization.
solution: Upgrade the remote database to Oracle 11.0 or above in order to use the combined capture and apply optimization.

message: Database link is not NULL for Apply with the name " string " .
cause: The combined capture and apply optimization could not be used since apply_database_link was not NULL.
solution: Drop and recreate the apply with NULL value for apply_database_link.

message: Apply process string died unexpectedly.
cause: Apply process died unexpectedly.
solution: Check your system for anomalies and restart apply. If this error persists, contact Oracle Support Services. See trace file for more details.

message: Capture aborted: checkpoint-free mode requires combined capture and apply mode.
cause: The requirements for combined capture and apply mode were broken.
solution: Restore the combined capture and apply mode and then restart the capture. If combined capture and apply mode is no longer desired, drop the existing checkpoint-free capture and create another one that will take checkpoints.

message: Apply " string " on database " string " is in the mode of combined capture and apply.
cause: The combined capture and apply optimization could not be used because Apply was already in the mode of combined capture and apply.
solution: Do not configure two captures for one apply.

message: Client has already attached to string apply " string ".
cause: The client has already attached to the specified apply process.
solution: Detach apply process before reattach.

message: An active session currently attached to XStream server " string ".
cause: An attempt was made to attach to the specified XStream server while another session was attached to it.
solution: Retry when there is no session attaching to the specified XStream server.

message: The value for argument "ARRAY_SIZE" is too small
cause: The value for argument "ARRAY_SIZE" was less than the number of columns in the requested column list.
solution: Check the return value for "NUM_COLUMNS" parameter then allocate all input arrays to at least that size and invoke the same OCI function again.

message: The value for argument string exceeds maximum string
cause: The value for specified value exceeded the maximum allowed.
solution: Correct the value of specified argument.

message: Error from Apply Network Receiver for Apply " string " and Capture " string ".
cause: The Apply Network Receiver aborted due to an unexpected error.
solution: Query DBA_APPLY_ERROR to determine the error and then restart the Capture and Apply.

message: string apply process " string " (OS id string ) is exiting due to ORA- string .
cause: An apply process encountered an unexpected error.
solution: Query DBA_APPLY to examine the status of Apply and restart Apply if needed.

message: string capture process " string " is unable to communicate with capture server string during initialization.
cause: Capture server might not be started properly
solution: Fix any errors during capture server creation and re-start capture process

message: string capture process string receives an error from capture server.
cause: Capture server received an error.
solution: Check log for error details.

message: string capture server for apply " string " and capture " string "encounters disabled or aborted propagation " string ".
cause: Propagation was disabled or aborted.
solution: Start propagation.

message: string capture server for apply " string " and propagation " string " becomes active and needs join capture process " string ".
cause: Capture server was waiting for propagation or apply to start
solution: Capture process needs restart (done automatically).

message: No propagation process found between source queue " string "." string " and destination queue " string "." string ".
cause: Propagation has not been configured.
solution: Configure a propagation between specified queues and restart capture.

message: Failure in creating capture servers (ksv error code string ).
cause: Failure in ksv slave creation.
solution: Identify the actual ksv error and act accordingly.

message: string capture server string is unable to communicate with capture process " string ".
cause: Capture process was not started properly or was aborted.
solution: If Oracle GoldenGate, XStream or Streams capture process was stopped, then restart the capture process. Otherwise, fix any errors during the capture process creation and restart the capture process.

message: user-defined XStream callback error
cause: A value other than OCI_CONTINUE or OCI_SUCCESS was returned for the user-defined XStream callback function. Any returned value other than OCI_CONTINUE or OCI_SUCCESS is invalid.
solution: Verify that either OCI_CONTINUE or OCI_SUCCESS is returned from the user-defined XStream callback function.

message: STREAMS process " string " is not configured as an XStream outbound server.
cause: An attempt was made to attach to a STREAMS apply process, which was not configured as an XStream outbound server.
solution: Check the apply name or re-create the apply process as an XStream outbound server.

message: string apply coordinator and apply slave are unable to communicate.
cause: GoldenGate, XStream or Streams Apply process may have died unexpectedly.
solution: Check your system for anomalies and restart apply. If this error persists, contact Oracle Support Services. See trace file for more details.

message: Insufficient privileges to attach to XStream outbound server " string ".
cause: Sufficient privileges were not granted to attach to the specified XStream outbound server.
solution: Query DBA_XSTREAM_OUTBOUND view to get the connect_user value for the specified outbound server. Then modify the application to connect to the outbound server's database using this value.

message: XStream outbound server " string " requires combined capture and apply mode.
cause: The specified XStream outbound server was not in combined capture and apply mode.
solution: Restore the combined capture and apply mode and then restart the capture.

message: Cannot set "DISABLE_ON_ERROR" parameter to 'N'.
cause: An attempt was made to change the "DISABLE_ON_ERROR" parameter for an XStream outbound server to 'N'.
solution: Remove invalid statement.

message: Cannot define handler for an XStream outbound server.
cause: An attempt was made to define a handler for an XStream outbound server.
solution: Remove invalid statement.

message: Cannot delete or execute error transaction from XStream outbound server " string ".
cause: An attempt was made to delete or execute an error transaction from the specified XStream outbound server.
solution: Remove invalid statement.

message: Unable to create XStream outbound server " string " due to existing handler.
cause: An attempt was made to create the specified XStream outbound server while there was a handler defined for the specified server.
solution: Use DBMS_APPLY_ADM.SET_DML_HANDLER procedure to remove all handlers defined on the specified server then retry statement.

message: string failed to update acknowledgment SCN for propagation " string " from capture " string " to apply " string ".
cause: propagation might have been modified after GoldenGate, XStream or Streams was started.
solution: Ensure propagation is configured properly and restart GoldenGate, XStream or Streams.

message: Unable to alter parameter ' string ' because string capture process is not configured to run locally
cause: An attempt was made to alter the specified capture parameter when the GoldenGate, XStream or Streams capture process was not configured to run on the local database.
solution: Remove the invalid parameter or use DBMS_CAPTURE_ADM.ALTER_CAPTURE procedure to alter the parameter.

message: The source database for XStream outbound server " string " is invalid
cause: An attempt was made to add an XStream outbound server with a source database that was different from the associated capture's source database.
solution: Correct the value for the 'source_database' parameter in the call.

message: The specified rules must be created from the same subsetting condition
cause: An attempt was made to remove an outbound server's subset rules when the specified INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE rules were not created from the same subsetting condition.
solution: Correct the rules in the statement.

message: Server " string " is not an XStream inbound server
