cause: illegal operation on secondary objects of a domain index
solution: Try appropriate operation on the domain index.

message: invalid XPATH or NAMESPACE option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate option.

message: invalid syntax for PARAMETERS
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid option.
solution: Check and use valid options.

message: option not supported for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid option.
solution: Check and use valid options.

message: illegal operation on the Path Table
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate command on the XML Index.

message: invalid ALTER INDEX option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate option.

message: invalid Path Table option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate option.

message: invalid Path Id Index option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate option.

message: invalid Order Key Index option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate option.

message: invalid Parent Order Key Index option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate option.

message: invalid Value Index option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
solution: Use the appropriate option.

message: The XML Index is not locally partitioned.
cause: An attempt was made to create a global partitioned XML Index.
solution: Do not attempt to create global partitioned XML Index or to maintain a non-local partitioned XML Index.

message: Partitioned XML Index not yet supported.
cause: An attempt was made to create a partitioned XML Index.
solution: Do not attempt to create partitioned XML Index.

message: Invalid Input.
cause: The input to the function is not valid.
solution: Make sure the input is valid (both syntactically as well as semantically).

message: Invalid option for a partition of an XML Index
cause: An invalid option was specified at the partition level.
solution: Remove the invalid option.

message: Maximum order key depth exceeded
cause: The document could not be indexed because its nesting depth was more than that allowed by XML Index.
solution: Remove the offending document.

message: The XMLType column has to be declared as virtual
cause: The XMLType column was not declared as virtual when creating a structured XMLIndex.
solution: The XMLType column has to be declared as virtual when creating a structured XMLIndex.

message: The virtual XMLType column for chaining is missing
cause: The virtual XMLType column for chaining was missing when creating a structured XML index.
solution: A virtual XMLType column for chaining has to be specified when creating a structured XML Index.

message: XML Index with more than one virtual column is disallowed
cause: An attempt was made to create an XML Index with more than one virtual column.
solution: Create only one virtual column.

message: XML Index on XML DB repository does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to operate on a non-existent XML Index on XML DB repository.
solution: First create the index using DBMS_XDB_ADMIN.CREATEREPOSITORYXMLINDEX. Try the operation again.

message: Metadata of XML Index corrupted
cause: An attempt to locate the XML Index failed.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: XML Index on an Index Organized Table is not yet supported
cause: XML Index supported only on Heap Organized Table.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: insufficient privileges to change owner of resource string
cause: An attempt was made to change the <Owner> field of an XML DB resource without sufficient privileges to do so.
solution: Switch to SYS before performing the ownership change, or have the intended recipient of the resource perform the transfer.

message: cannot use DOM to add special attribute to schema-based parent
cause: An attempt was made to add or remove an xsi:schemaLocation, xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation, xsi:type, or xsi:nil attribute to or from a schema-based XML node using DOM.
solution: Use the updateXML operator instead of DOM.

message: Invalid argument for DOM stream
cause: Either a null or a nonleaf node was passed.
solution: Use a combination of DOM API and DOM streams to produce desired effect.

message: DOM streams operations cannot be performed on null/invalid node
cause: The node is NULL or inexistent
solution: Check the input parameters.

message: Streams operations over non-existent stream
cause: The stream passed is NULL or invalid.
solution: Check the input parameters.

message: XSL processing of XML failed with error LPX- string
cause: An LPX routine (XML/XSL processing) returned an error while tranforming an XML doc.
solution: Look up the LPX error and follow its corrective action.

message: transformation error: string
cause: Error occurred while transforming an XML doc with an XSL style sheet.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: XML context creation failed while string
cause: Error occurred while creating XML context.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Resource ' string ' is not an XDB schema document
cause: The given schema URL does not refer to a registered XDB schema
solution: Make sure the specified schema has been registered in XDB

message: Invalid resource handle or path name " string "
cause: An invalid resource handle or path name was passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver.
solution: Pass a valid resouce handle or path name to the hierarchical resolver.

message: Path name string is not a container
cause: XDB expected the given path name to represent a container.
solution: Pass a path name or resource handle that represents a container.

message: Parent string already contains child entry string
cause: An attempt was made to insert a duplicate child into the XDB hierarchical resolver.
solution: Insert a unique name into the container.

message: Length string of the BLOB in XDB$H_INDEX is below the minimum string
cause: In the XDB$H_INDEX table, the CHILDREN column, a BLOB, must have a certain minimum length without being chained. The calculated length of the LOB was less than the stated minimum.
solution: Set the value of the init.ora parameter db_block_size to at least 2K. For XDB to run at its fastest, set db_block_size to 8K.

message: Path name length string exceeds maximum length string
cause: The length of a path name passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver exceeded the maximum length.
solution: Choose a shorter path name.

message: Path name segment length string exceeds maximum length string
cause: The length of a path name segment passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver exceeded the maximum length of a path name segment.
solution: Choose a shorter path name segment.

message: Attempted to delete non-empty container string / string
cause: An attempt was made to delete a non-empty container in the XDB hierarchical resolver.
solution: Either perform a recursive deletion, or first delete the contents of the container.

message: LPX context creation failed while string
cause: Error occurred while creating LPX context because of an unexpected NULL value.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Access denied for property string
cause: An attempt was made to access a property you don't have access to
solution: Check the ACL to see what privileges you have for this property

message: XML element index string exceeds maximum insertion index string
cause: An attempt was made to insert an XML element at an invalid index location in the node.
solution: Choose a new index that falls within the allowed range.

message: XML parsing failed
cause: XML parser returned an error while trying to parse the document.
solution: Check if the document to be parsed is valid.

message: Given XPATH expression not supported
cause: XPATH expression passed to the function is currently unsupported.
solution: Check the xpath expression and change it to use a supported expression.

message: Invalid XPATH expression
cause: XPATH expression passed to the function is invalid.
solution: Check the xpath expression for possible syntax errors.

message: Attempted to delete the root container
cause: An attempt was made to delete the root container in the hierarchical index.
solution: Do not delete the root container.

message: Attempted to insert entry without name
cause: An attempt was made to insert an entry into the hierarchical resolver without a child name.
solution: Supply a child name and try inserting again.

message: Attempted to delete entry without name
cause: An attempt was made to delete an entry from the hierarchical resolver without a child name.
solution: Supply a child name and try deleting again.

message: Error generating unique OID for XML document
cause: An error occurred while generating a globally unique OID for storing an XML document.
solution: None

message: Error deleting XML document
cause: The XMLType object pointed to by the given REF could not be deleted because either the REF was invalid or it pointed to a non-existent table.
solution: Either use FORCE deletion or supply a valid REF.

message: Recursive deletion snapshot too old for string / string
cause: Changes were made to the structure of a directory while it was being recursively deleted.
solution: Try deleting the directory again.

message: The operation is not allowed, Reason: string
cause: The operation attempted is not allowed
solution: See reason and change to a valid operation.

message: Element definition not found
cause: The element definition was not found.
solution: Supply the definition for the element or use a defined element.

message: Element not found
cause: The element was not found.
solution: Make sure the specified element exists.

message: Index size error
cause: The index is greater than the allowed value.
solution: Make sure the index is less than allowed value.

message: Parser initialization failed with LPX- string error while string
cause: Error occurred while initializing a parser.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Invalid document element
cause: An attempt was made to replace the data at an invalid index number in the XML document
solution: Supply a correct occurrence number and try again.

message: unable to allocate additional memory while string
cause: A dynamic memory allocation failure occurred.
solution: Report this problem to a database administrator.

message: Path name or handle string does not point to a resource
cause: An attempt was made to retrieve a resource based on a path name or resource handle that points to an entity other than a resource.
solution: Do not attempt to retrieve a resource based on that path name or resource handle.

message: Resource metadata length string exceeded maximum length string
cause: An attempt was made to insert resource metadata that exceeded the maximum length of that type of metadata.
solution: Keep resource metadata within its allowed length.

message: Cannot bind to unsaved resource
cause: An attempt was made to bind to a resource that had not been saved to disk.
solution: Bind only to saved resources.

message: Unable to retrieve XML document
cause: The resource had an invalid (dangling) REF to an XML document.
solution: Rebind the resource using a valid XMLType REF.

message: cannot create context to parse an XPath string
cause: Error occurred while parsing an XPath.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: XML parsing failed with error LPX- string while string
cause: An LPX routine returned an error while transforming an XML doc.
solution: Look up the LPX error and follow its corrective action.

message: Requested number of XML children string exceeds maximum string
cause: An attempt was made to add more than the maximum number of allowable children in an XML element.
solution: Redefine the schema to allow breaking up of the children among siblings.

message: invalid node set encountered while executing string
cause: The given node set was either NULL or has an invalid type associated with it.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Could not bind locked resource to path string / string
cause: An attempt was made to bind an existing resource to a new location in the hierarchy, but a lock could not be obtained on the resource.
solution: Commit or roll back the transaction that has the lock on the resource.

message: XSL processing context initialization failed
cause: A error occurred while creating a XSL context.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Invalid XML attribute name string
cause: The attribute name in the XML document did not match anything in the associated schema.
solution: Supply only schema-defined or XML standard attributes.

message: Invalid string value: " string "
cause: The text in the XML document did not represent a valid value given the datatype and other constraints in the schema.
solution: Ensure that the specified value in XML documents is valid with respect to the datatype and other constraints in the schema.

message: XML namespace length string exceeds maximum string
cause: The length of the disk-formatted XML namespace exceeded the maximum.
solution: Keep XML namespace declarations below the maximum length.

message: Property string : XML type ( string ) not compatible with internal memory type ( string )
cause: The XML datatype given is inconsistent with the database datatype, and a conversion cannot be made.
solution: This is an internal error, generally resulting from corruption of the compiled XML schema. Re-register schemas, or contact Oracle support.

message: Property string : Memory type ( string ) not compatible with database type ( string )
cause: The memory type associated with this property is mapped to an incompatible database type, and a conversion cannot be made.
solution: This is an internal error, generally resulting from corruption of the compiled XML schema. Re-register schemas, or contact Oracle support.

message: Too many properties in type ' string '
cause: The type can only have the same number of properties (elements and attributes) as a table can have columns.
solution: Modify the XML schema to move properties into subelements that are not inlined.

message: Element ' string ' not globally defined in schema ' string '
cause: The specified element name has not been defined at the top level of the XML schema (i.e. globally). Elements must be defined globally to be the root of an XMLType object.
solution: Check the XML schema definition to make sure the specified element name has been defined at the top level.

message: Top-level prefix length string exceeds maximum string
cause: An attempt was made to save to disk a top-level XML namespace prefix whose length exceeded the maximum.
solution: Do not define XML namespace prefixes that exceed the maximum length.

message: Cannot store more than string extras outside the root XML node
cause: An attempt was made to store more than the maximum number of XML extras (e.g. comments and processing instructions) either before or after the document's root node.
solution: Keep the number of extras outside the root node below the maximum.

message: Incorrect argument(s) specified in the operator
cause: One or more of the arguments specified in the operator in the query are incorrect
solution: Correct the arguments specified in the operator

message: Could not retrieve resource data at path string
cause: An error occurred while retrieving the contents and/or metadata of a resource.
solution: Contact Oracle customer support.

message: Unsaved resources cannot be updated
cause: An attempt was made to update a resource that was never saved to disk.
solution: Perform a resource insertion instead.

message: Access denied
cause: The requested access privileges have not been granted to the current user. User must be granted privileges prior to resource access.
solution: Check the set of requested access privileges to make sure that they are included in the set of access privilges granted to the user.

message: Requested access privileges not supported
cause: The requested access privileges are not supported for the specified resource.
solution: Ensure that the set of requested access privileges are valid access privileges for the specified resource.

message: Cannot delete ACL with other references
cause: The requested deletion of an ACL resource cannot proceed. The ACL is in use by other resources.
solution: Remove the resources that are making reference to the ACL in question and try again.

message: The value of the depth argument in the operator cannot be negative
cause: The value of the depth argument passed to the primary operator is not a positive integer
solution: Pass a positive value of the depth argument

message: The string operator cannot have an ancillary operator
cause: An ancillary operator was used with an operator which does not does not support ancillary operators
solution: Remove the ancillary operator in the query

message: A null XMLType element cannot be inserted into RESOURCE_VIEW
cause: The element which is being inserted into the RESOURCE_VIEW is NULL
solution: Specify a non-null XMLType element to insert into RESOURCE_VIEW

message: The document being inserted does not conform to string
cause: The XMLType element being inserted into the RESOURCE_VIEW does not conform to the specified Schema
solution: Insert an element which conforms to the specified Schema

message: Display Name of the element being inserted is null
cause: The Display Name of the element which is being inserted into the RESOURCE_VIEW is null
solution: Specify the Display Name and insert the element into RESOURCE_VIEW

message: cannot modify read-only XOBs
cause: Read-Only XOBs cannot be modified.
solution: Use only read operations on such a XOB.

message: Cannot insert root XML document node if it already exists
cause: An attempt was made to insert a root node into an XML document that already had a root node.
solution: Call the appropriate replace function to replace the node instead of inserting it anew.

message: Resource at path string could not be deleted
cause: An error occurred while deleting the named resource. The specific error can be found one lower on the error stack.
solution: Look at the next error on the stack and take approprate action.

message: XDB error: string
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
solution: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Cannot delete an unsaved resource
cause: An attempt was made to delete a resource that had not been saved to disk.
solution: Delete only saved resources.

message: XPath compilation failed: string . string
cause: XPath compilation failed for specified reason.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Cannot instantiate abstract element or property [ string ]
cause: An attempt was made instantiate an abstract element.
solution: Use only read operations on such elements.

message: Cannot modify read-only property [ string ]
cause: An attempt was made to modify an immutable XML node.
solution: Use only read operations on such properties.

message: Insertion of string into string creates a cycle
cause: An attempt was made to insert a link into the XDB hierarchy that would create a cycle in the tree.
solution: Ensure that links to existing resources do not cause cycles.

message: XML nodes must be updated with valid nodes and of the same type
cause: An attempt was made to use updateXML to update an XML node with a node of another type.
solution: Ensure that the node specified by the XPath matches the type of new data provided.

message: updateXML expected data format [ string ] instead of [ string ]
cause: An attempt was made to use updateXML to update data with a node of the incorrect type. Text and attribute nodes must be updated with string data, whereas element nodes must be updated with XMLType data.
solution: Use CREATEXML or getStringVal to coerce the new data to the proper format.

message: Cannot apply typed changes to non-schema-based XMLType nodes
cause: An attempt was made to insert, delete, or update a non-schema-based XMLType node using an XML schema definition.
solution: Make changes to non-typed nodes only by referencing their tag names.

message: Invalid database user ID string
cause: An attempt was made set an invalid user ID into an XDB resource metadata property.
solution: Verify the validity of the user ID and try again.

message: Invalid database username or GUID string
cause: An attempt was made to set an invalid username or GUID into an XDB resource metadata property.
solution: Verify the validity of the username or GUID and try again.

message: Too many child nodes in XMLType fragment for updateXML
cause: An attempt was made to pass an XMLType fragment with multiple children as new data for the updateXML operator.
solution: Extract the desired child from the XMLType before passing it to updateXML as the desired new XML node.

message: Resource not retrieved using path name
cause: An attempt was made to access the path name of a resource that was either never saved to disk or was loaded using a method other than with its path name.
solution: Perform path name operations only on resources obtained using a path name.

message: XML comment length string exceeds maximum string
cause: The length of the disk-formatted XML comment exceeded the maximum.
solution: Keep outer XML comments declarations below the maximum length.

message: invalid string declaration in XML Schema
cause: The XML schema contains an invalid declaration identified by the message.
solution: Fix the identified error and try again.

message: required attribute " string " not specified
cause: The XML schema does not specify a required attribute.
solution: Specify a value for the required attribute.

message: invalid attribute " string " specified
cause: The XML schema specifies an invalid attribute.
solution: Remove specification of the invalid attribute.

message: error in SQL mapping information
cause: There is an error in the SQL type and table specification within the XML Schema.
solution: Ensure that all specified SQL types and tables are valid and compatible with the corresponding XML types.

message: unable to resolve reference to string " string "
cause: The identified type or attribute or element could not be resolved.
solution: Make sure that the name corresponds to a valid XML (simple/complex) type or attribute or element and try again.

message: type not specified for attribute or element " string "
cause: The identified attribute or element does not have a type.
solution: Make sure that every attribute and element has a valid type specification.

message: name not specified for global declaration
cause: The XML schema does not specify the name for the global declaration of attribute or element or simpleType or complexType.
solution: Specify names for all global declarations.

message: invalid attribute " string " specified in declaration of " string "
cause: The XML schema specifies an invalid attribute.
solution: Remove specification of the invalid attribute.

message: error while creating SQL type " string "." string "
cause: An error occurred while trying to create the SQL type based on the specification of a complex type.
solution: Fix the identified error and try again.

message: error while creating table " string "." string " for element " string "
cause: An error occurred while trying to create the table based on the declaration for the identified element.
solution: Fix the identified error and try again.

message: schema " string " already registered
cause: An attempt was made to register a schema with the same URL as a previously registered schema.
solution: Register the schema with a different URL.

message: insufficient privileges to register schema " string "
cause: An attempt was made to register a schema without sufficient privileges.
solution: Make sure that the user has sufficient privileges to register the schema.

message: insufficient privileges to delete schema " string "
cause: An attempt was made to delete a schema resource without sufficient privileges.
solution: Make sure that the user has sufficient privileges to delete the schema.

message: object " string "." string " depends on the schema
cause: An attempt was made to delete a schema which has dependent objects.
solution: Either drop the dependent objects prior to deleting the schema or use the CASCADE or FORCE options.

message: schema " string " does not target namespace " string "
cause: The schema document contains references (via include and import definitions) to other schemas that do not belong to valid namespaces.
solution: Make sure that all schemas referenced via include definitions target the same namespace as the parent schema. Further make sure that the namespace specified in the import definition matches the actual target namespace of the specified schema.

message: invalid database schema name " string "
cause: The XML schema document contains an invalid database schema name For example, the value of attribute SQLSchema
solution: Make sure that all database user/schema names specified in the XML schema document refer to existing database users/schemas.

message: empty string specified as a SQL name
cause: The XML schema document contains a null SQL name. For example, the values of attributes SQLName, SQLType, defaultTable.
solution: Make sure that all names of SQL schema objects specified in the XML schema document are valid SQL names. Otherwise, remove such attributes from the schema and try again.

message: invalid SQL name " string "
cause: The XML schema document contains an invalid SQL name. For example, the values of attributes SQLName, SQLType, defaultTable.
solution: Make sure that all names of SQL schema objects specified in the XML schema document are valid SQL names. This implies that the database length and other restrictions on names be satisfied.

message: null or invalid value specified for parameter : string
cause: The argument value passed for the given parameter is null or invalid.
solution: Make sure that all the input argument values are valid.

message: incompatible SQL type " string " for attribute or element " string "
cause: The SQL type information provided in the XML schema is not compatible with the XML datatype for the specified attribute or element.
solution: Make sure that the specified SQL types are compatible with the declared XML datatypes.

message: cannot generate string : " string . string " already exists
cause: The type/table name specified in the XML schema document cannot be generated because it is already being used.
solution: Use different names for types/tables or use the NOGEN mode so that schema compiler does not generate new types/tables.

message: validation failed for schema
cause: The XML Schema could not be validated.
solution: Make sure that the SQLType and other datatype mapping is valid.

message: Hierarchical Index not empty
cause: An attempt was made to rebuild the hierarchical index which is not empty.
solution: Delete all rows in the hierarchical index and then rebuild it.

message: XDB Security Internal Error
cause: An XDB Security internal error has occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support.

message: XDB Locking Internal Error
cause: An XDB Locking Internal error has occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support.

message: Token " string " not given while locking resource " string "
cause: Locking attempted on resource when the pricipal already owns a lock given by the token above.
solution: Reattempt the lock with the token.

message: Already locked in exclusive mode. Cannot add lock.
cause: The resource is already locked in exclusive mode. Cannot add another lock.
solution: Unlock the existing lock.

message: Resource locked in shared mode. Cannot add exclusive lock
cause: The resource is locked in shared mode. Cannot add a shared lock.
solution: Try locking in shared mode or unlocking the existing lock.

message: Cannot find lock with token " string " on " string "
cause: The lock may have been unlocked or expired. If token was supplied, token may be wrong.
solution: Verify this lock exists. Supply correct token.

message: User does not own lock with supplied token " string "
cause: The lock corresponding to the supplied token is not owned by the user.
solution: Log on as correct user. Supply correct token.

message: Action failed as resource " string " is locked by name lock
cause: Lock requests cause the whole request URI to be locked
solution: Supply lock token or unlock the lock

message: Action failed as resource string is locked
cause: Delete/Rename failed because of an existing lock
solution: Do lockdiscovery to find the lock and delete it.

message: Action failed as parent resource string is locked
cause: Delete/Rename failed because of an lock on parent resource
solution: Do lockdiscovery to find the lock and delete it.

message: Action failed as resource string is locked by name
cause: Delete/Rename failed because one of the children is locked.
solution: Do lockdiscovery to find the lock and delete it.

message: table string cannot be hierarchically enabled
cause: Trigger <tabname>_xdb_pitrigger already exists
solution: Delete all rows in the hierarchical index and then rebuild it.

message: fail to string for string port using xdb configuration
cause: port number for the defined presentation is not valid
solution: Either the port number is already in use or it is protected. Specify another port number.

message: XDB configuration may not be updated with non-schema compliant data
cause: An attempt was made to update the XDB configuration resource with non-schema or non-schema compliant data.
solution: Check the document to make sure it is schema based and schema compliant.

message: XDB configuration has been deleted or is corrupted
cause: The XDB configuration resource has been deleted or corrupted.
solution: Reinstall XDB, or reinsert a valid configuration document.

message: XDB configuration error: string
cause: An error related to XDB configuration has occurred.
solution: Make sure the configuration resource contains valid data.

message: Tablespace not specified correctly
cause: XDB cannot be moved to the specified tablespace.
solution: Specify a valid tablespace.

message: Table " string "." string " is not resource metadata enabled
cause: This table does not have a RESID column for resource metadata
solution: Use disable/enable_hierarchy to enable resource metadata

message: System schema " string " already registered
cause: An attempt was made to register schema with same URL as a system schema.
solution: Change the schema URL to avoid conflicts with system XML schemas.

message: XDB configuration cannot be udpated on all instances
cause: An attempt was made to update XDB configuration.
solution: Ensure that each instance is correctly configured with its listener.

message: The string operator cannot be FALSE
cause: The value of the operator that was specified is FALSE.
solution: Specify an operator that evaluates to TRUE.

message: The string operator has incorrect RHS value
cause: The value on the right hand side, that has been specified for the operator did not evaluate to TRUE.
solution: Specify a value on the right hand side that evaluates to TRUE .

message: RCList cannot contain noncommitted resource configuration
cause: A commit was not executed after adding a resource configuration to an RCList by calling DBMS_RESCONFIG.ADDRESCONFIG()
solution: Make sure a commit is executed after calling DBMS_RESCONFIG.ADDRESCONFIG()

message: The event handler calls cannot exceed the depth of string
cause: Tried to fire an event with depth exceeding the maximum.
solution: Make sure the event that is being fired does not generate infinitely recursive calls, either to itself or to other functions or procedures.

message: Unable to retrieve repository's resource configuration
cause: Tried to access a resource configuration referenced by the XDB repository that has been deleted.
solution: Disassociate the resource configuration from the repository.

message: Specified resource configuration is not associated with given resource
cause: Tried to delete a nonexistant resource configuration from the configuration list of the target resource.
solution: Make sure that the resource and resource configuration names are specified correctly and the resource configuration belongs to the configuration list of the given resource.

message: <RCList> contains OID that is not a resource configuration OID
cause: The OID in <RCList> element was not a resource configuration OID.
solution: Update the <RCList> element and resubmit statement.

message: Cannot validate handler " string "." string "
cause: Attempted to invoke an invalid event handler. This can be a result of one of the following reasons: 1) The handler did not exist. 2) The handler could not be compiled successfully.
solution: Verify that the named handler does exist, then recompile and fix all compilation errors that may subsequently arise.

message: Cannot execute handler " string "." string " with invoker rights
cause: Attempted to invoke an event handler with invoker rights when the SET-INVOKER attribute in the resource configuration that defines the handler was not set to TRUE.
solution: Either redefine the named handler with definer rights or change the SET-INVOKER attribute in the resource configuration that defines the named handler to TRUE.

message: Cannot delete a configuration that is referenced by other resources
cause: Attempted to delete a resource configuration that was referenced by other resources.
solution: Remove all references to the target resource configuration by executing DELETERESCONFIG or DELETEREPOSITORYRESCONFIG procedures in DBMS_RESCONFIG package or specify the DELETE_FORCE option in the DELETERESOURCE statement.

message: Resource has already been rendered
cause: One of the following has occurred: 1) Attempted to invoke setRender* method after the resource was rendered through a setRender* method or after data was written to the output stream. 2) Attempted to access the output stream of the resource after a setRender* method was executed on the resource.
solution: Remove the method causing the problem.

message: Resource configuration string is already associated with the resource string
cause: The resource configuration already exists in the resource configuration list of the resource or the repository
solution: Check if this resource configuration really needs to be added. If so, remove it from resource and repository lists before adding it.

message: Index out of range
cause: The position specified was not valid.
solution: Check (0 <= pos < size of the configuration list of the target resource)

message: Resource-configuration is being referenced by one or more resources
cause: Tried to add a resource configuration to the repository that was being referenced by existing resources.
solution: Remove the resource configuration from other resources before trying to add it to the repository again.

message: Invalid resource configuration list
cause: Attempted to create or update a resource that had duplicate resource configurations or conflicted with the repository configurations.
solution: Correct the resource configuration list and re-submit statement.

message: Illegal operation: string
cause: Tried to invoke a method when it was not allowed.
solution: Do not execute the indicated method.

message: Must specify a valid path value
cause: The path specified for the <defaultChildConfig> or <defaultChildACL> element must refer to an existing resource.
solution: Correct problem and resubmit statement.

message: Must specify the schema for each listener
cause: The schema element was not specified.
solution: Correct problem and resubmit statement.

message: XDB_SET_INVOKER role is required
cause: XDB_SET_INVOKER role was required to set the SET-INVOKER attribute to TRUE.
solution: Correct problem and resubmit statement.

message: Implementation language for string is not specified
cause: Implementation language for specified listener source was not specified.
solution: Correct problem and resubmit statement.

message: Duplicate listener, string , found in resource configuration
cause: Duplicate listener source was found in resource configuration.
solution: Remove duplicates and resubmit statement.

message: Invalid listener source string . string
cause: The listener source specified in the resource configuration did not exist or was invalid.
solution: Correct the listener source in the <listener> element and resubmit statement.

message: string is not an ACL resource
cause: The specified resource did not conform to acl.xsd schema.
solution: Specify a valid path for the <defaultChildACL> element and resubmit statement.

message: string is not a valid resource configuration
cause: The resource specified in the <defaultChildConfig> element while creating a resource configuration or specified as the rcpath in a call using DBMS_RESCONFIG package did not conform to XDBResConfig.xsd schema.
solution: Specify a valid path and resubmit statement.

message: no such schema: string
cause: Nonexistent schema defined in the resource configuration.
solution: Specify a valid schema in the resource configuration and resubmit statement.

message: uncaught error in handler string
cause: The named handler raised an exception.
solution: Fix the identified error.

message: Cyclic definition encountered for string : " string "
cause: The schema definition for this type has cycles.
solution: Remove cyclic definition and re-compile schema.

message: Cannot create schema URL with reserved prefix "http://xmlns.oracle.com/xdb/schemas/"
cause: This prefix is reserved for XDB extended schema URLs and cannot be used in a user specified URL.
solution: Modify the prefix to a different one.

message: invalid XML document
cause: The XML document is invalid with respect to its XML Schema.
solution: Fix the errors identified and try again.

message: attribute string not in XDB namespace
cause: The specified attribute should be prefixed with XDB's namespace.
solution: Ensure that all XDB specified attributes are prefixed with XDB's namespace and try again.

message: Invalid Content-Type charset
cause: HTTP Content-Type header had a charset that Oracle does not understand.
solution: Fix the Content-Type header in the HTTP request.

message: schema " string " currently being referenced
cause: The specified schema URL is currently being referenced by the same session. This could happen because of PLSQL XMLType variables still in scope.
solution: Ensure all references to this schema in this session are released and try the operation again.

message: XML DB is in an invalid state
cause: XML DB's internal tables are in an invalid state, probably because the database was not upgraded or the upgrade was not successful
solution: Ensure that the database is upgraded successfully. If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support

message: max substitution group size string exceeded by " string " ( string ) for head element " string " ( string )
cause: The maximum limit on nested substitution groups has been exceeded by an element.
solution: Delete specified schema and re-register it after removing the offending substitution element.

message: element or attribute " string " cannot be stored out of line
cause: An element or attribute of a simple type has SQLInline=false
solution: Remove the SQLInline=false qualification for the offending element or attribute

message: element or attribute " string " has no SQLType specified
cause: Schema registration was invoked with GENTYPES=false without specifying a SQLType for some element or attribute
solution: Specify a SQLType for the offending element or attribute and register the schema again

message: element or attribute " string " has invalid attribute value " string " (should be " string ")
cause: An element or attribute for a complextype derived by restriction has an attribute whose value is different from that in the base type
solution: Remove the mismatched attribute values from the offending element or attribute

message: cannot load object-relational XML attribute using direct path
cause: The table being loaded contains a xml column with object-relational storage. The xmltype column contains a type with subtypes. This type of attribute cannot be loaded with direct path.
solution: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

message: cannot load object-relational XML attribute using direct path
cause: The table being loaded contains a xml column with object-relational storage. The xmltype column either contains an out-of-line partitioned table or the table itself is partitioned by one of the attributes of xmltype. This type of table cannot be loaded with direct path.
solution: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

message: XML nodes over 64K in size cannot be inserted
cause: An attempt was made to insert an XML Text Node with a size greater than 64K. This is not supported.
solution: Create text nodes under 64K.

message: Node localname and namespace values should be less than 64K
cause: An attempt was made to specify an XML Node with localname or namespace value greater than or equal to 64K. This is not supported.
solution: Node localnames and namespace values should be under 64K.

message: Number of children ( string ) defined in ' string ' exceeds maximum ( string )
cause: An attempt was made to define more than the allowed number of children in a complexType of an XMLSchema document.
solution: Modify the XML Schema to move children of complexType into subelements that are not inlined.

message: Cyclic Schema Registration without using FORCE option
cause: An attempt was made to register cyclic schemas with FORCE = false.
solution: Use FORCE = true when registering cyclic schemas.

message: schema processing error LSX- string while string
cause: An LSX routine returned an error.
solution: Look up the LSX error and follow its corrective action.

message: cannot load XMLType column using direct path
cause: The table being loaded contained an XML column with object-relational or binary storage and supplemental logging wass enabled for the table. Direct path load is not supported for such table when supplemental logging is enabled.
solution: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

message: API not supported in this release
cause: This API was not supported.
solution: None

message: DOM Type mismatch in invalid PL/SQL DOM handle
cause: The specified PL/SQL DOM handle is referencing a DOM Node whose DOM Type that does not match the one available in the session. This could happen because the pl/sql handle was reused, or the original document is no longer available.
solution: Ensure that the pl/sql handle for the target node is valid and try the operation again.

message: PL/SQL DOM handle accesses node that is no longer available
cause: The specified pl/sql handle is referencing a node in a DOM Document that is no longer available.
solution: Ensure that the pl/sql handle for the target node is valid and try the operation again.

message: Too many PL/SQL DOM handles specified
cause: An attempt was made to create a PL/SQL DOM handle that exceeded the maximum allowable number of PL/SQL DOM handles.
solution: Free PL/SQL DOM handles and try the operation again.

message: Node type string cannot be converted to desired type
cause: The given node's type cannot be converted correctly for this operation. For example, a DOM Element cannot be converted to Document Fragment
solution: Pass a valid node type for the conversion.

message: DOM Nodes do not belong to the same DOM Document
cause: The specified PL/SQL DOM Node does not belong to the parent DOM Document of the referring DOM Node.
solution: Ensure that both the DOM Nodes are part of the same DOM Document.

message: Document contains too many nodes
cause: Unable to load the document because it has exceeded the maximum allocated number of DOM nodes.
solution: Reduces the size of the document.

message: Cannot Add Node ' string ' (type=' string ') to Simple Type Node ' string '
cause: Trying to add attribute/element nodes to a simple type against the schema definition. Simple types can have only special attribute like namespaces, xsi:nil etc.
solution: Use a valid node for the operation.

message: The specified printing option is invalid
cause: The printing option specified in the operation is invalid.
solution: Use a valid printing option for the operation.

message: Resource string is not a version-controlled resource
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Checkout is requested for a resource that isn't under version control". Only version-controlled resource can be checked out. - Checkout is requested for a row of a non-versioned table.
solution: put the resource under version-control before checking out.

message: Resource string is already checked out
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Checkout is requested for a resource that is already checked out to the workspace by the same of different user.
solution: checked in the resource from the workspace before checking out

message: Resource string has not been checked out
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Checkin or uncheckout is requested for a resource that has not been checked out to the workspace by any user in a workspace
solution: checked in the resource from the workspace before checking out

message: This versioning feature isn't supported for resource string
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Container cannot be put under version-controlled.
solution: Avoid using these features.

message: Resource string is already deleted
cause: Access a version-controlled resource that is already deleted.
solution: Remove the cyclic definitions in the type and retry compilation.

message: XML node ' string ' (type= string ) does not support this operation
cause: The given node's type is not supported for this operation. For example, trying to add children to an attribute node, or passing in a document node as a child, are unsupported operations.
solution: Use a valid node type for the operation.

message: XML nodes over string in size cannot be printed
cause: An attempt was made to use an XML Text Node with a size greater than 64K, or an XML Comment Node with a size greater than 4K. These cannot be printed. For example, trying to add children to an attribute node, or passing in a document node as a child, are unsupported operations.
solution: Use getClobVal() or getStringVal() to print the Document.

message: Error in processing file string
cause: An error occurred while operating on the specifed file. The possible causes are the file header is corrupt or check the next error on stack
solution: Ensure that the specified file is correct. Look at the next error on the stack and take appropriate action.

message: Mismatch in number of bytes transferred due to non-binary mode
cause: An error occurred while reading the specifed file. The most probable cause is that the transfer was initiated in ASCII mode.
solution: Ensure that the transfer mode is set to BINARY

message: Warning in processing file string
cause: A warning was raised while operating on the specifed file. However, the current operation was completed successfully.
solution: This is primarily an informational message. Look at the next error on the stack to obtain further information.

message: Invalid ACL Argument
cause: A System Constraining ACL was passed as one of the arguments to this function.
solution: Please ensure that none of the aclid arguments are for the System Constraining ACL.

message: DBMS_LDAP: generic error: string
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP package.
solution: Please report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: LDAP client/server error: string
cause: There is a problem either on the LDAP server or on the client.
solution: Please report this error to the LDAP server administrator or your Database administrator.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Init Failed.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP Init operation.
solution: Please check the host name and port number, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP Session.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP bind operation.
solution: Please check the session handler that you use for binding, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP Auth method.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP bind operation.
solution: Please check the authentication credentials that you use for binding, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP search scope.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP search operation.
solution: Please check the search scope that you use for search, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP search time value.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP search operation.
solution: Please check the search time value that you use for search, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP Message.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP message that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - LDAP count_entry error.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP count_entry operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP count_operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - LDAP get_dn error.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP get_dn operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP get_dn, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP entry dn.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
solution: Please check the entry dn that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod_array.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP mod_array that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod option.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP populate_mod_array operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP mod option that you use for LDAP populate_mod_array operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod type.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP populate_mod_array operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP mod type that you use for LDAP populate_mod_array operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod value.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP populate_mod_array operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP mod value that you use for LDAP populate_mod_array operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP rdn.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP rdn value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP newparent.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP rename_s operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP newparent value that you use for LDAP rename_s operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP deleteoldrdn.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP rename_s operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP deleteoldrdn value that you use for LDAP rename_s operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP notypes.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP explode_dn or explode_rdn operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP notypes value that you use for LDAP explode_dn or explode_rdn operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP SSL wallet location.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP sslwrl value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP SSL wallet passwd.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP sslpasswd value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP SSL authentication mode.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
solution: Please check the LDAP sslauth value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

message: DBMS_LDAP: cannot open more than string LDAP server connections
cause: An attempt was made to open more than the maximum allowed LDAP server connections.
solution: Free unused connections.

message: DBMS_LDAP: invalid LDAP session
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use an LDAP session which is not valid and might have already been closed.
solution: Check the LDAP session handle in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: invalid BER_ELEMENT
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a BER_ELEMENT which is not valid and might have already been freed.
solution: Check the BER_ELEMENT in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: MOD_ARRAY size limit exceeded
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to add an element beyond the MOD_ARRAY size limit.
solution: Increase the MOD_ARRAY size limit in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: invalid LDAP MESSAGE handle
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use an LDAP MESSAGE handle which is not valid and might have already been freed.
solution: Check the LDAP MESSAGE handle in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: invalid MOD_ARRAY
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a MOD_ARRAY which is not valid and might have already been freed.
solution: Check the MOD_ARRAY in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: invalid input parameter
cause: An invalid argument has been passed by a PL/SQL module to a DBMS_LDAP subprogram
solution: Check the input argument to the DBMS_LDAP subprogram in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: unable to dynamically allocate additional memory
cause: An error occured during dynamic memory allocation from session heap.
solution: Verify that adequate memory resources are available.

message: DBMS_LDAP: invalid PROPERTY_SET
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a PROPERTY_SET which is not valid and might have already been freed.
solution: Check the PROPERTY_SET in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: invalid MOD_PROPERTY_SET
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a MOD_PROPERTY_SET which is not valid and might have already been freed.
solution: Check the MOD_PROPERTY_SET in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

message: DBMS_LDAP: Shared servers are not supported.
cause: The session executing functions from the DBMS_LDAP package is being handled by a shared server in the Database.
solution: Use dedicated database sessions to execute functions in the DBMS_LDAP package.

message: Cannot contact LDAP server string at port number
cause: The LDAP server specified could not be contacted. This can happen if the server is down or inaccessible.
solution: Contact the administrator of the LDAP server

message: change source string is not an existing change source
cause: The caller did not use the name of an existing change source. The name given does not match the name of any existing change source.
solution: Check the spelling of the change source name. Choose an existing change source.

message: unrecognized parameter string
cause: Unrecognized parameter was detected.
solution: Check for too many parameters in the call.

message: change table string already contains a column string
cause: Issued ALTER_CHANGE_TABLE with an add operation but a column by this name already exists in the specified table.
solution: Check the names and call the procedure again.

message: all input parameters are null
cause: All input parameters are null. At least one property must be altered.
solution: Call the procedure again, making sure that all the required parameters have been specified. Ensure that at least one parameter is not null. Refer to user documentation for the correct way of calling this procedure.

message: cannot make changes while change set string is advancing
cause: The change set is currently advancing. Change sources related to an advancing change set cannot be altered. Change tables related to the advancing change set cannot be created, altered or dropped. Some or all the parameters of the change set cannot be altered while the set is advancing.
solution: Wait until the change set has finished advancing, then reissue the command. If altering the change set, only the advance_enable parameter can be altered during an advance.

message: change source string is referenced by a change set
cause: The operation cannot complete because this change source is referenced by one or more change sets.
solution: Drop the change sets first, then re-issue the command. May have to drop some change tables before the change sets are dropped.

message: end_date must be greater than the begin_date
cause: The end data of the change set is earlier than the begin date. The end date must always be later in time than the begin date, so that the duration between the begin and end dates is a positive amount of time.
solution: Change the begin date and/or the end date, so that the end date is later than the begin date.

message: invalid value specified for begin_scn or end_scn
cause: The begin_scn was not greater than zero. The end_scn was less than zero. The end_scn was less than the begin_scn.
solution: Check the values of both begin_scn and end_scn. Correct them to make sure that they form a legal SCN range. An end_scn value of zero indicates an infinite scn range.

message: one or more values for input parameters are incorrect
cause: One or more of the inputs to the procedure had invalid values.
solution: Identify the bad parameter(s) and supply correct values to the procedure.

message: change set string is not an existing change set
cause: Could not find an existing change set by this name.
solution: Check the spelling of the change set name. Call the procedure again, passing the correct change set name.

message: change set string is referenced by a change table
cause: The operation cannot be performed because the change set contains one or more change tables.
solution: You will need to drop the change table(s) first, then repeat the operation

message: change set string is disabled and cannot be advanced
cause: The specified change set is disabled. The change set needs to be enabled for the operation to succeed.
solution: Determine why the change set is disabled and correct this condition. Alter the change set specifying 'y' for advance_enable then retry the operation.

message: change set string is currently being advanced
cause: An advance operation is in progress for this change set and we only allow one at a time.
solution: Since the change set is currently being advanced, the best action is to wait for it to finish advancing. Only one caller at a time can advance the change set. Check for the cause of long running advance operations.

message: error(s) occurred during change table advance
cause: One or more errors occurred during the advance operation.
solution: Check the log file(s) for a more detailed report of the underlying errors.

message: change set string does not exist
cause: Specified change set does not exist or the user does not have access to the publications in that change set. The name specified did not match the name of any existing change set. Certain privileges are required to access the publications within that change set.
solution: Check the name and call the procedure again, with the name of an existing change set. Contact the publisher or database administrator if user privileges are required to access the publications in the change set.

message: invalid SOURCE_COLMAP value
cause: A source_colmap value of 'y' was specified for an asynchronous change table.
solution: Specify a source_colmap parameter value of 'n' and call the procedure again.

message: column list contains control column string
cause: Reserved column name was specified in a column list or column type parameter.
solution: Control columns are selected with separate parameters. If you did not want a control column, then change the name of the specified column so that it does not conflict with a reserved column name.

message: source schema string does not exist
cause: Trying to create a synchronous change table and the source schema did not match any existing schema names in the database.
solution: Specify the name of an existing schema.

message: source table string does not exist
cause: When creating a synchronous change table, the underlying source table must exist when the procedure is called. In this case, the source table did not exist.
solution: Specify the name of an existing table.

message: unable to submit the purge job
cause: When creating the first change table, a purge job is submitted to the job queue. Submission of this purge job failed.
solution: Make sure that job queue processes are enabled and are currently running. If this does not solve the problem, contact Oracle.

message: change table does not exist
cause: Specified change table does not exist.
solution: Recheck the name, and call the procedure again using an existing change table.

message: owner schema string does not exist
cause: Value specifed for the owner parameter does not contain the name of an existing schema in the database.
solution: Recheck the name, and call the procedure again using an existing schema name.

message: change table string does not contain column string
cause: Issued ALTER_CHANGE_TABLE with a drop operation and the specified column does not exist in the change table.
solution: Recheck the names, and call the procedure again.

message: change table has active subscriptions
cause: The change table is subscribed to, so it cannot be dropped.
solution: Do not drop a change table while there are active subscribers. If this is an emergency, use the FORCE parameter. This will forcibly drop the change table out from under all subscribers.

message: subscription does not exist
cause: The subscription either did not exist or did not belong to this user.
solution: Call the function again with a valid subscription name.

message: cannot modify active subscriptions
cause: The subscription was already activated so that additional calls to SUBSCRIBE were prohibited.
solution: Subscribe to all the desired tables and columns before activating the subscription. Ensure that the correct subscription name is specifed.

message: publication string already subscribed
cause: The subscription already contained this publication.
solution: Check the values of subscription_name and publication_id. Check any other subscribe calls to see if they subscribe to columns that are shared among more than one publication on the same source table. Do not attempt to subscribe to the same publication more than once in the same subscription. Use the publication_id variant of the SUBSCRIBE call if needed to specify precise publications.

message: no publication contains all the specified columns
cause: One or more of the specifed columns cannot be found in a single publication.
solution: Change the subscription request to select only columns that are in the same publication. Consult the USER_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS view to see current publications.

message: subscription has not been activated
cause: The called procedure required an activated subscription.
solution: Check the subscription name and correct if necessary. Call the ACTIVATE_SUBSCRIPTION procedure for this subscription and then reissue the original command.

message: subscriber view exists
cause: A view that is already in use was specified for the subscriber view.
solution: Call the SUBSCRIBE procedure using a different subscriber view name.

message: all source tables must belong to the synchronous change set
cause: Not all of the source tables belong to the synchronous change set.
solution: Check the spelling of the source tables. Make sure that all of the source tables belong to the synchronous change set.

message: invalid source table
cause: Either the schema_name.source_table did not exist or it did not belong to this subscription.
solution: Check the spelling of the schema_name and source_table. Verify that the specifed table exists in the specifed schema and is subscribed to by the subscription.

message: subscriber view does not exist
cause: The subscription did not contain this subscriber view.
solution: Recheck the name, and specify the name of an existing subscriber view.

message: purge is currently running
cause: Called the PURGE procedure while a purge job was currently running.
solution: Wait for purge to complete before reissueing this command.

message: an error occurred during the purge operation
cause: An error occurred during the purge operation
solution: Check the logfile for a more detailed report of the underlying errors.

message: duplicate change source string
cause: A change source by the specifed name already exists.
solution: Recreate the change source with a unique name.

message: duplicate change set string
cause: A change set by the specified name already exists.
solution: Recreate the change set with a unique name.

message: duplicate change table string
cause: A change table by the specified name already exists.
solution: Recreate the change table with a unique name.

message: subscription is already active
cause: The subscription is already active.
solution: Check name and retry.

message: change set string is empty and cannot be advanced
cause: User attempted to advance a change set which does not contain any change tables. Without change tables, a change set cannot be advanced.
solution: Create change tables in the change set, then retry the advance.

message: table is not a change table
cause: User attempted to execute the DROP_CHANGE_TABLE procedure on a table that is not a CHANGE table. This can also occur when a CHANGE table object has been orphaned. CHANGE tables can become orphaned after a CREATE_CHANGE_TABLE failure or an incomplete DROP_CHANGE_TABLE.
solution: Check spelling. If error was due to an incorrect name, then retry the procedure using the correct name. To drop a table that is not a CHANGE table, or an orphaned CHANGE table, use the DROP TABLE DDL command instead.

message: operation timed out while acquiring lock on string
cause: CDC attempted to acquire a lock on the resource, but the operation timed out.
solution: Retry the operation later.

message: deadlock detected while acquiring lock on string
cause: CDC attempted to acquire a lock on the resource, but encountered a deadlock.
solution: Contact Oracle corporation

message: parameter error while acquiring lock on string
cause: CDC attempted to acquire a lock on the resource, but encountered a problem passing parameters to the lock manager.
solution: Contact Oracle corporation

message: invalid lock handle while acquiring lock on string
cause: CDC attempted to acquire a lock on the resource, but encountered a invalid lock handle, which did not correspond to any existing handle.
solution: Contact Oracle corporation

message: this session does not own the lock handle for string
cause: CDC attempted to acquire a lock on the resource, does not own the the lock associated with the lock. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle corporation

message: cannot create change tables in the SYS schema
cause: Attempted to create a change table in the SYS schema. This is not allowed.
solution: Use a different existing schema and retry the command.

message: invalid value for change_source
cause: The specified value was not a valid name for a Change Source.
solution: Specify a valid name and retry the command.

message: invalid value for change_set_name
cause: The specified value was not a valid name for a Change Set.
solution: Specify a valid name and retry the command.

message: invalid value for change_table_name
cause: The specified value was not a valid name for a Change Table.
solution: Specify a valid name and retry the command.

message: invalid value string for capture_values, expecting: OLD, NEW, or BOTH
cause: The specified value was not a valid option for a capture_values.
solution: Specify a valid option and retry the command.

message: invalid value string for parameter, expecting: Y or N
cause: The specified value was not Y or N.
solution: Specify Y or N for the parameter and retry the command.

message: invalid value string for parameter, expecting: Y, N, or NULL
cause: The specified value was not Y, N or NULL.
solution: Specify Y, N or NULL for the parameter and retry the command.

message: invalid value string for operation parameter, expecting: ADD or DROP
cause: The specified value was not ADD or DROP.
solution: Specify ADD or DROP and retry the command.

message: nothing to ALTER
cause: The specified column list is NULL and all optional control columns are 'N'.
solution: Specify one or more columns to ALTER.

message: error executing a procedure in the DBMS_CDC_UTILITY package
cause: An internal attempt to invoke a procedure within the DBMS_CDC_UTILITY package failed.
solution: Check the trace logs for more information. Ensure that the package has been installed successfully. Try issuing a DESCRIBE command from SQL on the package. If it fails, then try reinstalling the package. If it succeeds then try invoking one of the procedures from SQL.

message: maximum length of description field exceeded
cause: The maximum number of characters permitted in the description field was exceeded.
solution: The maximum length of the description field is 30 characters. Ensure the length does not exceed this value and retry the command.

message: an internal error occurred
cause: This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Worldwide Customer Support and report the error.

message: system triggers for DBMS_CDC_PUBLISH package are not installed
cause: One or more required system triggers are not installed. These triggers are required for the proper operation of Change Data Capture. Operations on Change tables cannot continue.
solution: Install or reenable the triggers, or reinstall the package.

message: logfile location string is not an existing directory
cause: The directory specification for logfile location for the change source, does not correspond with an existing directory, or the directory was not accessible.
solution: 1. Create the directory if it does not exist. If the directory does exist, change the file system permissions so the directory can be accessed. OR 2. perform ALTER CHANGE SOURCE and change the logfile_location to be an existing directory that contains the logfiles

message: logfile location string contains no files that match pattern string
cause: The directory specification for logfile location for the change source, does not contain any files whose names pattern-match the logfile_suffix.
solution: 1. Make sure that the logfile location contains logfiles whose names match the logfile_suffix pattern for the change set. OR 2. perform ALTER CHANGE SOURCE and change the logfile_suffix such that it matches the names of existing logfiles in the directory

message: internal error while accessing metadata
cause: An unexpected internal error occurred while CDC was accessing its internal Metadata.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: logfile location string is an empty directory
cause: The directory specification for logfile location for the change source, is an empty directory
solution: 1. Make sure it is the correct location of the logfiles. If it is, make sure the directory contains logfiles. OR 2. perform ALTER CHANGE SOURCE and change the logfile_location to be an existing directory that contains the logfiles

message: target table for the change table no longer exists
cause: User tried to drop a change table but its underlying storage table (that contains the change data) has been dropped.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: cannot obtain a lock on the subscription
cause: A timeout occurred while trying to place a lock on the subscription. Another session had already acquired the lock on the subscription.
solution: Ensure the subscription name is correct and correct it if necessary. If it is already correct, try the operation again after the session holding the lock has released it.

message: no publications found
cause: Did not find any publications that matched the input parameters or the user does not have the privileges to access the specified publication.
solution: Check the input parameters on the call to SUBSCRIBE. Validate that the proposed source table has been published by checking the USER_PUBLICATIONS view for that source table. Contact the publisher if user privileges are required to access the publication. Retry the command with correct security or publication information.

message: no column found in the source table
cause: The OBJECT_ID flag was set to 'Y' on the call to CREATE_CHANGE_TABLE and change table belongs to the synchronous change set. The corresponding object column was not detected in the source table.
solution: Create the change table with the OBJECT_ID flag set to 'N' or investigate why the object column is not in the source table and add it to the source table.

message: cannot process DDL change record
cause: The change set has stop_on_ddl enabled and was trying to process a DDL change record.
solution: Check the alert log to find out what the DDL record contained. Make any necessary changes to the change tables. Call ALTER_CHANGE_SET with recover_after_error and remove_ddl set to 'Y'.

message: cannot enable Change Data Capture for change set string
cause: The change set has reached the specified limit that was set up by the CREATE_CHANGE_SET command.
solution: Check the alert log to find out whether capture, apply or both reached the limit. Once apply reaches its limit, the change set is permanently disabled. Create a new change set with new limits to continue capturing data.

message: asynchronous change tables must contain the RSID$ column
cause: If creating an asynchronous change table, the RSID was set to 'N'. If altering an asynchronous change table with an operation parameter of 'DROP' RSID was set to 'Y'.
solution: When creating asynchronous change tables, always specify 'Y' for the RSID parameter. When altering asynchronous change tables always specify 'N' for RSID.

message: invalid OBJECT_ID value
cause: An object_id value of 'y' was specified for an asynchronous change table.
solution: Specify an object_id parameter value of 'n' and call the procedure again.

message: Importing Change Data Capture version string . string is too new
cause: An attempt was made to Import a file that was exported by a newer version of Oracle than the target instance.
solution: If possible, re-export the file using a version of export that matches the import target. Objects can not be imported into previous versions of Oracle that did not support them.

message: date bound out of range
cause: The upper_bound or lower_bound specified in extend_window or purge_window API is beyond the range of records in the change set.
solution: Either select a bound that is within range or do not select an upper or lower bound at all.

message: Invalid change view window
cause: The specified upper_bound or lower_bound is forcing a condition where the change view window will have nothing in it.
solution: Select a different upper_bound or lower_bound and reissue the API call that produced the error. Alternatively, make the upper_bound or lower_bound parameter NULL and reissue the API call.

message: redo log catalog contains no metadata for the source table
cause: While advancing a change set, an CDC attempted to query the LogMiner dictionary system tables to obtain the columns from the source table. The query returned no rows. This may be because none of the redo logs contains a catalog, or it may be an internal error.
solution: First, verify that the source system contains the source table. execute dbms_logmnr_d.build procedure to populate the redos log with logminer dictionary information. If this has been done and the problem persists, then contact Oracle Corporation

message: a change table data column is missing from the source table
cause: While advancing a change set, an CDC determined that at least one of the data columns in a change table does not match the name of any of the columns in the source table. The source table column listis stored in dictionary table SYSTEM.LOGMNR_OBJ$
solution: Make sure that all of the data columns of the change table have the same names as the corresponding columns in the source table, and that all the columns exist in the source table.

message: could not detach LogMiner session during cleanup
cause: Failure during detach from a LogMiner session during advance of an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error. This exception is raised when a previous exception occurred during the internal protocol with LogMiner, after which Change Data Capture attempted to detach the LogMiner session as part of recovery. The detach session also failed
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: could not detach LogMiner session after change set advance
cause: Failure during detach from a LogMiner session after successful advance of an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error. This exception is raised when an asynchronous change set has been successfully advanced but CDC was unable to detach from the LogMiner session
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: could not create LogMiner session
cause: Failure during create of a new LogMiner session while advancing an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: staging database and source database cannot be the same
cause: A CDC API call specified a source database name that matched the staging database on which the CDC API call is being executed.
solution: Make sure that the CDC API call is being executed from the staging database and that the source database is correctly specified. The source database and staging database need to be different databases.

message: change source string is not a HotLog change source
cause: A change source was specified that was not a HotLog change source, but a HotLog change source was required.
solution: Correct the call to supply a HotLog change source.

message: invalid option for non-distributed Hotlog change source
