cause: A CDC API call specified enabled_source = 'Y' on a non-Distributed HotLog change source.
solution: Specify a Distributed HotLog change source.

message: cannot have spaces in the parameter string
cause: The specifed parameter contained at least 1 space character.
solution: Check the value of the specified parameter. Remove the spaces and reissue the CDC API call.

message: source database version must be at least 9.2.0.6 or greater
cause: The source database is not at version 9.2.0.6 or higher.
solution: Upgrade the source database to 9.2.0.6 or higher.

message: invalid database link
cause: The database link used to connect from a staging database to a source database was invalid. The database link may not exist, may not be accessible to the current user, or may have been redefined since the Distributed HotLog change source was originally created.
solution: Make sure that there is a database link to the source_database for the Distributed HotLog change source. Make sure this database link is accessible to the current user.

message: cannot support column string in this configuration
cause: The specified column cannot be used in a Distributed HotLog configuration when the source database version is 9.2.0.6 or 10.1.0.0.
solution: Remove the specified column from the CREATE_CHANGE_TABLE or ALTER_CHANGE_TABLE CDC API call.

message: cannot support begin dates or end dates in this configuration
cause: The specified values cannot be used in a Distributed HotLog configuration.
solution: Remove the specified values from the CREATE_CHANGE_SET CDC API call.

message: cannot support change set string in this configuration
cause: Change sources with the hot mine option enabled are limited to 1 change set. The system detected an existing change set so a second one can not be created.
solution: Associate the change set with a different change source.

message: invalid DDL_MARKERS value
cause: A DDL_MARKERS value of 'y' was specified for an synchronous change table.
solution: Specify a DDL_MARKERS parameter value of 'n' and call the procedure again.

message: could not attach to LogMiner session
cause: Failure during attach to a LogMiner session while advancing an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: could not add logfile to LogMiner session
cause: Failure during add logfile to a LogMiner session while advancing an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: could not set session parameters for LogMiner session
cause: Failure during set parameters for a LogMiner session while advancing an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: could not prepare session for LogMiner session
cause: Failure during prepare session for a LogMiner session while advancing an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: could not activate a LogMiner session
cause: Failure during activation of a LogMiner session while advancing an asynchronous change set. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Corporation

message: error in synchronous change table on " string "." string "
cause: There was an error originating from this synchronous change table. One possible cause is that schema redefinition has occurred on the source table and one or more columns in the change table are now a different type than corresponding source columns. Another possible cause is that there is a problem accessing the synchronous change table.
solution: Check further error messages in stack for more detail about the cause. If there has been schema redefinition, drop and recreate the synchronous change table.

message: must use DBMS_CDC_PUBLISH.DROP_CHANGE_TABLE to drop change tables
cause: An attempt was made to use the SQL command DROP TABLE for change tables, but DROP TABLE is not supported for change tables.
solution: Use the DBMS_CDC_PUBLISH.DROP_CHANGE_TABLE procedure instead of the DROP TABLE command.

message: invalid value specified for first_scn
cause: The first_scn was not greater than zero or was less than the previous value of first_scn.
solution: Check the value of first_scn. Correct it to make sure it is an integer greater than zero and greater than any previous value for this change source.

message: description and remove_description cannot both be specified
cause: The description and remove_description parameters were both specified.
solution: Check the values of description and remove_description. Correct call to only supply one of these values.

message: null value specified for required parameter string
cause: A null value was specified for a parameter that requires an explicit value.
solution: Correct call to supply a value for this parameter.

message: change source string is not a ManualLog change source
cause: A change source was specified that is not a ManualLog change source, but a ManualLog change source is required.
solution: Correct call to supply a ManualLog change source.

message: change source string is not an AutoLog change source
cause: A change source was specified that was not an AutoLog change source, but an AutoLog change source was required.
solution: Correct call to supply an AutoLog change source.

message: invalid number supplied for supplemental_processes
cause: The caller supplied an invalid value for supplemental_processes. The value must be a positive integer.
solution: Correct call to supply a positive integer value for supplemental_processes.

message: invalid date supplied for begin_date or end_date
cause: The caller supplied an invalid value for begin_date or end_date. The value must be a valid date value.
solution: Correct call to supply a valid date value for begin_date and/or end_date.

message: cannot alter or drop predefined change source
cause: The caller attempted to alter or drop one of the predefined change sources HOTLOG_SOURCE or SYNC_SOURCE.
solution: Do not attempt to alter or drop a predefined change source or correct call to supply the name of a user-created change source.

message: cannot alter or drop predefined change set
cause: The caller attempted to alter or drop the predefined change set SYNC_SET.
solution: Do not attempt to alter or drop the predefined change set or correct call to supply the name of a user-created change set.

message: duplicate subscription name string
cause: A subscription by the specifed name already exists.
solution: Recreate the subscription with a unique name.

message: string parameter value longer than maximum length string
cause: A value was specified for a parameter that was longer than the maximum permitted length.
solution: Correct the call to supply a shorter value for this parameter that fits within the maximum length.

message: invalid parameter value for synchronous change set
cause: A parameter value was specified that is not supported for synchronous change sets.
solution: Correct the call to supply only valid parameter values for a synchronous change set. Synchronous change sets only support the default values for the following parameters: begin_scn, end_scn, begin_date, end_date, stop_on_ddl, supplemental_processes.

message: publication does not exist
cause: The specified publication did not exist or the specified subscription subscribed to a publication that no longer exists.
solution: Recheck the publication or subscription specified. Either call the procedure again with an existing publication or create a new subscription that only subscribes to existing publications.

message: name uses reserved prefix CDC$
cause: A name was specified that starts CDC$. The name prefix CDC$ is reserved for use by Oracle Corporation.
solution: Change the name so it does not start with characters CDC$

message: name exceeds maximum length of 30 characters
cause: A name was supplied that exceeds the maximum length of 30 characters.
solution: Change the name so it does not exceed 30 characters

message: name cannot contain double quotation marks
cause: A name containing a double quotation mark was supplied. Subscription names cannot contain the double quotation mark.
solution: Change the name so it has no double quotation marks

message: unsupported column type specified in change table
cause: A source column of an unsupported type was specified for inclusion in a change table. Columns types of LOB or LONG are not currently supported for change capture.
solution: Change the column list so that it does not include columns of LOB or LONG types.

message: change set string disabled due to capture error
cause: This change set has encountered a capture error and was disabled.
solution: Contact the change set's publisher to request that the capture error be resolved. Subscriptions using this change set cannot be activated or have their subscription windows extended or purged until the capture error is resolved.

message: CDC change source string already exists
cause: A Change Data Capture change source intended for import already existed.
solution: Either verify that the existing change source has the desired characteristics or drop the existing change source and perform the import again.

message: CDC change set string already exists
cause: A Change Data Capture change set intended for import already existed.
solution: Either verify that the existing change set has the desired characteristics or drop the existing change set and perform the import again.

message: CDC change table string . string already exists
cause: A Change Data Capture change table intended for import already existed.
solution: Either verify that the existing change table has the desired characteristics or drop the existing change table and perform the import again.

message: change column string already exists in CDC change table string . string
cause: A column in a Change Data Capture change table intended for import was already present in the change table.
solution: Either verify that the change table contains the desired columns or drop the change table and perform the import again.

message: CDC subscription string already exists
cause: A Change Data Capture subscription intended for import already existed.
solution: Either verify that the existing subscription has the desired characteristics or drop the existing subscription and perform the import again.

message: CDC subscription string already subscribes to publication ID string
cause: A Change Data Capture subscription intended for import already subscribed to a publication.
solution: Either verify that the existing subscription has the desired characteristics or drop the existing subscription and perform the import again.

message: CDC subscription string already subscribes to publication ID string column string
cause: A Change Data Capture subscription intended for import already subscribed to a published column.
solution: Either verify that the existing subscription has the desired characteristics or drop the existing subscription and perform the import again.

message: could not find Streams object string for CDC change set string
cause: An underlying Streams capture, apply, or queue was missing for an imported Change Data Capture change set.
solution: Drop the imported change set because it is invalid. Retry the import, ensuring that STREAMS_CONFIGURATION=y is specified.

message: could not find change source string for CDC change set string
cause: The change source was missing for an imported Change Data Capture change set.
solution: Drop the imported change set because it is invalid. Verify that the schema containing the missing change source was included in the original export. If needed, perform the export again, including the schema of the missing change source.

message: could not find change set string for CDC change table string . string
cause: The change set was missing for an imported Change Data Capture change table.
solution: Drop the imported change table because it is invalid. Verify that the schema containing the missing change set was included in the original export. If needed, perform the export again, including the schema of the missing change set.

message: could not find column string in CDC change table string . string
cause: A column was missing for an imported Change Data Capture change table.
solution: It is likely that this table existed before the import operation and import did not overwrite it. Determine whether the imported change table should supercede the original table. If so, drop the original table and retry the import. If not, the change table must have a different name in order to be imported.

message: could not find source table string . string for CDC change table string . string
cause: The source table was missing or was not set up correctly for an imported Change Data Capture change table. A synchronous change table requires the source table to exist and have the Change Data Capture trigger defined on it. An asynchronous change table requires table rules to be defined for the source table.
solution: Drop the imported change table because it is invalid. Verify that the schema containing the source table was included in the original export. If needed, perform the export again, including the schema of the source table. If change table is asynchronous, ensure that STREAMS_CONFIGURATION=y is specified for the import.

message: could not find source column string for CDC change table string . string
cause: A source column was missing for an imported Change Data Capture change table.
solution: Drop the imported change table because it is invalid. Verify that the schema containing the source table was included in the original export. If needed, perform the export again, including the schema of the missing source table.

message: could not find change set string for CDC subscription string
cause: The change set was missing for an imported Change Data Capture subscription.
solution: Drop the imported subscription because it is invalid. Verify that the schema containing the missing change set was included in the original export. If needed, perform the export again, including the schema of the missing change set.

message: could not find publication for CDC subscriber view string . string
cause: A publication was missing for an imported Change Data Capture subscription.
solution: Drop the imported subscription because it is invalid. Verify that the schema containing the missing publication was included in the original export. If needed, perform the export again, including the schema of the missing publication.

message: could not find published column string for CDC subscriber view string . string
cause: A published column was missing for an imported Change Data Capture subscription.
solution: Drop the imported subscription because it is invalid. Verify that the schema containing the missing published column was included in the original export. If needed, perform the export again, including the schema of the missing published column.

message: could not find column string in CDC subscriber view string . string
cause: A column was missing in a subscriber view for an imported Change Data Capture subscription.
solution: It is likely that this view existed before the import operation and import did not overwrite it. Determine whether the imported subscriber view should supercede the original view. If so, drop the original view and retry the import. If not, the subscriber view must have a different name in order to be imported.

message: cannot enable change source string
cause: The change source cannot be enabled when there is no change table created in any of the change sets associated with the change source.
solution: Add a change table to a change set before enabling the the change source.

message: only one change set ( string ) is allowed in change source
cause: A Distributed HotLog change source can contain at most one change set.
solution: Create a new change source and create the change set in the new change source.

message: Change Data Capture string publisher string is missing DBA role
cause: The publisher does not have the DBA role, which is required by the Change Data Capture operation.
solution: Grant the DBA role the Change Data Capture publisher.

message: cannot support change source string in this configuration
cause: Each database can only have one change source with hot mine option enabled. The system detected an existing hot mine change source in the database, therefore, a second hot mine change source cannot be created.
solution: Remove the existing change source and create this new change source again.

message: cannot support encrypted column string in the source table
cause: One of the columns specified in the parameter COLUMN_TYPE_LIST was an encrypted column in the source table
solution: remove the encrypted column in the parameter COLUMN_TYPE_LIST

message: specified purge date is invalid
cause: The purge date specified was an invalid date or was outside of the range of data currently in the change set.
solution: Do not specify purge date or specify a date that is within the range of data in the change set.

message: change set string disabled
cause: This change set was disabled.
solution: Contact the change set's publisher to request that the change set be enabled. Subscriptions using this change set cannot be activated or have their subscription windows extended or purged until the change set is enabled.

message: no privilege to create job
cause: This change table could not be created because the create job privilege is needed to submit the default purge job.
solution: Grant the create job privilege and try again

message: string is not a valid identifier
cause: All Change Data Capture (CDC) identifiers must have at most 30 characters, and must start with a letter that is followed by any combination of letters, numerals, and the signs '$', '_', and '#'. Other characters cannot be used in identifiers. The rules for CDC identifiers are the same as for PL/SQL identifiers.
solution: Rename object to conform to CDC naming rules and try again.

message: invalid input value string for parameter string in function string
cause: A NULL or invalid value was supplied for the parameter.
solution: Correct the input value and try the call again.

message: Function string cannot be called now that fetch has begun.
cause: The function was called after the first call to FETCH_xxx.
solution: Correct the program.

message: parameter string value " string " in function string inconsistent with string
cause: The parameter value is inconsistent with another value specified by the program. It may be inconsistent with the object type associated with the OPEN context, or it may be of the wrong datatype (a boolean rather than a text string or vice versa).
solution: Correct the program

message: object " string " of type string not found in schema " string "
cause: The specified object was not found in the database.
solution: Correct the object specification and try the call again.

message: invalid string parameter " string " for object type string in function string
cause: The specified parameter value is not valid for this object type.
solution: Correct the parameter and try the call again.

message: the following was returned from string in routine string : LPX- number : string
cause: An LPX routine (XML/XSL processing) returned an internal error number to its PL/SQL wrapper routine in facility KUX which provides the implementation for package UTL_XML.
solution: Look up the LPX error number and follow its corrective action.

message: XML context number does not match any previously allocated context
cause: A method in package UTL_XML was called with an invalid XML context handle. All handles must have previously been allocated by UTL_XML.XMLINIT.
solution: Always call XMLINIT before any other methods in pkg. UTL_XML.

message: function string is inconsistent with transform.
cause: Either (1) FETCH_XML was called when the "DDL" transform was specified, or (2) FETCH_DDL was called when the "DDL" transform was omitted.
solution: Correct the program.

message: specified object of type string not found
cause: The specified object was not found in the database.
solution: Correct the object specification and try the call again.

message: error loading file " string " from file system directory " string "
cause: The installation script initmeta.sql failed to load the named file from the file system directory into the database.
solution: Examine the directory and see if the file is present and can be read.

message: cannot call this function from a non-master process
cause: Called a Data Pump process model function from a process which is not a master process.
solution: Create a master process first. Then call the function from the master process. If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Allocation of process descriptor failed.
cause: During creation of a master process or a worker process, a failure occurred allocating a process descriptor for the process.
solution: Try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Master process string failed during startup.
cause: The master process whose name is listed failed during startup.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: routine string received this error from string : string
cause: The call to the specified routine failed and the specific error text is included in this error message (the last %s string).
solution: Correct inputs to the specified routine.

message: routine string received this error: string
cause: The specified routine failed and the specific error text is included in this error message (the last %s string).
solution: Correct inputs to the specified routine.

message: unable to write to dump file " string "
cause: Export was unable to write to the export file, probably because of a device error. This message is usually followed by a device message from the operating system.
solution: Take appropriate action to restore the device.

message: unable to open dump file " string " for write
cause: Export was unable to open the export file for writing. This message is usually followed by device messages from the operating system.
solution: Take appropriate action to restore the device.

message: FILESIZE is outside valid range of string KB to string TB
cause: The value specified for the FILESIZE parameter was either too small to hold the header information for the export file, plus any data, or exceeded the allowed maximum size for a dump file.
solution: Retry the operation using a value for FILESIZE that falls within the valid range.

message: invalid dump file " string "
cause: Either the file was not generated by Export or it was corrupted.
solution: If the file was indeed generated by Export, report this as an Import bug and submit the export file to Oracle Customer Support.

message: file or device " string " cannot be specified for string operation
cause: There was an inappropriate use of file or device in the current operation.
solution: Correct operation or job setup.

message: error creating master process
cause: Setup to create a master process failed.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: premature end of file at block string
cause: d either by a corrupted Data Pump export dump file or by an Oracle internal error. This message should be preceded by another message identifying the name of the dump file in question.
solution: Retry the Data Pump import operation. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem persists.

message: a job is not attached to this session via the specified handle
cause: An attempt to reference a job using a handle which is invalid or no longer valid for the current session.
solution: Select a handle corresponding to a valid active job or start a new job.

message: A job cannot be modified after it has started.
cause: The user attempted to change the definition of a Data Pump job through filters, transforms or parameters after it had started. These changes can only be made while defining a job.
solution: Stop the current job and rerun it with the correct definition.

message: Schema string is needed to import this object, but is unaccessible
cause: An error occurred when attempting to import objects. The schema specified is needed to import this object, but access to this schema is not available.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: job does not exist
cause: An invalid reference to a job which is no longer executing, is not executing on the instance where the operation was attempted, or that does not have a valid Master Table. Refer to any following error messages for clarification.
solution: Start a new job, or attach to an existing job that has a valid Master Table.

message: API call succeeded but more information is available
cause: The user specified job parameters that yielded informational messages.
solution: Call DBMS_DATAPUMP.GET_STATUS to retrieve additional information.

message: error getting worker process exception
cause: Attempt to get a worker process exception failed.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: unable to allocate additional memory
cause: A dynamic memory allocation failure occurred.
solution: Report this problem to a database administrator.

message: a job name is required to attach a job for user string
cause: No job name was supplied for an attach and the user has either no jobs executing or mutiple jobs executing.
solution: Provide a job name for attach to use in selecting an executing job, or to use for restarting a stopped job.

message: privileges are required
cause: The necessary privileges are not available for operations such as: restarting a job on behalf of another owner, using a device as a member of the dump file set, or ommiting a directory object associated with any of the various output files. Refer to any following error messages for additional information.
solution: Select a different job to restart, try a different operation, or contact a database administrator to acquire the needed privileges.

message: master table " string . string " not found, invalid, or inaccessible
cause: A Master Table is required but no such table exists, or the content is not consistent with that of a valid Master Table, or the table is not accessible. Refer to any following error messages for clarification.
solution: Make sure a valid Master Table exists, and eliminate any problems indicated by the following error messages.

message: unable to create master table " string . string "
cause: Job creation failed because a Master Table and its indexes could not be created, most commonly due to the pre-existance of a table with the same name (job name) in the user schema. Refer to any following error messages for clarification.
solution: Select a different job name, DROP the existing table, or eliminate any problems indicated by the following error messages.

message: job already exists
cause: Job creation or restart failed because a job having the selected name is currently executing. This also generally indicates that a Master Table with that job name exists in the user schema. Refer to any following error messages for clarification.
solution: Select a different job name, or stop the currently executing job and re-try the operation (may require a DROP on the Master Table).

message: unable to establish job resource synchronization
cause: A lock used in synchronizing Data Pump resources during job creation and deletion could not be obtained during job creation. This indicates that a process for some other Data Pump job has not released the lock due to an internal error.
solution: Eliminate the processes for any failed Data Pump job and try to create the new job again. If the error continues to occur, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: session is already attached to job string for user string
cause: The session executing the attach is already attached to the specified job.
solution: Select a different job or create a new session.

message: cannot create job string for user string
cause: Unable to create or restart a job. Refer to any following or prior error messages for clarification.
solution: Eliminate the problems indicated.

message: cannot attach to job string for user string
cause: Unable to attach a job to a session. Refer to any following or prior error messages for clarification.
solution: Eliminate the problems indicated.

message: unexpected data found
cause: The Master Table or Data Pump file contents appear invalid. The table or file may not have been produced by a Data Pump job, or they may have been corrupted.
solution: Select a different job name (Master Table) or replace the table or file with one produced by Data Pump.

message: unable to open dump file " string " for read
cause: Import was unable to open the export file for reading. This message is usually followed by device messages from the operating system.
solution: Take appropriate action to restore the device.

message: unable to create dump file " string "
cause: Export was unable to create the specified file with write enabled.
solution: Check the file name and file system for the source of the error.

message: the following SQL statement fails: string
cause: An internal error was generated from package DBMS_METADATA.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: unable to close dump file " string "
cause: Export or Import was unable to close the dump file. This message is usually followed by device messages from the operating system.
solution: Take appropriate action to restore the device.

message: unable to position to block number string in dump file " string "
cause: Export or Import was unable to position its file pointer to a specific block within the dump file. This message is usually followed by device messages from the operating system.
solution: Take appropriate action based on the device messages.

message: unable to read from dump file " string "
cause: Import could not read from the dumpfile, probably because of a device error. This message is usually followed by a device message from the operating system.
solution: Take appropriate action to restore the device.

message: Timeout before master process string finished initialization.
cause: The master process whose name is listed started up but did not finish its initialization within the allowed time limit.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Master process string violated startup protocol.
cause: The master process whose name is listed started up but then exited before notifying the creating process that it was finished with initialization.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: timeout waiting for master process response
cause: After creating the job infrastructure and sending the initial message to the master process, it failed to respond in the allotted time and most likely aborted during startup.
solution: Retry the open or attach request. Contact Oracle Customer Support if the problem persists.

message: communication error with master process - detaching job
cause: Unexpected failure trying to communicate with the master process.
solution: Attach again and retry operation. Contact Oracle Customer Support if the problem persists.

message: command response message was invalid type - detaching job
cause: Something horribly wrong with the command/response protocol.
solution: Reattach and retry operation. Contact Oracle Customer Support if the problem persists.

message: unable to determine job operation for privilege check
cause: Failure trying to determine the operation of the current job in order to test for appropriate privileges.
solution: Retry in case it's an intermittent failure. If it still fails, detach, reattach, and retry the call. Contact Oracle Customer Support if the problem persists.

message: unable to convert file or volume size as specified to a number
cause: File or volume size specification has an error the prevents it from being converted into a numeric value.
solution: Fix the call.

message: no data or metadata objects selected for job
cause: After the job parameters and filters were applied, the job specified by the user did not reference any objects.
solution: Verify that the mode of the job specified objects to be moved. For command line clients, verify that the INCLUDE, EXCLUDE and CONTENT parameters were correctly set. For DBMS_DATAPUMP API users, verify that the metadata filters, data filters, and parameters that were supplied on the job were correctly set.

message: cannot use TABLESPACE_EXPR filter with transportable mode
cause: A TABLESPACE_EXPR metadata filter was supplied for for a transportable mode import job. Transportable mode import does not support the subsetting of tablespaces from a dump file set.
solution: Remove the filter expression.

message: data filter name can not be defaulted
cause: A null data filter name was supplied.
solution: Fix the call to specify a data filter name.

message: specifying a schema name requires a table name
cause: The caller specified a schema name but neglected to specify a corresponding table name.
solution: Fix the call to include a table name.

message: status message was invalid type - detaching job
cause: Message from the master process on the status queue had an invalid message type, indicating a failure in the protocol.
solution: Reattach and retry the operation. Contact Oracle Customer Support if the problem persists.

message: metadata filter name can not be defaulted
cause: A null metadata filter name was supplied.
solution: Fix the call to specify a metadata filter name.

message: there are no metadata transform values of type VARCHAR2
cause: The specified metadata transform value was an invalid type.
solution: Fix the call to specify a valid metadata transform value.

message: metadata transform name can not be defaulted
cause: A null metadata transform name was supplied.
solution: Fix the call to specify a metadata transform name.

message: metadata remap name can not be defaulted
cause: A null metadata remap name was supplied.
solution: Fix the call to specify a metadata remap name.

message: unable to construct unique job name when defaulted
cause: The job name was defaulted, and the name creation algorithm was unable to find a unique job name for this schema where the table name (for the master table) didn't already exist.
solution: Specify a job name to use or delete some of the existing tables causing the name conflicts.

message: mode can only be defaulted for IMPORT and SQL_FILE operations
cause: The job mode can not be null except for IMPORT and SQL_FILE operations.
solution: Fix the call to specify the job mode.

message: Master process string had an unhandled exception.
cause: A Data Pump process model master process had an unhandled exception condition.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: parameter name can not be defaulted
cause: A null was supplied for the parameter name.
solution: Fix the call by providing a valid parameter name.

message: Timeout before worker process string finished initialization.
cause: The worker process whose name is listed started up but did not finish its initialization within the allowed time limit.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Worker process string violated startup protocol.
cause: The worker process whose name is listed started up but then exited before notifying the creating process that it was finished with initialization.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Username argument must be specified and non-null.
cause: Called change user with a NULL username or a null string.
solution: Specify a valid username argument. If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Worker process string had an unhandled exception.
cause: A Data Pump process model worker process had an unhandled exception condition.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Worker process string died unexpectedly.
cause: A Data Pump process model worker process died unexpectedly, so PMON is cleaning up the process.
solution: Check your system for problems. Check the trace file for the process, if one was created, for any additional information. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: worker process interrupt for normal exit by master process
cause: A worker process was requested to clean up and exit because the master process is doing a normal exit.
solution: If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp). it means that the master process for the operation exited prematurely. Try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: worker process interrupt for unhandled exception in master process
cause: A worker process was requested to clean up and exit because an unhandled exception occurred in the master process.
solution: If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), it means that the master process for the operation had an unhandled exception. Check the log file for the operaton and the trace file for the master process for any additional information. Try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: worker process interrupt for unexpected death of master process
cause: A worker process was requested to clean up and exit (signaled by PMON, doing cleanup because the master process died unexpectedly).
solution: If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), it means that the master process for the operation died unexpectedly. Check the log file for the operaton and the trace file for the master process for any additional information. Try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: illegal value for number of workers, string
cause: Called create worker processes with an illegal number of workers specified.
solution: Make sure that the number of workers value is greater than 0 and less than the maximum value for the platform (normally 32767). If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp) and you specified the parallel parameter, try the operation again with a smaller value for the parallel parameter. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Table data object string has long columns, and longs can not be loaded/unloaded using a network link
cause: Table data objects that contain long columns can not be selected over a network link.
solution: Export this table to a file and then import the same table from the file.

message: error creating worker processes
cause: Setup to create worker processes failed.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: error creating worker process string with worker id string
cause: Attempt to create the listed worker process failed.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Worker process string failed during startup.
cause: The worker process whose name is listed failed during startup.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: illegal value for base worker id, string
cause: Called create worker processes with an illegal base worker id value specified.
solution: Make sure that the base worker id value is greater than 0 and less than the maximum value for the platform (normally 32767). If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Process name buffer size must be specified and must be greater than 0.
cause: Called get worker exception and either specified NULL or 0 for the buffer size argument.
solution: Be sure to specify a buffer size that is big enough to hold the worker process name (e.g. 30 bytes). If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: The worker received message number string from the MCP, which is invalid.
cause: Bad code.
solution: Fix mcp code and reissue export/import command.

message: The following SQL statement failed trying to insert a row into the Master table: string
cause: Bad code.
solution: Fix code and reissue export/import command.

message: Table data object string failed to load/unload and is being skipped due to error: string
cause: Table failed to load or unload due to some error.
solution: Check load/unload error, correct problem and retry command.

message: master table string failed to load/unload
cause: Master table failed to load or unload.
solution: Check load/unload error, correct problem and retry command.

message: Inconsistent master table on restart. The following SQL statement returned string identical objects. string
cause: Master table on restart has the same object inserted multiple times.
solution: Restart not possible, reissue original export/import.

message: unable to export/import string using client specified string method
cause: Table attributes prevent client specified method for exporting or importing data.
solution: Use default 'DATA_ACCESS' parameter value.

message: aborting operation at process order number string
cause: User asked for it.
solution: Don't ask for it.

message: Error stack buffer size must be specified and must be greater than 0.
cause: Called get worker exception and either specified NULL or 0 for the error stack size argument.
solution: Be sure to specify am error stack buffer size that is big enough to hold the error stack string (e.g. 4096 bytes). If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Very long string supplied for AUDIT_SYSLOG_LEVEL parameter
cause: Very long string supplied for AUDIT_SYSLOG_LEVEL in init.ora
solution: Use a valid facility.level such as "local1.notice" as described in syslog's manual pages

message: Event to enable xmltype table export/import with schema
cause: Event to enable xmltype table export/import with schema
solution: Disable the event at level 0x100

message: the current operation was cancelled by the user
cause: The user requested to cancel current operation
solution: No action is necessary

message: write to SPFILE requested but SPFILE is not modifiable
cause: An ALTER SYSTEM command or an internal self-tuning mechanism requested a write to the SPFILE but the SPFILE was not modifiable.
solution: Perform an in-memory parameter update only.

message: write to SPFILE requested but no SPFILE is in use
cause: An ALTER SYSTEM command or an internal self-tuning mechanism requested a write to the SPFILE but no SPFILE was in use.
solution: Re-start the instance using an SPFILE, or execute ALTER SYSTEM SET SPFILE.

message: cannot create SPFILE already being used by the instance
cause: A create spfile command is trying to write to an SPFILE that was used to startup the instance.
solution: Specify a different SPFILE name

message: error occured processing parameter ' string '
cause: An error occured while parsing the parameter file.
solution: See additional errors to determine the root cause.

message: obsolete or deprecated parameter(s) specified for string instance
cause: Obsolete or deprecated parameters for this instance type were specified in the SPFILE or the PFILE on the server side.
solution: See alert log for a list of parameters that are obsolete or deprecated. Remove them from the SPFILE or the server side PFILE.

message: error while parsing size specification [ string ]
cause: The value specified for an alter operation on a size parameter is not valid
solution: Correct the value and retry the operation

message: string initialization parameter has been deprecated
cause: A deprecated parmeter was specified at startup
solution: Consult Oracle documentation to find new parameters to use instead.

message: internal
cause: A parameter error occured.
solution: Call Oracle support.

message: error while processing parameter update at instance string
cause: An error occured while processing a parameter on a remote instance.
solution: See accompanying error messages.

message: cannot reset the memory value for instance string from instance string
cause: Memory resets of local parameters are only allowed.
solution: Retry the query for the local instance if needed.

message: cannot find entry to delete in SPFILE
cause: The SPFILE did not contain the sid.parameter entry.
solution: Change the sid and/or the parameter.

message: cannot restore SPFILE to location already being used by the instance
cause: A restore operation trying to write to an SPFILE that was used to startup the instance.
solution: Specify a different SPFILE name

message: SPFILE format is inconsistent with value of COMPATIBLE parameter
cause: The SPFILE was in H.A.R.D. (Hardware Assisted Resilient Data) compliant format but the value of the COMPATIBLE parameter was set to pre-11.0. This is not allowed since Oracle has a policy of irreversible compatibility advance.
solution: Change the value of the COMPATIBLE parameter to be 11.0 or higher.

message: failure in verifying parameters from the restored SPFILE
cause: Failure during processing of parameters from restored SPFILE. It could be that restore image of the SPFILE is corrupted.
solution: Further diagnostic information should be in the error stack.

message: error processing parameter " string " from the SPFILE restore image
cause: Failure during processing of parameters from restored SPFILE. It could be that restore image of the SPFILE is corrupted.
solution: Further diagnostic information should be in the error stack.

message: unable to restore SPFILE
cause: Failure during SPFILE restore. It could be that the restore destination is not valid.
solution: Further diagnostic information should be in the error stack.

message: parameter " string " cannot be updated in SPFILE
cause: Database is mounted.
solution: Unmount the database to update the parameter in the SPFILE

message: failure in updating SPFILE
cause: A failure occured while updating the SPFILE.
solution: See associated errors.

message: parameter cannot be modified in memory on another instance
cause: Parameter adjustment can take a very long time
solution: Modify the parameter individually on each instance using the SID clause of the alter system command

message: The parameter SPFILE cannot be updated in the server parameter file.
cause: An attempt was made to update the parameter SPFILE in the server parameter file.
solution: Convert the server parameter file into a parameter file and then add the parameters needed and recreate the server parameter file.

message: SID='*' clause needed to modify this parameter
cause: The parameter did not have the same value on all RAC instances.
solution: Retry the command by specifying SID='*'

message: parameter value longer than string characters
cause: An attempt was made to alter a parameter value but the number of characters in the parameter value was longer than the allowed maximum. For a list parameter, one of the values in the list was longer than the allowed maximum.
solution: Reduce the parameter value length and retry the command. For the DISPATCHERS parameter, use listener aliases to reduce value length.

message: parameter value longer than string characters
cause: An attempt was made to alter a parameter value but the combined length of all the parameter values was more than the allowed maximum.
solution: Reduce the parameter value length and retry the command. For the DISPATCHERS parameter, use listener aliases to reduce value length.

message: invalid directory specified for audit_file_dest parameter
cause: Either the directory does not exist or it is not writable.
solution: Retry the command by specifying a valid directory or granting appropriate directory permissions.

message: string . string is not a table or view object.
cause: An attempt was made to set the audit table to a non-table object or a non-view object.
solution: Specify a valid table or view object for the audit table option.

message: string . string has fewer columns compared to string table.
cause: An attempt was made to set the audit table to a table or view object that has fewer columns compared to the base audit table.
solution: Specify a valid table or view object for the audit table option.

message: There is no string column with the matching type in string . string .
cause: An attempt was made to set the audit table to a table or view object that does not have a column with the same name and type as the one in the audit table.
solution: Specify a valid table or view object for the audit table option.

message: Syslog facility or level not recognized
cause: Syslog facility or level did not conform to the standard facility or level provided in the syslog.h file
solution: Specify a facility or level such as "LOCAL1.NOTICE" which conforms to the syslog.h file

message: resetting with SCOPE=MEMORY or SCOPE=BOTH is currently not supported
cause: An attempt was made to reset an in-memory parameter value
solution: Specify SCOPE=SPFILE if applicable, or explicitly set the parameter to the desired value

message: an SPFILE is already associated with the instance
cause: An attempt was made to update the parameter SPFILE on an instance that was already associated with an spfile.
solution: Restart the instance with a parameter file.

message: illegal reference of a query name in WITH clause
cause: forward or recursive reference of a query name in WITH clause is not allowed.
solution: Correct query statement, then retry.

message: free temporary object number not available
cause: Too many queries using temp table transformation are currently being run to use up all temporay object numbers.
solution: Turn off temporary table transformation or wait, then retry

message: unsupported column aliasing
cause: column aliasing in WITH clause is not supported yet
solution: specify aliasing in defintion subquery and retry

message: unsupported use of WITH clause
cause: Inproper use of WITH clause because one of the following two reasons: 1. nesting of WITH clause within WITH clause not supported yet 2. For a set query, WITH clause can't be specified for a branch. 3. WITH clause cannot be specified within parenthesis.
solution: correct query and retry

message: unreferenced query name defined in WITH clause
cause: There is at least one WITH clause query name that is not referenced in any place.
solution: remove the unreferenced query name and retry

message: unsupported case for inlining of query name in WITH clause
cause: There is at least one query name which is inlined more than once because its definition query is too simple and references another query name. This is currently unsupported yet.
solution: remove such query name and retry

message: unsupported use of LEVEL in membership condition
cause: An attempt was made to use LEVEL in membership condition with subquery that is not supported.
solution: Rewrite query to avoid using LEVEL in membership condition

message: number of WITH clause column names does not match number of elements in select list
cause: A list of column aliases or names was specified for a WITH clause query name but the number of elements in the list did not match the number of elements in the select list of the definition query.
solution: Update the column alias list or the select list to ensure they have the same number of elements.

message: recursive WITH clause must have column alias list
cause: A WITH clause query referred to itself (recursive) but did not have a column alias list specified for it.
solution: Add a column alias list for the WITH clause query name.

message: recursive WITH clause must use a UNION ALL operation
cause: A WITH clause query referred to itself (recursive) but did not use a UNION ALL operation in its definition query.
solution: Rewrite the recursive WITH clause query to use a UNION ALL operation.

message: UNION ALL operation in recursive WITH clause must have only two branches
cause: A WITH clause query referred to itself (recursive) but used a UNION ALL operation with more than two branches, which is not currently supported.
solution: Rewrite the recursive WITH clause query to use only two branches in the UNION ALL operation.

message: recursive WITH clause must reference itself directly in one of the UNION ALL branches
cause: A WITH clause query referred to itself (recursive) indirectly, such as through a subquery or view.
solution: Rewrite the recursive WITH clause query to refer to itself directly in the FROM clause of one of the UNION ALL branches.

message: recursive WITH clause needs an initialization branch
cause: A WITH clause query referred to itself (recursive) but did not have a branch in a UNION ALL with no references to itself (the initialization branch or anchor member).
solution: Rewrite the recursive WITH query to have a branch in a UNION ALL operation with no references to itself.

message: cycle detected while executing recursive WITH query
cause: A recursive WITH clause query produced a cycle and was stopped in order to avoid an infinite loop.
solution: Rewrite the recursive WITH query to stop the recursion or use the CYCLE clause.

message: maximum level of recursion reached while executing recursive WITH query
cause: A recursive WITH query reached the maximum level of recursion specified and was stopped.
solution: Increase the maximum level of recursion or use the CYCLE clause.

message: sequence column name for SEARCH clause must not be part of the column alias list
cause: The SEARCH clause for a recursive WITH query specified a sequence column that was already listed in the column alias list for the WITH clause query name.
solution: Specify a different name for the sequence column for the SEARCH clause or remove the name from the column alias list.

message: cycle mark value and non-cycle mark value must be one byte character string values
cause: The cycle mark or the non-cycle mark values specified in the CYCLE clause of a recursive WITH query were not one byte character string values as required.
solution: Specify a one byte character string for the cycle mark and non-cycle mark values of the CYCLE clause for the recursive WITH query.

message: cycle mark column name for CYCLE clause must not be part of the column alias list
cause: The CYCLE clause for a recursive WITH query specified a cycle mark column that was already listed in the column alias list for the WITH clause query name.
solution: Specify a different name for the cycle mark column for the CYCLE clause or remove the name from the column alias list.

message: duplicate name found in column alias list for WITH clause
cause: The column alias list for a WITH clause element contained a name which appeared more than once in the list.
solution: Remove the duplicate name from the column alias list.

message: string operation failed
cause: A mapping operation failed.
solution: Check FMON trace files for errors.

message: mapping service not available
cause: The mapping service was never started or previously failed to start properly.
solution: Set FILE_MAPPING to TRUE if it is not currently set. Otherwise, check FMON trace files for an ORA-32052 error.

message: failed to start mapping service
cause: The mapping service failed to start properly.
solution: Check FMON trace files for errors.

message: operation not supported
cause: Mapping libraries do not support operation.
solution: Check whether mapping libraries are available and whether operation is supported by the libraries.

message: lost communication with FMPUTL process
cause: Lost communication with mapping utility.
solution: Check FMON and FMPUTL trace files for errors.

message: invalid file type
cause: Invalid file type used when mapping files.
solution: Specify one of expected file types.

message: invalid number of extents
cause: Invalid number of extents used for map operation.
solution: Specify a non-negative number of extents.

message: invalid lock mode
cause: An invalid mode was used for a lock operation.
solution: Specify one of expected lock modes.

message: operation restricted to SYSDBA users
cause: Operation requires SYSDBA priviliges.
solution: Connect to the database as SYSDBA.

message: deadlock detected on mapping structures
cause: Mapping structures already locked by the same session.
solution: Unlock mapping structures before proceeding with current operation.

message: channel failure
cause: Channel failure between foreground and background process.
solution: Check foreground trace files for errors.

message: operation invalid on transient object
cause: Trying to perform an operation on transient object which is is valid only on persistent objects
solution: Make sure object is persistent

message: cannot create OCI Environment
cause: An OCI Environment could not be created for OCCI
solution: Insure that the parameters to the creatEnvironment method are valid

message: invalid OCI handle
cause: An invalid OCI handle is passed to an OCI call.
solution: This is an internal OCCI Error. Please contact customer support.

message: error from OCI call
cause: An error code other than OCI_ERROR is returned from an OCI call.
solution: This is an internal OCCI Error. Please contact customer support.

message: cannot retrieve OCI error message
cause: Error message after an OCI call could not be retrieved.
solution: This is an internal OCCI Error. Please contact customer support.

message: array fetch not allowed without setBuffer on all columns
cause: The setBuffer method was not called for all column postions and the next method was called to fetch more than one row.
solution: Call the setBuffer method for all column positions if next is to to be called to fetch more than one row.

message: internal OCI memory allocation failure
cause: Memory could not be allocated from an OCI heap.
solution: Increase the process memory size.

message: max column or parameter size not specified
cause: The max column or parameter size is not specified.
solution: Specify the max size by setMaxColumnSize or setMaxParamSize.

message: invalid column or parameter position
cause: An invalid column or parameter position is specified.
solution: Specify a valid column or position number.

message: Connection not specified
cause: A null connection was passed.
solution: Pass a valid, non-null connection.

message: Null object passed
cause: Null object was passed.
solution: Pass a non-null object.

message: Cannot perform operation on a null LOB
cause: The LOB instance on which the operation was attempted was null.
solution: Use a valid, non-null LOB instance to perform this operation.

message: Buffer size is less than amount specified
cause: The buffer size specified for the LOB read or write operation was less than the amount to be read or written.
solution: The buffer size must be equal to or greater than than the amount to be read from or written to the LOB.

message: Source LOB is null
cause: The source LOB instance on which the operation was attempted was null.
solution: Use a valid, non-null source LOB instance for this operation.

message: Cannot perform operation on a null FILE
cause: The FILE instance on which the operation was attempted was null.
solution: Use a valid, non-null FILE instance to perform this operation.

message: Buffer size is less than amount specified
cause: The buffer size specified for the FILE read or write operation was less than the amount to be read or written.
solution: The buffer size must be equal to or greater than than the amount to be read from or written to the FILE.

message: Source FILE is null
cause: The source FILE instance on which the operation was attempted was null.
solution: Use a valid, non-null source FILE instance for this operation.

message: Attribute number is out of range
cause: The attribute number passed is greater than the total number of attributes of the described object.
solution: Pass the attribute number within the allowable range.

message: Illegal attribute passed
cause: The attribute passed is not applicable for the described object.
solution: Pass a valid attribute.

message: Attribute type is not appropriate
cause: The return type of the get method does not match the type of the attribute being passed.
solution: Call the appropriate get method.

message: Cannot perform operations on a null REF
cause: The REF instance on which the operation was attempted was null.
solution: Use a valid, non-null REF instance to perform this operation.

message: REFs do not belong to any connection
cause: Neither of the REFs being compared had associated connection information.
solution: Atleast one of the REFs being compared must be associated with a valid connection.

message: setDataBuffer called after fetch has started
cause: Fetch from result set has already started and the setDataBuffer call was made.
solution: Call the setDataBuffer method before calling the next() method.

message: cannot get information about this column
cause: The setDataBuffer method was called to get information about this column. Therfore, the current method cannot be called.
solution: Use the information from the buffers specifed in the setDataBuffer call.

message: invalid offset/index refrenced in Bytes
cause: The offset/index is out of range of valid data locations in Bytes offsets.
solution: Insure that offsets or index is within the range of Bytes object.

message: bind data type cannot be changed
cause: The setXXX method is called again with a different data type than originally specified, or the setXXX method is called for a subsequent iteration without being called before the first iteration.
solution: Call the setXXX method with the same data type as done before the first iteration. If no setXXX method was called for this parameter postion the first iteration, then make sure that a setXXX method is called before the first addIteration method is called.

message: maximum iterations cannot be changed
cause: The setMaxIterations is called after a setXXX method has been called.
solution: Call the setMaxIterations method before calling any setXXX methods.

message: Cannot get stream from LOB/FILE
cause: An open stream exists on the the LOB/FILE on which the operation was attempted.
solution: Close the stream before getting another.

message: Cannot assign LOBs
cause: An open stream exists on the target LOB.
solution: Close the stream on the target LOB before assigning the LOBs.

message: Cannot assign FILEs
cause: An open stream exists on the target FILE.
solution: Close the stream on the target FILE before assigning the FILEs.

message: Cannot perform operation on an invalid stream
cause: The LOB/FILE from which the stream was obtained had been nullified or destroyed.
solution: Use a valid stream.

message: Cannot write to the stream
cause: A write was performed after the last buffer was written.
solution: Close this stream and get a new stream to perform the write.

message: cannot peform this operation on stream
cause: Either a read is attempted from a stream oi write mode, or a write is attempted on a stream in read mode.
solution: Check the status of the stream to find out the valid operations that can be performed.

message: get method does not match the type of the parameter
cause: The getXXX method called on the Statement object does not match the type of the bind parameter.
solution: Call the getXXX method that is the same as the type of the parameter.

message: maximum number of iterations exceeded
cause: The addIteration exceeds the maximum number of iterations set by the the setMaxIterations method.
solution: Increase the maximum number of allowed iterations.

message: Environment not specified
cause: A null environment was passed.
solution: Pass a valid, non-null environment.

message: Cannot perform operation on a null interval
cause: The interval involved in this operation is null.
solution: Use valid, non-null interval instance to perform this operation.

message: Environment not specified
cause: The interval on which the operation was attempted was null and no environment was specified.
solution: Specify non-null environment or perform the operation on a non null instance.

message: Cannot perform operation on a null date
cause: The date involved in this operation is null.
solution: Use valid, non-null date instance to perform this operation.

message: Environment not specified
cause: The date on which the operation was attempted was null and no environment was specified.
solution: Specify non-null environment or perform the operation on a non null instance.

message: Cannot perform operation on a null timestamp
cause: The timestamp involved in this operation is null.
solution: Use valid, non-null timestamp instance to perform this operation.

message: Environment not specified
cause: The timestamp on which the operation was attempted was null and no environment was specified.
solution: Specify non-null environment or perform the operation on a non null instance.

message: Cannot perform operation on a null number
cause: The number involved in this operation is null.
solution: Use valid, non-null number instance to perform this operation.

message: Environment not specified
cause: The number on which the operation was attempted was null and no environment was specified.
solution: Specify non-null environment or perform the operation on a non null instance.

message: Anydata context not specified
cause: A null anydata context was passed.
solution: Pass a valid, non-null anydata context.

message: Anydata not specified
cause: A null anydata was passed.
solution: Pass a valid, non-null anydata.

message: Cannot perform operation on stream
cause: This operation is not applicable to streams obtained from LOBs.
solution: None

message: Invalid type passed
cause: An inapplicable type was passed to this call.
solution: Pass an applicable type.

message: Cannot set prefetch options for a null Type
cause: A null Type name was passed.
solution: Pass an non-null Type name.

message: Cannot perform piecewise fetch
cause: Zero amount was passed and buffer size was less than LOB size
solution: Specify a larger buffer or use Stream

message: Read/Write SQL method not registered
cause: readSQL/writeSQL method was NULL or was not registered
solution: Register readSQL/writeSQL by calling put method in Map

message: Method called on Invalid Environment type
cause: A non-XA call made on an XA Environment or XA call made on non-XA Environment
solution: Make sure Environment type is OK

message: Method called on Invalid Connection type
cause: A non-XA call made on an XA Connection or XA call made on non-XA Connection
solution: Make sure Connection type is OK

message: Cannot get XA environment
cause: Incorrect dbname string was passed or the XA connection has not been opened
solution: Pass the correct dbname string or check if the XA connection is open

message: Cannot get XA connection
cause: Incorrect dbname string was passed or the XA connection has not been opened
solution: Pass the correct dbname string or check if the XA connection is open

message: No payload set on the Message
cause: An attempt was made to enqueue a message without setting a payload on it.
solution: Set a payload on the message before calling the send method.

message: Cannot perform operation on a null AnyData
cause: The AnyData instance on which the operation was attempted was null.
solution: Use a valid, non-null AnyData instance to perform this operation.

message: cannot drop a secondary materialized view " string "." string "
cause: An attempt was made to drop a materialized view of a nested table column's storage table.
solution: Drop the materialized view that contains the nested table column. This will implicitly drop all secondary materialized views.

message: object-relational materialized views must be primary key based
cause: An attempt was made to create an object-relational materialized view that is not primary key based.
solution: Create the materialized view with the PRIMARY KEY keyword.

message: object materialized views must be object ID based
cause: An attempt was made to create an object materialized view that is not object ID based.
solution: Create the materialized view using the OF clause but omit any ROWID or PRIMARY KEY clauses.

message: mviews with user-defined types cannot reference multiple master sites
cause: For materialized views with user-defined types, the definition query cannot reference tables from different master sites.
solution: Do not create materialized views with user-defined types referencing multiple master sites.

message: materialized views with user-defined types cannot use prebuilt table
cause: An attempt was made to create a materialized view with the ON PREBUILT TABLE option.
solution: Do not create the materialized view with the ON PREBUILT TABLE option.

message: RepAPI materialized views with user-defined types are not supported
cause: An attempt was made to create a RepAPI materialized view with user-defined types.
solution: Do not create a RepAPI materialized view with user-defined types.

message: updatable materialized views with user-defined types must use SELECT *
cause: An attempt was made to create an updatable materialized view with user-defined types where the definition query did not use SELECT * at the topmost level.
solution: Rewrite the definition query so that SELECT * is used at the topmost level.

message: must use FROM ONLY clause when referencing an object table
cause: An attempt was made to create a materialized view whose definition query references object tables without the FROM ONLY clause.
solution: Rewrite the definition query to use the FROM ONLY clause for all the object tables in the query.

message: object materialized views must use SELECT *
cause: An attempt was made to create an object materialized view where the definition query did not use SELECT * at the topmost level.
solution: Rewrite the definition query so that SELECT * is used at the topmost level.

message: object mview type " string "." string " does not match the master table type
cause: An attempt was made to create an object materialized view whose type does not match the type of the master object table.
solution: Redefine the type so that it matches the type of the master object table.

message: object materialized views must select from an object table
cause: An attempt was made to create an object materialized view whose definition query did not select from an object table.
solution: Rewrite the definition query to select from an object table.

message: materialized view definition query selects an unsupported user-defined type
cause: An attempt was made in the definition query to select an embedded user-defined type, function returning a user-defined type, or a function whose arguments are user-defined types.
solution: Rewrite the definition query to exclude these unsupported user-defined types.

message: cannot refresh a secondary materialized view " string "." string "
cause: An attempt was made to refresh a materialized view of a nested table column's storage table.
solution: Refresh the materialized view that contains the nested table column. This will implicitly refresh all secondary materialized views.

message: REFRESH FAST of " string "." string " unsupported after PMOPs
cause: A Partition Maintenance Operation (PMOP) has been performed on a detail table, and the specified materialized view does not support fast refersh after PMOPs.
solution: Use REFRESH COMPLETE. Note: you can determine why your materialized view does not support fast refresh after PMOPs using the DBMS_MVIEW.EXPLAIN_MVIEW() API.

message: REFRESH FAST of " string "." string " unsupported after deletes/updates
cause: One or more deletes or updates has been performed on one or more of the detail tables referenced by the specified materialized view. This materialized view does not support fast refresh after deletes or updates.
solution: Use REFRESH COMPLETE. Note: you can determine why your materialized view does not support fast refresh after deletes or updates using the DBMS_MVIEW.EXPLAIN_MVIEW() API.

message: REFRESH FAST of " string "." string " unsupported after mixed DML and Direct Load
cause: One or more of the materialized view logs on the detail tables referenced by the specified materialized view omits the sequence number option. Such a log cannot be used to refresh a materialized view after deletes or updates and direct path insert.
solution: Use REFRESH COMPLETE. Note: you can use the DBMS_MVIEW.EXPLAIN_MVIEW() API to determine which materialized view logs omit the sequence number option.

message: REFRESH FAST of " string "." string " unsupported after mixed DML
cause: One or more of the materialized view logs on the detail tables referenced by the specified materialized view omits the sequence number option. Such a log cannot be used to refresh a materialized view after deletes or updates have been performed on multiple detail tables.
solution: Use REFRESH COMPLETE. Note: you can use the DBMS_MVIEW.EXPLAIN_MVIEW() API to determine which materialized view logs omit the sequence number option.

message: cannot run a job from a job
cause: An attempt was made to execute a job from within another job.
solution: Do not submit jobs that run other jobs.

message: cannot rename a materialized view
cause: Renaming a materialized view or its base table is not supported.
solution: Do not rename the base table of a materialized view.

message: Cannot use direct loader log to FAST REFRESH materialized view " string "." string "
cause: The direct loader log might have been dropped
solution: Need to do complete refresh

message: REFRESH FAST of " string "." string " unsupported after container table PMOPs
cause: A Partition Maintenance Operation (PMOP) has been performed on the materialized view, and no materialized view supports fast refersh after container table PMOPs.
solution: Use REFRESH COMPLETE. Note: you can determine why your materialized view does not support fast refresh after PMOPs using the DBMS_MVIEW.EXPLAIN_MVIEW() API.

message: REFRESH FAST of " string "." string " unsupported after detail table TRUNCATE
cause: A detail table has been truncated and no materialized view supports fast refersh after a detail table has been truncated
solution: Use REFRESH COMPLETE. Note: you can determine why your materialized view does not support fast refresh after TRUNCATE using the DBMS_MVIEW.EXPLAIN_MVIEW() API.

message: PCT refresh of " string "." string " not allowed the sequence of DMLs/PMOPs
cause: A table join dependent on another table on which PCT refresh is enabled has changed
solution: Use REFRESH FORCE which will pick the best possible refresh method on the materialized view

message: invalid operation on online redefinition interim table " string "." string "
cause: An invalid operation was performed on an interim table which was being used for online redefinition of a table.
solution: Do not perform any unsupported operation on the interim table.

message: type " string "." string " is incompatible with the master site
cause: A type used by the materialized view was found to be incompatible with its coressponding type on the master site. This could be because the type does not exist on the master site or has been evolved to a different version from that on the materialzied view site.
solution: Make sure that the types used by the materialized view are the same on both the materialized view and master sites.

message: cannot refresh materialized view " string "." string " as type evolution has occured
cause: The types used by the materialized view or its master tables have been evolved.
solution: Ensure that the types used by the materialized view have been evolved to the same version at both the master and materialized sites. Then, before refreshing the materialized view, evolve the materialized view using ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW.

message: disable table scn update for Materialized view
cause: an event is set for disabling table scn update to prevent deadlock situation. (bug 1376209)
