solution: disable null refresh and/or base table scn update for Materialized view

message: cannot create prebuilt materialized view on a table already referenced by a MV
cause: the table on which the materialized view is created as prebuilt is already referenced by a materialized view
solution: create the materialized view on a different table

message: dimension must have at least one level
cause: An level-less dimension is not allowed.
solution: Do not drop the only level of a dimension.

message: cannot use USING NO INDEX to create materialized view " string "." string "
cause: The USING NO INDEX option was specified to create an updatable primary key based materialized view, an index-organized materialized view or an object-id materialized view.
solution: Do not use the USING NO INDEX option to create an updatable primary key based materialized view, an index-organized materialized view or an object-id materialized view.

message: cannot alter materialized view with pending changes refresh on commit
cause: There are some pending changes in the detail tables
solution: Execute an on-demand refresh on the materialized view to synchronize the data between the materialized view and the detail tables and then issue an ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW statement.

message: on commit refresh grab all the detailed tables
cause: an event is set to let on-commit MV refresh to grab all the detailed tables, no matter whether they have modified or not.
solution: None

message: cannot alter materialized view with the PMOP
cause: the materialized view is not allowed to have destructive PMOPS such as DROP, TRUNCATE and EXCHANGE (sub)partition. The UGA flag of i_am_a_refresh should be set first.
solution: execute set_i_am_a_refresh first before alter materialized view with the PMOP.

message: cannot tune the materialized view definition
cause: Due to constructs in the materialized view definition, it could not be tuned to be fast-refreshable or rewriteable.
solution: Execute DBMS_MVIEW.EXPLAIN_MVIEW to determine the cause.

message: The EXPLAIN_MVIEW facility failed to explain the materialized view " string "." string "
cause: The dependent object(s) of the materialized view may have changed. The materialized view may no longer be valid.
solution: Execute ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW COMPILE and to determine the status of the materialized view in catalog views.

message: The EXPLAIN_MVIEW facility failed to explain the materialized view statement
cause: An error exists in the materialized view definition. As a result, the materialized view statement could not be explained.
solution: Check the syntax of the statement. If it is a CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW statement, then also check the PARAMETERs specified for the materialized view.

message: cannot create a secondary materialized view with synonym as base table
cause: It is not supported to create a secondary materialized view with synonym in the FROM clause.
solution: Removed the synonym(s) from the statement.

message: fail to refresh the materialized view string . string due to the changed synonym
cause: The definition of one or more synonyms in the from clause have changed. The structure of the materialized view has become invalid.
solution: Restore the synonym(s) or drop the materialized view and recreate it again.

message: ON COMMIT materialized view refresh caused changes to the master table/materialized view
cause: ON COMMIT refresh of a read-only materialized view changed the master table/materialized view. A trigger on the refreshed materialized view may be the cause.
solution: Do not create triggers on materialized view which update the master table/materialized view.

message: NULL capabilities during explain mview
cause: The supplied defining query did not generate any capabilities information.
solution: Replace the query since it is not suitable for creating a materialized view.

message: revalidate summary object based on user input
cause: An event was set to specify the number of attempts that the system needed to make in order to validate an invalidated summary object.
solution: Revalidate an invalidated summary object based on user input.

message: cannot reference prebuilt table in definition query for materialized view
cause: The prebuilt container table of the materialized view was referenced in the definition query.
solution: Change the definition query to reference a non-prebuilt table.

message: ON COMMIT refresh obtain shared lock for all the detailed tables
cause: An event was set to let ON COMMIT materialized view refresh to obtain a shared lock for all the detailed tables, whether they have been modified or not.
solution: No action necessary.

message: database link name cannot start with a number while creating materialized view
cause: This event was disabled by default. If enabled, the fix for bug 6074902 will be disabled and you will be unable to create database links starting with a number when creating a materialized view on remote tables.
solution: No action necessary.

message: cannot use object id columns from materialized view log on " string "." string "
cause: The materialized view log either does not have object id columns logged, or the timestamp associated with the object id columns is more recent than the last refresh time.
solution: A complete refresh is required before the next fast refresh. Add object id columns to the materialized view log, if required.

message: materialized view log on " string "." string " does not have new values
cause: Materialized view log on the indicated table does not have new values information.
solution: Add new values to materialized view log using the ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG command.

message: cannot use new values from mv log on " string "." string "
cause: The materialized view log either does not have new values logged, or the timestamp associated with the new values columns is more recent than the last refresh time.
solution: Perform a complete refresh is required before the next fast refresh.

message: snapshot log uses Change Data Capture which is not enabled for this database
cause: A snapshot log that utilizes Change Data Capture is being imported to a database where Change Data Capture has not been enabled.
solution: First enable Change Data Capture on the database then retry the import.

message: cannot alter tablespace for existing materialized view log
cause: The tablespace specification for the existing materialized view log cannot be altered or changed.
solution: remove the tablespace clause from the statement.

message: cannot alter partitioning for existing materialized view log
cause: The partitioning specification for the existing materialized view log cannot be altered or changed.
solution: remove the partitioning clause from the statement.

message: cannot exclude new values when materialized view log includes new values
cause: The excluding new values specification for the existing materialized view log cannot be accepted when including new values is the current option.
solution: change excluding new values clause.

message: materialized view log on " string "." string " already has new values
cause: The materialized view log on the indicated table already has new values.
solution: No action required.

message: materialized view log on " string "." string " already excludes new values
cause: The materialized view log on the indicated table already excludes new values.
solution: No action required.

message: materialized view definition query exceeds the maximum length
cause: The materialized view definition query exceeds the 64K limit.
solution: Change the materialized view definition query so that it does not exceed the maximum length of 64K.

message: encrypted column " string " not allowed in the materialized view log
cause: The materialized view log being created/altered is to capture an encrypted column of the base table.
solution: Do not capture the encrypted column.

message: allow concurrent refresh of materialized view and truncate
cause: This event is set to allow concurrent refresh of materialized view and truncate of base table; it prevents a deadlock situation. (bug 6710019)
solution: Set this event to allow concurrent refresh of materialized view and truncate of the base table.

message: materialized view logs are not compatible with each other for fast refresh
cause: An attempt was made to create a fast refreshable materialized view on tables which have commit SCN-based materialized view logs and tables which have timestamp-based materialized view logs.
solution: Use COMPLETE REFRESH or change underlying materailized view logs to make them compatible with each other for fast refresh.

message: fast refreshable remote materialized view on a detail table with commit SCN-based materialized view log is not supported
cause: The materialized view creation failed because fast refreshable remote materialized view on a detail table with commit SCN-based materialized view log was not supported.
solution: None

message: one or more commit SCN-based materialized view logs are not in consistent state for fast refresh
cause: Dictionary table "SYS"."SNAP_XCMT$" is not in consistent state.
solution: No action required.

message: must use DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG to drop " string "." string "
cause: An attempt was made to drop materialized view log using a command other than DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG.
solution: No action required.

message: COMMIT SCN keyword only appears in CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG statement
cause: An attempt was made to alter an existing materialized view log to have commit SCN.
solution: No action required.

message: on commit materialized view is not supported on detail tables with commit SCN-based materialized view logs
cause: An attempt was made to create an on commit materialized view on detail tables with commit SCN-based materialized view logs.
solution: No action required.

message: unsupported fast refreshable materialized view defined on detail tables which have commit SCN-based materialized view logs
cause: An attempt was made to create an unsupported fast refreshable materialized view on detail tables with commit SCN based materialized view logs.
solution: No action required.

message: commit SCN-based materialized view log is not supported on a table with LOB column(s)
cause: An attempt was made to create a commit SCN-based materialized view log on a table which has LOB column(s).
solution: No action required.

message: commit SCN-based materialized view log cannot be created on table " string "." string " when there exist direct load/PMOP log entries for the table
cause: An attempt was made to create a commit SCN-based materialized view log on a table which had direct load/PMOP log entries in sys.sumdelta$ and sys.sumpartlog$.
solution: Refresh the table's dependent materialized views before creating commit SCN-based materialized view log on the table.

message: commit SCN-based materialized view log cannot be dropped on table " string "." string " when there exist direct load/PMOP log entries for the table
cause: An attempt was made to drop a commit SCN-based materialized view log on a table which had direct load/PMOP log entries in sys.sumdelta$ and sys.sumpartlog$.
solution: Refresh the table's dependent materialized views before dropping commit SCN-based materialized view log on the table.

message: materialized view log on " string "." string " already has this purge option
cause: Materialized view log on the indicated table already has the purge option specified.
solution: Specify a different purge option or omit the purge option.

message: asynchronous and scheduled purge option is not allowed on commit SCN-based materialized view log
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter a commit SCN-based materialized log with asynchronous and scheduled purge option.
solution: Specify a different purge option or omit the purge option.

message: materialized view log on " string "." string " in DST upgrade
cause: The materialized view log was created or altered on a table that had a Daylight Saving Time upgrade in progress.
solution: Wait until DST upgrade finishes on the master table.

message: materialized view contains unsupported NLS transformation
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter materialized view under NLS settings which transformed the materialized view's defining query in ways not by supported by Oracle.
solution: Contact Oracle support or workaround problem by removing NLS settings or modifying the materialized view's defining query.

message: SEARCH and CYCLE clauses can only be specified for recursive WITH clause elements
cause: A SEARCH or a CYCLE clause was specified for a WITH clause element that was not recursive.
solution: Remove the SEARCH or CYCLE clause, or add recursion to the WITH clause element.

message: cycle value for CYCLE clause must be different from the non-cycle value
cause: A CYCLE clause was specified for a recursive WITH query but the cycle value was the same as the non-cycle or DEFAULT value.
solution: Change either the cycle or the non-cycle values so that they no longer match.

message: sequence column for SEARCH clause must be different from the cycle mark column for CYCLE clause
cause: A SEARCH clause and a CYCLE clause was specified for a recursive WITH query, but the sequence column of the SEARCH clause matched the cycle mark column of the CYCLE clause.
solution: Change either the sequence column or the cycle mark column so that they no longer match.

message: duplicate name found in sort specification list for SEARCH clause of WITH clause
cause: A SEARCH clause was specified for a recursive query with a sort specification list which contained duplicate names.
solution: Remove the duplicate names from the sort specification list of the SEARCH clause.

message: duplicate name found in cycle column list for CYCLE clause of WITH clause
cause: A CYCLE clause was specified for a recursive query with a cycle column list which contained duplicate names.
solution: Remove the duplicate names from the cycle column list of the CYCLE clause.

message: element in cycle column list of CYCLE clause must appear in the column alias list of the WITH clause element
cause: An element in the cycle column list of a CYCLE clause that was specified for a recursive WITH query did not appear in the column alias list of the WITH clause element.
solution: Change the cycle column list to use only names which are listed in the column alias list of the WITH clause element.

message: unsupported operation in recursive branch of recursive WITH clause
cause: The recursive component of the UNION ALL in a recursive WITH clause element used an operation that was currently not supported. The following should not be used in the recursive branch of the UNION ALL operation: GROUP BY, DISTINCT, MODEL, grouping sets, CONNECT BY, window functions, HAVING, aggregate functions.
solution: Rewrite the query without the unsupported operation.

message: unsupported join in recursive WITH query
cause: The recursive component of a recursive WITH clause element contained one of the following: - A LEFT OUTER join where the right side was the recursive query name. - A RIGHT OUTER join where the left side was the recursive query name. - A FULL OUTER join involving the recursive query name.
solution: Rewrite the query without the unsupported join operation.

message: WITH clause element did not have a column alias list
cause: A WITH clause element used the SEARCH clause or CYCLE clause or both but did not have a column alias list specified for it.
solution: Add a column alias list for the WITH clause query name.

message: element in sort specification list of SEARCH clause did not appear in the column alias list of the WITH clause element
cause: An element in the sort specification list of a SEARCH clause that was specified for a recursive WITH query did not appear in the column alias list of the WITH clause element.
solution: Change the sort specification list to use only names which are listed in the column alias list of the WITH clause element.

message: recursive query name referenced more than once in recursive branch of recursive WITH clause element
cause: The recursive component of the UNION ALL in a recursive WITH clause element referenced the recursive query name more than once. Only one reference to the recursive query name is allowed in the recursive branch of a recursive WITH clause element.
solution: Rewrite the query using only one reference to the recursive query name in the recursive branch of the recursive WITH clause element.

message: Dirname ' string ' cannot exceed ' string ' characters
cause: Path name too long
solution: Use shorter pathname than maximum specified for dirname.

message: Writing SGA to file failed
cause: Underlying OSDs encountered an error
solution: Check additional information. slercerrno contains errno.

message: Cannot execute command. Flash Freeze is not in effect
cause: This command can only be issued after a flash freeze
solution: Refer to instructions for flash freeze and Oracle diagnostics.

message: Mapping SGA from file failed
cause: Underlying OSDs encountered an error
solution: Check additional information. slercerrno contains errno.

message: expecting one of string , string , string , or string but found string
cause: illegal value specified for create watchpoint mode
solution: specify one of the expected modes

message: too many watchpoints
cause: too many watchpoints created
solution: increase appropriate initialization parameters

message: expecting one of string , string , or string but found string
cause: invalid arguments provided
solution: provide one of the expected arguments

message: expecting string but found string
cause: invalid arguments to command
solution: provide one of the expected arguments

message: no such watchpoint id
cause: invalid watchpoint id
solution: use oradebug show to list valid watchpoint ids

message: watchpoint was already deleted
cause: trying to delete an already deleted watchpoint
solution: use oradebug show to list valid watchpoint ids

message: cannot create watchpoint on unreadable memory
cause: trying to create watchpoint on invalid address
solution: provide a different valid address

message: cannot create watchpoint in memory needed by watchpointing code
cause: overlap exists between requested memory range to watch and internal memory structures that watchpointing operations need
solution: provide a different address range

message: type ' string ' is unknown
cause: trying to dump an invalid type name
solution: specify a known type

message: cannot dump multiple ' string ' types: structure size is unknown
cause: trying to dump an invalid address
solution: provide a different valid address

message: cannot issue ORADEBUG command ' string ' to process ' string '; prior command execution time exceeds string ms
cause: The process targeted to execute the ORADEBUG command was busy executing another ORADEBUG command for a time greater than the timeout value specified.
solution: Increase the timeout value.

message: cannot wait for process ' string ' to finish executing ORADEBUG command ' string '; wait time exceeds string ms
cause: The execution of the ORADEBUG command took longer than the the timeout value specified.
solution: Increase the timeout value.

message: cannot issue ORADEBUG command ' string ' to process ' string ' (prior command execution time exceeds string ms); total wait time exceeds string ms
cause: The process targeted to execute the ORADEBUG command was busy executing another ORADEBUG command. But, because the total wait time for all targeted processes exceeded the maximum wait time, the ORADEBUG command was not issued to the target process.
solution: Increase the timeout value.

message: cannot wait for process ' string ' to finish executing ORADEBUG command ' string ' (waited string ms); total wait time exceeds string ms
cause: The total wait time for all targeted processes exceeded the maximum wait time, therefore the wait for the targeted process to finish executing the ORADEBUG command was aborted.
solution: Increase the timeout value.

message: insufficient privileges to execute ORADEBUG command: string
cause: Sufficient privileges were not granted.
solution: Perform the operation using a database session that has the required privileges. See the Oracle ORADEBUG documentation for more details.

message: error authenticating credentials
cause: An error was encountered while authenticating credentials.
solution: Check the other error messages for additional information or contact Oracle Support Services.

message: error parsing ORADEBUG command: string
cause: An invalid ORADEBUG command was specified.
solution: Specify the correct ORADEBUG command and arguments.

message: Replacement occured despite hint to the contrary
cause: This should never be signalled; it's internal.
solution: Report to Oracle support.

message: Explicit column default is not supported for modifying views
cause: Default keyword was used to modify views.
solution: Use implicit default - omitting column-value pair.

message: missing TYPE keyword
cause: keyword TYPE is missing.
solution: Use TYPE keyword.

message: username must be SYS or SYSTEM
cause: A user name of SYS or SYSTEM was not specified when providing a password in the CREATE DATABASE statement.
solution: Only passwords for the SYS and SYSTEM users can be provided in the CREATE DATABASE statement. Re-issue the statement with passwords for users SYS or SYSTEM.

message: password for SYS already specified
cause: A password for the SYS user was specified twice in the CREATE DATABASE statement.
solution: Re-issue the CREATE DATABASE statement with only one password for the SYS user.

message: password for SYSTEM already specified
cause: A password for the SYSTEM user was specified twice in the CREATE DATABASE statement.
solution: Re-issue the CREATE DATABASE statement with only one password for the SYSTEM user.

message: both SYS and SYSTEM passwords must be provided
cause: Passwords for both the SYS and SYSTEM users were not provided in the CREATE DATABASE statement. If one of the passwords was provided, then both should be provided.
solution: Re-issue the CREATE DATABASE statement with a password for both the SYS and SYSTEM users.

message: missing or invalid password
cause: An incorrect password was provided for the SYS or SYSTEM user in the CREATE DATABASE statement.
solution: Re-issue the CREATE DATABASE statement with a valid password.

message: table function with left correlation to a table cannot also be left outer-joined to the table
cause: A table function T2 contains a reference to a table T1. T2 is also left outer-joined to T1. This is not allowed.
solution: Remove the reference to T1 from T2 or remove the left outer-join specification (+).

message: query passed to table function has wrong number of elements in select list
cause: The query used as an input to a table function which takes a a ref cursor as argument has wrong number of elements in the select list which does not correspond to the elements in ref cursor. The ref cursor mentioned here refers to the one referenced in order by parition clauses. This is not allowed.
solution: Make sure that the select list of the query matches the ref cursor columns as defined in the function.

message: missing LOG keyword
cause: keyword LOG is missing.
solution: Use LOG keyword.

message: duplicate specification of a supplemental log attribute
cause: In a create/alter DDL a supplemental log attribute is specified more than once.
solution: Rewrite the Create/Alter DDL such that it has a single occurence of any supplemental log attribute.

message: multiple specification of a supplemental logging attribute
cause: The primary key, unique index, foreign key or all column supplemental logging attribute can be specified at most once in a create/alter ddl.
solution: Rewrite the Create/Alter DDL with single occurence of the offending supplemental logging attribute.

message: Cannot drop nonexistent string supplemental logging
cause: specified supplemental log attribute does not exist.
solution: None

message: supplemental logging attribute string exists
cause: specified supplemental logging attribute exits.
solution: retry the alter/create ddl after removing this supplemental logging attribute.

message: unable to drop minimal supplemental logging
cause: Minimal supplemental logging could not be dropped as one of primary key, foreign key, unique or all column supplemental logging is enabled at the database level.
solution: Use V$DATABASE to determine the databasewide supplemental logging directives. Minimal supplemental logging could be dropped if and only if no other databasewide supplemental logging directives are enabled.

message: log group specification not allowed here
cause: Supplemental log specification is not allowed in the statement.
solution: Remove the supplemental log specification from the statement.

message: connect string too long
cause: The connect string specified for the database link was more than 2000 characters.
solution: Specify a connect string less than 2000 chracters.

message: all columns in log group can not be no log columns
cause: A supplemental log group must have at least one column of scalar type that is not marked as no log.
solution: Redefine the supplemental log group with at least one column of scalar type that is not marked as no log.

message: database supplemental logging attributes in flux
cause: there is another process actively modifying the database wide supplemental logging attributes.
solution: Retry the DDL or the LogMiner dictionary build that raised this error.

message: invalid object category for COMMENT command
cause: The object category specified is not a valid object for which to use the COMMENT command.
solution: Retry the COMMENT command by specifying an accepted object category. (ie, Table, Operator, Indextype, etc.)

message: DDL statement cannot be audited with BY SESSION specified
cause: An attempt was made to audit a DDL statement with BY SESSION clause specified. DDL statements can be audited BY ACCESS only.
solution: Specify BY ACCESS instead of BY SESSION to audit the DDL statement.

message: duplicate ALTER USER or CREATE USER option
cause: An ALTER USER option was duplicated.
solution: Remove the duplicate option.

message: database supplemental logging attributes inconsistent
cause: failed to propogate supplemental logging attributes to all RAC instances. Most likely caused by an instance leaving the RAC while this DDL was in progress.
solution: Retry the DDL or the LogMiner dictionary build that raised this error.

message: user names cannot be changed in ALTER DATABASE LINK command
cause: An attempt was made to change the fixed user name of the database link.
solution: None

message: RETENTION and PCTVERSION cannot be used together
cause: cannot use both RETENTION and PCTVERSION together.
solution: Use either RETENTION or PCTVERSION.

message: value for retention cannot be provided
cause: cannot give a value for Retention Period.
solution: do not provide the value for parameter.

message: FREEPOOLS and FREELIST GROUPS cannot be used together
cause: cannot use both FREEPOOLS and FREELIST GROUPS together.
solution: Use either FREEPOOLS or FREELIST GROUPS.

message: invalid FREEPOOLS LOB storage option value
cause: The specified FREEPOOLS LOB storage option value must be an integer.
solution: Choose an appropriate integer value and retry the operation.

message: invalid REBUILD option
cause: Keyword FREEPOOLS expected after the REBUILD keyword.
solution: User must specify FREEPOOLS keyword.

message: invalid REBUILD option
cause: cannot rebuild freepools while creating table with lob column.
solution: User must not specify REBUILD... in this context.

message: missing NAV keyword in MODEL clause
cause: The NAV keyword was specified where it is expected.
solution: Specify the NAV keyword or check the SQL statement.

message: invalid ITERATE value in MODEL clause
cause: The specified ITERATE value must be a 4 byte positive integer.
solution: Choose an appropriate value and retry the operation.

message: missing INCREMENT or DECREMENT keyword in FOR loop
cause: INCREMENT or DECREMENT keyword was not specifiedi where it is expected.
solution: Specify the INCREMENT or DECREMENT keyword or check the SQL statement.

message: missing REFERENCE keyword in MODEL clause
cause: The REFERENCE keyword was not specified where it is expected.
solution: Specify the REFERENCE keyword or check the SQL statement.

message: missing SINGLE REFERENCE or DIMENSION keyword in MODEL clause
cause: SINGLE REFERENCE or DIMENSION keyword was not specified where it is expected.
solution: Specify the applicable keywords or check the SQL statement.

message: incorrect use of MODEL CV operator
cause: CV function was used outside a dimension expression, in UNTIL condition, or with non-dimensional arguments.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: invalid use of FOR loop
cause: The MODEL FOR loop was used where it is not allowed. FOR loops are not allowed in complex dimensional predicates, on the right hand side of rules, or in the until condition.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: not a MODEL cell
cause: The operator requires a MODEL cell as operand.
solution: Specify MODEL cell as operand, check SQL statement.

message: illegal MODEL SELECT expression
cause: An expression other than MODEL aliases, constants, or expressions of the two is specified in the MODEL SELECT clause.
solution: Reformulate the query, perhaps nesting inside another SELECT.

message: incorrect use of MODEL IS ANY predicate
cause: IS ANY predicate is used outside dimension expression or with non-dimensional or different dimensional arguments.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: missing DIMENSION BY keyword in MODEL clause
cause: The DIMENSION keyword was not pecified where it is expected.
solution: Specify the DIMENSION keyword or check the SQL statement.

message: missing MEASURES keyword in MODEL clause
cause: The MEASURES keyword was not specified where it is expected.
solution: Specify the MEASURES keyword or check the SQL statement.

message: incorrect use of MODEL PREVIOUS function
cause: The MODEL PREVIOUS function was used outside of MODEL "ITERATE UNTIL" clause, or was nested.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: incorrect use of MODEL ITERATION_NUMBER
cause: ITERATION_NUMBER was used outside of an iterated MODEL.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: illegal subquery within MODEL rules
cause: A subquery was used illegally within the MODEL rule.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: illegal aggregation in UNTIL iteration condition
cause: An aggregate function was used in UNTIL condition.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: illegal multi-cell reference
cause: Multi-cell reference was specified on a measure expression without an aggregate function.
solution: Use an aggregate function on the measure expression or qualify the cell reference.

message: incorrect use of MODEL PRESENT* functions
cause: A PRESENT* function (IS PRESENT, PRESENTV, PRESENTNNV) was used in a measure expression.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: illegal reordering of MODEL dimensions
cause: The expressions to qualify dimensions were specified in an incorrect order within a cell reference.
solution: Reorder dimension expressions in the cell reference.

message: illegal dimension in cell reference predicate
cause: A non-positional dimension was referenced in the predicate.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: illegal bounds or increment in MODEL FOR loop
cause: FOR loop allows only numeric and datetime without timezone type for bounds. Only constants of interval and numeric types are allowed as increment/decrement expressions.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: illegal pattern in MODEL FOR LIKE loop
cause: The FOR LIKE pattern had zero or more than one wild characters.
solution: Simplify the pattern to have a single wildcard character.

message: invalid nesting of MODEL cell reference
cause: MODEL cell reference was nested too deeply.
solution: Avoid deep nesting of cell references and rewrite if necessary.

message: measure used for referencing cannot be updated
cause: A measure used in nested referencing is updated by a MODEL rule in the automatic order MODEL.
solution: Modify the SQL statement or use sequential order MODEL.

message: multiple assignment in automatic order MODEL
cause: A MODEL cell was updated on the same measure in multiple MODEL rules. Multiple assignment is not allowed in automatic order MODELs as it causes in ambiguity and nondeterminism.
solution: Use sequential order MODEL or rewrite the rule to avoid this.

message: illegal use of objects in MODEL
cause: An object column was used as a MODEL column. Object types are not allowed as partition by, dimension by or measure expressions.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: incorrect subquery in MODEL FOR cell index
cause: An illegal subquery was specified in MODEL FOR cell index. A subquery used in a MODEL FOR cell index can not have subqueries, correlation, binds and references to WITH tables.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: MODEL subquery FOR cell index returns too many rows
cause: Subquery in MODEL FOR cell index returned more than the allowed maximum.
solution: Split the rule into multiple ones.

message: automatic order MODEL evaluation does not converge
cause: Evaluation using automatic rule ordering did not reach a convergence point.
solution: Modify the rules or use sequential order instead.

message: not a single cell reference predicate
cause: A predicate that is not a single cell reference predicate was specified where a single cell reference predicate was expected. A single cell reference predicate is either a constant expression or a predicate of the form <dimension_key = constant_expr>
solution: Make sure that the predicate is a proper single cell reference. In some cases, you might have to put explicit type conversion operators (or casts) on the constant expression.

message: Too many rules in MODEL
cause: The number of rules (possibly after rule unfolding) exceeded the maximum number of rules allowed.
solution: Reduce the number of rules.

message: Self cyclic rule in sequential order MODEL
cause: A self-cyclic rule was detected in the sequential order MODEL. Sequential order MODELs cannot have self cyclic rules to guarantee that the results do not depend on the order of evaluation of the cells that are updated or upserted.
solution: Use ordered rule evaluation for this rule.

message: Non unique addressing in MODEL dimensions
cause: The address space defined for the MODEL (partition by and dimension by expressions) do not uniquely identify each cell.
solution: Rewrite the MODEL clause. Using UNIQUE SINGLE REFERENCE option might help.

message: Aggregate functions on reference MODELs are not allowed
cause: An aggregate function was specified on the cells of a reference MODEL.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: FOR LIKE loops are not allowed for multi-byte character types
cause: FOR LIKE loops was specified for a multi-byte character type.
solution: Check the SQL statement and rewrite if necessary.

message: invalid expression in MODEL rule ORDER BY clause
cause: An invalid expression was specified in the MODEL rule ORDER BY clause where only expressions of dimension and measure columns and reference MODEL cell references are allowed
solution: Modify the order by clause in the MODEL rule.

message: non-unique cell values from the ORDER BY clause
cause: The MODEL rule ORDER BY clause did not generate unique values for all cells that satisfy the predicates in the left side of the rule.
solution: Modify the rule ORDER BY clause in the MODEL rule.

message: invalid use of window function in MODEL rule
cause: The window functions can not be used in SQL Model rules that have FOR-loops on the left side or aggregates on the right side.
solution: Modify the MODEL rule.

message: this function is not allowed outside of MODEL clause
cause: A function allowed only within the MODEL clause is used outside of MODEL clause.
solution: Rewrite the SQL statement.

message: Hash Table Infrastructure ran out of memory
cause: Not enough memory.
solution: Increase memory.

message: HTI: Not enough memory
cause: Memory is not enough.
solution: Increase memory.

message: HTI: No free slot
cause: There is not enough memory.
solution: Increase memory.

message: error occurred in DIAG Group Service
cause: An unexpected error occurred while performing a DIAG Group Service operation.
solution: Verify that the DIAG process is still active. Also, check the Oracle DIAG trace files for errors.

message: Possible hangs up to hang ID= string detected
cause: Hang Manager detected one or more hangs. These could be valid hangs that require action or the system could be overloaded causing very slow progress which can be interpreted as hangs. If hang resolution is enabled, Hang Manager may attempt to resolve the hang by terminating the ultimate blocker.
solution: Check the incident logs associated with this message for diagnostic information.

message: Rolling migration is going on
cause: DIAG detected rolling migration in IPC.
solution: No action needed. DIAG is shutting down for rolling migration. This error number is solely used for internal purposes.

message: deadlock detected: string
cause: Oracle sessions waiting for resources were deadlocked.
solution: Reissue any commands that failed and contact Oracle Support Services with the incident information.

message: Command cannot be executed on remote instance
cause: DIAG is not registered with DIAG Group Service
solution: Issue the command without the cluster database syntax

message: Another Parallel Oradebug session is in progress
cause: Another session for Parallel Oradebug is in progress with the database
solution: Issue the command later when the current session finishes

message: Parallel Oradebug session is aborted
cause: Group reconfiguration is occurring among DIAGs
solution: Issue the command later when group reconfiguration completes

message: Error occurred when executing Parallel Oradebug
cause: Error is encountered during executing command at local node
solution: Check alert log and DIAG trace file for error detail

message: Error occurred when sending Oradebug command to remote DIAGs
cause: IPC communication problem encountered
solution: Check IPC communication between DIAGs and issue the command again

message: DIAG process is not running in the instance
cause: DIAG process is not alive
solution: Check error in DIAG trace file and issue the command again when DIAG is restarted

message: Hang analysis aborted due to wrong message type
cause: DIAG received wrong message.
solution: Check DIAG trace files for errors.

message: Hang analysis aborted due to failed memory allocation
cause: DIAG couldn't allocate buffer for remote copy.
solution: Check DIAG trace files for errors.

message: Hang analysis aborted due to failed memory copy
cause: DIAG couldn't copy buffer to remote node.
solution: Check DIAG trace files for errors.

message: Hang analysis aborted due to failed heap re-grow
cause: DIAG couldn't re-grow the heap for wait-for-graphs.
solution: Check DIAG trace files for errors.

message: The requested operation cannot be proceeded
cause: Operation was aborted because instance termination was in progress.
solution: Retry later after restarting the instance.

message: Hang analysis already going on
cause: Hang analysis was already in process globally or for the instance.
solution: Wait for the current operation to complete and re-run the command.

message: Hang analysis initialize failed
cause: Hang analyzer was not able to allocate memory to initialize.
solution: Check the trace files.

message: command cannot be executed on remote instance
cause: The database was not mounted in SHARED mode.
solution: Mount the database in SHARED mode.

message: instr with negative offset: use varchar semantics on LOBs
cause: The current varchar behavior is different. e.g. instr('abcd', 'cd', -2, 1) returns 3, whereas instr(to_clob('abcd'), 'cd', -2, 1) returns 0, (i.e. no match), because the reverse search starts from offset -2, which points to 'c' and moving backward, i.e. 'd' is ignored. This is symmetric to instr('dcba','dc',2,1), which returns 0.
solution: ORACLE uses the same varchar semantics on LOBs (instr). Using the same example, instr(to_clob('abcd'), 'cd', -2, 1) will return 3 as in the varchar case.

message: No server connection for this operation
cause: The client side sql or plsql function operation requires a connection to the server, but currently no client/server connection existed.
solution: Establish a client/server connection.

message: cannot add file to bigfile tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to add the second file to a bigfile tablespace.
solution: Do not use this command with bigfile tablespace.

message: BIGFILE is invalid option for this type of tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to create a bigfile tablespace that is dictionary managed or locally managed with manual segment-space management.
solution: Either change the tablespace type to locally managed with automatic segment-space management, or create a SMALLFILE tablespace instead.

message: operation not supported for smallfile tablespace string
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation which is supported only for bigfile tablespaces, e.g. resize tablespace.
solution: Use the appropriate clause of the ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE command instead.

message: more than one file was specified for bigfile tablespace string
cause: More than one datafile or tempfile was specified in CREATE TABLESPACE command for a bigfile tablespace.
solution: Change command to contain only one file or create a smallfile tablespace instead.

message: cannot change size attributes of read only tablespace string
cause: An attempt was made to change size attributes of a tablespace that is read only.
solution: Change the tablespace to read/write and retry the operation.

message: Element ' string ' cannot share the default table ' string ' with element ' string '
cause: An element in the restriction shared a default table with the corresponding element in it's supertype.
solution: Change the default table's name for the element in restriction.

message: internal error string
cause: An unexpected error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid value string for string
cause: An invalid value was specified for a parameter.
solution: Specify a valid value for the parameter.

message: value for string must be string
cause: An invalid value was specified for a parameter.
solution: Specify the value as indicated by the message.

message: value for string cannot be altered
cause: An attempt was made to alter a value that cannot be altered.
solution: Retry the operation without altering the indicated value.

message: invalid value string , string should have form string
cause: A value specified for a parameter has the incorrect form.
solution: Specify a string of the correct form.

message: identifier for string too long, maximum length is string characters
cause: An identifier string exceeded the maximum allowed length.
solution: Specify a string whose length is less than the maximum allowed length.

message: value for string is too long, maximum length is string
cause: A value exceeded it's maximum allowed length.
solution: Specify a value whose length is less than the maximum allowed length.

message: message system link string already exists
cause: A message system link of the specified name already exists.
solution: Specify a different name.

message: message system link string does not exist
cause: A message system link of the specified name does not exist.
solution: Specify a message system link name that already exists.

message: foreign queue string is already registered
cause: The foreign queue has already been registered for this message system link (NAME@MSGLINK).
solution: Specify a different name that is not being used for this message system link.

message: foreign queue string is not registered
cause: The foreign queue (NAME@MSGLINK) has not been registered for this message system link.
solution: Specify the name of a registered foreign queue.

message: subscriber string already exists
cause: The specified subscriber identifier already exists.
solution: Specify a different identifier.

message: subscriber string does not exist
cause: The specified subscriber identifier does not exist.
solution: Specify an existing subscriber identifier.

message: propagation schedule string already exists
cause: The specified propagation schedule identifer already exists.
solution: Specify a different identifier.

message: propagation schedule string does not exist
cause: The specified propagation schedule identifier does not exist.
solution: Specify a schedule identifier that already exists.

message: message system link string is referenced by a foreign queue
cause: An attempt was made to remove a message system link currently referenced by one or more registered foreign queues.
solution: Unregister all foreign queues using this message system link and retry the operation.

message: foreign queue string is referenced by a subscriber or schedule
cause: An attempt was made to unregister a foreign queue currently referenced by one or more subscribers or propagation schedules.
solution: Remove all subscribers and propagation schedules using this foreign queue and retry the operation.

message: message system link string is not configured with a log queue for string
cause: An attempt was made to add a propagation subscriber but the message system link was not configured with a log queue for the indicated propagation type.
solution: Alter the message system link to configure the link with a log queue for this propagation type.

message: AQ queue string does not exist
cause: An operation was attempted where the specified AQ queue does not exist.
solution: Specify the name of an existing AQ queue.

message: AQ queue string must be a normal queue
cause: An operation was attempted where the specified AQ queue exists but is not a normal queue.
solution: Specify the name of an AQ queue which was created as a normal queue (NORMAL_QUEUE).

message: subscriber queue and exception queue must use same message system link
cause: An operation was attempted for INBOUND propagation where the specified subscriber queue and exception queue reference different message system links.
solution: Specify an exception queue that is a registered foreign queue of the same message system link as the subscriber queue.

message: subscriber queue and exception queue must have same payload type
cause: An operation was attempted for OUTBOUND propagation where the AQ queues used for the subscriber queue and exception queue have different payload types.
solution: Specify an exception queue that has the same payload type as the subscriber queue.

message: subscriber string is marked for removal
cause: An administration operation was attempted for a subscriber which is marked for removal. If attempting to remove a subscriber, the Messaging Gateway agent is not running or is running but unable to remove the subscriber at this time.
solution: Do not issue propagation administration commands for a subscriber for which removal is pending. Wait for the subscriber to be removed by the agent or issue REMOVE_SUBSCRIBER with the FORCE option to force the subscriber to be removed.

message: subscriber exists for queue string and destination string
cause: An attempt was made to create a propagation subscriber when one already exists for the specified queue and destination pair.
solution: Specify a different queue and destination pair, or remove the subscriber using that pair and retry the operation.

message: schedule exists for source string and destination string
cause: An attempt was made to create a propagation schedule when one already exists for the specified source and destination pair.
solution: Specify a different source and destination pair, or remove the schedule using that pair and retry the operation.

message: Messaging Gateway agent has not been started
cause: An attempt was made to shut down the Messaging Gateway agent when it is not started.
solution: No action required.

message: Messaging Gateway agent has already been started
cause: An attempt was made to start the Messaging Gateway agent when it is already started.
solution: No action required.

message: Messaging Gateway agent must be shut down
cause: An operation was attempted that requires the Messaging Gateway agent to be shut down.
solution: Issue SHUTDOWN, wait for MGW_GATEWAY view to show a NOT_STARTED status, and retry the operation. CLEANUP_GATEWAY may need to be issued to reset the gateway state if the agent fails to shut down after a reasonable time period.

message: Messaging Gateway agent must be running
cause: An operation was attempted that requires the Messaging Gateway agent to be started and responsive.
solution: Issue STARTUP, wait for MGW_GATEWAY view to show a RUNNING status, and retry the operation.

message: Messaging Gateway agent cannot be shut down while it is starting
cause: An attempt was made to shut down the Messaging Gateway agent when it is in the process of starting and initializing.
solution: Wait for MGW_GATEWAY view to show a RUNNING status and retry the operation. CLEANUP_GATEWAY may need to be issued to reset the gateway state if the agent fails to start after a reasonable time period.

message: result code string returned by Messaging Gateway agent
cause: The Messaging Gateway agent terminated abnormally due to an unexpected error.
solution: Review the Messaging Gateway log file for further information regarding the problem. Resolve the problem and start the Messaging Gateway agent. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be resolved.

message: timed out trying to acquire administration lock
cause: A timeout occurred when attempting an administration operation. Either an administration operation was attempted while the Messaging Gateway agent was starting and initializing, or two administration operations were attempted at the same time.
solution: Retry the operation. If the Messaging Gateway agent is starting, wait for MGW_GATEWAY view to show a RUNNING status and retry the operation.

message: failure string trying to acquire administration lock
cause: An unexpected error occurred trying to acquire administration lock.
solution: Retry the operation. Contact Oracle Support Services if the error persists.

message: failure string trying to release administration lock
cause: An unexpected error occurred trying to release administration lock.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services if the error persists.

message: Messaging Gateway agent user has not been set
cause: A Messaging Gateway agent user has not been configured.
solution: Create a database user having role MGW_AGENT_ROLE and issue DB_CONNECT_INFO to configure an agent user.

message: database user string does not exist
cause: The specified database user does not currently exist.
solution: Create the user and grant all necessary privileges and roles.

message: database user string must be granted role string
cause: The specified database user does not have a required role.
solution: Grant the user the indicated role.

message: invalid configuration state string
cause: The specified configuration state is invalid.
solution: Remove and re-create the configured entities. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be identified or resolved.

message: exceeded maximum number of properties
cause: An attempt was made to alter a property list where the number of properties in the resulting list exceeds the maximum allowed.
solution: Order the elements of the alter list differently so the number of elements in the resulting list is less than the maximum.

message: property string is reserved, names with MGWPROP$_ prefix are not valid
cause: An attempt was made to specify a reserved name for a property name.
solution: Use a non-reserved name.

message: property name cannot be NULL
cause: An attempt was made to use NULL for a property name.
solution: Specify a non-NULL name.

message: invalid value for property string
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid value for a property.
solution: Specify a valid property value.

message: value for property string cannot be altered
cause: An attempt was made to alter a property that cannot be altered.
solution: Retry the operation without altering the indicated property.

message: value for string is outside the valid range of string to string
cause: A value was specified that is not in the valid range.
solution: Specify a value within the indicated range.

message: exceeded maximum number of string values
cause: An attempt was made to add a value of the specified type but the maximum number of such values has been reached.
solution: No action required.

message: Messaging Gateway agent is already running
cause: An attempt was made to start the Messaging Gateway agent when an agent instance is already running.
solution: Shut down the Messaging Gateway agent currently running, verify the agent process has been terminated, and start the Messaging Gateway agent.

message: Messaging Gateway agent cannot be started; status is string
cause: An attempt to start the Messaging Gateway agent failed due to the indicated agent status. A BROKEN status indicates a problem that requires user intervention before the agent can be started.
solution: Review the MGW_GATEWAY view and the Messaging Gateway log file for further information. Resolve the problem and start the Messaging Gateway agent. Contact Oracle Support Services if the problem cannot be resolved.

message: operation is not supported on this platform
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation that is not supported on this platform.
solution: Switch to a platform on which the operation is supported.

message: foreign queue DOMAIN required for JMS unified connections
cause: A DOMAIN was not specified when registering a foreign queue for a messaging system link that is configured to use the JMS unified messaging model.
solution: Specify a non-NULL value for the DOMAIN parameter.

message: string cannot be set unless string is set
cause: An attempt was made to specify a value for a parameter that cannot be set unless an associated parameter is also set.
solution: Specify a valid value for both parameters, or, do not specify a value for either parameter.

message: agent string does not exist
cause: The specified Messaging Gateway agent name did not exist.
solution: Specify an existing agent name.

message: agent string already exists
cause: The specified Messaging Gateway agent name already existed.
solution: Specify a different agent name.

message: agent string is referenced by a message system link
cause: An attempt was made to remove a Messaging Gateway agent currently referenced by one or more message system links.
solution: Remove all message system links associated with this agent and retry the operation.

message: propagation job string does not exist
cause: The specified propagation job identifier did not exist.
solution: Specify an existing identifier.

message: propagation job string already exists
cause: The specified propagation job identifier already existed.
solution: Specify a different identifier.

message: propagation job string is marked for removal
cause: An administration operation was attempted for a propagation job which is marked for removal. If attempting to remove a job, the Messaging Gateway agent is not running or is running but unable to remove the job at this time.
solution: Do not issue propagation administration commands for a job for which removal is pending. Wait for the job to be removed by the agent, or, issue REMOVE_JOB with the FORCE option to force the job to be removed.

message: operation not supported for propagation job
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation that was not supported for a propagation job.
solution: Perform the operation using a propagation job procedure.

message: propagation job exists for source string and destination string
cause: An attempt was made to create a propagation job, subscriber, or schedule when a propagation job already existed for the specified source and destination pair.
solution: Specify a different source and destination pair, or remove the propagation job using that pair and retry the operation.

message: (AGOPEN00) AGGMAP workspace object cannot be accessed because it was compiled by a more recent version of string .
cause: The AGGMAP was already compiled by a more recent version of the product than was being used to execute this command.
solution: Recompile the AGGMAP in the current version.

message: (XSAGDNGL00) In AGGMAP workspace object , the FLOOR argument of number must be less than the CEILING argument of number .
cause: The user specified a floor argument greater than the ceiling argument.
solution: Adjust the floor and ceiling arguments so that the floor is less than the ceiling. OBSOLETE, please remove this

message: (XSAGDIMDROP) workspace object , to be transformed during data load, must be a base dimension and not otherwise referenced in the AGGMAP.
cause: The user tried to specify a dimension in a dataflow-related clause in an aggmap which is already in another RELATION statement, DIMENSION statement, or possibly dimensioning the AGGMAP, or they specified a composite or conjoint dimension, or an object which is not a dimension
solution: Remove the conflicting reference or specify a valid object

message: (XSAGDNGL01) workspace object is not a relationship array.
cause: A RELATION clause in the AGGMAP named a workspace object that is not a relation.
solution: Name a valid self-relation in the RELATION statement.

message: (XSAGDIMBREAK) Invalid breakout for dimension workspace object .
cause: The user specified something that was not a valid dimension or relation on a BREAKOUTDIM line in an aggmap. This might be because the object was not a valid relation, was not over the specified dimension or was multidimensional
solution: Use a valid relation instead

message: (XSAGDNGL02) The relation workspace object is not related to itself.
cause: A relation was named in a RELATION clause of the AGGMAP that is not a self-relation.
solution: Name a valid self-relation in the RELATION statement.

message: (XSAGDNGL03) The relation workspace object is not a relation over a base dimension of AGGMAP workspace object .
cause: A relation was named in a RELATION clause of the AGGMAP that is not a relation for a base dimension of the AGGMAP.
solution: Name a valid self-relation in the RELATION statement, that is, one that has a dimension that dimensions the AGGMAP.

message: (XSAGDNGLPREC) In AGGMAP workspace object , PRECOMPUTE may only be specified either for the entire AGGMAP or for individual RELATION statements.
cause: PRECOMPUTE was specified both as a line in the AGGMAP and on at least one of the RELATION lines, or it was specified more than once as a line of the AGGMAP.
solution: Remove either the PRECOMPUTE line, or the PRECOMPUTE specification for all of the RELATION lines.

message: (XSAGDNGL04) Relation workspace object is duplicated in the AGGMAP workspace object .
cause: Two RELATION statements in the AGGMAP reference the same relation object.
solution: Remove the duplicate RELATION statement.

message: (XSAGDNGL05) AGGMAP workspace object contains invalid syntax.
cause: A line in the AGGMAP contains invalid syntax.
solution: Change the line to have valid syntax.

message: (XSAGDNGL06) In AGGMAP workspace object , variable operator workspace object cannot be dimensioned by rollup dimension workspace object .
cause: Operator variables cannot have the rollup dimension as one of their base dimensions.
solution: Modify the definition of the operator variable so that the current rollup dimension is not one of its bases.

message: (XSAGDNGL07) In AGGMAP workspace object , workspace object is not a valid operator or variable name.
cause: An invalid argument was supplied to the OPERATOR clause in the relation statement.
solution: Fix the OPERATOR clause so that it specifies either a valid variable name or a valid operator.

message: (XSAGDNGL08) In AGGMAP workspace object , the data type of workspace object must be TEXT, not string .
cause: An operator variable was supplied whose data type is not TEXT.
solution: Change the operator clause to reference a TEXT variable.

message: (XSAGDNGL10) The measure dimension workspace object must be a TEXT or ID base dimension that does not dimension AGGMAP workspace object , but is in the same analytic workspace.
cause: A MEASUREDIM was supplied in the AGGMAP that was not acceptable.
solution: Modify the MEASUREDIM clause to specify a valid dimension.

message: (XSAGDNGL11) AGGMAP workspace object contains duplicate information.
cause: The aggmap contains multiple instances of a clause that can only be specified once.
solution: Remove the extra clause.

message: (XSAGDNGL12) In AGGMAP workspace object , workspace object is not a valid valueset.
cause: A line in the AGGMAP contains an invalid element where a valid valueset is required.
solution: Change the line to have a valid valueset.

message: (XSAGDNGL13) In AGGMAP workspace object , workspace object should be scalar, not a dimensioned valueset.
cause: A line in the AGGMAP contains a dimensioned valueset where a scalared valueset is required.
solution: Change the line to have a scalar valueset.

message: (XSAGDNGL14) In AGGMAP workspace object , you can have either a single independent PROTECT statement or PROTECT statements in your RELATION statements.
cause: The AGGMAP either specified multiple PROTECT statements not on a RELATION line, or specified PROTECT statements both independently and on RELATION lines.
solution: Correct the AGGMAP to have valid syntax.

message: (XSAGDNGL15) In AGGMAP workspace object , VALUESET workspace object must be in extra dimensions of the relation.
cause: The RELATION phrase contains a VALUESET which is not over the extra dimension of the RELATION.
solution: Correct the RELATION phrase to contain a valueset over the extra dimension or not to contain any valueset.

message: (XSAGDNGL16) In AGGMAP workspace object , VALUESET workspace object in PRECOMPUTE phrase must be in the self dimension of the relation.
cause: The precompute phrase contains a valueset which is not over the self dimension of the relation.
solution: Correct the relation phrase to contain a valueset over the self dimension or not to contain any valueset.

message: (XSAGDNGL17) ARGS option workspace object must be a TEXT variable.
cause: An ARGS value had a non-text data type.
solution: Use a text variable for ARGS.

message: (XSAGDNGL18) In AGGMAP workspace object , RELATION workspace object contains hierarchy dimensions that are also dimensions of the AGGMAP.
cause: Hierarchy dimensions(extra dimensions) of a RELATION in the AGGMAP are base dimensions of the AGGMAP.
solution: Correct the RELATION not to have hierarchy dimensions(extra dimensions) which are also base dimensions of the AGGMAP.

message: (XSAGDNGL19) In AGGMAP workspace object , VALUESETS workspace object and workspace object are both over the same hierarchy dimension.
cause: Two or more different VALUESETs over the same hierarchy dimension are used in the AGGMAP.
solution: Use the same VALUESET for two RELATION phrases or use two different VALUESETs over two different hierachy dimensions.

message: (XSAGDNGL20) In AGGMAP workspace object , VALUESET workspace object must qualify all relations dimensioned by workspace object .
cause: A VALUESET over a hierarchy dimension qualifies some RELATIONs but not all RELATIONs dimensioned by the same hierarchy dimension.
solution: Use the same VALUESET to qualify all the RELATIONs dimensioned by the same hierarchy dimension.

message: (XSAGDNGL21) AGGREGATE operator string requires a WEIGHTBY clause, but the ARGS clause in AGGMAP workspace object did not specify one.
cause: The user used an operator which needs weight values but not provided the weight values.
solution: Provide weight values using a WEIGHTBY cluase.

message: (XSAGDNGL51) The AGGREGATE operator string does not require a weight, but ARGS clause in AGGMAP workspace object specified workspace object as a weight.
cause: The ARGS variable specified a weight even though one is not needed.
solution: Modify the ARGS variable so that it does not specify a weight for that operation.

message: (XSAGDNGL22) In AGGMAP workspace object , you can specify only one SCREENBY clause.
cause: The AGGMAP contained multiple SCREENBY clauses.
solution: Remove one of the SCREENBY clauses from the AGGMAP.

message: (XSAGDNGL23) In AGGMAP workspace object , the relation workspace object and the relation workspace object are both over the same base dimension.
cause: The AGGMAP contains incompatible RELATION statements.
solution: Remove one of the RELATION statements from the AGGMAP.

message: (XSAGDNGL24) AGGMAP workspace object cannot be used to aggregate workspace object , because it is defined in a different analytic workspace.
cause: The user attempted to aggregate a variable in another analytic workspace.
solution: Create an AGGMAP in the other analytic workspace to aggregate that variable.

message: (XSAGDNGL25) AGGMAP workspace object is a dimensioned AGGMAP; it can only be used to aggregate like-dimensioned variables.
cause: The user attempted to aggregate a variable with different dimensions than the AGGMAP. This is only possible with undimensioned AGGMAPs.
solution: Create a new undimensioned AGGMAP.

message: (XSAGDNGL28) In AGGMAP workspace object , error code string is greater than the maximum error code of number .
cause: The user specified an invalid ERRORMASK value.
solution: Remove the invalid value from the ERRORMASK list.

message: (XSAGDNGL29) In AGGMAP workspace object , the value for the ERRORLOG MAX option must be greater than 0.
cause: The user specified an ERRORLOG MAX of 0 or a negative number.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses a positive number.

message: (XSAGDNGL30) In ALLOCMAP workspace object , WEIGHTBY option workspace object must be a numerical VARIABLE or FORMULA.
cause: The WEIGHTBY clause requires numerical VARIABLE or FORMULA but the user used invalid objects.
solution: Correct the WEIGHTBY cluase to use a valid numerical VARIABLE or FORMULA.

message: (XSAGDNGL31) In AGGMAP workspace object , the hierarchy dimension QDR workspace object cannot refer to the related dimension of the relation.
cause: The user specified an invalid hierarchy dimension qualified data reference.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses a valid dimension value qualified data reference.

message: (XSAGDNGL32) In AGGMAP workspace object , the hierarchy dimension QDR workspace object must be a hierarchy dimension of the relation.
cause: The user specified an invalid qualified data reference for the hierarchy dimension.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses a valid dimension value qualified data reference.

message: (XSAGDNGL33) In AGGMAP workspace object , the hierarchy dimension QDR over dimension workspace object must specify a positive dimension offset.
cause: The user specified an invalid qualified data reference for the hierarchy dimension.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses a valid dimension value qualified data reference.

message: (XSAGDNGL34) In AGGMAP workspace object , all QDRs of dimension workspace object must map to the same dimension position.
cause: The user specified two conflicting hierarchy dimension qualified data references.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses a consistent qualified data reference.

message: (XSAGDNGL35) In AGGMAP workspace object , the hierarchy dimension QDR over dimension workspace object must be specified for every relation dimensioned by that hierarchy dimension.
cause: Multiple dimensions share the same hierarchy dimension, but it is only qualified within a subset of the AGGMAP relations.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses consistent qualified data references.

message: (XSAGDNGL36) In AGGMAP workspace object , the offset number is not a valid offset into dimension workspace object .
cause: The hierarchy dimension offset is an invalid dimension position.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses valid qualified data references.

message: (XSAGDNGL37) In AGGMAP workspace object , the value ' number ' is not a valid value of dimension workspace object .
cause: The hierarchy dimension offset is an invalid dimension position.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses valid qualified data references.

message: (XSAGDNGL39) In AGGMAP workspace object , the hierarchy dimension QDR workspace object must refer to a dimension.
cause: The user specified an invalid qualified data reference for the hierarchy dimension.
solution: Adjust the AGGMAP so that it uses a valid dimension value qualified data reference.

message: (XSAGDNGL40) In AGGMAP workspace object , you cannot reference dimension workspace object with both a RELATION statement and a DIMENSION statement.
cause: The user included both RELATION and DIMENSION statements in the AGGMAP referring to the same AGGMAP.
solution: Remove one of the conflicting clauses.

message: (XSAGDNGL41) In AGGMAP workspace object , the non-dimensioned valueset workspace object must have a parent QDR in its VALUESET statement over the VALUESET's base dimension.
cause: The VALUESET statement specified a scalar valueset but did not include a qualified data reference to specify the parent.
solution: Add a qualified data reference specifying the parent to the VALUESET statement.

message: (XSAGDNGL42) In AGGMAP workspace object , you cannot qualify the dimensioned valueset workspace object .
cause: The VALUESET line referred to a dimensioned valueset.
solution: Use a non-dimensioned valueset to limit the status of the dimensioned one.

message: (XSAGINIT01) AGGMAP workspace object cannot be dimensioned by a conjoint dimension.
cause: The specified AGGMAP was dimensioned by a conjoint dimension.
solution: Use the CHGDFN command to change the conjoint to a composite dimension.

message: (XSAGCOMP04) number is not the name of a MODEL in any attached analytic workspace.
cause: An invalid model name was attached to an AGGMAP.
solution: Remove the model from the AGGMAP or create a model with that name.

message: (XSAGGMAPLIST01) Your expression uses too much execution space. Eliminate recursion or reduce the levels of nesting.
cause: formulas likely refer to each other recursively or with a great deal of depth.
solution: eliminate recursion and flatten formula trees.

message: (APABBR01) A value of '%V' is not valid for the workspace object option.
cause: An inappropriate value was specified for the named option.
solution: Set a legal value for the option.

message: (APABBR02) Value ' number ' is not valid for the workspace object option.
cause: An inappropriate value was specified for the named option.
solution: Set a legal value for the option.

message: (XSAWFREEZE1) The analytic workspace string is already frozen.
cause: Attempting to freeze an AW when it is already frozen
solution: Thaw the AW before freezing it again.

message: (XSAWFREEZE2) The analytic workspace string must be attached RW or RX.
cause: The AW must be updatable to change the freeze state
solution: Reattach AW before freezing or thawing it again.

message: (XSAWFREEZE3) Cannot rollback analytic workspace string ; generations are in use.
cause: One or more generations due to be destroyed as part of a rollback to freeze command are currently in use.
solution: Get sessions using those generations to detach the AW.

message: (XSAWFREEZE4) The analytic workspace string is not frozen.
cause: You are attempting to "rollback to freeze" an AW that is not frozen.
solution: Only execute this command on a frozen AW.

message: (CINSERT06) The target position for MAINTAIN ADD or MAINTAIN MOVE cannot fall in the range of session-only values.
cause: The user specified a BEFORE or AFTER clause specifying a position in the range of SESSION dimension values.
solution: Do not use a position clause, or specify a position before the first SESSION value.

message: (CINSERT02) The workspace object dimension is too large.
cause: The dimension has too many values.
solution: Deleted values can still take up space in the dimension and cause this error. Try removing the deleted values by exporting the dimension to EIF and reimporting it with the REPLACE DELETE option.

message: (CINSERT07) You cannot add session-only values to the workspace object dimension.
cause: The user tried to add a SESSION dimension value while a spreadsheet spreadsheet cursor was open.
solution: Try adding the SESSION value while the cursor is not active.

message: (CINSERT20) Custom member values cannot be added to concat dimension workspace object , or to any of its bases, because it is not defined as UNIQUE.
cause: Only UNIQUE concat dimensions can have custom member values.
solution: Use the CHGDFN command to change the concat dimension to UNIQUE and retry.

message: (CINSERT04) %K is not a valid value for the workspace object dimension. Values for this dimension can have at most number significant digits after rounding to number decimal places.
cause: The user attempted to insert a value that had too many digits into a NUMBER dimension. For instance, the user might have tried to insert the value 99999 (5 digits) into a dimension with data type NUMBER(4).
solution: Use a smaller number for the dimension value, or define a new dimension with a larger precision and replace the old dimension with the new one.

message: (CINSERT05) %K cannot be added to workspace object because it is already a value of the dependent UNIQUE concat dimension workspace object , from leaf dimension workspace object .
cause: A value cannot be added to a dimension if it conflicts with an existing value in a unique concat dimension containing this dimension.
solution: The concat(s) causing the conflict could be CHGDFNed to NOT UNIQUE, or either of the duplicate values could be renamed to make them UNIQUE.

message: (CMOVE03) You cannot move a session-only dimension value.
cause: The user named a SESSION dimension value in the MAINTAIN MOVE command.
solution: Do not try to MAINTAIN MOVE session-only dimension values.

message: (CRENAME03) %K is already a value of the dependent UNIQUE concat dimension workspace object , from leaf dimension workspace object .
cause: A value cannot be renamed in a dimension if the new value conflicts with an existing value in a unique concat dimension containing this dimension.
solution: The concat(s) causing the conflict could be CHGDFNed to NOT UNIQUE, or either of the duplicate values could be changed to make them UNIQUE.

message: (DIMSHOW01) Partition number does not exist.
cause: The DIMSHOW command specified a nonexistent partition.
solution: Specify the name of an existing partition, or remove the PARTITION qualification from the DIMSHOW command.

message: (DIMSHOW02) A partition name may be specified only for a partitioned variable.
cause: A PARTITION qualification was provided for an object other than a partitioned variable.
solution: Remove the PARTITION qualification.

message: (DBERR01) Analytic workspace string does not exist.
cause: The analytic workspace requested does not seem to be in the current database
solution: Check that you are in the correct schema and have access to the requested AW.

message: Could not create analytic workspace string
cause: A serious error was encountered while trying to set up the tables for the named analytic workspace. Possibilities include a tablespace that can't be written to, corrupted metadata about which AWs exist, bogus tables with names the code expects to be able to use, or the remains of a partially removed AW.
solution: There should be another error on the error stack. Consult it to determine what is causing the problem and remove that table.

message: (DBERRBSZ) Analytic workspace string cannot be opened. Tablespace blocksize number does not match database cache size number .
cause: The blocksize of the containing tablespace didn't match database cache size.
solution: Change either size to make them consistent, or set olap_page_pool_size to 0 to allow automatic OLAP pool management when compatibility is greater than 10.2.

message: (DBERRRLS) Analytic workspace string cannot be accessed because it has fine-grained access control applied to it
cause: An attempt was made to access the specified analytic workspace's LOB table. The OLAP option detected the table had fine-grained security applied to it. The OLAP option requires full access to this table to operate correctly.
solution: Remove the fine-grained access control.

message: (DBERRTHW) Analytic workspace string cannot be attached with the THAW option because it was frozen with the NOTHAW option
cause: An attempt to attach the AW using the thaw option was made; the AW was frozen using the NOTHAW option.
solution: Either attempt the command again without the THAW option.

message: while operating on ' string '
cause: Error is raised to inform user what object was being worked on when an error occurred during the creation of an AW. It should always be signaled with 33263
solution: See error#33263

message: (DBERR05) Analytic workspace string already exists.
cause: The AW CREATE command was passed the name of an analytic workspace that already exists
solution: Specify a different name.

message: simulated paging error
cause: This is an internal error that should never be seen
solution: Contact Oracle technical support

message: (XSCHKRLS01) Analytic workspace string has open cursors and cannot be detached.
cause: A session attempted to detach an analytic workspace while there are cursors open against it.
solution: Close the open cursor before attempting to close the analytic workspace.

message: (DBERR07) Timed out while trying to lock analytic workspace string for string .
cause: A lock operation that was supposed to happen very quickly was taking too long. It can be due to another session being stopped while holding that lock, another session crashing while holding that lock, or an internal error.
solution: If another session is stopped, resume that session to let it release the lock. If another session has crashed, wait for a few minutes while PMON or SMON process is recovering that lock. Contact Oracle OLAP Support if none of the situations above apply.

message: Autonomous transaction query of an UPDATEd analytic workspace is not supported
cause: The user made attempt to reference an anayltic workspace that has uncommited updates within an autonomous query.
solution: Either COMMIT or ROLLBACK your uncommited changes, or don't use an autonomous transaction.

message: (DBERR09) Analytic workspace string cannot be attached in RW or EXCLUSIVE mode until the changes made and updated in MULTI mode are committed or rolled back.
cause: There are still changes to this analytic workspace that were updated and not committed when the workspace was attached in MULTI mode.
