cause: Flashback Database failed because incarnation information was not found in the control file. The Flashback target incarnation was not in the control file or had a missing parent incarnation.
solution: Register logs from the missing incarnations and retry the command.

message: cannot flashback data file string - missing incarnation information
cause: Flashback Database failed because incarnation information for the start of the offline range for a file was not found in the control file. Flashback could not update the file's header with the missing incarnation's resetlogs information.
solution: Check the trace log for the offline range of the data file. If redo logs from the missing incarnation can be found, register the logs in the control file and retry the command.

message: FLASHBACK DATABASE not started; in test mode
cause: The FLASHBACK DATABASE command was not performed because it was started in test mode.
solution: No action required.

message: redo logs not required
cause: The FLASHBACK DATABASE command was performed in test mode and determined that no redo logs were required to perform the tested FLASHBACK DATABASE command.
solution: No action required.

message: required redo logs are available
cause: The FLASHBACK DATABASE command was performed in test mode and determined that no redo logs required to perform the tested FLASHBACK DATABASE command were missing.
solution: No action required.

message: required redo log is not available
cause: A redo log needed for the recovery part of FLASHBACK DATABASE could not be found or accessed.
solution: See trace files for details of the problem.

message: Cannot flashback data file string ; may not be able to undo all changes.
cause: A data file was plugged in when there was a guaranteed restore point, but Flashback Database was not enabled. It is possible that some changes to the data file, after it was converted, were not logged to the Flashback Database logs.
solution: If the FLASHBACK DATABASE command was meant to rewind the database to a time before the file was plugged in, take the data file offline and retry the command. If the FLASHBACK DATABASE command was meant to rewind the database to a time after the file was plugged in, restore the original version of the plugged in file and retry the command.

message: Cannot advance compatibility from string to string due to guaranteed restore points
cause: Flashback database cannot undo the advance of database compatibility. Therefore, one cannot advance the compatibility of the database while there are guaranteed restore points in the database.
solution: Drop all guaranteed restore points first and retry, or delay the advance of database compatibility to a later time.

message: Cannot drop tablespace string on primary database due to guaranteed restore points.
cause: An attempt was made to drop a tablespace on a primary database while there are guaranteed restore points. You cannot do this because Flashback database cannot undo dropping of a tablespace.
solution: Drop all guaranteed restore points first and retry, or delay dropping the tablespace until all guaranteed restore points are removed.

message: Cannot drop tablespace string on standby database due to guaranteed restore points.
cause: An attempt was made to drop a tablespace on a standby database while there are guaranteed restore points. You cannot do this because Flashback database cannot undo dropping of a tablespace.
solution: Drop all guaranteed restore points and rerun recovery on standby database.

message: Cannot shrink data file string on primary database due to guaranteed restore points.
cause: An attempt was made to shrink a data file on a primary database while there are guaranteed restore points. You cannot do this because Flashback database cannot undo the shrinking of a data file.
solution: Drop all guaranteed restore points first and retry, or delay the data file resize until all guaranteed restore points are removed.

message: Cannot shrink data file string on standby database due to guaranteed restore points.
cause: An attempt was made to shrink a data file on a standby database while there are guaranteed restore points. You cannot do this because Flashback database cannot undo the shrinking of a data file.
solution: Drop all guaranteed restore points and rerun recovery on standby database.

message: missing mandatory column " string " of error log table " string "
cause: Mandatory column of error logging table is not present
solution: Add the named column to the error logging table. Consult ORACLE documentation for the correct data type.

message: column " string " of table " string " must be one of the first " string " columns
cause: Mandatory information column of error logging table is present, but must be at the beginning of the row.
solution: Create the error logging table correctly. Consult ORACLE documentation for the correct format of an error logging table.

message: errors in array DML exceed string
cause: The operation failed because the array DML had more errors than can be stored internally for BATCH ERRORs.
solution: Do not use BATCH ERROR mode when array DML has more error rows than the number specified in the error.

message: DML error logging is not supported for abstract column " string "
cause: A DML Error Logging operation was attempted on a table which has an ADT, REF, VARRAY, or nested table column type, and the error logging table referred to the specified column.
solution: Either do not use DML Error Logging on such a table or remove the offending column from the error logging table. The scalar columns can be logged, but not abstract column types.

message: DML error logging is not supported for LOB column " string "
cause: A DML Error Logging operation was attempted on a table which has a CLOB, NCLOB, or BLOB column type, and the error logging table referred to the specified column.
solution: Either do not use DML Error Logging on such table or remove the offending column from the error logging table. The scalar columns can be logged, but not LOB column types.

message: DML error logging is not supported for LONG column " string "
cause: A DML Error Logging operation was attempted on a table which has a LONG, or LONG RAW column type, and the error logging table referred to the specified column.
solution: Either do not use DML Error Logging on such a table or remove the offending column from the error logging table. The scalar columns can be logged, but not long column types.

message: insert into DML Error Logging table " string " failed
cause: An error occurred when attempting to log a DML Error on behalf of the DML Error logging clause. This may be intended if a trigger is defined on the error table (which in turn errors out in certain cases).
solution: Determine root cause of error (in error stack).

message: DML error logging is not supported for FILE column " string "
cause: A DML Error Logging operation was attempted on a table which has a BFILE column and the Error Logging table referred to the specified column.
solution: Either don't use DML Error Logging on such table or remove the offending column from the error logging table. The scalar columns can be logged, but not BFILE column types.

message: internal error occurred during DML Error Logging
cause: An unexpected error occurred while executing recursive SQL to insert a row into the DML Error Logging table.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support.

message: DML Error logging is not supported with BATCH ERROR mode
cause: A DML Error Logging operation was attempted on a table which has BATCH ERROR mode also specified.
solution: Refrain from using both DML Error Logging and BATCH ERROR mode on the same table.

message: BATCH ERROR mode is not supported for this operation
cause: BATCH ERROR mode specified for this operation.
solution: Refrain from using BATCH ERROR mode with this operation.

message: unique constraint ( string . string ) violated
cause: An INSERT statement with a CHANGE_DUPKEY_ERROR_INDEX hint tried to insert a duplicate key into a table.
solution: Either remove the unique restriction or do not insert the key.

message: An index must be specified in the index hint
cause: Index specification was missing in an IGNORE_ROW_ON_DUPKEY_INDEX or CHANGE_DUPKEY_ERROR_INDEX hint.
solution: In the hint, specify a unique index that exists on the table.

message: Index specified in the index hint is invalid
cause: The index specified in an IGNORE_ROW_ON_DUPKEY_INDEX or CHANGE_DUPKEY_ERROR_INDEX hint could not be found.
solution: Specify a unique index that exists on the table. The index cannot be a non-unique index or a bitmap index.

message: Either mutate the error or ignore row on unique violation
cause: IGNORE_ROW_ON_DUPKEY_INDEX and CHANGE_DUPKEY_ERROR_INDEX were both specified in the same statement.
solution: You cannot specify both hints in the same statement. Remove one of these two hints, or both, from the statement.

message: Multiple indexes in change or ignore duplicate key hint
cause: Multiple indexes were specified in an IGNORE_ROW_ON_DUPKEY_INDEX or CHANGE_DUPKEY_ERROR_INDEX hint.
solution: Only one index must be specified in the hint.

message: CHANGE_DUPKEY_ERROR_INDEX hint disallowed for this operation
cause: CHANGE_DUPKEY_ERROR_INDEX hint was specified for the operation.
solution: You cannot specify this hint for this operation. Remove the hint from the statement.

message: IGNORE_ROW_ON_DUPKEY_INDEX hint disallowed for this operation
cause: IGNORE_ROW_ON_DUPKEY_INDEX hint was specified for the operation.
solution: You cannot specify this hint for this operation. Remove the hint from the statement.

message: RETRY_ON_ROW_CHANGE hint disallowed for this operation
cause: RETRY_ON_ROW_CHANGE hint was specified for the operation.
solution: You cannot specify this hint for this operation. Remove the hint from the statement.

message: remote table not supported for DML error logging
cause: A remote table was specified in the DML error logging clause.
solution: You cannot specify a remote table to which errors will be logged. Specify a local table only.

message: Source platform string not cross platform compliant
cause: Cross platform transport was not allowed for this platform.
solution: For a list of supported platforms, query fixed view SYS.V$TRANSPORTABLE_PLATFORM.

message: Target platform string not cross platform compliant
cause: Cross platform transport was not allowed for this platform.
solution: None

message: Source database not 10.0.0.0 compatible
cause: Cross platform transport is not supported unless database compatibility is advanced to 10.0.0.0 or higher
solution: Use the compatible parameter to advance source database compatibility and redo the transport

message: Cross platform transport is not supported between source platform identifier string and target platform identifier string
cause: The platform identifier in the transported file indicated that the datafile format was different than the target database datafile format.
solution: For a list of supported platforms, query fixed view SYS.V$TRANSPORTABLE_PLATFORM. If both platforms are present, Contact Oracle support

message: Source platform string not cross platform compliant
cause: The platform identifier in the transported file indicated that this platform is not supported for a cross platform transport.
solution: For a list of supported platforms, query fixed view SYS.V$TRANSPORTABLE_PLATFORM.

message: Target platform string not cross platform compliant
cause: Cross platform transport was not allowed for this platform.
solution: For a list of supported platforms, query fixed view SYS.V$TRANSPORTABLE_PLATFORM.

message: Source platform string is in different byte order than target platform string
cause: Probably a conversion was not done before the import phase of the transport.
solution: Use RMAN CONVERT functionality to convert endian ordering.

message: Failed to update block 0 to new version 10 format
cause: An attempt was made to update block 0 to version 10 format.
solution: check additional error messages and contact Oracle Support Services.

message: File string from platform string is not compatible with current platform string
cause: The file was directly copied to this platform from a platform with a different endian ordering.
solution: Use RMAN CONVERT functionality to convert endian ordering.

message: bad dump file specification
cause: The user specified a dump file that could not be used in the current job. Subsequent error messages describe the inadequacies of the dump file.
solution: Specify a dump file that is usable for the job.

message: invalid argument value
cause: The user specified API parameters were of the wrong type or value range. Subsequent messages supplied by DBMS_DATAPUMP.GET_STATUS will further describe the error.
solution: Correct the bad argument and retry the API.

message: invalid operation
cause: The current API cannot be executed because of inconsistencies between the API and the current definition of the job. Subsequent messages supplied by DBMS_DATAPUMP.GET_STATUS will further describe the error.
solution: Modify the API call to be consistent with the current job or redefine the job in a manner that will support the specified API.

message: unable to get count of total workers alive
cause: Attempt to get count of total worker processes alive failed.
solution: Check the additional error messages to see what caused the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: invalid state
cause: The state of the job precludes the execution of the API.
solution: Rerun the job to specify the API when the job is an appropriate state.

message: inconsistent arguments
cause: The current API cannot be executed because of inconsistencies between arguments of the API call. Subsequent messages supplied by DBMS_DATAPUMP.GET_STATUS will further describe the error.
solution: Modify the API call to be consistent with itself.

message: internal error
cause: An unexpected error occurred while processing a Data Pump job. Subsequent messages supplied by DBMS_DATAPUMP.GET_STATUS will further describe the error.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Client detached before the job started.
cause: The client detached or ended their session before the Data Pump job was started.
solution: Create new job and remain attached to the job until it is started.

message: Remapping the SYSTEM schema is not supported.
cause: A remap_schema transform with the SYSTEM schema was specified.
solution: Retry the import command without remapping the SYSTEM schema.

message: One or more workers have prematurely exited.
cause: One or more of the worker processes exited before the job was completed. With no workers, the master process will terminate the job.
solution: Rerun the job. If problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: job is not running
cause: An API was executed that required the job to be running, but the job was not active.
solution: Retry the API. If problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Operation not supported when job is in string state.
cause: The state of the job precludes the execution of the API.
solution: Rerun the job to specify the API when the job is an appropriate state.

message: Worker request not supported when job is in string state.
cause: The state of the job precludes the execution of a worker request. This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: master process received invalid message number string
cause: Internal Error
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: invalid operation type string
cause: User specified an invalid operation name on an DBMS_DATAPUMP.OPEN API or an invalid operation name was specified in the master table for a restart API.
solution: Correct the operation name and recreate the job.

message: invalid mode type string
cause: User specified an invalid mode on an DBMS_DATAPUMP.OPEN API or an invalid mode was specified in the master table for a restart API.
solution: Correct the mode and recreate the job.

message: Database compatibility version string is not supported.
cause: User selected COMPATIBLE as the version on an DBMS_DATAPUMP.OPEN API, but the current database compatibility version is not supported by the Data Pump API. Database versions before 9.2 are not supported by the Data Pump.
solution: Specify a supported version and recreate the job.

message: Database version string is not supported.
cause: User selected LATEST as the version on an DBMS_DATAPUMP.OPEN API, but the current database version is not supported by the Data Pump API. Database versions before 9.2 are not supported by the Data Pump.
solution: Specify a supported version and recreate the job.

message: Version string is not supported.
cause: User specified an explicit version on an DBMS_DATAPUMP.OPEN API, but the current database version is not supported by the Data Pump API. Database versions before 9.2 are not supported by the Data Pump.
solution: Specify a supported version and recreate the job.

message: wrong schema specified for job
cause: Internal error caused by the master process finding inconsistencies between the schemas specified for the job.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: jobs of type string are not restartable
cause: Attempt to restart a job which was not restartable.
solution: Recreate the job via the open API.

message: master table is inconsistent on validation string
cause: Job cannot be restarted because it failed a validation check. Validation checks are of the form -xx.y where -xx is the value of the PROCESS_ORDER column in the master table where the error was detected and y is the actual validity check for the row.
solution: Recreate the job. If master table has not been modified, but problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: wrong version of master table
cause: Job cannot be restarted because the version of the database upon which the job started is different than the current version of the database and the format of the master table has changed between the versions.
solution: Recreate the job.

message: cannot restart job from string state
cause: The job was not in a suitable state for restart. Jobs must begin executing before they can be restarted.
solution: Recreate the job.

message: worker string with process name " string " prematurely terminated
cause: The specified worker process terminated unexpectedly. Subsequent messages describe the reason for the termination.
solution: In many cases, the Data Pump will attempt to automatically restart the worker. If problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: invalid file type string
cause: An invalid filetype was specified for an DBMS_DATAPUMP.ADD_FILE API call.
solution: Correct the filetype parameter and reissue the API request.

message: invalid filter name string
cause: An invalid filter name was specified on a DBMS_DATAPUMP.DATA_FILTER
solution: Correct the filter name parameter and reissue the API request.

message: function string is not supported in string jobs
cause: The specified API is not supported for the specified class of jobs.
solution: Recreate the job with the appropriate mode or operation type.

message: Data cannot be filtered under the direct path access method.
cause: The user specified that the data access method for the job was direct which precludes the use of certain data filters.
solution: Use the SUBQUERY or the SAMPLE data filter with the automatic data access method.

message: Table string does not exist.
cause: The user referenced a table in an API that did not exist.
solution: Correct table name and retry API.

message: Data filter string has already been specified.
cause: The user has already specified a data filter that matches on the filter name, schema name, and table.
solution: Specify a different data filter.

message: invalid metadata filter name string
cause: An invalid metadata filter name was specified on a DBMS_DATAPUMP.METADATA_FILTER API call.
solution: Correct the metadata filter name parameter and reissue the API request.

message: Object type path not supported for string metadata filter.
cause: An object type path was specified for the filter, but the filter does not support the object type path parameter.
solution: Remove the object type path parameter.

message: Object path " string " is not supported for string jobs.
cause: The specified object type path is invalid for the job mode.
solution: Correct the object type path.

message: Schema expression " string " contains no valid schemas.
cause: The specified SCHEMA_EXPR filter resulted in no schemas being selected.
solution: Correct the the SCHEMA_EXPR filter specification.

message: Schema expression " string " must identify exactly one schema.
cause: For TABLE mode jobs, the SCHEMA_EXPR filter must identify exactly one schema.
solution: Correct the the SCHEMA_EXPR filter specification.

message: Filter " string " either identifies all object types or no object types.
cause: A Metadata filter specifying path names either returned all objects or no objects in the job.
solution: Correct the the metadata filter specification.

message: invalid transform name string
cause: An invalid transform name was specified on a DBMS_DATAPUMP.METADATA_TRANSFORM API call.
solution: Correct the transform name parameter and reissue the API request.

message: Object type string is not supported for string .
cause: The specified object type is invalid for the specified transform or remap.
solution: Correct the object type.

message: Metadata transform string has already been specified.
cause: The user has already specified the metadata transform for the same class of object types.
solution: Specify a different object_type for the transform.

message: invalid metadata remap name string
cause: An invalid metadata remap name was specified on a DBMS_DATAPUMP.METADATA_REMAP API call.
solution: Correct the metadata remap name parameter and reissue the API request.

message: Metadata remap string has already been specified.
cause: The user has already specified a metadata remap that matches on the remap name and original value.
solution: Specify a different original value.

message: Jobs of type string cannot use multiple execution streams.
cause: The user specified a value of parallelism that is precluded by the operation type or mode of the job.
solution: Specify only a parallelism of 1 for this type of job.

message: Unable to start all workers; only string worker(s) available.
cause: The full degree of parallelism could not be honored due process limits, resource limits, or other internal errors.
solution: Increase process/resource limits for the job.

message: invalid parameter name string
cause: An invalid parameter name was specified on a DBMS_DATAPUMP.SET_PARAMETER API call.
solution: Correct the parameter name and reissue the API request.

message: parameter string is incompatible with parameter string
cause: Two parameters were set that were incompatible with each other. Only the first parameter setting will be used.
solution: Decide which parameter is to be used and stick to it.

message: parameter string specified multiple times
cause: The user has already specified a parameter that matches on the name and the specific parameter doesn't support duplicate definitions.
solution: Specify non-repeatable parameters only once.

message: cannot specify SKIP_CURRENT on initial start of a job.
cause: The user has already specified SKIP_CURRENT for a job that has never executed.
solution: Only specify SKIP_CURRENT when restarting a job.

message: parameter or attribute string must be defined for a string job
cause: The job being defined cannot be started because it is missing the specified definition.
solution: Specify the omitted parameter or attribute before starting the job.

message: missing or invalid definition of the SQL output file.
cause: The job being defined cannot be started because it is missing the file to receive the SQL output of the job or the definition is unusable.
solution: Specify a valid directory name and file name for the SQL file.

message: The string feature is not supported in version string .
cause: The user attempted to use a feature that was not enabled in the database version specified for the current job. Typically, this error occurs if the compatibility level of the database is below the current version of the database or if the user explicitly specifies a version for a Data Pump job.
solution: Specify the current database version as a version parameter for the the job.

message: invalid log file specification.
cause: The log file for the job was incorrectly specified.
solution: Specify a valid directory name and file name for the log file.

message: invalid worker request string for string jobs.
cause: The worker process sent a message that wasn't supported for the current job.
solution: Internal error -- contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: current object skipped: string of type string
cause: The user specified SKIP_CURRENT when restarting a job. This message is a confirmation that the object will not be imported.
solution: User must manually define the object in the target database.

message: dump file set is incomplete
cause: An IMPORT or SQL_FILE operation was being performed but not all of the files from the EXPORT dump file set were included.
solution: Check the export log file and make sure all of the files that were exported are included in the current job.

message: table(s) dropped because of conflict with master table
cause: A table specified by a job was not included because its definition would collide with the master table definition for the current job.
solution: After the job completes. Import the conflicting tables using a unique job name to avoid conflicts with normal user tables.

message: import mode string conflicts with export mode string
cause: The mode used for import cannot be used with a dump file set of specified mode. Transportable jobs are not compatible with other modes.
solution: Perform the import using a mode compatible with the export.

message: error creating master process string
cause: An attempt to create the listed master process failed.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Check the trace log for the failed process to see if there is any information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: unable to write to the log file
cause: Errors were detecting while writing to the log file. Subsequent messages will detail the problems.
solution: Fix the problems outlined in the secondary messages.

message: unexpected master process exception in string
cause: An unhandled exception was detected internally within the master control process for the Data Pump job. This is an internal error. messages will detail the problems.
solution: If problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Unable to close the log file.
cause: Errors were detecting while closing the log file. Subsequent messages will detail the problems.
solution: Fix the problems outlined in the secondary messages.

message: invalid master table data in row with PROCESS_ORDER= string
cause: A corruption was detected in the master table in the specified row(s). Either the row wasn't found, it was missing columns or had illegal values in its columns.
solution: Rerun the job with an uncorrupted master table.

message: Unable to open the log file.
cause: Errors were detecting while opening the log file. Subsequent messages will detail the problems.
solution: Fix the problems outlined in the secondary messages.

message: Value for string is badly formed.
cause: The value of the user specified filter did not contain a legitimate SQL clause. Subsequent messages will detail the problems.
solution: Fix the problems outlined in the secondary messages.

message: cannot delete job string for user string
cause: Unable to delete a job. Refer to the any following or prior error messages for clarification.
solution: Eliminate the problems indicated.

message: unable to subscribe agent string to queue " string "
cause: The Data Pump's communication layer was unable to attach one of its processes to the control or status queue. Subsequent messages will detail the problem.
solution: Fix the problem if possible, or contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: unable to dequeue message for agent string from queue " string "
cause: The Data Pump's communication layer was unable to retrieve a message from the control or status queue. Subsequent messages will detail the problem.
solution: Fix the problem if possible, or contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: unable to enqueue message string
cause: The Data Pump's communication layer was unable to send the specified message on the control or status queue. Subsequent messages will detail the problem.
solution: Fix the problem if possible, or contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: failed to create queues " string " and " string " for Data Pump job
cause: The Data Pump's communication layer was unable to create the status and control queues required for interprocess communication. Subsequent messages will detail the problem.
solution: Fix the problem if possible, or contact Oracle Support.

message: failed to unsubscribe agent string from queue " string "
cause: The Data Pump's communication layer was unable to unsubscribe a process from the control or status queue. Subsequent messages will detail the problem.
solution: Fix the problem if possible, or contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Object type string created with compilation warnings
cause: The object in the SQL statement following this error was created with compilation errors. If this error occurred for a view, it is possible that the base table of the view was missing.
solution: This is a warning. The object may have to be recompiled before being used.

message: Object type string failed to create with error: string Failing sql is: string
cause: Examine original error code to determine actual cause
solution: Original error code will contain more information

message: cannot detach job string for user string
cause: Unable to detach a job from the session. Refer to any following error messages for clarification.
solution: Eliminate the problems indicated.

message: cannot update job string for user string
cause: Unable to update the fixed table information for a job. Refer to any following or prior error messages for clarification.
solution: Eliminate the problems indicated.

message: cannot retrieve job information
cause: Unable to retrieve fixed table information for a job. Refer to the secondary error messages that follow this one for clarification.
solution: Eliminate the problems indicated by the secondary errors.

message: directory name string is invalid
cause: A corresponding directory object does not exist.
solution: Correct the directory object parameter, or create a corresponding directory object with the CREATE DIRECTORY command.

message: file name cannot contain a path specification
cause: The name of a dump file, log file, or sql file contains a path specification.
solution: Use the name of a directory object to indicate where the file should be stored.

message: Cannot add devices to file oriented job.
cause: Attempt to add a device to a job that already contains more than one disk file.
solution: Only specify one file for jobs that contain sequential devices.

message: unable to determine logical standby and streams status
cause: An error occurred when determining if the Data Pump job needed to support logical standby or streams.
solution: The subsequent message describes the error that was detected. Correct the specified problem and restart the job.

message: unable to set SCN metadata for object " string . string " of type string
cause: An error occurred when applying a SCN to the specified object to support logical standby or streams.
solution: The subsequent message describes the error that was detected. Correct the specified problem and restart the job.

message: FLASHBACK automatically enabled to preserve database integrity.
cause: A Data Pump job was required to enable flashback support to specific SCNs in order to preserve the consistency of a logical standby or streams instantiation.
solution: None

message: Parallel execution not supported in this database edition.
cause: Parallel execution of Data Pump jobs is not supported for this database edition.
solution: Specify a parallelism of 1 for jobs not running on Enterprise Edition databases.

message: Dump file space has been exhausted: Unable to allocate string bytes
cause: The Export job ran out of dump file space before the job was completed.
solution: Reattach to the job and add additional dump files to the job restarting the job.

message: invalid input value string for parameter string
cause: A NULL or invalid value was supplied for the parameter.
solution: Correct the input value and try the call again.

message: Data Pump job encountered unexpected error string
cause: An unexpected, potentially non-fatal error occurred while processing a Data Pump job.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Worker process received data objects while loading metadata. Invalid process order range is string .. string
cause: This is an internal error. Messages will detail the problem.
solution: If problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: cannot create index for " string " on master table string
cause: One or more indexes couldn't be created on the master table. subsequent error messages describe the failure.
solution: Correct the condition that is preventing the indexes from being created.

message: Timeout before master process string finished initialization. Master error:
cause: The master process whose name is listed started up but did not finish its initialization within the allowed time limit.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Also, check the trace log for the failed process, if one was created, to see if there is any additional information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Timeout before worker process string finished initialization. Worker error:
cause: The worker process whose name is listed started up but did not finish its initialization within the allowed time limit.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Also, check the trace log for the failed process, if one was created, to see if there is any additional information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: cannot call this function from a SQL parallel query slave process
cause: Called a Data Pump process model function from a process which is a SQL parallel query slave process
solution: A SQL parallel query slave process cannot create a Data Pump master process. This is not supported. If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (for example, expdp or impdp), contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Master process string failed during startup. Master error:
cause: The master process whose name is listed failed during startup.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Also, check the trace log for the failed process, if one was created, to see if there is any additional information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Worker process string failed during startup. Worker error:
cause: The worker process whose name is listed failed during startup.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Also, check the trace log for the failed process, if one was created, to see if there is any additional information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Master process string violated startup protocol. Master error:
cause: The master process whose name is listed started up but then exited before notifying the creating process that it was finished with initialization.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Also, check the trace log for the failed process, if one was created, to see if there is any additional information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Worker process string violated startup protocol. Worker error:
cause: The worker process whose name is listed started up but then exited before notifying the creating process that it was finished with initialization.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Also, check the trace log for the failed process, if one was created, to see if there is any additional information about the failure. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Unprivileged users may not operate upon other users' schemas
cause: An unprivileged user attempted to reference another user's schema during a Data Pump operation. Because of this, no schemas were were selected for the job.
solution: Retry the operation under a username owning the schema.

message: error deleting worker processes
cause: An attempt to delete the worker processes failed.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for possible actions. Correct the error, if possible, and try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Dependent object type string skipped, base object type string already exists
cause: During a Data Pump import job, a dependent object is being skipped because its base object already existed.
solution: If the object from the dump file is wanted, drop the base and dependent objects and try to import again using desired filters.

message: Dependent object type string skipped, base object type string creation failed
cause: During a Data Pump import job, a dependent object is being skipped because its base object creation failed.
solution: If the object from the dump file is wanted, drop the base and dependent objects and try to import again using desired filters

message: Unable to determine database version
cause: The Data Pump was unable to determine the compatibility level and version of the current database using SYS.DBMS_UTILITY.DB_VERSION.
solution: Make sure access to the DBMS_UTILITY package is granted to you. If this is a network job, be sure that access to the DBMS_UTILITY package is granted to you on the remote instance.

message: Dump files are not supported for network jobs.
cause: An attempt was made to add a dumpfile to an Import job that is using a network link to the source database.
solution: Do not specify a dumpfile for jobs that do not require dumpfiles.

message: string is not supported over a network link
cause: An attempt was made to use an option that is not supported over network links such as the PARTITION_LIST filter.
solution: Do not attempt to use Data Pump features on network jobs if they are not compatible with jobs over the network.

message: invalid trigger operation on mutating table string . string
cause: A Data Pump load operation failed because a trigger attempted to fire on the table while it was mutating.
solution: Disable trigger(s) on the specified table. Also see ORA-004091.

message: Type needed to create table is not included in this operation. Failing sql is: string
cause: A create table was attempted and a dependent type does not exist in the dumpfile or on the target database. Either the export or the import Data Pump job was a table mode job and types are not included in table mode jobs.
solution: Determine which type(s) are missing and create them on the target system and run the Data Pump import job again.

message: worker process interrupt for delete worker processes call by master process
cause: The master process that created this worker process called delete worker processes to abort the current operation.
solution: No action is necessary. This is an informational error message.

message: Table string can't be truncated, data will be skipped. Failing error is: string
cause: Table data was about to be loaded into a table that already existed and the table_exists_action parameter is truncate, but the table could not be truncated.
solution: Determine actual cause by looking at base error.

message: Table string can't be replaced, data will be skipped. Failing error is: string
cause: Table data was about to be loaded into a table that already existed and the table_exists_action parameter is replace, but the table could not be dropped.
solution: Determine actual cause by looking at base error.

message: Unprivileged users may not perform string remappings.
cause: A user attempted to remap objects during an import but lacked the IMPORT_FULL_DATABASE privilege.
solution: Retry the job from a schema that owns the IMPORT_FULL_DATABASE privilege.

message: Data Pump transportable tablespace job aborted string
cause: A DBMS_PLUGTS procedure failed and the Data Pump operation could not continue so it was aborted. The DBMS_PLUGTS failure listed describes the original error.
solution: Look at the DBMS_PLUGTS error to determine actual cause.

message: dump file name " string " contains an invalid substitution variable
cause: The substitution variable '%' must be followed by '%','u', or 'U'.
solution: Correct the substitution variable in the dump file name and re-enter the command.

message: Worker unexpected fatal error in string while calling string [ string ]
cause: An unhandled exception was detected internally within the worker process for the Data Pump job while calling the specified external routine. This is an internal error. Additional information may be supplied.
solution: If problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Worker unexpected fatal error in string [ string ] string
cause: An unhandled exception was detected internally within the worker process for the Data Pump job. This is an internal error. Additional information may be supplied.
solution: If problem persists, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: unexpected error from call to string string
cause: The exception was raised by the function invocation, a procedural action extension of export.
solution: Record the accompanying messages and report this as a Data Pump internal error to customer support.

message: unexpected DbmsJava error number from statement string
cause: The error was returned from a call to a DbmsJava procedure.
solution: Record the accompanying messages and report this as a Data Pump internal error to customer support.

message: Object type string not imported. Name conflicts with the master table
cause: The table being imported from the remote instance has the same name as the master table running this Data Pump job.
solution: Rerun the Data Pump job with a nonconflicting name.

message: Object type string not imported. Base object name conflicts with the master table
cause: The object being imported from the remote instance is dependent on an object that has the same name as the master table running this Data Pump job.
solution: Rerun the Data Pump job with a nonconflicting name.

message: object type " string "." string " already exists with different hashcode
cause: An object type could not be created because there was already a type with the same name but a different hashcode on the target system. Tables in the transportable tablespace set that use this object type cannot be read.
solution: Drop the object type from the target system and retry the operation.

message: object type " string "." string " already exists with different typeid
cause: An object type in a transportable tablespace set already exists on the target system, but with a different typeid. The typeid could not be changed because the type is used by an existing table. Tables in the transportable tablespace set that use this object type cannot be read.
solution: Drop the object type from the target system and retry the operation.

message: Cannot include " string " tablespace as a Transportable Tablespace
cause: The user attempt to specify the SYSAUX or SYSTEM tablespace as a member of the transportable tablespace list in the current job. These tablespaces may not be transported between databases.
solution: Specify different tablespaces to be transported.

message: File " string " is already a member of this dump set
cause: An attempt was made to add a new file to an export job but a file with the same name already exists in the dump set for the job.
solution: Reenter the new file information using a different file name.

message: cannot specify an SCN on a transportable job
cause: A target SCN was specified for a table in a transportable job by the streams or logical standy components which was not the defaulted SCN for the table.
solution: This is an internal error. Please report it to Oracle support.

message: cannot specify a TABLE_EXISTS_ACTION of string for a job with no metadata
cause: A job was defined with the TABLE_EXISTS_ACTION parameter set to REPLACE or SKIP, but without metadata. Without metadata, data could not be loaded for the requested table actions.
solution: Change the setting of the TABLE_EXISTS_ACTION parameter to APPEND or TRUNCATE or supply Metadata with the data.

message: Insufficient privileges to load data not in your schema
cause: An unprivileged user attempted to load data into a different schema.
solution: Use a privileged account if you must load data not in your schema

message: Data Pump does not support XMLType objects in version string . string will be skipped.
cause: Object had an XMLType column using either an object relational or binary storage format, which is unsupported by Data Pump in the target version.
solution: Use the original export and import utilities to move this object.

message: dump file " string " belongs to job string
cause: When a dump file set consists of multiple files, all files in the set must be specified for an import operation, and all files must have been produced by the same export job. One of the files provided does not belong to the original dump file set. For instance, it was created by a different export job than the other files.
solution: Remove the dump file indicated in the message and retry the import operation providing only the complete set of dump files created by a specific export job.

message: dump file " string " is a duplicate of dump file " string "
cause: When a dump file set consists of multiple files, all files in the set must be specified for an import operation. One of the files provided to import was found to be a duplicate of another dump file in the set. This can occur if the files in the dump set were copied or renamed using operating system utilities and the same dump file was inadvertently copied more than once with different destination names.
solution: Remove the dump file indicated in the message and retry the import operation providing only the complete set of dump files created by a specific export job.

message: incompatible version number string in dump file " string "
cause: A dump file was specified for an import operation whose version number is incompatible with the dump file version of the Data Pump product currently running on the system. Usually this message indicates that the dump file was produced by a newer version of the Data Pump export utility.
solution: Import this dump file using the Data Pump import utility with the same version as the export which created the file.

message: dump file " string " may be an original export dump file
cause: A dump file was specified for an import operation which appears to have been created using the original export utility. These dump files cannot be processed by the Data Pump import utility.
solution: Try using the original import utility to process this dump file.

message: file name parameter must be specified and non-null
cause: No file name was provided in an DBMS_DATAPUMP.ADD_FILE API call.
solution: Correct the file name parameter and reissue the API request.

message: directory object parameter must be specified and non-null
cause: No directory object was provided in either an DBMS_DATAPUMP.ADD_FILE API call or to the directory parameter used by the Data Pump command line clients.
solution: Correct the directory object parameter and retry the operation.

message: schema " string " does not exist
cause: The specified schema was referenced as the source of a REMAP_SCHEMA parameter, but did not exist in the dump file (for
solution: Specify the correct name of the schema to be remapped.

message: cannot migrate Data Pump queue table ownership to this instance
cause: There are active Data Pump jobs running on another instance in a RAC. All concurrent, active Data Pump jobs must be run on the same instance.
solution: Start this job on the same instance where other active Data Pump jobs are running, or wait until they finish.

message: unable to import data into pre-existing queue table string . Table_exists_action of string being ignored for this table
cause: A Data Pump import detected that a queue table that was to be imported already exists. Importing data into pre-existing queue tables is not supported.
solution: If the data from the dump file is desired, then drop the queue table and perform the import again, or use the import parameter table_exists_action=replace.

message: cannot link privileged user to non-privileged user
cause: A Data Pump job initiated be a user with EXPORT_FULL_DATABASE/IMPORT_FULL_DATABASE roles specified a network link that did not correspond to a user with equivalent roles on the remote database.
solution: Specify a network link that maps users to identically privileged users in the remote database.

message: bad flashback time
cause: A flashback time was specified for the Data Pump job which either could not be parsed or else could not be translated into a system change number (SCN). This typically occurs when
solution: Specify an explicit SCN for the desired flashback rather than a time.

message: Objects from foreign schemas have been removed from import
cause: An non-privileged user attempted to import objects into a schema other than their own.
solution: Either perform the import from a privileged schema or else remap all schemas that were exported into the username running the import.

message: error expanding dump file name " string "
cause: Export was unable to expand the directory object and dump file name into a full file name. Subsequent messages will detail the problems.
solution: Fix the problems outlined in the secondary messages.

message: error parsing dump file name " string "
cause: Export was unable to parse the dump file name. Subsequent messages will detail the problems.
solution: Fix the problems outlined in the secondary messages.

message: error appending extension to file " string "
cause: Export or Import was unable to append the default extension to create the file name. The given file name could be too long or contain illegal characters. Subsequent messages will detail the problems.
solution: Fix the problems outlined in the secondary messages.

message: cannot call this function from a non-Data Pump process
cause: Called a Data Pump process model function from a process which is not a Data Pump process.
solution: Refer to any other error messages for additional information. If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: error on whats my name call
cause: Attempt to get the Data Pump process name failed.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for additional information. If this error occurs from a Data Pump client (e.g. expdp or impdp), try the operation again. If the error occurs again, contact Oracle Customer Support and report the error.

message: Full database jobs require privileges
cause: Either an attempt to perform a full database export without the EXP_FULL_DATABASE role or an attempt to perform a full database import over a network link without the IMP_FULL_DATABASE role.
solution: Retry the operation in a schema that has the required roles.

message: Transportable tablespace job require privileges
cause: User attempted to perform a transportable tablespace job without being having the proper EXP_FULL_DATABASE or IMP_FULL_DATABASE role.
solution: Retry the operation in a schema that has the required roles.

message: A sample size of string is invalid.
cause: An attempt was made to do data sampling on a table with a value outside of the range of 0 - 100.
solution: Retry the filtering using a sampling number greater than 0 and less than 100.

message: Partition string was not found.
cause: If exporting or importing over the network, the user specified a partition name that was not found in the source database. For importing from files, the user specified a partition name not found in the dump file set.
solution: Retry the operation using the correct partition name.

message: Schema string was not found.
cause: If exporting or importing over the network, either the user specified a schema name that was not found in the source database or else the user lacked the proper EXP_FULL_DATABASE or IMP_FULL_DATABASE role that would allow them to access another schema. For importing from files, the user specified a schema name not found in the dump file set.
solution: Retry the operation using the correct schema name.

message: Object string was not found.
cause: If exporting or importing over the network, either the user specified an object name that was not found in the source database or else the user lacked the proper EXP_FULL_DATABASE or IMP_FULL_DATABASE role that would allow them to access the object another in another schema. For importing from files, the user specified an object name not found in the dump file set.
solution: Retry the operation using the correct object name.

message: Object path string was not found.
cause: If exporting or importing over the network, the user specified an object type path name that was not found in the source database. For importing from files, the user specified an object type path name not found in the dump file set.
solution: Retry the operation using the correct object type path name.

message: Local version of string cannot work with remote version of string .
cause: A Data Pump job specified a network link, but the version on the remote database cannot interoperate with the version on the local database.
solution: Do not specify network links between instance running different versions of the database.

message: Schema expression string does not correspond to any schemas.
cause: A schema expression or schema list was supplied for a Data Pump job that did not identify any schemas in the source database.
solution: Correct the schema specifications and retry the job.

message: Job is experiencing a resumable wait. string
cause: The Data Pump job is stalled with one or more of its sessions having a resumable wait. Resumable waits are typically caused by a non-expandable tablespace running out of space. The follow-on message describes the nature of the wait.
solution: Correct the condition causing the wait. This will typically involve adding datafiles to the tablespace that is full.

message: Cannot remap transportable tablespace names with compatibility of string .
cause: The user attempted to remap a tablespace name in a transportable tablespace job when the compatibility level was set below 10.1.
solution: Reset the compatibility level of the database to a more recent version.

message: Encrypted data has been stored unencrypted in dump file set.
cause: No encryption password was specified for an export job that involved data that was encrypted in the database.
solution: No specific user action is required. This is only a warning that secure data may be readable from within the dump file set.

message: Encryption password must be supplied.
cause: No encryption password was supplied to import a dump file set that was created using an encryption password.
solution: Specify the encryption password for the dump file set.

message: Encryption password is not needed.
cause: An encryption password was supplied to import a dump file set that was not created using an encryption password.
solution: No user action is required. This is merely a warning message.

message: Encryption password is incorrect.
cause: The wrong encryption password was supplied to import a dump file set.
solution: Resubmit the job using the correct encryption password for the dump file set.

message: invalid compression value string
cause: An invalid value was specified for compression.
solution: Correct the value and recreate the job.

message: cannot perform estimate on metadata only jobs
cause: An estimate was requested for a job by specifying the ESTIMATE or ESTIMATE_ONLY parameter. However, the job was also defined to have no data. These specifications conflict with each other.
solution: Remove one of the conflicting specifications for the job.

message: unable to load table " string "." string " because of OID transform
cause: The OID transform for the job was set to false and the identified table contained either VARRAYs with non-final types or unscoped REF columns. Both of these column types have embedded OIDs so they
solution: You must manually move the data with the specified tables when OIDs are not preserved.

message: unable to encrypt ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD
cause: The specified encryption password was unable to be encrypted for placement within the master table or decrypted when it was to be restored from the master table. Subsequent messages will describe the actual error that caused the encryption to fail.
solution: Fix the problems referenced by the subsequent messages. The most common reason for the encryption to fail is the lack of a security wallet.

message: Only partial table data may be exported due to fine grain access control on string
cause: An unprivileged user has tried to export a table that has fine grain access control. The table owner is subjected to access control and may not be able to export all rows in the table. Only the rows that can be seen by that user will be exported. In order to preserve integrity of the table, the user importing the table should have enough privilege to recreate the table with the security policies at import time.
solution: It is strongly recommended that the database administrator handle exporting of this table.

message: internal error string occurred during compression phase string
cause: An unexpected error occurred while compressing data buffers.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: internal error string ocurred during decompression phase string
cause: An unexpected error occurred while decompressing data buffers.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Transportable Data Pump jobs cannot exclude PLUGTS objects
cause: A Transportable Data Pump job requires all PLUGTS% objects, but the user-supplied exclude filters were excluding these objects.
solution: Reenter command without excluding PLUGTS% objects.

message: The transportable tablespace failure list is
cause: Some of the tablespaces specified for this job could not be exported.
solution: See specific errors for each tablespace, correct the problem, and try again.

message: No tablespaces in the specified list exist.
cause: The tablespaces specified on the EXPORT command did not exist.
solution: Check the list of tablespaces and reenter command with correct set of tablespaces.

message: The transportable set is not self-contained, violation list is
cause: The tablespaces specified for this job did not satisfy the closure checking. The list of violations specified each closure violation.
solution: See specific errors for violation and correct the problem or change the tablespaces on the command line and try again.

message: unable to encrypt dump file set
cause: Data Pump could not create an encrypted dump file set. This message will be accompanied by other messages that give more details about why the encrypted dump file set could not be created. The most common reason for this message is that you are trying to create a dump file set that can be transparently decrypted, and the database external security device is not open.
solution: If the external security device is not open, then open it. If the external security device is not configured, then the only type of encrypted dump file set that you can create is a password-based dump file set.

message: unable to decrypt dump file set
cause: The dump file set could not be decrypted. The reason could be either that an invalid password was entered, or that, when using transparent decryption, the database external security device was not open.
solution: If password-based import was enabled for this dump file set, then supply the correct password. If transparent import was enabled for this dump file set, then ensure that the database external security device is open.

message: internal error occurred during encryption phase string
cause: An unexpected error occurred while encrypting data buffers.
solution: See the secondary error for more information and contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: internal error ocurred during decryption phase string
cause: An unexpected error occurred while decrypting data buffers.
solution: See the secondary error for more information and contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: table mode jobs with transportable=always and partition filters only allow objects from one table
cause: Multiple tables are not supported when specifying partitions while using transportable table mode.
solution: Retry the job specifying only one table.

message: Table mode jobs do not allow the schema to be wild carded.
cause: The table filter included a schema expression with the % wild card.
solution: Retry the job specifying actual schemas.

message: Table mode jobs require the tables to be comma separated.
cause: The string describing tables in a table mode job was not comma separated.
solution: Retry the job specifying the tables separated by commas.

message: At least one schema in the TABLE_FILTER does not exist.
cause: The TABLE_FITER specified contains a schema that does not exist.
solution: Retry the job specifying only schemas that exist.

message: Link name " string " is invalid.
cause: The name of the network link supplied for a Data Pump job was not usable. Secondary messages identify the problem.
solution: Rerun the job using a valid network link.

message: Dump files are not supported for estimate only jobs.
cause: An attempt was made to add a dumpfile to an Export job that only requested file estimates.
solution: Do not specify a dumpfile for jobs that do not require dumpfiles.

message: Data cannot be filtered or selected in string jobs.
cause: A data filter was supplied for the specified type of job, but is not supported in the specified job type. From the command line, data filters can be specified by the CONTENT, TABLES (partition specifications), SAMPLE and QUERY parameters.
solution: Do not restrict data handling on jobs that cannot support data filtering.

message: Partition selection is not supported over a network link.
cause: Specific partitions were selected for a job operating over a network link.
solution: Remove the partition specifications and rerun the job.

message: No subsetting of tablespaces is allowed for transportable import.
cause: A tablespace filter was applied to a transportable import job that was not performed over a network link. In this case, the tablespace may not be changed from its specification at export time.
solution: Rerun the job without specifying a tablespace filter.

message: Transforms are not supported in transportable jobs.
cause: A metadata transformation such as STORAGE or SEGMENT_ATTRIBUTES has been specified for a transportable Data Pump job.
solution: Rerun the job without specifying a transform.

message: A parallel degree of string is invalid.
cause: A bad numeric was supplied for specifying the parallelism to be used within a Data Pump job. The degree of parallelism must be an integer great than 0.
solution: The the degree specifying and retry the parallelism setting.

message: Value string is invalid for parameter string .
cause: A parameter for a Data Pump job was set with a NULL or invalid value.
solution: Refer to the documentation to identify the legal values for each parameter. Retry the operation with a valid value.

message: Parameter string is invalid for string jobs.
cause: The a parameter has been specified that is not supported for the specified type of Data Pump.
solution: Remove the parameter specification and retry the operation.

message: Parameter string requires privileges.
cause: Use of the specified privileges requires the user to have the IMP_FULL_DATABASE role for import jobs or the EXP_FULL_DATABASE role for export jobs.
solution: Remove the parameter specification and retry the operation.

message: A PCTSPACE adjustment of string is invalid.
cause: User specified a storage space transformation that was out of range. Values for PCTSPACE must be greater than zero.
solution: Retry the operation with a valid PCTSPACE value.

message: unable to retrieve dumpfile information as specified
cause: User specified an invalid or inaccessible file with the specified filename and directory object.
solution: Retry the operation with a valid directory object and filename.

message: installation error: XSL stylesheets not loaded correctly
cause: The XSL stylesheets used by the Data Pump Metadata API were not loaded correctly into the Oracle dictionary table "sys.metastylesheet." Either the stylesheets were not loaded at all, or they were not converted to the database character set.
solution: Connect AS SYSDBA and execute dbms_metadata_util.load_stylesheets to reload the stylesheets.

message: Metadata processing is not available
cause: The Data Pump could not use the Metadata API. Typically, this is caused by the XSL stylesheets not being set up properly.
solution: Connect AS SYSDBA and execute dbms_metadata_util.load_stylesheets to reload the stylesheets.

message: Data Pump does not support external tables with encrypted columns. string will not be exported
cause: The object is an external table with encrypted columns and this is unsupported with Data Pump.
solution: External table must be manually recreated on the target system.

message: object type " string "." string " hashcode mismatch
cause: An object type in a transportable tablespace set could not be used because there was a type with the same name but a different hashcode (and type definition) on the target system. Tables in the transportable tablespace set that use this object type cannot be created.
solution: Drop the object type and dependent objects from the target system if possible and retry the operation.

message: object type " string "." string " typeid mismatch
cause: An object type in a transportable tablespace set already exists on the target system, but with a different typeid. The typeid could not be changed because the type or a dependent type is used by an existing table. Tables in the transportable tablespace set that use this object be created.
solution: Drop the object type and dependent objects from the target system if possible and retry the operation.

message: type check on object type " string "." string " failed
cause: The type check on a type failed. Therefore, the table create for the table which uses the type also fails.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for additional information. Correct the error, if possible, and try the action again.

message: directory object name is too long
cause: The directory object name provided to the Data Pump Job was invalid because its length was greater than 30 characters.
solution: Retry the operation with a valid directory object name.

message: file name is too long
cause: The file name provided to the Data Pump Job was invalid because its length was greater than 4000 characters.
solution: Retry the operation with a valid file name.

message: Specifying data filters is invalid when dumpfiles do not contain table data.
cause: A data filter was supplied for an import job, but the dumpfile does not contain any table data. The export command created a dumpfile with metadata only. No table data was included. From the command line, data filters can be specified by the CONTENT, SAMPLE and QUERY parameters.
solution: Do not restrict data handling on jobs that cannot support data filtering.

message: Unable to create global temporary master table string
cause: Data Pump tried to create a global temporary master table but could not. The errors that follow describe why the table could not be created.
solution: Examine and fix the problems described in the additional errors.

message: Internal Data Pump error. Master table information for version string not found.
cause: An unexpected error occurred while processing the job. The data in an internal table could not be found.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: string row(s) were rejected with the following error: string
cause: These rows were not loaded due to constraint or index violations.
solution: Retry the operation when row data is fixed.

message: Unable to construct a unique departitioned object name for string string . string : string when defaulted.
cause: All (sub)partitions in the job were to be created as individual objects and the renaming was defaulted. The job will attempt to create unique object names, but the name creation algorithm was unable to find a unique object name for the specified (sub)partition.
solution: Specify a rename_table transform to use or delete some of the existing objects causing the name conflicts.

message: Service name string is not available
cause: The specified resource service name for the Data Pump job
solution: Pick a service name that the user is authorized to use.

message: invalid data remap name: string
cause: The specified type of data remapping was not supported.
solution: Only COLUMN_FUNCTION data remaps are supported. Retry the operation using a supported data remap name.

message: invalid remap function: string
cause: The specified package function for performing data remapping was not found.
solution: Either create the specified package function or else grant the user access to the function.

message: invalid remap column name: string
cause: The column name specified for the data remapping does not exist in the specified table.
solution: Specify a scalar column name within the table to be remapped.

message: Data cannot be remapped under the direct path access method.
cause: Data remapping was requested on a job that requires the direct path access method. Data remapping can only be performed using the external table access method.
solution: Retry the job without specifying any access method.

message: data remap string has already been specified
cause: A data remap has already been specified for the indicated column. Only one data remap may be defined for a column.
solution: Remove one of the data remap specifications for the job.

message: Failed to load XML document string . Compare process aborted.
cause: An error occurred while performing XML difference parse.
solution: Resubmit XML compare request with valid document.

message: XML node attribute differences are not supported.
cause: MDAPI XML difference parsing did not support node attributes.
solution: Resubmit XML compare request with valid document.

message: No differences found.
cause: XML documents compared were identical.
solution: No action required.

message: Error while processing difference document.
cause: Error occurred in the MDAPI difference writer.
solution: Refer to any following error messages for additional information. Correct the error, if possible, and try the action again.

message: Unable to export/import string due to table attributes.
cause: See the Data Pump documentation for an explanation of what table attributes prevent an export or import from succeeding.
solution: Resolve conflicting table attributes.

message: Import job requires 'TRANSPORT_DATAFILES' parameter.
cause: The export job used 'TRANSPORTABLE=ALWAYS' and the import job requires TRANSPORT_DATAFILES to be specified.
solution: Specify the transport datafiles associated with this job.

message: import job requires export dump file " string "
cause: A Data Pump IMPORT or SQL_FILE operation was being performed but not all of the files from the Data Pump export dump file set were included.
solution: Check the export log file and make sure all of the files that were exported are included in the current job. The import log file also lists the export names of the missing files.

message: cannot locate master table within provided dump files
cause: A Data Pump IMPORT or SQL_FILE operation was being performed but not all of the files from the Data Pump export dump file set were included. In particular, the dump file containing the export job's master table was not provided.
solution: Check the export log file and make sure all of the files that were exported are included in the current job.

message: Importing a SecureFile LOB with metadata into a scalar, column string , is not allowed.
cause: An import of a SecureFile LOB with metadata into a scalar column was attempted.
solution: Change the scalar column to a SecureFile LOB.

message: Importing a SecureFile LOB with metadata or archived SecureFile LOB into a BasicFile LOB is not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to import a SecureFile LOB that contained metadata or was archived at the time of export into a BasicFile LOB.
solution: Perform the import into a different table, perform DBMS_LOB.ARCHIVE_GET on any archived SecureFile LOBs, and then use INSERT AS SELECT to migrate the SecureFile LOB data to the BasicFile LOB.

message: Specified tables do not exist.
cause: The tables specified for this export job did not exist.
solution: Check the specified table list and make sure the tables listed exist.

message: direct path load not possible into preexisting table with column that has a default value and is not being loaded; table string , column string
cause: The direct path access method could not be used to load into a pre-existing table that has a column with a default value and that column is not being loaded into.
solution: Remove the ACCESS_METHOD parameter from the import command line.

message: Failed to fetch PLUGTS_BLKs.
cause: The Data Pump expected a PLUGTS_BLK object to be exported but none were.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Transportable tablespace Data Pump jobs from read-only databases not supported.
cause: The remote database was read-only and Data Pump export jobs using transportable tablespace over a network link require the remote database to be read/write.
solution: Use Data Pump without transportable tablespace or make the remote database read/write.

message: Data cannot be remapped for more than 10 columns.
cause: An attempt was made to use REMAP_DATA to remap more than 10 columns.
solution: Do not use the REMAP_DATA to remap more than 10 columns.

message: Cannot rename cluster.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two clusters with different names. There is no SQL ALTER statement to rename a cluster.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot add column to cluster.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two clusters with different column lists. There is no SQL ALTER statement to add a column to a cluster.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot delete column from cluster.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two clusters with different column lists. There is no SQL ALTER statement to delete a column from a cluster.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot modify column in cluster.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two clusters with different column lists. There is no SQL ALTER statement to modify a column in a cluster.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter size for hash cluster.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two hash clusters with different sizes. There is no SQL ALTER statement to modify the size of a hash cluster.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter PARALLEL INSTANCES.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two objects, both with PARALLEL but with different INSTANCES values. There is no SQL ALTER statement to modify PARALLEL INSTANCES.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter type of table: string
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing tables of different types: relational table, object table or XMLType table. There is no SQL ALTER statement to change a table's type.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter object_type of object table: string
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing object tables based on different object types. There is no SQL ALTER statement to change an object table's object type.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter unpartitioned table to partitioned.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two tables, one unpartitioned, the other partitioned. There is no SQL ALTER statement to partition an unpartitioned table.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot remove default from table column.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two table columns, one with a default value, one without. There is no SQL ALTER syntax to remove a column default.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter a real column to make it virtual or vice versa.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two table columns, one virtual, one real. There is no SQL ALTER statement to make a virtual column real or vice versa.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter a column of type LONG to anything other than LOB.
cause: DBMS_METADATA_DIFF was comparing two table columns, the first of type LONG, the second of a data type other than LOB. There is no SQL ALTER statement to modify a long data type to anything other than a CLOB or NCLOB.
solution: The difference cannot be eliminated with an SQL ALTER statement.

message: Cannot alter a LOB column to another data type.
