message: Specified value for _PLSQL_MAX_STACK_SIZE ( string ) is larger than available memory ( string )
cause: The value specified for the _PLSQL_MAX_STACK_SIZE parameter was larger than the amount of stack size available to the process.
solution: Specify a smaller value for the _PLSQL_MAX_STACK_SIZE parameter.

message: value for string must be greater than zero
cause: The input parameter in question has a value of zero or less.
solution: Provide a value greater than zero for the relevant parameter.

message: wordsize must be string or greater
cause: The input wordsize is less than the prescribed limit for the BLAST Match or Align algorithm.
solution: Provide a wordsize greater than or equal to the prescribed value.

message: wordsize must be in the range string - string for BLAST-P
cause: The input wordsize has a value out of the prescribed range.
solution: Provide a wordsize value within the prescribed range for BLAST-P.

message: penalty must be negative for BLAST-N
cause: The input value provided for penalty is zero or greater.
solution: Provide a negative penalty value.

message: no column named string in training table string
cause: The training table does not contain the specified column
solution: Provide a case-id/target column that exists in the training table

message: null case ID column - cannot provide row diagnostics in string
cause: A row diagnostics table name was provided, but without a corresponding case or row identifier column in the build data.
solution: Provide a non-null case identifier column in the build data to identify rows in the row diagnostics table.

message: sufficient memory could not be allocated given the number of attributes
cause: Unable to allocate sufficient memory to create a model capable of producing confidence bounds on predictions because there were too many attributes or there were high cardinality categorical attributes, or both, in the build data.
solution: Reduce the number of attributes, especially high cardinality categoricals, or enable ridge regression.

message: solution to least squares problem could not be found
cause: Unable to find solution because the predictor covariance matrix was singular.
solution: Enable ridge regression or remove exact multicollinearities from the build data.

message: reference class name not found in build data
cause: The provided reference class name was not found in the build data.
solution: Provide an existing target value as the reference class name.

message: reference class name not found in the weights table
cause: The provided reference class name did not correspond to any of the entries in the weights table.
solution: Provide consistent specification for reference class name and weights table.

message: Target attribute has more than two distinct values
cause: Generalized Linear Models only support binary classification.
solution: Consolidate target values into two distinct categories.

message: solution to least squares problem could not be found
cause: Unable to find solution because the predictor build data were not properly scaled.
solution: Standardize the predictor build data by enabling auto prep.

message: Specified diagnostics table name already exists
cause: A diagnostics table name matching an existing table was specified.
solution: Choose a table name that does not match any existing user table.

message: Data Mining System Error string - string - string
cause: An internal system error occured during a data mining operation.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid input string for data mining operation string
cause: The input parameter is either null or invalid for the given operation.
solution: Provide a valid value. Check range for NUMBER parameters.

message: invalid case-id column: string
cause: The case-id column was invalid. If a case-id column is specified, it must be present in the input data source. The case-id column cannot be the same as the target column, and the column's data type is restricted to NUMBER, CHAR, and VARCHAR2 when building a GLM model with a diagnostics table.
solution: Change the schema of your input data to supply a case-id column of appropriate data type.

message: invalid training data for model build
cause: The training data provided in the reported table is unsuitable for build, either because it is empty, has unsuitable data, or the schema of the table does not match the input specifications.
solution: Inspect the training data and correct the contents/schema as appropriate.

message: input data incompatible with model signature
cause: The data provided for this post-build operation is in format different from that used for model build.
solution: Provide data whose attribute data types match the build data. Input data attributes must have the same data types as those described in the model signature for the model.

message: positive target value not specified for computing Lift
cause: Positive target value has not been specified for Lift.
solution: Provide a positive target value for the Lift operation.

message: operation requires string option to be installed
cause: The specified option has not been installed with the RDBMS.
solution: Install the reported option and retry the operation.

message: input data contains too few distinct target ( string ) values
cause: At least two distinct target values are required for Build.
solution: Provide counter-example target values in the input data.

message: inconsistent logical data record
cause: Repeated instances of a record identifier or repeated attribute(s) in a nested column.
solution: Remove or re-label repeated instances to resolve inconsistencies.

message: Duplicate model tables found for table type string
cause: Operation would result in duplicate model table types which is not supported.
solution: Remove the duplicate entry.

message: no mining attributes found in build data
cause: Could not build a model when only special or empty columns were present. Special columns include target, row weight, and case ID columns.
solution: Provide mining attribute data.

message: insufficient number of valid data rows
cause: Fewer than two valid data rows were found in the build data.
solution: Provide at least two valid build data rows. If the model is either a classification or regression model, then valid rows must have non-NULL targets. If a weight column was provided, then valid rows must have positive row weights. In addition, if DELETE_ROW missing value treatment was used, consider disabling it.

message: insufficient number of distinct target values
cause: Less than two distinct target values were found in the build data.
solution: Provide the classification build data with valid rows containing at least two distinct target values. Valid rows must have non-NULL targets. If a weight column was provided, then valid rows must have positive row weights. In addition, if DELETE_ROW missing value treatment was used, consider disabling it.

message: weights table target values mismatched with build data
cause: The entries in the weights table did not correspond to the target values in the build data.
solution: Verify the entries in the weights table.

message: weights table schema is incorrect
cause: The weights table did not have the required schema.
solution: Provide a weights table with schema: (target_value, weight), where the type of the first column corresponds to the type of the target column (CHAR, VARCHAR2 or NUMBER) and the type of the second column is NUMBER.

message: NULL values found in weights table
cause: The weights table had NULL entries.
solution: Replace or eliminate all NULL entries in the weights table.

message: repeated target values found in weights table
cause: The weights table had repeated target values.
solution: Remove the repeated target values from the weights table.

message: insufficient number of target values in weights table
cause: The weights table had less that 2 target values.
solution: Provide at least two target values in the weights table.

message: nested columns incompatible with missing value treatment
cause: delete_row missing value treatment is not supported for nested columns.
solution: Use 2D (non-nested) data representation or manually delete the rows with NULL values and disable the delete_row missing value treatment.

message: invalid weight value in the weights table
cause: Negative or zero weight values were found in the weights table.
solution: Ensure that weight values in the weights table are positive.

message: force option not allowed for drop model in different schema
cause: The force option was specified, but the model is in a different schema.
solution: If the force option is necessary, run the drop model from the owning schema. If the force option is not necessary, set the force parameter to FALSE.

message: invalid data type for row weights column string .
cause: Row weights column was not assigned one of the allowed data types.
solution: Choose a row weight column of type NUMBER or FLOAT.

message: invalid transformation definition for column string
cause: Transformation definition has duplicate or NULL columns.
solution: Provide a valid transformation definition specification.

message: invalid column reference
cause: Transformation expression has no column references or more than one reference or the reference is qualified.
solution: Provide a valid expression.

message: invalid stack definition for attribute string
cause: Stack definition expression or reverse expression has syntax errors or it does not match the transformation definition.
solution: Provide a valid expression.

message: transformation definition does not match the data
cause: Transformation definition specifies nested transformation for non-nested data or it removes all of the columns.
solution: Provide a valid data.

message: invalid input parameter string
cause: The input parameter was either null or invalid.
solution: Provide a valid value for the input parameter.

message: column string does not exist in the input table string
cause: The column was missing from the table.
solution: Correct the table schema and/or provide the correct column name.

message: model string does not exist
cause: The model did not exist.
solution: Supply a valid model name.

message: model string already exists
cause: A model by the same name exists.
solution: Provide a different, unique name for the model.

message: invalid setting name string
cause: The input setting name was invalid.
solution: Consult the documentation for the settings table and provide a valid setting name.

message: invalid setting value for setting name string
cause: The input value for the given setting name was invalid.
solution: Consult the documentation for the settings table and provide a valid setting value.

message: duplicate or multiple function settings
cause: The input settings table contained settings for multiple mining functions.
solution: Provide setting(s) for a single function in the settings table.

message: duplicate or multiple algorithm settings for function string
cause: The input settings table had duplicate or multiple algorithm settings for a mining function.
solution: Provide only one appropriate algorithm setting for the mining function.

message: setting string is invalid for string function
cause: The specified setting was not supported for the mining function supplied.
solution: Provide appropriate combination of function and algorithm settings.

message: invalid score criterion type when cost matrix is specified
cause: The score criterion type may not be 'PROBABILITY' when a cost matrix is specified.
solution: Set score criterion type to 'COST' or don't specify a cost matrix.

message: algorithm name string is invalid
cause: Algorithm name for the model was invalid or the operation was not valid for the algorithm.
solution: Check the algorithm name for the model and verify that the operation is valid.

message: invalid target data type in input data for string function
cause: Target data type was invalid.
solution: Classification function accepts CHAR,VARCHAR2, and NUMBER targets. Regression function accepts NUMBER targets only.

message: contradictory values for settings: string , string
cause: The settings values were not compatible.
solution: Check the documentation and change the setting value(s).

message: duplicate setting: string
cause: Duplicate setting in the settings table.
solution: Remove the duplicate setting from the settings table.

message: model string is incompatible with current operation
cause: The current operation was not supported for the mining function the model corresponds to.
solution: Provide the model name suitable for current operation.

message: feature not supported
cause: The feature was not supported in the API.
solution: Modify the code to avoid usage of the feature.

message: priors table mismatched with training data
cause: The entries in the priors table do not correspond to the targets in the training data.
solution: Verify the entries in the priors table.

message: Both priors table and weights table are specified
cause: Both a priors table and a weights table are specified for SVM model build.
solution: Priors table is the old (pre 11g) mechanism for specifying class weights, and class weights table is the new (and correct) way to specify class weights. Remove the priors table entry from the settings table (after transferring class weight settings, if appropriate). Going forward, priors table will be valid only for NB models. Use class weights for SVM.

message: apply result table string is incompatible with current operation
cause: The current operation was not allowed for the apply result table supplied.
solution: Make sure the operation being performed is valid for the mining function used to build the model (using which the apply result table was created).

message: maximum number of attributes exceeded
cause: The data had too many attributes.
solution: Reduce the dimensionality of the data.

message: maximum target cardinality exceeded
cause: The target cardinality of the training data was too high.
solution: Reduce the target cardinality.

message: data mining model export failed, job name= string , error= string
cause: The model export job failed.
solution: Check export job settings as required by DataPump.

message: data mining model import failed, job name= string , error= string
cause: The model import job failed.
solution: Check import job settings as required by DataPump.

message: transactional input - no matching id for value column string
cause: The training data is transactional - and a value column is specified without a matching id specification.
solution: Specify a valid id column name as input

message: model is currently in use by another process
cause: The model is currently in use by another process.
solution: Retry if necessary.

message: model upgrade/downgrade must be performed by SYS
cause: Upgrade/Downgrade routines are being invoked by a user with insufficient privilieges.
solution: Run the routines as SYS during migration.

message: invalid transformation attribute
cause: Transformation list provided to CREATE_MODEL has duplicate or NULL attributes. Case ID or target attribute has attribute_subname that is not NULL. Attribute provided to ALTER_REVERSE_EXPRESSION does not exist in the model.
solution: Remove NULLs and duplicates and fix case ID and target attributes or provide a valid attribute for a given model.

message: scoring cost matrix already exists
cause: The model already has a scoring cost matrix.
solution: To add a new scoring cost matrix the existing one should be removed first.

message: scoring cost matrix not found
cause: The model does not have a scoring cost matrix.
solution: To remove a scoring cost matrix the model should have one.

message: invalid transformation expression
cause: Expression has syntax or semantic errors.
solution: Provide a valid expression.

message: transactional input incompatible with specified algorithm
cause: Training data in transactional format is not accepted for model creation using the specified mining algorithm.
solution: Pivot the data into 2D tabular format, or provide the transactional input through a nested table column.

message: transactional input - incompatible datatype for column string
cause: The data type of the column in the input training data is not supported.
solution: Cast or change the type of the column to one of CHAR, VARCHAR, NUMBER or FLOAT

message: transactional input - case id should be provided with id string
cause: The training data is transactional by virtue of presence of a and item id - but does not have a case id specification.
solution: Specify a valid case id column name as input

message: no support vectors were found
cause: The input data is non-predictive in nature, or one of the input settings is incorrect/incompatible with respect to the input data.
solution: Provide additional data or change model setting value.

message: no target values were found
cause: No target values were identified during load.
solution: Validate that the target is correctly specified.

message: no target counter examples were found
cause: One or more of the target classes have only positive examples.
solution: Provide counter examples or remove that target class.

message: priors cannot be specified for one-class models
cause: Priors were specified.
solution: Do NOT provide priors for one-class models.

message: specified priors or weights table has an incorrect schema
cause: The priors or class weights table whose name is specified in in the settings does not have the prescribed schema. A priors table should have the schema (target_value, prior_probability) and a class weights table should have the schema (target_value, class_weight)
solution: Modify the schema of the input priors or class weights table to match the ones provided above (also in the documentation).

message: input data for model build contains negative values
cause: The input data contains negative values, which is not acceptable for a Non-negative Matrix Factorization model.
solution: Provide clean data for build without any negative values.

message: NMF: number of features not between [1, string ]
cause: The number of requested features must be greater than 1, and less than the smaller of the number of attributes and the number of cases in the dataset.
solution: Specify the desired number of features within the acceptable range.

message: no meaningful matrix factorization found
cause: Input data was not significantly different from 0.
solution: Check your data for problems or add a positive constant to all the numeric attributes.

message: number of mining attributes ( string ) exceeds maximum ( string )
cause: Input data was found to contain a number of mining attributes exeeding the maximum allowed.
solution: Check the input data for categorical fields with high cardinality.

message: no statistically significant features were found
cause: Input data inadequate in volume and/or quality to derive statistically significant predictors for building a data mining model.
solution: Provide a well-prepared training data set.

message: apply rules prohibited for this model mode
cause: Adaptive Bayes Network rules are only generated for SingleFeature ABN models
solution: Rebuild model in SingleFeature mode and then apply with rules.

message: invalid model type string for Adaptive Bayes Network algorithm
cause: The valid values for the abns_model_type settings are: abns_multi_feature, abns_single_feature, abns_naive_bayes.
solution: Use a valid value for the abns_model_type setting.

message: invalid model name
cause: A model name is invalid or does not exist.
solution: Check spelling. A valid model name must begin with a letter and may contain only alphanumeric characters and the special characters $, _, and #. The name must be less than or equal to 30 characters and cannot be a reserved word.

message: invalid cost matrix
cause: Cost matrix specification is invalid.
solution: Provide valid cost matrix specification. Check syntax for data mining functions.

message: missing cost matrix
cause: Cost matrix specification is missing.
solution: Provide valid cost matrix specification. Check syntax for data mining functions.

message: model does not exist
cause: The model entered does not exist.
solution: Check spelling.

message: label not in the model
cause: The user-specified label was not present in the model.
solution: Provide a valid label. The set of valid labels can be retrieved from a classification model by invoking PREDICTION_SET, from a clustering model by invoking CLUSTER_SET, and from a feature extraction model by invoking FEATURE_SET.

message: remote operations not permitted on mining models
cause: An attempt was made to perform queries or DML operations on remote tables using local mining models.
solution: Remove the reference to remote tables in the statement.

message: invalid data for model - cosine distance out of bounds
cause: The norm computed using attribute values from the incoming row for the cosine model is outside the range 0-1.
solution: Remove or correct the data in the offending row.

message: duplicate attributes provided for data mining function
cause: A duplicate, non-nested attribute was provided as input to the data mining function. A duplicate attribute is one which is present in the model signature, occurs more than once in the USING clause after tablename expansion, and is not a collection element in a nested table column.
solution: Eliminate the duplicate attribute(s).

message: model incompatible with data mining function
cause: The supplied model cannot be operated upon by the data mining function because the model is built for a mining function and/ or based on an algorithm that is incompatible with function.
solution: Provide the name of the model suitable for the function.

message: model cost not available
cause: The supplied model was assumed to have been built with a cost matrix specification, when in reality, it was not.
solution: Provide a model name that corresponds to a model that was built with an appropriate cost matrix specification.

message: confidence level must be greater than 0 and less than 1
cause: The specified value for confidence level is out of range.
solution: Specify a value for confidence level in the range 0 < level < 1

message: input class is invalid for the specified predictive model
cause: The specified model is either not a classification model, or does not have the input class label as one of its target values.
solution: Provide the correct target value (class label) or provide the appropriate classification model with the target attribute that has the specified class label as one of its values.

message: invalid cost matrix specification
cause: A valid cost matrix is not specified.
solution: Consult documentation for valid cost matrix specification.

message: invalid classname string in cost matrix specification
cause: Actual or predicted classname specified is not present in training data
solution: Provide valid classname(s) in cost matrix specification

message: invalid prior probability specification
cause: Valid prior probabilities not specified. Valid probabilities should be between 0 and 1.
solution: Consult documentation for valid prior probability specification.

message: invalid classname string in prior probability specification
cause: Actual or predicted classname specified is not present in training data.
solution: Provide valid classname(s) in prior probability specification.

message: invalid impurity metric specified
cause: Impurity metric specified is not valid. Examples of valid metrics are TREE_IMPURITY_GINI, TREE_IMPURITY_ENTROPY.
solution: Consult documentation for valid impurity metrics and specification.

message: dm_nested types not supported by this algorithm
cause: The training input to the CREATE_MODEL routine contains one or more columns of dm_nested type (DM_NESTED_NUMERICALS and/or DM_NESTED_CATEGORICALS). These columns are currently not supported for Decision Tree, O-Cluster, and Adaptive Bayes Network algorithms.
solution: Remove columns of these data types from the input data source.

message: invalid bin number, is zero or negative value
cause: Input bin number has zero or negative values.
solution: Provide positive bin numbers starting from 1.

message: bin number too large
cause: Bin number is too large.
solution: Reprocess build data by choosing smaller bin numbers.

message: Attribute string has too many distinct values ( string )
cause: Exceeded maximum number of distinct values allowed in an attribute.
solution: Bin numerical data with fewer than 1024 bins or recode categorical data with fewer than 1024 unique values.

message: All rows contain the same data
cause: All rows contained the same data and could not be clustered using k-Means with cosine distance metric.
solution: Use Euclidean distance metric.

message: access violation on model storage object
cause: An attempt was made to directly access/modify a schema object that stores model metadata and content.
solution: Perform all mining operations (create,drop,alter, and select using data mining functions) against named model objects. Contact your DBA or Oracle Support if you suspect that an orphaned schema object.

message: One or more 11g models exist
cause: There are 11g data mining models existing in the database.
solution: Drop 11g data mining models prior to downgrade to 10g.

message: only SELECT and ALTER are valid for mining models
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke an invalid privilege on a mining model.
solution: Do not attempt to grant or revoke any privilege besides SELECT or ALTER on mining models.

message: Invalid field specification for: string
cause: The derived field was incorrectly defined.
solution: Make sure the field is correctly defined in the PMML document.

message: More than one linear regression equation in the model
cause: More than one linear regression equation was in the model.
solution: Make sure there is only one linear regression equation in the model.

message: No model found in PMML document
cause: There was no model found in the PMML document.
solution: Make sure the PMML document contains a model section.

message: Only one model allowed in PMML document
cause: More than one model existed in the PMML document.
solution: PMML model import only supports one model per PMML document. Make sure only one model exists in the PMML document.

message: Target has more than two categories
cause: The target contained more than two categories.
solution: PMML model import supports only binary logistic regression. Make sure the target contains no more than two categories.

message: NormContinuous must include at least two LinearNorm elements
cause: NormContinuous included less than two LinearNorm elements.
solution: NormContinuous must include at least two LinearNorm elements. Make sure at least two LinearNorm elements are included.

message: Invalid interval for Discretize field: string
cause: The intervals were incorrect.
solution: Make sure that both margins are not missing.

message: Unsupported feature in PMML document: string
cause: The feature was not supported by PMML model import.
solution: Please make sure to use supported features.

message: Unsupported PMML transformation: string
cause: The transformation was not supported.
solution: Make sure to use supported transformations.

message: PMML DerivedField must have a unique name specified: string
cause: A DerivedField did not reference another defined field.
solution: A DerivedField did not have a unique name specified. Make sure to specify a unique name for each DerivedField.

message: PMML DerivedField depends on a undefined field: string
cause: A DerivedField may only reference other defined fields.
solution: Make sure DerivedFields reference other defined fields.

message: PMML regression equation references an undefined field: string
cause: Regression equation did not reference defined fields.
solution: Regression equation may only reference defined fields. Make sure all fields are defined.

message: session id list not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the session id list specified was null.
solution: Check the session id list, and try again with a valid value.

message: destination instance not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the destination instance specified was null.
solution: Check the destination instance , and try again with a valid value.

message: client id not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the client id specified was null.
solution: Check the client id, and try again with a valid value.

message: percentage not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the percentage specified was null.
solution: Check the percentage, and try again with a valid value.

message: session id list not specified
cause: An attempt to cancel migration was made, which failed because the session id list specified was null.
solution: Check the session id list, and try again with a valid value.

message: session id not specified
cause: An attempt to get migration status was made, which failed because the session id specified was null.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: sid field is null
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had a null sid field.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: serial# field is null
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had a null serial# field.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: Session with session number string , serial number string does not exist
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because of invalid session number and/or serial number.
solution: Check the session number and serial number and try again.

message: No more memory to hold connection state information
cause: An attempt to reference more connections than configured
solution: Check the connection information and try again.

message: Operation failed for session id string , serial number string
cause: An migration related operation failed because of contention between sessions.
solution: Check the additional error codes for more information, and retry operation later.

message: Migration not allowed for session number string , serial number string
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the session specified cannot be migrated.
solution: Check the session number and serial number and try again.

message: instance name not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the instance name specified was null.
solution: Check the instance name, and try again with a valid value.

message: Session number string , serial number string currently being migrated
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the session specified is currently being migrated.
solution: Check the session number and serial number and try again.

message: destination connect string not specified
cause: A migration attempt was made, which failed because the connect string specified was null.
solution: Check the connect string and try again.

message: Session recreation failed
cause: Session recreation failed at the destination instance.
solution: Check session state and try migration again

message: Session prepare failed for session number string , serial number string
cause: A migration attempt was made, which failed because session prepare failed.
solution: Retry migration again after checking all arguments.

message: Session begin at the destination instance failed
cause: Session begin failed at the destination instance because the shadow connection could not be established.
solution: Check the connect string and try beginning the session again.

message: invalid value " string " specified for parameter " string "
cause: An invalid value was specified for the the given parameter.
solution: Correct the value being specified for the parameter.

message: OCI error during transparent session migration
cause: An OCI operation failed during transparent session migration.
solution: Check the OCI error signalled, and take corrective action.

message: instance name not specified
cause: An attempt to recover after instance death was made, which failed because the instance name specified was null.
solution: Check the instance name, and try again with a valid value.

message: death time not specified
cause: An attempt to recover after instance death was made, which failed because the death time specified was null.
solution: Check the death time, and try again with a valid value.

message: Cursor needs to be parsed again
cause: An SQL operation failed because the cursor state was lost.
solution: Reissue all operations starting from parse.

message: sid field string is invalid
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had an invalid sid field.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: serial# field string is invalid
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had an invalid serial# field.
solution: Check the serial#, and try again with a valid value.

message: Error status string during OCI operation at string
cause: An OCI operation failed during transparent session migration.
solution: Check the OCI error signalled, and take corrective action.

message: Session id not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the session id specified by the client was null.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: Destination session id not specified for sid string serial# string
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the destination session id specified by the client was null.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: Session id not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the session id specified by the client was null.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: Destination session key not specified for sid string serial# string
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the destination session key specified by the client was null.
solution: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

message: Oracle Cluster Registry operation failed with event string .
cause: The Portable Clusterware/Oracle Cluster Registry stack returned an error.
solution: Check if the Portable Clusterware stack is properly brought up.

message: The database: string has already been designated as Cluster Director.
cause: An attempt was made to designate multiple databases as the Cluster Director.
solution: Undesignate the existing Cluster Director before Designating a new one.

message: No database has currently been designated as Cluster Director.
cause: An attempt was made to query/undesignate a Cluster Director when no database has been designated as Cluster Director.
solution: None

message: Only the designated Cluster Director: string can undesignate itself.
cause: An attempt was made to undesignate the current Cluster Director by a database that is not the Cluster Director.
solution: Login to the currently designated Cluster Director to perform the undesignation.

message: The database: string is the Cluster Director.
cause: An attempt was made to control the Cluster Director on a database that is not the Cluster Director.
solution: Log in to the currently designated Cluster Director to perform the control operation.

message: The Cluster Director is not stopped.
cause: An attempt was made to control the Cluster Director before the Cluster Director was stopped.
solution: Use dbms_cluster_director.stop to stop the Cluster Director and retry the control operation.

message: invalid argument string : value is null
cause: An attempt to read the scan hostname or port failed
solution: Verify pcw is running and scan is configured. Run grdcscan read_config to verify or grdcscan set_config host:port to set scan name and port.

message: invalid argument: service string cannot be found
cause: The program attempted to access a nonexistent or deleted service.
solution: Check to make sure the service has been properly created.

message: Posting system alert with reason_id string failed with code [ string ] [ string ]
cause: Internal Error: An attempt to post a system alert failed.
solution: If this condition repeats, please contact Oracle Support.

message: Updating system alert with reason_id string failed; previous alert not found
cause: System Error: An attempt to update a system alert failed. The alert was improperly cleared from WRI$_ALERT_OUTSTANDING.
solution: Do not delete from WRI$_ALERT_OUTSTANDING. If this condition repeats, please contact Oracle Support.

message: The Director has blocked this instance. Cannot start [ string ]
cause: An attempt to start services on an instance that will be shutdown
solution: Start the services on another available instance

message: Session state not capturable due to reason ( string , string )
cause: Session state capture was initiated when session state could not be captured.
solution: Check session state status and make sure session state can be captured.

message: Session state capture or restore failed
cause: Capture or restore operation failed.
solution: Check session state status and failure reason for details.

message: Invalid session state operation
cause: Invalid session state operation was issued.
solution: Check if session status was valid for the current operation.

message: Session capture in progress
cause: Session state capture was initiated and could not perform the requested operation.
solution: Wait for the current capture to complete or abort it.

message: Invalid parameter for session state capture or restore
cause: Invalid parameter was passed to session state capture or restore interface.
solution: Correct the invalid parameter(s).

message: Session capture or restore internal error KPCSFR- string
cause: Internal operation error was encountered.
solution: Turn on related trace for details and report it as a bug.

message: Cannot restore session state due to reason ( string , string )
cause: Session state restore was initiated when session was not ready for state restore.
solution: Restore session state immediately after logging into a session or perform necessary operations to make the session ready for restore; for example, commit current transaction, or close BFiles.

message: OCI error during session state capture and restore
cause: An OCI operation failed during an internal operation of session state capture and restore.
solution: Check the OCI error signaled and take corrective action.

message: OCI operation failed at string due to ORA- string
cause: An OCI operation failed during an internal operation of session state capture and restore.
solution: Check the OCI error signaled and take corrective action.

message: Failed to resolve session state directory object
cause: Session state directory object passed to capture or restore was incorrect.
solution: Verify session state directory object and retry.

message: Failed to insert capture or restore record
cause: An error occurred while capture or restore record was being stored into the database.
solution: Check the error signaled and take corrective action.

message: Failed to restore session state from a file (error code number )
cause: Session state file may be corrupted.
solution: Ensure that the file is a session state file.

message: Failed to switch to new session in SSCR
cause: This is the generic internal error number for the SSCR exceptions. This indicates that the SSCR has encountered an exceptional condition.
solution: Report as a bug.

message: Failed to access session state file
cause: An error was encountered while reading from or writing to session state capture file.
solution: Check the error stack for the actual error number and turn on tracing if necessary.

message: Invalid session state file: string
cause: An invalid session state file was used in session state restore operation.
solution: Check if the session state file is a valid file created by session capture.

message: Package not supported: string
cause: The specified package is not supported.
solution: Do not call the package functions and procedures.

message: File driver is not initialized
cause: An attempt was made to operate on the uninitialized file driver.
solution: Initialize the file driver using the OCIServerAttach function.

message: failed to write data to file
cause: You may not have sufficient privileges or quotas for this action.
solution: Ensure that you have sufficient privileges and quotas for this action.

message: failed to read data from file

message: Failed to connect to file driver

message: Failed to open file

message: Bind character set ( string ) does not match database character set ( string )

message: Define character set ( string ) does not match database character set ( string )
cause: In this recursive OCI call, the define character set was different from the current database character set. This is usually caused by database character set change.
solution: Be sure to do redefine in the current environment.

message: insufficient privileges

message: cannot revoke a privilege that was not granted

message: rule class's action callback procedure may have errors

message: action preference name " string " collides with an event attribute name

message: specified rule does not exist

solution: Use a valid rule identifier.

message: rule manager feature currently not supported

message: invalid ordering property for the rule class

message: error in ordering property : string

solution: Make sure that the attributes listed in the ordering property are all part of the rule class/event structure definition with appropriate extended names.

message: invalid primitive event object in rule class properties : string

solution: Correct the name of the primitive event object in the rule class properties and try again.

message: conflicting values for autocommit and duration properties
cause: An attempt was made to create a rule class with autocommit enabled when the duration of events is set to TRANSACTION.
solution: Turn autocommit off or choose a different duration policy.

message: invalid duration policy for primitive object in a composite event
cause: An attempt was made to specify a SESSION or TRANSACTION duration policy for the primitive objects.
solution: Correct the rule class properties and try again.

message: event structure string does not exist
cause: The object type that represents the event structure was not created in the user's schema.
solution: Create the object type with the event structure's name and try again.

message: invalid XML element " string " in rule class properties
cause: An invalid XML element was used in the properties specification for the rule class.
solution: Use the correct (case-sensitive) tags in the properties.

message: event structure object type in inconsistent state
cause: The object type specified for the event structure was in an inconsistent state.
solution: Fix the object type and try again.

message: invalid usage of " string " attribute in " string " element
cause: An invalid or unsupported XML attribute was used in the rule class properties.
solution: Use the correct (case-sensitive) tags in the properties.

message: event structure for simple events cannot be reused for composite events
cause: An attempt was made to reuse an object type (event structure) for composite events when it is already configured for simple events.
solution: Drop the attribute set associated with the object and try again.

message: invalid value for " string " attribute in the rule class properties
cause: An invalid value was specified for an attribute in the rule class properties.
solution: Correct the value and try again.

message: invalid text node or child element for " string " element in properties
cause: An attempt was made to specify a child element or a text node in invalid position in the rule class properties specification.
solution: Correct the rule class properties and try again.

message: invalid value for the " string " attribute
cause: An attempt was made to assign an invalid value for an attribute in the rule class properties.
solution: See the documentation.

message: specified rule class configuration not supported: " string "
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported configuration for the rule class.
solution: Remove the specified tag in the properties and try again.

message: invalid duration specification in rule properties: " string "
cause: Invalid value was specified for the duration attribute in the rule class properties.
solution: Correct the value and try again.

message: invalid unit of time used in duration specification
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid unit of time for the rule class's duration specification. Valid units are : minutes, hours, and days.
solution: Correct the duration specification and try again.

message: invalid duration specification at the primitive event level
cause: An attempt was made to specify a duration policy for the primitive events when the composite event was configured with TRANSACTION or SESSION duration policy.
solution: Correct the rule class properties and try again.

message: missing primitive event name
cause: The name attribute of the object element in the rule class properties was not specified. This is a required value.
solution: Specify the name of the primitive event and try again.

message: invalid attribute for " string " element in rule condition
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid attribute for an XML element in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid child node in " string " element
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid child element or text node for an XML element in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid element " string " in the rule condition
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid element or a valid element in invalid position in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid or empty rule condition
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid or empty rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: Missing " string " element in the rule condition
cause: The rule condition was specified without a required element.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid attribute for the " string " element in the rule condition
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid attribute for an element in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid use of " string " attribute in rule condition
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid attribute for an element in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: duplicate tag " string " in rule condition
cause: An attempt was made to specify the same XML tag in more than one positions within a single rule condition.
solution: Remove the duplicate reference to the tag and try again.

message: missing " string " attribute for " string " element in the rule condition
cause: One of the required attributes was not specified in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: negation not allowed in rule conditions with "any" semantics
cause: An attempt was made to specify a "not" element within an "any" element in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid sequence of child elements in " string " element
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid sequence of elements within a parent element.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid rule condition for a rule class involving composite events
cause: An attempt was made to add an invalid rule condition to a rule set defined for composite events.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid composite event structure
cause: A composite event structure may only have attributes that are either table aliases or of an object type that is defined in the owner's schema.
solution: Ensure that the event structure has no scalar attributes and all the embedded types in it are defined in the owner's schema.

message: Event structure object type has one or more dependent objects
cause: An attempt was made to configure an object type that has one or more dependents as a event structure. The object type cannot be modified due to the dependent objects.
solution: Create a new object type for the event structure and try again.

message: invalid value for the equal attribute in the rule condition
cause: An invalid value is assigned to the equal attribute in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: inconsistent value for the "count" attribute of the "any" element
cause: The value specified for the "count" attribute of the "any" element is greater than or equal to the the number of primitive events appearing in the rule condition.
solution: Specify a smaller value for the "any" element's "count" attribute.

message: insufficient number of primitive events for the use of "sequence"
cause: An attempt was made to use "sequence" attribute when there is an insufficient number of primitive events in the rule conditions.
solution: Remove the sequence specification.

message: rule condition construct not supported: string
cause: An attempt was made to use a rule condition construct that is not supported in the current release.
solution: Modify the rule condition.

message: insufficient number of child elements in " string " element.
cause: An attempt was made to use fewer than two elements within an "and" or "notany" element.
solution: Specify at least two elements within the parent element.

message: rule class internal objects cannot be dropped
cause: An attempt was made to drop an internal object that is required for a rule class.
solution: Drop the rule class associated with this object.

message: invalid value for the "count" attribute in the "any" element
cause: An invalid value is assigned to the count attribute in the rule condition. The values should be a positive integer that is smaller than the number of object elements within the "any" element.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid primitive event " string " for the rule class
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid primitive event in a rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: ordering property for the rule class is too long
cause: An attempt was made to configure the rule class with an ordering property that is longer than 240 characters.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: the system generated rule class package has errors
cause: An attempt was made to use a rule class configuration that was not supported.
solution: File a bug.

message: number of primitive events in the composite event exceeds maximum limit
cause: An attempt was made to create a composite event structure with more than 32 primitive events.
solution: Use a composite event that consists of fewer primitive events.

message: invalid use of "equal" or "sequence" attribute with a single event
cause: An attempt was made to use "equal" or "sequence" attribute when the "count". attribute in a rule condition with "any" semantics is set to 1.
solution: Remove the "equal" and "sequence" specifications.

message: invalid consumption policy for the primitive event
cause: An attempt was made to use EXCLUSIVE consumption policy for a primitive event when the composite event is configured for RULE consumption policy.
solution: Correct the rule class properties and try again.

message: conflicting values for duration, consumption, and autocommit policies
cause: An attempt was made to use an EXCLUSIVE consumption policy with no autocommit and a duration other than TRANSACTION or SESSION.
solution: Modify the rule class properties and try again. Autocommit should be set to YES when the consumption policy is EXCLUSIVE.

message: XML schema validation failed when validating against string
cause: The user input has undefined element or attribute according to the provided XML schema definition.
solution: Correct the user inputs and try again.

message: rule class results view name already used for an existing object
cause: An attempt was made to use a duplicate name for the rule class results view.
solution: Use a different name for the rule class results view.

message: invalid operation for the rule class
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid operation for the rule class.
solution: No action necessary. This is an informational message only.

message: invalid list of primitive event identifiers
cause: An attempt was made to pass an empty list of primitive event identifiers to the CONSUME_PRIM_EVENTS API.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: duplicate or invalid event name in equal specification
cause: An attempt was made to specify a duplicate or invalid primitive event for the rule class's equal property.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: duplicate table names in the event structure with table aliases
cause: The table used for an event structure has the same name as another table or a primitive event type in the event structure.
solution: Use an event structure with distinct table names for table aliases.

message: invalid rowid passed in for " string " table
cause: An attempt was made to pass a NULL or invalid rowid for a table in the event structure.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: sequence attribute not allowed in rule conditions using table aliases
cause: An attempt was made to use sequence attribute in a rule condition that is defined using table aliases. Sequence usage is not permitted for the lack of timestamp attribute.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: dmlevents policy allowed only for event structures with table aliases
cause: An attempt was made to use the dmlevents policy for an event structure with no table alias constructs.
solution: Correct the rule class properties and try again.

message: schema for data tables does not match that of the rule class
cause: An attempt was made to use the dmlevents policy for a rule class that refers to table residing in different schema. To use the dmlevents policy, the table associated with table aliases in the event structure and the rule class should exist in the same schema.
solution: Remove dmlevents specification from rule class properties.

message: invalid use of dmlevents policy for primitive event
cause: An attempt was made to use the dmlevents policy for a primitive event defined with more than one table alias attribute.
solution: Remove the dmlevents specification from the rule class properties.

message: DML event trigger creation failed with string
cause: Triggers could not be created on the data table to track DML events.
solution: Remove the dmlevents specification from the rule class properties.

message: conflicting values for the autocommit and dmlevents policies
cause: An attempt was made to use dmlevents policy in combination with autocommit set to YES. This combination is not allowed.
solution: Set autocommit to NO and try again.

message: dmlevents specification only allowed with table alias attributes
cause: An attempt was made to use the dmlevents policy for an event structure not containing any table alias attributes.
solution: Remove the dmlevents specification from the rule class properties.

message: Rules Manager background process string does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to use a Scheduler process that does not exist.
solution: Execute EXFSYS.RLM$CREATE_SCHEDULER_JOBS procedure as a privileged user.

message: clean up of expired events failed
cause: The background process that cleans up the expired events failed for a rule class.
solution: Invoke EXFSYS.DBMS_RLMGR_UTL.CLEANUP_EVENTS API for the exact nature of the problem.

message: invalid rule class package
cause: An attempt was made to use a rule class package with invalid signature or permissions.
solution: Drop the rule class and recreate it.

message: unable to lock a rule in the rule class
cause: A rule matching the current event is locked by another session.
solution: Reissue the command after committing the other sessions.

message: invalid value for the RLM$ENABLED column
cause: An attempt was made to insert or update a value other than 'Y' or 'N' into the RLM$ENABLED column of a rule class table.
solution: Retry the DML statement with a value of 'Y' or 'N' for the RLM$ENABLED column.

message: invalid window specification for the collection element
cause: An invalid attribute value was specified for the "windowlen" or the "windowsize" attribute. The value specified for the "windowlen" attribute should be a number indicating the number of days or a fraction of a day. The value specified for the "windowsize" attribute should be an integer which indicates number of items in the collection. The maximum value allowed for the window specification is 64000.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: use of "collection" invalid for the primitive event
cause: An attempt was made to define a rule condition with "collection" element when the corresponding event was not configured for collections of events.
solution: Correct the rule condition and try again.

message: attribute " string " not allowed in the "groupby" specification
cause: The attributes listed in the "groupby" specification in a rule condition were not a subset of the attributes specified in the rule class properties.
solution: Correct the "groupby" specification for the rule condition and try again.

message: invalid value for the "groupby" attribute
cause: An invalid value was specified for the "groupby" attribute.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid collection specification in the rule condition
cause: An attempt was made to insert a rule condition with invalid collection element specification.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: maximum number of grouping expressions for a rule class exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to specify more than 32 expressions for the "groupby" clause in rule class properties.
solution: Use fewer than 32 expressions for the "groupby" clause.

message: invalid aggregate specification: string
cause: The aggregate operation specified in the rule condition was invalid.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: unsupported aggregate operator in the having/compute clause: string
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported aggregate operator in the having or the compute clause in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid attribute or data type for an aggregate operator: string
cause: An attempt was made to apply an aggregate operator on an invalid attribute or an attribute with invalid or unsupported data type in the aggregate operator. Only NUMBER and DATE attributes are allowed in the aggregate operators.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid equal specification around: string
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid equal clause for a rule condition or the rule class properties.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: equal specification should have a minimum of two elements
cause: An attempt was made to specify fewer than two elements in the equal clause for a rule condition or the rule class properties.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid operator in the having clause: string
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid relational operator in the having clause of the rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: attribute prefix missing in aggregate specification: string
cause: An attempt was made to specify an aggregate predicate across multiple primitive event types with no attribute prefix.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid use of " string " attribute in aggregate predicate
cause: An attempt was made to use an attribute where a literal is expected in the aggregate predicate in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: maximum number of aggregate operations per rule condition exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to specify more than 5 aggregate operations in a rule condition.
solution: Correct the input an try again.

message: a conditions table already exists for the event structure
cause: A table storing the primitive rule conditions was already assigned to the event structure.
solution: No action necessary. This is an informational message only.

message: conditions table with a rule class association cannot be truncated or dropped
cause: An attempt was made to truncate or drop a conditions table when one or more rule classes are associated to it through the event structure.
solution: Drop the rule class before truncating or dropping the conditions table.

message: invalid conditions table
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid conditions table.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid child node in "object" element with "ref" attribute
cause: An attempt was made to use both a condition and a "ref" attribute in the "object" element.
solution: Remove the "ref" attribute.

message: invalid condition reference: " string "
cause: An attempt was made to use a reference to a nonexistent conditions table or a condition.
solution: Ensure that the conditions table exists for the primitive event and the value specified for the "ref" attribute of the "object" element is valid.

message: conditions table cannot be dropped with DROP TABLE command
cause: An attempt was made to drop a conditions table with a DROP TABLE command.
solution: Use DBMS_RLMGR.DROP_CONDITIONS_TABLE instead.

message: a condition referenced in rule conditions may not be deleted
cause: An attempt was made to delete a condition when one or more rule conditions refer to it.
solution: Delete the rules before deleting the conditions.

message: unsupported construct with collection events: " string "
cause: An attempt was made to define a collection rule condition with unsupported constructs.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: the identifier for the shared condition may not be modified
cause: An attempt was made to update the identifier of a row stored in the conditions table.
solution: Insert a row with the new identifier instead.

message: invalid use of aggregate operator for a noncollection event
cause: An attempt was made to specify an aggregate operator on an event that is not identified as collection.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid attribute in the rule condition's having clause
cause: An invalid attribute is used in the specification for the having clause of the rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: missing groupby specification for the collection " string "
cause: An attempt was made to use a collection element with no groupby specification in the rule condition.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid use of "windowlen" and "windowsize" attributes
cause: An attempt was made to use the windowlen and windowsize attributes within the same collection element.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: invalid use of window specification with SESSION/TRANSACTION duration
cause: An attempt was made to use the windowlen or windowsize attributes when the events are configured for SESSION or TRANSACTION duration.
solution: Remove the window specification and try again.

message: invalid use of DMLEVENTS and CNFEVENTS in rule class properties
cause: An attempt was made to specify both the DMLEVENTS and CNFEVENTS for the same rule class.
solution: Remove either the DMLEVENTS or the CNFEVENTS specification.

message: insufficient privileges for database change notification
cause: An attempt was made to use CNFEVENTS property with insufficient privileges.
solution: Grant CHANGE NOTIFICATION privilege and EXECUTE privilege on DBMS_CHANGE_NOTIFICATION to the user and try again.

message: invalid online redefinition column mapping for table " string "." string "
cause: An attempt was made to change the logical structure of a materialized view log, queue table, or a partition by specifying a non-NULL column mapping during online redefinition.
solution: Pass a NULL column mapping parameter.

message: online redefinition options require COMPATIBLE parameter to be string or greater
cause: The following types of redefinition require a 10.2 or higher compatibility setting: o redefining a materialized view log o redefining a table with objects o redefining a clustered table o redefining an AQ queue table o redefining a table partition The following types of redefinition require an 11.0 or higher compatibility setting: o redefining a table with a materialized view log o redefining a table with dependent materialized views
solution: Shut down and restart with an appropriate compatibility setting.

message: partition " string " of table " string "." string " not being redefined
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a partition which is not involved in this redefinition.
solution: Pass a valid partition name.

message: partition must be specified for this redefinition
cause: A partition was involved in this redefinition but was not specified.
solution: Specify the partition involved in this redefinition.

message: redefinition not instantiated
cause: An attempt was made to complete an instantiation-deferred redefinition without invoking dbms_redefinition.sync_interim_table.
solution: Invoke dbms_redefinition.sync_interm_table to instantiate this redefinition.

message: invalid type of redefinition method
cause: An unknown redefinition method was used.
solution: Use one of the supported redefinition methods: o dbms_redefinition.cons_use_pk o dbms_redefinition.cons_use_rowid

message: dependent object registration not supported during a partition redefinition
cause: An attempt was made to register dependent objects when redefining a partition.
solution: Do not invoke dbms_redefinition.register_dependent_object during a partition redefinition.

message: dependent object unregistration not supported during a partition redefinition
cause: An attempt was made to unregister dependent objects when redefining a partition.
solution: Do not invoke dbms_redefinition.unregister_dependent_object during a partition redefinition.

message: error occurred while instantiating the redefinition
cause: An error occurred while instantiating the online redefinition which requires aborting the redefinition.
solution: Correct the error, abort, and restart the online redefinition.

message: error occurred while synchronizing the redefinition
cause: An error occurred while synchronizing the online redefinition.
solution: Correct the error and continue the online redefinition.

message: error occurred while synchronizing the redefinition
cause: An error occurred while synchronizing the online redefinition which requires aborting the redefinition.
solution: Correct the error, abort, and restart the online redefinition.

message: error occurred while completing the redefinition
cause: An error occurred while completing the online redefinition.
solution: Correct the error and continue the online redefinition.

message: error occurred while completing the redefinition
cause: An error occurred while completing the online redefinition which requires aborting the redefinition.
solution: Correct the error, abort, and restart the online redefinition.

message: interim table of an AQ IOT table should be an IOT table
cause: An attempt was made to create a table that is not an index-organized table (IOT) as the interim table of an AQ IOT table (history, time management, or dequeue).
solution: Ensure that the interim table is created as an IOT table.

message: online redefinition unable to lock AQ objects
cause: An online redefinition of an AQ table was unable to lock all related AQ objects.
solution: Abort and retry the redefinition.

message: online redefinition unable to log changes made to AQ tables
cause: An online redefinition of an AQ table was unable to log changes made to AQ tables during the redefinition.
solution: Abort and retry the redefinition.

message: shape of interim table does not match specified column mapping
cause: The number of columns, or the type or the length semantics of a column, in the interim table did not match the specified column mapping.
solution: Ensure that the interim table matches the column mapping by either modifying the column mapping string or altering the interim table's column definition(s).

message: interim table of an AQ table should not be an AQ table
cause: An attempt was made to create an AQ table as an interim table of an online redefined AQ table.
solution: Ensure that the interim table is not created as an AQ table.

message: partition cannot be redefined online because of index organization incompatibility
cause: interim table is incompatible with partition being redefined because one or more of the following apply: - one is index-organized and the other is not - one has IOT overflow segment and the other does not - one has IOT mapping table and the other does not
solution: Ensure that the interim table is compatible with the partition being redefined.

message: partition cannot be redefined online because of incompatible partitioning of interim table
cause: both original and interim tables are partitioned, or original table is composite-partitioned but interim table is non-partitioned.
solution: Ensure that the interim table has compatible partitioning with the original table. For example, if the original table is partitioned, the interim table should be non-partitioned. If the original table is composite-partitioned, the interim table should be partitioned.

message: partition cannot be redefined online because of unsupported type of interim table
cause: An unsupported type of interim table was provided during the partition redefinition. Currently the following types of interim tables are not supported: - a nested table or has nested-table columns - an external table - part of cluster - contains LOB shared segments
solution: Do not use unsupported types of interim tables.

message: partition cannot be redefined online because of incompatible row dependencies
cause: original/interim table was created with row dependency and interim/original table was not.
solution: Ensure that both tables are created with same row dependency properties.

message: partition cannot be redefined online because of presence of nested columns
cause: An attempt was made to online redefine a partition with nested table columns.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a partition with nested table columns.

message: compatibility of AQ table must be release 8.1.x or later
cause: An attempt was made to perform online redefinition on an AQ table that was created with compatibility prior to release 8.1.x.
solution: Ensure that the AQ table is created with the COMPATIBLE parameter set to release 8.1.x or later before attempting online redefinition.

message: interim table of an AQ table can not be a partitioned table
cause: An attempt was made to use a partitioned table as an interim table.
solution: Ensure that the interim table is not a partitioned table.

message: redefinition of CONS_USE_ROWID method cannot be used to redefine an AQ IOT table
cause: An attempt was made to use method of DBMS_REDEFINITION.CONS_USE_ROWID to redefine an AQ IOT table.
solution: Ensure that method of DBMS_REDEFINITION.CONS_USE_PK is used to redefine an AQ IOT table.

message: duplicated rows detected while instantiating the redefinition
cause: Duplicated rows are detected during instantiation of the redefinition.
solution: Abort the redefinition, turn off the optimistic ascending SCN optimization, and restart the redefinition.

message: cannot redefine an object online that is not a table
cause: An attempt was made to redefine an object online that is not a table.
solution: Ensure that the object being redefined online is a table.

message: materialized view log " string "." string " does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to register a nonexistent materialized view log as a dependent object.
solution: Invoke DBMS_REDEFINITION.REGISTER_DEPENDENT_OBJECT on a valid materialized view log.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " at this time
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table which is incompatible with another ongoing redefinition.
solution: Do not perform the redefinition operation on this table or wait until the incompatible ongoing redefinition has completed.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " with commit SCN-based MV log
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table which had a commit SCN-based materialzed view log defined on it.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table that has a commit SCN-based materialzed view log defined on it.

message: interim table cannot have a commit SCN-based MV log defined on it
cause: An attempt was made to use an interim table which had a commit SCN-based materialzed view log defined on it.
solution: Ensure that the interim table does not have a commit SCN-based materialzed view log defined on it.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " with Flashback Data Archive enabled
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table which had Flashback Data Archive enabled.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table that has Flashback Data Archive enabled.

message: interim table " string "." string " cannot have Flashback Data Archive enabled
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table with an interim table which had Flashback Data Archive enabled.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table with an interim table which has Flashback Data Archive enabled.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " which was a CDC table
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table which was a CDC table.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table that was a CDC table.

message: cannot online redefine IOT table " string "." string " with CONS_USE_ROWID
cause: An attempt was made to redefine an IOT table with CONS_USE_ROWID.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine an IOT table with CONS_USE_ROWID.

message: cannot online redefine temporary table " string "." string "
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a temporary table.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a temporary table.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " with IOT overflow segment
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table with IOT overflow segment.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table with IOT overflow segment.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " with a CDC log defined on it
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table on which a CDC log was defined.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table on which a CDC log was defined.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " with FGA or RLS enabled
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table with Fine Grained Auditing (FGA) or Row Level Security (RLS) enabled.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table with Fine Grained Auditing (FGA) or Row Level Security (RLS) enabled.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " with column of binary XML type
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table with a column of binary XML type.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table with a column of binary XML type.

message: cannot online redefine table " string "." string " with nested table columns
cause: An attempt was made to redefine a table with nested table columns.
solution: Do not attempt to online redefine a table with nested table columns.

message: cannot rename user on whose type a table depends
cause: An attempt was made to rename a user whose schema contained a type on which some table depends. The operation may not proceed as it would render the table invalid causing loss of data.
solution: Drop table(s) dependent on types belonging to the schema of the user being renamed.

message: may not create a schema synonym for the specified schema
cause: An attempt was made to create a schema synonym for one of the reserved schemas (such as SYS or SYSTEM.)
solution: Schema synonyms for this schema may not be created.

message: may not rename specified user
cause: An attempt was made to rename one of the reserved users (such as SYS or SYSTEM) or an administrative user.
solution: This user may not be renamed.

message: specified schema does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to create a schema synonym for a schema which did not exist.
solution: Correct the input and try again.

message: schema synonym ' string ' does not exist
cause: The named schema synonym did not exist.
solution: Verify you are using the correct schema synonym name.

message: RENAME TO already specified
cause: The RENAME TO clause was specified twice.
solution: Use only one RENAME TO clause.

message: user name conflicts with another user, role or schema synonym name
cause: There was already a user, role or schema synonym with that name.
solution: Specify a different user name.

message: role name conflicts with another user, role or schema synonym name
cause: There was already a user, role or schema synonym with that name.
solution: Specify a different role name.

message: schema synonym name conflicts with another user, role or schema synonym name
cause: There was already a user, role or schema synonym with that name.
solution: Specify a different schema synonym name or use CREATE OR REPLACE SCHEMA SYNONYM.

message: user, role or schema synonym ' string ' does not exist
cause: There was no user, role, or schema synonym by that name.
solution: Respecify the name.

message: cannot drop a schema synonym for a schema of a user who is currently connected
cause: An attempt was made to drop a schema synonym for a schema of a user who was logged on.
solution: Make sure user is logged off, then repeat command.

message: cannot rename a user that is currently connected
cause: An attempt was made to rename a user that was logged on.
solution: Make sure user is logged off, then repeat command.

message: an Editioning view is already defined on this table
cause: An attempt was made to create an Editioning view on a table on which another Editioning view is already defined in the same Edition. This violates a restriction that at most one Editioning view may be associated with any base table in a given Edition.
solution: Create the new view as a regular view or, if the view being created is really intended to be an Editioning view associated with this table, drop the existing Editioning view before creating the new one.

message: definition of an Editioning view may not refer to a synonym
cause: An attempt was made to create an Editioning view referring to a synonym, which is not supported.
solution: Do not create an Editioning view if you want the view to refer to a synonym.

message: definition of an Editioning view may not refer to remote tables
