cause: An attempt was made to create an Editioning view referring to remote tables, which is not supported.
solution: Do not create an Editioning view if you want the view to refer to a remote table.

message: duplicate column reference in a definition of an Editioning view
cause: An attempt was made create an Editioning view referencing the same column of a base table more than once, which is not supported.
solution: Do not create an Editioning view if you have multiple columns referring to the same column of the base table.

message: base table and the Editioning view must belong to the same schema
cause: An attempt was made to create an Editioning view in a schema different from that of the base table.
solution: Create an Editioning view in the same schema as the base table.

message: only an Editioning view may replace an Editioning view
cause: An attempt was made to replace an Editioning view with a view which is not an Editioning view or vice versa.
solution: Ensure that either both or neither of the views involved are Editioning views.

message: a CrossEdition trigger may not be created on an Editioning view
cause: An attempt was made to create a CrossEdition trigger on an Editioning view, which is not supported.
solution: Instead of creating a CrossEdition trigger on an Editioning view, create it on the Editioning view's underlying table.

message: columns of an Editioning view may only refer to base table columns
cause: An attempt was made to define an Editioning view containing a column referring to an entity other than a base table column (for example, a PL/SQL function without a parameter), which is not supported.
solution: Ensure that every column of an Editioning view refers to a column of a base table.

message: view string . string is already in read-only mode
cause: An attempt was made to set a read-only table in read-only mode.
solution: This DDL can only be executed on a read/write view.

message: view string . string is already in read/write mode
cause: An attempt was made to set a read/write view in read/write mode.
solution: This DDL can only be executed on a read-only view.

message: Implementation restriction: this operation is only permitted on Editioning views
cause: The view being altered was not an Editioning view. In this release, an ALTER VIEW READ ONLY, or ALTER VIEW READ WRITE operation is only permitted on Editioning views.
solution: Ensure that the view is an Editioning view.

message: This operation is not permitted on Editioning views with compilation errors
cause: ALTER VIEW READ ONLY and ALTER VIEW READ WRITE are not permitted on Editioning views which have compilation errors.
solution: Resolve the compilation errors.

message: This operation is not supported on Editioning views marked invalid
cause: ALTER VIEW READ ONLY and ALTER VIEW READ WRITE are not permitted on Editioning views which are marked invalid.
solution: Recompile the Editioning view to ensure that it is valid.

message: editioning view cannot be owned by a non-editioned user
cause: An attempt was made to create an editioning view in a non-editioned schema.
solution: Enable editions for the user and then create the editioning view.

message: cannot perform a DML operation on a read-only view
cause: An attempt was made to insert, delete, or update row(s) of a view created with read-only option. DML operations on such views are explicitly prohibited.
solution: Perform the desired DML operation on the view's underlying base table or issue ALTER VIEW ... READ WRITE command to make the view updatable.

message: Cannot use bind variable in VERSIONS clause when the object has a Row-Level Security (RLS) policy defined on it.
cause: The object being accessed had a Row-Level Security (RLS) policy defined on it and the VERSIONS clause contained a bind variable.
solution: Rewrite the query without the bind variable in the VERSIONS clause.

message: pkcs11 library not found
cause: The PKCS11 library could not be found.
solution: Make sure that the pkcs11 library is at the location specified in the wallet.

message: pkcs11 token not found
cause: The PKCS11 token could not be found.
solution: Make sure that a token with correct label is present in slot.

message: pkcs11 passphrase is wrong
cause: The PKCS11 passphrase is wrong.
solution: Make sure that the token passphrase specified is correct.

message: pkcs11: No tokens present
cause: a token is not present in the slot
solution: Place a pkcs11 token in the slot

message: pkcs11: Token login failed
cause: To login to the pkcs11 token a correct passphrase is needed
solution: Check the token passphrase.

message: pkcs11: finding private key on token error
cause: error occurred while finding private key on token
solution: Make sure the private key corresponding to the certificate in wallet is on the token. Check trace message

message: pkcs11: key pair gen error
cause: error occurred while generating key pair using HSM
solution: Check trace message

message: pkcs11: No certificate found on the smart card/HSM
cause: No certificate was found on the smart card/HSM.
solution: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to populate the smart card/HSM with certificate.

message: pkcs11: No user certificate found on the smart card/HSM
cause: No user certificate was found on the smart card/HSM.
solution: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to populate the smart card/HSM with certificate and private key.

message: pkcs11: No certificate found on smart card/HSM label with given cert label
cause: There were no certificate labels on the smart card/HSM that matched the certificate label specified in the wallet.
solution: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to set certificate label in smart card/HSM.

message: pkcs11: Multiple certificates found on smart card/HSM with given cert label
cause: Certificates with identical labels were found in the smart card/HSM.
solution: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to assign unique certificate labels to certificates.

message: pkcs11: Certificate with given cert label is not a user cert
cause: The certificate with the specified certificate label did not have a matching private key in the smart card/HSM.
solution: Follow smart card/HSM vendor instructions to create credentials (certificate/private key) in smart card/HSM.

message: invalid or illegal combination of COMMIT WRITE options
cause: invalid or illegal combination of options provided to COMMIT WRITE SQL statement.
solution: Provide a valid combination of options for COMMIT WRITE statement

message: invalid value for parameter string
cause: invalid or illegal value provided for parameter.
solution: Provide a valid value for the parameter

message: indexes on ORA_ROWSCN not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to create an index that refers to the ORA_ROWSCN pseudo-column, either directly or in an expression.
solution: Do not use ORA_ROWSCN to define an index on a table.

message: DROP INDEX is invalid for hash cluster index
cause: An attempt was made to drop an index defined on a hash cluster. Hash cluster indexes cannot be dropped.
solution: Do not attempt to drop an index defined on a hash cluster.

message: Advanced Compression Option parameter is required to be enabled
cause: An Advanced Compression Option (ACO) feature was specified without enabling the ACO parameter.
solution: Set or Update the ACO parameter (enable_option_advanced_compression) to TRUE.

message: LOB feature unsupported below compatible 11.0.0
cause: An 11g LOB feature was specified when the RDBMS is operating at a compatible setting lower than "11.0.0".
solution: Upgrade the RDBMS compatible setting to "11.0.0" or higher to enable the desired new features.

message: SECUREFILE and BASICFILE cannot be used together
cause: SECUREFILE and BASICFILE were both specified.
solution: Modify the SQL statement to specifiy only one of SECUREFILE or BASICFILE.

message: SECUREFILE lobs cannot be used in non-ASSM tablespace " string "
cause: SECUREFILE lobs require ASSM
solution: Specify an ASSM tablespace for SECUREFILE lobs. 43854, 0000, "Deprecated"

message: Unsupported LOB type for SECUREFILE LOB operation
cause: A LOB that is not a SECUREFILE was used in a SQL statement or in a call where a SECUREFILE LOB was expected.
solution: Convert the LOB to a SECUREFILE LOB or do not use this keyword or call.

message: Parameter Error
cause: Attempt to modify a LOB with an invalid parameter.
solution: Fix paramters and retry the operation.

message: CONTENTTYPE string too long
cause: Length of CONTENTTYPE string exceeded the defined maximum.
solution: Modify length of CONTENTTYPE string and retry operation.

message: CONTENTTYPE buffer length incorrect
cause: Length of CONTENTTYPE buffer less than defined constant.
solution: Modify length of CONTENTTYPE buffer and retry operation.

message: LOB feature unsupported below compatible setting 11.2.0
cause: An 11.2 LOB feature was specified when the database was operating at a compatible setting lower than "11.2.0".
solution: Upgrade the database compatible setting to "11.2.0" or higher to enable the desired new features.

message: SECUREFILE LOBs delta update invalid operation
cause: Invalid delta update operation was issued on LOB. This includes operation beyond LOB length; move operation with destination offset inside move interval.
solution: Check operation parameters for validity.

message: invalid schema
cause: The schema for the given schema name did not exist.
solution: Provide a valid schema name.

message: invalid object name
cause: The input parameter string was not a qualified SQL identifier of an existing SQL object.
solution: Make sure the string matches an existing SQL object that is accessible by the current schema.

message: invalid SQL name
cause: The input parameter string was not a valid simple SQL name.
solution: Check with the DBMS_ASSERT spec to verify that the parameter string is a valid simple SQL name.

message: invalid qualified SQL name
cause: The input parameter string was not a valid qualified SQL name.
solution: Check with the DBMS_ASSERT spec to verify that the parameter string is a valid qualified SQL name.

message: invalid priority
cause: The priority level given by the user was invalid.
solution: See UTL_MAIL for valid priority values and change the priority parameter accordingly.

message: timeout waiting for lock on cursor
cause: A timeout occured while waiting for a cursor to be compiled. This is usually caused by the SQL parse requiring access to system resources which are locked by concurrently executing sessions.
solution: Investigate possible causes of resource contention. If neccessary, contact support for additional information on how to diagnose this problem.

message: library cache object string . string found in an in-flux state
cause: The pseudo-cursor depends on a table which was found to be obsolete due to metadata invalidation of the library cache object.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services for additional information.

message: NULL service name is not permitted
cause: The service name argument was found to be NULL.
solution: Provide a non-NULL service name.

message: NULL network name is not permitted
cause: The network name argument was found to be NULL.
solution: Provide a non-NULL network name.

message: service name exists
cause: This service name was already in existence.
solution: Provide a new unique service name.

message: service string does not exist
cause: The specified service was not in existence.
solution: Provide a valid service name.

message: service string is running
cause: The specified service was running.
solution: This message is informational only.

message: service name exceeds maximum length of string
cause: The service name was too long.
solution: Use a shorter service name.

message: network name too long
cause: The network name, excluding the domain, was too long.
solution: Use a shorter network name.

message: maximum number of services exceeded
cause: The maximum number of services has been reached.
solution: None

message: service string not running
cause: The specified service was not running.
solution: This message is informational only.

message: database closed
cause: The database was closed.
solution: Open the database and retry the operation.

message: instance name invalid
cause: The instance name argument was not valid.
solution: Provide a valid instance name.

message: network name already exists
cause: The network name was already in existence.
solution: Use an alternate network name.

message: all service attributes null
cause: All attributes specified were null.
solution: At least one attribute must be non-null.

message: invalid argument
cause: Invalid argument supplied.
solution: Supply a valid argument.

message: database open read-only
cause: The database is open read-only.
solution: Close the database and reopen it read/write before trying again.

message: exceeded maximum SERVICE_NAMES length
cause: The total length of all running service network names exceeded the maximum allowable length.
solution: Stop another service to start this one.

message: Cannot delete AQ service
cause: Specified AQ service belonged to a queue.
solution: Delete the queue.

message: cannot read command line from trace file string
cause: Trace file could not be read.
solution: Make sure trace file exists and contains valid raw trace data.

message: invalid file name ' string '
cause: A NULL or zero length file name was specified.
solution: Correct the file name to be a nonzero length string.

message: negative <count> ' string ' to string option
cause: The given count was a nonpositive number.
solution: Provide a positive count number.

message: no <count> argument to string option
cause: Count number was missing for the option.
solution: Provide a count number to the option.

message: no entry points found in trace file string
cause: The given trace symbol was not found.
solution: None

message: no <symbol> argument to string option
cause: <symbol> argument to -[un]trace option was missing.
solution: Provide <symbol> argument to -[un]trace option.

message: no <filename> argument to string option
cause: <filename> argument to the option was missing.
solution: Provide <filename> argument to the option.

message: unsupported version number: string
cause: Version of the trace file was not supported.
solution: Provide supported version of trace file.

message: invalid value specified for flag parameter
cause: Mutually exclusive values were specified for the flag parameter.
solution: Internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: upicui2 client function requires Oracle server of 10.2 or higher
cause: A 10.2 or higher client is being used with an older Oracle server.
solution: Use an Oracle server with the same version as the client.

message: Invalid ACL: START_DATE cannot be larger than END_DATE for all ACE
cause: The END_DATE was smaller than the START_DATE in one of the ACE's in this ACL.
solution: Set all END_DATE to be larger than or equal to the START_DATE in each of the ACE's in this ACL.

message: Invalid ACL: Cyclic ACL inheritance is not allowed
cause: A cycle was formed by ACL inheritance.
solution: Check the ACL inheritance and break the cycle by removing some ACL inheritance.GG function exceeds system limits.

message: Invalid ACL: Security class of parent ACL must be an ancestor of security class of child ACL
cause: Security class of parent ACL was not an ancestor of security class of child ACL
solution: Change the security class of parent ACL to be an ancestor of security class of child ACL.

message: Invalid ACL: Parent ACL ' string ' does not exist
cause: The path to the parent ACL was not a valid resource.
solution: Change the parent ACL of this resource or create the parent ACL at the specified location.

message: Invalid ACL: Undefined privileges
cause: An undefined privilege was found in an ACE in the ACL.
solution: Make sure the privilege is defined in the security class as specified in the ACL.

message: Invalid ACL: Unresolved principal ' string '
cause: An unresolved principal is found in an ACE in the ACL.
solution: Make sure the principal is a valid user or role in the system.

message: Invalid ACL: Invalid ACLID
cause: The specified ACLID did not point to a valid ACL document.
solution: Make sure the ACLID points to a valid ACL document.

message: Invalid ACL: string
cause: The specified ACL did not meet the validation requirements of the constraining ACL.
solution: Ensure ACL meets the validation requirements of the constraining ACL.

message: cannot DISALLOW NONSCHEMA without a SCHEMA clause
cause: If no SCHEMA clause (explicit schema or ANYSCHEMA) was specified, nonschema data cannot be disallowed.
solution: Remove DISALLOW NONSCHEMA or add some SCHEMA clause.

message: nonschema XML disallowed for this column
cause: An attempt was made to insert nonschema based XML documents in a binary XML column that disallows nonschema data.
solution: Insert only schema-based documents or alter the column to ALLOW NONSCHEMA data.

message: XML Schema registered for BINARY cannot be used for CLOB/OBJ-REL
cause: An attempt was made to use a XML Schema registered for binary usage as part of a CLOB or OBJ-REL clause.
solution: Specify a schema registered for CLOB or OBJ-REL use. Else specify BINARY XML storage for column.

message: BINARY XML storage requires XML Schema registered for BINARY usage
cause: An attempt was made to specify BINARY XML storage using an XML schema not registered for BINARY.
solution: Specify a schema registered for BINARY usage. Else specify CLOB or OBJ-REL storage for column.

message: XML DB needs to be installed for creating an XMLType table or column
cause: An attempt was made to create an XMLType table or column with out XML DB installed.
solution: Install XML DB.

message: QMEL: Too much concurrency.
cause: Too much concurrency
solution: Transient error, try again.

message: QMEL: Lock not found.
cause: Lock not found
solution: Check arguments

message: QMEL: Lock Denied.
cause: Lock denied
solution: None

message: Resource Locked by Implicit Lock
cause: The resource is locked by an implicit lock
solution: Implicit locks are normally caused by NFS locks. Refer to XDB Protocol guide for removing/obtaining information about implicit locks.

message: QMEL: Invalid arguments.
cause: Arguments to QMEL are not correct.
solution: None

message: Language ' string ' is not a valid language for a translation
cause: Invalid language.
solution: The language must conform to IETF RFC 3066.

message: Language not found for translation
cause: The document had multiple translations and one of them did not have the xml:lang attribute.
solution: All translations must have the xml:lang attribute when multiple translations are present.

message: Multiple translations found for language ' string '
cause: The document had multiple translations for a language.
solution: The document must contain only one translation per language for every translated element.

message: Multiple source language translations found
cause: The document had multiple source language translations.
solution: The document must contain only one source language translation for every translated element.

message: XPath ' string ' does not uniquely identify a translated element
cause: The given XPath pointed to multiple translated elements.
solution: The given XPath must uniquely identify a translated element.

message: Must have xdb:maxOccurs='1' for translated elements
cause: The value of xdb:maxOccurs was not '1' for a translated element.
solution: The value of xdb:maxOccurs must be '1' for a translated element.

message: Must have xsd:maxOccurs='unbounded' for translated elements
cause: The value of xsd:maxOccurs was not 'unbounded' for a translated element.
solution: The value of xsd:maxOccurs must be 'unbounded' for a translated element.

message: No source language translation found
cause: The document had no source language translation for a translated element.
solution: The document must contain exactly one source language translation for every translated element.

message: Translations not supported for object relational storage
cause: The storage type of the schema was object relational.
solution: Register the schema with storage type as clob or binary xml.

message: Invalid schema definition for translated element
cause: The schema definition for a translated element was invalid.
solution: A translated element must be a complex type with simple content which is a restriction or extension of xs:string.

message: Malformed XLIFF document: string
cause: The XLIFF document was malformed.
solution: Fix the error and try again.

message: XPath refers to an untranslatable element
cause: XPath pointed to an untranslatable element.
solution: XPath for this operation must refer to a translatable element.

message: Invalid XPath in XLIFF document used for merging
cause: XPath within trans-unit/id attribute was invalid.
solution: XPath within trans-unit/id attribute must point to a set of translations, not to a particular translation.

message: XPath does not select all translations
cause: XPath did not select all translations for a particular element.
solution: XPath must point to a set of translations, not to a particular translation.

message: XML Index string is not usable at the moment
cause: The async XML Index could not be used since ORACLE is not open for query.
solution: Try the same query again when ORACLE is open for query, or use NO_XMLINDEX_REWRITE hint.

message: Path string cannot be removed from the repository XML Index
cause: The repository XML Index indexed one of the parent folders of the resource identified by given path.
solution: Try removing the parent folder from the repository XML Index.

message: Path string cannot be removed from the repository XML Index
cause: The repository XML Index did not index the resource identified by given path.
solution: Try removing a resource that is indexed by the repository XML Index.

message: The repository XML Index cannot be dropped directly
cause: DROP INDEX could not be used on the repository XML Index.
solution: Try using DBMS_XDB_ADMIN.DROPREPOSITORYXMLINDEX.

message: Predicate Index on nodes with similar children not allowed
cause: There was at least one node in the document with multiple similar children which was used in Predicate Indexing.
solution: Try removing Predicate Index on nodes with multiple similar children.

message: Too many predicates
cause: Number of predicates were more than limit.
solution: Try reducing number of predicates.

message: Group name already existed
cause: The group name specified already exists.
solution: Try a different group name.

message: Parameter string did not exist.
cause: The parameter name specified did not exist.
solution: Check the parameter name.

message: Group string did not exist.
cause: The group name specified did not exist.
solution: Check the group name.

message: Cannot drop the last group.
cause: An attempt was made to drop the last group in the index.
solution: Use the DROP INDEX statement instead.

message: Parameter string is already registered.
cause: The parameter name specified was already registered.
solution: Either drop the existing parameter or use a different parameter name.

message: Cannot drop a group whose tables are shared by other group(s).
cause: An attempt was made to drop a group whose tables are shared by other group(s).
solution: First drop group(s) with shared table(s) from this group.

message: Cannot alter columns of a table that is shared by other group(s).
cause: An attempt was made to add columns to, modify columns of, or drop columns from a table shared by other group(s).
solution: First drop group(s) with shared table(s) from this group and then proceed with this operation.

message: Cannot alter columns of a dependent shared table.
cause: An attempt was made to add columns to, modify columns of, or drop columns from a dependent shared table. One can only add columns to, modify columns of, or drop columns from the original shared table.
solution: Use the group name of the original shared table while executing this operation.

message: Cannot have more than one drop, add or modify operations in an ALTER INDEX statement.
cause: An attempt was made to have more than one add, modify, or drop column or group operations in the ALTER INDEX statement.
solution: Use multiple ALTER INDEX statements instead.

message: Cannot add or drop columns to or from multiple tables.
cause: An attempt was made to add or drop columns to or from multiple tables in a single ALTER INDEX statement.
solution: Use multiple ALTER INDEX statements instead.

message: Missing XMLTABLE in GROUP clause.
cause: An attempt was made to create or add a group without XMLTABLE.
solution: Add required XMLTABLE clause to the GROUP clause.

message: An XMLIndex with a structured component cannot be specified with ASYNC.
cause: An attempt was made to specify ASYNC parameter for an XMLIndex with a structured component.
solution: Use valid parameters for XMLIndex with a structured component.

message: Invalid name for GROUP.
cause: An attempt was made to create a GROUP with invalid name.
solution: Use a valid name for the GROUP.

message: Missing PATH for the COLUMN.
cause: An attempt was made to create a COLUMN without PATH.
solution: Specify PATH for the COLUMN definition.

message: Cannot create secondary index on unstructured component of XMLIndex.
cause: An attempt was made to create a secondary index on the unstructured component of an XMLIndex when the XMLIndex does not have an unstructured component.
solution: Alter XMLIndex to add an unstructured component.

message: XML schema enumeration index is out of range
cause: The enumeration item corresponding to the enumeration index could not be found in the XML schema.
solution: If the XML schema has been evolved, try restarting the client that performed the evolution.

message: New element ' string ' in complex type ' string ' has the same qualified name as another element
cause: The new element that was added to a complex type by in-place XML schema evolution had the same qualified name as another element in the same complex type or in one of its ancestor complex types.
solution: Try adding an element with a different qualified name.

message: Change to minOccurs attribute of element ' string ' is illegal
cause: The value of attribute minOccurs on an element could not be increased by in-place XML schema evolution.
solution: Do not increase the value of attribute minOccurs.

message: Change to maxOccurs attribute of element ' string ' is illegal
cause: The value of attribute maxOccurs on an element could not be decreased by in-place XML schema evolution.
solution: Do not decrease the value of attribute maxOccurs.

message: Change to complexType property of element ' string ' is illegal
cause: The complexType property on an element could not be changed by in-place XML schema evolution.
solution: Do not change the complexType property.

message: Change to SQLType attribute of element ' string ' is illegal
cause: The SQLType property on an element in a binary XML schema could not be changed by in-place XML schema evolution.
solution: Do not change the SQLType property.

message: Number of classifiers cannot be NULL
cause: The num_classifiers argument was found to be NULL.
solution: Provide a non-NULL num_classifiers.

message: NULL classifier list not permitted
cause: The wlm_classifiers argument was found to be NULL.
solution: Provide a non-NULL wlm_classifiers.

message: No new plan (classifier list) has been submitted
cause: No new plan was created before submission.
solution: Create a new plan, followed by adding classifier & PC lists.

message: Plan is in transition (about to be activated)
cause: New plan was attempted to be created before activating the current plan.
solution: Completely submit the current plan and activate it.

message: Plan is not created yet
cause: A new plan was not created before submitting the Classifier and Performance Class lists.
solution: Call dbms_wlm.create_plan first to create the plan.

message: No classifier is present
cause: The classifier list contained no classifiers.
solution: Check the syntax of the classifier list.

message: Extra classifiers are present in list
cause: More classifiers were present in the list than specified.
solution: Only include the number of classifiers less than or equal to num_classifiers mentioned in dbms_wlm.create_plan.

message: Peformance Class name is too large
cause: The Performance Class name was larger than 32 bytes.
solution: Rename the Performance Class to fit within 32 bytes.

message: Work Request Class name is too large
cause: The Work Request Class name was larger than 32 bytes.
solution: Rename the Work Request Class to fit within 32 bytes.

message: No expression is present for classifier
cause: This classifiers contained no expression. It should contain one more more expressions.
solution: Check syntax in the classifier list.

message: No parameter is present for expression
cause: This expression contained no paramaters or attribute values. It should contain one or more attribute values. Attributes can be SERVICE, MODULE, ACTION, PROGRAM or USER.
solution: Check syntax in the classifier list.

message: Service name is too large
cause: The service name mentioned in the parameter list was too large.
solution: Check the service name.

message: Module name is too large
cause: The module name mentioned in the parameter list was too large.
solution: Check the module name.

message: Action name is too large
cause: The action name mentioned in the parameter list was too large.
solution: Check the action name.

message: Program name is too large
cause: The program name mentioned in the parameter list was too large.
solution: Check the program name.

message: User name is too large
cause: The user name mentioned in the parameter list was too large.
solution: Check the user name.

message: Number of Performance Classes is less than specified
cause: The number of Performance Classes submitted were less than what was specified.
solution: Submit the full list of Performance Classes.

message: Classifier list is too large
cause: The length of the classifier list was greater than 4000 bytes.
solution: Break the list into two lists before submission.

message: General failure
cause: There was an unknown failure.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Execution of this WLM function is denied
cause: Either a WLM plan was being loaded from another instance, or the strict order of the PL/SQL calls for loading WLM plan was not followed.
solution: Check if another session is also concurrently trying to load a WLM plan. If that is not true, check the order in which you are making these PL/SQL calls to load your WLM plan.

message: Number of Work Request Classes is less than specified
cause: The number of Work Request Classes submitted were less than what was specified.
solution: Submit the full list of Work Request Classes.

message: Number of classifiers is too large
cause: A very large number ( > 1024) of classifiers were requested.
solution: Submit a smaller ( < 1024) number of classifiers.

message: QoS Resource Manager plan does not exist in database " string "
cause: QoS Resource Manager plan did not exist in this database.
solution: Rerun CATPROC.SQL to create the plan.

message: The QoS Resource Manager plan is not in use
cause: The QoS Resource Manager plan was not in use.
solution: Correct the setting of the current Resource Manager plan and try again.

message: Resource Manager is disabled
cause: Resource Manager was turned off.
solution: Reenable the Resource Manager and retry the operation.

message: Classifier plan does not match across instances
cause: Classifier plan was not the same across instances.
solution: Resubmit the classifier plan and try again.

message: Number of Performance Classes is more than what was specified.
cause: The number of Performance Classes submitted were more than what was specified.
solution: Submit only the specified number of Performance Classes.

message: Number of Performance Classes is too large
cause: A large number ( >= 50) of Performance Classes were requested.
solution: Submit a smaller ( < 50) number of Performance Classes.

message: Unable to resolve symbolic link " string "
cause: The system is unable to resolve the specified symbolic link.
solution: Check the definition of the symbolic link to ensure that this refers to a valid resource.

message: Too many steps in resolving symbolic link " string "
cause: This error is raised when the system is unable to fully resolve a path with symbolic links within a reasonable number of steps. It could be due to cycles in definitions of symbolic links or very long chains of symbolic links to symbolic links.
solution: Remove any cycles in symbolic link definitions. If there are no cycles, reduce the length of chains of symbolic links to symbolic links.

message: Cannot create hard link to specified resource
cause: The system cannot create a hard link to the specified resource.
solution: Check the configuration parameter(s) to verify the restrictions on creating hard links to folder or non-folder resources.

message: target path in document link exceeds maximum length
cause: Target path length exceeds the maximum which can be stored to disk.
solution: Reduce target path to smaller length

message: extended link type not supported
cause: XLink type attribute is extended.
solution: Remove extended link, or replace with simple link.

message: unable to resolve target in document link
cause: target path does not resolve to valid resource.
solution: check validity of target path.

message: can not delete with incoming hard document links
cause: there is a hard document link with this resource as the target.
solution: query DOCUMENT_LINKS view to see which resource has a hard link to this resource. Change the document link in the source resource accordingly.

message: found a loop in XInclude elements while expanding string
cause: There is a loop in XInclude elements within the document.
solution: Remove the loop in XInclude elements.

message: href attribute is required within XInclude element
cause: The href attribute is missing within XInclude element.
solution: Add the href attribute.

message: xpointer not supported within XInclude element
cause: The xpointer attribute is specified within XInclude element.
solution: Remove the xpointer attribute.

message: exceeded maximum depth of nested xinclude expansion
cause: The depth of nested xinclude expansion has exceeded system limit.
solution: Reduce the depth of nested xinclude expansion.

message: invalid or unsupported xpath expression string
cause: The specified xpath is either invalid or unsupported in this context.
solution: Change the xpath expression.

message: error while processing XInclude string
cause: There was an error while processing the specified XInclude.
solution: Ensure that the XInclude attributes are correct.

message: SecureFile feature unsupported below compatible 11.2.0.0.0
cause: An 11gR2 LOB feature was specified when the database was operating at a compatible setting lower than 11.2.0.0.0.
solution: Upgrade the database compatible setting to 11.2.0.0.0 or higher to enable the desired new features.

message: SecureFile archive implicit not allowed
cause: A SecureFile was archived and implicit retrieval was not allowed.
solution: Retrieve the SecureFile with a Get operation.

message: Content ID not found in the DBFS HS
cause: The content ID was invalid or was already deleted.
solution: No action required.

message: DBFS HS: Invalid checksum, potential data corruption
cause: Potential data corruption.
solution: No action required.

message: DBFS HS SBT Error
cause: Error related to SBT Tape library.
solution: Refer to error log for more details.

message: DBFS HS invalid store
cause: Error related to DBFS HS Store.
solution: Check that the store name and store parameters are valid values.

message: cannot rename data file ' string ' - file was instantly restored.
cause: During ALTER DATABASE RENAME or RMAN command SWITCH, the rename was specified for an instantly restored file.
solution: Rename the file that was not instantly restored or wait until the repopulation work is complete and the retry the command.

message: catalog instantly restored data file copy string is not supported
cause: This data file copy was instantly restored. Cataloging such file is not supported.
solution: Do not request to catalog instantly restored data file copy.

message: instant restore of data file copy string is not supported
cause: An attempt was made to create a data file copy in instant restore mode. This is not supported.
solution: Do not request to create data file copy in instant restore mode.

message: deleting instantly restored data file string is not supported
cause: This data file was instantly restored with the full option. Deleting such file is not supported.
solution: Do not request to delete instantly restored data file.

message: moving instantly restored data file string is not supported
cause: This data file was instantly restored. Moving such file is not supported.
solution: Do not request to move instantly restored data file.

message: instant restore of data file string failed
cause: During an instant restore, it was not possible to initialize the destination data file. There might be other messages on the error stack or alert log or trace file that indicate the specific reason for the failure. One common reason for this message is that the instant restore feature is disabled in this database.
solution: Check the other messages. If the situation cannot be resolved then request a regular, not instant, restore.

message: Invalid option to enable Extensible Data Security
cause: Input value was not a valid option to enable XDS.
solution: Use a valid option to enable XDS.

message: string is not valid for Extensible Data Security policies
cause: An illegal argument value was used with DBMS_RLS to enable XDS.
solution: Use DBMS_XDS to enable XDS.

message: Privilege " string " is not valid in Data Security Document for " string "
cause: An invalid privilege was specified in the Data Security Document.
solution: Correct the privilege element in the document.

message: Column " string " is not valid in Data Security Document for " string "
cause: An invalid column was specified in the Data Security Document.
solution: Correct the column element in the document.

message: Predicate " string "is not valid in Data Security Document
cause: An invalid predicate was specified in the Data Security Document.
solution: Correct the predicate in the document.

message: Document not found. Fix schema location.
cause: CreateResource failed or an invalid schema location was specified.
solution: If the resource is in resource view, fix the schema location. Otherwise, consult create resource documentation.

message: Cannot mix VPD column and Fusion column security policies
cause: The object is protected by both VPD column security and Fusion column security policies.
solution: Disable or drop either the VPD or Fusion column policies.

message: No colName foreignKey for inheritedFrom element " string ".
cause: No colName foreignKey was specified for an inheritedFrom element in the DataSecurity policy document.
solution: Correct the inheritedFrom element. At least one of the foreignKey elements of an inheritedFrom element must be specified by means of a colName element.

message: The memberEvaluationRule in instanceSet " string " is too long.
cause: The specified length for the memberEvaluationRule element of the instanceSet element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 4000.
solution: Limit the length of the memberEvaluationRule in the instanceSet to 4000.

message: The "when" predicate of inheritedFrom " string " is too long.
cause: The specified length for the "when" predicate element of the inheritedFrom element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 4000.
solution: Limit the length of the "when" predicate of the inheritedFrom element to 4000.

message: The colValue of foreignKey of inheritedFrom " string " is too long.
cause: The specified length for the colValue element of the foreignKey element of the inheritedFrom element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 32767.
solution: Limit the length of the colValue element of foreignKey element of inheritedFrom element to 32767.

message: The value of the "selectPrivilege" element is too long.
cause: The specified length for the selectPrivilege element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 32767.
solution: Limit the length of the selectPrivilege element to 32767.

message: The value of the "privilege" element is too long.
cause: The specified length for the privilege element of the attributeSec element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 32767.
solution: Limit the length of the privilege element to 32767.

message: The value of the "aclDirectory" element is too long.
cause: The specified length for the aclDirectory element of the acls element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 32767.
solution: Limit the length of the aclDirectory element to 32767.

message: The value of the "aclFile" element is too long.
cause: The specified length for the aclFile element of the aclFiles element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 32767.
solution: Limit the length of the aclFile element to 32767.

message: The value of the "paramDatatype" element is too long.
cause: The specified length for the paramDatatype element of the instanceSet element in the DataSecurity policy document was greater than 100.
solution: Limit the length of the paramDatatype element to 100.

message: Number of columns of foreignKey does not match primaryKey.
cause: The number of column elements within the foreignKey element did not match the number of column elements within the primaryKey element of the inheritedFrom element in the DataSecurity policy document. The colunm elements of foreignKey may be specified using either colName or colValue elements. The colunm elements of primaryKey may be specified using only colName elements.
solution: Ensure that the number of colunms of foreignKey matches the number of columns of primaryKey.

message: The OBJECT_ID is not valid.
cause: The PL/SQL API DBMS_XDSUTL.INVALIDATE_DSD_CACHE was called with an invalid OBJECT_ID.
solution: Change the length of the OBJECT_ID passed into the PL/SQL API DBMS_XDSUTL.INVALIDATE_DSD_CACHE to 32, and ensure that its value matches exactly with the XMLRef object identifier of an existing DataSecurity document within the XDB repository.

message: XDB object ID of DataSecurity document " string " was not found.
cause: The XDB object ID corresponding to the DataSecurity document path (shown in the error message) was not found. Note that the error message is limited to displaying only the first 256 characters of the DataSecurity document's path.
solution: Resolve the error shown in the previous error frame.

message: Triton security internal error.
cause: This is a Triton security internal error.
solution: None

message: Invalid XS user specified
cause: An invalid extensible security user was specified.
solution: Check the user name and execute the function or procedure again.

message: Invalid Session ID specified
cause: An invalid extensible security session ID was specified.
solution: Check the session ID and execute the function or procedure again.

message: Invalid Cookie specified
cause: An invalid extensible security session cookie was specified.
solution: Check the session cookie and execute the function or procedure again.

message: Invalid Namespace specified
cause: An invalid extensible security application namespace was specified.
solution: Check the namespace and execute the function or procedure again.

message: Invalid Role specified
cause: An invalid extensible security role was specified.
solution: Check the role and execute the function or procedure again.

message: Invalid Namespace or Attribute specified
cause: An invalid extensible security application namespace or attribute was specified.
solution: Check the namespace and attribute, and execute the function or procedure again.

message: Namespace already exists
cause: The specified extensible security application namespace was already in existence.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a different namespace.

message: Invalid attribute specified
cause: An invalid extensible security application namespace attribute was specified.
solution: Check the attribute, and execute the function or procedure.

message: Invalid ACL identifier specified
cause: The specified ACL identifier is invalid.
solution: Check the ACL identifier, and execute the function or procedure again with a valid ACL ID.

message: Username not specified
cause: Extensible security Username was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a username.

message: Session ID not specified
cause: Extensible security Session ID was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a session ID.

message: Namespace not specified
cause: Extensible security Application namespace was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a namespace.

message: Not attached to XS session
cause: Not attached to an Extensible security session.
solution: Attach to a XS session and execute the function or procedure.

message: Attribute name not specified
cause: Extensible security Application namespace attribute name was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with an attribute name.

message: Attribute value not specified
cause: Extensible security Application namespace attribute value was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with an attribute value.

message: Inactivity Timeout not specified
cause: Extensible security session inactivity timeout was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with an inactivity timeout value.

message: Cookie not specified
cause: Extensible security session cookie was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a cookie value.

message: Role not specified
cause: Extensible security Role was not specified.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a Role value.

message: Insufficient privileges
cause: An attempt was made to execute an Extensible security session function or procedure without the appropriate privilege.
solution: Ask the administrator to perform the operation or to grant the appropriate privilege.

message: Error occurred while executing the event handler
cause: An error or exception was returned by the error handling function invoked as part of the current operation.
solution: Check the trace files to identify the source of the error in the event handling function. Attempt the operation again after the error has been resolved.

message: Column width too small
cause: The size of the column or variable used to store the output of this function or procedure is too small.
solution: Increase the size of the column or variable and try again.

message: Cookie already in use by another session
cause: The specified Extensible security session cookie was used by another Extensible security session.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a different cookie.

message: session ID mismatch
cause: The specified session ID does not match the attached session ID.
solution: Execute the function or procedure without a session ID or with a matching attached session.

message: Already attached to a lightweight user session
cause: The current database session is already attached to a lightweight user session.
solution: Detach from the current lightweight user session before attaching to the new lightweight user session.

message: The specified name string is too long
cause: The length of the name is longer than allowable limits.
solution: Please try again with a new name with a length smaller than the allowable length. Please refer to the documentation to identify the maximum name length for the current operation.

message: Length of value too large
cause: The specified attribute value is too large.
solution: Execute the function or procedure again with a smaller attribute value.

message: Invalid event type specified
cause: The event type specified is invalid.
solution: Reattempt the operation with an invalid event type.

message: User status is currently inactive
cause: User was marked inactive.
solution: Change status in enterprise directory to active and try again.

message: User's password has expired
cause: User password was expired.
solution: Change the user's password and update status to active.

message: User's account was locked
cause: The user's account is locked.
solution: Update user's status to Active in Enterprise Directory and try again.

message: Cannot create system dynamic role
cause: An attempt was made to create system dynamic roles.
solution: Attempt the operation without system attribute or system attribute set to FALSE.

message: Cannot delete system seeded principals
cause: An attempt was made to delete system seeded principals.
solution: Do not attempt to delete system seeded principals.

message: Cannot modify system attribute in dynamic roles
cause: An attempt was made to modify system attribute in dynamic roles.
solution: Attempt operation without modifying the value of system.

message: Cannot detach from a direct-login XS session
cause: An attempt was made to detach from an XS session created by a direct password login.
solution: To detach and destroy the XS session, logout of the DB session.

message: Switching users not allowed for a proxy session
cause: An attempt was made to switch users within a proxy session.
solution: Switch back to original user and try again.

message: Principal already exists
cause: The specified light weight principal was already in existence.
solution: Execute the function or procedure with a different name.

message: Unsupported verifier type
cause: This verifier was not currently supported.
solution: Execute again with a different verifier type.

message: Requested event handler not registered for the event
cause: An attempt was made to update or delete nonregistered event handler.
solution: Please verify event handler name.

message: Requested event handler already registered for the event
cause: An attempt was made to re-register an event handler.
solution: Please verify event handler name.

message: Requested event handler does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to register a nonexistent event handler.
solution: Please verify event handler name or create the event handler.

message: Cannot destroy a direct-login XS session
cause: An attempt was made to destroy an XS session created by a direct password login.
solution: To destroy the XS session, logout of the DB session.

message: Invalid error code supplied
cause: An error code with an illegal value was supplied.
solution: Use an error code from the range of valid values.

message: Circular definition for aggregate privilege string in security class string
cause: Definition of an aggregate privilege contained itself.
solution: Fix the aggregate privilege definition.

message: Privilege string aggregated in security class string is not found
cause: Definition of an aggregate privilege contained a privilege that is not defined in this or parent security classes.
solution: Fix the aggregate privilege definition.

message: Circular definition for security class string
cause: Security class definition inherited from itself through circular definition.
solution: Fix the security class definition.

message: Security class string cannot inherit from base security classes
cause: Definition of a security class specified an internal base security class as a parent security class.
solution: Remove the internal base security class from the "inherits-from" list.

message: Unable to load security class string
cause: The specified security class did not exist.
solution: Create resource for the security class.

message: Missing parent security class for security class string
cause: The specified security class did not have any parent security class.
solution: Add a parent security class using "inherits-from" tag.

message: Privilege string not found in the associated security classes
cause: The specified privilege did not exist in the security classes that were associated with the ACLs.
solution: Use a security class that contains the specified privilege.

message: Invalid security class targetNamespace or name.
cause: The security class targetNamespace attribute was either null or was longer than 4000 characters. Or, the security class name attribute was either null or was longer than 1024 characters.
solution: Provide valid targetNamespace and name attributes.

message: Duplicate definition for privilege string in security class string .
cause: The privilege name in the security class was previously defined in another security class.
solution: Provide a unique name for the privilege.

message: Duplicate security class name string under targetnamespace string
cause: The security class name under the targetnamespce was also used for another security class.
solution: Provide a unique name for the security class.

message: Invalid value for argument ' string '
cause: Input value was not valid for the procedure.
solution: Use a valid option.

message: Value for argument ' string ' out of range
cause: Input value was out of range.
solution: Use a value within allowed range.

message: Cannot complete the operation, overlapping job already exists
cause: Cleanup job already existed which spanned the given audit trail type.
solution: Drop the existing job.

message: Cannot complete the operation, overlapping property already exists
cause: The property already exists which spans the given audit trail type.
solution: Clear the existing property.

message: ' string ' already exists
cause: The value being set already existed.
solution: Delete the existing entry.

message: Incorrect job name specified
cause: The job did not exist or was not created by DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT package.
solution: Create the job using DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT package.

message: Internal error: Audit Table not partitioned
cause: Invalid operation on a non partitioned table.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Property ' string ' cannot be cleared
cause: The property could not be cleared.
solution: None. The property can only be set or reset.

message: Cleanup not initialized for the audit trail
cause: DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT.INIT_CLEANUP was not called for the erroring audit trail.
solution: Invoke the procedure, DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT.INIT_CLEANUP.

message: Error during audit trail cleanup
cause: The audit trail cleanup operation could not be completed.
solution: Check the UNIX error number for a possible operating system error. If there is no error, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Error during audit trail cleanup, internal error
cause: The audit trail cleanup could not be completed because of an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Audit table(s) cannot be moved to ' string ' tablespace
cause: The tablespace was either unavailable or did not have enough space to accomodate the audit table being moved.
solution: Make sure that the tablespace is online and has enough space for the audit tables being moved.

message: The audit trail is already initialized for cleanup
cause: DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT.INIT_CLEANUP was already invoked for the audit trail type.
solution: None

message: Error during DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT operation
cause: Could not complete the DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT operation.
solution: Check the PL/SQL error stack and trace files for a possible error. Fix the cause and retry the operation. If the error is internal or if there is no error, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Subset of audit trail is already initialized
cause: Audit Trail was initialized which spans the given audit trail type.
solution: Use DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT.DEINIT_CLEANUP to deinitialize conflicting audit trail types.

message: Missing value for argument ' string ' in Oracle RAC enabled database
cause: The DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT API was executed in an Oracle RAC enabled database and AUDIT_TRAIL_TYPE was one of AUDIT_TRAIL_OS or AUDIT_TRAIL_XML. But, Oracle RAC instance number for which DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT API was run, was not supplied.
solution: Input a valid Oracle RAC instance number for which the configuration must be done.

message: Insufficient space in ' string ' tablespace, cannot complete operation
cause: Could not complete the operation because the DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT API involved movement of one or more audit tables and there was not enough space in the destination tablespace.
solution: Turn on tracing using DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT.SET_DEBUG_LEVEL to find the amount of space required. Then, allocate that space in the destination tablespace, even if destination tablespace datafile has AUTOEXTEND option turned on. And then, retry the operation.

message: Conflicting operation on audit table(s)
cause: Audit tables were being operated by more than one DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT API from different sessions. The simultaneous execution of the following API with one another and with itself can cause the conflict: INIT_CLEANUP, DEINIT_CLEANUP, SET_AUDIT_TRAIL_LOCATION and MOVE_DBAUDIT_TABLES.
solution: Wait until the execution of one of the API's completes and try executing the API again.

message: Conflicting operation on audit files
cause: Audit files were being operated by more than one DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT API from different sessions. The simultaneous execution of the CLEAN_AUDIT_TRAIL API with itself can cause the conflict.
solution: Wait until the execution of one of the API's complete and try executing the API again.

message: Error during DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT operation; database I/O suspended
cause: An I/O attempt occurred during DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT operation and the database I/O was suspended.
solution: Retry the operation after resuming database I/O suspension. If database I/O is not suspended, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Subset of audit trail is already deinitialized
cause: Audit trail was deinitialized which spans the given audit trail type.
solution: Use DBMS_AUDIT_MGMT.INIT_CLEANUP to initialize conflicting audit trail types.

message: Command cannot have both BY <user-list> and IN SESSION <session-information> clauses together
cause: BY <user-list> clause was supplied with IN SESSION <session-information> clause in the command.
solution: Use either BY <user-list> or IN SESSION <session-information> clause.

message: ALL STATEMENTS option cannot be supplied with BY SESSION clause
cause: An attempt was made to use ALL STATEMENTS audit option with BY SESSION clause. ALL STATEMENTS audit option can be configured with BY ACCESS only.
solution: Specify BY ACCESS instead of BY SESSION.

message: NOAUDIT command cannot be executed with IN SESSION clause
cause: An attempt was made to use IN SESSION <session-information> clause in NOAUDIT command.
solution: None

message: Factor Type string already defined
cause: The object with this name exists already
solution: Choose a unique object name and retry the operation

message: Factor Type string not found
cause: The object being requested does not exist
solution: Choose an object name that exists and retry the operation

message: error creating Factor Type string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred creating the factor type
solution: Please review the definition and retry the operation

message: error deleting Factor Type string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred deleting the factor type
solution: Please review the definition and retry the operation

message: error updating Factor Type string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred updating the factor type
solution: Please review the definition and retry the operation

message: error renaming Factor Type string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred renaming the factor type
solution: Please review the definition and retry the operation

message: Factor string already defined
cause: The object with this name exists already
solution: Choose a unique object name and retry the operation

message: Factor string not found
cause: The object being requested does not exist
solution: Choose an object name that exists and retry the operation

message: error creating Factor string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred creating the factor
solution: Please review the definition for accuracy and retry the operation

message: error deleting Factor string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred deleting the factor
solution: Please review the definition for accuracy and retry the operation

message: error updating Factor string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred updating the factor
solution: Please review the definition for accuracy and retry the operation

message: Factor Link already exists for string and string
cause: The object with this name exists already
solution: Choose a unique object name and retry the operation

message: error creating Factor Link for string and string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred creating the factor link
solution: Please review the definition for accuracy and retry the operation

message: Factor Link does not exist for string and string
cause: The factor link referenced does not exist
solution: Please review the definition for accuracy and retry the operation

message: error deleting Factor Link for string and string , string
cause: An unexpected error occurred deleting the factor link
solution: Please review the definition for accuracy and retry the operation

message: Factor type string is used by one or more factors.
cause: The specified factor type was used by existing factor(s).
solution: Remove the dependent factors and retry the operation.

message: Factor string is referred by one or more factor links.
