Delete the specified document from the repository. 2. Insert the new document into the repository.

message: user-defined UID definition document: string already exists
cause: The insert operation failed because only one user-defined UID definition document is allowed.
solution: To change an existing user-defined UID definition document, follow these steps: 1. Export the specified document to a file. 2. Delete the specified document from the repository. 3. Make changes to the exported document. 4. Insert the updated document into the repository. To add a new user-defined UID definition document, follow these steps: 1. Delete the specified document from the repsitory. 2. Insert the new document into the repository.

message: The tag value for a replace action attribute is null.
cause: The operation failed because a null tag value was found for a replace action attribute in the anonymity document
solution: Either add a non-null tag value for each replace action attribute

message: tag string is referenced by document: string
cause: The insert operation failed because the specified tag in the dictionary document was being referenced by the listed document.
solution: To perform the insert operation, follow these steps 1. Export the listed document to a file. 2. Delete the listed document from the repository. 3. Remove the specified tag from the exported document. 4. Insert the updated document into the repository. 5. Repeat the insert operation.

message: tag string is referenced by unknown document
cause: The operation failed because a tag in the specified dictionary document was being referenced by another document in the repository.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid tag: string
cause: The operation failed because the specified tag was invalid.
solution: The tag must match the regular expression ([0-9a-fA-FxX]{8}). Correct the tag format and try the operation again. See the dictionary schemas (ordcmsd.xsd, ordcmpv.xsd) listed in the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: invalid tag: string
cause: The operation failed because the specified tag was invalid.
solution: The tag must match the regular expression ([0-9a-fA-F]{8}). Correct the tag format and try the operation again. See the dictionary schemas (ordcmsd.xsd, ordcmpv.xsd) listed in the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: tag: string collides with existing tag: string in document: string
cause: The operation failed because the specified tag collided with
solution: Tag collisions are not allowed in the dictionary documents. Correct the specified tag in the document and try the operation again.

message: internal error: string
cause: This document could not be processed due to an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: definer name DICOM is not allowed in a private dictionary
cause: The operation failed because the definer name DICOM was found in the private dictionary.
solution: Correct the definer name and try the operation again.

message: unsupported <ATTRIBUTE_TAG> tag value: string
cause: The operation failed because the locator path with FIELD_TAG was not supported in the <ATTRIBUTE_TAG> tag in the anonymity document.
solution: Remove the FIELD_TAG in the locator path and try the operation again. See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information about locator path syntax.

message: The data model is being edited by another user.
cause: The operation failed because the data model was being edited by another user.
solution: The data model can be edited by only one administrator at a time.

message: no editDataModel session found
cause: The operation failed because there was no editDataModel session.
solution: Call the editDataModel procedure first and try the operation again.

message: lock release returned error: string
cause: The operation succeeded, but an error occurred while releasing a lock.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: lock request error: string
cause: The operation failed because an exclusive lock could not be acquired.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: An editDataModel session already exists.
cause: The editDataModel procedure was called more than once in the same session.
solution: Continue the insert or delete operations, call rollbackDataModel to rollback the data model changes, or call publishDataModel to publish the data model changes.

message: empty data model table
cause: The operation failed because the data model table was empty.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: unrecognized preference parameter name: string
cause: The operation failed because the parameter name was invalid.
solution: Correct the value and try the operation again. See the preference schema (ordcmpf.xsd) listed in the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: invalid preference parameter value: string
cause: The operation failed because the parameter value was invalid.
solution: Correct the value and try the operation again. See the preference schema (ordcmpf.xsd) listed in the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: The <ATTRIBUTE_TAG> value: string is not a simple tag.
cause: The operation failed because the value of the specified <ATTRIBUTE_TAG> tag contained wild card characters 'x' or 'X'.
solution: Only simple tags that match the regular expression [0-9A-F]{8}(\(.*\))? are allowed in the <ATTRIBUTE_TAG> tag. For example: 00080096(DICOM), 00080096 and so on. Correct the tag format and try the operation again. See the schemas ordcmdt.xsd, ordcmmp.xsd, and ordcman.xsd listed in the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: document name: string is too long
cause: A document name with more than 100 characters was specified.
solution: Use a shorter document name and try the operation again.

message: string is not a standard attribute tag
cause: The operation failed because the specified standard dictionary attribute tag did not have an even group number.
solution: A standard dictionary attribute tag represents a two-byte hexadecimal number (group number followed by element number) and must match the regular expression [0-9a-fA-FxX]{3}[02468aceACExX]{1}[0-9a-fA-FxX]{4}. Correct the attribute tag format and try the operation again.

message: document name string contains reserved prefix - ORD
cause: The operation failed because the specified document name contained the ORD prefix that is reserved for Oracle Multimedia documents.
solution: Remove the ORD prefix from the document name and try the operation again.

message: invalid model name: string
cause: The operation failed because the specified model name was invalid.
solution: The model name DEFAULT is the only value that is supported in this release. Remove the model name or replace it with the value DEFAULT and try the operation again.

message: invalid exportOption: string
cause: The specified value for the exportOption parameter was not valid.
solution: Valid values for the exportOption parameter are USER, ALL, or ORACLE. The default value is USER. Remove the specified value for the exportOption parameter or replace it with a valid value for this parameter.

message: no user-defined documents to export
cause: The value USER was specified for the exportOption parameter, but there were no user-defined documents in the repository.
solution: Valid values for the exportOption parameter are USER, ALL, or ORACLE. Specify another valid value for the exportOption parameter.

message: stored tag list document: string already exists
cause: The operation failed because only one stored tag list document is allowed.
solution: To change an existing stored tag list document, follow these steps: 1. Export the specified document to a file. 2. Delete the specified document from the repository. 3. Make changes to the exported document. 4. Insert the updated document into the repository. To add a new stored tag list document, follow these steps: 1. Delete the specified document from the repository. 2. Insert the new document into the repository.

message: invalid manifest file: string or directory: string
cause: The specified manifest file name or directory name was invalid.
solution: Confirm that the manifest file and the directory exist, and that the names are valid.

message: validation failed for manifest file: string
cause: The specified manifest file did not conform to the XML schema ordcmmft.xsd.
solution: Ensure that the manifest file conforms to the XML schema ordcmmft.xsd.

message: cannot import data model because user-defined documents exist
cause: User-defined documents were found in the repository.
solution: First export all user-defined documents in the repository so they can be saved, then delete all user-defined documents in the repository before importing a data model.

message: doc version: string in string is not <= repos version: string
cause: The document version of the specified document was not compatible with the repository version.
solution: You cannot import this data model into this version of the repository. Either upgrade or import a data model that is compatible with your repository version. See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information about document versioning considerations for the importDataModel procedure.

message: manifest file: string does not contain all the Oracle documents
cause: The specified manifest file did not contain the complete set of Oracle-defined documents that were included in the database release.
solution: A manifest file can contain all user-defined documents, all Oracle-defined documents, or both. Confirm that the manifest file includes all the documents listed in the orddcm_dbrelease_docs information view or no Oracle-defined documents. See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information on manifest files.

message: tag: string from string is not listed in the stored tag list document
cause: The specified document contained a tag that was not included in the stored tag list document.
solution: If the preference parameter MANDATE_ATTR_TAGS_IN_STL is set to true the stored tag list document must contain all the tags used by the constraint and mapping documents. Change the preference parameter value to false, or add the listed tag to the stored tag list document. See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information on stored tag list documents.

message: even group number is not allowed in private tag: string
cause: The operation failed because the specified private dictionary attribute tag contained an even group number.
solution: A dictionary attribute tag represents a two-byte hexadecimal number (a group number followed by an element number). Even group numbers are reserved for the DICOM Standard dictionary. Thus, the group number of a private dictionary attribute tag must be an odd number. Replace the even group number with an odd number in the specified attribute tag, and try the operation again.

message: invalid docSet: string
cause: The specified value for the docSet parameter was not valid.
solution: Valid values for the docSet parameter are USER, ALL, or ORACLE. The default value is USER. Remove the specified value for the docSet parameter, or replace it with a valid value.

message: namespace value is too long
cause: A namespace value longer than 700 characters was specified in the mapping document.
solution: Use a shorter namespace value and try the operation again.

message: null ROOT_ELEM_TAG tag value
cause: The value of the ROOT_ELEM_TAG tag was null or all spaces.
solution: Correct the value and try again.

message: The repository data model is in invalid state.
cause: Error detected while loading the data model from the repository.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: The repository data model is not loaded.
cause: The operation failed because the ord_dicom.setDataModel procedure was not called to load the repository data model.
solution: Call the ord_dicom.setDataModel procedure first and try the operation again.

message: unable to load repository: string
cause: The ord_dicom.setDataModel procedure failed to load the repository due to the listed error.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid document type : string
cause: The ord_dicom.setDataModel procedure failed to load the repository because an invalid document type was found.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: cannot find VR number for data type: string
cause: The VR number for the listed data type could not be found in the lookup table.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid range tag: string
cause: The ord_dicom.setDataModel procedure failed to load the repository because an invalid range tag was found in the dictionary table.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: assertion failure: string
cause: The operation failed because an assertion error had occurred.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Argument string is null.
cause: The argument was expecting a non-null value, but the value of the passed argument was null.
solution: Check your program and ensure that the caller of the routine does not pass a null argument value.

message: Argument string is null or invalid.
cause: The argument was expecting a non-null, valid value, but the value of the passed argument was null or invalid.
solution: Check your program and ensure that the caller of the routine does not pass a null or invalid argument value.

message: internal error, argument [ string ]
cause: The internal argument was invalid.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: security violation
cause: A possible security violation was detected.
solution: Check the alert log and trace file for more information.

message: unable to read empty DICOM object
cause: There was no data in the specified DICOM object.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about loading DICOM object data into the database.

message: unable to read invalid ORDDicom object
cause: The value of the source attribute or the extension attribute of the ORDDicom object was null.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about creating a valid ORDDicom object.

message: unable to read invalid ORDImage object: attribute string is null
cause: The ORDImage object was invalid.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about creating a valid ORDImage object.

message: cannot access DICOM data with invalid source type
cause: An invalid source type was stored in the source attribute of the ORDDicom object.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about the supported source types for DICOM data.

message: cannot access DICOM image data with invalid source type
cause: An invalid source type was stored in the source attribute of the ORDImage object.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about the supported source types for DICOM image data.

message: cannot access ORDDataSource object with invalid source type
cause: An invalid source type was stored in the ORDDataSource object. Or, an error occurred while trying to retrieve a BFILE while the object status was local.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about the supported source types.

message: cannot export the ORDDataSource object with an external source
cause: The source of the ORDDataSource object was not local.
solution: Import the data before calling the export procedure. Or, get the data directly from the external source.

message: The source LOB locator is null.
cause: The source BLOB locator or BFILE locator was null.
solution: Correct the statement to pass an initialized LOB locator.

message: unable to write to an invalid destination ORDDicom object
cause: The value of the source attribute or the extension attribute of the destination ORDDicom object was null.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about constructing a valid ORDDicom object.

message: unable to write to a nonlocal destination ORDDicom object
cause: The source attribute of the destination ORDDicom object was not local.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about constructing a local ORDDicom object.

message: unable to write to an invalid destination ORDImage object
cause: The value of the source attribute of the destination ORDImage object was null.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about constructing a valid ORDImage object.

message: unable to write to a nonlocal destination ORDImage object
cause: The source attribute of the destination ORDImage object was not local.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about constructing a local ORDImage object.

message: The destination BLOB locator is null.
cause: The destination BLOB locator was null.
solution: Correct the statement to pass an initialized BLOB locator.

message: Mapping document does not exist.
cause: The specified mapping document did not exist.
solution: Check the installed mapping documents, and correct the statement to pass the name of an installed mapping document.

message: Anonymity document does not exist.
cause: The specified anonymity document did not exist.
solution: Check the installed anonymity definition documents, and correct the statement to pass the name of an installed anonymity definition document.

message: Constraint does not exist.
cause: The specified constraint did not exist.
solution: Check the installed constraints, and correct the statement to pass an installed constraint name.

message: The metadata for the new DICOM object is invalid.
cause: The metadata for the new DICOM object did not conform to the default metadata schema (ordcmmd.xsd).
solution: Check the metadata argument to ensure it has the correct namespace and conforms to the default metadata schema (ordcmmd.xsd). See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about the default metadata schema (ordcmmd.xsd).

message: The SOP INSTANCE UID for the new DICOM object is invalid.
cause: The SOP INSTANCE UID for the new DICOM object was invalid.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about creating a valid SOP INSTANCE UID.

message: cannot import from a null or invalid source type
cause: A null or invalid source type was specified in the import procedure.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about the supported source types for the DICOM object.

message: cannot export to a null or invalid destination data type
cause: A null or invalid destination data type was specified in the export procedure.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about the supported destination data types for the DICOM object.

message: Attribute does not exist.
cause: The specified attribute did not exist.
solution: Ensure that the attribute name is valid.

message: Metadata attribute is not available.
cause: The value of the metadata attribute of the ORDDicom object was null.
solution: Call the setProperties method first.

message: cannot extract metadata that conforms to the schema definition
cause: The extracted metadata did not conform to its schema definition.
solution: Check the metadata schema definition, the mapping document and the parameters for the extractMetadata method to ensure that they are correct. See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for information about creating repository documents and extracting metadata.

message: Missing DICOM magic number.
cause: The DICOM object did not contain the DICOM magic number "dicm" required by part 10 of the DICOM standard.
solution: Fix the DICOM object or the DICOM object source, if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: Missing DICOM header.
cause: The DICOM object did not contain the file preamble.
solution: Fix the DICOM object or the DICOM object source, if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: Missing the mandatory DICOM attribute string .
cause: One or more mandatory DICOM attributes were missing from the DICOM object.
solution: Fix the DICOM object or the DICOM object source, if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: The DICOM object contains invalid attribute value string .
cause: The DICOM object did not conform to the DICOM standard and contained invalid attribute values.
solution: Fix the DICOM object or the DICOM object source, if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: The DICOM object encoding is wrong string .
cause: The DICOM object did not conform to the DICOM standard's binary encoding rules.
solution: Determine if the DICOM object is corrupt. If the DICOM object is not corrupt, verify whether it conforms to the binary encoding rules in the DICOM standard. If the DICOM object is corrupt, fix it if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: The attribute string does not conform to the VM rule.
cause: The DICOM object either contained an attribute that did not conform to the DICOM value multiplicity rule or was missing an attribute that was required by the DICOM standard.
solution: Determine if the DICOM object conforms to the DICOM standard. If it does, verify if the data dictionary matches the DICOM object or is more recent than the DICOM object. If the data dictionary is obsolete, update it using the ORD_DICOM_ADMIN repository API, if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: The DICOM object contains an invalid VR value string .
cause: The DICOM object with explicit value representation encoding had attribute VR values that did not match their definitions in the data dictionary.
solution: Determine if the DICOM object conforms to the DICOM standard. If it does, verify if the data dictionary matches the DICOM object or is more recent than the DICOM object. If the data dictionary is obsolete, update it using the ORD_DICOM_ADMIN repository API, if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: The DICOM object contains undefined values string .
cause: The DICOM object had attribute values that were expected to be part of the data model.
solution: Determine if the DICOM object conforms to the DICOM standard. If it does, verify if the data model matches the DICOM object or is more recent than the DICOM object. If the data model is obsolete, update it using the ORD_DICOM_ADMIN repository API, if possible. Otherwise, update the DICOM preference document to ignore this category of error.

message: The DICOM object contains unsupported values string .
cause: This type of DICOM object is not supported by the current release.
solution: Check for software updates, and contact Oracle Support Services for information about feature enhancements.

message: The DICOM object attribute string has invalid definer name.
cause: A private attribute definer for a private attribute contained in this DICOM object had invalid characters.
solution: Determine if the DICOM object is corrupt. If the DICOM object conforms to the DICOM standard, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Not a DICOM object.
cause: The binary object is not a DICOM object.
solution: Determine if the DICOM object is corrupt. If the DICOM object conforms to the DICOM standard, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Not a DICOM image.
cause: The binary object was not a DICOM image.
solution: Determine if the DICOM object is an image. Only DICOM images can be processed with image processing functions.

message: Image processing failure.
cause: An error occurred when processing a DICOM image.
solution: Determine if the DICOM image is corrupt, and if it is supported by the current release.

message: The DICOM object does not contain attribute string .
cause: The DICOM object did not contain the attribute that was required for conformance validation.
solution: Determine if the locator path is properly constructed. All attributes used in the locator path must be defined in the DICOM standard, and must not be retired. All attributes except the last attribute in the locator path must be of sequence type. If the locator path is correct, verify if the DICOM data dictionary is up to date. If the data dictionary is obsolete, update it using the ORD_DICOM_ADMIN repository API.

message: cannot apply conformance validation on DICOM attribute string .
cause: The content length of the attribute exceeded the value of the XML_SKIP_ATTR parameter that was defined in the preference document.
solution: Remove the attribute from the constraint rule or increase the value of the XML_SKIP_ATTR parameter that is defined in the preference document. Then, attempt the operation again.

message: cannot perform conformance validation because recursion level exceeds MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH
cause: When evaluating the recursive constraint on the DICOM object, the number of levels of recursion exceeded the value of the MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH parameter that was defined in the preference document.
solution: Ensure that the constraint definition is correct. If necessary, increase the value of the MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH parameter that is defined in the preference document. Then, attempt the operation again.

message: error logging conformance validation messages
cause: An error occurred while trying to log conformance validation messages.
solution: Ensure that the constraint rule definition does not contain any ACTION elements if the isConformanceValid method is called from a SQL query. If this error persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Invalid locator path string
cause: A locator path for an attribute was invalid.
solution: Please verify the locator path is properly constructed. All attribute used in the locator path must be defined in the DICOM standard and must not be retired. An attribute that is not the last one of the locator path must be a sequence type. If the locator path is correct, please verify the DICOM data dictionary is up-to-date. If the data dictionary is obsolete, please use the ORD_DICOM_ADMIN API to update the data dictionary.

message: I/O failure string .
cause: A device I/O failure occurred when attempting to read from and write to a DICOM object.
solution: Check the permissions and privileges that have been granted for I/O operations.

message: SQL error string .
cause: An error occurred when attempting to run a SQL command.
solution: If you are using a JDBC connection string, ensure that the connection string is valid. Check the user account to see if it is locked. Ensure that the listener and the database server are running. And ensure that the setDataModel() function has been invoked before any other DICOM functions are called.

message: XML error string .
cause: An error occurred when attempting to read from and write to XML metadata.
solution: Ensure that Oracle XDB and all related schemas are properly installed.

message: XSLT error string .
cause: An error occurred while attempting to process XML metadata.
solution: Ensure that Oracle XDB and all related schemas are properly installed. And, verify that the mapping and anonymity documents are valid.

message: make anonymous error string .
cause: An error occurred while attempting to make DICOM object anonymous.
solution: Ensure that the anonymity document content is valid.

message: unimplemented feature: string
cause: The specified feature is not implemented.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: internal error string .
cause: An internal error occurred while attempting to process a DICOM object.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services, and supply them with a script that can be duplicated as well as the DICOM object that caused this error.

message: cannot move tablespace because tables are being used
cause: The operation failed because Oracle Multimedia tables were being used.
solution: End all sessions using Oracle Multimedia tables and try again.

message: Virtual column feature not yet implemented
cause: Feature has not been implemented.
solution: Feature is being implemented.

message: string : invalid identifier specified for virtual column expression
cause: Column expression referenced a column that does not exist in the table.
solution: Rewrite column expression to reference only scalar columns in the table.

message: only pure functions can be specified in a virtual column expression
cause: Column expression contained a function whose evaluation is non-deterministic.
solution: Rewrite column expression to reference only pure functions.

message: specified data type is not supported for a virtual column
cause: Only scalar data types are supported for virtual columns. LONG, BLOB, REF, and BFILE data types are not supported for virtual columns.
solution: Specify the expression column with a supported scalar data type.

message: resultant data type of virtual column is not supported
cause: The data type of the underlying expression is not supported. Only scalar data types are supported for virtual columns. LONG, BLOB, REF, and BFILE data types are not supported for virtual columns.
solution: Specify the expression of virtual column to return a supported scalar data type.

message: keyword VIRTUAL cannot be specified here
cause: The keyword VIRTUAL was either repeated or incorrectly specified.
solution: Remove the keyword from the specified syntax.

message: keyword VISIBLE cannot be specified here
cause: The keyword VISIBLE was either repeated or incorrectly specified.
solution: Remove the keyword from the specified syntax.

message: keyword HIDDEN cannot be specified here
cause: The keyword HIDDEN was either repeated or incorrectly specified.
solution: Remove the keyword from the specified syntax.

message: expression column is not supported for an index organized table
cause: Attempt to create/alter an index organized table with an expression column
solution: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

message: expression column is not supported for an external table
cause: Attempt to create/alter an external table with an expression column
solution: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

message: expression column is not supported for a temporary table
cause: Attempt to create/alter a temporary table with an expression column
solution: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

message: expression column is not supported for a clustered table
cause: Attempt to create/alter a clustered table with an expression column
solution: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

message: virtual column is referenced in a column expression
cause: This virtual column was referenced in an expression of another virtual column
solution: Ensure the column expression definition for any virtual column does not refer to any virtual column

message: INSERT operation disallowed on virtual columns
cause: Attempted to insert values into a virtual column
solution: Re-issue the statment without providing values for a virtual column

message: Resulting table from a CTAS operation contains virtual column(s)
cause: Table being created by a CTAS operation contains a virtual column definition
solution: Remove the virtual column definition from the table being created

message: Duplicate column expression was specified
cause: Expression of the virtual column being added/created conflicts with an existing/previously specified functional index expression or virtual column expression
solution: Change the expression of the virtual column os there are no duplicate expressions

message: Invalid column expression was specified
cause: Virtual column expression is not a valid arithmetic expression. it probably refers to another column in the table
solution: Change the expression of the virtual column

message: UPDATE operation disallowed on virtual columns
cause: Attempted to update values of a virtual column
solution: Re-issue the statment without setting values for the virtual column

message: A virtual column exists for this expression
cause: Specified index expression matches an existing virtual column"
solution: Re-issue the statment by replacing the index expression with the matching virtual column

message: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because it is a partitioning column
cause: Attempted to modify the expression of a virtual column that was also a partitioning column.
solution: This is not supported.

message: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because it is a subpartitioning column
cause: Attempted to modify the expression of a virtual column that was also a subpartitioning column.
solution: This is not supported.

message: Cannot use PL/SQL expressions in partitioning or subpartitioning columns
cause: Attempted to partition a table on a virtual column that contained PL/SQL expressions.
solution: This is not supported.

message: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because an index is defined on column
cause: Attempted to change the expression of a virtual column that was indexed.
solution: Alter index unsable. Change expression and then rebuild index.

message: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because a constraint is defined on column
cause: Attempted to change the expression of a virtual column that had a constraint defined on it.
solution: Drop constraint and then change expression.

message: expression column is not supported for an organization cube table
cause: Attempted to create or alter an organization cube table with an expression column
solution: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

message: Virtual column cannot have a default value
cause: Attempted to alter a virtual column to have a default value.
solution: This is not valid, change the DDL.

message: Real column cannot have an expression
cause: Attempted to alter a real column to have an expression.
solution: This is not valid, change the DDL.

message: cannot modify data-type of virtual column
cause: Attempted to change the data-type of virtual column without modifying the underlying expression
solution: change the underlying expression to be compatible with the data-type change

message: cannot change the HIDDEN/VISIBLE property of a virtual column
cause: Attempted to change the HIDDEN/VIRTUAL property of a virtual column
solution: re-issue the DDL without the virtual column property change

message: Virtual column cannot be updated in trigger body
cause: Attempted to change the value of virtual column in a trigger body"
solution: This is not valid, change the trigger definition.

message: datatype mismatch between virtual column and expression
cause: virtual column expression was changed after column was created"
solution: change the underlying expression to return datatype that conforms to the virtual column

message: column to be dropped or modified is used in a virtual column expression
cause: Attempted to drop or modify a column that was used in a virtual column expression.
solution: Drop the virtual column first or change the virtual column expression to eliminate dependency on the column to be dropped.

message: column to be renamed is used in a virtual column expression
cause: Attempted to rename a column that was used in a virtual column expression.
solution: Drop the virtual column first or change the virtual column expression to eliminate dependency on the column to be renamed.

message: column to be modified is used in a virtual column expression
cause: Attempted to modify the data type of a column that was used in a virtual column expression.
solution: Drop the virtual column first or change the virtual column expression to eliminate dependency on the column to be modified.

message: virtual columns not allowed in functional index expressions
cause: An attempt was made to create a functional index with an expression defined on one or more virtual columns.
solution: Specify the index expression using only regular columns.

message: keyword HIDDEN cannot be specified here
cause: Attempted to specify HIDDEN key word for a virtual column
solution: This is not supported.

message: cannot define referential constraint with ON DELETE SET NULL clause on virtual column
cause: Attempted to specify ON DELETE SET NULL clause for a referential integrity constraint on a virtual column.
solution: Reissue the statement without specifying ON DELETE SET NULL clause.

message: table must have at least 1 column that is not virtual
cause: An attempt was made to create a table with only virtual columns.
solution: Include at least 1 column that is not virtual in the table being created.

message: Virtual column cannot be encrypted
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter a virtual column to have encryption.
solution: Encryption is unnecessary for a virtual column as the data is not stored on disk.

message: invalid combination of elements
cause: The geometry did not start from the correct level in the hierarchy.
solution: Correct the hierarchy in the geometry.

message: no holes expected
cause: The geometry contained one or more unexpected holes.
solution: Remove any holes in the geometry.

message: solid not closed
cause: The solid geometry was not closed i.e., faces of solid are not 2-manifold due to incorrectly defined, oriented, or traversed line segment because each edge of a solid must be traversed exactly twice, once in one direction and once in the reverse direction.
solution: Correct the orientation of the edges of the neighboring polygons.

message: incorrect solid orientation
cause: The orientation of the solid was not correct.
solution: Correct the orientation or specification of the outer or inner solid geometry according to the geometry rules for such a solid.

message: multiple outer geometries
cause: The geometry contained more than one outer geometry.
solution: Remove all but one of the outer geometries.

message: ring does not lie on a plane
cause: The ring was not flat.
solution: Make sure all of the vertices of the ring are on the same plane.

message: compound curve not supported for 3-D geometries
cause: The 3-D geometry contained one or more compound curves, which are not supported for 3-D geometries.
solution: Remove all compound curves from the geometry.

message: duplicate points in multipoint geometry
cause: The multipoint geometry had two points that either had identical coordinates or were the same point considering the geometry tolerance.
solution: Make sure all points are different, considering the tolerance.

message: overlapping surfaces in a multisolid geometry
cause: The multisolid geometry contained one or more fully or partially overlapping surfaces.
solution: Ensure that the multisolid geometry contains no overlapping areas.

message: solid not attached to composite solid
cause: To connect solids in a composite solid geometry, at least one of the faces of a solid must be shared (fully or partially) with only another solid. However, at least one of the faces in this composite solid was not shared by exactly two solids only.
solution: Ensure that at least one face in a composite solid is shared by exactly two solids.

message: no outer geometry expected
cause: An outer geometry was found when only inner geometries were expected.
solution: Remove all outer geometries.

message: edges of inner and outer solids intersect
cause: An inner solid had a common edge with outer solid.
solution: Ensure that edges of inner and outer solids do not intersect.

message: a vertex of an inner solid is outside corresponding outer solid
cause: A solid geometry contained an inner solid with at least one vertex outside its corresponding outer solid.
solution: Ensure that all vertices of inner solids are not outside their corresponding outer solid.

message: inner solid surface overlaps outer solid surface
cause: One or more faces of an inner solid surface either fully or partially overlapped an outer solid surface.
solution: Ensure that inner and outer surfaces have no shared (fully or partially overlapping) faces.

message: overlapping areas in multipolygon
cause: A multipolygon geometry contained one or more common (shared, fully or partially overlapped) polygons.
solution: Ensure that no polygons in a multipolygon overlap.

message: outer rings in a composite surface intersect
cause: Outer rings, either on the same plane or different planes, in a composite surface intersected.
solution: Ensure that outer rings do not intersect. They can share edges.

message: adjacent outer rings of composite surface cannot be on same plane
cause: The conditional flag was set, and a composite surface had at least two outer rings sharing a common edge on the same plane.
solution: Change those outer rings into one larger outer ring.

message: outer ring is on the same plane and overlaps another outer ring
cause: An outer ring in a composite surface shared a common area with another outer ring.
solution: Ensure that no outer rings fully or partially overlap.

message: shared edge of composite surface not oriented correctly
cause: A shared edge (one shared by two polygons) in a composite surface was not correctly oriented. Each shared edge must be oriented in one direction with respect to its first polygon and then in the reverse direction with respect to its second polygon.
solution: Reverse one of the directions of the shared edge with respect to its polygons.

message: polygon (surface) not attached to composite surface
cause: Not all polygons of a surface had a common (fully or partially shared) edge.
solution: Ensure that each polygon is attached to the composite surface by one of its edges.

message: inner ring not on the same plane as its outer ring
cause: An inner ring was not on the same plane as its outer ring.
solution: Ensure that each inner ring is on the same plane as its outer ring.

message: inner ring is not inside or is touching outer ring more than once
cause: An inner ring either was not inside its outer ring or touched its outer ring more than once.
solution: Ensure that the inner ring is inside its outer ring and does not touch the outer ring more than once. If an inner ring touches its outer ring more than once, then the outer ring is no longer a topologically simple or singly connected polygon (ring).

message: inner rings of same outer ring cannot intersect or share boundary
cause: Two inner rings of the same outer ring intersected or shared a boundary.
solution: Ensure that line segments of an inner ring do not intersect or fully or partially coincide with line segments of another inner ring sharing the same outer ring.

message: inner rings of same outer ring cannot touch more than once
cause: Two inner rings of the same outer ring touched more than once.
solution: Ensure that inner rings of the same outer ring touch at no more than one point.

message: inner ring cannot be inside another inner ring of same outer ring
cause: An inner ring was inside another ring of the same outer ring.
solution: Ensure that no inner ring is inside another inner ring of the same outer ring.

message: incorrect box volume due to wrong ordinates
cause: The rectangular box in shortcut format did not have its first x,y,z coordinates either all greater or less than its second x,y,z coordinates.
solution: Make sure that the first x,y,z coordinates are either all greater or all less than the second x,y,z coordinates.

message: multi or composite geometry must be decomposed before extraction
cause: The extraction could not be performed because the multi or composite geometry must first be decomposed into simple geometries (with or without inner geometries). The multi or composite geometry had a gtype of GTYPE_MULTISOLID, GTYPE_MULTISURFACE, GTYPE_MULTICURVE, GTYPE_MULTIPOINT, or GTYPE_COLLECTION, or the geometry was a line string.
solution: Use the MULTICOMP_TOSIMPLE parameter to element extractor to decompose the multi or composite geometry to a simple geometry.

message: operation not permitted on a simple geometry
cause: A MULTICOMP_TOSIMPLE parameter to element extractor was attempted on a geometry that is already simple.
solution: Do not use the MULTICOMP_TOSIMPLE parameter to element extractor on simple geometries.

message: inner composite surfaces or surfaces with inner ring(s) expected
cause: An INNER_OUTER parameter to element extractor was attempted on a surface that was not simple or composite.
solution: Ensure that the etype of the geometry for the INNER_OUTER parameter to element extractor is ETYPE_SURFACE or ETYPE_COMPOSITESURFACE.

message: geometry should have multi-level hierarchy (like triangle)
cause: The geometry did not have the multi-level hierarchy required for this operation. For example, if the parameter to element extractor (hierarchy level) is not LOWER_LEVEL, but the geometry etype is ETYPE_SOLID and gtype is GTYPE_SOLID, an extract operation is not allowed, because a simple solid can only be decomposed into lower level geometries, such as composite surfaces.
solution: Ensure that the geometry has the appropriate hierarchy. For example, if the geometry etype is ETYPE_SOLID and gtype is GTYPE_SOLID, the parameter to element extractor (hierarchy level) should be LOWER_LEVEL.

message: invalid etype for element at element offset
cause: An invalid etype was encountered.
solution: Correct the etype of the geometry.

message: invalid orientation for element at element offset
cause: The orientation of the current geometry was not valid.
solution: Reverse the orientation of the geometry.

message: incomplete composite surface
cause: The end of composite surface was reached before all necessary surfaces were defined.
solution: Add more surfaces to match the geometry definition, or reduce the specified number of surfaces.

message: invalid etype in composite surface of solid
cause: The etype of the composite surface of a solid was not valid.
solution: Ensure that the etype is orient*1000+ETYPE_SOLID, where orient is 1 for outer solid and 2 for inner solid.

message: incorrect box surface due to wrong specification
cause: The elemInfo definition was not correct for the surface of the axis aligned box.
solution: Change the interpretation to 3 in the elemInfo definition.

message: incorrect box surface because it is on arbitrary plane
cause: The axis aligned box surface was not on the yz, xz, or xy plane.
solution: Ensure that the first and fourth coordinates, or the second and fifth coordinates, or the third and sixth coordinates are the same. This means that the surface is on the yz, xz or xy plane, respectively.

message: axis aligned box surface not defined properly
cause: The inner geometry etype did not start with 2, or the outer geometry etype did not start with 1, or both occurred.
solution: Use the correct etype for the inner and outer geometries.

message: incorrect box surface due to wrong orientation
cause: The rectangular surface in shortcut format did not have its first x,y,z coordinates all greater than or equal to or all less than or equal to its second x,y,z coordinates.
solution: Ensure that the first x,y,z coordinates are either all greater than or equal to or all less than or equal to the second x,y,z coordinates.

message: unexpected gtype
cause: The gtype of the geometry was not GTYPE_SOLID, GTYPE_SURFACE, GTYPE_CURVE or GTYPE_POINT.
solution: Correct the elemInfo array to fix any invalid gtype and etypes that violate the geometry hierarchy.

message: cannot process the geometry(s) for this operation
cause: The geometry had errors in it.
solution: Validate the geometry or geometries to ensure that each is valid.

message: at least one element must be a surface or solid
cause: One of the geometries had holes, and the geometries were neither (A) simple, composite, or multisurfaces, or (B) simple, composite, or multisolids. (Surfaces and solids are the only geometries that can have holes. Points and curves cannot have holes.)
solution: Ensure that each geometry having holes is a surface or solid (simple, composite, or multi).

message: holes incorrectly defined
cause: The holes were defined with incorrect etype.
solution: Ensure that the etype is correct in the definition of the inner geometry.

message: volume of solid cannot be 0 or less
cause: The solid geometry having one outer and multiple inner geometries had a negative or zero volume.
solution: Correct the orientation or specification of the outer solid geometry to obey outer geometry rules so that the outer geometry has a positive volume. Additionally, correct the orientation or specification of inner solid geometries to obey inner geometry rules so that each inner geometry has a negative volume.

message: wrong input for COUNT_SHARED_EDGES
cause: The COUNT_SHARED_EDGES parameter value was not 1 or 2.
solution: Ensure that the COUNT_SHARED_EDGES parameter value is either 1 or 2.

message: input geometry gtype must be GTYPE_POLYGON for extrusion
cause: The input geometry gtype was not GTYPE_POLYGON.
solution: Ensure that the gtype of the input polygon is GTYPE_POLYGON.

message: input geometry has incorrect elemInfo
cause: The input 2-D polygon did not have only one outer ring.
solution: Ensure that the input 2-D polygon has only one outer ring.

message: input 2-D polygon not valid
cause: The 2-D polygon violated the rules for polygons and rings.
solution: Correct the polygon definition.

message: grdHeight and/or Height array sizes incorrect
cause: The sizes of grdHeight and Height arrays were not equal to half the size of input 2-D polygon's ordinates array. As a result, each point in the 2-D polygon could not be extruded from the grdHeight entry to the Height entry.
solution: Ensure that the sizes of the grdHeight and Height arrays are half that of input 2-D polygon ordinates array.

message: height entries must be >= to ground height entries
cause: In the definition of a solid, the height values were less than the ground height.
solution: Ensure that that height values are greater than or equal to ground height values.

message: incorrect geometry for appending
cause: The geometry could not be appended to a homogeneous collection (for example, multi-geometry) or to a heterogeneous geometry (for example, collection). In other words, the gtype of the geometry to be appended was neither GYTPE_COLLECTION or GTYPE_MULTI-X (where X is point, curve, surface, or solid).
solution: Ensure that the geometries involved in the append operation have appropriate gtypes.

message: arcs are not supported as defined
cause: An arc was defined in a geometry type in which arcs are not supported. Arcs are supported for 2-D (circle) polygons, 2-D compound polygons, 2-D single arc, and 2-D compound (composite) curves only.
solution: Remove or simplify the arcs.

message: invalid geometry dimension
cause: The geometry did not have three dimensions.
solution: Ensure that geometry has three dimensions.

message: operation is not supported for 3-D geometry
cause: A 3-D geometry was passed into an operation that supports only 2-D geometries.
solution: Check the Spatial documentation for operations that are supported and not supported on 3-D geometries.

message: incomplete composite solid
cause: The end of composite solid was reached before all necessary solids were defined.
solution: Add more solids to match the geometry definition, or reduce the specified number of solids.

message: 3D SRID is not found for the corresponding 2D SRID
cause: In extruding a 2D polygon into a 3D geometry, the SRID conversion function did not find an equivalent 3D SRID of the 2D SRID.
solution: Specify a 2D SRID that has a 3D equivalent

message: query element and source geometry cannot be the same
cause: A query element geometry and a source geometry were the same, which prevented a label pointing query element in the source geometry from being output.
solution: Redefine the query element or the source geometry so that a label can be output.

message: query element cannot be a collection or multitype geometry
cause: A query element was a collection geometry or a multitype geometry. Such geometries are not permitted in a query element because they are at the top of the geometry hierarchy. A query element must be part of the source geometry.
solution: Redefine the query element or the source geometry so that a label can be output.

message: CREATE_PC: invalid parameters for creation of Point Cloud
cause: An invalid or unknown parameter was specified in the creation of Point Cloud.
solution: Check for valid set of parameters.

message: CREATE_PC: input points table string does not exist
cause: The specified table for loading points into a Point Cloud did not exist.
solution: Create the points table with appropriate columns, and then create the Point Cloud.

message: CREATE_PC: specified total dimensionality cannot exceed 8
cause: The specified total dimensionality for the Point Cloud exceeded the maximum limit of 8.
solution: Create the Point Cloud with fewer dimensions. You can store the rest in the output points table.

message: CREATE_PC: input points table should not be empty
cause: The input points table had no data.
solution: Insert data into the input points table and then create the Point Cloud.

message: CREATE_PC: scratch-tables/views ( string ) exist and need to be dropped
cause: Transient tables/views from a previous CREATE_PC operation were still in existence.
solution: Delete the invalid Point Cloud from the base table (for cleanup of scratch tables), and initialize and create the Point Cloud again. Alternately, use SDO_UTIL.DROP_WORK_TABLES with oidstring as the parameter.

message: CREATE_PC: error fetching data from input points table
cause: An internal read error occurred during Point Cloud creation.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

message: CREATE_PC: error writing Point Cloud LOB
cause: An internal LOB write error occurred during Point Cloud creation. The cause might be lack of table space.
solution: Look for information from other errors in the stack, or contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

message: CREATE_PC: input extent cannot be null
cause: The extent of the Point Cloud was null.
solution: Specify an extent for the Point Cloud that is not null.

message: CREATE_PC: input extent cannot be more than 2-D for geodetic data
cause: The extent of the Point Cloud was more than 2-D for geodetic data.
solution: Change the extent to 2-D (longitude, latitude).

message: INIT: either invalid basetable/schema or they do not exist
cause: The base table or schema, or both, were invalid strings; or the base table and schema combination did not exist.
solution: Ensure that the specified base table exists in the specified schema before performing the initialization operation.

message: INIT: internal error creating DML trigger
cause: The necessary privileges to create the trigger were not granted.
solution: Grant the necessary privileges to create the trigger. If necessary, contact Oracle Support Services for help with privileges for trigger creation.

message: INIT: block table name has to be unique
cause: The specified block table name was not unique. For example, it might have been used for another block table.
solution: Specify a different block table name.

message: INIT: internal error [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: CLIP_PC: invalid Point Cloud; extent is empty
cause: The input Point Cloud for the CLIP_PC operation was invalid.
solution: Specify a point cloud that was created using the CREATE_PC procedure.

message: CLIP_PC: SRIDs of query and Point Cloud are incompatible
cause: The Point Cloud and the query geometry had incompatible SRID values.
solution: Change the query SRID to be compatible with that of the Point Cloud.

message: CLIP_PC: query and BLKID parameters cannot both be null
cause: Both the query and BLKID parameters were null in the call to the CLIP_PC operation.
solution: Either specify a query geometry that is not null, or specify a BLKID for use as a query.

message: CLIP_PC: internal error [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: TO_GEOMETRY: TOTAL_DIMENSIONALITY not same as in INIT operation
cause: The specified TOTAL_DIMENSIONALITY was invalid.
solution: Ensure that the TOTAL_DIMENSIONALITY matches that specified in the call to the initialization operation.

message: TO_GEOMETRY: internal error [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: CREATE_PC: internal error [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: PARTITION_TABLE utility: invalid input parameters [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: PARTITION_TABLE utility: scratch tables exist with oidstr = string
cause: Scratch tables/views could not be created because they already existed.
solution: Use SDO_UTIL.DROP_WORK_TABLES with the specified oidstr parameter to clean up the scratch tables.

message: PARTITION_TABLE utility: invalid SORT_DIMENSION specified
cause: An invalid string was specified for the SORT_DIMENSION.
solution: Specify the SORT_DIMENSION as 'BEST_DIM', 'DIMENSION_1', 'DIMENSION_2', or 'DIMENSION_3'.

message: PARTITION_TABLE utility: invalid WORKTABLESPACE parameter
cause: An invalid string was specified for the WORKTABLESPACE parameter.
solution: Specify an existing valid tablespace for WORKTABLESPACE (to hold the scratch tables).

message: PARTITION_TABLE utility: error in reading input, output tables
cause: The names for the input/output tables were invalid, or the tables did not exist or did not have the right structure.
solution: Check the Spatial documentation for PARTITION_TABLE.

message: CREATE_TIN: invalid parameters specified in creation of TIN
cause: An invalid or unknown parameter was specified in the creation of the TIN.
solution: Check the Spatial documentation for CREATE_TIN.

message: CREATE_TIN: input points table string does not exist
cause: The specified table for loading points into a TIN did not exist.
solution: Create the points table with appropriate columns, and then create the TIN.

message: CREATE_TIN: specified total dimensionality cannot exceed 8
cause: The specified total dimensionality for the TIN exceeded the maximum limit of 8.
solution: Create the TIN with fewer dimensions. You can store the rest in the output points table.

message: CREATE_TIN: input points table should not be empty
cause: The input points table had no data.
solution: Insert data into the input points table, and then create the TIN.

message: CREATE_TIN: scratch tables/views( string ) exist and need to be dropped
cause: Transient tables from previous CREATE_TIN operation still existed.
solution: Delete the invalid TIN from the base table (for cleanup of scratch tables), and initialize and create the TIN again. Alternately, use SDO_UTIL.DROP_WORK_TABLES with oidstring as its parameter.

message: CREATE_TIN: error fetching data from input points table
cause: An internal read error occurred during TIN creation.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

message: CREATE_TIN: error writing TIN LOB
cause: An internal LOB write error occurred during TIN creation. The cause might be lack of table space.
solution: Look for information from other errors in the stack, or contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

message: CREATE_TIN: input extent cannot be null
cause: The extent of the TIN was null.
solution: Specify an extent for the TIN that is not null.

message: CREATE_TIN: input extent has to be 2-D for geodetic data
cause: The extent of the TIN was more than 2-D for geodetic data.
solution: Change the extent to 2-D (longitude, latitude).

message: CLIP_TIN: invalid Point Cloud; extent is empty
cause: The input TIN for the CLIP_TIN operation was invalid.
solution: Specify a TIN that was created using the CREATE_TIN operation.

message: CLIP_TIN: SRIDs of query and TIN are incompatible
cause: The TIN and the query geometry had incompatible SRID values.
solution: Change the query geometry SRID to be compatible with that of TIN.

message: CLIP_TIN: query and blkid parameters cannot both be null
cause: Both the query and blkid parameters were null in the call to the CLIP_TIN operation.
solution: Either specify a query geometry that is not null, or specify a blkid for use as a query.

message: CLIP_TIN: internal error [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: TO_GEOMETRY: internal error [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: CREATE_TIN: internal error [ number , string ]
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: query gtype is a superset of the source geometry
cause: A query element geometry was at a higher level in the geometry hierarchy than the source geometry.
solution: Try replacing the source geometry with the query geometry.

message: query element cannot be matched to an element in source geometry ( string )
cause: A query element geometry was not a part of the source geometry.
solution: Redefine the query element or the source geometry.

message: a 2D SRID cannot be used with a 3D geometry
cause: A 2D SRID was used with a 3D geometry.
solution: Replace the 2D SRID with an appropriate 3D SRID.

message: Java exception from tag data translation java stack
cause: Java exceptions.
solution: Turn on java output by calling dbms_java.set_output(OUTPUT_SIZE); Set java logging level by calling MGD_ID_UTL.setJavaLoggingLevel('INFO'); Analyze java logging messages.

message: Tag data translation category not found
cause: No matching category ID could be found.
solution: Make sure the input category name, category version or category ID is correct.

message: Tag data translation scheme not found
cause: No matching scheme could be found for the input data format.
solution: Make sure the input data format is supported and correct.

message: Tag data translation level not found
cause: No matching level could be found for the input data format.
solution: Make sure the input data format is supported and correct.

message: Tag data translation option not found
cause: No matching option could be found for the input data format.
solution: Make sure the input data format is supported and correct.

message: Tag data translation field validation failed
cause: Invalid field value.
solution: Make sure the field value of the input data is within the range specified in the tag data translation XML.

message: Tag data translation field not found
cause: Invalid input field.
solution: Make sure the spellings of the input fields are correct.

message: Tag data translation rule evaluation failure
cause: Error occurred when idcode translator tried to evaluate the rule specified in the tag data translation XML.
solution: Java proxy must be set in order to evaluate manager look up rules. Call MGD_ID_UTL.setProxy(PROXY_HOST, PROXY_PORT) to enable java proxy.

message: Too many matching levels were found for the input data
cause: Necessary field values were missing.
solution: Add additional field value pairs that are necessary to determine a unique matching level.

message: model string does not exist
cause: The specified model could not be found.
solution: Make sure that the model has been created.

message: rulebase string does not exist
cause: The specified rulebase could not be found.
solution: Make sure that the rulebase has been created.

message: insufficient privileges string
cause: Sufficient privileges were not granted.
solution: Ask the database administrator to grant the appropriate privileges.

message: SDO_RDF_TRIPLE_S constructor failed: string
cause: SDO_RDF_TRIPLE_S constructor failed.
solution: Check the stack trace for additional information.

message: specified reuse-bNode model-id string != target model-id string
cause: The reuse-bNode model-id specified for the SDO_RDF_TRIPLE_S constructor was neither 0 nor the model-id of the target model.
solution: Make sure that the reuse-bNode model is either 0 or the model-id of the target model.

message: reification constructor functions not supported
cause: Unsupported reification constructor functions were used.
solution: Insert each triple in the reification quad individually. See documentation for more information.

message: internal error: invalid string : value_name= string value_type= string
cause: The value type of this component of the RDF triple was invalid.
solution: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid value type for lexical value: string
cause: The value type of this lexical value was invalid.
solution: Make sure that the lexical value format is correct. If this error occurs during bulk load from a staging table, then this may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid time zone string for lexical value string
cause: The time zone of this lexical value was invalid.
solution: Make sure that the lexical value format is correct. If this error occurs during bulk load from a staging table then this may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: hash collision resolution failed for lexical value string
cause: Attempts to resolve hash collision exceeded the maximum retry count.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: parse failed for the string lexical value: string
cause: Attempts to insert the specified lexical value failed.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid value type string for long lexical value string
cause: The value type of this long (length > 4000) lexical value was invalid.
solution: Make sure that the long value has a valid value type.

message: parse failed for triple: id-form: string string string
cause: Attempts to insert triple failed.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: SDO_RDF_TRIPLE_S constructor failed to process triple containing bNode
cause: The SDO_RDF_TRIPLE_S constructor without bNode reuse option was invalid for triple containing bNode.
solution: Use SDO_RDF_TRIPLE_S constructor that allows bNode reuse.

message: invalid temporary table name ( string ) for use with batch load
cause: Specified temporary table name was not valid.
solution: See documentation for rules for temporary table name validity.

message: batch load attempt failed: string
cause: The batch load operation failed.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: model string does not match model string for table and column
cause: This column of the table was not associated with the specified model.
solution: Make sure to use the correct target model.

message: model string already exists
cause: A model with the specified name was already present.
solution: Choose a different model name, or delete the existing model and create a new model with the specified name.

message: column string in table string already contains data
cause: At model creation time, the table column contained data.
solution: Ensure that the table column does not contain data before model creation.

message: model string create attempt failed: string
cause: The attempt to create the specified model did not succeed.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: model string drop attempt failed: string
cause: The attempt to drop the specified model did not succeed.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: network already exists
cause: Attempt to create the network failed because the network already existed.
solution: If necessary, drop the network before trying to recreate the network.

message: model(s) exist
cause: An attempt was made to drop a network that contained one or more models.
solution: Drop all the model(s) and then retry the operation.

message: rulebase(s) exist
cause: An attempt was made to drop a network that contained one or more rulebases.
solution: Drop all the rulebase(s) and then retry the operation.

message: no rulebases specified
cause: Rulebases for the operation were not specified.
solution: Specify at least one rulebase.

message: rulebase or rules index string already exists string
cause: A rulebase or rules index with the specified name already existed.
solution: Choose a different name, or delete the existing rulebase or rules index.

message: rules index ( string ) create attempt failed: string
cause: The attempt to create the specified rules index did not succeed.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: rule string yields a triple with a literal subject or predicate
cause: The specified rule created an invalid triple containing a literal in the subject or predicate position.
solution: Check and modify the rule to avoid creation of invalid triple.

message: literal value string insert attempt failed
cause: The attempt to create the specified literal value failed.
solution: This may be an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: same model string specified more than once in the list of models
cause: The specified model occurred more than once in the list of models.

message: Backing out live transaction
cause: Flashback Transaction Backout was requested on a transaction that has not committed yet.
solution: Commit the transaction before using this feature.

message: Specified input transaction by name has no SCN hint
cause: The specified transaction names for Flashback Transaction Backout was missing an SCN hint.
solution: Provide an SCN hint, and guarantee that the named transactions start before the given SCN.

message: Mining finished without seeing specified transactions
cause: The SCN hit passed was not good. The SCN hit may have come after the start of any of the input transactions.
solution: Give a lesser and more conservative SCN hint, with greater probability of having seen the start of a transaction.

message: Transaction conflicts in NOCASCADE mode
cause: Transactions other than the ones specified conflicts with the specified transactions.
solution: Try using other options like NONCONFLICT_ONLY or CASCADE or NOCASCADE_FORCE.

message: DDL done on an interesting object after mining start SCN
cause: The Flashback Transaction Backout process encountered an interesting object which had its last DDL operation done on it after the mining start time. An interesting object is one that has been modified by either the specified transactions or any of their dependents.
solution: Specify transactions that have committed after the last DDL done on all the objects they touched.

message: Transaction performed unsupported change
cause: A transaction in the dependency DAG performed some
solution: The specified transaction cannot be backed out.

message: Encountered mining error during Flashback Transaction Backout. function: string
cause: Mining error.
solution: None

message: Invalid input to Flashback Transaction Backout
cause: Null varrays passed or invalid input specified
solution: Specify properly formed varrays and valid options

message: Creation of dependencies could not finish
cause: One or more input transaction or any of its dependents are not committed or have been aborted after more than 1 minute of calling the backout function.
solution: Commit all the active transactions associated with this table and try again.

message: Mining could not start
cause: Mining could not start for the following reasons. 1. A logminer session was processing 2. The database was not mounted or not opened for read and write 3. Minimum supplemental logging was not enabled 4. Archiving was not enabled
solution: Fix the mentioned problems and try again. Note that if you enable supplemental logging now, you will not be able to remove a transaction that has committed without supplemental logging.

message: Flashback Transaction experienced error in executing undo SQL
cause: There was a constraint violation exception when executing in NOCASCADE_FORCE mode. Users could also get this error if appropriate supplemental logging is not enabled causing constraint dependencies to go unnoticed.
solution: Either use CASCADE or NONCONFLICT_ONLY options or add appropriate level for supplemental logging.

message: Backing out PDML or XA-RAC transaction
cause: One of the transactions in the dependency graph was a PDML transaction or a local transaction which is a branch of a global XA transaction, spanning multiple RAC instances. Currently flashback transaction does not support this type of transaction.
solution: None

message: Backing out an AQ transaction
cause: One of the transactions in the dependency graph touched an AQ table. As AQ externalizes database information, these transactions are not backed out, as the entire effects of the transaction cannot be seen from inside the database.
solution: None

message: Backing out a DDL transaction
cause: One of the transactions in the dependency graph is a DDL transaction and could not be backed out.
solution: None

message: Mining sees input transaction changes without seeing transaction start
cause: The start SCN provided was higher than the transaction start but below the transaction commit. The result was only partial changes for the given transaction.
solution: Please provide a lower scn hint to flashback transaction.

message: Mining across reset logs
cause: Flashback Transaction Backout cannot work with missing changes. This error is thrown if we walk across a reset-logs branch, where we might have missed changes.
solution: If the user knows that the transaction happened in the current reset logs branch, then the SCN-hint is possibly incorrect. Provide an SCN in the current reset log branch.

message: Supplemental logging not available for mining SCN range
cause: Flashback Transaction cannot work if there are regions in the mining range where supplemental logging is not enabled.
solution: If you have provided a SCN/time hint which is approximate and far beyond the specified transaction start time, then readjust the SCN hint and try again. If the system has figured out the transaction start time or you are sure of the range, then the specified transaction cannot be backed out.

message: Log record in compatibility lower than 11.0
cause: The logical change record shows that the compatibility of the mined redo is lower than version 11.0. Flashback transaction works only on redo versions 11.0 and above.
solution: Advance the compatibility and try to back out transactions that have occurred after the compatibility increase.

message: Trigger 4144 corruption
cause: Above events used for testing corruption path
solution: None

message: string is not a corrupted transaction
cause: the given transaction is not in the corrupt list v$corrupt_xid_list
solution: check v$corrupt_xid_list

solution: check undo$

message: string is not a valid transaction id

message: string is not a valid undo segment number

solution: Reissue the SQL statement after the database is open for queries.

message: The _highthreshold_undoretention value should be at least string based on the current undo retention settings.
cause: The _highthreshold_undoretention value was not greater than or equal to the UNDO_RETENTION setting and the low threshold value used for tuning undo retention.
solution: Reissue the SQL statement with a higher value.

message: The maximum query length (mql) value should be atmost string based on the current _highthreshold_undoretention setting.
cause: The maximum query length (mql in minutes) was not less than or equal to half the _highthreshold_undoretention parameter setting.
solution: Reissue the SQL statement with a lower value for mql or increase the value of _highthreshold_undoretention parameter.

message: The UNDO_RETENTION parameter value should be atmost string , the _highthreshold_undoretention setting.
cause: The UNDO_RETENTION parameter value was not less than or equal to the _highthreshold_undoretention parameter setting.
solution: Reissue the SQL statement with a lower value for UNDO_RETENTION parameter or increase the value of _highthreshold_undoretention parameter.

cause: An attempt was made to remove the primary tablespace of the Flashback Archive.
solution: No action required.

message: Flashback Archive tablespace must be ASSM tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to add a tablespace that was not an ASSM tablespace.
solution: Add tablespace that is created with segment space management auto.

message: Flashback Archive supports Oracle 11g or higher
cause: An attempt was made to created a Flashback Archive with incorrect compatible mode or without auto undo management.
solution: Use compatible mode equal to 11.0 or higher, and use auto undo management.

message: Event to test Flashback Archiver internal management tasks
cause: The purpose of this event is for testing.
solution: No action required.

message: Flashback Data Archive cannot be enabled on this object
cause: An attempt was made to enable Flashback Data Archive on an object which is not supported by Flashback Data Archive.
solution: Do not use Flashback Archive clause for this object.

message: Table has columns with data types that are not supported by Flashback Data Archive
cause: An attempt was made to add a column of data type that is not supported by Flashback Data Archive. Or, the table on which Flashback Data Archive is being enabled contains column(s) with data types not supported by Flashback Data Archive.
solution: Do not use FLASHBACK ARCHIVE clause for this object. If adding column, do not use LONG or Nested Table column data type.

message: Tablespace has Flashback Archive tables
cause: An attempt was made to remove a tablespace that has Flashback Archive tables.
solution: No action required.

message: Cannot do DDL on Flashback Data Archive enabled table
cause: An attempt was made to do DDL on tracked tables while one DDL is runnning.
solution: Retry the DDL at a later time.

message: Unable to disassociate or re-associate Flashback Data Archive table " string "." string "
cause: Either an incorrect table name was used or an exclusive lock on the table could not be acquired.
solution: Check the table name and release locks on the table.

message: Flashback Data Archive enabled table " string "." string " is disassociated
cause: An attempt was made to perform operation on a Flashback Data Archive enabled table that is currently disassociated for DDL.
solution: Retry the operation at a later time.

message: Flashback Data Archive enabled table " string "." string " has different definition from its history table
cause: The Flashback Data Archive enabled table has different table definition from its history table.
solution: Fix the table definition.

message: Flashback Data Archive enabled table " string "." string " is not in the correct compliance mode for this operation
