cause: You have misspelled the parameter name.
solution: Spell the parameter name correctly.

message: ' string ' is not in the legal range for ' string '
cause: The value of the parameter is not within the legal range.
solution: Refer to the manual for the allowable values for this parameter.

message: ' string ' contains an illegal integer radix for ' string '
cause: An illegal integer radix specification was found.
solution: Only 'd', 'h', 'D', and 'H' may be used as radix specifications.

message: ' string ' is not a legal integer for ' string '
cause: The value is not a valid integer.
solution: Specify only valid integers for this parameter.

message: ' string ' is not a legal boolean for ' string '
cause: The value is not a valid boolean.
solution: Refer to the manual for allowable boolean values.

message: parameter name abbreviation ' string ' is not unique
cause: The abbreviation given was not unique.
solution: Use a longer abbreviation to make the parameter name unique.

message: invalid positional parameter value ' string '
cause: An invalid positional parameter value has been entered.
solution: Remove the invalid positional parameter.

message: could not open parameter file ' string '
cause: The parameter file does not exist.
solution: Create an appropriate parameter file.

message: syntax error at ' string '
cause: A syntax error was detected.
solution: Change the input so that the correct syntax is used.

message: no closing quote for value ' string '
cause: A quoted string was begun but not finished.
solution: Put a closing quote in the proper location.

message: multiple values not allowed for parameter ' string '
cause: You attempted to specify multiple values for a parameter which can take only one value.
solution: Do not specify more than one value for this parameter.

message: error when processing file ' string '
cause: A problem occurred when processing this file.
solution: Examine the additional error messages and correct the problem.

message: error when processing from command line
cause: A problem occurred when processing the command line.
solution: Examine the additional error messages and correct the problem.

message: error when processing an environment variable
cause: A problem occurred when processing an environment variable.
solution: Examine the additional error messages and correct the problem.

message: syntax error at ' string ' following ' string '
cause: A syntax error was detected.
solution: Change the input so that the correct syntax is used.

message: syntax error at ' string ' at the start of input
cause: A syntax error was detected.
solution: Change the input so that the correct syntax is used.

message: syntax error at ' string ' at the end of input
cause: A syntax error was detected.
solution: Change the input so that the correct syntax is used.

message: unable to obtain a valid value for ' string '
cause: No valid value was obtained for this parameter.
solution: Rerun the application and enter a valid value.

message: ' string ' is not a legal oracle number for ' string '
cause: The value is not a valid oracle number.
solution: Refer to the manual for allowable oracle number values.

message: ' string ' is not an allowable value for ' string '
cause: The value is not a legal value for this parameter.
solution: Refer to the manual for allowable values.

message: value ' string ' for ' string ' must be between ' number ' and ' number '
cause: The value of the parameter is not within the legal range.
solution: Specify a value that is within the legal range.

message: invalid function argument received
cause: A function received an invalid argument
solution: Check function calls, make sure correct arguments are being passed.

message: invalid parameter key type received
cause: A function received an invalid parameter key type
solution: Check parameter key types in function calls

message: number of keys being set exceeds allocation
cause: Number of parameter keys being set exceeds allocation
solution: Reduce the number of keys being set or increase allocation

message: invalid key index supplied
cause: The key index specified was not within bounds
solution: Change key index to ensure it lies within bounds

message: OCI Thread operation fails
cause: An OCI Thread function call has failed.
solution: Check the function call to make sure that the correct parameters are being passed and take the apropriate action.

message: Invalid argument passed to OCIFile function
cause: An invalid argument is passed to the OCIFile function. The most common cause is that a NULL pointer is passed where a non-NULL pointer is expected.
solution: Make sure that the values passed as arguments are valid. Esp check for NULL pointers.

message: File already exists
cause: Tried to open a file with OCI_FILE_EXCL flag and the file already exists.
solution: OCIFile is supposed throw this exception in this case.

message: File does not exist
cause: The OCIFile function requires the file to exist, but it does not.
solution: Make sure that the file exists.

message: An invalid File Object is passed to the OCIFile function
cause: An invalid File Object is passed to the OCIFile function.
solution: Make sure that the file object is a valid one. Create a new file object by calling OCIFileOpen if needed.

message: The memory address given as buffer for OCIFileRead/Write is invalid
cause: An invalid memory address is given as the buffer pointer for OCIFileRead/Write.
solution: Make sure that the required memory is allocated and pass a valid memory address as buffer pointer.

message: An I/O Error occured during an OCIFile function call
cause: An I/O error occurred at the system level.
solution: This is a system error and the action will depnd on the error.

message: Out of disk space
cause: The disks associated with the underlying file system are full.
solution: Create more disk space.

message: An invalid argument was given to operating system call
cause: The OS call was called with an invalid argument.
solution: Check the values passed. If unsuccessful to solve the problem contact ORACLE support.

message: The OCIFileWrite causes the file to exceed the maximum allowed size
cause: There is no space to write to the file. Its size is at the maximum limit.
solution: Up to the user.

message: OCIFileOpen: Cannot create the file or cannot open in the requested mode
cause: The create flag was specified in OCIFileOpen such that the file was to be created. But unable to do so. Or the file already exists and the permissions on it doesn't allow the file to be opened in in the requested open mode
solution: Check whether the user has permissions to create the specified file or if the file exists whether the permissions on it allow the requested open mode.

message: Unable to access the file
cause: The function was unable to access the existing the file.
solution: Check if the user has the required permissions on the file.

message: A system error occurred during the OCIFile function call
cause: A system error occured while executing the OCIFile function.
solution: Depend on the error.

message: The OCIFile context is not initialzed
cause: The function OCIFileInit need to be called before calling any other OCIFile function to initialize the OCIFile context.
solution: Call the function OCIFileInit need to be called before calling any other OCIFile function.

message: The thread safety initialization failed
cause: The call to SlgInit failed in OCIFileInit.
solution: Contact support

message: invalid type given for an argument
cause: There is an argument with an invalid type in the argument list.
solution: Use the correct type wrapper for the argument.

message: invalid format code used in the format string
cause: There is an invalid format code in the format string.
solution: Replace the invalid format code with a valid one.

message: invalid flag used in a format specification
cause: There is an invalid flag in a format specification.
solution: Replace the invalid flag with a valid one.

message: duplicate flag used in a format specification
cause: There is a duplicate flag in a format specification.
solution: Remove the duplicate flag.

message: invalid argument index used in a format code
cause: Zero or negative argument index or index not following (."
solution: Replace the invalid argument index with a valid one.

message: argument index is too large
cause: An argument index exceeds actual number of arguments supplied.
solution: Fix format string or pass additional arguments.

message: integer in argument index is not immediately followed by )
cause: Missing closing parenthesis in argument index.
solution: Fix the format specification.

message: invalid precision specifier
cause: Period in format specification not followed by valid format.
solution: Replace the invalid precision specifier with a valid one.

message: invalid field width specifier
cause: Invalid field width supplied.
solution: Replace the invalid field width with a valid one.

message: argument type not compatible with a format code
cause: Bad argument type given for a format code.
solution: Make format and arguments be compatible.

message: output too large to fit in the buffer
cause: The buffer is not large enough to hold the entire output string.
solution: Fix the buffer size and length passed in.

message: missing argument list
cause: No argument list supplied.
solution: Modify the argument list to have at least OCIFormatEnd in it.

message: XML node ' string ' (type= string ) does not support this operation
cause: The given node's type is not supported for this operation. For example, trying to add children to an attribute node, or passing in a document node as a child, are unsupported operations.
solution: Use a valid node type for the operation.

message: Element ' string ' cannot contain mixed text
cause: XML elements must be declared mixed to contain multiple text nodes
solution: Declare this element type as mixed in its schema

message: Reference node ' string ' not contained in specified parent node ' string '
cause: When using a reference node, it must have the specified parent node
solution: Use a node in the specified parent as the reference

message: Element ' string ' may not appear at this point within parent ' string '
cause: The ordering specified by the content model of the parent does not allow for this element to occur at this position.
solution: Reorder the child elements to conform with the content model of the parent element

message: ' string ' ( string node) cannot be inserted in parent ' string ' ( string node)
cause: The schema does not allow a child node of this type to be inserted into a parent node of this type. For example, only element nodes may only be inserted into a document
solution: Insert only child nodes that make sense for this node type

message: XML maxoccurs value ( string ) exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to insert more than maxoccurs values into a schema-based XML document.
solution: Do not insert more than maxoccurs values into the document.

message: Maximum number ( string ) of ' string ' XML node elements exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to insert more than the allowed number of elements (specified by the maxoccurs facet) into an XML document.
solution: Do not attempt to add more than the maximum number of elements to XML documents.

message: No schema definition for ' string ' (namespace ' string ') in parent ' string '
cause: The schema definition for the parent node being processed does not allow for the specified child node in its content model. Note that any typecasting via xsi:type must occur before the schema definitions for the new type can be used.
solution: Only insert elements and attributes declared in the schema. Check to make sure that xsi:type (if used) is specified first.

message: No prefix defined for namespace ' string ' (particle string )
cause: An XML namespace mapping (xmlns:<prefix>=<namespace URL>) must be defined for each particle (element or attribute) stored in an schema-constrained XMLType document.
solution: Add an xmlns attribute definition (attribute name="xmlns:prefix" and value="namespace URL") to the current XMLType document. The safest place to add this attribute is in the root node of the document to ensure that the mapping will be in scope.

message: Order violation: Element ' string ' may not follow element ' string '
cause: The XML schema specifies a content model that is sequential, where the order of nodes in the instance must follow the order specified by the schema, and this instance relies on the schema validity to avoid maintaining instance order information
solution: Insert elements only in the order specified in the schema

message: Cannot resolve prefix ' string ' for QName node ' string '
cause: An attempt was made to store a QName value without having a valid namespace in scope for that prefix.
solution: Declare the namespace for the prefix used

message: Cannot specify empty URI for non-default namespace ' string '
cause: An attempt was made to insert a namespace declaration for a non-default namespace using an empty URI string.
solution: Specify a non-empty URI for namespace declarations other than the default namespace.

message: XML Schema Evolution error for schema ' string ' table string column ' string '
cause: The given XMLType table/column which conforms to the given schema had errors during evolution. For more information, see the more specific error below this one
solution: Based on the schema, table and column information in this error and the more specific error below, take corrective action

message: XML Schema ' string ' is dependent on XML schema ' string '
cause: Not all dependent schemas were specified and/or the schemas were not specified in dependency order, i.e., if schema S1 is dependent on schema S, S must appear before S1.
solution: Include the previously unspecified schema in the list of schemas and/or correct the order in which the schemas are specified. Then retry the operation.

message: Error during rollback for XML schema ' string ' table string column ' string '
cause: The given XMLType table/column which conforms to the given schema had errors during a rollback of XML schema evolution. For more information, see the more specific error below this one
solution: Based on the schema, table and column information in this error and the more specific error below, take corrective action

message: Could not create mapping table ' string '
cause: A mapping table could not be created during XML schema evolution. For more information, see the more specific error below this one
solution: Ensure that a table with the given name does not exist and retry the operation

message: XML Schema Evolution warning: temporary tables not cleaned up
cause: An error occurred after the schema was evolved while cleaning up temporary tables. The schema evolution was successful
solution: If the user needs to remove the temporary tables, use the mapping table to get the temporary table names and drop them.

message: Element or attribute at Xpath string exceeds maximum length
cause: An attempt was made to insert a node of length exceeding the maximum length (specified by the maxLength facet) into an XML document.
solution: Do not attempt to add a node exceeding the maximum length to XML documents.

message: insufficient privileges to change owner of resource string
cause: An attempt was made to change the <Owner> field of an XML DB resource without sufficient privileges to do so.
solution: Switch to SYS before performing the ownership change, or have the intended recipient of the resource perform the transfer.

message: cannot use DOM to add special attribute to schema-based parent
cause: An attempt was made to add or remove an xsi:schemaLocation, xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation, xsi:type, or xsi:nil attribute to or from a schema-based XML node using DOM.
solution: Use the updateXML operator instead of DOM.

message: Resource ' string ' is not an XDB schema document
cause: The given schema URL does not refer to a registered XDB schema
solution: Make sure the specified schema has been registered in XDB

message: Invalid resource handle or path name " string "
cause: An invalid resource handle or path name was passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver.
solution: Pass a valid resouce handle or path name to the hierarchical resolver.

message: Path name string is not a container
cause: XDB expected the given path name to represent a container.
solution: Pass a path name or resource handle that represents a container.

message: Parent string already contains child entry string
cause: An attempt was made to insert a duplicate child into the XDB hierarchical resolver.
solution: Insert a unique name into the container.

message: Length string of the BLOB in XDB$H_INDEX is below the minimum string
cause: In the XDB$H_INDEX table, the CHILDREN column, a BLOB, must have a certain minimum length without being chained. The calculated length of the LOB was less than the stated minimum.
solution: Set the value of the init.ora parameter db_block_size to at least 2K. For XDB to run at its fastest, set db_block_size to 8K.

message: Path name length string exceeds maximum length string
cause: The length of a path name passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver exceeded the maximum length.
solution: Choose a shorter path name.

message: Path name segment length string exceeds maximum length string
cause: The length of a path name segment passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver exceeded the maximum length of a path name segment.
solution: Choose a shorter path name segment.

message: Attempted to delete non-empty container string / string
cause: An attempt was made to delete a non-empty container in the XDB hierarchical resolver.
solution: Either perform a recursive deletion, or first delete the contents of the container.

message: Access denied for property string
cause: An attempt was made to access a property you don't have access to
solution: Check the ACL to see what privileges you have for this property

message: XML element index string exceeds maximum insertion index string
cause: An attempt was made to insert an XML element at an invalid index location in the node.
solution: Choose a new index that falls within the allowed range.

message: XML parsing failed
cause: XML parser returned an error while trying to parse the document.
solution: Check if the document to be parsed is valid.

message: Given XPATH expression not supported
cause: XPATH expression passed to the function is currently unsupported.
solution: Check the xpath expression and change it to use a supported expression.

message: Invalid XPATH expression
cause: XPATH expression passed to the function is invalid.
solution: Check the xpath expression for possible syntax errors.

message: Attempted to delete the root container
cause: An attempt was made to delete the root container in the hierarchical index.
solution: Do not delete the root container.

message: Attempted to insert entry without name
cause: An attempt was made to insert an entry into the hierarchical resolver without a child name.
solution: Supply a child name and try inserting again.

message: Attempted to delete entry without name
cause: An attempt was made to delete an entry from the hierarchical resolver without a child name.
solution: Supply a child name and try deleting again.

message: Error generating unique OID for XML document
cause: An error occurred while generating a globally unique OID for storing an XML document.
solution: None

message: Error deleting XML document
cause: The XMLType object pointed to by the given REF could not be deleted because either the REF was invalid or it pointed to a non-existent table.
solution: Either use FORCE deletion or supply a valid REF.

message: Recursive deletion snapshot too old for string / string
cause: Changes were made to the structure of a directory while it was being recursively deleted.
solution: Try deleting the directory again.

message: The operation is not allowed, Reason: string
cause: The operation attempted is not allowed
solution: See reason and change to a valid operation.

message: Element definition not found
cause: The element definition was not found.
solution: Supply the definition for the element or use a defined element.

message: Element not found
cause: The element was not found.
solution: Make sure the specified element exists.

message: Index size error
cause: The index is greater than the allowed value.
solution: Make sure the index is less than allowed value.

message: Invalid document element
cause: An attempt was made to replace the data at an invalid index number in the XML document
solution: Supply a correct occurrence number and try again.

message: Path name or handle string does not point to a resource
cause: An attempt was made to retrieve a resource based on a path name or resource handle that points to an entity other than a resource.
solution: Do not attempt to retrieve a resource based on that path name or resource handle.

message: Resource metadata length string exceeded maximum length string
cause: An attempt was made to insert resource metadata that exceeded the maximum length of that type of metadata.
solution: Keep resource metadata within its allowed length.

message: Cannot bind to unsaved resource
cause: An attempt was made to bind to a resource that had not been saved to disk.
solution: Bind only to saved resources.

message: Unable to retrieve XML document
cause: The resource had an invalid (dangling) REF to an XML document.
solution: Rebind the resource using a valid XMLType REF.

message: Requested number of XML children string exceeds maximum string
cause: An attempt was made to add more than the maximum number of allowable children in an XML element.
solution: Redefine the schema to allow breaking up of the children among siblings.

message: Could not bind locked resource to path string / string
cause: An attempt was made to bind an existing resource to a new location in the hierarchy, but a lock could not be obtained on the resource.
solution: Commit or roll back the transaction that has the lock on the resource.

message: Invalid XML attribute name string
cause: The attribute name in the XML document did not match anything in the associated schema.
solution: Supply only schema-defined or XML standard attributes.

message: Invalid string value: " string "
cause: The text in the XML document did not represent a valid value given the datatype and other constraints in the schema.
solution: Ensure that the specified value in XML documents is valid with respect to the datatype and other constraints in the schema.

message: XML namespace length string exceeds maximum string
cause: The length of the disk-formatted XML namespace exceeded the maximum.
solution: Keep XML namespace declarations below the maximum length.

message: Property string : XML type ( string ) not compatible with internal memory type ( string )
cause: The XML datatype given is inconsistent with the database datatype, and a conversion cannot be made.
solution: This is an internal error, generally resulting from corruption of the compiled XML schema. Re-register schemas, or contact Oracle support.

message: Property string : Memory type ( string ) not compatible with database type ( string )
cause: The memory type associated with this property is mapped to an incompatible database type, and a conversion cannot be made.
solution: This is an internal error, generally resulting from corruption of the compiled XML schema. Re-register schemas, or contact Oracle support.

message: Too many properties in type ' string '
cause: The type can only have the same number of properties (elements and attributes) as a table can have columns.
solution: Modify the XML schema to move properties into subelements that are not inlined.

message: Element ' string ' not globally defined in schema ' string '
cause: The specified element name has not been defined at the top level of the XML schema (i.e. globally). Elements must be defined globally to be the root of an XMLType object.
solution: Check the XML schema definition to make sure the specified element name has been defined at the top level.

message: Top-level prefix length string exceeds maximum string
cause: An attempt was made to save to disk a top-level XML namespace prefix whose length exceeded the maximum.
solution: Do not define XML namespace prefixes that exceed the maximum length.

message: Cannot store more than string extras outside the root XML node
cause: An attempt was made to store more than the maximum number of XML extras (e.g. comments and processing instructions) either before or after the document's root node.
solution: Keep the number of extras outside the root node below the maximum.

message: Incorrect argument(s) specified in the operator
cause: One or more of the arguments specified in the operator in the query are incorrect
solution: Correct the arguments specified in the operator

message: Could not retrieve resource data at path string
cause: An error occurred while retrieving the contents and/or metadata of a resource.
solution: Contact Oracle customer support.

message: Unsaved resources cannot be updated
cause: An attempt was made to update a resource that was never saved to disk.
solution: Perform a resource insertion instead.

message: Access denied
cause: The requested access privileges have not been granted to the current user. User must be granted privileges prior to resource access.
solution: Check the set of requested access privileges to make sure that they are included in the set of access privilges granted to the user.

message: Requested access privileges not supported
cause: The requested access privileges are not supported for the specified resource.
solution: Ensure that the set of requested access privileges are valid access privileges for the specified resource.

message: Cannot delete ACL with other references
cause: The requested deletion of an ACL resource cannot proceed. The ACL is in use by other resources.
solution: Remove the resources that are making reference to the ACL in question and try again.

message: The value of the depth argument in the operator cannot be negative
cause: The value of the depth argument passed to the primary operator is not a positive integer
solution: Pass a positive value of the depth argument

message: The string operator cannot have an ancillary operator
cause: An ancillary operator was used with an operator which does not does not support ancillary operators
solution: Remove the ancillary operator in the query

message: A null XMLType element cannot be inserted into RESOURCE_VIEW
cause: The element which is being inserted into the RESOURCE_VIEW is NULL
solution: Specify a non-null XMLType element to insert into RESOURCE_VIEW

message: The document being inserted does not conform to string
cause: The XMLType element being inserted into the RESOURCE_VIEW does not conform to the specified Schema
solution: Insert an element which conforms to the specified Schema

message: Display Name of the element being inserted is null
cause: The Display Name of the element which is being inserted into the RESOURCE_VIEW is null
solution: Specify the Display Name and insert the element into RESOURCE_VIEW

message: cannot modify read-only XOBs
cause: Read-Only XOBs cannot be modified.
solution: Use only read operations on such a XOB.

message: Cannot insert root XML document node if it already exists
cause: An attempt was made to insert a root node into an XML document that already had a root node.
solution: Call the appropriate replace function to replace the node instead of inserting it anew.

message: Resource at path string could not be deleted
cause: An error occurred while deleting the named resource. The specific error can be found one lower on the error stack.
solution: Look at the next error on the stack and take approprate action.

message: XDB error: string
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
solution: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Cannot delete an unsaved resource
cause: An attempt was made to delete a resource that had not been saved to disk.
solution: Delete only saved resources.

message: Cannot modify read-only property [ string ]
cause: An attempt was made to modify an immutable XML node.
solution: Use only read operations on such properties.

message: Insertion of string into string creates a cycle
cause: An attempt was made to insert a link into the XDB hierarchy that would create a cycle in the tree.
solution: Ensure that links to existing resources do not cause cycles.

message: XML nodes must be updated with nodes of the same type
cause: An attempt was made to use updateXML to update an XML node with a node of another type.
solution: Ensure that the node specified by the XPath matches the type of new data provided.

message: updateXML expected data format [ string ] instead of [ string ]
cause: An attempt was made to use updateXML to update data with a node of the incorrect type. Text and attribute nodes must be updated with string data, whereas element nodes must be updated with XMLType data.
solution: Use CREATEXML or getStringVal to coerce the new data to the proper format.

message: Cannot apply typed changes to non-schema-based XMLType nodes
cause: An attempt was made to insert, delete, or update a non-schema-based XMLType node using an XML schema definition.
solution: Make changes to non-typed nodes only by referencing their tag names.

message: Invalid database user ID string
cause: An attempt was made set an invalid user ID into an XDB resource metadata property.
solution: Verify the validity of the user ID and try again.

message: Invalid database username or GUID string
cause: An attempt was made to set an invalid username or GUID into an XDB resource metadata property.
solution: Verify the validity of the username or GUID and try again.

message: Too many child nodes in XMLType fragment for updateXML
cause: An attempt was made to pass an XMLType fragment with multiple children as new data for the updateXML operator.
solution: Extract the desired child from the XMLType before passing it to updateXML as the desired new XML node.

message: Resource not retrieved using path name
cause: An attempt was made to access the path name of a resource that was either never saved to disk or was loaded using a method other than with its path name.
solution: Perform path name operations only on resources obtained using a path name.

message: invalid string declaration in XML Schema
cause: The XML schema contains an invalid declaration identified by the message.
solution: Fix the identified error and try again.

message: required attribute " string " not specified
cause: The XML schema does not specify a required attribute.
solution: Specify a value for the required attribute.

message: invalid attribute " string " specified
cause: The XML schema specifies an invalid attribute.
solution: Remove specification of the invalid attribute.

message: error in SQL mapping information
cause: There is an error in the SQL type and table specification within the XML Schema.
solution: Ensure that all specified SQL types and tables are valid and compatible with the corresponding XML types.

message: unable to resolve reference to string " string "
cause: The identified type or attribute or element could not be resolved.
solution: Make sure that the name corresponds to a valid XML (simple/complex) type or attribute or element and try again.

message: type not specified for attribute or element " string "
cause: The identified attribute or element does not have a type.
solution: Make sure that every attribute and element has a valid type specification.

message: name not specified for global declaration
cause: The XML schema does not specify the name for the global declaration of attribute or element or simpleType or complexType.
solution: Specify names for all global declarations.

message: invalid attribute " string " specified in declaration of " string "
cause: The XML schema specifies an invalid attribute.
solution: Remove specification of the invalid attribute.

message: error while creating SQL type " string "." string "
cause: An error occurred while trying to create the SQL type based on the specification of a complex type.
solution: Fix the identified error and try again.

message: error while creating table " string "." string " for element " string "
cause: An error occurred while trying to create the table based on the declaration for the identified element.
solution: Fix the identified error and try again.

message: schema " string " already registered
cause: An attempt was made to register a schema with the same URL as a previously registered schema.
solution: Register the schema with a different URL.

message: insufficient privileges to register global schema " string "
cause: An attempt was made to register a global schema without sufficient privileges.
solution: Make sure that the user has sufficient privileges to register a global schema.

message: insufficient privileges to delete schema " string "
cause: An attempt was made to delete a schema resource without sufficient privileges.
solution: Make sure that the user has sufficient privileges to delete the schema.

message: object " string "." string " depends on the schema
cause: An attempt was made to delete a schema which has dependent objects.
solution: Either drop the dependent objects prior to deleting the schema or use the CASCADE or FORCE options.

message: schema " string " does not target namespace " string "
cause: The schema document contains references (via include and import definitions) to other schemas that do not belong to valid namespaces.
solution: Make sure that all schemas referenced via include definitions target the same namespace as the parent schema. Further make sure that the namespace specified in the import definition matches the actual target namespace of the specified schema.

message: invalid database schema name " string "
cause: The XML schema document contains an invalid database schema name For example, the value of attribute SQLSchema
solution: Make sure that all database user/schema names specified in the XML schema document refer to existing database users/schemas.

message: empty string specified as a SQL name
cause: The XML schema document contains a null SQL name. For example, the values of attributes SQLName, SQLType, defaultTable.
solution: Make sure that all names of SQL schema objects specified in the XML schema document are valid SQL names. Otherwise, remove such attributes from the schema and try again.

message: invalid SQL name " string "
cause: The XML schema document contains an invalid SQL name. For example, the values of attributes SQLName, SQLType, defaultTable.
solution: Make sure that all names of SQL schema objects specified in the XML schema document are valid SQL names. This implies that the database length and other restrictions on names be satisfied.

message: null or invalid value specified for parameter : string
cause: The argument value passed for the given parameter is null or invalid.
solution: Make sure that all the input argument values are valid.

message: incompatible SQL type " string " for attribute or element " string "
cause: The SQL type information provided in the XML schema is not compatible with the XML datatype for the specified attribute or element.
solution: Make sure that the specified SQL types are compatible with the declared XML datatypes.

message: cannot generate string : " string . string " already exists
cause: The type/table name specified in the XML schema document cannot be generated because it is already being used.
solution: Use different names for types/tables or use the NOGEN mode so that schema compiler does not generate new types/tables.

message: validation failed for schema
cause: The XML Schema could not be validated.
solution: Make sure that the SQLType and other datatype mapping is valid.

message: Hierarchical Index not empty
cause: An attempt was made to rebuild the hierarchical index which is not empty.
solution: Delete all rows in the hierarchical index and then rebuild it.

message: XDB Security Internal Error
cause: An XDB Security internal error has occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support.

message: XDB Locking Internal Error
cause: An XDB Locking Internal error has occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Support.

message: Token " string " not given while locking resource " string "
cause: Locking attempted on resource when the pricipal already owns a lock given by the token above.
solution: Reattempt the lock with the token.

message: Already locked in exclusive mode. Cannot add lock.
cause: The resource is already locked in exclusive mode. Cannot add another lock.
solution: Unlock the existing lock.

message: Resource locked in shared mode. Cannot add exclusive lock
cause: The resource is locked in shared mode. Cannot add a shared lock.
solution: Try locking in shared mode or unlocking the existing lock.

message: Cannot find lock with token " string " on " string " for unlock
cause: The lock may have been unlock or it may have expired.
solution: No action needed. Unlock already successful.

message: User does not own lock " string "
cause: The lock to be unlocked is not owned by the user.
solution: None

message: Action failed as resource " string " is locked by name lock
cause: Lock requests cause the whole request URI to be locked
solution: Supply lock token or unlock the lock

message: Action failed as resource string is locked
cause: Delete/Rename failed because of an existing lock
solution: Do lockdiscovery to find the lock and delete it.

message: Action failed as parent resource string is locked
cause: Delete/Rename failed because of an lock on parent resource
solution: Do lockdiscovery to find the lock and delete it.

message: Action failed as resource string is locked by name
cause: Delete/Rename failed because one of the children is locked.
solution: Do lockdiscovery to find the lock and delete it.

message: table string cannot be hierarchically enabled
cause: Trigger <tabname>_xdb_pitrigger already exists
solution: Delete all rows in the hierarchical index and then rebuild it.

message: fail to string for string port using xdb configuration
cause: port number for the defined presentation is not valid
solution: Either the port number is already in use or it is protected. Specify another port number.

message: XDB configuration may not be updated with non-schema compliant data
cause: An attempt was made to update the XDB configuration resource with non-schema or non-schema compliant data.
solution: Check the document to make sure it is schema based and schema compliant.

message: XDB configuration has been deleted or is corrupted
cause: The XDB configuration resource has been deleted or corrupted.
solution: Reinstall XDB, or reinsert a valid configuration document.

message: XDB configuration error: string
cause: An error related to XDB configuration has occurred.
solution: Make sure the configuration resource contains valid data.

message: Tablespace not specified correctly
cause: XDB cannot be moved to the specified tablespace.
solution: Specify a valid tablespace.

message: The string operator can not be FALSE
cause: The value of the operator that is specified is FALSE
solution: Specify an operator that evaluates to TRUE

message: The string operator has incorrect RHS value
cause: The right hand side value that has been specified for the operator does not evaluate to TRUE
solution: Specify value on the right hand side that evaluate to TRUE

message: Cyclic definition encountered for string : " string "
cause: The schema definition for this type has cycles.
solution: Remove cyclic definition and re-compile schema.

message: Cannot create schema URL with reserved prefix "http://xmlns.oracle.com/xdb/schemas/"
cause: This prefix is reserved for XDB extended schema URLs and cannot be used in a user specified URL.
solution: Modify the prefix to a different one.

message: invalid XML document
cause: The XML document is invalid with respect to its XML Schema.
solution: Fix the errors identified and try again.

message: attribute string not in XDB namespace
cause: The specified attribute should be prefixed with XDB's namespace.
solution: Ensure that all XDB specified attributes are prefixed with XDB's namespace and try again.

message: Invalid Content-Type charset
cause: HTTP Content-Type header had a charset that Oracle does not understand.
solution: Fix the Content-Type header in the HTTP request.

message: schema " string " currently being referenced
cause: The specified schema URL is currently being referenced by the same session. This could happen because of PLSQL XMLType variables still in scope.
solution: Ensure all references to this schema in this session are released and try the operation again.

message: XML DB is in an invalid state
cause: XML DB's internal tables are in an invalid state, probably because the database was not upgraded or the upgrade was not successful
solution: Ensure that the database is upgraded successfully. If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support

message: max substitution group size string exceeded by " string " ( string ) for head element " string " ( string )
cause: The maximum limit on nested substitution groups has been exceeded by an element.
solution: Delete specified schema and re-register it after removing the offending substitution element.

message: element or attribute " string " cannot be stored out of line
cause: An element or attribute of a simple type has SQLInline=false
solution: Remove the SQLInline=false qualification for the offending element or attribute

message: element or attribute " string " has no SQLType specified
cause: Schema registration was invoked with GENTYPES=false without specifying a SQLType for some element or attribute
solution: Specify a SQLType for the offending element or attribute and register the schema again

message: element or attribute " string " has invalid attribute value " string " (should be " string ")
cause: An element or attribute for a complextype derived by restriction has an attribute whose value is different from that in the base type
solution: Remove the mismatched attribute values from the offending element or attribute

message: cannot load object-relational XML attribute using direct path
cause: The table being loaded contains a xml column with object-relational storage. The xmltype column contains a type with subtypes. This type of attribute cannot be loaded with direct path.
solution: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

message: cannot load object-relational XML attribute using direct path
cause: The table being loaded contains a xml column with object-relational storage. The xmltype column either contains an out-of-line partitioned table or the table itself is partitioned by one of the attributes of xmltype. This type of table cannot be loaded with direct path.
solution: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

message: XML nodes over 64K in size cannot be inserted
cause: An attempt was made to insert an XML Text Node with a size greater than 64K. This is not supported.
solution: Create text nodes under 64K.

message: Node localname and namespace values should be less than 64K
cause: An attempt was made to specify an XML Node with localname or namespace value greater than or equal to 64K. This is not supported.
solution: Node localnames and namespace values should be under 64K.

message: DOM Type mismatch in invalid PL/SQL DOM handle
cause: The specified PL/SQL DOM handle is referencing a DOM Node whose DOM Type that does not match the one available in the session. This could happen because the pl/sql handle was reused, or the original document is no longer available.
solution: Ensure that the pl/sql handle for the target node is valid and try the operation again.

message: PL/SQL DOM handle accesses node that is no longer available
cause: The specified pl/sql handle is referencing a node in a DOM Document that is no longer available.
solution: Ensure that the pl/sql handle for the target node is valid and try the operation again.

message: Too many PL/SQL DOM handles specified
cause: An attempt was made to create a PL/SQL DOM handle that exceeded the maximum allowable number of PL/SQL DOM handles.
solution: Free PL/SQL DOM handles and try the operation again.

message: DOM Nodes do not belong to the same DOM Document
cause: The specified PL/SQL DOM Node does not belong to the parent DOM Document of the referring DOM Node.
solution: Ensure that both the DOM Nodes are part of the same DOM Document.

message: Resource string is not a version-controlled resource
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Checkout is requested for a resource that isn't under version control". Only version-controlled resource can be checked out. - Checkout is requested for a row of a non-versioned table.
solution: put the resource under version-control before checking out.

message: Resource string is already checked out
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Checkout is requested for a resource that is already checked out to the workspace by the same of different user.
solution: checked in the resource from the workspace before checking out

message: Resource string has not been checked out
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Checkin or uncheckout is requested for a resource that has not been checked out to the workspace by any user in a workspace
solution: checked in the resource from the workspace before checking out

message: This versioning feature isn't supported for resource string
cause: Either one of the following is the cause: - Container cannot be put under version-controlled.
solution: Avoid using these features.

message: Resource string is already deleted
cause: Access a version-controlled resource that is already deleted.
solution: Remove the cyclic definitions in the type and retry compilation.

message: XML node ' string ' (type= string ) does not support this operation
cause: The given node's type is not supported for this operation. For example, trying to add children to an attribute node, or passing in a document node as a child, are unsupported operations.
solution: Use a valid node type for the operation.

message: XML nodes over string in size cannot be printed
cause: An attempt was made to use an XML Text Node with a size greater than 64K, or an XML Comment Node with a size greater than 4K. These cannot be printed. For example, trying to add children to an attribute node, or passing in a document node as a child, are unsupported operations.
solution: Use getClobVal() or getStringVal() to print the Document.

message: Error in processing file string
cause: An error occurred while operating on the specifed file. The possible causes are the file header is corrupt or check the next error on stack
solution: Ensure that the specified file is correct. Look at the next error on the stack and take appropriate action.

message: Mismatch in number of bytes transferred due to non-binary mode
cause: An error occurred while reading the specifed file. The most probable cause is that the transfer was initiated in ASCII mode.
solution: Ensure that the transfer mode is set to BINARY

message: Warning in processing file string
cause: A warning was raised while operating on the specifed file. However, the current operation was completed successfully.
solution: This is primarily an informational message. Look at the next error on the stack to obtain further information.

message: unable to initialize Summary Advisor environment
cause: The Summary Advisor external procedure initialization process failed.
solution: Contact Oracle Worldwide Support.

message: OCI error
cause: A OCI callback routine reported an error
solution: Contact Oracle Worldwide Support.

message: out of memory
cause: Summary Advisor failed to allocate the necessary memory.
solution: Contact Oracle Worldwide Support.

message: internal error
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Worldwide Support.

message: syntax error
cause: A syntax error occurred.
solution: Correct syntax error if possible or contact Oracle Worldwide Support.

message: no fact-tables could be found
cause: The fact-filter is not specified, and there are no fact-tables in the warehouse. A fact-table is a table having foreign-key constraints to one or more of the dimension-tables in the data warehouse.
solution: Check the fact-filter is correctly specified; check that appropriate constraints exist; and the user has privileges to access the tables

message: no dimensions could be found
cause: The database does not have any dimensions
solution: Create the dimensions in your warehouse

message: statistics missing on tables/columns
cause: The system metadata does not contain statistics on one or more tables or columns. The Advisor needs cardinalities of all fact-tables, and of the level-keys of all dimensions in the data warehouse.
solution: Run ANALYZE on the tables and summaries in the warehouse to collect statistics

message: statistics missing on materialized views

message: invalid fact-tables specified in fact-filter
cause: The tables specified in the fact-filter are not valid fact-tables. A fact-table must have foreign-key constraints to one or more of the dimension-tables in the data warehouse.
solution: Check the fact-filter is correctly specified; check that appropriate constraints exist; and the user has privileges to access the tables

message: invalid summaries specified in the retention-list
cause: The summaries specified in the retention-list are not valid.
solution: Check the spelling of the summary-names; check that they are valid; and the user has privileges to access them.

message: one or more of the workload tables is missing
cause: One or both of the workload tables are missing. The two workload tables which should be present in the user's schema are V_192216243_F_5_E_14_8_1 and V_192216243_F_5_E_15_8_1; the former is mapped to WORK$_IDEAL_MVIEW and the latter to WORK$_MVIEW_USAGE. The workload tables are created by the Oracle Trace Formatter when the data-collection-file (oraclesm.dat) is formatted by the user.
solution: Check whether the Formatter succeeded in formatting the data collection. Sometimes the V_192216243_F_5_E_14_8_1 (i.e WORK$_IDEAL_MVIEW) may not be created whereas the other table is created. The most likely cause of this is the init.ora parameters needed to invoke mview-rewrite are not enabled. Check your documentation for all the init.ora parameters which need to be set for mview-rewrite to occur. Another possibility is no GROUP BY queries were issued during the time the data was collected, in which case, run the Trace collection for a longer time to get a representative sampling of the queries issued in the data warehouse.

message: the size of must-retain summaries exceeds specified space limit
cause: The specified space limit is greater than the size of must-retain summaries.
solution: Reduce the number of must-retain summaries or increase the space limit

message: inline view or subquery in FROM list not supported for this type MV
cause: You have specified a materialized view that references an inline view or a subquery. The indicated capability is not supported for this type of materialized view.
solution: Restructure the materialized view query.

message: MV is not fast refreshable even with view merging
cause: You have a materialized view with view in the FROM clause, however it does not meet the criteria for fast refresh after view merging.
solution: Restructure the materialized view query to remove the offending view or the complex construct in the view.

message: see the reason why REFRESH_FAST_AFTER_ONETAB_DML is disabled
cause: REFRESH_FAST_AFTER_ANY_DML is disabled for the same reason that REFRESH_FAST_AFTER_ONETAB_DML is disabled.
solution: Correct the problem with REFRESH_FAST_AFTER_ONETAB_DML.

message: the detail table does not have a materialized view log
cause: The fast refresh cannot be performed because the master table does not contain a materialized view log.
solution: Use the CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW LOG command to create a materialized view log on the master table.

message: cannot use object id columns from materialized view log
cause: The materialized view log either does not have object id columns logged, or the timestamp associated with the object id columns is more recent than the last refresh time.
solution: A complete refresh is required before the next fast refresh. Add object id columns to the materialized view log, if required.

message: the materialized view contains partition extended table name
cause: Fast refresh of materialized aggregate views and/or materialized join views are not supported if they were defined using partition extended table names.
solution: Create the fast refreshable materialized view without using partition extended table names or create the materialized view as a complete refresh materialized view.

message: tables must be identical across the UNION operator
cause: You have specified a materialized view using the UNION operator and the tables on each side of the UNION operator do not match. Fast refresh is not supported in this context.
solution: Restructure the materialized view query such that the respective sides of the UNION operator have the same table.

message: the materialized view has a join operation in the outer UNION block
cause: Fast refresh is not supported if a materialized view having the UNION operator contains a join operation.
solution: Rewrite the materialized view query without the join.

message: the unique constraints does not exist on the join columns of the inner table
cause: If there are outer joins, unique constraints must exist on the join columns of the inner table. Othwerwise, the materialized view can not be fast refreshable.
solution: None

message: the materialized view does not have a UNION ALL marker column
cause: For a materialized view with UNION ALL to be fast refreshable, it must have a UNION ALL marker column. This is a constant column, at the same ordinal position in each query block and must have distinct values in each query block.
solution: Add a UNION ALL marker column to each query block in the UNION ALL query defining the materialized view.

message: some query block in UNION ALL MV is not fast refreshable
cause: For a materialized view with UNION ALL to be fast refreshable, each query block must conform to a fast refreshable materialized join view or materialized aggregate view.
solution: Check each query block in the UNION ALL to ensure it is either a materialized view with joins or aggregates.

message: MV with UNION ALL in a view is too complex
cause: If a materialized view has a view whose definition involves a UNION ALL query, then the materialized view's defining query cannot have any clauses other than SELECT or FROM. Other clauses such as WHERE, HAVING, CONNECT BY, or GROUP BY are not allowed. Further more, the FROM clause should have only one item.
solution: Remove any clauses besides SELECT and FROM from the materialized view's defining query.

message: MV with UNION ALL in a view must match the view's SELECT list
cause: If a materialized view has a view whose definition involves a UNION ALL query, then the materialized view's select list must match the underlying view's select list exactly. It must not have any expressions and must not have add/drop/reorder columns from the underlying view.
solution: Use select * when defining a materialized view with a UNION ALL in a view.

message: MV has a view with UNION ALL that is not fast refreshable
cause: The materialized view has a view whose definition involves a UNION ALL query that does not satisfy the requirements for fast refresh.
solution: Check that the defining query of the view being referenced in the materialized view satisfies conditions for fast refresh of a UNION ALL materialized view.

message: MV with UNION ALL requires compatibility >= 9.2
cause: The setting of the COMPATIBLE initialization parameter is less than 9.2.0.
solution: Set COMPATIBLE to 9.2.0 or higher.

message: no primary key constraint in the master table
cause: The explain_mview assumes that the materialized view is going to be created as the Primary Key materialized view. A Primary Key materialized view can not be created if the base table does not have a primary key constraint.
solution: Add a primary key constraint to the base table, or create the materialized view as Rowid MV by specifying the WITH ROWID option. If the materialized view is a Rowid MV, then it should be able to do complete refresh and even fast refresh, given that the materialized view log on the master table has a rowid.

message: a SPREADSHEET clause is present
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view uses a SPREADSHEET clause.
solution: Remove the SPREADSHEET clause.

message: PCT is enabled through a join dependency
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view does not contain some expression join dependent on the partitioning key of relation in question in the select list. For definition of join dependency, please look at Oracle documentation.
solution: Change the query to contain the partitioning key

message: Expression to enable PCT not in PARTITION BY of analytic function or SPREADSHEET
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the expression is not in the PARTITION BY clause
solution: Change the query so that the expression is in the PARTITION BY

message: Expression to enable PCT cannot be rolled up
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the expression is rolled up
solution: Change the query so that the expression is not rolled up

message: no partition key or PMARKER in select list
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view unless the select list (and group by list if a GROUP BY clause is present) includes either the partition key of or a PMARKER function reference to the table in question.
solution: Add the partition key or a PMARKER function reference to the select list (and the GROUP BY clause, if present).

message: PARTITIONED OUTER JOIN is present
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view has PARTITIONED OUTER JOIN.
solution: Remove PARTITIONED OUTER JOIN.

message: materialized view on external table
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view references an external table.
solution: Re-phrase the query to avoid the use of the external tables.

message: named view in FROM list not supported for this type MV
cause: You have specified a materialized view that references a named view The indicated capability is not supported for this type of materialized view.
solution: Restructure the materialized view query.

message: materialized view definition changes
cause: The definition of the materialized view has changed. Usually redefining the synonym or table in the definition can cause this. The materialized view can not be fast refreshed.
solution: Complete refresh or recreate the materialized view.

message: SQL PIVOT or UNPIVOT is present
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view has sql PIVOT or UNPIVOT operation.
solution: Remove sql PIVOT or UNPIVOT.

message: types of MV logs are not compatible
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view is defined on detail tables which do not have a compatible type of materialized view logs, either all timestamp based or commit SCN based.
solution: Complete refresh or recreate materialized view logs.

message: commit SCN based MV log is not in consistent state
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the relevant materialized view log is not in consistent state due to the failure when populating the mapping table of SYS.SNAP_XCMT$.
solution: Perform a complete refresh of the materialized view.

message: unsupported MV on commit SCN based MV logs
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the relevant materialized view is not supported to be defined on detail tables which have commit SCN based MV logs.
solution: None

message: CASE expressions present in materialized view
cause: The capability in question is not supported when the materialized view contain CASE expressions.
solution: Re-phrase the query to avoid the use of CASE expressions.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if query contains a named view
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained a named view.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of named views.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if query contains an inline view
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained an inline view.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of an inline view.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if query contains a remote table
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained a remote table.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of a remote table.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if HAVING clause includes a subquery
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query HAVING clause included a subquery.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of a subquery in the HAVING clause.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if WHERE clause includes a subquery
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query WHERE clause included a subquery.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of a subquery in the WHERE clause.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if query contains LEFT OUTER, RIGHT OUTER or FULL OUTER JOIN
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained LEFT OUTER, RIGHT OUTER or FULL OUTER JOIN.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of LEFT OUTER, RIGHT OUTER or FULL OUTER JOIN.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if there is a self join or self cartesian product in query
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained self join of self cartesian product in the query.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of self joins or self cartesian product in the query.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if query has ORDER BY clause
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained an ORDER BY clause.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of the ORDER BY clause.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if query has set operand query blocks
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained set operand query blocks.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of set operand query blocks.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if query has an inner query
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained an inner query.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of the inner query.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible if there is a subquery inside select-list
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query contained a subquery inside a select-list.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of a subquery inside a select-list.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible because this query join may produce extra duplicate rows
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view contained a join condition that can result in duplicate rows in the materialized view.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the occurrence of duplicate rows in the materialized view.

message: PCT FAST REFRESH is not possible for complex queries
cause: The capability in question was not supported because the materialized view query was too complex.
solution: No action is necessary.

message: subquery using the NOT IN clause in materialized view
cause: The capability in question was not supported when the materialized view uses NOT IN with a subquery.
solution: Rephrase the query to avoid the use of the NOT IN clause.

message: Invalid CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW statement string
cause: The CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW statement that was passed into the procedure was not a valid one.
solution: Check the reason(s) following the error or the statement and retry the operation.

cause: The MATERIALIZED VIEW statement could not be tuned.

cause: The materialized view was created with the FOR UPDATE option.

message: Cannot tune materialized view ON PREBUILT table
cause: The materialized view was created on a prebuilt table.
solution: Rephrase the statement to avoid the use of the ON PREBUILT option.

cause: The materialized view has the capabilities that are specified in the statement.
solution: None

cause: The materialized view could not be tuned or decomposed to be fast refreshable.
solution: Run the dbms_mview.explain_mview to find out the reason.

cause: RMAN was run with input/output being sent to DBMS_PIPE. An error was encountered while reading from or writing to the pipe. This error should be preceded by information describing the error.

cause: The PIPE and CMDFILE options cannot be used together. When using the PIPE option, RMAN must obtain its input from the input pipe.
solution: Remove either the PIPE or CMDFILE option.

message: PIPE requires that TARGET be specified on the command line
cause: The PIPE option obtains its input from, and writes its output to, an Oracle database pipe in the target database. Therefore, the target database connection must be specified on the command line, so that RMAN can connect to the target database to receive its input from the pipe.
solution: Specify the TARGET option on the RMAN command line.

message: pipe string is not private and owned by SYS
cause: The pipe that RMAN needs to use for its input or output is either a public pipe or a private pipe that is not owned by SYS. This is a potential security problem, because it allows a non-SYS user to issue commands to RMAN or to retrieve the RMAN output.
solution: If you are attempting to put data on the RMAN input pipe prior to starting RMAN, so RMAN will process the data on the pipe as soon as it starts, you must be connected as SYS and you must first use the DBMS_PIPE.CREATE_PIPE function to explicitly create the pipe as a private pipe.

cause: The SCRIPT and CMDFILE options cannot be used together. When using the SCRIPT option, RMAN executes only the specified script.

cause: No password was provided for the target database.
solution: Provide target database password.

message: recovery catalog database Password:
cause: No password was provided for the recovery catalog database.
solution: Provide recovery catalog database password.

message: auxiliary database Password:
cause: No password was provided for the auxiliary database.
solution: Provide auxiliary database password.

message: must connect before startup
cause: A STARTUP command was attempted before connecting to the database.
solution: Connect to database before attempting STARTUP command.

message: startup failed: string
cause: The database failed to startup.
solution: The cause of the failure is included in the error message. Correct the cause of the failure and retry the startup command.

message: error setting target database character set to string
cause: An error was received while setting the session character set in the target database.
solution: This error should not normally happen. Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: could not get OCI error handle
cause: An error was received while initializing the OCI layer.
solution: This error should not normally happen. Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: startup error description: string
cause: of failure.
solution: No action is required.

message: target database name " string " does not match channel's name: " string "
cause: The CONNECT clause in the ALLOCATE command has resulted in a connection to a database which is not the same as the one used to connect to the target database.
solution: Verify that the CONNECT string connects to the same database as the one specified in the TARGET connection for the CONNECT command.

message: target database DBID string does not match channel's DBID string
cause: The CONNECT clause in the ALLOCATE command has resulted in a connection to a database which is not the same as the one used to connect to the target database.
solution: Verify that the CONNECT string connects to the same database as the one specified in the TARGET connection for the CONNECT command.

message: target database mount id string does not match channel's mount id string
cause: The CONNECT clause in the ALLOCATE command has resulted in a connection to a database which is not the same as the one used to connect to the target database.
solution: Verify that the CONNECT string connects to the same database as the one specified in the TARGET connection for the CONNECT command.

message: starting Oracle instance without parameter file for retrieval of spfile
cause: The instance could not be started because no default parameter file (either PFILE or SPFILE) could be found. The instance will be started in restricted mode with default parameters.
solution: None - this is an informational message.

message: unable to generate a temporary file
cause: Creation of a temporary file failed. If could be that the system does not have enough resources (disk space, memory or similar).
solution: Verify and free some system resources memory and try again.

message: unable to open a temporary file: " string "
cause: Opening of a temporary file failed. If could be that the system does not have enough resources (disk space, memory or similar).
solution: Verify and free some system resources memory and try again.

message: unable to write to a temporary file: " string "
cause: Writing to a temporary file failed. If could be that the system does not have enough resources (disk space, memory or similar).
solution: Verify and free some system resources memory and try again.

message: initialization parameters used for automatic instance: string
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: using contents of file string
cause: The specified file was included as part of the auxiliary database parameter file. This is an informational message.
solution: No action is required.

message: cannot open auxiliary parameter file string
cause: An auxiliary parameter file was specified with SET AUXILIARY INSTANCE PARAMETER FILE command but the specified file cannot be found.
solution: Set the parameter file to an existent file or retry the command without setting AUXILIARY INSTANCE PARAMETER FILE.

message: source recovery catalog database Password:
cause: A password was not provided for the source recovery catalog database.
solution: Provide source recovery catalog database password.

message: error from source recovery catalog database: string
cause: Oracle error signaled by source recovery catalog database. This message should be accompanied by other error message(s) indicating the cause of the error.
solution: Check the accompanying errors.

message: WARNING from source recovery catalog database: string
cause: Nonfatal Oracle error signaled by source recovery catalog database. This message should be accompanied by other error message(s) indicating the cause of the error.
solution: Check the accompanying errors.

message: CONFIGURE AUXNAME required for datafile string
cause: Either: -) The control file mounted by the auxiliary database does not have an entry for this datafile, therefore file name conversion is not possible. -) A COPY DATAFILE TO AUXNAME command was issued, but no auxname was set for this datafile.
solution: Use the CONFIGURE AUXNAME command to specify a file name that the auxiliary database can use as a restore destination.

message: auxiliary file name string conflicts with a file used by the target database
cause: RMAN is attempting to use the specified file name as a restore destination in the auxiliary database, but this name is already in use by the target database.
solution: Use the CONFIGURE AUXNAME command to specify a name for the data file that does not conflict with a file name in use by the target db.

message: aborting Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery
cause: Previously encountered error(s) were issued which require corrective action.
solution: Resolve the error conditions, and then re-issue the RECOVER command.

message: Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery is not allowed for tablespace string
cause: The SYSTEM, SYSUAX or a tablespace containing rollback segments is not allowed in Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery.
solution: Remove the indicated tablespace from the recovery set and retry the operation.

message: target database log mode is NOARCHIVELOG
cause: An attempt was made to apply Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery to a database that is in NOARCHIVELOG mode.
solution: If all required archived log files are available for Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery, alter the target database log mode to ARCHIVELOG and retry the Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery operation. Otherwise, Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery cannot be applied to this database.

message: Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery is not allowed for re-created tablespace string
cause: The requested tablespace has been re-created and is not allowed in Point-in-Time Recovery.
solution: Remove the indicated tablespace from the recovery set and retry the operation.

message: cannot recover clone standby single tablespaces
cause: Standby recover can only be performed for the whole database.
solution: Change the tablespace list to a database specification.

message: no channel allocated
cause: A command was entered that requires a channel, and no channel is allocated.
solution: Use ALLOCATE CHANNEL before using the command

message: Block Media Recovery requires Enterprise Edition
cause: The RECOVER...BLOCK command was specified.
solution: Remove the RECOVER...BLOCK command.

message: target database must be opened in READ WRITE mode for Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery
cause: The target database was not opened in read write mode.
solution: Open the database in read write mode.

message: auxiliary instance must be in NOMOUNT state for Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery
cause: The Auxiliary instance was not in NOMOUNT state.
solution: Open the auxiliary instance in NOMOUNT state.

message: auxiliary control file name string conflicts with a file used by the target database
cause: RMAN is attempting to use the specified control file name for Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery as a restore destination in the auxiliary database, but this name is already in use by the target database.
solution: Set control_files parameter in the auxiliary instance to a name that does not conflict with a file name in use by the target database.

message: Tablespaces with undo segments were not found in recovery catalog
cause: The recovery catalog did not have information about tablespaces with undo segments.
solution: Manually specify the tablespaces with undo segments in the optional UNDO tablespaces clause of the RECOVER command.

message: WARNING: not enough information in recovery catalog for specified point-in-time recovery
cause: The recovery catalog did not have information about the tablespaces with undo segments at the specified Point-in-Time. This happened because the current recovery catalog was not in use at the specified Point-in-Time. A list of tablespaces with undo segments was supplied.
solution: RMAN assumes that the current set of tablespaces with undo segments is the same set that was in use at the specified Point-in-Time. If the set of tablespaces with undo segments changes, the recovery fails. If recovery fails, use the optional UNDO TABLESPACE clause of the RECOVER command to specify the correct set of tablespaces.

message: failover to previous backup
cause: This is an informational message to indicate the RMAN could not successfully restore the files using the specified backups. An attempt was made to restore the datafile/archived logs/ control file/SPFILE using a previous existing backup.
solution: See accompanying additional error messages indicating the cause of the failover.

message: no copy of datafile number found to recover
cause: A RECOVER COPY command was not able to proceed because no copy of indicated file was found to recover. Possible causes include the following: 1. no copy of indicated file exists on disk that satisfy the criteria specified in the user's recover operands. 2. copy of indicated datafile exists on disk but no incremental backup was found to apply to the datafile copy.
solution: One of the following: 1. Use or correct TAG specification to recover a different datafile copy. 2. Use BACKUP FOR RECOVER OF COPY command to create necessary incremental backup or copy.

message: some datafile copies cannot be recovered, aborting the RECOVER command
cause: This error message can follow one or more RMAN-5017 or RMAN-5019 error messages.
solution: See RMAN-5017 or RMAN-5019 error messages documentation for more information.

message: WARNING: no channel of required type allocated to recover copy of datafile number
cause: A RECOVER COPY command could not proceed because incremental backup sets exist on a device type that has not been allocated.
solution: Use the LIST command to determine which device type is needed, then allocate a channel of that type.

message: cannot specify AUXILIARY DESTINATION option for normal recovery
cause: The AUXILIARY DESTINATION option was specified for a normal recovery. It is only allowed for Tablespace Point-in-Time Recovery.
solution: Remove the AUXILIARY DESTINATION option and re-run the RECOVER command.

message: this configuration cannot be changed for a BACKUP or STANDBY control file
cause: The user attempted to modify the configuration which cannot be changed for a BACKUP or STANDBY control file while the mounted control file was either BACKUP or STANDBY. The following configurations can be changed only when connected to primary database instance that has CURRENT/CREATED control file type mounted: CONFIGURE RETENTION POLICY CONFIGURE EXCLUDE CONFIGURE ENCRYPTION CONFIGURE DB_UNIQUE_NAME
solution: Connect to primary database instance and execute the command.

message: TRANSPORT TABLESPACE may not be used with user-managed auxiliary instance
cause: A user-managed auxiliary instance was specified.
solution: Retry the operation with an RMAN-managed auxiliary instance.

message: TABLESPACE DESTINATION required
cause: A required TABLESPACE DESTINATION was not specified.
solution: Specify a TABLESPACE DESTINATION and retry the operation.

message: List of tablespaces presumed to have UNDO segments
cause: Accompanying message to 5015.
solution: See action of message 5015.

message: Tablespace string
cause: Accompanying message to 5015.
solution: See action of message 5015.

message: WARNING: presuming following set of tablespaces applies to specified point-in-time
cause: RMAN assumes that the current set of tablespaces with undo segments is the same set that was in use at the specified Point-in-Time.
