solution: No action required, this is an informational message only.

message: database not open: sort area size too small
cause: sort area size too small to execute RMAN commands.
solution: open the database or increase sort_area_size.

message: could not locate archived log string
cause: The specified archived log could not be found on any allocated channel.
solution: Allocate additional channels on other nodes of the cluster or, if the archived logs has been deleted, use the CROSSCHECK ARCHIVELOG command to correct the recovery catalog or target database control file entries.

message: could not locate datafile copy string
cause: The specified datafile copy could not be found on any allocated channel.
solution: Allocate additional channels on other nodes of the cluster or if the datafile copy has been deleted, use the CROSSCHECK DATAFILECOPY command to correct the recovery catalog or target database control file entries.

message: could not locate control file copy string
cause: The specified control file copy could not be found on any allocated channel.
solution: Allocate additional channels on other nodes of the cluster or if the control file copy has been deleted, use the CROSSCHECK CONTROLFILECOPY command to correct the recovery catalog or target database control file entries.

message: no backup of the SPFILE found to restore
cause: A SPFILE restore could not proceed because no backup of the SPFILE was found. It may be the case that a backup of this file exists but does not satisfy the criteria specified in the user's restore operands.
solution: Modify options for the SPFILE restore.

message: no channel to restore a backup of the SPFILE
cause: A SPFILE restore could not proceed because the backup on a device type that was not allocated for restore.
solution: No action required, this is an informational message only. See message 6026 for further details.

message: command string : string % complete, time left number : number : number
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: database dropped
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: database unregistered from the recovery catalog
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: database name " string " does not match target database name " string "
cause: The UNREGISTER DATABASE command was used with a database name that does not match the name of the database to which RMAN is connected.
solution: Specify the correct database name or avoid specifying the database name when connected to the target database.

message: database name " string " is not unique in the recovery catalog
cause: The UNREGISTER DATABASE command was used with a database name that is ambiguous.
solution: Use the SET DBID command to specify the database id and resolve the ambiguity.

message: database " string " is not found in the recovery catalog
cause: The UNREGISTER DATABASE command was used with a database name that was not found in the recovery catalog.
solution: Make sure the database name specified in the DROP DATABASE command syntax is correct.

message: database name is not specified
cause: The command failed because of the following: o RMAN is not connected to the target database o The database name is not specified in the command o DBID is not set with the SET DBID command
solution: Any one of the following actions will fix the problem: o Connect to the target database o Specify database name o Set DBID with SET DBID command

message: database name is " string " and DBID is string
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: platform name ' string ' longer than number
cause: The specified platform name exceeds the maximum allowable platform name.
solution: Correct the platform name.

message: specification does not match any backup set in the repository
cause: The specified backup sets were not found in the recovery catalog or target database control file.
solution: Verify backup set existence and retry the command.

message: specification does not match any datafile copy in the repository
cause: The specified datafile copies were not found in the recovery catalog or target database control file.
solution: Verify datafile copy existence and retry the command.

message: skipping datafile copy string ; already backed up string time(s)
cause: The indicated datafile copy was not included in the backup set because it was already backed up on the device requested.
solution: Use FORCE option to override backup optimization.

message: backup cancelled because there are no files to backup
cause: There were no files or all files were skipped for this backup set, therefore no backup set was created.
solution: This message is informational only.

message: at least 1 channel of tertiary storage must be allocated to execute this command
cause: The executed command requires a SBT channel, but no channels of type SBT were configured or allocated.
solution: ALLOCATE or CONFIGURE a SBT channel.

message: more than one channel types were allocated
cause: RECOVERY FILES, RECOVERY AREA or DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST option was specified in BACKUP command, but more than one channel types was used and no DEVICE TYPE or CHANNEL option was specified.
solution: Specify CHANNEL or DEVICE TYPE option and retry the command.

message: restore point string does not exist.
cause: The specified restore point does not exists in v$restore_point table of the target database.
solution: Check the name of restore point and retry the command.

message: SPFILE cannot be backed up by proxy.
cause: The PROXY option was specified, but proxy copy of SPFILE is not supported. This file will be placed into a non-proxy backup set.
solution: No action required, this is an informational message only.

message: ASM file string cannot be proxy backed up.
cause: The PROXY option was specified, but proxy copy of ASM file is not supported. This file will be placed into a non-proxy backup set.
solution: No action required, this is an informational message only.

message: error while looking up tempfile: string
cause: An error occurred while looking up the specified tempfile in the recovery catalog or target database control file.
solution: This error is accompanied by other errors describing the reason for the failure; see those error messages for further information. One possible problem is that the tempfile name was not entered correctly.

message: tempfile not found in the repository
cause: The specified tempfile is not found in the control file or recovery catalog.
solution: Make sure that the tempfile name is correct and retry

message: INCREMENTAL FROM SCN option is not supported with [ string ]
cause: The INCREMENTAL FROM SCN option was supplied but does not apply to this type of backup.
solution: Remove the INCREMENTAL FROM SCN operand and re-enter the command.

message: WARNING: datafile string : incremental-start SCN is too recent; using checkpoint SCN string instead
cause: The incremental-start sysetm change number (SCN) which was specified when starting an incremental datafile backup is greater than the datafile checkpoint SCN, which could cause some blocks to be missed.
solution: Specify a smaller incremental-start system change number (SCN).

message: cannot flashback database to non-guaranteed restore point string when flashback is off
cause: The indicated restore point was not guaranteed and flashback was disabled. When flashback is disabled, Oracle can flashback only to guaranteed restore point.
solution: Specify a guaranteed restore point or turn on flashback and retry the command. the command.

message: DB_UNIQUE_NAME " string " does not match target database (" string ")
cause: The value specified in the FOR DB_UNIQUE_NAME option did not match the DB_UNIQUE_NAME parameter setting of the target database.
solution: Use the RMAN STARTUP command, with no parameter file option, to start the target database without a parameter file, then run the RESTORE SPFILE command again.

message: DB_UNIQUE_NAME is not unique in the recovery catalog
cause: RMAN could not identify which SPFILE to restore for this target database, because the recovery catalog contained two or more different instances of this database, each with different DB_UNIQUE_NAME values.
solution: Use the FOR DB_UNIQUE_NAME option to specify the name of the instance whose parameter file you want to restore.

message: skipping datafile copies that are already backed up
cause: Some datafile copies were not be backed up because they were already backed up on the device requested.
solution: No action is required. You can use the FORCE option to override backup optimization and force these files to be backed up.

message: skipping archived logs that are already backed up
cause: Some archived logs were not be backed up because they were already backed up on the device requested.
solution: No action is required. You can use the FORCE option to override backup optimization and force these files to be backed up.

message: skipping backup sets that are already backed up
cause: Some backup sets were not be backed up because they were already backed up on the device requested.
solution: No action is required. You can use the FORCE option to override backup optimization and force these files to be backed up.

message: ignoring encryption for proxy or image copies
cause: This information message is displayed when the RMAN client is generating proxy or image copies and encryption was enabled for the input files.
solution: This is an informational message only.

message: specified encryption algorithm not supported
cause: An encryption algorithm not supported by the database is specified during backup.
solution: Refer to contents of v$rman_encryption_algorithms view for the list of supported encryption algorithm. Specify a valid encryption algorithm and retry the command.

message: string
cause: An error occurred when processing user request.
solution: None

message: Tablespace string will be encrypted in future backup sets
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: Tablespace string will not be encrypted in future backup sets
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: Tablespace string will default to database encryption configuration
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: duplicate or conflicting options are specified: string and string
cause: An error occurred when processing the command because user specified two duplicate options or the two options are not allowed to be used together.
solution: Remove one of the above options and retry the command.

message: length of password must be greater than zero
cause: Zero length password was specified for encrypted backups.
solution: Retry the command using a password with non-zero length.

message: backup encryption requires Enterprise Edition
cause: The backup command tried to create encrypted backups, but Enterprise Edition is not installed.
solution: Do not create encrypted backups.

message: cannot do IMPORT CATALOG after NOCATALOG has been used
cause: The IMPORT CATALOG command was used after the NOCATALOG option was already specified.
solution: Restart RMAN and connect to recovery catalog if you wish to IMPORT CATALOG.

message: cannot do IMPORT CATALOG before connecting to recovery catalog
cause: The IMPORT CATALOG command was used before connecting to the recovery catalog.
solution: Connect to recovery catalog using CONNECT CATALOG command if you wish to IMPORT CATALOG.

message: connected to source recovery catalog database
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: must specify a TNS service name for source recovery catalog database
cause: The connect string does not contain TNS service name. IMPORT CATALOG without TNS service name is not supported.
solution: Specify a service name and resubmit the command.

message: not connected to source recovery catalog database
cause: IMPORT CATALOG command was issued but no connection to the source recovery catalog database has been established.
solution: Resubmit IMPORT CATALOG command with correct connect string.

message: source recovery catalog database not started
cause: IMPORT CATALOG command was issued which requires the source recovery catalog to be open.
solution: Open the source recovery catalog database and re-submit the command.

message: ORACLE error from source recovery catalog database: string
cause: This message should be accompanied by other error message(s) indicating the cause of the error.
solution: Check the accompanying errors.

message: WARNING: string : sqlcode number was caught, automatic retry # string
cause: The RMAN client caught a transient error during temporary resource allocate for IMPORT CATALOG command and will automatically retry several times.
solution: No action required, this is an informational message.

message: import validation complete
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action required.

message: database unregistered from the source recovery catalog
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: string package version string in source database is not of version string
cause: The catalog schema version of the source recovery catalog is not the same as the target recovery catalog. The two catalog
solution: UPGRADE source recovery catalog schema and recovery catalog schema to same version and retry the command.

message: Datafile headers of locally managed datafiles need to be updated.
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: Update of datafile headers of locally managed datafiles finished.
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: One or more datafile headers of locally managed datafiles were not updated.
cause: Errors prevented the update of one or more datafile headers.
solution: See trace file for details of the problem.

message: This operation might take some time.
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: could not read file header for datafile string to do FLASHBACK.
cause: The indicated datafile header could not be read to do FLASHBACK DATABASE.
solution: If the database must be taken back in time then a restore and incomplete recovery must be performed.

message: WARNING: TAG string option is ignored; backups will be tagged with string
cause: WITH TAG option and TAG option were used together. When WITH TAG option is used, all the backups created by the command will have tag specified with WITH TAG option.
solution: The TAG option can be removed to not display the message.

message: changed the DB_UNIQUE_NAME value from string to string
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: database db_unique_name is " string ", db_name is " string " and DBID is string
cause: UNREGISTER DB_UNIQUE_NAME or CHANGE DB_UNIQUE_NAME command was executed, hence RMAN displayed the database information for which DB_UNIQUE_NAME the metadata will be removed/renamed in the recovery catalog.
solution: No action required, this is an informational message only.

message: database with db_unique_name string unregistered from the recovery catalog
cause: UNREGISTER DB_UNIQUE_NAME command was executed.
solution: No action required, this is an informational message only.

message: Flashback database logging is not on.
cause: A FLASHBACK DATABASE command was tried but flashback database logging has not been enabled.
solution: Flashback database logging must be enabled via the ALTER DATABASE FLASHBACK ON command before a FLASHBACK DATABASE command can be tried. If the database must be taken back in time then a restore and incomplete recovery must be performed.

message: Not enough flashback database log data to do FLASHBACK.
cause: There was not enough flashback database log data to do the FLASHBACK DATABASE.
solution: If the database must be taken back in time then a restore and incomplete recovery must be performed.

message: Grant succeeded.
cause: This is an informational message issued in response to a GRANT command.
solution: No action required.

message: Revoke succeeded.
cause: This is an informational message issued in response to a REVOKE command.
solution: No action required.

message: found eligible base catalog owned by string
cause: When creating a virtual private catalog, an 11g base catalog was found, owned by the specified user, and the currently connected catalog user has been granted privileges on this catalog, and can therefore create a virtual private catalog using this base catalog. This is an informational message issued in response to a CREATE VIRTUAL CATALOG command.
solution: No action required.

message: found ineligible base catalog owned by string
cause: When creating a virtual private catalog, an 11g base catalog was found, owned by the specified user, and the currently connected catalog user has not been granted any privileges on this catalog. This is an informational message issued in response to a CREATE VIRTUAL CATALOG command.
solution: No action required.

message: no base catalog found
cause: When trying to create a virtual catalog, either no base catalog was found, or this user has no privilege to create a virtual catalog against any existing base catalog.
solution: Establish the correct privileges and re-create the virtual catalog.

message: too many eligible base catalogs found
cause: When trying to create a virtual catalog, more than one base catalog was found that is eligible to be the base catalog for this virtual catalog.
solution: Revoke privileges so that the current catalog user has privileges on only one base catalog, then re-issue the CREATE VIRTUAL CATALOG command.

message: created virtual catalog against base catalog owned by string
cause: A virtual private catalog was created, where the base catalog data is owned by the specified user. This is an informational message issued in response to a CREATE VIRTUAL CATALOG command.
solution: No action required.

message: Enter value for string :
cause: This is a user prompt.
solution: Enter a substitution value to proceed.

message: SET NEWNAME command has not been issued for tempfile string
cause: A SWITCH command was specified for a tempfile, but no destination was specified and no SET NEWNAME command has been previously issued for that file. An explicit file to switch to must be specified if no SET NEWNAME command has been issued.
solution: Correct and resubmit the SWITCH command.

message: compression algorithm ' string ' of release string not found
cause: An unsupported compression algorithm was specified for the backup.
solution: Query the V$RMAN_COMPRESSION_ALGORITHM view for the list of suppmrted compression algorithms. Specify a valid compression algorithm and retry the command.

message: compression algorithm ' string ' of release string cannot be used because database compatibility is less than string
cause: The compression algorithm is not supported because the current compatibility level of the database is too low.
solution: Query the V$RMAN_COMPRESSION_ALGORITHM view for the list of supported compression algorithms. Specify a valid compression algorithm and retry the command.

message: SECTION SIZE cannot be used when piece limit is in effect
cause: The SECTION SIZE backup option was used together with the MAXPIECESIZE channel limit. These options are mutually exclusive, because they are independant methods of creating multiple backup pieces with one backup command.
solution: Use one option or the other, but not both.

message: compression algorithm ' string ' of release string requires advanced compression option
cause: The compression algorithm was not supported because it requires advanced compression option to be enabled.
solution: Enable advanced compression option by setting advanced_compression_option_usable=true or specify a different compression algorithm.

message: specification does not match any datafile copy in the repository
cause: No datafile copies were found that match specification in the recovery catalog or target database control file.
solution: Check the specifier.

message: specification does not match any control file copy in the repository
cause: No control file copies were found that match specification in the recovery catalog or target database control file.
solution: Check the specifier.

message: specification does not match any backup in the repository
cause: No backups were found that match specification in the recovery catalog or target database control file.
solution: Check the specifier.

message: WARNING: last archived log from primary database not recieved at standby database
cause: An archived log was switched at the primary database during backup at the standby database and this log was not shipped to the standby database. The backup created at the standby database will need more logs to recover.
solution: Check whether the standby databse is configured correctly to recieve logs from the primary database.

message: current log archived at primary database
cause: The ALTER SYSTEM ARCHIVE LOG CURRENT command completed successfully at the primary database because the connected target instance was a physical standby database. The switched archived logs were included in the backup so that the backed files could be recovered to a consistent point-in-time.
solution: None. This is an informational message.

message: WARNING: failed to archive current log at primary database
cause: An attempt to switch the archived log at the primary database failed.
solution: Resolve the error messages associated with this message to avoid the warning.

message: recovery catalog is partially upgraded to string
cause: The recovery catalog database was not completely upgraded to the specified version. Either there were some errors during execution of UPGRADE CATALOG or UPGRADE CATALOG was cancelled before completion.
solution: Execute UPGRADE CATALOG again.

message: updating recovery catalog with new database incarnation
cause: The target database has a new incarnation that has not already been seen by the recovery catalog. This usually happens because a Point-in-Time Recovery was done. RMAN has made the necessary updates to the recovery catalog.
solution: This is an informational message only.

message: WARNING: unable to generate V$RMAN_STATUS or V$RMAN_OUTPUT row
cause: The routine createRmanStatusRow() or createRmanOutputRow() could add new row into V$RMAN_STATUS or V$RMAN_OUTPUT.
solution: Check the associated error messages. If the associated error message indicates a condition that can be corrected, do so, otherwise contact Oracle.

message: WARNING: disabling update of the V$RMAN_STATUS and V$RMAN_OUTPUT rows
cause: Informational message only.
solution: No action required.

message: AS COMPRESSED BACKUPSET option cannot be used when backing up backup sets
cause: The backup set was specified with AS COMPRESSED BACKUPSET.
solution: Remove the AS COMPRESSED BACKUPSET option.

message: backup of datafile string was cancelled
cause: This is an informational message displayed when PARTIAL option of DURATION option was specified on the BACKUP command and backup could not be completed within the given duration time.
solution: Run the BACKUP command to backup cancelled files, or let the next backup window backup the cancelled files. It should be noted that the files that were skipped in the current job will be given preference to other files for next the BACKUP command with DURATION option.

message: backup of archived log for thread number with sequence number and starting SCN of string was cancelled
cause: This is an informational message displayed when PARTIAL option of DURATION option was specified on the BACKUP command and backup could not be completed within the given duration time.
solution: Run BACKUP command to backup cancelled files, or let the next backup window backup the cancelled files. It should be noted that the files that were skipped in the current job will be given preference to other files for next the BACKUP command with DURATION option.

message: backup of backup set key number was cancelled
cause: This is an informational message displayed when PARTIAL option of DURATION option was specified on the BACKUP command and backup could not be completed within the given duration time.
solution: Run BACKUP command to backup cancelled files, or let the next backup window backup the cancelled files. It should be noted that the files that were skipped in the current job will be given preference to other files for next the BACKUP command with DURATION option.

message: backup of control file was cancelled
cause: This is an informational message displayed when PARTIAL option of DURATION option was specified on the BACKUP command and backup could not be completed within the given duration time.
solution: Run BACKUP command to backup cancelled files, or let the next backup window backup the cancelled files. It should be noted that the files that were skipped in the current job will be given preference to other files for next the BACKUP command with DURATION option.

message: MINIMIZE LOAD option not allowed for the specified input files
cause: This option was specified in a backup command specification for BACKUP BACKUPSET or BACKUP CURRENT CONTROLFILE command.
solution: Remove the MINIMIZE LOAD option and retry the command.

message: WARNING: operation will not run in parallel on the allocated channels
cause: RMAN allocated more than one channel for a job, but the job will not run in parallel on these channels because parallelism require Enterprise Edition.
solution: None

message: WARNING: parallelism require Enterprise Edition
cause: RMAN allocated more than one channel for a job, but the job will not run in parallel on these channels because parallelism require Enterprise Edition.
solution: None

message: can not invoke parallel recovery for test recovery
cause: Recover database was called with TEST and PARALLEL option
solution: Call recover database with either just the TEST or PARALLEL option

message: only one PARALLEL or NOPARALLEL clause may be specified
cause: Recover database was called with PARALLEL and NOPARALLEL option
solution: Call recover database with either just the PARALLEL or NOPARALLEL option.

message: backup of spfile was cancelled
cause: This is an informational message displayed when PARTIAL option of DURATION option was specified on the BACKUP command and backup could not be completed within the given duration time.
solution: Run BACKUP command to backup cancelled files, or let the next backup window backup the cancelled files. It should be noted that the files that were skipped in the current job will be given preference to other files for next the BACKUP command with DURATION option.

message: validate cancelled because there are no files to validate
cause: All files for this validate command were skipped, therefore no files to validate.
solution: This message is informational only.

message: BLOCK string must be greater or equal to BLOCK string
cause: The value of TO block number was less than the value of from block number.
solution: Increase the value of TO BLOCK past the value of from BLOCK and retry the command.

message: restore point string already exists
cause: The specified restore point already exists on this database.
solution: Use LIST RESTORE POINT to see existing names and retry the command with a unique restore point name.

message: WARNING: allocated SBT channel to Oracle Availability Machine in NOCATALOG mode
cause: Oracle Availability Machine might have run out of resources because congestion control could not be enabled in NOCATALOG mode.
solution: Use the CATALOG mode to connect RMAN to an Oracle Availability Machine instance.

message: database string is not open read-only
cause: CONVERT DATABASE attempted on a database that was not open read-only.
solution: Open the database in read-only mode and retry the operation.

message: Convert database check failed
cause: This database could not be transported because DBMS_TDB.CHECK_DB returned FALSE.
solution: None

message: External table string . string found in the database
cause: An external table was found in the database.
solution: Redefine the table in the transported database.

message: Directory string . string found in the database
cause: A directory object was found in the database.
solution: Redefine the directory in the transported database.

message: BFILE string . string found in the database
cause: A BFILE was found in the database.
solution: Redefine the BFILE in the transported database.

message: BFILEs are used in the system, please redefine them in the transported database
cause: BFILEs may or may not exist in the database. Automatically performed BFILE check failed because database was open read-only and could not allocate temporary space. This does not affect CONVERT DATABASE operation.
solution: Use DBMS_TDB.CHECK_EXTERNAL to perform BFILE check when the database is open in read/write mode.

message: User string with string privilege found in password file
cause: Password file was used.
solution: Re-create the password file on the target platform using ORAPWD for the transported database.

message: Cannot specify NEW DATABASE clause more than once
cause: NEW DATABASE clause specified more than once
solution: Remove redundant NEW DATABASE clause and retry the operation.

message: Cannot specify ON TARGET PLATFORM clause more than once
cause: ON TARGET PLATFORM clause specified more than once
solution: Remove redundant ON TARGET PLATFORM clause and retry the operation.

message: Cannot specify TRANSPORT SCRIPT clause more than once
cause: TRANSPORT SCRIPT clause specified more than once
solution: Remove redundant ON TARGET PLATFORM clause and retry the operation.

message: Cannot specify SKIP clause more than once
cause: SKIP clause specified more than once
solution: Remove redundant SKIP clause and retry the operation.

message: Cannot specify FROM PLATFORM clause
cause: CONVERT DATABASE command cannot use FROM PLATFORM clause.
solution: Change FROM PLATFORM clause and retry.

message: Database name ' string ' longer than number
cause: The specified database name exceeded the maximum allowable database name length.
solution: Correct the database name.

message: Transport script name too long
cause: The specified transport script name exceeded the maximum allowable script name length.
solution: Correct the script name.

message: Format string too long
cause: The specified format string exceeded the maximum allowable format string length.
solution: Correct the format string.

message: Convert script name too long
cause: The specified convert script name exceeded the maximum allowable script name length.
solution: Correct the script name.

message: Database must be closed and mounted EXCLUSIVE and RESTRICTED.
cause: DROP DATABASE was attempted while the database was open or not mounted EXCLUSIVE and RESTRICTED.
solution: Change the database state to mounted EXCLUSIVE and RESTRICTED.

message: OPTION number is invalid; OPTION must be between string and string
cause: An invalid OPTION was used.
solution: Change the OPTION argument.

message: no automatic repair OPTION number was listed in ADVISE FAILURE
cause: The OPTION specified was not one of the automatic repair options listed by ADVISE FAILURE or there were no options listed by the ADVISE FAILURE command.
solution: Change the OPTION argument or resubmit ADVISE FAILURE with a different set of failures.

message: contents of repair script:
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: no repair script present for REPAIRID string
cause: REPAIRID option specified in the command was invalid or the repair script had been purged from Automated Diagnostic Repository.
solution: Retry REPAIR FAILURE command with a different OPTION number.

message: executing repair script
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: searching flashback logs for block images until SCN string
cause: Starting the flashback log search for RECOVER...BLOCK command. The log is searched until the indicated system change number (SCN).
solution: None. This is an informational message displayed for RECOVER...BLOCK command.

message: searching flashback logs for block images
cause: Starting the flashback log search for RECOVER...BLOCK command. The log is searched until the end of the log.
solution: None. This is an informational message displayed for RECOVER...BLOCK command.

message: finished flashback log search, restored string blocks
cause: Flashback log search finished for RECOVER...BLOCK command.
solution: None. This is an informational message displayed for RECOVER...BLOCK command.

message: invalid validate option specified: string
cause: The specified object was invalid with VALIDATE command.
solution: Delete the invalid operand.

message: repair failure complete
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: database needs to be restarted
cause: The target database control file was missing.
solution: Restart the instance and repair the database.

message: no automatic repairs were listed by ADVISE FAILURE
cause: There were no automatic repairs listed by the ADVISE FAILURE command.
solution: Choose a different failure, submit ADVISE FAILURE command, and then submit REPAIR FAILURE command.

message: REPAIR command must be preceded by ADVISE command in same session
cause: The ADVISE command was not issued in the same session as the REPAIR command.
solution: Submit ADVISE command and then submit the REPAIR command in same session.

message: Network copies are only supported for image copies.
cause: An attempt was made to specify BACKUP AUXILIARY FORMAT without specifying the AS COPY clause. A network copy is only supported with an image copy.
solution: Seek an alternate method of copying the desired files.

message: create datafile failed; retry after removing string from OS
cause: An attempt was made to re-create a database file. This attempt failed.
solution: If the indicated file already exists, remove the file from operating system and retry the RMAN command.

message: finished standby search, restored string blocks
cause: Standby search finished for RECOVER...BLOCK command.
solution: None. This is an informational message displayed for RECOVER...BLOCK command.

message: Executing: string
cause: This is an informational message only.
solution: No action is required.

message: Reason: File was not created using DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST initialization parameter
cause: This message should be accompanied by other message(s) indicating the name of file that was not created using DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST initialization parameter. One of the following scenarios caused this error: 1) This is an archived log file and was created when the LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n initialization parameter was set explicitly to recovery area location. For example, LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_1='location=+FRA' where '+FRA' was also your DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST value. 2) This is an RMAN backup file and was created in a recovery area using the FORMAT option of the BACKUP command. 3) This is an online log file or current control file and was created prior to setting the recovery area. 4) This file fits none of the above scenarios and is not supported by the recovery area.
solution: All of following actions will resolve future occurrences of this error: 1) To create archived logs in recovery area, set the LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n initialization parameter to 'location=USE_DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST'. Do not explicitly set the LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n initialization parameter to a recovery area location. 2) To create RMAN backups in recovery area, do not use the FORMAT option of the BACKUP command. All of following actions will resolve current problem: 1) If this is an archived log file or an RMAN backup file, use the CATALOG command to re-catalog the files. 2) If this is an online log file or a current control file to be managed by the recovery area, re-create the file using the DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST initialization parameter.
