message: invalid trace level
cause: The trace level specified was incorrect.
solution: Specify a valid trace level.

message: Operation: string failed. Error: string
cause: An RD operation failed with the specified error.
solution: Re-try the operation with tracing enabled to to determine what happened.

message: invalid port number: number
cause: The port number specified for a service is invalid.
solution: Specify a port number that is greater than zero.

message: invalid number specified:
cause: The number specified contained non-numeric characters.
solution: Specify a number with only numeric characters.

message: invalid address format:
cause: The format specified for an address was incorrect.
solution: Specify a valid format.

message: results processor may not be null
cause: A null object was specified for the class that is to process the results of an operation.
solution: Specify a non-null object.

message: invalid instance uniqueness
cause: The uniqueness value specified for an instance was not valid.
solution: Specify a valid uniqueness value.

message: Invalid service instance attribute
cause: An attribute specified for a service instance was not valid.
solution: Specify an attribute in the correct format.

message: Invalid service instance tag: " string ". Available tags:
cause: The tag value specified for a service instance was incorrect.
solution: Specify a valid tag value.

message: invalid domain type: " string ". Available domain types:
cause: The type specified for a domain was not valid.
solution: Specify a valid domain type.

message: Unknown command: " string "
cause: An invalid command was specified.
solution: Specify a valid command.

message: Unknown option: " string "
cause: An invalid option was specified.
solution: Specify a valid option.

message: invalid flag value:
cause: The value specified for a flag was not valid.
solution: Specify a valid flag value.

message: deletion of trace output file failed:
cause: The tool attempted to remove a trace file so that it could create a new one. However, the attempt failed.
solution: Examine the accompanying exception for details about what happened.

message: deletion of error log file failed:
cause: The tool attempted to remove an error log so that it could create a new one. However, the attempt failed.
solution: Examine the accompanying exception for details about what happened.

solution: Remove the file or specify a file which does not exist.

message: error log already exists:
cause: The error log specified already exists.
solution: Remove the file or specify a file which does not exist.

cause: The trace file specified is actually a directory.
solution: Specify a file name.

message: error log is a directory:
cause: The error log specified is actually a directory.

message: The error log " string " cannot be created. Check permissions on the parent directory:
cause: The tool failed to create the error log.

message: invalid time-to-live:
cause: A non-numeric value was specified for the time to live.
solution: Specify a numeric value.

message: Option type must be greater than zero:
cause: The type specified for an option was less than or equal to zero.

message: unknown type:
cause: The type specified is invalid.
solution: Specify a known type.

message: invalid stream type:
cause: The stream type specified is invalid.
solution: Specify a known type.

message: invalid argument count:

solution: Specify a valid number of arguments.

cause: Oracle-related error is encountered while executing a request.

cause: ORACLE_HOME environment variable is not set.
solution: Make sure that the ORACLE_HOME environment variable has been properly set and exported.

message: Error encountered when reading file string
cause: Error when reading file.

cause: Error encountered when connecting to EVM daemon.

cause: Error encountered when subscribing an EVM event.

cause: Error encountered when creating an EVM event.

cause: Error encountered when posting an EVM event.

cause: Empty event type is specified.

cause: Error encountered when handling incoming EVM message.

message: Oracle Cluster Repository mismatch with node string . ( string != string )

message: local node string not listed in configuration

message: endpoint already in use: string

solution: Shut down the other process, and retry the startup attempt.

message: voting device access took an excessive amount of time. ( string sec)

solution: Contact the disk hardware vendor for information on improving the availability of the disk.

message: unable to access voting device: string

solution: Examine the permissions on the voting device. If this failure occurred later than boot time, then access to the voting device was lost.

message: voting device not configured. [ string ] [ string ]

solution: The voting device assists in ensuring data integrity and is required by the CSS daemon. Configure a voting device and restart the cluster.

message: remote node string signaled our eviction via voting device: cause string
cause: A remote node of the cluster evicted the local node due to network failure or due to software failure in the local CSS daemon.
solution: Verify the stability of the private network between the local node and the specified remote node.

message: local node evicted by vendor node monitor
cause: The Operating System vendor's node monitor evicted the local node.
solution: Examine the vendor node monitor's logs for relevant information.

message: error string getting status from vendor node monitor
cause: The CSS daemon received a failure interacting with the vendor node monitor. The local node may have been evicted or the vendor node monitor may have been shut down.
solution: Examine the vendor node monitor's logs for relevant information.

message: reconfiguration successful, incarnation string with string nodes
cause: A rconfiguration has completed successfully
solution: None

message: local node number string , master node number string
cause: Informational message regarding this incarnation
solution: None

message: timed out waiting on nested reconfiguration
cause: The current reconfiguration hung. A network failure may have \ occurred.
solution: The local node will terminate itself to cause remote nodes to enter a nested reconfiguration. This may allow the cluster to continue operation.

message: An attempt to begin a nested reconfiguration failed.
cause: unable to cancel previous reconfiguration to begin a new one
solution: None

message: out of sync with master: [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: Consistency checks between the local node and the master failed.
solution: The local daemon will terminate itself to ensure that the surviving cluster is all properly coordinated.

message: assigning default private interconnect name string for node string
cause: A private interconnect name was not specified. The node name was used as a default instead.
solution: Verify that the node name refers to IP addresses on the private interconnect. Using a non-private network can cause performance and stability issues.

message: assigning default host name string for node string
cause: A host name for the node was not specified. The node name was used as a default instead.
solution: If the node name is not equal to the host name, the host name must be supplied to clscfg. Failure to do so will cause the Cluster Ready Services daemons not to function.

message: existing configuration version ( string ) detected

solution: Informational message only. No action is required. clscfg will not modify the existing configuration unless explicitly requested with the -force flag.

message: successfully determined required configuration for all components
cause: clscfg was able to determine the proper configuration requirements.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. clscfg will attempt to write the configuration next.

message: An existing configuration was detected. It was not overwritten.
cause: An existing configuration was detected, and clscfg chose not to overwrite it.
solution: This message may be ignored if it is seen as part of starting any node other than the first one. The -force option can be used to override this decision, but if it is used when there are active cluster members, failure CLSS-0101 and data integrity issues are likely.

message: successfully deleted string of string configuration values
cause: clscfg completed a portion of the delete operation.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. If some of the values were not deleted, another error message should be visible with more information.

message: successfully deleted string of string configuration keys
cause: clscfg completed a portion of the delete operation.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. If some of the keys were not deleted, another error message should be visible with more information.

message: successfully rolled back delete operation
cause: The delete node operation failed, but the configuration was properly restored to its original state.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required.

message: node deletion successful
cause: The delete node operation succeeded.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required.

message: formatting voting device: string
cause: clscfg started formatting the voting device.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required.

message: tried to delete key string but it was not there
cause: clscfg attempted to delete a key as part of a delete operation, but it had already been deleted.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. This might be an indication of corrupted configuration, or a previous delete operation that did not complete.

message: configuring TCP ports string , string , string , and string
cause: The specified ports were configured for use with the Cluster Ready Services Daemons.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. To change the ports used, specify 4 alternate ports with "-t". Example: -t 1001,1002,1003,1004

message: configuring node: node number string , node name string
cause: This node configuration was requested.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. To alter the list of nodes re-run the install and specify a different set of nodes, or make use of the add and delete node install options after the current install is complete.

message: configuring node: host name string , private interconnect name string
cause: This node configuration was requested.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. To alter the list of nodes re-run the install and specify a different set of nodes, or make use of the add and delete node install options after the current install is complete.

message: creating configuration with user ( string ) and group ( string )
cause: The configuration was set up with the specified user and group.
solution: Informational message only. No action is required. Some configuration information will only be accessible to members of the specified group. Note: On Windows platforms the group may be blank.

message: Warning: -force specified. Overwriting existing configuration.
cause: The -force parameter was supplied.
solution: The -force parameter will cause clscfg to overwrite the existing configuration. If used while a Cluster Ready Services cluster is actively running, this can cause instability and data integrity exposures.

message: Too many nodes were specified. limit is string
cause: Too many nodes were specified on command line.
solution: Retry the operation with a smaller number of simultaneous changes.

message: Node string specified is out of range. Maximum node number is string .
cause: A node was specified with node number out of range.
solution: Retry the operation with a smaller node number.

message: Unable to parse TCP port options specified.
cause: Arguments to the -t flag were not valid port numbers, or some number other than 4 ports were supplied.
solution: Correct the arguments to the -t flag and rerun the operation.

message: TCP port string is out of bounds.
cause: The TCP port specified was not a valid port number.
solution: Specify an another port. Usually TCP ports need to be between 1001 and 65,535.

message: missing required parameter -l with language ID information
cause: The -l parameter was required for the requested operation.
solution: Supply the -l parameter with the proper language ID.

message: missing required parameter -o with path to ORA_CRS_HOME
cause: The -o parameter was required for the requested operation.
solution: Supply the -o parameter with the proper path.

message: failure configuring component string
cause: The Oracle Cluster Repository configuration for the specified component was unsuccessful.
solution: Look for other error information and contact Oracle support.

message: missing required parameter -q with path to the voting device
cause: The -q parameter was required for the requested operation.
solution: Supply the -q parameter with a valid path for the voting device.

message: missing required parameter -c with a cluster name
cause: The -c parameter was required for the requested operation.
solution: Supply the -c parameter with a name for the cluster.

message: missing required parameter -nn with the list of nodenames
cause: The -nn parameter was required for the requested operation.
solution: Supply a list of node names with the format: nodenameA,nodenumA,nodenameB,nodenumB,...

message: node string already exists in the configuration with node number string
cause: A node name specified for the add node operation conflicted with the existing configuration.
solution: Choose an alternate node to add to the cluster, or give the new node a unique name, or delete the previous node, then retry.

message: private interconnect name string is already assigned to node number string
cause: The private interconnect name specified for the add node operation conflicted with the existing configuration.
solution: Choose an alternate node to add to the cluster, or give the new node a unique name, or delete the previous node, then retry.

message: Host name string is already assigned to node number string .
cause: The host name specified for the add node operation conflicted with the existing configuration.
solution: Choose an alternate node to add to the cluster, or give the new node a unique name, or delete the previous node, then retry.

message: Node number string is already assigned to node string .
cause: The node number specified for the add node operation conflicted with the existing configuration.
solution: Chose an alternate node to add to the cluster, or give the new node a unique node number, or delete the previous node, then retry.

message: failure string validating configuration of node string
cause: clscfg was unable to validate existing configuration of the specified node.
solution: Validate the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node, or choose another node to delete.

message: failure string validating configuration of private interconnect name string
cause: clscfg was unable to validate existing configuration of the specified node.
solution: Validate the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node, or choose another node to delete.

message: failure string validating configuration of node with host name string
cause: clscfg was unable to validate existing configuration of the specified node.
solution: Validate the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node, or choose another node to delete.

message: node name string for node string does not match existing node name string
cause: The node name specified in a delete operation did not match the existing configuration.
solution: Specify the correct information describing the node you intend to delete, then retry.

message: node number string for node string does not match existing node number string
cause: The node number specified in a delete operation did not match the existing configuration.
solution: Specify the correct information describing the node you intend to delete, then retry.

message: private interconnect name string for node string does not match string
cause: The private interconnect name specified in a delete operation did not match the existing configuration.
solution: Specify the correct information describing the node you intend to delete, then retry.

message: host name string for node string does not match existing host name string
cause: The host name specified in a delete operation did not match the existing configuration.
solution: Specify the correct information describing the node you intend to delete, then retry.

message: concurrent node deletion suspected when deleting key string
cause: A key being deleted by the current operation was deleted by another process during the small amount of time between opening it for deletion and actually deleting it. An attempt to execute multiple separate delete operations may have occurred, and may have corrupted the configuration.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Oracle Cluster Repository, and restore from backup if necessary. If only one clscfg process was active on the cluster this may be ignored.

message: failure updating the configuration in node deletion
cause: clscfg was unable to modify the existing configuration for node deletion. The existing configuration was probably not harmed.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node, and retry.

message: CSS daemon refused node deletion, status string . attempting rollback
cause: Cluster Synchronization Services daemon refused the node deletion.
solution: One or more of the designated nodes may still be active. clscfg will now attempt to roll back the deletion process. The Cluster Ready Services daemons must be shut down on a node before any attempt to remove them from the configuration. More information on why the attempt was refused may be available in the Cluster Synchronization Service logfile.

message: failure rolling back node deletion. configuration irrecoverable
cause: clscfg attempted to roll back the deletion process after a failure and was unable to do so. Configuration was partially deleted and left in an inconsistent state.
solution: Shut down the cluster and restore the Oracle Cluster Repository from backup.

message: failed to completely delete node configuration
cause: The node deletion was mostly successful, and should be functional in this state. Some portions of the configuration were not successfully deleted.
solution: This can be ignored. The safer choice is to restore the Oracle Cluster Repository from backup, and attempt the delete again. Adding any of the deleted nodes back to the configuration in the future may fail if this is ignored.

message: failure string querying maximum configurable node number
cause: clscfg was unable to determine the legitimate range of node numbers.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node.

message: failure string querying existing configured node list
cause: clscfg was unable to retrieve the list of currently configured nodes.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node.

message: failure string querying the maximum node name size
cause: clscfg was unable to determine the size of the largest node name.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node.

message: failure string querying the cluster name
cause: clscfg was unable to determine the existing cluster name.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Cluster Ready Services install on the local node.

message: failure formatting voting device ( string ) at [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: clscfg failed to format the voting device.
solution: Verify the path and permissions set on the voting device.

message: failure string opening configuration for write operation
cause: clscfg was attempting to open the current configuration for write access.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Oracle Cluster Repository. Shut down the cluster and restore OCR from backup if necessary.

message: failure string writing new configuration
cause: clscfg was attempting to write new configuration data.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Oracle Cluster Repository. Shut down the cluster and restore OCR from backup if necessary.

message: failure string opening configuration for delete operation
cause: clscfg received an error while attempting to delete part of the existing configuration.
solution: Verify the integrity of the Oracle Cluster Repository. Shut down the cluster and restore OCR from backup if necessary.

message: failure string writing configuration to disk
cause: clscfg received a failure writing information to the Oracle Cluster Repository.
solution: Verify the settings for the Oracle Cluster Repository and retry.

message: The number of Oracle Cluster Repository keys exceeds limit of string .
cause: clscfg ran out of internal space for keys during install.
solution: Re-run the install and specify a smaller list of nodes. When that completes, use the add node option to add the remaining nodes.

message: The number of Oracle Cluster Repository keys exceeds limit of string .
cause: clscfg ran out of internal space for keys during delete node.
solution: Re-run the delete node operation and delete fewer nodes at once.

message: unable to allocate string bytes of memory at location: string
cause: clscfg was unable to allocate enough memory to service the request.
solution: Ensure that the specified amount of memory will be available and retry the operation.

message: failure string in SCLS API at string
cause: clscfg was unable to query for information about the system setup.
solution: Contact Oracle support with the additional information printed just after this message.

message: add, install, delete, concepts, and local are mutually exclusive
cause: clscfg was run with two different mode flags. All mode flags are mutually exclusive.
solution: Correct the command line and try again.

message: Clustername should be between 1 and string letters.
cause: cluster name supplied with -c argument was the wrong size.
solution: Supply an alternate cluster name of an appropriate length.

message: unknown parameter string supplied
cause: An unknown parameter was passed to clscfg.
solution: Use "clscfg -help" or "clscfg -concepts" for more information.

message: unable to determine local hostname
cause: clscfg was unable to determine the local hostname.
solution: Verify the operating system host name configuration.

message: The requested operation requires High Availability privileges.
cause: The current user did not have High Availability privileges.
solution: Log in as a different user and retry the operation.

message: Failure string contacting the CRS daemon.
cause: clscfg was unable to communicate with the CRS daemon.
solution: The requested operation must be performed from an active cluster node. Validate the pre-existing installation on the local machine, or perform the operation from another node.

message: failure string contacting the CSS daemon
cause: clscfg was unable to communicate with the CSS daemon.
solution: The requested operation must be performed from an active cluster node. Validate the pre-existing installation on the local machine, or perform the operation from another node.

message: Untranslated failure: [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ] [ string ]
cause: A failure with no translation occurred.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support for more information.

message: See the documentation for usage information.
cause: Incorrect or insufficient arguments were passed to crsuser.
solution: Read documentation for instructions on how to use this tool.

message: Enter the password for user string .
cause: crsuser requires the password to register the user.
solution: Enter the requested password.

cause: The operation succeeded.
solution: None

solution: Contact Oracle Customer support for more information.

message: unexpected argument: string
cause: crsuser failed to parse the arguments, or an unknown argument was passed.
solution: Supply the correct arguments and try again.

message: Memory allocation failure for string bytes.
cause: crsuser was unable to allocate memory.
solution: Free up some system memory and try again.

message: insufficient privileges for action: string
cause: The current user did not have sufficient privileges.
solution: Log in as another user and try again.

message: Operating System function: string failed with error data: string
cause: A call to an Operating System dependent service or function returned an error indication. The message includes the name of the function and the returned error data. The latter varies by platform but typically is numeric; on most platforms it is the value of C "errno" after the failing call.
solution: This error normally is accompanied by other (higher-level) messages describing the operation that is affected by the failure. It may also include one or more of messages 101, 103, and 104 providing additional error details. All of the messages should be examined to assess the error, which may have a very ordinary cause and correction, such as an input file failing to open because the supplied name was misspelled.

message: Operating System error message: string
cause: This message accompanies message 100 above when the Operating System dependent error data can be converted into a text message. On most Oracle platforms the message is a text representation of the C "errno" value reported in message 100.
solution: See message 100.

message: Operating System interface detected an error
cause: This message is issued instead of messages 100-101 when a "logical" error condition (rather than failure of an Operating System function call) is detected at an Operating System specific interface. The error condition is further described by accompanying message(s), including 103 and 104.
solution: This error normally is accompanied by other (higher-level) messages describing the operation that is affected by the failure. In most cases it will also include messages 103 and 104, providing additional details about the error. All of the messages should be examined to assess the error, which may have a very ordinary cause and correction, such as a missing required environment variable.

message: error location: string
cause: This message accompanies message 100, 102, or 105 and identifies a location in Oracle program code that encountered the error.
solution: See message 100, 102, or 105. This information normally is useful only when reporting the error condition to Oracle as a potential code bug.

message: additional error information: string
cause: This message accompanies message 100, 102, or 105 and supplies additional information related to the error condition. A single error may include multiple lines of additional information.
solution: See message 100, 102, or 105.

message: Operating System interface has reported an internal failure
cause: This message indicates that an Operating System dependent interface within Oracle code has detected internal corruption or some other evidence of internal program failure.
solution: This message may be accompanied by other (higher-level) messages indicating the product operation that was affected by the failure. It may also be accompanied by either or both of messages 103 and 104. All situations reporting this condition should be referred to Oracle Support for resolution.

message: An improper Operating System error display was attempted
cause: During processing of an error condition, an attempt was made to format/display Operating System dependent error data, but the error data structure was found to indicate "no error".
solution: This error should be reported to Oracle Support for resolution.

message: **** Error stack contains number records, newest first:
cause: The collection of errors about to be presented contains this many following records.
solution: This and the following data should be reported to Oracle Support for resolution.

message: **** Error stack end ****

solution: The preceding data should be reported to Oracle Support for resolution.

message: OSE: string string

cause: This is generic internal error for Cluster Wallet.
solution: Contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: Out of heap memory.

solution: Retry the operation when more memory is available.

message: Error in the cluster registry (OCR) layer. [ number ] [ string ]
cause: An error occurred in the cluster registry layer while performing a cluster wallet operation.
solution: Ensure correct operation of cluster registry by inspecting ocr error (oerr proc <ocrerror>), by using ocrcheck and ocrdump, and retry the operation.

message: Error in the network security layer. [ number ] [ string ]
cause: An error occurred in the network security layer while performing a cluster wallet operation.
solution: Inspect the network security error (oerr ora <nzerr>), and take corrective action to ensure correct operation.

message: Cannot perform cluster wallet operation because one of the parameters is NULL.
cause: Program tried a cluster wallet operation using a NULL parameter.
solution: Check the parameters, and retry the operation.

message: Cannot perform cluster wallet operation because the context is invalid.
cause: The cluster wallet context passed was invalid.
solution: Intialize the cluster wallet and retry the operation.

message: Cannot perform cluster wallet operation because one of the parameters is invalid. [ number ] [ string ]
cause: Program tried a cluster wallet operation using an invalid parameter.
solution: Check the parameters, and retry the operation.

message: The cluster wallet to be created already exists.

message: The cluster wallet to be operated on does not exist.

message: Error in the NLS services.

message: Cannot perform cluster wallet operation because data stored in the registry is invalid.

solution: Delete the registry key associated with the wallet and recreate the wallet.

message: User is not authorized to perform the cluster wallet operation. [ number ] [ string ]
cause: Program tried an operation on a cluster wallet for which it does not have permission.
solution: Check to see if program is run as the correct user.

message: Error in the clusterware operating system (SCLS) services. [ string ]
cause: An error occurred in the SCLS services while performing a cluster wallet operation.
solution: Check to see if NIS/LDAP on Unix and Active Directory Service on Windows has been correctly configured.

message: Enter Password:

message: opened new file " string " after close failure

If the additional diagnostic data in a preceding alert log message indicate a file system environmental problem, attempt to correct it. Otherwise contact Oracle Support Services.

message: An error occurred while attempting to close file " string " during log file rotation. Additional diagnostics: string
cause: An error was encountered when attempting to close the specified file.

message: An error occurred while attempting to rename file " string " to " string " during log file rotation. Additional diagnostics: string
cause: An error was encountered when attempting to rename the source file to the destination file.

solution: To complete the valdidation, shut down the clusterware stack on this node, start another node and restart the stack on this node.

solution: Wait until the other command completes and reissue the command if necessary. Message 1626 would be printed if the command succeeds.

message: A Configuration change request failed because read of existing voting files failed; Details at string in string
cause: CSSD was not able to read the lease blocks of a majority of Voting files which is an indication of a problem with the voting files.
solution: Run the command 'crsctl query css votedisk' to get the list of currently working voting files. User may delete problematic voting file or use a different set.

message: A Configuration change request failed because write to new voting files failed; Details at string in string
cause: A voting file write failed, causing the associated configuration change to fail. This often results from adding a voting file that is not accessible to one or more nodes.
solution: Confirm that voting files added in a configuration change are accessible and writeable from all cluster nodes. If they are, contact Oracle Customer Support.

message: A configuration change request failed because not all the new voting files were discovered; Details at string in string
cause: One or more of the voting files being added were not discovered. Message 1638 identifies the unique ID(s) of the file(s) that could not be found.
solution: Verify if the discovery string is adequate to discover the new voting files. If not, modify discovery string using command 'crsctl replace discoverystring xxxxx'.

message: A configuration change request failed because one or more nodes are not a sufficient Clusterware version level; Details at string in string
cause: One ore more nodes are not a sufficient version level.
solution: Configuration change would not be successful until all nodes are at at the latest version. Try after all the nodes are upgraded.

message: Node string is being removed from the cluster in cluster incarnation number
cause: The local node is removing the indicated node from the cluster because it appears to be dead.
solution: Verify that the node that was removed, or the Oracle Clusterware on that node, was down. The CRS alert log of the node that was removed has information regarding why the node, or clusterware on the node, was no longer active. If the node was still up and Oracle Clusterware still active on that node, collect the CSS daemon logs from all nodes and any CSS daemon core files and contact Oracle Support.

message: CSSD failed to register group string in vendor clusterware; details at string in string
cause: The local node is not able to register the group of vendor clusterware.
solution: Verify that the vendor clusterware is installed and configured correctly.

message: CSSD is unable to determine cluster name; details at string in string
cause: Name of the cluster cannot be determined from configuration.
solution: Verify that Oracle Clusterware installation was successful.

message: CSSSD failed to initialize vendor clusterware; details at string in string
cause: The local node is not able to attach vendor clusterware.
solution: Verify that the vendor clusterware is installed and configured correctly.

message: The CSS daemon was started in exclusive mode but found an active CSS daemon on node string and is terminating; details at string in string
cause: The CSS daemon was started in exclusive mode, which requires that the clusterware stack is down on all other nodes to ensure data integrity. A CSS daemon was detected on another node, so the CSS daemon on this node is terminating.
solution: Stop the Oracle clusterware stack that is running on the indicated node.

message: Unable to locate configured voting file with ID string ; details at string in string
cause: The voting file with unique the ID indicated in the message was not found during the voting file discovery phase of CSS initialization.
solution: Verify that all configured voting files are accessible on this node. Any voting files that are not accessible should be removed and replaced with accessible voting files using the appropriate 'crsctl' commands.

message: Unable to locate voting file with ID string that is being added to the list of configured voting files; details at string in string
cause: The voting file with the unique ID indicated in the message was not found during the voting file discovery phase of CSS initialization. This voting file is in the process of being added to the list of configured voting files.
solution: Verify that all voting files to be added are accessible on this node. Any voting files that are not accessible should be removed and replaced with accessible voting files using the appropriate 'crsctl' commands.

message: Rejecting configuration change number : number because another configuration change is already in progress; details at string in string
cause: A configuration change was requested, but another configuration change is already in progress and only one configuration change may be processed at a time.
solution: Wait for the current configuration change to complete, then resubmit this configuration change.

message: Rejecting configuration change number : number because one or more new voting files in the new configuration could not be found; details at string in string
cause: A configuration change that involved the addition of voting files is being rejected because some of the new voting files were not located.
solution: Verify that the voting file name is correct and that it is accessible on this node, if the voting files are not managed by ASM. Message number 1638 provides greater detail.

message: Rejecting configuration change number : number because only number of the required number voting files of the new configuration were located; details at string in string
cause: A configuration change that involved a change to the list of voting files is being rejected because a sufficient number of voting files in the new configuration could not be located.
solution: Verify that all voting files in the new configuration are accessible on this node.

message: Node number is using a different CSS configuration from the one used by this node; this node is terminating to preserve integrity; details at string in string
cause: Another node in the cluster is using a different set of CSS configuration values, such as misscount or voting files. Inconsistency can result in data corruption, so this node is terminating to avoid data corruption.
solution: Collect Clusterware alert log and the CSSD log indicated in the message as well as the CSS daemon logs of all other nodes in the cluster and contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Failed to format the CSS voting disk string

cause: The difference between the local time and the time on the reference node was too much to be synchronized in a short period.

cause: The Cluster Time Synchronization Service experienced high network latency. The local time was not significantly different from the mean cluster time; therefore, the Cluster Time Synchronization Service will maintain the system time with slew time synchronization.

message: The Cluster Time Synchronization Service is unable to perform step time synchronization due to high network latency with the reference node. The local time is significantly different from the mean cluster time. The Cluster Time Synchronization Service is aborting.

solution: Shut down the Oracle Clusterware on the local node. Determine the root cause of high network latency. Perform appropriate repair if necessary, then restart the Oracle Clusterware on the local node.

message: Failure number with Cluster Synchronization Services while deleting voting disk.

solution: Respond based on the return code as follows: 15 - adjust privileges or use a different userid 16 - review the voting disk configuration displayed by 'crsctl query css votedisk' and correct your request accordingly 19 - ensure that compatible versions are installed others - report to Oracle Support Services

message: All OCR locations are on ASM disk groups [ string ], and none of these disk groups are mounted. Details are at " string " in " string ".
cause: OCR was configured on ASM disk groups, and all of the listed disk groups failed to mount. The possible causes are: 1. A disk was not accessible. 2. A disk in a normal or high redundancy disk group failed after the most recent dismount. 3. The ASM_DISKSTRING in the SPFILE or the GPnP profile was incorrect.
solution: Check the ASM alert logs for more information. To correct disk access or failure issues either: a) restore access to the disks in the disk group and mount the disk group (via ASMCMD or SQL). or b) Issue a force mount to the disk group to offline missing disks and mount a normal or high redundancy disk group. To correct the ASM_DISKSTRING in the SPFILE and propagate the change to the GPnP profile, in sqlplus, issue the SQL command "ALTER SYSTEM SET ASM_DISKSTRING <discovery_string> SCOPE=BOTH"

solution: Check the agent parameters and restart the resource manually.

message: Could not start agent ' string '. Details at string in string .
cause: Creation of the agent process failed.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Failed to get definition for resource ' string '. Details at string in string .
cause: The definition of the resource could not be determined.
solution: Delete the resource and add it again using the crsctl command.

message: Invalid path ' string ' found for agent filename. Details at string in string .
cause: The path that was specified for the agent was incorrect.
solution: Check that the path exists and is readable.

message: Agent ' string ' has exceeded maximum failures and has been disabled. Details at string in string .
cause: The specified agent has failed too many times.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Agent ' string ' was unable to process commands. Details at string in string .
cause: Agent was unable to process commands.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Cleaning resource ' string ' failed as part of reboot-less node fencing
cause: A resource 'clean' action associated with reboot-less node eviction encountered an error. This is an expected occurence in most cases.
solution: None

message: Unable to open environment file ' string '.
cause: The environment file specified could not be opened.
solution: Verify that the filename, its location and its permissions are correct.

message: Syntax error in environment file ' string '.
cause: The environment file specified did not have key value pairs in the correct format.
solution: Correct the key value format and retry. Consult the Clusterware Administration manual for the correct format.

message: User does not have permission to start CRSD.
cause: Unable to start CRSD due to insufficient permissions.
solution: Start CRSD as a privileged user.

message: Could not communicate with Event Manager.
cause: Unable to communicate with Event Manager daemon.
solution: Run the 'crsctl check evmd' command to determine whether Event Manager daemon is properly configured and is running.

message: Oracle Clusterware has experienced an internal error. Details at string in string .
cause: This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: Could not set system resource limits for Clusterware: "ulimit - string string ".
cause: A ulimit command issued internally to set system resource limits failed.
solution: Ensure that the correct resource limit values are set in the user profile and limits.conf.

message: unable to obtain local host name for reboot advisory log file scan
cause: An attempt to retrieve the local host name failed. The scan for reboot advisory files will not use host name criteria and so may report occurrences for other nodes as well as this one.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: an error occurred accessing reboot advisory log file location: string
cause: The scan for reboot advisory log files was unable to access the indicated file system location. The location was skipped, so any reboot advisory files that it contains will not be reported. This message is accompanied by CLSU- messages containing details of the access error.
solution: Respond based on the error described by the accompanying CLSU- messages. This may involve re-creating the directory or changing its permissions.

message: an error occurred searching reboot advisory log file location: string
cause: The scan for reboot advisory log files was unable to read the next file name from the indicated file system location. No further processing of reboot advisory files from that location occurs. This message is accompanied by CLSU- messages containing details of the access error.
solution: Respond based on the error described by the accompanying CLSU- messages.

message: reboot advisory log file: string is unexpectedly empty
cause: The scan for reboot advisory log files encountered a file that was empty. This might happen (rarely) if a component is initializing its use of reboot advisory at the same time the scan is running. Processing of other files in the location continues.
solution: Frequent occurrence of this message should be reported to Oracle Support Services.

message: an error occurred reading reboot advisory log file: string
cause: The scan for reboot advisory log files experienced a read error on a reboot advisory file. No further processing is done for that file, but the scan continues with other files. This message is accompanied by CLSU- messages containing details of the read error.
solution: Respond based on the accompanying CLSU- messages.

message: an error occurred closing reboot advisory log file: string
cause: The scan for reboot advisory log files experienced a close error on a reboot advisory file. The scan continues with other files. This message is accompanied by CLSU- messages containing details of the close error.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: an error occurred opening reboot advisory log file: string
cause: The scan for reboot advisory log files experienced an error when it opened a reboot advisory file. The scan continues with other files. This message is accompanied by CLSU- messages containing details of the open error.
solution: If the error indicated in the accompanying CLSU- messages is one that can be corrected, do so. Otherwise, report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: an error occurred closing reboot advisory log file location: string
cause: The scan for reboot advisory log files experienced an error when it closed the indicated file system location. Processing of other reboot advisory locations (if any) continues normally. This message is accompanied by CLSU- messages containing details of the close error.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: string
cause: Operating system error data related to reboot advisory file processing was returned. The error data is packaged in a CLSU- message that follows "CRS-08008:". One or more of these messages appears after a message announcing the error condition.
solution: Look up the embedded CLSU- message for an explanation of the operating system error data. If there is no CLSU- message ID present, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: reboot advisory log file: string contains invalid data (length number , error code number )
cause: A reboot advisory log record read from the indicated file contained incorrect data.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid network reboot advisory message detected (length number , error code number )
cause: A reboot advisory record received over the network was improperly formed or contained incorrect data.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: reboot advisory message from host: string , component: string , with time stamp: string
cause: d a reset or reboot of the affected host, and respond accordingly. Refer to the discussion of reboot advisories in the Oracle Clusterware administration documentation for additional guidance.
solution: Use the reboot advisory message(s) to determine why Oracle Clusterware

message: reboot advisory message from a higher Oracle Clusterware version detected
cause: A reboot advisory message from a higher version installation of Oracle Clusterware was detected. This is an expected occurrence with network reboot advisories when there are nodes with a higher Oracle Clusterware version than this node (such as during an upgrade). It is an unexpected condition with file reboot advisories.
solution: The reboot advisory message is displayed in a following CRS-08013 message in a "raw" text form. In the case of network reboot advisories, the explanatory message text should be readable and useful to determine the cause of the node reboot. If the reboot advisory message is from a file, report this message to Oracle Support Services.

message: reboot advisory message text: string
cause: An explanatory text message associated with a reboot advisory announced in a preceding CRS-08011 or CRS-08012 message was displayed. These text messages are always written in US English locale.
solution: Refer to the descriptions of messages CRS-08011 and -08012, and to the Oracle Clusterware documentation on reboot advisories.

message: reboot advisory binary data ( number bytes string ) follows:
cause: Binary data associated with a reboot advisory message was displayed. It is followed by one or more lines of CRS-08015 message containing the binary data formatted in hexadecimal. If an asterisk appears inside the parentheses, an invalid data length was detected.
solution: Refer to the description of message CRS-08011 and -08012, and to the Oracle Clusterware documentation on reboot advisories.

message: number string
cause: Hexadecimal display of binary data included in a reboot advisory log message was displayed. The first number is an offset and is followed by up to 16 bytes of data.
solution: Refer to the description of message CRS-08011 and -08012, and to the Oracle Clusterware documentation on reboot advisories.

message: an error occurred determining the location for reboot advisory log files
cause: The search for reboot advisory log files was unable to determine the file system location used for those files. Processing of reboot advisory files is skipped. This message is accompanied by CLSU- messages containing failure details. This is an internal error.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: location: string has number reboot advisory log files, number were announced and number errors occurred
cause: This summary message is written during Oracle Clusterware startup if one or more reboot advisory log files was found and examined.
solution: This message is informational, but if the error count is nonzero the associated messages (earlier in the alert log) should be examined.

message: warning: missing cluster identity data for reboot advisory message validation
cause: During Oracle Clusterware start up, an attempt to obtain the identity of the cluster failed. Processing continues normally, but network reboot advisories from nodes in other clusters may be reported in this cluster's alert log.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: warning generated by the initialization of the reboot advisory in the CSS agent, string
cause: During initialization of the reboot advisory, a warning was generated
solution: Report this warning to Oracle Support Services.

message: error generated by the initialization of the reboot advisory in the CSS agent, string
cause: During initialization of the reboot advisory, an error was generated.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Failed to allocate memory.
cause: During intialization, memory could not be allocated.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Internal Error
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Error reading from standard input
cause: Could not read commands from the command line.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Quoted string not ended

solution: Put in the corresponding quote or remove the unmatched quote.

message: Error string : Parsing error. Invalid arguments given.
cause: Invalid or unknown arguments passed.
solution: Refer to product documentation or to command online help for an explanation of verbs and arguments.

message: Error string : mandatory data not supplied
cause: Mandatory data not supplied to the command.
solution: Refer to product documentation or to command online help for an explanation of verbs and arguments.

message: Error string : Failed to initialize connection to the Cluster Logger Service
cause: Error occurred while connecting to the Cluster Logger Service.
solution: Ensure that Cluster Logger Service is running and reachable from the client node by using the 'ping' command for the given node.

message: Error string : Error sending query to the Cluster Logger Service
cause: Error occurred while sending query to the Cluster Logger Service.
solution: Ensure that the Cluster Logger Service is running and reachable from the client node by using the 'ping' command for the given node.

message: Error string : Invalid data received from the Cluster Logger Service
cause: Invalid or unknown data received from the Cluster Logger Service.
solution: Ensure that the Cluster Logger Service is running and reachable from the client node by using the 'ping' command for the given node.

message: Error: Corrupt reply from the Cluster Logger Service
cause: Invalid or unknown data received from the Cluster Logger Service.
solution: Make sure that the version of both master and client installation is same. Also, check the connectivity between master and client using the 'ping'.

message: Error: Invalid or unknown reply received from the Cluster Logger Service
cause: Error occurred in the data received.
solution: Make sure that the version of both master and client installation is same. Also, check the connectivity between master and client.

message: Error string : No arguments supplied
cause: No argument was supplied with the command.
solution: Some commands need arguments with them. Refer to the product documentation or to the online help display.

message: Error string : No parameter string supported
cause: A wrong parameter was passed with the command.
solution: Refer to the command help and pass the correct parameters.

message: Error string : No master node name given
cause: The master node name was not passed in the command.
solution: Pass the appropriate master node name with the command.

message: Error string : Invalid or no start time given
cause: A start time was not provided or the time was passed in the wrong format.
solution: Pass the correct start time. For correct format, refer to command help.

message: Error string : Invalid or no end time given
cause: A end time was not provided or the time was passed in the wrong format.
solution: Pass the correct end time. For correct format, refer to command help.

message: Error string : Time not given or in wrong format or invalid
cause: Time was not provided or was invalid.
solution: Pass the correct and valid time. For correct format, refer to command help.

message: Error string : No node name given
cause: Node name not provided.
solution: Provide a node name in the command. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information.

message: Error string : No disk ID name given
cause: Disk ID was not given in the command with -diskid.
solution: Pass a valid disk ID with -diskid option.

message: Error string : No parameter given
cause: The parameter was not passed in the query.
solution: Pass appropriate parameter for query. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information.

message: Error string : Parameter string is not supported with this verb
cause: Invalid or unknown parameter passed.
solution: Pass the correct parameter. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information.

message: Error string : No NIC ID given
cause: NIC ID was not given in the command with -nicid.
solution: Pass a valid NIC ID with -nic option.

message: Error string : No PID given
cause: PID was not given in the command with -pid.
solution: Pass a valid PID with -pid option.

message: Error string : No region given
cause: Incorrect or no region given with -c option.
solution: Pass a valid region with -c option. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information.

message: Argument string not supported with this verb string . -h for help.
cause: Unknown or invalid argument passed with the command.
solution: Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Invalid hour given in the time argument
cause: Invalid hour in the time string was passed.
solution: Pass a valid time string in accordance with the format. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Invalid minutes given in the time argument
cause: Invalid minutes in the time string was passed.
solution: Pass a valid time string in accordance with the format. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Invalid seconds given in the time argument
cause: Invalid seconds in the time string was passed.
solution: Pass a valid time string in accordance with the format. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Arguments not in proper format, or invalid arguments
cause: Invalid arguments given.
solution: Pass a valid verb and correct arguments for it. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Invalid Cluster Health Monitor repository size given
cause: Non-numeric value or value out of range given for Cluster Health Monitor repository size.
solution: Specify Cluster Health Monitor repository size in the valid range. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: string Error: Node name not given. -disk, -nic and -proc need node name
cause: The required node name was not provided for -disk, -nic, or -proc.
solution: Provide a node name with -n option. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Error: -s and -e need to be specified together
cause: Either -s or -e is missing.
solution: Start and end time need to be given together for range queries, which cannot be unbounded. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Error string : -i is not allowed with the range query
cause: The -i option was specified on an oclumon range query.
solution: Use -i only in continuous mode. Refer to the command inline help or product documentation for more information.

message: Error string : Band value not given or incorrect
cause: The band value was not passed with -t option or was invalid.
solution: Provide a valid band value. Refer command help.

message: Error string : The -repos argument was specified without an option.
cause: -repos was not provided with the option, generating a parsing error.
solution: Provide a valid option to -repos. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Error string : No size given with resize
cause: A valid value was not provided with resize.
solution: Provide a valid numerical value with 'resize'. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Error string : Non-numeric or invalid value for size: string
cause: An invalid or non-numeric value was provided for size.
solution: Provide a valid numeric size. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: No key specified with -getkey
cause: An option was not given with -getkey.
solution: Provide a valid key as an option with -getkey.

message: No key given for -get
cause: An option was not provided with -get.
solution: Provide a valid option with -get. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Invalid key given
cause: An unknown key was provided with -get.
solution: Provide a supported key with -get. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information on supported arguments.

message: Error string : Error Dumping Log (return code: number ) for node string
cause: An error occurred while dumping local log.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services. Cluster Health Monitor repository directory may be unreachable, unreadable or incorrect.

message: Error string : No data received from the Cluster Logger Service after number attempts
cause: Data was not received from the Cluster Logger Service after the given number of attempts or data was not available.
solution: None

message: Error string : Cannot get environment variable CRFHOME
cause: An internal error occurred.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Error string : Too many host names
cause: Too many host names were provided.
solution: Provide valid number of host names. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information.

message: Error string : Invalid interval size given
cause: Non-numeric or invalid interval provided.
solution: Provide a valid numerical value for interval size. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information

message: Error string : string control not supported
cause: The given debug control was not supported.
solution: Provide a supported control. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information.

message: Key:value pair missing
cause: A required key:value pair was missing.
solution: Provide a valid key:value pair. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information

message: Incomplete or invalid parameters string
cause: Incomplete or invalid parameters supplied.
solution: Provide the complete and correct parameters. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information

message: module:level given in invalid format or invalid value
cause: Invalid format or value specified for module:level.
solution: Provide correct module:level. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information

message: Error string : Invalid Cluster Health Monitor repository location given
cause: Invalid Cluster Health Monitor repository location provided.
solution: Provide a directory with read and write permissions for Cluster Health Monitor repository location. Refer to the product documentation or to the command online help for information.

message: Error string : No response received from the Cluster Logger Service
cause: No data received from the Cluster Logger Service for the query.
solution: Ensure that the Cluster Logger Service is running and reachable from the client node by using the 'ping' command for the given node.

message: Error string : Changing log level failed due to authentication failure
cause: Log level could not be changed due to authentication failure.
solution: Ensure that this command is run as root.

message: Error string : Changing log level failed due to connection failure
cause: A connection failure occurred while changing the log.
solution: Ensure that the daemons are running and are reachable from the client node by using the 'ping' command for the given node.

message: Error string : Unable to send message due to memory allocation failure
cause: Memory could not be allocated for debug message.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Error string : Changing log level failed due to response time-out
cause: A time out happened while waiting for response.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Error string : Error in changing log level
cause: An error occured while changing log level.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Disk ID not found
cause: Given disk ID was not found or not present in the interesting list.
solution: Provide a disk ID which is available at the start of the query range.

message: Process ID not found
cause: Given process ID was not found.
solution: Provide a process ID which is available at the start of the query range.

message: NIC ID not found
cause: Given NIC ID was not found.
solution: Provide a correct NIC ID.

message: Error string : -allnodes and -n must not be used together
cause: Both -allnodes and -n were supplied on a dumpnodeview command.
solution: Specify either -allnodes or -n with specific nodes.

message: The new Cluster Health Monitor repository location is string .
cause: The Cluster Health Monitor repository location was successfully replaced.
solution: None

message: The new Cluster Health Monitor repository retention time is number seconds.
cause: The Cluster Health Monitor repository retention time was successfully modified.

message: Error setting Cluster Health Monitor repository size
cause: An error occurred while setting Cluster Health Monitor repository size on the Cluster Logger Service.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Error updating Cluster Health Monitor repository size in configuration file.
cause: An error occurred while writing the Cluster Health Monitor repository size to configuration files.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: No data for the node at the given time
cause: Data was not found for the given node.
solution: This is an informational message only.

message: No data available
cause: Data was not available for the query.
solution: Make sure the System Monitor Service is running on the given node.

message: No data available for the given nodes
cause: Data was not available for given nodes.
solution: Make sure the System Monitor Service is running on the given nodes.

message: Internal Error on master
cause: An internal error on master caused this error.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Data requested was outside Cluster Health Monitor retention time limits.
cause: A request for data outside Cluster Health Monitor repository limit caused this error.
solution: Data needs to be requested in the proper Cluster Health Monitor repository limits. Refer to the product documentation for more information.

message: Start time greater than end time
cause: A start time greater [or later] than end time caused an error.
solution: Make sure the start time is less than the end time for the given range query.

message: Threshold out of acceptable range
cause: A threshold was specified that is outside the allowed range.
solution: Make sure threshold is within the acceptable range. Refer documentation or online help for more information

message: New Cluster Health Monitor repository location same as the old location on node string
cause: The new location specified for Cluster Health Monitor repository is same as the old location.
solution: Provide a different location for Cluster Health Monitor repository. Refer documentation or online help for more information.

message: Cluster Health Monitor repository location not changed as the location provided does not exist on node string .
cause: The new location specified for Cluster Health Monitor repository does not exist.
solution: Provide a different location for Cluster Health Monitor repository. Refer documentation or online help for more information.

message: Error updating Cluster Health Monitor repository location string in configuration file.
cause: An error occurred while writing the Cluster Health Monitor repository location to configuration files.
solution: Report this error to Oracle Support Services.

message: Cluster Health Monitor repository location change failed on one or more nodes. Aborting location change.
cause: An error occurred while setting Cluster Health Monitor repository location on the Cluster Logger Service.
solution: Retry specifying a valid location.

message: Cluster Health Monitor repository retention change failed on one or more nodes. Aborting retention change.
cause: An error occurred while setting Cluster Health Monitor repository size on the Cluster Logger Service.
solution: Retry specifying a valid location.

message: The system monitor service aborted on host string . Details at string in string .
cause: The system monitor service aborted due to an internal error.
solution: If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: The Cluster Logger Service aborted on host string . Details at string in string .
cause: The Cluster Logger Service aborted due to an internal error.
solution: If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: The Cluster Health Monitor repository location string is inaccessible. Details at string in string .
cause: An error occurred while accessing the Cluster Health repository.
solution: Check that the Cluster Health Monitor repository location in question has the correct permissions. Determine whether this behavior is limited to one node or whether it occurs across all of the nodes in the cluster. Use the 'oclumon manage -repos reploc <location>' command to replace the Cluster Health Monitor repository location.

message: The system monitor service on this host is unable to communicate with the Cluster Logger Service on host string , and will log data to the local repository.
cause: Communication was lost with the Cluster Logger Service node.
solution: Verify all network connections between cluster nodes and repair any problematic connections. If no network problems are found, 1. Run diagcollection.pl. 2. Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: The Cluster Logger Service on host string is dropping the Cluster Health Monitor node view. Details at string in string .
cause: The Cluster Logger Service was unable to insert Cluster Health Monitor node view into Cluster Health Monitor repository .
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: The Cluster Health Monitor repository is deleted due to corruption and the Cluster Logger Service is disabled on string . Details at string in string .
cause: A critical error occurred while operating on Cluster Health Monitor repository.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: The system monitor service local repository is disabled on the host string . Details at string in string .
cause: An internal error occurred while writing to the system monitor service local repository.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: The maximum Cluster Health Monitor repository retention time is reached. Deleting the oldest Cluster Health Monitor node views in age order.
cause: The maximum time for which the oldest Cluster Health Monitor node view will be available on Cluster Health Monitor repository was reached.
solution: If necessary, use 'oclumon manage -repos resize <size>' command to change the retention time.

message: The Cluster Health Monitor repository retention time cannot be changed due to lack of disk space on node string .
cause: The Cluster Health Monitor retention time condition could not be fulfilled because the Cluster Health Monitor repository ran out of disk space at run time at the repository location.
solution: Use the 'oclumon manage -repos reploc <location>' command to replace the Cluster Health Monitor repository with a disk location that has at least 1GB of available space per cluster node.

message: The new Cluster Logger Service master is string .

message: The new Cluster Logger Service replica is string .

cause: Memory allocation failed.
solution: Correct the system memory problem and retry.

message: unable to reach string address from local node
cause: An attempt to reach the IP address specified failed.
solution: Make sure that the specified IP address is a valid IP address and is assigned to an interface. Make sure that there are no firewalls between local node and node on which specified IP address is hosted.

message: unable to determine local hostname
cause: The hostname could not be read.
solution: Check that the hostname for the local machine is valid. Look at the accompanying messages. If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: APPVIP type needs a VIP name. Specify a VIP name using -vip commandline option
cause: VIP resource name was missing in the command line for APPVIP type.
solution: Specify a VIP name using -vip option.

message: unable to generate client ID for VIP type string , cluster name string , VIP resource name string
cause: An attempt to generate client ID for specified cluster name, VIP type and resource name failed.
solution: Make sure that cluster name and VIP resource name do not exceed 252 characters. Make sure that VIP type is a valid VIP type. Refer to 'crsctl get clientid -help' for more information.

message: unable to discover DHCP server in the network listening on port number for client ID string
cause: An attempt to discover DHCP server listening on port specified failed.
solution: Make sure that DHCP servers exist on the network and are listening on port specified. If they are listening on a different port specify then specify that port using the -port option. For more information refer to help for 'crsctl discover dhcp' command.

message: unable to request DHCP lease for client ID string on port number
cause: An attempt to request DHCP lease for the specified client ID on specified port failed.
solution: Make sure that there are DHCP servers with IP addresses available on the network. If other DHCP servers are available which are listening on a different port specify an alternative port using the -port option. For more information refer to help for 'crsctl request dhcp' command.

message: unable to release DHCP lease for client ID string , on port number
cause: An attempt to release DHCP lease for the specified client ID on specified port failed.
solution: Make sure that there are DHCP servers listening on port specified. If the DHCP server is listening on a different port specify an alternative port using -port option. For more information refer to help for 'crsctl release dhcp' command.

message: HOSTVIP type needs a node name. Specify a node name using -n option
cause: Node name was missing in the command line for HOSTVIP type.
solution: For HOSTVIP type node name needs to be specified via -n option.

message: VIP type string is invalid
cause: An invalid VIP type was specified for DHCP client ID generation.
solution: Make sure that VIP type is a valid VIP type. Refer to 'crsctl get clientid -help' for more information.

message: error obtaining local host DNS resolver configuration
cause: An attempt to obtain local host DNS configuration failed.
solution: Make sure that the user executing the command has sufficient permission to read local system configuration.

message: the number name servers configured on this system exceeds the number maximum allowed
cause: An attempt to obtain local host DNS configuration failed because more name servers were found then allowed on this operating system.
solution: Reduce the number of name servers configured to the maximum allowed.

message: Domain name look up for name string failed. Operating system error: string
cause: An attempt to query DNS servers for name specified failed.
