solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of the correct usage and syntax for the image processing command string.

message: missing value in CUT rectangle
cause: An incorrect number of values was used to specify a rectangle.
solution: Use exactly four integer values for the lower-left and upper- right vertices.

message: extra value in CUT rectangle
cause: An incorrect number of values was used to specify a rectangle.
solution: Use exactly four integer values for the lower left and upper right vertices.

message: string
cause: A syntax error was found while parsing the parameters for the image process function.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of the correct usage and syntax for the image processing command string.

message: string
cause: An error was found while accessing image data.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: multiple incompatible scaling parameters found
cause: Multiple incompatible scaling parameters were found in the image process command string. With the exception of XSCALE and YSCALE, which can be used together in a process command string, scaling functions are mutually exclusive and cannot be combined.
solution: Remove scaling functions until only one remains (or two, if they are XSCALE and YSCALE).

message: missing value in scaling operation
cause: An incorrect number of values was used to specify image dimensions. fixedScale and maxScale require exactly two integer values for the X and Y dimensions of the desired image.
solution: Use two values for fixedScale and maxScale.

message: extra value in scaling operation
cause: An incorrect number of values was used to specify image dimensions. fixedScale and maxScale require exactly two integer values for the X and Y dimensions of the desired image.
solution: Use two values for fixedScale and maxScale.

message: incorrect number of input channels
cause: An incorrect number of values was used to specify input channels. InputChannels requires either one or three channels numbers for the gray or red, green, and blue channel assignments.
solution: Use either one or three values to specify the input channels.

message: default channel out of range
cause: An incorrect value was used to specify the default channel selection.
solution: Use a channel number which is less than or equal to the number of bands and greater than zero.

message: height or width not present in parameter string
cause: Height and/or width were not specified in the setProperties parameter string.
solution: Specify both the height and width.

message: invalid value for height or width
cause: Height and/or width were not positive integers"
solution: Specify both the height and width as positive integers"

message: illegal combination of parameters
cause: Other than height, width, dataOffset, and userString no other parameters may be specified in the setProperties parameter string when CCITTG3 or CCITTG4 is used as the compressionFormat.
solution: Supply only the height and width when compessionFormat is either CCITTG3 or CCITTG4. The dataOffset and userString may optionally be supplied as well.

message: invalid value for numberOfBands
cause: NumberOfBands was not a positive integer"
solution: Specify numberOfBands as a positive integer"

message: invalid value for dataOffset
cause: DataOffset was not a positive integer"
solution: Specify dataOffset as a positive integer"

message: invalid format for parameter value
cause: A floating point value was specified where an integer is required, or a character value was specified where a numeric value is required.
solution: Specify the correct type of values for process parameters.

message: invalid process verb
cause: A process verb was specified that is not understood by Oracle Multimedia.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid process verbs.

message: mismatched quotes
cause: Quotation marks used within a process command string were not matched.
solution: Ensure that quotation marks occur in pairs.

message: locale error
cause: This is an internal error.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: error parsing foreign image description
cause: An internal error occurred while processing a foreign image.
solution: Contact Oracle Support Services.

message: invalid deletePages specified
cause: The specified value for the deletePages parameter was not valid.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for reference information about valid values for deletePages parameter.

message: invalid movePages specified
cause: The specified value for the movePages parameter was not valid.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for reference information about valid values for movePages parameter.

message: invalid combination of TIFF page operations
cause: The specified TIFF page operations were not valid.
solution: See the Oracle Multimedia documentation for reference information about valid values for TIFF page operations.

message: internal error while parsing command
cause: An internal error occurred while parsing the command passed to the image processing function or the foreign image setProperties function.
solution: If you are certain that your command is correct, then contact Oracle Support Services.

message: empty or null image processing command
cause: An empty or null image processing command was passed to the image process function.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of the correct usage and syntax for the image processing command string.

message: contentFormat and interleave conflict
cause: Interleave values were specified using both the contentformat and interleave verbs.
solution: Specify interleave using either contentformat or interleave, but not both.

message: invalid contentFormat specified
cause: The specified contentFormat was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid contentFormat specifications.

message: contentFormat includes invalid extra information
cause: The specified contentFormat included invalid characters at the end of the parameter string.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid contentFormat specifications.

message: invalid compressionFormat specified
cause: The specified compressionFormat was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid compressionFormat specifications.

message: invalid compressionQuality specified
cause: The specified compressionQuality was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid compressionQuality specifications.

message: invalid cut values specified
cause: An invalid value was found while parsing the parameters for the cut operation.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of the correct usage and syntax for the image processing command string.

message: invalid page number specified
cause: An invalid page number was specified.
solution: Specify page numbers that are not negative.

message: invalid channelOrder specified
cause: The specified channelOrder was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid channelOrder specifications.

message: invalid interleave specified
cause: The specified interleave was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid interleave specifications.

message: invalid pixelOrder specfied
cause: The specified pixelOrder was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid pixelOrder specifications.

message: invalid scanlineOrder specified
cause: The specified scanline order was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid scanlineOrder specifications.

message: invalid quantize method specified
cause: The specified quantization method was not valid.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of valid quantization method specifications.

message: invalid inputChannels specified
cause: An invalid value was specified for the inputChannels verb.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of the correct usage and syntax for the image processing command string.

message: invalid rotate value
cause: An invalid value was specified for image rotation. Rotation values must be a floating point number.
solution: Correct the statement by providing a valid rotation value.

message: extra value in rotate operation
cause: Multiple arguments were used to specify image rotation. The rotate operation accepts only a single value.
solution: Provide a single value for the rotate operation.

message: invalid value for gamma correction
cause: An invalid value was specified for gamma correction. Gamma values must be positive.
solution: Correct the statement by providing a positive gamma value.

message: incorrect number of gamma values
cause: An incorrect number of values were used to specify gamma correction. Gamma correction requires either one or three gamma values.
solution: Provide either one or three values to specify the gamma correction.

message: invalid value for contrast enhancement
cause: An invalid value was used to specify contrast enhancement.
solution: To specify contrast enhancement using percentages, provide values between 0 and 100. To specify contrast enhancement using bounds, provide values greater than 0.

message: incorrect number of contrast values
cause: An incorrect number of values were used to specify contrast enhancement. Contrast enhancement requires one, two, three, or six contrast values.
solution: Provide one or three values to specify contrast enhancement using percentages; provide two or six values to specify contrast enhancement using contrast bounds.

message: invalid frame number
cause: An incorrect number was used to specify frame in Dicom image. The number should be greater than 0 and less than total frames in Dicom image.
solution: Provide one number greater than 0 and less than total frames in Dicom image.

message: input format does not support page selection
cause: The page verb was specified for an input format that does not support selecting pages.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which image formats support page selection.

message: input format does not support channel selection
cause: The inputChannels verb was specified for an input format that does not support selecting channels.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which image formats support input channel selection.

message: invalid quantize argument
cause: A quantize value was specified that accepts an argument, but the argument provided was not valid.
solution: Provide a valid, non-negative argument for the quantize value.

message: missing quantize argument
cause: A quantize value was specified that requires an argument, but no argument was provided.
solution: Provide an argument for the quantize value.

message: extra quantize argument
cause: An extra argument was provided for a quantize value. Some quantize values accept no arguments, while others accept a single argument.
solution: Provide an argument only for quantize values that accept an argument.

message: specified format does not support output
cause: The output format specified by fileFormat does support output.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which formats support output.

message: output format does not support the specified contentFormat

solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which contentFormat values are supported for each output format.

message: output format does not support the specified interleave
cause: The specified interleave is not supported by the explicitly or implicitly specified output format.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which interleave values are supported for each output format.

message: output format does not support the specified compressionFormat
cause: The specified compressionFormat is not supported by the explicitly or implicitly specified output format.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which compressionFormat values are supported for each output format.

message: output format does not support the specified compressionQuality
cause: The specified compressionQuality is not supported by the explicitly or implicitly specified output format.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which compressionQuality values are supported for each output format.

message: output format does not support the specified channelOrder
cause: The specified channelOrder is not supported by the explicitly or implicitly specified output format.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which channelOrder values are supported for each output format.

message: output format does not support the specified pixelOrder
cause: The specified pixelOrder is not supported by the explicitly or implicitly specified output format.
solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which pixelOrder values are supported for each output format.

message: output format does not support the specified scanlineOrder

solution: Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a description of which scanlineOrder values are supported for each output format.

message: export destination access denied

cause: There is no image data in the image object.

cause: This is an internal error.

message: Incorrect parameter specification during CREATE INDEX

message: unable to write to the ORDImageSignature object
cause: The signature object was not valid and therefore the write operation failed. This problem is commonly caused by an attempt to invoke the generateSignature method on an uninitialized ORDImageSignature object.
solution: Ensure that the ORDImageSignature object has been initialized and inserted into a table. Also ensure that the row containing the signature object is locked. (The two previous actions do not apply to signature objects created using temporary BLOBs). Ensure that there is sufficient tablespace to contain the signature.

message: tablespace specified during CREATE INDEX is not valid

solution: Create the tablespace, grant appropriate privileges on the tablespace to the current user, or choose a different tablespace.

message: unsupported option string

message: not a DICOM object

solution: Use an object that conforms to the DICOM standard. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: unsupported DICOM version
cause: The object header could not be parsed, possibly because the object header did not conform to the DICOM standard release 2003.
solution: Use an object that conforms to the DICOM standard release 2003. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: unsupported DICOM object type
cause: The category of DICOM objects is not supported by Oracle Multimedia.
solution: Use a DICOM image is supported by Oracle Multimedia. Oracle Multimedia supports image types defined in the DICOM standard release 2003. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more details.

message: input DICOM object is not an image
cause: The DICOM object was not a DICOM image. DICOM object types such as structured reporting are not allowed by this function.
solution: Invoke this function with a DICOM image. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more details.

message: unsupported DICOM transfer syntax
cause: The operation failed because the transfer syntax in the DICOM object, which describes the binary encoding of the DICOM object, was not supported by Oracle Multimedia.
solution: Use a DICOM object with a transfer syntax supported by Oracle Multimedia. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more details.

message: DICOM object cannot be parsed
cause: The DICOM object could not be parsed by Oracle Multimedia, possibly due to an incorrect format or corrupted object.
solution: Verify that the DICOM object is not corrupted. If the DICOM object is valid, contact Oracle Support Services.

message: 2FF01 - incorrect image format
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the supplied image BLOB format did not match the image format or the image format is unsupported.
solution: For supported image formats, specify an input BLOB that has the same format as the image. For unsupported image formats, this method is not supported. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information.

message: 2FF02 - incorrect average color feature specification
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. The specified average color value was not a valid SI_Color value.
solution: Specify an average color value that is not null and contains valid SI_Color values. SI_Color attribute values must be integers from 0 to 255. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information on constructing valid SI_Color objects.

message: 2FF03 - incorrect color histogram feature specification
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. This exception was caused by one of the following. - The specified color value was null or invalid. - The specified frequency value was null or invalid. - The input color and frequency arrays were not equal in size. - The SI_ColorList array attribute had reached the maximum size.
solution: Ensure that the following are true(as applicable to your case): - The color and frequency values are not null. - The SI_Color attribute values are integers from 0 to 255. - The frequency value is a double precision number from 0 to 100. - The color and frequency arrays are equal in size and the size of the arrays is less than the SI_MaxHistogramLength value listed in the SI_VALUES view in the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information on constructing SI_ColorHistogram objects.

message: 2FF04 - incorrect feature list specification
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the specified feature values were invalid or the specified feature weights were invalid.
solution: Check the values of feature and featureweight pairs. For a non null feature value, the corresponding feature weight value must be a double precision number greater than 0.0. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information on the SI_FeatureList object type and its methods.

message: 2FF05 - incorrect color specification
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. The specified red/green/blue value was null or invalid.
solution: Specify red, green and blue values as integers from 0 to 255.

message: 2FF06 - average color feature cannot be determined
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the specified image was null, the image data in the specified image was null, or the average color feature was not supported by the specified image format
solution: Specify an image with non null image data and a supported format. Refer to the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA views and the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a list of supported image formats and image features.

message: 2FF07 - positional color feature cannot be determined
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the specified image was null, the image data in the specified image was null, or the positional color feature was not supported by the specified image format.
solution: Specify an image with non null image data and a supported format. Refer to the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA views and the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a list of supported image features and formats.

message: 2FF08 - color histogram feature cannot be determined
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the specified image was null, the image data in the specified image was null, or the color histogram feature was not supported by the specified image format.
solution: Specify an image with non null image data and a supported format Refer to the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA views and the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a list of supported image features and formats.

message: 2FF09 - texture feature cannot be determined
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the specified image was null, the image data in the specified image was null, or the texture feature was not supported by the specified image format.
solution: Specify an image with non null image data and a supported format. Refer to the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA views and the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a list of supported image features and formats.

message: 2FF10 - illegal image format specification
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. The specified format name was null or invalid.
solution: Specify a format name that is not null. For supported image formats, specify a format name that matches the image BLOB format. For unsupported image formats, specify a format name that is not listed as supported image format. Refer to the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA views and the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a list of supported image formats.

message: 2FF11 - unsupported image format conversion specified
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the specified target format value was null, the specified image had a null format value, or the conversion from the specified image format to the specified target format was not supported.
solution: Specify an image with a supported image format and specify a target format value that is supported for conversion. Refer to the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA views and the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a list of supported image format conversions.

message: 2FF12 - illegal specification for thumbnail generation
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. Either the specified image format did not support thumbnail generation, the specified thumbnail height or width was greater than the image height or width respectively, or the default thumbnail size 80 X 80 was greater than the image height or width respectively.
solution: Specify an image for which thumbnail generation is supported and specify thumbnail height and width values that are less than the image height and width values. Refer to the SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA views and the Oracle Multimedia documentation for a list of supported thumbnail formats.

message: 2202D Data exception - Null image value
cause: There was a SQL/MM Still Image exception. The function was invoked using a null image value.
solution: Specify an image whose image data is not null. Refer to the Oracle Multimedia documentation for more information on constructing SI_StillImage objects.

cause: Validity Constraint 2.8 failed: "Parameter-entity replacement text must be properly nested with markup declarations." *Example: <?xml version="1.0"?> <!DOCTYPE greeting [ <!ENTITY % e "<!ELEMENT "> %e; greeting (#PCDATA)> ]> <greeting>Hello!</greeting> *Explanation: The parameter entity 'e' contains markup which may not be split up; the entire ELEMENT (or ATTLIST or ENTITY) definition must be present in one piece.
solution: Correct the document.

message: standalone document declaration should be "no"
cause: Validity Constraint 2.9 failed: "Standalone document declaration must have the value 'no' if any external markup declarations contain declarations of: * attributes with default values - or - * entities - or - * attributes with values subject to normalization - or - * element types with element content"
solution: Correct the document.

message: document structure does not match DTD
cause: Validity Constraint 3 failed: "An element is valid if there is a declaration matching elementdecl where the Name matches the element type, and one of the following holds: * The declaration matches EMPTY and the element has no content * The declaration matches children and the sequence of child elements belongs to the language generated by the regular expression in the content model, with optional white space (characters matching the nonterminal S) between each pair of child elements. * The declaration matches Mixed and the content consists of character data and child elements whose types match names in the content model. * The declaration matches ANY, and the types of any child elements have been declared."
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~S" is not declared in the DTD
cause: Validity Constraint 3 failed: The named element has no matching elementdecl in the DTD
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~S" is not empty as required by the DTD
cause: Validity Constraint 3 failed: The named element is declared as EMPTY in the DTD but contains sub-elements in the document.
solution: Correct the document.

message: attribute "~1S" of element "~2S" is undefined
cause: Validity Constraint 3.1 failed:
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~S" has multiple declarations
cause: Validity Constraint 3.2 failed: "No element type may be declared more than once."
solution: Correct the DTD.

message: parameter-entity parenthetical cannot be split up
cause: Validity Constraint 3.2.1 failed: "Parameter-entity replacement text must be properly nested with parenthesized groups. For interoperability, if a parameter-entity reference appears in a choice, seq, or Mixed construct, its replacement text should not be empty, and neither the first nor last non-blank character of the replacement text should be a connector (| or ,). *Example: <?xml version="1.0"?> <!DOCTYPE foo [ <!ELEMENT greeting (#PCDATA)> <!ENTITY % e "(#PCDATA|"> <!ELEMENT foo %e; greeting)> ]> <greeting>Hello!</greeting> *Explanation: The parenthetical content of the 'e' entity may not be split up into sections: both open and close parentheses must be in the same declaration.
solution: Correct the DTD.

message: duplicate name "~S" in mixed-content declaration
cause: Validity Constraint 3.2.2 failed: "The same name must not appear more than once in a single mixed-content declaration." *Example: <!ELEMENT p (#PCDATA|a|b|c|d|a)> *Explanation: 'a' occurs more than once in the mixed-content declaration.
solution: Correct the DTD.

message: invalid ~1s "~2S" (not a Name)
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.1 failed: Given thing is not a Name
solution: Correct the document.

message: invalid ~1s "~2S" (not a Nmtoken)
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.1 failed: Given thing is not a Nmtoken
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~S" has multiple ID attributes
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.1 failed: "No element type may have more than one ID attribute specified."
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~1S" ID attribute "~2S" must be #IMPLIED or #REQUIRED
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.1 failed: "An ID attribute must have a declared default of #IMPLIED or #REQUIRED."
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~1S" attribute "~2S" has invalid enumeration value "~3S"
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.1 failed: "Values of this type must match one of the Nmtoken tokens in the declaration."
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~1S" is missing required attribute "~2S"
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.2 failed: "If the default declaration is the keyword #REQUIRED, then the attribute must be specified for all elements of the type in the attribute-list declaration."
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~1S" attribute "~2S" has invalid value "~3S", must be "~4S"
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.2 failed: "If an attribute has a default value declared with the #FIXED keyword, instances of that attribute must match the default value."
solution: Correct the document.

message: undefined entity "~S"
cause: Validity Constraint 4.1 failed: "In a document with an external subset or external parameter entities with "standalone='no'", the Name given in the entity reference must match that in an entity declaration."
solution: Correct the document.

message: element "~1S" attribute "~2S" must be an unparsed entity
cause: The attribute value must be an unparsed entity.
solution: Correct the document.

message: entity "~1S" NDATA (notation) "~2S" is undefined
cause: Entity's NDATA (notation) is undefined
solution: Correct the document.

message: undefined notation "~S"
cause: Notation is not known.
solution: Correct the document.

message: undefined ID "~S" in IDREF
cause: Validity Constraint 3.3.1 failed: "A name must not appear more than once in an XML document as a value of this type; i.e., ID values must uniquely identify the elements which bear them."
solution: Correct the document.

message: duplicate ID "~S"
cause: An ID was used twice, they must be unique.
solution: Correct the document.

message: attribute value should be one or more tokens
cause: An attribute with tokenized type (IDREFS, ENTITIES, NMTOKENS) did not contain any tokens.
solution: Value must contain one or more tokens, separated by spaces.

message: duplicate entity "~S" (ignored)
cause: Warning returned by XmlDomGetDecl when original document did not contain an XMLDecl
solution: This is a warning, not an error. The value XMLERR_NO_DECL is used by the programmer to detect whether a document had an XMLDecl or not. It does not indicate a problem.

message: could not convert from encoding ~1s to ~2s
cause: The conversion cannot be made between the specified encodings.
solution: Choose a data encoding which can represent all expected input encoding (such as a Unicode-based encoding, UTF-8 or UTF-16).

message: unknown encoding "~s"
cause: The specified encoding was not known. It should be an IANA or Oracle encoding name.
solution: Use an appropriate encoding.

message: could not open "~s" (error ~u)
cause: The named input (file, URL, etc) does not exist.
solution: Make sure the named input is available and can be opened.

message: could not read from "~s" (error ~u)
cause: Data could not be read from the named input.
solution: Take appropriate action to allow data to be read.

message: syntax error
cause: A syntax error was found.
solution: Check the XML document line and correct it.

message: expected "<!--" at the start of comment
cause: Bad syntax detected when processing a comment.
solution: Fix the comment syntax.

message: invalid CDATA section
cause: Bad syntax detected when processing CDATA. Proper format is '<![CDATA[' data ']]>'.
solution: Correct the CDATA syntax.

message: expected "[" at the start of conditional section
cause: Bad syntax detected when processing a conditional section.
solution: Fix the conditional section syntax.

message: unknown DTD keyword "~s"
cause: An unknown keyword was found in the DTD.
solution: Use a proper keyword.

message: PI names starting with XML are reserved
cause: Processing instruction starting with XML was found.
solution: Use another name for the processing instruction.

message: expected '~1c' instead of '~2c'
cause: A syntax error was detected.
solution: Use proper syntax.

message: attribute default must be REQUIRED, IMPLIED, or FIXED
cause: Attribute default was invalid.
solution: Default must be REQUIRED, IMPLIED, or FIXED.

message: comment must not contain "--"
cause: A syntax error was detected in the comment.
solution: Use '--' only when specifying the end of the comment.

message: comment did not end in "-->"
cause: A syntax error was detected in the comment.
solution: Be sure to end the comment with '-->'.

message: CDATA section did not end in "]]>"
cause: A syntax error was detected in the CDATA section.
solution: Be sure to end the CDATA section with ']]>'.

message: processing instruction did not end in "?>"
cause: A syntax error was detected in the PI section.
solution: Be sure to end the PI with '?>'.

message: invalid character ~1u (~2X)
cause: An invalid multibyte character was found.
solution: Use only characters allowed by the XML specification.

message: invalid character ~1u (~2x)
cause: An invalid Unicode character was found.
solution: Use only characters allowed by the XML specification.

message: invalid character ~1u ('~2c')
cause: An invalid native (ASCII/EBCDIC) character was found.
solution: Use only characters allowed by the XML specification.

message: invalid digit '~c' in character reference
cause: An invalid digit was found in a character reference.
solution: Character references are either &#DDD; where D's are decimal digits, or &#xHHH; where H's are hexadecimal digits.

message: the string "]]>" cannot occur in character data
cause: Found ']]>' in character data.
solution: Do not use ']]>' in character data.

message: the character "<" cannot occur in attribute values
cause: Found '<' in an attribute value.
solution: Do not use '<' in attribute values.

message: error received from SAX callback function
cause: An error was received from the SAX callback function.
solution: Examine the additional error messages and take corrective action.

message: external entity "~s" found in an attribute value
cause: An external entity reference was found in an attribute value.
solution: Use only references to internal or character entities in attribute values.

message: multiple occurrences of attribute "~S" found
cause: An attribute occurred multiple times in the same start-tag or empty-element tag.
solution: Make sure that the attributes are unique.

message: end-element tag "~1S" does not match start-element tag "~2S"
cause: An element tag was not ended properly.
solution: Make sure that the correct end element tag is used.

message: entity "~S" is not declared
cause: An entity is not declared.
solution: Declare the entity before referencing it.

message: entity "~S" is not a parsed entity
cause: An entity reference contained the name of an unparsed entity.
solution: Only reference parsed entities.

message: entity reference "~S" refers to itself
cause: An entity reference contains a recursive reference to itself.
solution: Modify the contents of the entity reference to remove this recursion.

message: input source is empty
cause: An XML input file has no contents.
solution: The XML file representing a document must contain at least one element.

message: invalid character ~1u (~2x) found in a Name or Nmtoken
cause: An invalid character was found in a NAME or NMTOKEN.
solution: Use only the characters allowed for NAMES and NMTOKENS by the XML specification.

message: invalid character ~1u ('~2c') found in a Name or Nmtoken
cause: An invalid character was found in a NAME or NMTOKEN.
solution: Use only the characters allowed for NAMES and NMTOKENS by the XML specification.

message: invalid use of a parameter entity reference
cause: A parameter entity reference was found in an improper location in the internal DTD subset.
solution: Use a parameter entity reference only where markup declarations can occur in the internal DTD subset, in the external DTD subset, or in an external entity.

message: namespace prefixes starting with "xml" are reserved
cause: Namespace prefix starting with XML was found.
solution: Use another name for the namespace prefix.

message: namespace prefix "~S" is not declared
cause: Namespace prefix is not declared.
solution: Declare the prefix in an attribute list.

message: invalid XML version, must be 1.0 or 2.0
cause: Only versions 1.0 and 2.0 of the XML specification are supported.
solution: Use the 1.0 or 2.0 specification & set version# accordingly.

message: invalid character ~1u ('~2c') found in public identifier
cause: An invalid character was found in a public identifier.
solution: Use only the characters allowed for public identifiers by the XML specification.

message: invalid condition section keyword, must be INCLUDE or IGNORE
cause: A conditional section <![ keyword [ markup ]]> had invalid keyword, must be either "IGNORE" or "INCLUDE"
solution: Correct condition section usage in document.

message: unterminated conditional section
cause: A conditional section was not properly terminated with ]]>.
solution: Verify conditional nesting in document and correct.

message: invalid attribute type "~s"
cause: The attribute type is not valid. Options are CDATA, ID, IDREF, IDREFS, ENTITY, ENTITIES, NMTOKEN, or NMTOKENS.
solution: Check and correct attribute declaration.

message: element-start tag is not well formed
cause: A start-element tag was improperly formed.
solution: Check and correct the start-element syntax.

message: entity reference is not well formed
cause: An entity reference (general or parameter) was not formed properly.
solution: Form entity reference correctly as "&name;" or "%name;".

message: invalid use of ampersand ('&') character (use &)
cause: The ampersand character is used only to start entity or character references.
solution: To include an ampersand character as data, use the built-in & general entity.

message: element attribute value must be enclosed in quotes
cause: An attribute defined in an element's start-tag must be enclosed in single ('') or double ("") quotes.
solution: Enclose the attribute value in quotes.

message: invalid use of less-than ('<') character (use <)
cause: The less-than character ('<') is not permitted as data.
solution: Use the built-in entity < instead. Check for mismatched quotes ("') in case the '<' is part of subsequent markup.

message: extra data after end of document
cause: After the close of the top-level element, more data was found.
solution: The end-element tag for the top-level element must be the last thing in the document.

message: missing system ID after public ID
cause: In an external ID declaration, the public ID literal was not followed by the system ID literal as required.
solution: Provide with public *and* system IDs for 'PUBLIC' type.

message: invalid Document Type Declaration (DTD)
cause: Problems were encountered in the DTD declaration.
solution: Review the DTD and correct the problems.

message: invalid entity declaration
cause: Problems were encountered parsing an entity declaration.
solution: Check and correct the declaration syntax.

message: invalid external ID declaration
cause: Problems were encountered parsing an external ID declaration.
solution: Check and correct the declaration syntax.

message: invalid attribute declaration
cause: Problems were encountered parsing an attribute declaration.
solution: Check and correct the declaration syntax.

message: conditional sections are valid only in external DTDs
cause: A condition section is not permitted in internal DTDs.
solution: Remove the condition section.

message: invalid entity replacement-text nesting
cause: Markup included from an entity must nest/group properly. That is, open/close markup must occur within the same entity. For example, <!DOCTYPE doc [ <!ENTITY e "</foo><foo>"> ]> <doc><foo>&e;</foo></doc> Is invalid since foo's start-tag occurs in the top-level document, but the close-tag is provided by the "e" entity. Both start and end must be provided by the same source.
solution: Examples, such as the ones above, are not permitted.

message: missing required version number in XML declaration
cause: An XML declaration was missing the required version#.
solution: Always provide a version#, which must come first in the declaration. XML is case sensitive, so only "version" (not "Version", and so on) is valid.

message: invalid XML declaration
cause: Problems were encountered parsing an XML declaration.
solution: Check and correct the declaration syntax.

message: XML standalone declaration must be "yes" or "no"
cause: The "standalone" parameter in the XML declaration had an invalid value.
solution: standalone must be set to either "yes" or "no". Case is sensitive, so "Yes", "YES", and so on, are invalid.

message: invalid element declaration
cause: Problems were encountered parsing an element declaration.
solution: Check and correct the declaration.

message: invalid children specification in element declaration
cause: The 'children' specification in an element declaration was invalid.
solution: Check and correct the declaration.

message: invalid "Mixed" specification in element declaration
cause: The 'Mixed' specification in an element declaration was invalid.
solution: Check and correct the declaration.

message: invalid notation declaration
cause: Problems were encountered parsing a notation declaration.
solution: Check and correct the declaration syntax.

message: invalid xml:space attribute declaration
cause: The xml:space attribute must be declared as an enumeration with choices "default" and "preserve". For example, <!ATTLIST foo xml:space (default|preserve) 'preserve').
solution: Declare the special attribute as above.

message: invalid URL ~s
cause: The specified URL was invalid and could not be parsed.
solution: Correct the URL; consult RFC-2396.

message: unsupported protocol ~s
cause: An URL was encountered which requested a protocol not supported by the XML parser. Only HTTP and file are currently allowed.
solution: Make the data available through the filesystem or HTTP.

message: couldn't connect to host ~s port ~d
cause: A TCP connection couldn't be opened to the named host.
solution: Verify the hostname and connectivity to the host.

message: send failed to host ~s
cause: An error occurred trying to send data over a TCP connection.
solution: Verify network connectivity, and so on.

message: read failed from to host ~s
cause: An error occurred trying to read data from a TCP connection.
solution: Verify network connectivity, and so on.

message: invalid language specification ~s
cause: The given language specification was invalid.
solution: Language specification has the format <language>_<territory>.<character set>. For example, "French_France".

message: could not resolve relative URL ~s
cause: The named relative URL couldn't be resolved against its parent.
solution: Make sure the relative makes sense in relation to its parent URL; see RFC-2396 sections 4, 5, and appendix C.

message: invalid access method ~1d, must be 0 to ~2d
cause: The provided access code was not in the valid range.
solution: The code should be one of the XMLACCESS_xxx codes defined in oraxml.h, in the range shown in the error message.

message: all three access functions (open/close/read) must be provided
cause: An attempt was made to set the access method callbacks, but all three functions were not provided.
solution: All three callback functions (open, close, and read) are required. They must all be provided, even if they are stub functions which do nothing.

message: FTP error: ~s
cause: An error was returned from the FTP server while trying to retrieve a file. See the specific message for details.
solution: Corrective action depends on the error.

message: FTP login failed: ~s
cause: The username/password combination was invalid for FTP login.
solution: Specify a valid pair.

message: FTP server unavailable: ~s
cause: The FTP server is unavailable for use.
solution: No action is possible from the client side. See server's error message.

message: failed to initialize TCP/IP
cause: The TCP/IP package could not be initialized.
solution: Check with system administrator to see if this is a configuration problem or a connectivity problem.

message: can't import node type
cause: Some node types (DOCUMENT_NODE & DOCUMENT_TYPE_NODE) cannot be imported with importNode().
solution: No action required.

message: can't set output/data encoding AFTER parsing
cause: Output/data encoding must be set after initialization but BEFORE any parsing has taken place.
solution: Set encoding before parsing any documents.

message: bad HTTP/Mime header
cause: An HTTP reply contained an invalid Mime header.
solution: Verify HTTP reply for accuracy. See RFC 2616.

message: no closing quote was seen
cause: A quoted string was started but not finished.
solution: Put a closing quote in the proper location.

message: invalid ~s proxy "~s"
cause: The proxy specification for the given protocol was invalid.
solution: Check and correct the proxy specification. For HTTP, this is the environment variable "http_proxy".

message: invalid no_proxy "~s"
cause: The no_proxy specification was invalid.
solution: Check and correct it. no_proxy is a comma- or space-separated list of machine or domain names, with an optional port part. If no port part is present, then it applies to all ports on that domain.

message: HTTP error ~s
cause: An HTTP protocol error occurred.
solution: Corrective action depends on the error..

message: unsupported encoding "~s"
cause: The specified encoding is known but not supported by the parser.
solution: Try a different encoding.

message: document cannot have both internal/external and shared DTDs
cause: A parser context which had a shared DTD set was used to parse a document which also contained a DTD. You cannot use both a shared DTD and and internal/external one.
solution: If a shared DTD is to be used, then the documents parsed must not contain or reference a DTD.

message: document encoding is ~s-based but default input encoding is not
cause: The input document was detected to be ASCII (or EBCDIC) based, but no encoding was specified in the XMLDecl and the default input coding was not ASCII (or EBCDIC) based, so could not be applied.
solution: Add an explicit encoding specification to the XMLDecl so the default input encoding is not needed, or pick a default encoding which matches the input document.

message: namespace prefix to NULL URI is not allowed
cause: An element's namespace prefix declarations was for a NULL URI, e.g. <foo xmlns:bar=""/> This is illegal presently in XML 1.0, but will be legal in XML 1.1
solution: Remove erroneous prefix definition.

message: invalid Unicode surrogate ~X ~X
cause: A Unicode document contained an invalid surrogate. If the first (high) surrogate is in the correct range 0xD800 to 0xDBFF, then the second (low) surrogate must be in the range 0xDC00 to 0xDFFF.
solution: Correct the document.

message: Exceeded max depth for recursion
cause: The depth of embedded elements in the document exceeded the limit of 2000.
solution: Correct the document.

message: Max limit of ~1d exceeded for ~s
cause: Max limit exceeded
solution: Correct the document.

message: CDATA-section-close delimiter is prohibited in element content
cause: Element content contained CDATA-section-close delimiter.
solution: Correct the document.

message: no name in attribute set
cause: The name attribute was not found in the attribute-set element.
solution: Add a name attribute for this element.

message: error in XPATH evaluation
cause: The XPATH evaluation returns an error.
solution: Check specified XPATH expression to determine the error.

message: Incorrect stylesheet. The node is not valid.
cause: The child node is of invalid type or has invalid name for this particular location in stylesheet, rendering the stylesheet as invalid XSLT.
solution: Fix the stylesheet by using valid nodes only.

message: attribute value "~S" not expected for ~S
cause: Attribute is found but its value is not the expected value.
solution: Set the attribute value to the correct value.

message: input parameter to function is null
cause: An input parameter passed into this function is null when it is not supposed to.
solution: Make sure the caller function is not passing null for this parameter.

message: missing token
cause: An expected token is not found.
solution: Check the input string to make sure the expected token is present.

message: inputed string ended with no corresponding closing '}'
cause: A closing '}' is expected.
solution: Add the closing '}' to the input string or remove the extra opening '{'.

message: namespace prefix ~S used but not declared
cause: Namespace prefix is used but not declared.
solution: Either declare the namespace or don't use this namespace prefix.

message: attribute ~S not found in ~S
cause: The expected attribute for this node is not found.
solution: Need to add this attribute to the node.

message: cannot initialize XPATH
cause: XPATH context could not be initialized.
solution: Check the initialization function LpxsutInitXpathCtx().

message: element ~S not found in ~S
cause: The expected element is not found.
solution: Check the initialization function LpxsutInitXpathCtx().

message: unsupported feature: ~s
cause: This feature is not supported.
solution: Do not use this feature.

message: cannot construct XML PI with content: ~S
cause: The content of XML PI node might be invalid.
solution: Make necessary changes to make the node valid according to spec.

message: cannot construct XML comment with content: ~S
cause: The content of XML comment node might be invalid.
solution: Make necessary changes to make the node valid according to spec.

message: an internal failure occurred
cause: An internal error occurred in the code.
solution: Contact appropriate developer.

message: extension function ~S not supported
cause: This extension function is not supported.
solution: Either contact appropriate developer for more information or don't use this extension function.

message: invalid value ~S for ~S attribute ~S
cause: The value for the specified attribute is invalid.
solution: Consult the XSL spec, use only legal values.

message: undefined decimal-format "~S"
cause: The named decimal-format is undefined (the name "#default" means the default format).
solution: Define the desired decimal-format before trying to use it.

message: duplicate xsl:decimal-format "~S"
cause: The named decimal-format was declared more than once.
solution: Make sure there is only a single declaration.

message: The node specified is not valid
cause: The node specified is not of expected type.
solution: Use only the nodes of legal type.

message: No more attributes can be added to a non empty element
cause: The element to which an attribute was being added is non empty and hence can not add anymore attributes to it.
solution: Modify the XSLT stylesheet so that all the attributes are added to an element before anything else is added to it. If you absolutely can not do that then select your output method to be DOM based rather then a stream or SAX based output which you are using presently.

message: None of the output method (DOM, SAX, Stream) is selected
cause: User is trying to process an XML file with out selecting any mechanism for output.
solution: User must select one of the output mechanisms (SAX/DOM/Stream) before attempting to process the XML file.

message: A doc referred by XSLT stylesheet could not be opened : ~s
cause: Either an import,include or document() function tried to open a document and failed.
solution: Make sure that document is present and can be opened.

message: illegal apply-imports because of no current template: ~s
cause: apply-imports was used even when there was no current template possibly with in for-each.
solution: Make sure that apply-imports are invoked only if there is a current template and it is not in a xsl:for-each.

message: "~S" is not a valid value for the lang attribute of xsl:sort
cause: An invalid language name was specified for sorting.
solution: Provide a valid value for the lang attribute of xsl:sort.

message: an internal error has occurred in XPATH
cause: An internal error has occurred in XPATH.
solution: Contact the appropriate developer.

message: invalid QName in the XSL file
cause: An invalid QName was passed to the XPATH parser.
solution: See whether there are any invalid QNames in the XSL file.

message: invalid axisname in the XSL file
cause: An invalid axis name was passed to the XPATH parser.
solution: See whether all axis names in the XSL file are correct.

message: unmatched quote in the XSL file
cause: An unmatched quote was found in the XSL file.
solution: Check for unmatched quotes in the XSL file.

message: unable to resolve namespace URI
cause: The namespace URI may not be valid.
solution: Make sure that the name space URIs are valid.

message: unable to allocate memory
cause: May be out of memory.
solution: Try increasing virtual memory.

message: object of incorrect type passed to the function
cause: An object of incorrect type was passed to the XPATH/XSL function.
solution: Do the required conversion before passing in an object of type which is different from the expected type.

message: right square bracket missing in the XSL file
cause: Right square bracket missing in the XSL file.
solution: Check for unmatched square bracket in the XSL file.

message: right parenthesis missing in the XSL file
cause: Right parenthesis missing in the XSL file.
solution: Check for unmatched parenthesis in the XSL file.

message: incorrect token encountered while parsing
cause: An unexpected token encountered while parsing the expression/ pattern.
solution: Check the syntax of the expressions/patterns.

message: unable to resolve the variable reference
cause: Variable reference may not be valid.
solution: Check whether the variable references are valid.

message: unknown function name encountered
cause: The function is not supported at this time or the name is invalid.
solution: Check the function names. If valid and this error occurs, then avoid using them at this time.

message: loss of precision due to excessively large numerical constant
cause: The numerical constant in the XPath expression is too big.
solution: None

message: Invalid token in: '~S'
cause: Invalid token in XPath expression.
solution: Check the expression.

message: Invalid child element '~1S' of element '~2S'.
cause: Invalid child element in this stylesheet context.
solution: Check the stylesheet.

message: Invalid attribute value '~1S': {element '~2S', attribute '~3S'}.
cause: Invalid attribute value in this stylesheet context.
solution: Check the stylesheet.

message: Invalid attribute value '~1S', for attribute '~2s'.
cause: Invalid attribute value for this attribute.
solution: Check the stylesheet.

message: Invalid attribute '~1S' in element '~2S'.
cause: Invalid attribute for this element.
solution: Check the stylesheet.

message: Missing attribute '~1s' in element '~2S'.
cause: Missing attribute for this element.
solution: Check the stylesheet.

message: Invalid reference: '~S'.
cause: Invalid variable or parameter or template reference.
solution: Check the stylesheet.

message: Repeated declaration of '~1S' in element '~2S'.
cause: Only one declaration is allowed at this level.
solution: Check the stylesheet.

message: Function call with invalid number of arguments in '~1S'.
cause: Invalid number of arguments.
solution: Check the function signature.

message: VM Stack overflow.
cause: The XML data is too large.
solution: Increase the size of VM stacks in XmlXslVMCreate().

message: SAX callback returns with error.
cause: SAX callback returns an error.
solution: Check the callback function.

message: Output attribute '~S' doesn't have a parent element.
cause: Attribute is generated in a wrong context.
solution: Check the XSLT stylesheet.

message: Output namespace attribute '~S' doesn't have a parent element.
cause: Attribute generated in the wrong context.
solution: Check the XSLT stylesheet.

message: Invalid output comment '~S'.
cause: Invalid comment node.
solution: Check the XSLT stylesheet.

message: XSLTVM terminate.
cause: VM terminates.
solution: No action.

message: Invalid output PI '~S'.

cause: Invalid encoding specified.

cause: The string data is too large.

cause: Too many XML nodes.

message: Invalid argument.
cause: Invalid or missing argument.
solution: Check the function signature.

message: invalid SOAP context
cause: The SOAP context passed to an XmlSoap function was invalid.
solution: Make sure the context passed is an xmlsoapctx and is still valid (has not been destroyed).

message: invalid SOAP role
cause: An invalid SOAP role was specified.
solution: Only xmlsoaprole enum values should be used (see xml.h).

message: invalid SOAP connection binding
cause: An invalid SOAP connection binding was specified.
solution: Only xmlsoapbind enum values should be used (see xml.h).

message: SOAP POST failed
cause: A SOAP message sent with an HTTP binding failed.
solution: See the returned HTTP error to determine the problem.

message: elem has no mustUnderstand
cause: Header block does not have a mustUnderstand attribute.
solution: This is legal, no action required.

message: elem has no role
cause: Header block does not have a role attribute.
solution: This is legal, no action required.

message: message has no fault
cause: Message body has no Fault child.
solution: This is legal, no action required.

message: no Fault reason w/given language
cause: Fault element does not have a reason with given language.
solution: This is legal, no action required.

message: SOAP failed to make HTTP connection
cause: SOAP failed to make an HTTP connection to the given URL.
solution: Possible cause is invalid URL or memory exhaustion.

message: SOAP reply not valid XML
cause: The reply to a SOAP call was not a valid XML document.
solution: Check the calling URL for validity; otherwise the problem is likely to be on the reply side.

message: invalid SOAP version
cause: The version string specified at SOAP creation time was invalid.
solution: Specify a valid version string, either '1.1' or '1.2'.

message: failed to set HTTP header
cause: Connection does not exists, or header is badly formed, or maximum number of headers is exceeded.
solution: Check that connection exists, header has ':', decrease number of headers.

message: body has more than one fault
cause: Message body has multiple Fault children.
solution: Most likely bug in the server.

message: fault is not a single child
cause: Message body has additional children besides Fault.
solution: Most likely bug in the server.

message: badly formed fault elemen
cause: Fault element does not have one of mandatory children or has children, which are not allowed.
solution: Most likely bug in the server.

message: badly formed Text subelement
cause: Mandatory text child is missing from the requested message subelemt.
solution: Most likely bug in the server.

message: badly formed Value subelement
cause: Mandatory Value child of the Code child of the Fault badly formed or absent.
solution: Most likely bug in the server.

message: message has no envelope
cause: The message has no envelope element child.
solution: Most likely bug in the server.

message: prefix too long
cause: The maximum size of encoded namespace attribute name is 1022.
solution: Use shorter prefix.

message: envelope has no header
cause: The message envelope does not have header.
solution: This is legal, no action required

message: envelope has no body
cause: The message envelope does not have body.
solution: Most likely bug in the server.

message: elem has no relay
cause: Header block does not have a relay attribute.
solution: This is legal, no action required.

message: no such element
cause: The element with requested namespace name and local part does not exists.
solution: This is legal, no action required.

message: arguments "~1s" to function "~2s" are null
cause: Input arguments passed into this function are null when it is not supposed to.
solution: Make sure the caller function is not passing null for this parameter.

message: arguments "~s" are exclusive
cause: Input arguments passed into this function are exclusive. Specify only one of them.
solution: Specify only one of the exclusive arguments.

message: invalid ~1s, must be ~2s
cause: Invalid value was specified for attribute.
solution: Correct the value with one of the suggested values.

message: invalid proxy "~s"
cause: The proxy specification for the given protocol was invalid.
solution: Check and correct the proxy specification. For HTTP, this is the environment variable "http_proxy".

message: invalid no_proxy "~s"
cause: The no_proxy specification was invalid.
solution: Check and correct the specification. no_proxy is a comma- or space-separated list of machine or domain names, with an optional port part. If no port part is present, then it applies to all ports on that domain.

message: missing required argument "~s"
cause: A required argument was missing.
solution: Provide the missing argument to the function.

message: Etags and tokens must be either all tagged or all untagged
cause: The list of condition factors need to be either all tagged with absoluteURI's or all untagged with absoluteURI's.
solution: If all condition factors were applied to the resource receiving the request, make them all untagged. Otherwise, make them all tagged with appropriate resource's URI's.

message: maximum XML document size (~s bytes) exceeded
cause: The input XML document's size exceeded the limit set by "max_xml_size" attribute set in XmlDavCreate().
solution: Raise the value set for max_xml_size attribute in XmlDavCreate() if this does not create problems with security.

message: user-provided callback returns null
cause: Null was returned from user-provided callback function.
solution: Check error(s) encoutered within the callback function.

message: failed to initialize TCP/IP
cause: The TCP/IP package could not be initialized.
solution: Check with your system administrator to see if this is a configuration problem or a connectivity problem.

message: couldn't connect to host ~s port ~u
cause: A TCP connection couldn't be opened to the named host.
solution: Verify the hostname and connectivity to the host.

message: send failed to host ~s
cause: An error occurred trying to send data over a TCP connection.
solution: Verify network connectivity.

message: read failed from host ~s
cause: An error occurred trying to read data from a TCP connection.
solution: Verify network connectivity.

message: exceeded maximum TCP connections
cause: The maximum allowable number of TCP connections were exceeded. This happens only if too many pending HTTP responses have not been properly ended or destroyed.
solution: End a pending response session or destroy response objects that have been processed.

message: TCP connection was broken
cause: Either the server terminated the TCP connection or the TCP connection is in a bad state.
solution: Analyze the error. After cleanup, retry the method.

message: HTTP error ~s
cause: An HTTP protocol error occurred.
solution: Corrective action depends on the error.

message: unsupported transfer-coding values: ~s
cause: Only "chunked" and "identity" transfer-coding values are supported.
solution: This is WebDAV implementation's shortfall. There is no workaround for this problem.

message: not a text media type
cause: A text media type was expected. But other media types were found.
solution: Since this data cannot be read as a text type, use another routine to read it.

message: no entity body found
cause: No entity body was found when it was read.
solution: Check the HTTP status code and headers to see why the entity body was not found.

message: not xml media type
cause: An XML media type was expected. But other media types were found.
solution: Since this data cannot be read as an XML type, use another routine to read it.

message: missing lock token in lock refresh request
cause: A LOCK request to refresh a lock had no lock token header specified.
solution: Use XmlDavUpdResDesc to set a lock token in the resource

message: missing lock token in UNLOCK request
cause: An UNLOCK request to remove a lock had no lock token header specified.
solution: Use XmlDavUpdResDesc to set a lock token in the resource

message: wrong object type
cause: The wrong object type was given as argument to a WebDAV call.
solution: Review the failing function call, consult the documentation, and make sure the object types pass as correct.

message: protocol violation: ~s
cause: The entity body sent by the server in Chunked Transfer Encoding violated protocol.
solution: Either this is an internal implementation error or a server implementation error. Users should file a bug agaist either the server's or the client's implementation.

message: NULL pointer
cause: A NULL pointer was detected as an internal error condition.
solution: This is a programming error by the caller of the Schema processor. Contact someone who can fix the problem.

message: root element is not <schema>
cause: The top-level element of an XML Schema must be <schema>.
solution: Correct the Schema; consult the Schema specification.

message: invalid attribute "~1S" for element "~2S"
cause: The named Schema element had an invalid attribute.
solution: Correct the Schema; consult the Schema specification.

message: unexpected XML node type
cause: Schema contains an XML node other than element, text (or CDATA),
solution: Other node types are not permitted; remove them.

message: feature "~s" is not implemented
cause: An attempt was made to use a feature that is not yet implemented.
solution: Make an enhancement request for the feature.

message: data missing for type "~S"
cause: Data is missing for an element or attribute of a simple type.
solution: Add data in the element or attribute.

message: extra element(s) at end of "~S"
cause: Extra elements exist at the end of schema component declarations.
solution: Remove the extra elements.

message: internal error: ~s
cause: Implementation error.
solution: File a bug.

message: element "~S" not from Schema of Schemas
cause: Bogus element exists in the schema file. Its name is not from Schema of Schemas.
solution: Remove the bogus element.

message: empty instance document
cause: Instance document to be Schema validated was empty (no top-level element).
solution: Provide a complete XML instance document.

message: failed to parse document
cause: Failed to parse the schema document using the given URI.
solution: Provide the correct URI and make sure that the schema document is valid.

message: schema and instance document have incompatible character sets
cause: Parsed schema components were in a simple-type character set while the parsed instance document data was not. A simple-type character set is single-byte, not shift sensitive, and has no linguistic specials in use.
solution: Reinitialize the schema global context with appropriate parser context settings, i.e. pass a parser context with its output encoding set to be a multibyte or Unicode character set.

message: invalid schema context
cause: An invalid schema context was provided to the processor. Multiple schema documents were loaded and assembled into the schema context. At least one of them is not fully valid with respect to a schema corresponding to the Schema for Schemas.
solution: Check the errors reported when schema documents were loaded, mapped, or validated. Correct errors found in the identified schema documents and reload them into a new schema context. Then provide the new schema context to the processor.

message: unknown type "~S"
cause: A specified type was unknown (not defined in any loaded Schemas).
solution: Make sure the type was defined and that the type usage referenced the correct Schema.

message: undefined element "~S"
cause: Element is undefined in the specified namespace.
solution: If the element name is misspelled, correct the spelling.

message: unknown namespace prefix "~S"
cause: Prefix in a QName is undefined in the current scope.
solution: Correct the prefix name if it's misspelled.

message: unknown namespace URI "~S"
cause: Namespace URI is unknown to the schema processor.
solution: Correct the namespace URI if it's misspelled.

message: unknown attribute group "~S"
cause: The name of attribute group is unknown to the schema processor in the current scope.
solution: Correct the name of attribute group if it's misspelled.

message: unknown group "~S"
cause: The name of group is unknown to the schema processor in the current scope.
solution: Correct the name of group if it's misspelled.

message: unknown attribute "~S"
cause: The name of attribute is unknown to the schema processor in the current scope.
solution: Correct the name of attribute if it's misspelled.

message: property "~s" unknown
cause: The named validation property was unknown.
solution: Refer to the documentation for the complete list of validation properties.

message: duplicate element "~S"
cause: Element declaration is not unique within its scope.
solution: Rename the element.

message: duplicate group "~S"
cause: Group declaration is not unique within its scope.
solution: Rename the group.

message: duplicate type "~S"
cause: Type definition is not unique within its scope.
solution: Rename the type.

message: duplicate attribute group "~S"
cause: Attribute group declaration is not unique within its scope.
solution: Rename the attribute group.

message: duplicate attribute "~S"
cause: Attribute declaration is not unique within its scope.
solution: Rename the attribute.

message: facet "~S" should have single value attribute
cause: A facet declaration did not have a value attribute.
solution: Each facet declaration must contain one and only one value attribute.

message: type "~S" contains invalid facets
cause: A specified facet was invalid for a type. Each datatype has a different set of facets which may apply.
solution: Use only applicable facets for the type.

message: facet "~S" duplicated
cause: A facet (other than "enumeration") was specified more than once.
solution: Only the enumeration facet may be used more than once for a type.

message: facet "~1S" has invalid value "~2S"
cause: Facet value contained illegal characters or its value was out of range.
solution: Remove illegal characters.

message: facet "~S" not in schema schema
cause: Facets are not defined in the XMLSchema namespace.
solution: Remove illegal facet declarations.

message: mutually exclusive facets are not allowed
cause: Mutual exclusiveness violations were found for facets. For example, both "length" and either "minLength" or "maxLength" are not allowed to be facets.
solution: Remove the facets that are at fault.

message: "minLength" should not be greater than "maxLength"
cause: The value of "minLength" must be less than or equal to the value of "maxLength".
solution: Correct either "minLength" or "maxLength".

message: fixed facet value cannot be changed
cause: The value of a fixed facet in the base type definition should remain the same.
solution: Remove the fixed facet specification in the parent's type for the erroneous facet component.

message: value is not valid restriction of parent's minLength
cause: There was an error in that minLength was among the members of {facets} of {base type definition} and {value} was less than the {value} of the parent minLength.
solution: Increase the {value} of minLength.

message: value is not valid restriction of parent's maxLength
cause: There was an error in that maxLength was among the members of {facets} of {base type definition} and {value} was greater than the {value} of the parent maxLength.
solution: Increase the {value} of maxLength.

message: value is not valid restriction of parent's length
cause: There was an error in that length was among the members of {facets} of {base type definition} and {value} was not equal to the {value} of the parent length.
solution: Make {value} the same as parent's.

message: value is not valid restriction of parent's whiteSpace
cause: There was an error in that whiteSpace was among the members of {facets} of {base type definition} and at least one of the following conditions was true: 1 {value} is replace or preserve and {value} of the parent whiteSpace is collapse 2 {value} is preserve and the {value} of the parent whiteSpace is replace
solution: Change the {value} of whiteSpace.

message: base type is required
cause: Missing base type declaration in the type definition.
solution: Define a base type.

message: "list" element is improperly defined
cause: A "list" element either must have its "itemType" attribute set or have one of its children be a "simpleType" element, but both conditions cannot exist.
solution: Remove the erroneous condition.

message: "restriction" element is improperly defined
cause: A "restriction" element either must have its "base" attribute set or have one of its children be a "simpleType" element, but both conditions cannot exist.
solution: Remove the erroneous condition.

message: facet "~1S" has invalid value "~u"
cause: Facet value contained illegal characters or its value was out of range.
solution: Remove illegal characters.

message: attribute "processContents" has invalid value "~S"
cause: Attribute "processContents" in the "any" element or "anyAttribute" declaration has an invalid value.
solution: Specify one of the following values: lax, skip, or strict.

message: attribute "~1S" has invalid occurrences value "~2S"
cause: A minOccurs or maxOccurs attribute had an invalid value (not a integer or less than zero).
solution: Use a legal "occurs" value.

message: attribute "use" has invalid value "~S"
cause: A "use" attribute had an invalid value. Choices for "use" are "default", "fixed", "optional", "prohibited", or "required".
solution: Change the attribute to one of the above values.

message: attribute "~1S" has invalid qualification "~2S"
cause: An attribute that specifies qualification (form, attributeFormDefault, elementFormDefault) was invalid; it must be one of "qualified" or "unqualified".
solution: Change the attribute to one of the above values.

message: invalid min/max Occurs for <all> element, must be 0/1
cause: "minOccurs" has a value other than 0/1 or "maxOccurs" has a value other than 1.
solution: Specify 0/1 for "minOccurs" or "maxOccurs".

message: "maxOccurs" is less than "minOccurs"
cause: The value of the "maxOccurs" specification is less than the value of the "minOccurs" specification.
solution: Correct "minOccurs" or "maxOccurs".

message: ID type may only be used in attributes
cause: For backward compatibility with DTD, ID type may only be used in attributes.
solution: Remove the ID type.

message: invalid sub-element "~1S" for element "~2S"
cause: There was an invalid sub-element in the content of either the attribute or the element declaration. This was because the sub-element was either at the wrong position or out of context.
solution: Remove the sub-element or move it to the correct position.

message: element "~S" must have type or ref
cause: A Schema element was declared but was neither type or reference.
solution: One of type or reference must be specified.

message: attribute "~1S" invalid derivation-restriction value "~2S"
cause: An attribute which specifies a derivation-restriction setting (block, content, final) had an invalid value. Choices are "#all", "extension", or "restriction".
solution: Change the attribute to one of the above values.

message: attribute "~1S" invalid derived value "~2S"
cause: A derivedBy attribute had an invalid value. Choices are "extension" or "restriction".
solution: Change the attribute to one of the above values.

message: element or attribute is improperly defined
cause: An element or attribute definition must have either its "type" attribute set or must have one of its children be a "simpleType" or "complexType" element but both conditions cannot exist.
solution: Remove the erroneous condition.

message: "~1S" cannot contain "~2S"
cause: An invalid schema component exists in the current declaration.
solution: Remove the schema component.

message: annotation must come first in "~S"
cause: "annotation" element must be the first in the content.
solution: Make "annotation" the first element.

message: duplicated ID specified in "~S"
cause: An attempt was made to specify two distinct members of {attribute uses}with {attribute declaration}s, both of whose {type definition}s are from ID or are derived from ID.
solution: Declare only one member of the {attribute uses} whose {type definition} is from ID or will be derived from ID.

message: attributeGroup reference shouldn't have children
cause: A reference-to-attributeGroup element has children. It is suppose to be empty except for annotations.
solution: Remove the children.

message: invalid combination of attributes "ref" and "name"
cause: If the item's parent is not <schema>, then either the "ref" or the "name" attribute must be present, but not both. Top-level elements or attributes must have a name.
solution: Specify either the "ref" or "name" attribute.

message: only "minOccurs", "maxOccurs", or "id" is allowed
cause: If the item's parent is not <schema> and "ref" is present, then "complexType", "simpleType", "key", "keyref", "unique", "nillable", "default", "fixed", "form", "block", and "type" must be absent.
solution: Remove the prohibited attribute.

message: invalid combination of default and fixed attributes
cause: It is an error for a declaration to contain both fixed and default attributes.
solution: Remove either the default or the fixed attributes.

message: attribute "use" must have its value set to "optional"
cause: If "default" and "use" are both present, use must have its value set to "optional".
solution: Remove the default attribute or change the value of the "use" attribute.

message: invalid use of attribute "ref"
cause: If the item's parent is not <schema> and the attribute "ref" is present, then the element "simpleType" and the attributes "form" and "type" must be absent.
solution: Remove the prohibited items.

message: type is final and no derivations are allowed
cause: Derivation from a type that is declared to be final occurred.
solution: Remove the final declaration from the base type.

message: "~S" is abstract and cannot be used in an instance document
cause: The element declaration or the type definition was abstract.
solution: When an element is declared to be abstract, a member of that element's substitution group must appear in the instance document. When an element's corresponding type definition is declared as abstract, all instances of that element must use xsi:type to indicate a derived type that is not abstract.

message: base type of "~S" must be simple type or primitive datatype
cause: The derivation constraint was violated.
solution: Use complexType instead of simpleType.

message: list content of multiple simple types is not allowed
cause: Two or more simple types were specified within the list content .
solution: Specify only one simple type.

message: invalid substitution group affiliation between "~S" and "~S"
cause: There was an error in that {substitution group exclusions} prevented substitution group affiliation by type restriction or type extension.
solution: Remove the offending deriving method from the {substitution group exclusions} list.

message: disallowed type substitution between "~S" and "~S"
cause: There was a substituted type whose deriving method falls in the union of the {disallowed substitutions} and the {type definition}'s {prohibited substitutions}.
solution: Remove the offending deriving method from the element's {disallowed substitutions} list or the {type definition}'s {prohibited substitutions} list.

message: string "~S" is an invalid default for the complex type
cause: If the {content type} is a simple type definition, then the string must be valid with regard to the simple type definition as defined by String Valid (3.14.4). If the {content type} is mixed, then the {content type}'s particle must be emptiable as defined by Particle Emptiable (3.9.6). However, one of these conditions was not met, resulting in this error.
solution: Make the default string a valid default with regard to the complex type definition.

message: duplicated content specification in "~S"
cause: There was a duplicate content specification in the children of complexType.
solution: Remove the duplicate content specification.

message: no content specified in "~S"
cause: In a simpleContent specification, either "restriction" or "extension" was not specified as a child.
