message: Attribute " string " has no attribute map.
cause: The attribute had no corresponding attribute map on the hierarchy level.
solution: Create an attribute map on the attribute.

message: A dependency cannot be added on the organizationalSchema to the cube because measure " string " is invalid.
cause: An attempt was made to commit an organizationalSchema that contained an invalid measure.
solution: Correct the measure.

message: A dependency cannot be added on the organizationalSchema to the cube because the cube has been deleted.
cause: An attempt was made to commit an organizationalSchema that contained a deleted cube.
solution: Remove the cube reference from the organizationalSchema.

message: UniqueKey attribute " string " on the dimension level is invalid.
cause: The uniqueKey attribute was invalid.
solution: Correct the uniqueKey attribute or delete it from the dimension level.

message: Attribute map " string " is invalid.
cause: An attribute on the attribute map was invalid.
solution: Correct the attribute or delete it from the dimension.

message: The DimensionMap for Dimension " string " must contain either a query or a From clause
cause: The DimensionMap did not have a query or From clause.
solution: Specify a query or From clause for the DimensionMap.

message: No key expression is defined on this dimension map owned by " string ".
cause: A key expression was not defined on the dimension map.
solution: Define a key expression on the dimension map.

message: Measure " string " does not exist in cube " string ".
cause: The measure associated with the measure map did not exist in the cube.
solution: Correct the measure map or add the measure to the cube.

message: The number of dimensionalities on cube " string " does not match the number of cube dimensionality maps on the cube map.
cause: The number of cube dimensionalities did not equal the number of cube dimensionality maps on the cube map.
solution: Correct the cube dimensionality mappings.

message: Measure map " string " refers to an invalid measure, " string ".
cause: The measure was invalid.
solution: Correct the measure or delete it from the cube.

message: Dimension " string " is created before the attribute cube GID relation is added.
cause: The dimension was created before the attribute cube GID relation was added.
solution: Add the attribute cube GID relation.

message: A generic metadata validation error has occurred.
cause: An attempt was made to commit with invalid metadata.
solution: Correct the metadata.

message: A generic metadata validation error occurred against " string ".
cause: An attempt was made to commit with invalid metadata.
solution: Correct the metadata.

message: The dimension " string " is referenced more than once in the precompute list of the AWCubeOrganization.
cause: Duplicate dimensions were specified in the precompute list of the AWCubeOrganization.
solution: Remove duplicate dimensions from the precompute list.

message: The dimension " string " referenced in the precompute list of the AWCubeOrganization is not part of cube " string ".
cause: A dimension specified in the precompute list of the AWCubeOrganization is not part of the cube.
solution: Remove the dimension from the precompute list.

message: The ET attribute prefix of " string " specified for dimension " string " of cube " string " is invalid.
cause: The ET attribute prefix was invalid. The ET attribute prefix: 1) Must be fewer than six characters 2) Cannot be a substring of any MdmDimensionality or MdmMeasure colummn names.
solution: Correct the ET attribute prefix, or omit the prefix to use the default value.

message: The LevelHierarchy " string " contains more than one HierarchyLevel for DimensionLevel " string ".
cause: If HierarchyConsistencyRule is CONSISTENT or STAR_CONSISTENT, then a DimensionLevel within a LevelHierarchy can have only one HierarchyLevel.
solution: Correct the HierarchyLevels in the LevelHierarchy.

message: A subset of the following HierarchyLevels is ordered inconsistently in PrimaryDimension " string ": " string ".
cause: If HierarchyConsistencyRule is CONSISTENT or STAR_CONSISTENT, then HierarchyLevels cannot form loops between LevelHierarchies.
solution: Eliminate the loop.

message: name conflict between string " string " and string " string "
cause: Two metadata objects with the same parent had the same name. This duplication was allowed in Oracle Database 10 Release 2 (10.2) and earlier, but it is not valid for metadata objects in Oracle Database 11 Release 1 (11.1) and later.
solution: Run DBMS_CUBE.INITIALIZE_CUBE_UPGRADE which will populate a table (default name CUBE_UPGRADE_INFO) with new names to resolve the conflicts.

message: Level " string " is not uniquely mapped.
cause: More than one level was mapped to the same expression. If a dimension has materialized views, it cannot have more than one level mapped to the same expression.
solution: Uniquely map all levels or create the dimension without materialized views.

message: Cube " string " cannot override the aggregation maps for this measure.
cause: The consistent solve specification was invalid on the measure.
solution: Modify the cube so it is uncompressed with independent measure storage.

message: The data type of this measure in cube " string " or its mapped expression is incompatible with materialized views.
cause: The data type of a numeric measure in a cube with a materialized view had restricted scale or precision.
solution: Change the data type to NUMBER without any qualifications.

message: The OLAP DML data type cube storage qualifications " string " in cube " string " are incompatible with materialized views.
cause: The cube storage data type of the AWCubeOrganization with a materialized view had restricted scale or precision.
solution: Remove precision and scale restrictions on the NUMBER data type from the cube storage.

message: The data type of base attribute " string " or its mapped expression is incompatible with materialized views.
cause: The data type of the attribute or its mapped expression is not supported by materialized views.
solution: Change the data type of the attribute or its mapped expression.

message: Primary dimension " string " and the cube have incompatible organizations.
cause: The organizations of the primary dimension and of the cube were incompatible. If a cube has an AWCubeOrganization, then all of its primary dimensions must have analytic workspace primary dimension organizations.
solution: Create an analytic workspace primary dimension organization on the primary dimension.

message: Object " string " does not exist.
cause: A cube or dimension was defined in terms of an object that does not exist.
solution: Create the missing object or redefine the cube or dimension.

message: The object cannot be renamed.
cause: An attempt was made to rename an object without the necessary permissions to alter all of the dependent objects.
solution: Do not attempt to rename the object.

message: A partition level of the cube is invalid.
cause: The hierarchy level specified as a partition level of the cube was invalid.
solution: Remove the partition level from the cube or specify a valid hierarchy level.

message: cannot partition a cube by two different dimensions: " string " and " string "
cause: The cube was defined with partitioning by levels from different dimensions.
solution: Ensure that all partition levels for the cube belong to the same dimension.

message: More than one ORDER BY element is specified in the CUSTOMORDER clause.
cause: The CUSTOMORDER contained more than one ORDER BY element.
solution: Specify only one ORDER BY element in the CUSTOMORDER clause.

message: PrimaryDimension " string " is not a valid TimeDimension for the time series expression.
cause: PrimaryDimension was not a TimeDimension.
solution: Specify a TimeDimension for the time series expression.

message: table " string " not found
cause: A table used to map a cube or dimension does not exist. It may have been deleted after the original mapping.
solution: Create the table or remap to a different table.

message: Table " string " does not contain column " string ".
cause: A column used to map a cube or dimension does not exist. It may have been deleted after the original mapping.
solution: Create the column or remap to a different column.

message: Expression " string " is only valid within a model.
cause: The expression can only be specified as the right hand side of a model assignment.
solution: Redefine the expression to remove all model-specific features.

message: object string " string " not found
cause: The referenced object may have been deleted.
solution: Specify an existing object.

message: The string " string " referenced from object " string " is not found.
cause: The referenced object was not found. It may have been deleted.
solution: Specify an existing object.

message: invalid reference to table " string " in mapping " string "
cause: An expression in a mapping object referred to a table that is not part of the mapping query.
solution: Make sure that all expressions in the mapping object refer only to columns from the mapping query.

message: cannot parse OLAP syntax string
cause: The OLAP syntax string was invalid and could not be parsed.
solution: Replace the syntax with a valid syntax string.

message: cannot parse OLAP syntax string " string ": string
cause: The OLAP syntax string was invalid and could not be parsed.
solution: Replace the syntax with a valid syntax string.

message: Function " string " is not supported by the analytic workspace.
cause: A function was specified that is not supported by the OLAP DML language.
solution: Remove the unsupported function from the expression.

message: Data type " string " is not supported by the analytic workspace.
cause: A data type was specified that is not supported by the OLAP DML language.
solution: Use a supported data type.

message: invalid column expression " string "
cause: The OLAP DML expression was invalid in this context.
solution: Replace the expression with a valid syntax string.

message: missing expression in object " string "
cause: A mapping object did not contain all the expressions needed to perform the requested action.
solution: Add the necessary expressions to the mapping object.

message: Missing query and From clause in object " string ".
cause: A mapping object contained neither a query nor a From clause.
solution: Add the necessary query or From clause to the mapping object.

message: missing condition in object " string "
cause: A mapping object did not contain all the conditions that were needed to perform the requested action.
solution: Add the necessary conditions to the mapping object.

message: Dimension or hierarchy has too many Grouping ID columns.
cause: The number of Grouping ID columns exceeded the maximum allowed columns. Possible causes are: 1) Attribute spreading was enabled for some attributes in the dimension. 2) There were too many levels defined for the dimension or hierarchy.
solution: Do one of the following: 1) Disable attribute spreading for some or all of the attributes. 2) Eliminate some attributes. 3) Eliminate some levels.

message: cannot add a dynamic model to the cube's consistent solve specification.
cause: An attempt was made to add a dynamic model to a consistent solve specification that did not contain any aggregation commands.
solution: Add an aggregation command to the consistent solve specification.

message: cannot parse server XML string
cause: An internal error occurred while parsing query or metadata definitions.
solution: Examine the error output for more detail about the reason for the failure.

message: Invalid object type is used for object reference with id " string ".
cause: An object of the wrong type was specified as an object reference in the XML document.
solution: Correct the XML document to reference an object of the correct type.

message: cannot find object " string "
cause: An object that does not exist was referenced in the XML document.
solution: Create the referenced object or correct the XML document to reference an existing object.

message: invalid XML attribute " string " for element " string " and object " string "
cause: An XML attribute in the XML document was invalid.
solution: Correct the invalid attribute in the XML document.

message: invalid XML element " string "
cause: An XML element in the XML document was invalid.
solution: Correct the invalid element in the XML document.

message: invalid XML element " string " for object " string "
cause: An XML element in the XML document was invalid.
solution: Correct the invalid element in the XML document.

message: invalid property " string " with value " string " for object " string " in XML document
cause: The XML document did not specify the object property correctly.
solution: Correct the invalid property in the XML document.

message: invalid property " string " with key::value " string " for object " string " in XML document
cause: The XML document did not specify the object property correctly.
solution: Correct the invalid property in the XML document.

message: invalid XML document: string at line string
cause: An internal error occurred while parsing the XML document.
solution: Examine the error output for more detail about the reason for the failure.

message: Top level object " string " already exists.
cause: An attempt was made through the XML to create an object that already exists.
solution: Drop the existing object before recreating it.

message: Object of type " string " with ID " string " cannot be created because another object with that ID already exists.
cause: An attempt was made through the XML to create an object with an ID that was already used on an existing object.
solution: Rename the new object or delete the existing one.

message: Object type " string " is invalid for export.
cause: An attempt was made to export an object of an inappropriate type. Only objects of type analytic workspace, database schema, cube, cube dimension, measure folder, and cube build process are allowed for export.
solution: If the object is a subobject of a cube or cube dimension, then call the export procedure passing the cube or cube dimension as an argument instead of the object itself.

message: invalid XML attribute " string " with value " string " for element " string "
cause: An XML attribute in the XML document was invalid.
solution: Correct the invalid attribute in the XML document.

message: Unable to parse XML because the compatibility setting is below the minimum setting of 11.0.0.0.0.
cause: The compatibility setting was below the minimum for parsing XML.
solution: Set the compatibility to 11.0.0.0.0 or higher.

message: Unable to write XML because the compatibility setting is below the minimum setting of 11.0.0.0.0.
cause: The compatibility setting was below the minimum for writing XML.
solution: Set the compatibility to 11.0.0.0.0 or higher.

message: Metadata object type " string " cannot be renamed on import.
cause: The object type in the rename table was not a leaf object type, or the leaf object type could not be renamed.
solution: Enter a valid object type in the rename table.

message: Metadata object id " string " is not valid.
cause: The object id in the rename table was null or contained invalid characters.
solution: Enter a valid object id in the rename table.

message: The new name " string " for object " string " is not valid.
cause: The new name in the rename table was either null or empty.
solution: Enter a valid new name in the rename table.

message: Two new names for object " string " with type " string " are in the rename table.
cause: The rename table contained two different new names for the same object.
solution: Remove one of the rows from the rename table.

message: cannot upgrade object " string "
cause: The object could not be upgraded.
solution: Apply the modifications suggested by the other error messages that typically accompany this one. Then attempt the upgrade again. If you cannot correct the error, try exporting the XML definition for the object using DBMS_CUBE.EXPORT_XML, and reimporting the object into a different schema.

message: object " string " not found
cause: The upgrade command referred to an object that did not exist.
solution: Correct the object identifier and try again.

message: Object " string " cannot be upgraded because its name is the same as an existing object.
cause: The upgrade failed because the object name was the same as the name of an existing object. In earlier versions of Oracle Database, a cube, dimension, or measure folder could have the same name as a database table. In Oracle Database 11g and later, cubes, dimensions, measure folders, and RDBMS tables must all have different names.
solution: Change the object name and try the upgrade again.

message: Analytic workspace " string " cannot be upgraded because it contains customization " string ".
cause: The upgrade failed because the analytic workspace contained a customization. Customizations are not supported in releases after Oracle Database 10g.
solution: Remove the customization and attempt the upgrade again. To remove all customizations, call the upgrade procedure with the DeleteCustomizations option set to YES.

message: Cannot upgrade object " string ": only analytic workspaces and database schemas are valid arguments to the UPGRADE command.
cause: The identified argument of the UPGRADE command was an object that was neither type oracle.olapi.metadata.mdm.MdmDatabaseSchema nor type oracle.olapi.metadata.deployment.AW.
solution: If the object is in an analytic workspace or a database schema, call the UPGRADE command and use the analytic workspace or the database schema as an argument instead of the object.

message: Cannot upgrade analytic workspace " string ": the analytic workspace version is too old.
cause: An attempt was made to upgrade an analytic workspace that was formatted for Oracle Database 10.1.0.2 or earlier. Only analytic workspaces from Oracle Database 10.1.0.3 and later can be upgraded using DBMS_CUBE.UPGRADE.
solution: Upgrade the analytic workspace to release 10.1.0.3 or later using methods described in the OLAP documentation for Oracle 10.1.0.3. Then use DBMS_CUBE.UPGRADE to upgrade the analytic workspace to Release 11g.

message: Cannot upgrade object " string ": the metadata is already using the current version.
cause: An attempt was made to upgrade an analytic workspace that is already formatted correctly for the current version.
solution: Do not use the DBMS_CUBE.UPGRADE facility for this analytic workspace.

message: cannot process mapping " string ": string
cause: An object stored in an Oracle Database 10g analytic workspace contained an invalid mapping.
solution: Replace the mapping with a valid one. If the problem persists, set the IgnoreMappingErrors option to YES in the UPGRADE or COMMIT options.

message: Object contains multiple mappings.
cause: A dimension or measure stored in an Oracle OLAP 10g analytic workspace contained multiple mappings. This is not supported in releases after Oracle Database 10g.
solution: Modify the object to use only one mapping. If the problem persists, set the IgnoreMappingErrors option to YES in the UPGRADE or COMMIT options.

message: cannot process aggregation " string ": string
cause: An object stored in an Oracle Database 10g analytic workspace contained an invalid aggregation.
solution: Replace the aggregation with a valid one. If the problem persists, set the IgnoreMappingErrors option to YES in the UPGRADE or COMMIT options.

message: Legacy metadata contains invalid mappings.
cause: An object stored in an Oracle Database 10g analytic workspace contained mappings that could not be converted to post-10g format.
solution: Examine the list of invalid mappings and correct the errors reported for each object using Analytic Workspace Manager in 10g compatibility mode. If the problem persists, set the IgnoreMappingErrors option to YES in the UPGRADE or COMMIT options.

message: The MdmPrimaryDimension cannot be upgraded because a compile step failed with this message: " string ".
cause: A dimension could not be compiled.
solution: Correct the compilation errors in the analytic workspace. If the problem persists, set the IgnoreCompileErrors option to YES in the UPGRADE options. This allows other objects in the analytic workspace to be upgraded. Then fix and recompile the problem dimension so you can use it.

message: The expression for this MdmMeasure cannot be read. Analytic workspace " string " was not attached when the connection was opened.
cause: The Oracle Database 10g analytic workspace contained a derived measure. Derived measures can only be upgraded if the analytic workspace is attached before the first call to DataProvider.createSession or DataProvider.initialize.
solution: Attach the analytic workspace before calling DataProvider.createSession or DataProvider.initialize. Alternatively, set the IgnoreMappingErrors option to YES in the UPGRADE or COMMIT options to suppress this error message. The derived measure will become an MdmBaseMeasure after the upgrade.

message: cannot read legacy metadata
cause: The database contained metadata stored in an Oracle Database 10g analytic workspace or in CWM format. The metadata could not be converted to post-10g format because of problems in the stored metadata.
solution: Examine the list of errors and make corrections to the metadata using Analytic Workspace Manager in 10g compatibility mode. If the problem persists and is preventing you from accessing 11g metadata, set the MetadataReaderMode option to 11_ONLY in the connection properties.

message: error reading legacy metadata object: string
cause: One of the metadata objects, which was stored in either an Oracle Database 10g analytic workspace or CWM format, could not be converted to post-10g format.
solution: Make corrections to the metadata using Analytic Workspace Manager in 10g compatibility mode. If the problem persists and is preventing you from accessing post-10g metadata, set the MetadataReaderMode option to 11_ONLY in the connection properties.

message: Build completed with warnings.
cause: The build completed successfully, but some of the data may be incorrect due to inconsistencies in the metadata or input data.

message: Derived attribute " string " is not a DIM_KEY.
cause: The derived attribute specified in the CUSTOMORDER clause was not the DIM_KEY. A derived attribute in a CUSTOMORDER clause can only be the DIM_KEY.
solution: Specify the DIM_KEY or use a base attribute in the CUSTOMORDER clause.

message: Attribute " string " is not part of the primary dimension.
cause: The attribute specified in the CUSTOMORDER clause was not part of the primary dimension. An attribute in the CUSTOMORDER clause must be part of the primary dimension.
solution: Specify an attribute of the CUSTOMORDER clause that is part of the primary dimension.

message: Attribute " string " is not a visible attribute of the hierarchy.
cause: The attribute specified in the CUSTOMORDER clause was not a visible attribute of the hierarchy. An attribute in the CUSTOMORDER clause of a hierarchy must be a visible attribute of the hierarchy.
solution: Specify a visible attribute in the CUSTOMORDER clause of the hierarchy.

message: No attribute is specified for the CUSTOMORDER clause.
cause: The object specified in the CUSTOMORDER clause was not an attribute. Only an attribute can be specified in the CUSTOMORDER clause.
solution: Specify an attribute in the CUSTOMORDER clause.

message: The object contains multiple descriptions of type " string " for the language " string ".

solution: Ensure there is only one description on an object for each type for each language.

message: The CubeMap for cube " string " contains both a query and a From clause.
cause: The CubeMap had a query and a From clause.
solution: Specify either a query or a From clause for the CubeMap but not both.

message: The DimensionMap for dimension " string " contains both a query and a From clause.
cause: The DimensionMap had a query and a From clause.
solution: Specify either a query or From clause for the DimensionMap but not both.

message: The DimensionMap for dimension " string " contains a From clause with duplicate queries.
cause: The DimensionMap had a From clause with duplicate queries.
solution: Remove the duplicate queries in the From clause for the DimensionMap.

message: The CubeMap for cube " string " contains a From clause with duplicate queries.
cause: The CubeMap had a From clause with duplicate queries.
solution: Remove the duplicate queries in the From clause for the CubeMap.

message: Analytic workspace " string " has an invalid name.
cause: An attempt was made to create an analytic workspace with an invalid name. Analytic workspace names cannot contain lower-case letters.
solution: Change the analytic workspace name to a valid name, and commit the transaction.

solution: Remove multiple queries in the From Clause for the SolvedMap.

cause: The AWCubeOrganization had a cube storage data type of DATE, which was incompatible with materialized views.
solution: Either change the cube storage data type to DATETIME or create the cube without materialized views.

message: string XOQ-02512: OLAP DML error while compiling formula for measure " string "
cause: The measure expression in the derived measure could not be compiled.
solution: Redefine the measure expression for the derived measure.

message: A rewrite materialize view cannot be created for cube " string " because the aggregation from the consistent solve specification is incompatible.
cause: The consistent solve specification specified an aggregation that was not uniform over all dimensions and hierarchies or was not one of the supported aggregation operators.
solution: Change the aggregation on the consistent solve specification to be uniform and one of the supported aggregation types.

message: The attribute " string " is mapped to different expressions on the two HierarchyLevels " string " and " string ".
cause: An attribute was mapped to different expressions on two different HierarchyLevels that have the same DimensionLevel.
solution: Change the attribute mappings so that the target expression is the same on all HierarchyLevels having the same DimensionLevel.

message: The MVCreationOptions of REFRESH ON COMMIT, REFRESH START WITH, and REFRESH NEXT are not supported.
cause: The MVCreationOptions of either an AWPrimaryDimensionOrganization or an AWCubeOrganization contained unsupported settings.
solution: Ensure that the MVCreationOptions of AWPrimaryDimensionOrganizations and AWCubeOrganizations do not set REFRESH ON COMMIT and do not specify REFRESH START WITH or REFRESH NEXT.

message: The MdmValueHierarchy has no value hierarchy map.
cause: The MdmValueHierarchy did not contain a value hierarchy map.
solution: Add a SolvedValueHierarchyMap to all value hierarchies contained in dimensions with associated materialized views.

message: The data type " string " of the base attribute or base measure is different from the mapped expression " string ".
cause: Either the base attribute or base measure with the mapped expression was set to an inconsistent data type, or it was mapped to an expression of a different data type from its fixed data type.
solution: When changing a mapped expression for a base attribute or base measure, ensure that the expression has the same data type; otherwise, set the data type of the base attribute or base measure to NULL first. When a base attribute or a base measure has an existing mapped expression, do not set it to a different data type.

solution: "Change the mapped dimension in the cube dimensionality map of a query-rewrite-enabled cube materialized view to a hierarchy level or a dimension level that is the lowest hierarchy level on all hierarchies in the dimension."

message: The sparse type must be COMPRESSED or SPARSE when a secondary partition level is specified.
